translations.translation: zuru karachi AllAhara nAme yini parama karuNAmaYa, ati daYAlu|
sakala prazaMsA jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAharai,
yini daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu,
karmaphala divasera mAlika|
AmarA zudhu tomArai ‘ivAdata kari, zudhu tomArai sAhAyya prArthanA kari,
AmAderake sarala patha pradarzana kara,
tAdera patha, yAderake tumi anugraha dAna karecha, tAdera patha naYa yArA krodha-nipatita o pathabhraSTa|
Aliph-lAma-mIma,
ei se kitAva; ete kona sandeha nei, muttAkIdera janye eTA patha-nirdeza,
yArA adRzye ImAna Ane, sAlAta kAYema kare o tAderake ye jIvanopakaraNa dAna karechi tA hate vyaYa kare,
evaM tomAra prati yA nAyila haYeche o tomAra pUrve yA nAyila haYeche tAte yArA ImAna Ane o AkhirAte yArA nizcita vizvAsI,
tArAi tAdera pratipAlaka-nirdezita pathe Ache evaM tArAi saphalakAma|
yArA kupharI kareche tumi tAderake satarka kara vA nA kara, tAdera pakSe ubhaYai samAna; tArA ImAna Anave nA|
AllAh tAdera hRdaYa o karNa mohara kare diYechena, tAdera cokhera opara AvaraNa raYeche evaM tAdera janye Ache mahAzAsti|
Ara mAnuSera madhye emana lokao Ache yArA vale, ‘AmarA AllAh o AkhirAte ImAna enechi’, kintu tArA mu’mina naYa;
AllAh o mu’minagaNake tArA pratArita karate cAYa| athaca tArA ye nijederake bhinna kAukeo pratArita kare nA, eTA tArA vujhate pAre nA|
tAdera antare vyAdhi Ache| erapara AllAh tAdera vyAdhi vRddhi karechena evaM tAdera janye Ache kaSTadAYaka zAsti, kAraNa tArA mithyAvAdI|
tAderake yakhana valA haYa, ‘pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kara nA’, tArA vale, ‘AmarAi to zAnti sthApanakArI’|
sAvadhAna! erAi azAnti sRSTikArI, kintu erA vujhate pAre nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ye sakala loka ImAna eneche tomarAo tAdera mata ImAna AnaYana kara, tArA vale, ‘nirveAdhagaNa yerUpa ImAna eneche AmarAo ki serUpa ImAna Anava?’ sAvadhAna! erAi nirveAdha, kintu erA jAne nA|

yakhana tArA mu’minagaNera saMsparze Ase takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’; Ara yakhana tArA nibhRte tAdera zaYatAnadera saGge milita haYa takhana vale, ‘AmarA to tomAdera saGgei raYechi; AmarA zudhu tAdera saGge ThATTA-tAmAzA kare thAki|’
AllAh tAdera saGge tAmAzA karena evaM tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa vibhrAntera nyAYa ghure ver3Anora avakAza dena|
erAi hidAYAtera vinimaYe bhrAnti kraYa kareche| sutarAM tAdera vyavasA lAbhajanaka haYa nAi, tArA satpatheo paricAlita naYa|

tAdera upamA: yemana eka vyakti agni prajvalita karala; eTi yakhana tAra caturdika Alokita karala AllAh takhana tAdera jyoti apasArita karalena evaM tAderake ghora andhakAre phele dilena, tArA kichui dekhate pAYa nA-
tArA vadhira, mUka, andha, sutarAM tArA phirave nA|

kiMvA yemana AkAzera varSaNamukhara ghana megha-yAte Ache ghora andhakAra, vajradhvani o vidyut-camaka| vajradhvanite mRtyubhaYe tArA tAdera karNe aGguli praveza karAYa| AllAh kAphiradera pariveSTana kare Achena|

vidyut-camaka tAdera dRSTizakti prAYa kor3e neYa| yakhanai vidyutAloka tAdera sAmane udbhAsita haYa tArA takhanai tAte patha calate thAke evaM yakhana tArA andhakAre Acchanna haYa, takhana tArA thamake dA~r3AYa| nizcaYai AllAh icchA karale tAdera zravaNa o dRSTizakti haraNa karatena| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera sei pratipAlakera ‘ivAdata kara yini tomAdera o tomAdera pUrvavartIgaNake sRSTi karechena yAte tomarA muttAkI hate pAra,

yini pRthivIke tomAdera janye vichAnA o AkAzake chAda karechena evaM AkAza hate pAni varSaNa kare tA diYe tomAdera jIvikAra janye phalamUla utpAdana karena| sutarAM tomarA jene-zune kAukeo AllAh ra samakakSa dA~r3a kara nA|

Ami AmAra vAndAra prati yA avatIrNa karechi tAte tomAdera kona sandeha thAkale tomarA era anurUpa kona sUrA AnaYana kara evaM tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave AllAh vyatIta tomAdera sakala sAhAyyakArIke AhvAna kara|
yadi tomarA AnaYana nA kara Ara kakhanai karate pArave nA, tave sei Agunake bhaYa kara, mAnuSa o pAthara have yAra indhana, kAphiradera janye yA prastuta kare rAkhA haYeche|

yArA ImAna AnaYana kare o satkarma kare tAderake zubha saMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janye Ache jAnnAta-yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita| yakhanai tAderake phalamUla khete deoYA have takhanai tArA valave, ‘AmAderake pUrve jIvikArUpe yA deoYA hata eTA to tAi; tAderake anurUpa phalai deoYA have Ara sekhAne tAdera janye pavitra saGginI raYeche, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

AllAh mazA kiMvA tadapekSA kSudra kona vastura upamA dite saMkoca vodha karena nA| sutarAM yArA ImAna eneche tArA jAne ye, nizcaYai eTA satya-yA tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate eseche| kintu yArA kAphira tArA vale, AllAh kI abhiprAYe e upamA peza karechena? eTA diYe anekakei tini vibhrAnta karena, AvAra vahu lokake satpathe paricAlita karena| vastuta tini patha-parityAgakArIgaNa vyatIta Ara kAukeo vibhrAnta karena nA-
yArA AllAh ra saGge dRr3ha aGgIkAre Avaddha haoYAra para tA bhaGga kare, ye samparka akSuNNa rAkhate AllAh Adeza karechena tA chinna kare Ara duniYAYa azAnti sRSTi kare ver3AYa, tArAi kSatigrasta|

tomarA kirUpe AllAhke asvIkAra kara? athaca tomarA chile prANahIna, tini tomAderake jIvanta karechena, AvAra tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena o punarAYa jIvanta karavena, pariNAme tA~ra dikei tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|
tini pRthivIra savakichu tomAdera janye sRSTi karechena, tatpara tini AkAzera dike manosaMyoga karena evaM eke saptAkAze vinyasta karena; tini sarvaviSaYe savizeSa avahita|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka phirizatAdera valalena, ‘Ami pRthivIte pratinidhi sRSTi karachi’, tArA valala, ‘Apani ki sekhAne emana kAukeo sRSTi karavena, ye azAnti ghaTAve o raktapAta karave? AmarAi to ApanAra saprazaMsa stutigAna o pavitratA ghoSaNA kari| tini valalena, ‘nizcaYai Ami yA jAni tA tomarA jAna nA|’
Ara tini Adamake yAvatIYa nAma zikSA dilena, tArapara sei samudaYa phirizatAdera sAmane prakAza karalena evaM valalena, ‘ei samudaYera nAma AmAke vale dAo, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
tArA valala, ‘Apani mahAna, pavitra| Apani AmAderake yA zikSA diYechena tA chAr3A AmAdera to kona jJAnai nei| vastuta Apani jJAnamaYa o prajJAmaYa|’

tini valalena, ‘he Adama! tAderake e sakala nAma vale dAo|’ se tAderake ei sakalera nAma vale dile tini valalena, ‘Ami ki tomAderake vali nAi ye, AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra adRzya vastu samvandhe Ami nizcitabhAve avahita Ara tomarA yA vyakta kara vA gopana rAkha Ami tAo jAni?’
yakhana Ami phirizatAdera valalAma, ‘Adamake sijdA kara’, takhana ivalisa vyatIta sakalei sijdA karala; se amAnya karala o ahaMkAra karala| sutarAM se kAphiradera antarbhukta hala|
Ara Ami valalAma, ‘he Adama! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa kara evaM yethA icchA svacchande AhAra kara, kintu e vRkSera nikaTavartI haYo nA; hale tomarA anyAYakArIdera antarbhukta have|’

kintu zaYatAna eTA hate tAdera padaskhalana ghaTAla evaM tArA yekhAne chila sekhAna hate tAderake vahiSkAra karala| Ami valalAma, ‘tomarA eke anyera zatrurUpe neme yAo, pRthivIte kichukAlera janye tomAdera vasavAsa o jIvikA thAkala|’
erapara Adama tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate kichu vANI prApta hala| AllAh tAra prati kSamAparavaza halena| nizcaYai tini atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ami valalAma, ‘tomarA sakalei e sthAna hate neme yAo| pare yakhana AmAra pakSa hate tomAdera nikaTa satpathera kona nirdeza Asave takhana yArA AmAra satpathera nirdeza anusaraNa karave tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|’
yArA kupharI karave evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUhake asvIkAra karave tArAi agnivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|

he vanI isarAIla! AmAra sei anugrahake tomarA smaraNa kara yA diYe Ami tomAderake anugRhIta karechi Ara AmAra saGge tomAdera aGgIkAra pUrNa kara, Amio tomAdera saGge AmAra aGgIkAra pUrNa karava| Ara tomarA zudhu AmAkei bhaYa kara|

Ami yA avatIrNa karechi tomarA tAte ImAna Ana| eTA tomAdera nikaTa yA Ache tAra satyAYanakArI| Ara tomarAi tAra prathama pratyAkhyAnakArI haYo nA evaM AmAra AYAtera vinimaYe tuccha mUlya grahaNa kara nA| tomarA zudhu AmAkei bhaYa kara|
tomarA satyake mithyAra saGge mizrita kara nA Ara jene-zune satya gopana kara nA|
tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara o yAkAta dAo evaM yArA ruka‚‘ kare tAdera saGge ruka‚‘ kara|
tomarA ki mAnuSake satkarmera nirdeza dAo, Ara nijaderake vismRta hao? athaca tomarA kitAva adhyaYana kara| tave ki tomarA vujha nA?
tomarA dhairya o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya prArthanA kara Ara eTA vinItagaNa vyatIta Ara sakalera nikaTa nizcitabhAve kaThina|
tArAi vinIta yArA vizvAsa kare ye, tAdera pratipAlakera saGge nizcitabhAve tAdera sAkSAtkAra ghaTave evaM tA~rai dike tArA phire yAve|
he vanI isarAIla! AmAra sei anugrahake smaraNa kara yAra mAdhyame Ami tomAderake anugRhIta karechilAma evaM vizve savAra upare zreSThatva diYechilAma|
tomarA sei dinake bhaYa kara yedina keu kArao kona kAje Asave nA, kArao supAriza grahaNa karA have nA, kArao nikaTa hate vinimaYa gRhIta have nA evaM tArA kona prakAra sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami phira‘AonI sampradAYa hate tomAderake niSkRti diYechilAma, yArA tomAdera putragaNake yaveh kare o tomAdera nArIgaNake jIvita rekhe tomAderake marmAntika yantraNA dita; Ara ete tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka mahAparIkSA chila;
yakhana tomAdera janye sAgarake dvidhAvibhakta karechilAma Ara tomAderake uddhAra karechilAma evaM phira‘AonI sampradAYake nimajjita karechilAma Ara tomarA tA pratyakSa karachile|
yakhana mUsAra janye calliza rAtri nirdhArita karechilAma, tAra prasthAnera para tomarA takhana govatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechile; Ara tomarA to jAlima|
era parao Ami tomAderake kSamA karechi, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA jJApana kara|
Ara yakhana Ami mUsAke kitAva o ‘phurakAna’ dAna karechilAma yAte tomarA hidAYAtaprApta hao|

Ara yakhana mUsA Apana sampradAYera lokake valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! go-vatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa kare tomarA nijedera prati ghora atyAcAra karecha, sutarAM tomarA tomAdera sraSTAra pAne phire yAo evaM tomarA nijederake hatyA kara| tomAdera sraSTAra nikaTa eTAi zreYa| tini tomAdera prati kSamAparavaza havena| tini atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
yakhana tomarA valechile, ‘he mUsA! AmarA AllAhake pratyakSabhAve nA dekhA paryanta tomAke kakhanao vizvAsa karava nA’, takhana tomarA vajrAhata haYechile Ara tomarA nijerAi dekhachile|
erapara tomAdera mRtyura para Ami tomAderake punarjIvita karalAma yAte tomarA kRtajJatA jJApana kara|

Ami megha diYe tomAdera opara chAYA vistAra karalAma Ara tomAdera nikaTa mAnnA o sAloYA preraNa karalAma| valechilAma, ‘tomAderake ye uttama jIvikA dAna karechi tA hate AhAra kara|’ tArA ‘AmAra prati kona juluma kare nAi, varaM tArA tAdera pratii juluma karechila|’

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami valalAma, ‘e janapade praveza kara, yethA icchA svacchande AhAra kara, natazire praveza kara dvAra diYe evaM vala: ‘kSamA cAi’| ‘Ami tomAdera aparAdha kSamA karava evaM satkarmaparAYaNa lokadera prati AmAra dAna vRddhi karava|’
kintu yArA anyAYa karechila tArA tAderake yA valA haYechila tAra parivarte anya kathA valala| sutarAM anAcArIdera prati Ami AkAza hate zAsti preraNa karalAma, kAraNa tArA satya tyAga karechila|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYera janye pAni prArthanA karala, Ami valalAma, ‘tomAra lAThi diYe pAthare AghAta kara|’ phale eTi hate dvAdaza prasravaNa pravAhita hala| pratyeka gotra nija nija pAna-sthAna cine nila| valalAma, ‘AllAh-pradatta jIvikA hate tomarA pAnAhAra kara evaM duSkRtikArIrUpe pRthivIte nairAjya sRSTi kare ver3io nA|’

yakhana tomarA valechile, ‘he mUsA! AmarA ekairakama khAdye kakhanao dhairya dhAraNa karava nA; sutarAM tumi tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa AmAdera janye prArthanA kara-tini yena bha‚mijAta dravya zAka-savji, kA~kur3a, gama, masura o pe~YAja AmAdera janye utpAdana karena|’ mUsA valala, ‘tomarA ki utkRSTatara vastuke nikRSTatara vastura saGge vadala karate cAo? tave kona nagare avataraNa kara| tomarA yA cAo nizcaYai tA sekhAne Ache|’ tArA lAJchanA o dAridryagrasta hala Ara tArA AllAh ra krodhera pAtra hala| eTA eijanye ye, tArA AllAh ra AYAtake asvIkAra karata Ara navIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| avAdhyatA o sImAlaMghana karAra janyei tAdera ei pariNati haYechila|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche, yArA iYAha‚dI haYeche evaM khrisTAna o sAviIna-yArAi AllAh o AkhirAte ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, tAdera janye puraskAra Ache tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa| tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAdera aGgIkAra niYechilAma evaM ‘ta‚ra’ke tomAdera Urdhve uttolana karechilAma; valechilAma, ‘Ami yA dilAma dRr3hatAra saGge grahaNa kara Ara tAte yA Ache tA smaraNa rAkha, yAte tomarA sAvadhAna haYe calate pAra|’
era pareo tomarA mukha phirAle| AllAh ra anugraha o anukampA tomAdera prati nA thAkale tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta hate|
tomAdera madhye yArA zanivAra samparke sImAlaMghana karechila tAderake tomarA nizcitabhAve jAna| Ami tAdera valechilAma, ‘tomarA ghRNita vAnara hao|’
Ami eTA tAdera samasAmaYika o paravartigaNera zikSA grahaNera janye dRSTAnta o muttAkIdera janye upadezasvarUpa karechi|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA Apana sampradAYake valechila, ‘nizcaYai AllAh tomAderake ekaTi garu yaveha karAra Adeza diYechena’, tArA valechila, ‘tumi ki AmAdera saGge ThATTA karacha?’ mUsA valala, ‘AllAh ra zaraNa nicchi yAte Ami ajJadera antarbhukta nA hai|

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera janye tomAra pratipAlakake spaSTabhAve jAniYe dite vala, seTA kirUpa?’ mUsA valala, ‘AllAh valachena, eTA emana garu yA vRddhao naYa, alpavaYaskao naYa-madhyavaYasI| sutarAM tomarA yA AdiSTa haYecha tA kara|’

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera janye tomAra pratipAlakake spaSTabhAve jAniYe dite vala, era raM ki?’ mUsA valala, ‘AllAh valachena, eTA haluda varNera garu, era raM ujjvala gAr3ha, yA darzakadera Ananda deYa|’
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera janye tomAra pratipAlakake spaSTabhAve jAniYe dite vala, oTA konTi? AmarA garuTi samparke sandehe patita haYechi Ara AllAh icchA karale nizcaYa AmarA dizA pAva|’

mUsA valala, ‘tini valachena, eTA emana eka garu yA jami cASe o kSete pAni secera janye vyavahRta haYa nAi-sustha nikhu~ta|’ tArA valala, ‘ekhana tumi satya enecha|’ yadio tArA yaveha karate udyata chila nA, tavuo tArA oTAke yaveha karala|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA eka vyaktike hatyA karechile Ara eke anyera prati doSAropa karachile-tomarA yA gopana rAkhachile AllAh tA vyakta karachena|
Ami valalAma, ‘era kona aMza diYe eTAke AghAta kara|’ eibhAve AllAh mRtake jIvita karena evaM tA~ra nidarzana tomAderake dekhiYe thAkena, yAte tomarA anudhAvana karate pAra|

era parao tomAdera hRdaYa kaThina haYe gela, eTA pASANa kiMvA tadapekSA kaThina| kichu pAtharao emana ye, tA hate nadI-nAlA pravAhita haYa evaM kichu eirUpa ye, vidIrNa haoYAra para tA hate pAni nirgata haYa, AvAra kichu emana yA AllAh ra bhaYe dhase par3e| tomarA yA kara AllAh se samvandhe anavahita nana|
tomarA ki e AzA kara ye, tArA tomAdera kathAYa ImAna Anave-yakhana tAdera ekadala AllAh ra vANI zravaNa kare; erapara tArA tA hRdaYaGgama karAra parao vikRta kare, athaca tArA jAne|

tArA yakhana mu’minadera saMsparze Ase takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’, AvAra yakhana tArA nibhRte eke anyera saGge milita haYa takhana vale, ‘AllAh tomAdera kAche yA vyakta karechena tomarA ki tA tAderake vale dAo? e diYe tArA tomAdera pratipAlakera sAmane tomAdera viruddhe yukti peza karave; tomarA ki anudhAvana kara nA?’
tArA ki jAne nA ye, yA tArA gopana rAkhe kiMvA ghoSaNA kare nizcitabhAve AllAh tA jAnena?
tAdera madhye emana kichu nirakSara loka Ache yAdera mithyA AzA vyatIta kitAva samvandhe kona jJAna nei, tArA zudhu amUlaka dhAraNA poSaNa kare|

sutarAM durbheAga tAdera janye yArA nija hAte kitAva racanA kare evaM tuccha mUlya prAptira janye vale, ‘eTA AllAh ra nikaTa hate|’ tAdera hAta yA racanA kareche tAra janye zAsti tAdera evaM yA tArA upArjana kare tAra janye zAsti tAdera|

tArA vale, ‘dinakataka vyatIta agni AmAderake kakhanao sparza karave nA|’ vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAh ra nikaTa hate aGgIkAra niYecha; kAjei AllAh tA~ra aGgIkAra kakhanao bhaGga karavena nA kiMvA AllAh samvandhe emana kichu valacha yA tomarA jAna nA?’
hA~, yArA pApakAja kare evaM yAdera pAparAzi tAderake pariveSTana kare tArAi dojakhavAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare tArAi jAnnAtavAsI, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

smaraNa kara, yakhana vanI isrAIlera aGgIkAra niYechilAma, tomarA AllAh vyatIta anya kArao ‘ivAdata karave nA, mAtApitA, AtmIYa-svajana, pitRhIna o daridradera prati sadaYa vyavahAra karave evaM mAnuSera saGge sadAlApa karave, sAlAta kAYema karave o yAkAta dive, kintu svalpasaMkhyaka loka vyatIta tomarA viruddhabhAvApanna haYe mukha phiriYe niYechile|
-yakhana tomAdera aGgIkAra niYechilAma ye, tomarA parasparera raktapAta karave nA Ara Apanajanake svadeza hate vahiSkAra karave nA, erapara tomarA tA svIkAra karechile, Ara ei viSaYe tomarAi sAkSI|

tomarAi tArA yArA erapara eke anyake hatyA karacho evaM tomAdera eka dalake svadeza hate vahiSkAra karacho, tomarA nijerA tAdera viruddhe anyAYa o sImAlaMghana diYe parasparera pRSThapoSakatA karacho Ara tArA yakhana vandIrUpe tomAdera nikaTa upasthita haYa takhana tomarA muktipaNa dAo; athaca tAdera vahiSkaraNai tomAdera janye avaidha chila| tave ki tomarA kitAvera kichu aMze vizvAsa kara evaM kichu aMzake pratyAkhyAna kara? sutarAM tomAdera madhye yArA erUpa kare tAdera ekamAtra pratiphala pArthiva jIvane hInatA evaM kiYAmatera dina tArA kaThinatama zAstira dike nikSipta have| tArA yA kare AllAh se samvandhe anavahita nana|
tArAi AkhirAtera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvana kraYa kare; sutarAM tAdera zAsti lAghava karA have nA evaM tArA kona sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

evaM nizcaYa Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tAra pare paryAYakrame rAsUlagaNake preraNa karechi, mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsAke spaSTa pramANa diYechi Ara ‘pavitra AtmA’ diYe tAke zaktizAlI karechi| tave ki yakhanai kona rAsUla tomAdera nikaTa emana kichu eneche yA tomAdera manaHpUta naYa takhanai tomarA ahaMkAra karecha Ara katakake asvIkAra karecha Ara katakake hatyA karecha?
tArA valechila, ‘AmAdera hRdaYa AcchAdita’, varaM kupharIra janye AllAh tAderake lA‘nata karechena| sutarAM tAdera alpasaMkhyakai ImAna Ane|

tAdera nikaTa yA Ache AllAh ra nikaTa hate yakhana tAra pratyAYanakArI kitAva elo; yadio pUrve satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera viruddhe tArA era sAhAyye vijaYa prArthanA karata, tavuo tArA yA jJAta chila tA yakhana tAdera nikaTa elo takhana tArA tA pratyAkhyAna karala| sutarAM kAphiradera prati AllAh ra lA‘nata|

eTA kata nikRSTa yAra vinimaYe tArA tAdera AtmAke vikraYa kareche-tA ei ye, AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena, jidera vazavartI haYe tArA tAke pratyAkhyAna karata zudhu e kAraNe ye, AllAh tA~ra vAndAdera madhya hate yAke icchA anugraha karena| sutarAM tArA krodhera opara krodhera pAtra hala| kAphiradera janye lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti Ache|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena tAte ImAna AnaYana kara’, tArA vale, ‘AmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche AmarA tAte vizvAsa kari|’ athaca tA vyatIta sava kichui tArA pratyAkhyAna kare, yadio eTA satya evaM yA tAdera nikaTa Ache tAra pratyAYanakArI| vala, ‘yadi tomarA mu’mina hate tave kena tomarA atIte AllAh ra navIgaNake hatyA karechile?’
Ara nizcaYa mUsA tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANasaha eseche, tAra pare tomarA go-vatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechile| Ara tomarA to jAlima|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAdera aGgIkAra niYechilAma evaM ta‚rake tomAdera Urdhve uttolana karechilAma, valechilAma, ‘yA dilAma dRr3harUpe grahaNa kara evaM zono|’ tArA valechila, ‘AmarA zonolAma o amAnya karalAma| kupharIra kAraNe tAdera hRdaYe go-vatsaprIti siJcita haYechila| vala, ‘yadi tomarA ImAnadAra hao, tave tomAdera ImAna yAra nirdeza deYa tA kata nikRSTa|’
vala, ‘yadi AllAh ra nikaTa AkhirAtera vAsasthAna anya loka vyatIta vizeSabhAve zudhu tomAdera janyei haYa tave tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara-yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
kintu tAdera kRtakarmera janye tArA kakhanao tA kAmanA karave nA Ara AllAh jAlimadera samvandhe samyaka avahita|

tumi nizcaYa tAderake jIvanera prati samasta mAnuSa, emana ki muzarika apekSAo adhika lobhI dekhate pAve| tAdera pratyeke AkAGkSA kare yadi sahasra vatsara AYu deoYA hato; kintu dIrghAYu tAke zAsti hate dUre rAkhate pArave nA| tArA yA kare AllAh tAra draSTA|
vala, ‘ye keu jivrIlera zatru ejanye ye, se AllAh ra nirdeze tomAra hRdaYe kuraAna peৗ~che diYeche, yA era pUrvavartI kitAvera samarthaka evaM yA mu’minadera janye pathapradarzaka o zubha saMvAda’-
‘ye keu AllAh ra, tA~ra phirizatAgaNera, tA~ra rAsUlagaNera evaM jivrIla o mIkAIlera zatru se jene rAkhuka, AllAh nizcaYai kAphiradera zatru|’
Ara nizcaYai Ami tomAra prati spaSTa AYAtasamUha nAyila karechi| phAsikarA vyatIta anya keu tA pratyAkhyAna kare nA|
tave ki yakhanai tArA aGgIkArAvaddha haYeche takhanai tAdera kona ekadala tA bhaGga kareche? varaM tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|

yakhana AllAh ra pakSa hate tAdera nikaTa rAsUla elo, ye tAdera nikaTa yA Ache tAra pratyAYanakArI, takhana yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila tAdera ekadala AllAh ra kitAvaTike pazcAte nikSepa karala, yena tArA jAne nA|

Ara sulAYamAnera rAjatve zaYatAnarA yA AvRtti karata tArA tA anusaraNa karata| sulAYamAna kupharI kare nAi, varaM zaYatAnarAi kupharI karechila| tArA mAnuSake jAdu zikSA dita evaM yA vAvila zahare hArUta o mArUta pherezatAdvaYera opara avatIrNa haYechila| tArA kAukeo zikSA dita nA e kathA nA vale ye, ‘AmarA parIkSAsvarUpa; sutarAM tumi kupharI kara nA|’ tArA ubhaYera nikaTa hate svAmI-strIra madhye yA viccheda sRSTi kare tA zikSA karata, athaca AllAh ra nirdeza vyatIta tArA kArao kona kSati sAdhana karate pArata nA| tArA yA zikSA karata tA tAdera kSati sAdhana karata evaM kona upakAre Asata nA; Ara tArA nizcitabhAve jAnata ye, ye keu tA kraYa kare parakAle tAra kona aMza nei| eTA kata nikRSTa, yAra vinimaYe tArA svIYa AtmAke vikraYa kareche, yadi tArA jAnata!
yadi tArA ImAna AnaYana karata o muttAkI hata, tave nizcitabhAve tAdera pratiphala AllAh ra nikaTa adhika kalyANakara hata, yadi tArA jAnata!
he mu’minagaNa! ‘rAinA’ vala nA, varaM ‘unajuranA’ vala evaM zune rAkha, kAphiradera janye marmantuda zAsti raYeche|

kitAvIdera madhye yArA kupharI kareche tArA evaM muzarikarA eTA cAYa nA ye, tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera prati kona kalyANa avatIrNa hoka| athaca AllAh yAke icchA nija rahamatera janye vizeSarUpe manonIta karena evaM AllAh mahA anugrahazIla|
Ami kona AYAta rahita karale kiMvA vismRta hate dile tA hate uttama kiMvA tAra samatulya kona AYAta AnaYana kari| tumi ki jAna nA ye, AllAhi sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tumi ki jAna nA, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva ekamAtra AllAh ra i? evaM AllAh chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvakao nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tomarA ki tomAdera rAsUlake seirUpa prazna karate cAo, yeirUpa pUrve mUsAke prazna karA haYechila? Ara ye keu ImAnera parivarte kupharI grahaNa kare, nizcitabhAve se sarala patha hArAYa|

tAdera nikaTa satya prakAzita haoYAra parao, kitAvIdera madhye anekei tomAdera ImAna AnavAra para IrSAmUlaka manobhAvavazata AvAra tomAderake kAphirarUpe phire pAoYAra AkAksakSA kare| ataeva tomarA kSamA kara o upekSA kara, yatakSaNa nA AllAh kona nirdeza dena, nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara o yAkAta dAo| tomarA uttama kAjera yA kichu nijedera janye pUrve preraNa karave AllAh ra nikaTa tA pAve| tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra draSTA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘iYAha‚dI vA khrisTAna chAr3A anya keu kakhanai jAnnAte praveza karave nA|’ eTA tAdera mithyA AzA| vala, ‘yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tave tomAdera pramANa peza kara|’
hA~, ye keu AllAh ra nikaTa sampUrNarUpe AtmasamarpaNa kare evaM satkarmaparAYaNa haYa tAra phala tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache Ara tAdera kona bhaYa nei o tArA duHkhita have nA|

iYAhudIrA vale, ‘khrisTAnadera kona bhitti nei’ Ara khrisTAnarA vale, ‘iYAha‚dIdera kona bhitti nei’; athaca tArA kitAva pATha kare| eibhAve yArA kichui jAne nA tArAo anurUpa kathA vale| sutarAM ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karata kiYAmatera dina AllAh tAra mImAMsA karavena|

ye keu AllAh ra masajidasamUhe tA~ra nAma smaraNa karate vAdhA pradAna kare evaM edera vinAza sAdhane praYAsI haYa tAra apekSA var3a jAlima ke hate pAre? athaca bhaYa-vihaŸla nA haYe tAdera janye masajide praveza karA saMgata chila nA| pRthivIte tAdera janye lAJchanA bhoga o parakAle tAdera janye mahAzAsti raYeche|
pUrva o pazcima AllAh ra i; evaM yedikei tomarA mukha phirAo nA kena, sedikai AllAh ra dika| nizcaYai AllAh sarvavyApI, sarvajJa|
evaM tArA vale, ‘AllAh santAna grahaNa karechena|’ tini ati pavitra| varaM AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache sava AllAh ra i| sava kichu tA~rai ekAnta anugata|
AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sraSTA evaM yakhana tini kona kichu karate siddhAnta karena takhana tAra janye zudhu valena, ‘hao’, Ara tA haYe yAYa|

Ara yArA kichu jAne nA tArA vale, ‘AllAh AmAdera saGge kathA valena nA kena? kiMvA kona nidarzana AmAdera nikaTa Ase nA kena?’ eibhAve tAdera pUrvavartIrAo tAdera anurUpa kathA valata| tAdera antara ekai rakama| Ami dRr3ha pratyaYazIladera janye nidarzanAvalI spaSTabhAve vivRta karechi|
Ami tomAke satyasaha zubha saMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe preraNa karechi| jAhAnnAmIdera samvandhe tomAke kona prazna karA have nA|

iYAha‚dI o khrisTAnarA tomAra prati kakhanao santuSTa have nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi tAdera dharmAdarza anusaraNa kara| vala, ‘AllAh ra pathanirdezai prakRta pathanirdeza|’ jJAna prAptira para tumi yadi tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara tave AllAh ra vipakSe tomAra kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA Ara kona sAhAyyakArIo thAkave nA|
yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi tArA yathAyathabhAve tA tilAoYAta kare tArAi ete vizvAsa kare; Ara yArA tA pratyAkhyAna kare tArA kSatigrasta|
he isarAIla-santAnagaNa! AmAra sei anugrahake smaraNa kara yA diYe Ami tomAderake anugRhIta karechi Ara tomAderake vizve sakalera upare zreSThatva diYechi|

evaM tomarA sei dinake bhaYa kara yedina keu kArao kona upakAre Asave nA, kArao nikaTa hate kona vinimaYa gRhIta have nA evaM kona supAriza kArao pakSe lAbhajanaka have nA Ara tArA sAhAyya prAptao have nA|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana ivrAhImake tAra pratipAlaka kaYekaTi kathA diYe parIkSA karechilena evaM seguli se pUrNa karechila, AllAh valalena, ‘Ami tomAke mAnava jAtira netA karachi|’ se valala, ‘AmAra vaMzadharagaNera madhya hateo?’ AllAh valalena, ‘AmAra pratizruti jAlimadera prati prayojya naYa|’

evaM sei samaYake smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami kA‘vAgRhake mAnava jAtira milanakendra o nirApattAsthala karechilAma Ara valechilAma, ‘tomarA mAkAme ivrAhImake sAlAtera sthAnarUpe grahaNa kara|’ Ara ivrAhIma o ismAIlake tAoYAphakArI, i‘tikAphakArI, ruka‚‘ o sijdAkArIdera janye AmAra gRhake pavitra rAkhate Adeza diYechilAma|

smaraNa kara, yakhana ivrAhIma valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! eke nirApada zahara kara, Ara era adhivAsIdera madhye yArA AllAh o AkhirAte ImAna Ane tAderake phalamUla hate jIvikA pradAna kara|’ tini valalena, ‘ye keu kupharI karave tAkeo kichu kAlera janye jIvana upabhoga karate diva, erapara tAke jAhAnnAmera zAsti bhoga karate vAdhya karava Ara kata nikRSTa tAdera pratyAvartanasthala! ’
smaraNa kara, yakhana ivrAhIma o isamAIla kA‘vAgRhera prAcIra tulachila takhana tArA valechila, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera e kAja grahaNa kara, nizcaYa tumi sarvazrotA, sarvajJAtA|’

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera ubhaYake tomAra ekAnta anugata kara evaM AmAdera vaMzadhara hate tomAra eka anugata ummata kara| AmAderake ‘ivAdatera niYama-paddhati dekhiYe dAo evaM AmAdera prati kSamAzIla hao| tumi atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tAdera madhya hate tAdera nikaTa ekajana rAsUla preraNa kara-ye tomAra AYAtasamUha tAdera nikaTa tilAoYAta karave; tAderake kitAva o hikmata zikSA dive o tAderake pavitra karave| tumi to parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’
ye nijeke nirveAdha kareche se vyatIta ivrAhImera dharmAdarza hate Ara ke vimukha have| pRthivIte tAke Ami manonIta karechi; Ara AkhirAteo se avazyai satkarmaparAYaNagaNera anyatama|
tAra pratipAlaka yakhana tAke valechilena, ‘AtmasamarpaNa kara’, se valechila, ‘jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karalAma|’

Ara ivrAhIma o iYA‘ka‚va ei samvandhe tAdera putragaNake nirdeza diYe valechila, ‘he putragaNa! AllAhi tomAdera janye e dInake manonIta karechena| sutarAM AtmasamarpaNakArI nA haYe tomarA kakhanao mRtyuvaraNa kara nA|

iYA‘ka‚vera nikaTa yakhana mRtyu esechila tomarA ki takhana upasthita chile? se yakhana putragaNake jijJesa karechila, ‘AmAra pare tomarA kisera ‘ivAdata karave?’ tArA takhana valechila, ‘AmarA ApanAra ilAh-era evaM ApanAra pitRpuruSa ivrAhIma, ismAIla o isahAkera ilAh-erai ‘ivAdata karava| tini ekamAtra ilAh Ara AmarA tA~ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNakArI|’
sei chila eka ummata, tA atIta haYeche| tArA yA arjana kareche tA tAdera| tomarA yA arjana kara tA tomAdera| tArA yA karata se samvandhe tomAdera kona prazna karA have nA|
tArA vale, ‘iYAha‚dI vA khrisTAna hao, Thika patha pAve|’ vala, ‘varaM ekaniSTha haYe AmarA ivrAhImera dharmAdarza anusaraNa karava evaM se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|’

tomarA vala, ‘AmarA AllAhte ImAna rAkhi, evaM yA AmAdera prati evaM ivrAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYA‘ka‚va o tAra vaMzadharagaNera prati avatIrNa haYeche; Ara yA tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate mUsA, ‘IsA o anyAnya navIke deoYA haYeche; AmarA tAdera madhye kona pArthakya kari nA evaM AmarA tA~rai nikaTa AtmasamarpaNakArI|’

tomarA yAte ImAna AnaYana karecha tArA yadi seirUpa ImAna AnaYana kare tave nizcaYa tArA hidAYAta pAve| Ara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tArA nizcaYai viruddhabhAvApanna evaM tAdera viruddhe tomAra janye AllAhi yatheSTa| Ara tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AmarA grahaNa karalAma AllAh ra raM, raGe AllAh apekSA ke adhikatara sundara? evaM AmarA tA~rai ‘ivAdatakArI|

vala, ‘AllAh samvandhe tomarA ki AmAdera saGge vitarke lipta hate cAo-yakhana tini AmAdera pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka| AmAdera karma AmAdera Ara tomAdera karma tomAdera; evaM AmarA tA~ra prati ekaniSTha|’

tomarA ki vala, ‘ivrAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYA‘ka‚va o tAra vaMzadharagaNa avazyai iYAha‚dI kiMvA khrisTAna chila?’ vala, ‘tomarA ki vezi jAna, nA AllAh?’ AllAh ra nikaTa hate tAra kAche ye pramANa Ache tA ye gopana kare tAra apekSA adhikatara jAlima Ara ke hate pAre? tomarA yA kara AllAh se samvandhe anavahita nana|
sei chila eka ummata, tA atIta haYeche| tArA yA arjana kareche tA tAdera| tomarA yA arjana kara tA tomAdera| tArA yA karata se samvandhe tomAdera kona prazna karA have nA|

nirveAdha lokerA acirei valave ye, tArA e yAvata ye kivalA anusaraNa kare Asachila tA hate kise tAderake phiriYe dila? vala, ‘pUrva o pazcima AllAh ra i| tini yAke icchA sarala pathe paricAlita karena|’

eibhAve Ami tomAderake eka madhyapanthI jAtirUpe pratiSThita karechi, yAte tomarA mAnava jAtira janye sAkSIsvarUpa Ara rAsUla tomAdera janye sAkSIsvarUpa have| tumi e yAvata ye kivalA anusaraNa karachile eke Ami e uddezye pratiSThita karechilAma yAte jAnate pAri ke rAsUlera anusaraNa kare Ara ke phire yAYa| AllAh yAdera satpathe paricAlita karechena tArA vyatIta aparera nikaTa tA nizcaYai kaThina| AllAh eirUpa nana ye, tomAdera ImAnake vyartha karena| nizcaYai AllAh mAnuSera prati daYArdra, parama daYAlu|

AkAzera dike tomAra vAravAra tAkAnoke Ami avazyai lakSya kari| sutarAM tomAke avazyai emana kivalAra dike phiriYe dicchi yA tumi pachanda kara| ataeva tumi masajidula hArAmera dike mukha phirAo| tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena tAra dike mukha phirAo evaM yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tArA nizcitabhAve jAne ye, eTA tAdera pratipAlakera prerita satya| tArA yA kare se samvandhe AllAh anavahita nana|

yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tumi yadi tAdera nikaTa samasta dalIla peza kara, tavuo tArA tomAra kivalAra anusaraNa karave nA; Ara tumio tAdera kivalAra anusArI nao, Ara tArAo parasparera kivalAra anusArI naYa| tomAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra para tumi yadi tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara, nizcaYai takhana tumi jAlimadera antarbhukta have|
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA tAke serUpa jAne yerUpa tArA nijedera santAnagaNake cine Ara tAdera ekadala jene-zune satya gopana kare thAke|
satya tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate prerita| sutarAM tumi sandihAnadera antarbhukta haYo nA|

pratyekera ekaTi dika Ache, yedike se mukha kare| ataeva tomarA satkarme pratiyogitA kara| tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena AllAh tomAdera sakalake ekatra karavena| nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
yekhAna hatei tumi vera hao nA kena masajidula hArAmera dike mukha phirAo| eTA nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate prerita satya| tomarA yA kara se samvandhe AllAh anavahita nana|

tumi yekhAna hatei vera hao nA kena masajidula hArAmera dike mukha phirAo Ara tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena era dike mukha phirAve, yAte tAdera madhye jAlimadera vyatIta apara lokera tomAdera viruddhe vitarkera kichu nA thAke| sutarAM tAderake bhaYa kara nA, zudhu AmAkei bhaYa kara| yAte Ami AmAra niYAmata tomAderake pUrNarUpe dAna karate pAri Ara yAte tomarA satpathe paricAlita hate pAra|

yemana Ami tomAdera madhya hate tomAdera nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechi, ye AmAra AYAtasamUha tomAdera nikaTa tilAoYAta kare, tomAderake pavitra kare Ara kitAva o hikmata zikSA deYa Ara tomarA yA jAnate nA tA zikSA deYa|
sutarAM tomarA AmAkei smaraNa kara, Amio tomAderake smaraNa karava| tomarA AmAra prati kRtajJa hao Ara akRtajJa haYo nA|
he mu’minagaNa! dhairya o sAlAtera mAdhyame tomarA sAhAyya prArthanA kara| nizcaYai AllAh dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|
AllAh ra pathe yArA nihata haYa tAderake mRta vala nA, varaM tArA jIvita; kintu tomarA upalavdhi karate pAra nA|
Ami tomAderake kichu bhaYa, kSudhA o dhana-sampada, jIvana o phala-phasalera kSaYakSati diYe avazyai parIkSA karava| tumi zubha saMvAda dAo dhairyazIlagaNake-
yArA tAdera opara vipada Apatita hale vale, ‘AmarA to AllAh ra i evaM nizcitabhAve tA~ra dikei pratyAvartanakArI|’
erAi tArA yAdera prati tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate vizeSa anugraha o rahamata varSita haYa, Ara erAi satpathe paricAlita|

nizcaYai sAphA o mAraoYA AllAh ra nidarzanasamUhera antarbhukta| sutarAM ye keu kA‘vAgRhera hajja kiMvA ‘umarA sampanna kare ei duiTira madhye sA‘I karale tAra kona pApa nei Ara keu svataHsphUrtabhAve satkAja karale AllAh to puraskAradAtA, sarvajJa|

nizcaYai Ami yesava spaSTa nidarzana o hidAYAta avatIrNa karechi mAnuSera janye kitAve tA spaSTabhAve vyakta karAra parao yArA tA gopana rAkhe AllAh tAderake lA‘nata dena Ara abhizApakArIrAo tAderake abhizApa deYa|
kintu yArA taovA kare Ara nijederake saMzodhana kare Ara satyake suspaSTabhAve vyakta kare, erAi tArA yAdera taovA Ami kavUla kari, Ami atizaYa taovA grahaNakArI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai yArA kupharI kare evaM kAphirarUpe mArA yAYa tAdera opara lA‘nata AllAh evaM pherezatAgaNa o sakala mAnuSera|
ete tArA sthAYI have| tAdera zAsti laghu karA have nA Ara tAderake kona avakAzao deoYA have nA|
Ara tomAdera ilAh eka ilAh, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| tini daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYai AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sRSTite, rAtri o divasera parivartane, yA mAnuSera hita sAdhana kare tAsaha samudre vicaraNazIla nauyAnasamUhe, AllAh AkAza hate ye vArivarSaNa era mAdhyame dharitrIke tAra mRtyura para punarjIvita karena tAte Ara tAra madhye yAvatIYa jIvajantura vistAraNe, vAYura dika parivartane, AkAza o pRthivIra madhye niYantrita meghamAlAte jJAnavAna jAtira janye nidarzana raYeche|

tathApi mAnuSera madhye keu keu AllAh chAr3A aparake AllAh ra samakakSarUpe grahaNa kare evaM AllAhke bhAlavAsAra anurUpa tAderake bhAlavAse; kintu yArA ImAna eneche AllAh ra prati bhAlavAsAYa tArA sudRr3ha| jAlimarA zAsti pratyakSa karale yemana vujhave, hAYa! ekhana yadi tArA temana vujhata, samasta zakti AllAharai evaM AllAh zAsti dAne atyanta kaThora|
yakhana anusRtagaNa anusaraNakArIdera dAYitva asvIkAra karave evaM tArA zAsti pratyakSa karave Ara tAdera madhyakAra samasta samparka chinna haYe yAve,

Ara yArA anusaraNa karechila tArA valave, ‘hAYa! yadi ekavAra AmAdera pratyAvartana ghaTata tave AmarAo tAdera saGge samparka chinna karatAma yemana tArA AmAdera sAthe samparka chinna karala|’ eibhAve AllAh tAdera kAryAvalI tAdera paritAparUpe tAderake dekhAvena Ara tArA kakhanao agni hate vera hate pArave nA|
he mAnavajAti! pRthivIte yA kichu vaidha o pavitra khAdyavastu Ache tA hate tomarA AhAra kara evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kara nA, nizcaYa se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|
se to kevala tomAderake manda o azlIla kAjera evaM AllAh samvandhe tomarA yA jAna nA emana sava viSaYa valAra nirdeza deYa|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena tA tomarA anusaraNa kara’, tArA vale, ‘nA, varaM AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake yAte peYechi tAra anusaraNa karava|’ emana ki, tAdera pitRpuruSagaNa yadio kichui vujhata nA evaM tArA satpatheo paricAlita chila nA-tatsattveo|
yArA kupharI kare tAdera upamA: yemana kona vyakti emana kichuke DAke yA hA~ka-DAka chAr3A Ara kichui zone kare nA-vadhira, mUka, andha, sutarAM tArA vujhave nA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomAderake Ami yesava pavitra vastu diYechi tA hate AhAra kara evaM AllAh ra nikaTa kRtajJatA prakAza kara yadi tomarA zudhu tA~rai ‘ivAdata kara|

nizcaYa AllAh mRta jantu, rakta, zUkara-mAMsa Ara yAra opara AllAh ra nAma vyatIta anyera nAma uccArita haYeche tA tomAdera janye hArAma karechena| kintu ye ananyopAYa athaca nApharamAna kiMvA sImAlaMghanakArI naYa tAra kona pApa have nA| nizcaYai AllAh ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

AllAh ye kitAva avatIrNa karechena yArA tA gopana rAkhe o vinimaYe tuccha mUlya grahaNa kare tArA nijedera jaThare agni vyatIta Ara kichui pure nA| kiYAmatera dina AllAh tAdera saGge kathA valavena nA evaM tAderake pavitra karavena nA| tAdera janye marmantuda zAsti raYeche|
tArAi satpathera vinimaYe bhrAnta patha o kSamAra parivarte zAsti kraYa kareche; Aguna sahya karate tArA katai nA dhairyazIla!
eTA ei kAraNe ye, AllAh satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechena Ara yArA kitAva samvandhe matabheda sRSTi kareche, nizcaYa tArA dustara matabhede raYeche|

pUrva evaM pazcima dike tomAdera mukha phirAnote kona puNya nei; kintu puNya Ache keu AllAh, parakAla, pherezatAgaNa, samasta kitAva evaM navIgaNe ImAna AnaYana karale Ara AllAhpreme AtmIYa-svajana, pitRhIna, abhAvagrasta, paryaTaka, sAhAyyaprArthigaNake evaM dAsa-muktira janye artha dAna karale, sAlAta kAYema karale o yAkAta pradAna karale Ara pratizruti diYe tA pUrNa karale, artha-saMkaTe duHkha-kleze o saMgrAma-saMkaTe dhairya dhAraNa karale| erAi tArA yArA satyaparAYaNa Ara erAi muttAkI|

he mu’minagaNa! nihatadera vyApAre tomAdera janye kisAsera vidhAna deoYA haYeche| svAdhIna vyaktira vadale svAdhIna vyakti, krItadAsera vadale krItadAsa o nArIra vadale nArI, kintu tAra bhAiYera pakSa hate kichuTA kSamA pradarzana karA hale yathAyatha vidhira anusaraNa karA o satatAra saGge tAra deYa AdAYa vidheYa| eTA tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate bhAra lAghava o anugraha| era parao ye sImAlaMghana kare tAra janye marmantuda zAsti raYeche|
he vodhasampanna vyaktigaNa! kisAsera madhye tomAdera janye jIvana raYeche, yAte tomarA sAvadhAna hate pAra|

tomAdera madhye kArao mRtyukAla upasthita hale se yadi dhana-sampatti rekhe yAYa tave nyAYAnuga prathAmata tAra pitAmAtA o AtmIYa- svajanera janye osiYAta karAra vidhAna tomAderake deoYA hala| eTA muttAkIdera janye ekaTi kartavya|
eTA zonAra para yadi keu era parivartana sAdhana kare, tave yArA parivartana karave aparAdha tAderai| nizcaYai AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tave yadi keu osiYAtakArIra pakSapAtitva kiMvA anyAYera AzaMkA kare, erapara se tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa, tave tAra kona aparAdha nei| nizcaYai AllAh kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera janye siYAmera vidhAna deoYA hala, yemana vidhAna tomAdera pUrvavartIgaNake deoYA haYechila, yAte tomarA muttAkI hate pAra-

siYAma nirdiSTa kaYeka dinera janye| tomAdera madhye keu pIr3ita hale vA saphare thAkale anya samaYa ei saMkhyA pUraNa kare nite have| eTA yAderake sAtizaYa kaSTa deYa tAdera kartavya era parivarte phidYA- ekajana abhAvagrastake khAdya dAna karA| yadi keu svataHspha‚rtabhAve satkAja kare tave tA tAra pakSe adhika kalyANakara| Ara siYAma pAlana karAi tomAdera janye adhikatara kalyANaprasU yadi tomarA jAnate|

rAmAyAna mAsa, ete mAnuSera dizArI evaM satpathera spaSTa nidarzana o satyAsatyera pArthakyakArIrUpe kuraAna avatIrNa haYeche| sutarAM tomAdera madhye yArA ei mAsa pAve tArA yena e mAse siYAma pAlana kare| evaM keu pIr3ita thAkale kiMvA saphare thAkale anya samaYa ei saMkhyA pUraNa karave| AllAh tomAdera janye yA sahaja tA cAna Ara yA tomAdera janye kaSTakara tA cAna nA ejanye ye, tomarA saMkhyA pUrNa karave Ara tomAderake satpathe paricAlita karAnora kAraNe tomarA AllAh ra mahimA ghoSaNA karave evaM yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAra|

AmAra vAndAgaNa yakhana AmAra samvandhe tomAke prazna kare, Ami to nikaTei| prArthanAkArI yakhana AmAra nikaTa prArthanA kare Ami tAra prArthanAYa sAr3A dei| sutarAM tArAo AmAra DAke sAr3A dika Ara AmAra prati ImAna Anuka, yAte tArA Thika pathe calate pAre|

siYAmera rAtre tomAdera janye strI-sambhoga vaidha karA haYeche| tArA tomAdera paricchada evaM tomarA tAdera paricchada| AllAh jAnena ye, tomarA nijedera prati avicAra karachile| erapara tini tomAdera prati kSamAzIla haYechena Ara tomAdera aparAdha kSamA karechena| sutarAM ekhana tomarA tAdera saGge saMgata hao evaM AllAh yA tomAdera janye nirdhAraNa karechena tA kAmanA kara| Ara tomarA pAnAhAra kara yatakSaNa rAtrira kRSNarekhA hate USAra zubhrarekhA spaSTarUpe tomAdera nikaTa pratibhAta nA haYa| erapara nizAgama paryanta siYAma pUrNa kara| tomarA masajide i‘tikApharata avasthAYa tAdera saGge saMgata haYo nA| eiguli AllAh ra sImArekhA| sutarAM eigulira nikaTavartI haYo nA| eibhAve AllAh tA~ra vidhAnAvalI mAnava jAtira janye suspaSTabhAve vyakta karena, yAte tArA muttAkI hate pAre|
tomarA nijedera madhye eke anyera artha-sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa karo nA Ara mAnuSera dhana-sampattira kiYadaMza jene-zune anyAYabhAve grAsa karAra uddezye tA vicArakagaNera nikaTa peza kara nA|

loke tomAke nUtana cA~da samvandhe prazna kare| vala, ‘eTA mAnuSa evaM hajjera janye samaYa-nirdezaka|’ pechana dika diYe tomAdera gRhe praveza karAte kona puNya nei; kintu puNya Ache keu tAkoYA avalamvana karale| sutarAM tomarA dvAra diYe gRhe praveza kara, tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|
yArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kare tomarAo AllAh ra pathe tAdera viruddhe yuddha kara; kintu sImAlaMghana kara nA| nizcaYai AllAh sImalaMghana-kArigaNake bhAlavAsena nA|

yekhAne tAderake pAve hatyA karave evaM ye sthAna hate tArA tomAderake vahiSkAra kareche tomarAo sei sthAna hate tAderake vahiSkAra karave| phitanA hatyA apekSA gurutara| masajidula hArAmera nikaTa tomarA tAdera saGge yuddha karave nA, ye paryanta tArA sekhAne tomAdera saGge yuddha nA kare| yadi tArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kare tave tomarA tAderake hatyA karave, eTAi kAphiradera pariNAma|
yadi tArA virata haYa tave nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara tomarA tAdera viruddhe yuddha karate thAkave yAvata phitanA dUrIbhata nA haYa evaM AllAh ra dIna pratiSThita nA haYa| yadi tArA virata haYa tave jAlimaderake vyatIta Ara kAukeo AkramaNa karA calave nA|

pavitra mAsa pavitra mAsera vinimaYe| yAra pavitratA alaGghanIYa tAra avamAnanA sakalera janye samAna| sutarAM ye keu tomAderake AkramaNa karave tomarAo tAke anurUpa AkramaNa karave evaM tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha ye, AllAh avazyai muttAkIdera saGge thAkena|
tomarA AllAh ra pathe vyaYa kara Ara nijedera hAte nije-derake dhvaMsera madhye nikSepa kara nA| tomarA satkAja kara, AllAh satkarmaparAYaNa lokake bhAlavAsena|

tomarA AllAh ra uddezye hajja o umarA pUrNa kara, kintu tomarA yadi vAdhAprApta hao tave sahajalabhya kuravAnI kara| ye paryanta kuravAnIra pazu era sthAne nA peৗ~che tomarA mastaka muNDana kara nA| tomAdera madhye yadi keu pIr3ita haYa kiMvA mAthAYa kleza thAke tave siYAma kiMvA sAdAkA vA kuravAnIra mAdhyame era phidYA dive| yakhana tomarA nirApada have takhana tomAdera madhye ye vyakti hajjera prAkkAle umarA diYe lAbhavAna hate cAYa se sahajalabhya kuravAnI karave| kintu yadi keu tA nA pAYa tave tAke hajjera samaYa tinadina evaM vAr3I pherAra para sAtadina-ei pUrNa dazadina siYAma pAlana karate have| eTA tAdera janye, yAdera parijanavarga masajidula hArAmera vAsindA naYa| AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha ye, nizcaYai AllAh zAsti dAne kaThora|

hajja haYa sunirdiSTa mAsasamUhe| erapara ye keu e mAsagulite hajja karA sthira kare tAra janye hajjera samaYe strI-sambhoga, anyAYa AcaraNa o kalaha-vivAda vidheYa naYa| tomarA uttama kAjera yA kichu kara AllAh tA jAnena evaM tomarA pAtheYera vyavasthA kara, AtmasaMyamai zreSTha pAtheYa| he vodhasampanna vyaktigaNa! tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara|

tomAdera pratipAlakera anugraha sandhAna karAte tomAdera kona pApa nei| yakhana tomarA ‘ArAphAta hate phire Asave takhana mAza‘Arula hArAmera nikaTa peৗ~che AllAhke smaraNa karave evaM tini yebhAve nirdeza diYechena Thika seibhAve smaraNa karave; yadio itipUrve tomarA vibhrAntadera antarbhukta chile|
erapara anyAnya loka yekhAna hate phire Ase tomarAo se sthAna hate phire Asave| Ara AllAh ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karave, nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

erapara yakhana tomarA hajjera anuSThAnAdi samApta karave takhana AllAhke emanabhAve smaraNa karave yemana tomarA tomAdera pitRpuruSagaNake smaraNa karate, vA tAra ceYe vezI kare| mAnuSera madhye yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake ihakAlei dAo’, vastuta parakAle tAdera janye kona aMza nei|
Ara tAdera madhye yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera duniYAte kalyANa dAo evaM AkhirAte kalyANa dAo Ara AmAderake dojakhera zAsti hate rakSA kara-’
tArA yA arjana kareche tAra prApya aMza tAderai| vastuta AllAh hiseva grahaNe atyanta tatpara|

tomarA nirdiSTa saMkhyaka dinagulite AllAhke smaraNa karave| yadi keu tAr3AtAr3i kare dui dine cale Ase tave tAra kona pApa nei, Ara yadi keu deri kare tave tArao kona pApa nei| eTA tAra janye, ye tAkoYA avalamvana kare| tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara Ara jene rAkha ye, tomAderake avazyai tA~ra nikaTa ekatra karA have|
Ara mAnuSera madhye emana vyakti Ache, pArthiva jIvana samvandhe yAra kathAvArtA tomAke camatkRta kare evaM tAra antare yA Ache se samvandhe AllAhke sAkSI rAkhe| prakRtapakSe se bhISaNa kalahapriYa|
yakhana se prasthAna kare takhana se pRthivIte azAnti sRSTira evaM zasyakSetra o jIvajantu dhvaMserara ceSTA kare| Ara AllAh azAnti pachanda karena nA|
yakhana tAke valA haYa, ‘tumi AllAhke bhaYa kara’, takhana tAra AtmAbhimAna tAke pApAnuSThAne lipta kare, sutarAM jAhAnnAmai tAra janye yatheSTa| nizcaYai eTA nikRSTa vizrAmasthala|
mAnuSera madhye emana lokao Ache, ye AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhArthe nijera jIvana vikri kare thAke| AllAh tA~ra vAndAgaNera prati atyanta daYArdra|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA sarvAtmakabhAve isalAme praveza kara evaM zaYatAnera padAMka anusaraNa kara nA| nizcaYa se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|
suspaSTa nidarzana tomAdera nikaTa AsAra para yadi tomAdera padaskhalana ghaTe tave jene rAkha, nizcaYai AllAh mahAparAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|
tArA zudhu era pratIkSAYa Ache ye, AllAh o phirizatAgaNa meghera chAYAYa tAdera nikaTa upasthita havena, tArapara sava kichura mImAMsA haYe yAve| samasta viSaYa AllAh ra i nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
vanI isrAIlake jijJAsA kara, Ami tAderake kata spaSTa nidarzana pradAna karechi! AllAh ra anugraha AsAra para keu eTAra parivartana karale AllAh to zAstidAne kaThora|

yArA kupharI kare tAdera nikaTa pArthiva jIvana suzobhita karA haYeche, tArA mu’minaderake ThATTA-vidrupa kare thAke| Ara yArA tAkoYA avalamvana kare kiYAmatera dina tArA tAdera Urdhve thAkave| AllAh yAke icchA aparimita riyika dAna karena|

samasta mAnuSa chila ekai ummata| erapara AllAh navIgaNake susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe preraNa karena| mAnuSerA ye viSaYe matabheda karata tAdera madhye se viSaYe mImAMsAra janye tini tAdera saGge satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karena evaM yAderake tA deoYA haYechila, spaSTa nidarzana tAdera nikaTa AsAra pare, tArA zudhu paraspara vidveSavazata sei viSaYe virodhitA karata| yArA vizvAsa kare, tArA ye viSaYe bhinnamata poSaNa karata, AllAh tAderake se viSaYe nija anugrahe satyapathe paricAlita karena| AllAh yAke icchA sarala pathe paricAlita karena|

tomarA ki mane kara ye, tomarA jAnnAte praveza karave-yadio ekhanao tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera pUrvavartIdera anurUpa avasthA Ase nAi? artha-saMkaTa o duHkha-kleza tAderake sparza karechila o tArA bhIta o kampita haYechila| emanaki rAsUla o tA~ra saGge ImAna AnaYanakArigaNa vale uThechila, ‘AllAh ra sAhAyya kakhana Asave?’ jene rAkha, avazyai AllAh ra sAhAyya nikaTe|

loke ki vyaYa karave se samvandhe tomAke prazna kare| vala, ‘ye dhana-sampada tomarA vyaYa karave tA pitAmAtA, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, misakIna evaM musAphiradera janye| uttama kAjera yA kichu tomarA kara nA kena AllAh to se samvandhe samyaka avahita|

tomAdera janye yuddhera vidhAna deoYA hala yadio tomAdera nikaTa tA apriYa| kintu tomarA yA apachanda kara sambhavata tA tomAdera janye kalyANakara Ara yA bhAlavAsa sambhavata tA tomAdera janye akalyANakara| AllAh jAnena Ara tomarA jAna nA|

pavitra mAse yuddha karA samparke loke tomAke jijJAsA kare; vala, ‘ete yuddha karA bhISaNa anyAYa|’ kintu AllAh ra pathe vAdhA dAna karA, AllAhke asvIkAra karA, masajidula hArAme vAdhA deoYA Ara era vAsindAke tA hate vahiSkAra karA AllAh ra nikaTa tAra tulanAYa adhika anyAYa; phitanA hatyA apekSA gurutara anyAYa|’ tArA sarvadA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karate thAkave ye paryanta tomAderake tomAdera dIna hate phiriYe nA deYa, yadi tArA sakSama haYa| tomAdera madhye ye keu svIYa dIna hate phire yAYa Ara kAphirarUpe mRtyumukhe patita haYa, duniYA o AkhirAte tAdera karma niSphala haYe yAYa| erAi dojakhavAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|
yArA ImAna Ane evaM yArA hijarata kare evaM jihAda kare AllAh ra pathe, tArAi AllAh ra anugraha pratyAzA kare| AllAh kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|

loke tomAke mada o juYA samparke jijJAsA kare| vala, ‘ubhaYera madhye Ache mahApApa evaM mAnuSera janye upakArao; kintu edera pApa upakArera tulanAYa adhika|’ loke tomAke jijJAsA kare, kI tArA vyaYa karave? vala, ‘yA udvRtta|’ eibhAve AllAh tA~ra vidhAna tomAdera janye suspaSTarUpe vyakta karena, yAte tomarA cintA kara-

duniYA o AkhirAta samvandhe| loke tomAke iYAtImadera samparke jijJAsA kare; vala, ‘tAdera janye suvyavasthA karA uttama|’ tomarA yadi tAdera saGge ekatra thAka tave tArA to tomAderai bhAi| AllAh jAnena ke hitakArI Ara ke aniSTakArI| AllAh icchA karale e viSaYe tomAderake avazyai kaSTe phelite pAratena| nizcaYai AllAh pravala parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

ImAna nA AnA paryanta muzarika nArIke tomarA vivAha kara nA-muzarika nArI tomAderake mugdha karaleo, nizcaYa mu’mina krItadAsI tA apekSA uttama| ImAna nA AnA paryanta muzarika puruSera saGge tomarA vivAha dio nA-muzarika puruSa tomAderake mugdha karaleo, mu’mina krItadAsa tA apekSA uttama| erA agnira dike AhvAna kare Ara AllAh tomAderake nija anugrahe jAnnAta o kSamAra dike AhvAna karena| tini mAnuSera janye svIYa vidhAna suspaSTabhAve vyakta karena, yAte tArA eTA hate zikSA grahaNa karate pAre|

loke tomAke rajaHsrAva samvandhe jijJAsA kare| vala, ‘eTA azuci|’ sutarAM tomarA rajaHsrAvakAle strI-saMgama varjana karave evaM pavitra nA haoYA paryanta strI-saMgama karave nA| erapara tArA yakhana uttamarUpe parizuddha have takhana tAdera nikaTa Thika seibhAve gamana karave yebhAve AllAh tomAderake Adeza diYechena| nizcaYai AllAh taovAkArIke bhAlavAsena evaM yArA pavitra thAke tAderakeo bhAlavAsena|

tomAdera strIgaNa tomAdera zasyakSetra| ataeva tomarA tomAdera zasyakSetre yebhAve icchA gamana karate pAra| tomarA tomAdera bhaviSyatera janye kichu kara evaM AllAhkeo bhaYa kara| Ara jene rekho ye, tomarA AllAh ra sammukhIna hate yAccha Ara mu’minagaNake susaMvAda dAo|
tomarA satkAja, AtmasaMyama o mAnuSera madhye zAnti sthApana hate virata thAkave-e zapathera janye AllAh ra nAmake tomarA ajuhAta kara nA| AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tomAdera arthahIna zapathera janye AllAh tomAderake dAYI karavena nA| kintu tini tomAdera antarera saMkalpera janye dAYI karavena| AllAh kSamAparAYaNa, dhairyazIla|
yArA strIra saGge saMgata nA haoYAra zapatha kare tArA cAramAsa apekSA karave| erapara yadi tArA pratyAgata haYa tave nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yadi tArA tAlAka deoYAra saMkalpa kare tave AllAh to sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

tAlAkaprAptA strI tina rajaHsrAva kAla pratIkSAYa thAkave| tArA AllAh evaM AkhirAte vizvAsI hale tAdera garbhAzaYe AllAh yA sRSTi karechena tA gopana rAkhA tAdera pakSe vaidha naYa| yadi tArA Aposa-niSpatti karate cAYa tave ete tAdera punaH grahaNe tAdera svAmigaNa adhika hakadAra| nArIdera temani nyAYasaMgata adhikAra Ache, yemana Ache tAdera opara puruSadera; kintu nArIdera opara puruSadera maryAdA Ache| AllAh mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tAlAka duivAra| erapara strIke haYa vidhimata rekhe dive vA sadaYabhAve mukta kare dive| tomarA tomAdera strIderake yA pradAna karecha tAra madhya hate kona kichu grahaNa karA tomAdera pakSe vaidha naYa| avazya yadi tAdera ubhaYera AzaMkA haYa ye, tArA AllAh ra sImArekhA rakSA kare calate pArave nA evaM tomarA yadi AzaMkA kara ye, tArA AllAh ra sImArekhA rakSA kare calate pArave nA, tave strI kona kichura vinimaYe niSkRti pete icchA karale tAte tAdera kArao kona aparAdha nei| eisava AllAh ra sImArekhA| tomarA tA laMghana kara nA| yArA eisava sImArekhA laMghana kare tArAi jAlima|

erapara yadi se tAke tAlAka deYa tave se tAra janye vaidha have nA, ye paryanta se anya svAmIra saGge saMgata nA have| erapara se yadi tAke tAlAka deYa Ara tArA ubhaYe mane kare ye, tArA AllAh ra sImArekhA rakSA karate samartha have, tave tAdera punarmilane kArao kona aparAdha have nA| eiguli AllAh ra vidhAna, jJAnI sampradAYera janye AllAh eTA spaSTabhAve varNanA karena|

yakhana tomarA strIderake tAlAka dAo Ara tArA iddata pUrtira nikaTavartI haYa takhana tomarA haYa yathAvidhi tAderake rekhe dive vA vidhimata mukta kare dive| kintu tAdera kSati kare sImAlaMghanera uddezye tAderake tomarA ATakiYe rekho nA| ye eirUpa kare, se nijera prati juluma kare| Ara tomarA AllAh ra vidhAnake ThATTA-tAmAzAra vastu kara nA evaM tomAdera prati AllAh ra niYAmata o kitAva evaM hikmata yA tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena-yA diYe tini tomAderake upadeza dena, tA smaraNa kara| tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara Ara jene rAkha ye, nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe jJAnamaYa|

tomarA yakhana strIdera tAlAka dAo evaM tArA tAdera iddatakAla pUrNa kare, tArA yadi vidhimata paraspara sammata haYa, tave strIgaNa nijedera svAmIderake vivAha karate icchA karale tomarA tAderake vAdhA dio nA| era mAdhyame tomAdera madhye ye keu AllAh o AkhirAte ImAna rAkhe, tAke upadeza deoYA haYa| eTA tomAdera janye zuddhatama o pavitratama| AllAh jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|

ye stanyapAnakAla pUrNa karate cAYa tAra janye jananIgaNa tAdera santAnaderake pUrNa dui vatsara stanyapAna karAve| janakera kartavya yathAvidhi tAdera bharaNa-poSaNa karA| kAukeo tAra sAdhyAtIta kAryabhAra deoYA haYa nA| kona jananIke tAra santAnera janye Ara kona janakake tAra santAnera janye kSatigrasta karA have nA| evaM uttarAdhikArIrao anurUpa kartavya| kintu yadi tArA parasparera sammati o parAmarzakrame stanyapAna vandha rAkhate cAYa tave tAdera kArao kona aparAdha nei| tomarA yA vidhimata dite ceYechile, tA yadi arpaNa kara tave dhAtrI diYe tomAdera santAnake stanyapAna karAte cAile tomAdera kona gunAha nei| AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha ye, tomarA yA kara nizcaYai AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|

tomAdera madhye yArA strI rekhe mRtyumukhe patita haYa tAdera strIgaNa cAra mAsa daza dina pratIkSAYa thAkave| yakhana tArA tAdera iddatakAla pUrNa karave takhana yathAvidhi nijedera janye yA karave tAte tomAdera kona gunAha nei| tomarA yA kara AllAh se samvandhe savizeSa avahita|

strIlokadera nikaTa tomarA iMgite vivAha prastAva karale vA tomAdera antare gopana rAkhale tomAdera kona pApa nei| AllAh jAnena ye, tomarA tAdera samvandhe avazyai AlocanA karave; kintu vidhimata kathAvArtA vyatIta gopane tAdera nikaTa kona aGgIkAra kara nA; nirdiSTa kAla pUrNa nA haoYA paryanta vivAhakArya sampanna karAra saMkalpa kara nA| Ara jene rAkha, nizcaYai AllAh tomAdera manobhAva jAnena| sutarAM tA~ke bhaYa kara o jene rAkha, nizcaYai AllAh kSamAparAYaNa, parama sahanazIla|

ye paryanta nA tomarA tomAdera strIderake sparza karecha evaM tAdera janye mAhra dhArya karecha tAderake tAlAka dile tomAdera kona pApa nei| tomarA tAdera saMsthAnera vyavasthA kara-sacchala tAra sAdhyamata Ara asacchala tAra sAmarthyAnuyAYI vidhimata kharacapatrera vyavasthA karave, eTA nekakAra lokadera kartavya|

tomarA yadi tAderake sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka dAo, athaca mAhra dhArya kare thAka tave yA tomarA dhArya karecha tAra ardheka, yadi nA strI vA yAra hAte vivAha-vandhana raYeche se mApha kare deYa; Ara mApha kare deoYAi tAkoYAra nikaTatara| tomarA nijedera madhye sadAzaYatAra kathA vismRta haYo nA| tomarA yA kara nizcaYai AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|
tomarA sAlAtera prati yatnavAna have, vizeSata madhyavartI sAlAtera evaM AllAhara uddezye tomarA vinItabhAve dA~r3Ave;

yadi tomarA AzaMkA kara tave padacArI vA ArohI avasthAYa sAlAta AdAYa karave| Ara yakhana tomarA nirApada vodha kara takhana AllAhke smaraNa karave, yebhAve tini tomAderake zikSA diYechena, yA tomarA jAnate nA|

tomAdera madhye yAdera mRtyu Asanna evaM strI rekhe yAYa tArA yena tAdera strIderake gRha hate vera nA kare tAdera eka vatsarera bharaNa-poSaNera osiYAta kare| kintu yadi tArA vera haYe yAYa tave vidhimata nijedera janye tArA yA karave tAte tomAdera kona gunAha nei| AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tAlAkaprAptA nArIderake yathArIti bharaNa-poSaNa karA muttAkIdera kartavya|
eibhAve AllAh tA~ra vidhAna spaSTabhAve varNanA karena yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

tumi ki tAderake dekha nAi yArA mRtyubhaYe hAjAre hAjAre svIYa AvAsabhUmi parityAga karechila? erapara AllAh tAderake valechilena, ‘tomAdera mRtyu hoka|’ tArapara AllAh tAdera jIvita karechilena| nizcaYai AllAh mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla; kintu adhikAMza loka kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tomarA AllAh ra pathe yuddha kara Ara jene rAkha ye, nizcaYai AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
ke se, ye AllAhke karaye hAsAnA pradAna karave? tini tAra janye tA vahuguNe vRddhi karavena| Ara AllAh saMkucita o samprasArita karena evaM tA~ra pAnei tomarA phire yAve|

tumi ki mUsAra paravartI vanI isarAIla pradhAnaderake dekha nAi? tArA yakhana tAdera navIke valechila, ‘AmAdera janye eka rAjA niyukta kara yAte AmarA AllAh ra pathe yuddha karate pAri|’ se valala, ‘eTA to have nA ye, tomAdera prati yuddhera vidhAna deoYA hala takhana Ara tomarA yuddha karave nA?’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA yakhana nija nija AvAsabhUmi o svIYa santAna-santati hate vahiSkRta haYechi, takhana AllAh ra pathe kena yuddha karava nA?’ erapara yakhana tAdera prati yuddhera vidhAna deoYA hala takhana tAdera svalpa saMkhyaka vyatIta sakalei pRSTha pradarzana karala| Ara AllAh jAlimadera samvandhe savizeSa avahita|

Ara tAdera navI tAdera valechila, AllAh avazyai tAlUtake tomAdera rAjA karechena| tArA valala, ‘AmAdera opara tAra rAjatva kirUpe have, yakhana AmarA tA apekSA rAjatvera adhika hakdAra Ara tAke pracura aizvarya deoYA haYa nAi!’ navI valala, ‘AllAh avazyai tAke tomAdera janye manonIta karechena evaM tini tAke jJAne o dehe samRddha karechena|’ AllAh yAke icchA svIYa rAjatva dAna karena| AllAh prAcuryamaYa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tAdera navI tAdera valechila, ‘tAra rAjatvera nidarzana ei ye, tomAdera nikaTa sei tAvUta Asave yAte tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate citta-prazAnti evaM mUsA o hArUna-vaMzIYagaNa yA parityAga kareche tAra avaziSTAMza thAkave; phirizatAgaNa tA vahana kare Anave| tomarA yadi mu’mina hao tave avazyai tomAdera janye ete nidarzana Ache|’

erapara tAlUta yakhana sainyavAhinIsaha vera hala se takhana valala, ‘AllAh eka nadI diYe tomAdera parIkSA karavena| ye keu eTA hate pAna karave se AmAra dalabhukta naYa; Ara ye keu era svAda grahaNa karave nA se AmAra dalabhukta; e chAr3A ye keu tAra hAte eka koSa pAni grahaNa karave seo| erapara alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta tArA eTA hate pAna karala| se evaM tAra saGgI ImAnadAragaNa yakhana eTA atikrama karala takhana tArA valala, ‘jAlUta o tAra sainyavAhinIra viruddhe yuddha karAra mata zakti Aja AmAdera nei|’ kintu yAdera pratyaYa chila AllAh ra saGge tAdera sAkSAt ghaTave tArA valala, ‘AllAh ra hukume kata kSudra dala kata vRhat dalake parAbhUta kareche|’ AllAh dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|

tArA yakhana yuddhArthe jAlUta o tAra sainyavAhinIra sammukhIna hala takhana tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake dhairya dAna kara, AmAdera pA avicalita rAkha Ara kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya dAna kara|’

sutarAM tArA AllAh ra hukume tAdera parAbhUta karala; dAuda jAlUtake hatyA karala, AllAh tAke rAjatva o hikmata dAna karalena Ara yA tini icchA karalena tA tAke zikSA dilena| AllAh yadi mAnava jAtira eka dalake anya dala diYe pratihata nA karatena tave pRthivI viparyasta haYe yeta| kintu AllAh jagatasamUhera prati anugrahazIla|
e sakala AllAh ra AYAta, Ami tomAra nikaTa eTA yathAyathabhAve tilAoYAta karachi, Ara nizcaYai tumi rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|

ei rAsUlagaNa, tAdera madhye kAukeo kArao opara zreSThatva diYechi| tAdera madhye emana keu Ache yAra saGge AllAh kathA valechena, AvAra kAukeo ucca maryAdAYa unnIta karechena| mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsAke spaSTa pramANa pradAna karechi o pavitra AtmA diYe tAke zaktizAlI karechi| AllAh icchA karale tAdera paravartIrA tAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANa samAgata haoYAra parao pArasparika yuddha-vigrahe lipta hata nA; kintu tAdera madhye matabheda ghaTala| phale tAdera kichusaMkhyaka ImAna Anala evaM kichusaMkhyaka kupharI karala| AllAh icchA karale tArA pArasparika yuddha-vigrahe lipta hata nA; kintu AllAh yA icchA tA karena|
he mu’minagaNa! Ami yA tomAderake diYechi tA hate tomarA vyaYa kara sei dina AsAra pUrve, yei dina kraYa-vikraYa, vandhutva o supAriza thAkave nA evaM kAphirarAi jAlima|

AllAh, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei| tini ciraJjIva, sarvasattAra dhAraka| tA~ke tandrA vA nidrA sparza kare nA| AkAza o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samasta tA~rai| ke se, ye tA~ra anumati vyatIta tA~ra nikaTa supAriza karave? tAdera sAmane o pazcAte yA kichu Ache tA tini avagata| yA tini icchA karena tA vyAtIta tA~ra jJAnera kichui tArA AYatta karate pAre nA| tA~ra ‘kurasI’ AkAza o pRthivImaYa parivyApta; edera rakSaNAvekSaNa tA~ke klAnta kare nA; Ara tini mahAna, zreSTha|

dIna grahaNe jora-javaradasti nei; satya patha bhrAnta patha hate suspaSTa haYeche| ye tAgUtake asvIkAra karave evaM AllAh ra opara ImAna Anave se emana eka mayavUta hAtala dharave yA kakhanao bhAGgave nA| AllAh sarvazrotA, prajJAmaYa|

yArA ImAna Ane AllAh tAdera abhibhAvaka, tini tAderake andhakAra hate vera kare Aloke niYe yAna| Ara yArA kupharI kare tAgUta tAdera abhibhAvaka; erA tAderake Alo hate andhakAre niYe yAYa| erAi agni-adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|

tumi ki ai vyaktike dekha nAi, ye ivrAhImera saGge tAra pratipAlaka samvandhe vitarke lipta haYechila, yehetu AllAh tAke kartRtva diYechilena| yakhana ivrAhIma valala, ‘tini AmAra pratipAlaka yini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna’, se valala, ‘Amio to jIvana dAna kari o mRtyu ghaTAi|’ ivrAhIma valala, ‘AllAh sUryake pUrva dika hate udita karAna, tumi eke pazcima dika hate udita karAo to|’ erapara ye kupharI karechila se hatavuddhi haYe gela| AllAh jAlima sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

vA tumi ki sei vyaktike dekha nAi, ye emana eka nagare upanIta haYechila yA dhvaMsastUpe pariNata haYechila| se valala, ‘mRtyura para kirUpe AllAh eke jIvita karavena?’ tArapara AllAh tAke ekazata vatsara mRta rAkhalena| pare tAke punarjIvita karalena| AllAh valalena, ‘tumi kata kAla avasthAna karale?’ se valala, ‘eka dina vA eka dinerao kichu kama avasthAna karechi|’ tini valalena, ‘nA, varaM tumi ekazata vatsara avasthAna karecha| tomAra khAdyasAmagrI o pAnIYa vastura prati lakSya kara, eTA avikRta raYeche evaM tomAra gardabhaTira prati lakSya kara, kAraNa tomAke mAnavajAtira janye nidarzanasvarUpa karava| Ara asthigulira prati lakSya kara; kibhAve segulike saMyojita kari evaM gozata diYe Dheke dei|’ yakhana eTA tAra nikaTa spaSTa hala takhana se vale uThala, ‘Ami jAni ye, AllAh nizcaYai sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|’

yakhana ivrAhIma valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! kibhAve tumi mRtake jIvita kara AmAke dekhAo|’ tini valalena, ‘tave ki tumi vizvAsa kara nA?’ se valala, ‘kena karava nA, tave eTA kevala AmAra citta prazAntira janye|’ tini valalena, ‘tave cAraTi pAkhi nAo evaM ederake tomAra vazIbhUta kare nAo| tArapara tAdera eka eka aMza eka eka pAhAr3e sthApana kara| erapara ederake DAka dAo, erA drutagatite tomAra nikaTa Asave| jene rAkha, ‘nizcaYai AllAh pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’

yArA nijedera dhanaizvarya AllAh ra pathe vyaYa kare tAdera upamA ekaTi zasyavIja, yA sAtaTi zISa utpAdana kare, pratyeka zISe ekazata zasyadAnA| AllAh yAke icchA vahu guNe vRddhi kare dena| AllAh prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yArA AllAh ra pathe dhanaizvarya vyaYa kare erapara yA vyaYa kare tAra kathA vale ver3AYa nA Ara klezao deYa nA, tAdera puraskAra tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache| tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
ye dAnera para kaSTa deoYA haYa tA apekSA bhAla kathA o kSamA zreYa| AllAh abhAvamukta, parama sahanazIla|

he mu’minagaNa! dAnera kathA vale ver3iYe evaM kaSTa diYe tomarA tomAdera dAnake ai vyaktira nyAYa niSphala kara nA, ye nijera dhanasampada loka dekhAnora janye vyaYa kare thAke Ara AllAh o AkhirAte ImAna rAkhe nA| tAra upamA ekaTi masRNa pAthara-yAra opara kichu mATi thAke; erapara era opara pravala vRSTipAta eke pariSkAra kare rekhe deYa| yA tArA upArjana kareche tAra kichui tArA tAdera kAje lAgAte sakSama have nA| AllAh kAphira sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

Ara yArA AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhArthe o nijedera AtmA valiSTha karaNArthe dhanaizvarya vyaYa kare tAdera upamA kona ucca bhUmite avasthita ekaTi udyAna, yAte muSaladhAre vRSTi haYa, phale tAra phalamUla dviguNa janme| yadi muSaladhAre vRSTi nAo haYa tave laghu vRSTii yatheSTa| tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|

tomAdera keu ki cAYa ye, tAra khejura o AGurera ekaTi vAgAna thAke yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita evaM yAte sarvaprakAra phalamUla Ache, yakhana se vyakti vArdhakye upanIta haYa evaM tAra santAna-santati durvala, erapara tAra opara eka agnikSarA ghUrNijhar3a Apatita haYa o eTA jvaliYA yAYa? eibhAve AllAh tA~ra nidarzana tomAdera janye suspaSTabhAve vyakta karena yAte tomarA anudhAvana karate pAra|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yA upArjana kara Ara Ami yA bhUmi hate tomAdera janye utpAdana kare dei tanmadhye yA utkRSTa tA vyaYa kara; evaM era nikRSTa vastu vyaYa karAra saMkalpa kara nA: athaca tomarA eTA grahaNa karAra nao, yadi nA tomarA cokha vandha kare thAka| evaM jene rAkha ye, nizcaYai AllAh abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
zaYatAna tomAdera dAridryera bhaYa dekhAYa Ara azlIlatAra nirdeza deYa| Ara AllAh tomAderake tA~ra kSamA o anugrahera pratizruti pradAna karena| AllAh prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
tini yAke icchA hikmata pradAna karena evaM yAke hikmata pradAna karA haYa tAke prabhUta kalyANa dAna karA haYa; Ara vodhazaktisampanna lokerAi zudhu zikSA grahaNa kare|
yA kichu tomarA vyaYa kara vA yA kichu tomarA mAnata kara nizcaYai AllAh tA jAnena| Ara jAlimadera janye kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tomarA yadi prakAzye dAna kara tave tA bhAla; Ara yadi tA gopane kara evaM abhAvagrastake dAna kara tA tomAdera janye Arao bhAla; Ara tini tomAdera kichu kichu pApa mocana karavena; tomarA yA kara AllAh tA samyaka avahita|

tAdera satpatha grahaNera dAYitva tomAra naYa; varaM AllAh yAke icchA satpathe paricAlita karena| ye dhana-sampada tomarA vyaYa kara tA tomAdera nijedera janye Ara tomarA to zudhu AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhArthei vyaYa kare thAka| ye dhana-sampada tomarA vyaYa kara tAra puraskAra tomAderake purApuribhAve pradAna karA have evaM tomAdera prati anyAYa karA have nA|

eTA prApya abhAvagrasta lokadera; yArA AllAh ra pathe emanabhAve vyApRta ye, dezamaYa ghorApherA karate pAre nA; yAcJA nA karAra kAraNe ajJa lokerA tAderake abhAvamukta vale mane kare; tumi tAdera lakSaNa dekhe cinate pArave| tArA mAnuSera nikaTa nAchor3a haYe yAcJA kare nA| ye dhana-sampada tomarA vyaYa kara AllAh to tA savizeSa avahita|
yArA nijedera dhanaizvarya rAtre o divase, gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare tAdera puNya phala tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache, tAdera kona bhaYa nei Ara tArA duHkhitao have nA|

yArA suda khAYa tArA sei vyaktirai nyAYa dA~r3Ave yAke zaYatAna sparza diYe pAgala kare| eTA ejanye ye, tArA vale, ‘kraYa-vikraYa to sudera matai|’ athaca AllAh kraYa-vikraYake hAlAla o sudake hArAma karechena| yAra nikaTa tAra pratipAlakera upadeza eseche evaM se virata haYeche, tave atIte yA haYeche tA tArai; evaM tAra vyApAra AllAh ra ikhtiYAre| Ara yArA punarAYa Arambha karave tArAi dojakhavAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|
AllAh sudake nizcihna karena Ara dAnake vardhita karena| AllAh kona akRtajJa pApIke bhAlavAsena nA|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane, satkAja kare, sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa, tAdera puraskAra tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache| tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM sudera vakeYA yA Ache tA cher3e dAo yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|

yadi tomarA nA chAr3a tave AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera saGge yuddhera janye prastuta hao| kintu yadi tomarA taovA kara tave tomAdera mUladhana tomAderai| ete tomarA atyAcAra karave nA evaM atyAcAritao have nA|
yadi khAtaka abhAvagrasta haYa tave sacchalatA paryanta tAke avakAza deoYA vidheYa| Ara yadi tomarA cher3e dAo tave tA tomAdera janye kalyANakara, yadi tomarA jAnate|
tomarA sei dinake bhaYa kara ye dina tomarA AllAh ra dike phire Asave| erapara pratyekake tAra karmera phala purApuri pradAna karA have, Ara tAdera prati konarUpa anyAYa karA have nA|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana eke anyera saGge nirdhArita samaYera janye RNera kAravAra kara takhana tA likhe rekha; tomAdera madhye kona lekhaka yena nyAyyabhAve likhe deYa; lekhaka likhate asvIkAra karave nA| yemana AllAh tAke zikSA diYechena, sutarAM se yena likhe evaM RNagrahItA yena lekhAra viSaYavastu vale deYa evaM tAra pratipAlaka AllAhke bhaYa kare, Ara era kichu yena nA kamAYa; kintu RNagrahItA yadi nirveAdha vA durvala haYa vA lekhAra viSaYavastu vale dite nA pAre tave yena tAra abhibhAvaka nyAyyabhAve lekhAra viSaYavastu vale deYa| sAkSIdera madhye yAdera opara tomarA rAyI tAdera madhye du’jana puruSa sAkSI rAkhave, yadi du’jana puruSa nA thAke tave ekajana puruSa o du’jana strIloka; strIlokadera madhye ekajana bhula karale tAdera ekajana aparajanake smaraNa kariYe dive| sAkSIgaNake yakhana DAkA have takhana tArA yena asvIkAra nA kare| eTA choTa hoka vA var3a hoka, meYAdasaha likhate tomarA konarUpa virakta haYo nA| AllAh ra nikaTa eTA nyAyyatara o pramANera janye dRr3hatara evaM tomAdera madhye sandeha udreka nA haoYAra nikaTatara; kintu tomarA paraspara ye vyavasAYa nagada AdAna-pradAna kara tA tomarA nA likhale kona doSa nei| tomarA yakhana parasparera madhye vecAkenA kara takhana sAkSI rekha, lekhaka evaM sAkSI yena kSatigrasta nA haYa| yadi tomarA kSatigrasta kara tave tA tomAdera janye pApa| tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM tini tomAderake zikSA dena| AllAh sarvaviSaYe avahita|

yadi tomarA saphare thAka evaM kona lekhaka nA pAo tave hastAntarakRta vandhaka rAkhave| tomAdera eke aparake vizvAsa karale, yAke vizvAsa karA haYa se yena AmAnata pherata deYa evaM tAra pratipAlaka AllAhke bhaYa kare| tomarA sAkSya gopana kara nA, ye keu eTA gopana kare avazyai tAra antara pApI| tomarA yA kara AllAh tA savizeSa avahita|

AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu Ache samasta AllAh ra i| tomAdera mane yA Ache, tA prakAza kara vA gopana rAkha, AllAh era hiseva tomAdera nikaTa hate grahaNa karavena| erapara yAke icchA tini kSamA karavena Ara yAke khuzi zAsti divena| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

rAsUla, tAra prati tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte ImAna eneche evaM mu’minagaNao| tAdera sakale AllAhe, tA~ra phirizatAgaNe, tA~ra kitAvasamUhe o tA~ra rAsUlagaNe ImAna eneche| tArA vale, ‘AmarA tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye kona tAratamya kari nA’, Ara tArA vale, ‘AmarA zunechi evaM pAlana karechi| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA tomAra kSamA cAi Ara pratyAvartana tomArai nikaTa|’

AllAh kArao opara emana kona kaSTadAYaka dAYitva arpaNa karena nA yA tAra sAdhyAtIta| se bhAla yA upArjana kare tAra pratiphala tArai Ara se manda yA upArjana kare tAra pratiphala tArai| ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! yadi AmarA vismRta hai vA bhula kari tave tumi AmAderake pAkar3Ao kara nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera pUrvavartigaNera opara yemana gurudAYitva arpaNa karechile AmAdera opara temana dAYitva arpaNa kara nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! emana bhAra AmAdera opara arpaNa kara nA yA vahana karAra zakti AmAdera nei| AmAdera pApa mocana kara, AmAderake kSamA kara, AmAdera prati daYA kara, tumii AmAdera abhibhAvaka| sutarAM kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya kara|’
Alipha-lAma-mIma,
AllAh vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei, tini ciraJjIva, sarvasattAra dhAraka|
tini satyasaha tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechena, yA era pUrvera kitAvera samarthaka| Ara tini avatIrNa karechilena tAorAta o inajIla-

itipUrve mAnavajAtira satpatha pradarzanera janye; Ara tini phurakAna avatIrNa karechena| yArA AllAh ra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna kare tAdera janye kaThora zAsti Ache| AllAh mahAparAkramazAlI, daNDadAtA|
AllAh, nizcaYai AsamAna o yamIne kichui tA~ra nikaTa gopana thAke nA|
tinii mAtRgarbhe yebhAve icchA tomAdera AkRti gaThana karena| tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei; tini pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii tomAra prati e kitAva avatIrNa karechena yAra kichu AYAta ‘muhkAma’, eiguli kitAvera mUla; Ara anyaguli ‘mutAzAvih’, yAdera antare satya-laMghana pravaNatA raYeche zudhu tArAi phitanA o bhula vyAkhyAra uddezye mutAzAvihAtera anusaraNa kare| AllAh vyatIta anya keu era vyAkhyA jAne nA| Ara yArA jJAne sugabhIra tArA vale, ‘AmarA eTA vizvAsa kari, samastai AmAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate Agata’; evaM vodhazaktisampannerA vyatIta apara keu zikSA grahaNa kare nA|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! sarala patha pradarzanera para tumi AmAdera antarake satya laMghanapravaNa kara nA evaM tomAra nikaTa hate AmAderake karuNA dAna kara, nizcaYai tumi mahAdAtA|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi mAnava jAtike ekadina ekatre samaveta karave, ete kona sandeha nei; nizcaYai AllAh pratizrutira vyatikrama karena nA|’
nizcaYai yArA kupharI kare AllAh ra nikaTa tAdera dhanaizvarya o santAna-santati avazyai kona kAje lAgave nA Ara erAi dojakhera indhana|

tAdera abhyAsa phira‘AonI sampradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartigaNera abhyAsera nyAYa; erA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karechila; phale AllAh tAdera pApera janye tAderake zAstidAna karechilena| AllAh zAstidAne atyanta kaThora|
yArA kupharI kare tAderake vala, ‘tomarA zIghrai parAbhUta have evaM tomAderake ekatrita kare jAhAnnAmera dike niYe yAoYA have| Ara eTA kata nikRSTa AvAsasthala!’

duiTi dalera paraspara sammukhIna haoYAra madhye tomAdera janye avazyai nidarzana raYeche| ekadala AllAh ra pathe yuddha karachila, anyadala kAphira chila; erA tAderake cokhera dekhAYa dviguNa dekhachila| AllAha yAke icchA nija sAhAyya diYe zaktizAlI karena| nizcaYa ete antardRSTisampanna lokera janye zikSA Ache|

nArI, santAna, rAzikRta svarNaraupya Ara cihnita azvarAji, gavAdipazu o kSeta-khAmArera prati AkarSaNa mAnuSera janye suzobhita karA haYeche| eisava ihajIvanera bhogya vastu| Ara AllAh, tA~rai nikaTa Ache uttama AzraYasthala|

vala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake e sava vastu hate utkRSTatara kona kichura saMvAda diva? yArA tAkoYA avalamvana kare cale tAdera janye tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa jAnnAtasamUha raYeche, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| Ara sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, tAdera janye pavitra saGginIgaNa o AllAh ra nikaTa hate santuSTi raYeche| AllAh vAndAdera samparke samyaka draSTA|
yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi; sutarAM tumi AmAdera pApa kSamA kara evaM AmAderake Agunera AyAva hate rakSA kara;
tArA dhairyazIla, satyavAdI, anugata, vyaYakArI o zeSa rAtre kSamAprArthI|
AllAh sAkSya dena ye, nizcaYai tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei, phirizatAgaNa evaM jJAnIgaNao; AllAh nyAYanItite pratiSThita, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAha nei; tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

niHsandehe isalAmai AllAh ra nikaTa ekamAtra dIna| yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila tArA paraspara vidveSavazata tAdera nikaTa jJAna AsAra para matAnaikya ghaTiYechila| Ara keu AllAh ra nidarzanake asvIkAra karale AllAh to hiseva grahaNe atyanta tatpara|

yadi tArA tomAra saGge vitarke lipta haYa tave tumi vala, ‘Ami AllAh ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karechi evaM AmAra anusArigaNao|’ Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tAderake o nirakSaraderake vala, ‘tomarAo ki AtmasamarpaNa karecha?’ yadi tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare tave nizcaYai tArA hidAYAta pAve| Ara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave tomAra kartavya zudhu pracAra karA| AllAh vAndAdera samparke samyaka draSTA|
yArA AllAh ra AYAta asvIkAra kare, anyAYarUpe navIdera hatyA kare evaM mAnuSera madhye yArA nyAYaparAYaNatAra nirdeza deYa tAderake hatyA kare, tumi tAderake marmantuda zAstira saMvAda dAo|
eisava loka, edera kAryAvalI duniYA o AkhirAte niSphala have evaM tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ki tAderake dekha nAi yAderake kitAvera aMza pradAna karA haYechila? tAderake AllAh ra kitAvera dike AhvAna karA haYechila yAte eTA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa; erapara tAdera ekadala phire dA~r3AYa, Ara tArAi parAksamukha;
e kAraNe ye, tArA vale thAke, ‘dina kataka vyatIta AmAderake agni kakhanai sparza karave nA| tAdera nijedera dIna samvandhe tAdera mithyA udbhAvana tAderake pravaJcita kareche|

kintu seidina, yAte kona sandeha nei, tAdera ki avasthA have? ye dina Ami tAderake ekatra karava Ara pratyekake tAra arjita karmera pratidAna pUrNabhAve deoYA have, Ara tAdera prati kona anyAYa karA have nA|

vala, ‘he sArvabhauma zaktira mAlika AllAha! tumi yAke icchA kSamatA pradAna kara Ara yAra nikaTa hate icchA kSamatA ker3e nAo; yAke icchA tumi ijjata dAna kara, Ara yAke icchA tumi hIna kara| kalyANa tomAra hAtei| nizcaYai tumi sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

‘tumi rAtrike divase pariNata Ara divasake rAtrite pariNata kara: tumii mRta hate jIvantera AvirbhAva ghaTAo, AvAra jIvanta hate mRtera AvirbhAva ghaTAo| tumi yAke icchA aparimita jIvanopakaraNa dAna kara|’

mu’minagaNa yena mu’minagaNa vyatIta kAphiradera vandhurUpe grahaNa nA kare| ye keu eirUpa karave tAra saGge AllAh ra kona samparka thAkave nA; tave vyatikrama, yadi tomarA tAdera nikaTa hate AtmarakSAra janye satarkatA avalamvana kara| Ara AllAh tA~ra nijera samvandhe tomAderake sAvadhAna karachena evaM AllAh ra dikei phire yete have|
vala, ‘tomAdera antare yA Ache tA yadi tomarA gopana vA vyakta kara AllAh tA avagata Achena Ara AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu Ache tAo avagata Achena| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna’|

yedina pratyeke se ye bhAla kAja kareche Ara se ye manda kAja kareche tA vidyamAna pAve, sedina se tAra o oTAra madhye dUra vyavadhAna kAmanA karave| AllAh tA~ra nijera samvandhe tomAderake sAvadhAna karachena| AllAh vAndAdera prati atyanta daYArdra|
vala, ‘tomarA yadi AllAhke bhAlavAsa tave AmAke anusaraNa kara, AllAh tomAderake bhAlavAsivena Ara tomAdera aparAdha kSamA karavena| AllAh atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
vala, ‘AllAh o rAsUlera anugata hao|’ yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave jene rAkha, AllAh to kAphiraderake pachanda karena nA|
nizcaYai AllAh Adamake, nUhake o ivrAhImera vaMzadhara evaM ‘imarAnera vaMzadharake vizvajagate manonIta karechena|
erA eke aparera vaMzadhara| AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

smaraNa kara, yakhana imarAnera strI valechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra garbhe yA Ache tA ekAnta tomAra janye Ami utsarga karalAma| sutarAM tumi AmAra nikaTa hate eTA kavUla kara, nizcaYai tumi sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

erapara yakhana se eke prasava karala takhana se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami kanyA prasava karechi|’ se yA prasava kareche AllAh tA samyaka avagata| ‘Ara chele to ei meYera mata naYa, Ami era nAma ‘mAraiya়Ama’ rekhechi evaM abhizapta zaYatAna hate tAra o tAra vaMzadharadera janye tomAra zaraNa nicchi|’

erapara tAra pratipAlaka tAke bhAlabhAve kavUla karalena evaM tAke uttamarUpe lAlana-pAlana karalena Ara tini tAke yAkAriYAra tattvAvadhAne rekhechilena| yakhanai yAkAriYA kakSe tAra saGge sAkSAt karate yeta takhanai tAra nikaTa khAdya-sAmagrI dekhate peta| se valata, ‘he mAraiya়Ama! e sava tumi kothAYa pele?’ se valata, ‘eTA AllAh ra nikaTa hate|’ nizcaYai AllAh yAke icchA aparimita riyika dAna karena|
sekhAnei yAkAriYA tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa prArthanA kare valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke tumi tomAra nikaTa hate sat vaMzadhara dAna kara| nizcaYai tumi prArthanA zonekArI|’

yakhana yAkAriYA kakSe sAlAte dA~r3iYechilena takhana phirizatAgaNa tAke samvodhana kare valala, ‘AllAha tomAke iYAhiYAra susaMvAda dicchena, se have AllAh ra vANIra samarthaka, netA, strI virAgI o puNyavAnadera madhye ekajana navI|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra putra have kirUpe? AmAra to vArdhakya eseche evaM AmAra strI vandhyA|’ tini valalena ‘eibhAvei|’ AllAh yA icchA tA karena|
