se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke ekaTi nidarzana dAo|’ tini valalena, ‘tomAra nidarzana ei ye, tina dina tumi iMgita vyatIta kathA valate pArave nA, Ara tomAra pratipAlakake adhika smaraNa karave evaM sandhyAYa o prabhAte tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karave|’
smaraNa kara, yakhana pherezatAgaNa valechila, ‘he mAraiya়Ama! AllAh tomAke manonIta o pavitra karechena Ara vizvera nArIgaNera madhye tomAke manonIta karechena|’
‘he mAraiya়Ama! tomAra pratipAlakera anugata hao o sijdA kara Ara yArA ruka kare tAdera saGge ruka kara|

eTA adRzya viSaYera saMvAda-yA tomAke ohI diYe avahita karachi| mAraiya়Amera tattvAvadhAnera dAYitva tAdera madhye ke grahaNa karave era janye yakhana tArA tAdera kalama nikSepa karachila tumi takhana tAdera nikaTa chile nA evaM tArA yakhana vAdAnuvAda karachila takhanao tumi tAdera nikaTa chile nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana pherezatAgaNa valala, ‘he mAraiya়Ama! nizcaYai AllAh tomAke tA~ra pakSa hate ekaTi kAlemAra susaMvAda dicchena| tAra nAma mAsIh mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsA, se duniYA o AkhirAte sammAnita evaM sAnnidhyaprAptagaNera anyatama have|
‘se dolanAYa thAkA avasthAYa o pariNata vaYase mAnuSera saGge kathA valave Ara se have puNyavAnadera ekajana|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke kona puruSa sparza kare nAi, AmAra santAna have kIbhAve?’ tini valalena, ‘ebhAvei’, AllAh yA icchA sRSTi karena| tini yakhana kichu sthira karena takhana valena, ‘hao’ evaM tA haYe yAYa|
‘evaM tini tAke zikSA divena kitAva, hikamata, tAorAta o injIla|

‘evaM tAke vanI isarAIlera janye rAsUla karavena|’ se valave, ‘Ami tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera nikaTa nidarzana niYe esechi| Ami tomAdera janye kardama diYe ekaTi pakSIsadRza AkRti gaThana karava; erapara ete Ami phutkAra diva; phale AllAh ra hukume tA pAkhi haYe yAve| Ami janmAndha o kuSTha vyAdhigrastake nirAmaYa karava Ara AllAh ra hukume mRtake jIvanta karava| tomarA tomAdera gRhe yA AhAra kara o maojuda kara tA tomAderake vale diva| tomarA yadi mu’mina hao tave ete tomAdera janye nidarzana Ache|

‘Ara Ami esechi AmAra sAmane tAorAte yA Ache tAra samarthakarUpe o tomAdera janye yA niSiddha chila tAra katakagulike vaidha karate| Ara Ami tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera nikaTa nidarzana niYe esechi| sutarAM AllAhke bhaYa kara Ara AmAke anusaraNa kara|
‘nizcaYai AllAh AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka, sutarAM tomarA tA~ra ‘ivAdata karave| eTAi sarala patha|’

yakhana ‘IsA tAdera avizvAsa upalavdhi karala takhana se valala, ‘AllAh ra pathe kArA AmAra sAhAyyakArI?’ hAoYArIgaNa valala, ‘AmarAi AllAh ra pathe sAhAyyakArI| AmarA AllAhe ImAna enechi| AmarA AtmasamarpaNakArI, tumi era sAkSI thAka|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi yA avatIrNa karecha tAte AmarA ImAna enechi evaM AmarA ei rAsUlera anusaraNa karechi| sutarAM AmAderake sAkSyadAna-kArIdera tAlikAbhukta kara|’
Ara tArA cakrAnta karechila AllAho kauzala karechilena; AllAh kauzalIdera zreSTha|

smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAh valavena, ‘he ‘IsA! Ami tomAra kAla pUrNa karachi evaM AmAra nikaTa tomAke tule nicchi Ara yArA kupharI kareche tAdera madhya hate tomAke pavitra karachi| Ara tomAra anusArigaNake kiYAmata paryanta kAphiradera opara prAdhAnya dicchi, erapara AmAra kAche tomAdera pratyAvartana|’ tArapara ye viSaYe tomAdera matAntara ghaTache Ami tA mImAMsA kare diva|
yArA kupharI kareche Ami tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte kaThora zAsti pradAna karava Ara tAdera kona sAhAyya-kArI nei|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche tini tAdera pratiphala purApuribhAve pradAna karavena| AllAh jAlimadera pachanda karena nA|
eTA Ami tomAra nikaTa tilAoYAta karachi AYAtasamUha o sAragarbha vANI hate|
AllAh ra nikaTa nizcaYai ‘IsAra dRSTAnta Adamera dRSTAntasadRza| tini tAke mRttikA hate sRSTi karechena; erapara oTAke valalena ‘hao’, phale se haYe gela|
satya to tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate, sutarAM tumi saMzaYavAdIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|

tomAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra para ye keu e viSaYe tomAra saGge tarka kare tAke vala, Asa, AmarA AhvAna kari AmAdera putragaNake o tomAdera putragaNake, AmAdera nArIgaNake o tomAdera nArIgaNake, AmAdera nijederake o tomAdera nijederake, erapara AmarA vinIta Avedana kari evaM mithyAvAdIdera opara dei AllAh ra lA‘nata|
nizcaYai eTA satya vRttAnta| AllAh vyatIta anya ilAh nei; nizcaYa AllAh parama pratApazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave nizcaYai AllAh phAsAdakArIdera samvandhe samyaka avahita|

tumi vala, ‘he kitAvIgaNa! Asa se kathAYa yA AmAdera o tomAdera madhye eka; yena AmarA AllAh vyatIta kArao ‘ivAdata nA kari, kona kichukei tA~ra zarIka nA kari Ara AmAdera keu kAukeo AllAh vyatIta rava hiseve grahaNa nA kare|’ yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave vala, ‘tomarA sAkSI thAka, avazyai AmarA musalima|’
he kitAvIgaNa! ivrAhIma samvandhe kena tomarA tarka kara, athaca tAorAta o injIla to tAra parei avatIrNa haYechila? tomarA ki vujha nA?

hA~, tomarA to seisava loka, ye viSaYe tomAdera sAmAnya jJAna Ache se viSaYe tomarAi to tarka karecha, tave ye viSaYe tomAdera kona jJAna nei se viSaYe kena tarka karacho? AllAh jJAta Achena Ara tomarA jJAta nao|
ivrAhIma iYAhUdIo chila nA, khrisTAnao chila nA; se chila ekaniSTha AtmasamarpaNakArI evaM se muzarikadera antarbhuktao chila nA|
nizcaYai mAnuSera madhye tArA ivrAhImera ghaniSThatama yArA tAra anusaraNa kareche Ara ei navI o yArA ImAna eneche; Ara AllAh mu’minadera abhibhAvaka|
kitAvIdera ekadala cAYa yena tomAderake vipathagAmI karate pAre, athaca tArA nijederakei vipathagAmI kare, kintu tArA upalavdhi kare nA|
he kitAvI-gaNa! tomarA kena AllAh ra AYAtake asvIkAra kara, yakhana tomarAi sAkSya vahana kara?
he kitAvIgaNa! tomarA kena satyake mithyAra saGge mizrita kara evaM satya gopana kara, yakhana tomarA jAna?
kitAvIdera ekadala valala, ‘yArA ImAna eneche tAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tomarA dinera prArambhe tA vizvAsa kara evaM dinera zeSe tA pratyAkhyAna kara; haYata tArA phirave|

‘Ara ye vyakti tomAdera dInera anusaraNa kare tAderake vyatIta Ara kAukeo vizvAsa kara nA|’ vala, ‘AllAh ra nirdezita pathai ekamAtra patha| eTA ejanye ye, tomAderake yA deoYA haYeche anurUpa Ara kAukeo deoYA have vA tomAdera pratipAlakera sAmane tArA tomAderake yuktite parAbhUta karave| vala, ‘anugraha AllAh ra i hAte; tini yAke icchA tA pradAna karena| AllAh prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
tini svIYa anugrahera janye yAke icchA vizeSa kare veche nena| AllAh mahA anugrahazIla|

kitAvIdera madhye emana loka raYeche, ye vipula sampada AmAnata rAkhaleo pherata dive; AvAra emana lokao Ache yAra nikaTa ekaTi dInArao AmAnata rAkhale tAra pichane lege nA thAkale se pherata dive nA, eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA vale, ‘nirakSaradera prati AmAdera kona vAdhyavAdhakatA nei’, evaM tArA jene-zune AllAh samparke mithyA vale|
hA~, keu tAra aGgIkAra pUrNa karale evaM tAkoYA avalamvana kare calale AllAh avazyai muttAkIdera bhAlavAsena|

yArA AllAh ra saGge kRta pratizruti o nijedera zapathake tuccha mUlye vikraYa kare parakAle tAdera kona aMza nei| kiYAmatera dina AllAh tAdera saGge kathA valavena nA evaM tAdera dike tAkAvena nA Ara tAderake parizuddha karavena nA; tAdera janye marmantuda zAsti raYeche|

Ara nizcaYai tAdera madhye ekadala loka Achei yArA kitAvake jihvA diYe vikRta kare yAte tomarA eke AllAh ra kitAvera aMza mane kara; kintu oTA kitAvera aMza naYa evaM tArA vale, ‘tA AllAh ra pakSa hate’, kintu tA AllAh ra pakSa hate prerita naYa| tArA jene-zune AllAh samparke mithyA vale|

kona vyaktike AllAh kitAva, hikmata o navuoYAta dAna karAra para se mAnuSake valave, ‘AllAh ra parivarte tomarA AmAra dAsa haYe yAo’, eTA tAra janye saGgata naYa; varaM se valave, ‘tomarA ravvAnI haYe yAo, yehetu tomarA kitAva zikSA dAna kara evaM yehetu tomarA adhyaYana kara|’
pherezatAgaNake o navIgaNake pratipAlakarUpe grahaNa karate se tomAderake nirdeza dite pAre nA| tomAdera musalima haoYAra para se ki tomAderake kupharIra nirdeza dive?

smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAh navIdera aGgIkAra niYechilena ye, tomAderake kitAva o hikmata yA kichu diYechi, erapara tomAdera kAche yA Ache tAra pratyAYanakArIrUpe yakhana ekajana rAsUla Asave takhana tomarA avazyai tAra prati ImAna Anave evaM tAke sAhAyya karave|’ tini valavena, ‘tomarA ki svIkAra karale? Ara e samparke AmAra aGgIkAra ki tomarA grahaNa karale?’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA svIkAra karalAma|’ tini valalena, ‘tave tomarA sAkSI thAka Ara Amio tomAdera saGge sAkSI thAkalAma|’
era para yArA mukha phirAve tArAi satyapathatyAgI|
tArA ki cAYa AllAh ra dInera parivarte anya dIna? yakhana AkAze o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai svecchAYa vA anicchAYa tA~ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa kareche! Ara tA~ra dikei tArA pratyAnIta have|

vala, ‘AmarA AllAhte evaM AmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche evaM ivrAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYA‘ka‚va o tAra vaMzadharagaNera prati yA avatIrNa haYechila Ara yA mUsA, ‘IsA o anyAnya navIke tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate yA pradAna karA haYeche tAte ImAna enechi, AmarA tAdera madhye kona tAratamya kari nA evaM AmarA tA~rai nikaTa AtmasamarpaNakArI|’
keu isalAma vyatIta anya kona dIna grahaNa karate icchA karale tA kakhanao kavUla karA have nA evaM se have AkhirAte kSatigrastadera antarbhukta|

AllAh kirUpe satpathe paricAlita karavena sei sampradAYake, yArA ImAna AnaYanera para o rAsUlake satya vale sAkSyadAna karAra para evaM tAdera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzana AsAra para kupharI kare? AllAh jAlima sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|
erAi tArA yAdera karmaphala ei ye, tAdera opara AllAh ra, phirizatAgaNera evaM mAnuSa sakalerai lA‘nata|
tArA ete sthAYI have, tAdera zAsti laghu karA have nA Ara tAderake avakAzao deoYA have nA|
tave era para yArA taovA kare o nijederake saMzodhana kare neYa tArA vyatireke| nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ImAna AnAra para yArA kupharI kare evaM yAdera satya pratyAkhyAna-pravRtti vRddhi pete thAke tAdera taovA kakhanao kavUla have nA| erAi pathabhraSTa|

yArA kupharI kare evaM kAphirarUpe yAdera mRtyu ghaTe tAdera kArao nikaTa hate pRthivIpUrNa svarNa vinimaYasvarUpa pradAna karaleo tA kakhanao kavUla karA have nA| erAi tArA yAdera janye marmantuda zAsti raYeche; edera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
tomarA yA bhAlavAsa tA hate vyaYa nA karA paryanta tomarA kakhanao puNya lAbha karave nA| tomarA yA kichu vyaYa kara AllAh avazyai se samvandhe savizeSa avahita|

tAorAta avatIrNa haoYAra pUrve isarAIla nijera janye yA hArAma karechila tA vyatIta vanI isrAIlera janye yAvatIYa khAdyai hAlAla chila| vala, ‘yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tave tAorAta Ana evaM pATha kara|’
era parao yArA AllAh samparke mithyA sRSTi kare tArAi jAlima|
vala, ‘AllAh satya valechena| sutarAM tomarA ekaniSTha ivrAhImera dharmAdarza anusaraNa kara, se muzarikadera antarbhukta naYa|’
nizcaYai mAnavajAtira janye sarvaprathama ye gRha pratiSThita haYechila tA to vAkkAYa, eTA varakatamaYa o vizvajagatera dizArI|

ete aneka suspaSTa nidarzana Ache, yemana mAkAme ivrAhIma| Ara ye keu sekhAne praveza kare se nirApada| mAnuSera madhye yAra sekhAne yAoYAra sAmarthya Ache, AllAh ra uddezye ai gRhera hajja karA tAra avazyakartavya| Ara keu pratyAkhyAna karale se jene rAkhuka, nizcaYai AllAh vizvajagatera mukhApekSI nana|
vala, ‘he kitAvIgaNa! tomarA AllAh ra nidarzanake kena pratyAkhyAna kara? tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra sAkSI|’
vala, ‘he kitAvIgaNa! ye vyakti ImAna eneche tAke kena AllAh ra pathe vAdhA diccha, ete vakratA ane¦SaNa kare? athaca tomarA sAkSI| tomarA yA kara, AllAh se samvandhe anavahita nana|’
he mu’minagaNa! yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche, tomarA yadi tAdera dalavizeSera Anugatya kara, tave tArA tomAderake ImAna AnAra para AvAra kAphira vAniYe chAr3ave|

kirUpe tomarA satya pratyAkhyAna karave yakhana AllAh ra AYAtasamUha tomAdera nikaTa paThita haYa Ara tomAdera madhye tA~ra rAsUla raYeche? keu AllAhke dRr3habhAve avalamvana karale se avazyai sarala pathe paricAlita have|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhke yathArthabhAve bhaYa kara evaM tomarA AtmasamarpaNakArI nA haYe kona avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kara nA|

tomarA sakale AllAh ra rajju dRr3habhAve dhara Ara paraspara vicchinna haYo nA| tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha smaraNa kara: tomarA chile paraspara zatru Ara tini tomAdera hRdaYe prItira saJcAra karena, phale tA~ra anugrahe tomarA paraspara bhAi haYe gele| tomarA to agnikuNDera prAnte chile, AllAh tA hate tomAdera rakSA karechena| eirUpe AllAh tomAdera janye tA~ra nidarzanasamUha spaSTabhAve vivRta karena yAte tomarA satpatha pete pAra|
tomAdera madhye emana ekadala hoka yArA kalyANera dike AhvAna karave Ara satkarmera nirdeza dive o asatkarme niSedha karave; erAi saphalakAma|
tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA tAdera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzana AsAra para vicchinna haYeche o nijedera madhye matAntara sRSTi kareche| tAdera janye mahAzAsti Ache|

sedina kataka mukha ujjvala have Ara kataka mukha kAla have; yAdera mukha kAla have tAderake valA have, ‘ImAna AnaYanera para ki tomarA kupharI karechile? sutarAM tomarA zAsti bhoga kara, yehetu tomarA kupharI karate|’
Ara yAdera mukha ujjvala have tArA AllAh ra anugrahe thAkave, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|
eiguli AllAh ra AYAta, tomAra nikaTa yathAyathabhAve tilAoYAta karachi| AllAh vizvajagatera prati juluma karate cAna nA|
AsamAne yA kichu Ache o yamIne yA kichu Ache sava AllAh ra i; AllAh ra nikaTai sava kichu pratyAnIta have|

tomarAi zreSTha ummata, mAnavajAtira janye tomAdera AvirbhAva haYeche; tomarA satkAjera nirdeza dAna kara, asatkAje niSedha kara Ara AllAhara opara vizvAsa kara| kitAvIgaNa yadi ImAna Anata tave tAdera janye bhAla hata| tAdera madhye kichusaMkhyaka mu’mina Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMza satyatyAgI|
sAmAnya kleza deoYA chAr3A tArA tomAdera kona kSati karate pArave nA| yadi tArA tomAdera saGge yuddha kare tave tArA pRSThapradarzana karave; erapara tArA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

AllAh ra pratizruti o mAnuSera pratizrutira vAire yekhAnei tAdera pAoYA giYeche sekhAnei tArA lAJchita haYeche| tArA AllAh ra krodhera pAtra haYeche evaM hInatAgrasta haYeche| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAh ra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna karata Ara anyAYabhAve navIgaNake hatyA karata; eTA eijanye ye, tArA avAdhya haYechila Ara sImAlaMghana karata|
tArA sakale eka rakama naYa| kitAvIdera madhye avicalita ekadala Ache; tArA rAtrikAle AllAh ra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare evaM sijdA kare|
tArA AllAh evaM zeSa dine vizvAsa kare, satkAjera nirdeza deYa, asatkAje niSedha kare evaM tArA kalyANakara kAje pratiyogitA kare| tArAi sajjanadera antarbhukta|
uttama kAjera yA kichu tArA kare tA hate tAdera kakhanao vaJcita karA have nA| AllAh muttAkIdera samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
yArA kupharI kare tAdera dhanaizvarya o santAna-santati AllAh ra nikaTa kakhanao kona kAje Asave nA| tArAi dojakhavAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|

ei pArthiva jIvane yA tArA vyaYa kare tAra dRSTAnta himazItala vAYu, eTA ye jAti nijedera prati juluma kareche tAdera zasyakSetrake AghAta kare o vinaSTa kare| AllAh tAdera prati kona juluma karena nAi, tArAi nijedera prati juluma kare|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera Apanajana vyatIta apara kAukeo antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa kara nA| tArA tomAdera aniSTa karate truTi karave nA; yA tomAdera vipanna kare tAi tArA kAmanA kare| tAdera mukhe vidveSa prakAza pAYa evaM tAdera hRdaYa yA gopana rAkhe tA Arao gurutara| tomAdera janye nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta karechi, yadi tomarA anudhAvana kara|

dekha, tomarAi tAdera bhAlavAsa kintu tArA tomAdera bhAlavAse nA athaca tomarA samasta kitAve ImAna rAkha Ara tArA yakhana tomAdera saMsparze Ase takhana vale, ‘AmarA vizvAsa kari; kintu tArA yakhana ekAnte milita haYa takhana tomAdera prati Akroze tArA nijedera aGgulira agrabhAga dA~te keTe thAke| vala, ‘tomAdera Akrozei tomarA mara|’ antare yA raYeche se samvandhe AllAh savizeSa avahita|

tomAdera maGgala hale tA tAderake kaSTa deYa Ara tomAdera amaGgala hale tArA ete Anandita haYa| tomarA yadi dhairyazIla hao evaM muttAkI hao tave tAdera Sar3ayantra tomAdera kichui kSati karate pArave nA| tArA yA kare nizcaYai AllAh tA pariveSTana kare Achena|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tumi tomAra parijanavargera nikaTa hate pratyUSe vera haYe yuddhera janye mu’minagaNake ghA~Tite vinyasta karachile evaM AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yakhana tomAdera madhye dui dalera sAhasa hArAnora upakrama haYechila athaca AllAh ubhaYera vandhu chilena, AllAh ra pratii yena mu’minagaNa nirbhara kare|
Ara vadarera yuddhe yakhana tomarA hInavala chile AllAh to tomAdera sAhAyya karechilena| sutarAM tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA kRtajJa hate pAra|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tumi mu’minagaNake valachile, ‘eTA ki tomAdera janye yatheSTa naYa ye, tomAdera pratipAlaka-prerita tina sahasra pherezatA diYe tomAderake sahAYatA karavena?’
hyA~, nizcaYa, yadi tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM sAvadhAna haYe cala, tave tArA drutagatite tomAdera opara AkramaNa karale AllAh pa~A~ca sahasra cihnita pherezatA diYe tomAdera sAhAyya karavena|
eTA to AllAh tomAdera janye zudhu susaMvAda o tomAdera citta-prazAntira janye karechena Ara sAhAyya to zudhu parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa AllAh ra nikaTa hatei haYa,
kAphiradera eka aMzake nizcihna karAra janye vA lAJchita karAra janye; phale tArA nirAza haYe phire yAYa|
tini tAdera prati kSamAzIla havena vA tAderake zAsti divena-e viSaYe tomAra karaNIYa kichui nei; kAraNa tArA to jAlima|
AsamAne yA kichu Ache o yamIne yA kichu Ache samasta AllAh ra i| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena Ara yAke icchA zAsti dAna karena| AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA suda kheo nA kramavardhamAna evaM AllAhke bhaYa kara yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|
evaM tomarA sei agnike bhaYa kara yA kAphiradera janye prastuta rAkhA haYeche|
tomarA AllAh o rAsUlera Anugatya kara yAte tomarA kRpA lAbha karate pAra|
tomarA dhAvamAna hao svIYa pratipAlakera kSamAra dike Ara sei jAnnAtera dike yAra vistRti AsamAna o yamInera nyAYa, yA prastuta rAkhA haYeche muttAkIdera janye,
yArA sacchala o asacchala avasthAYa vyaYa kare Ara yArA krodha saMvaraNakArI evaM mAnuSera prati kSamAzIla; AllAh satkarmaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena;

evaM yArA kona azlIla kAja kare phelale vA nijedera prati juluma karale AllAhke smaraNa kare Ara nijedera pApera janye kSamA prArthanA kare| AllAh vyatIta ke pApa kSamA karave? evaM tArA yA kare phele, jene-zune tAra punarAvRtti kare nA|
erAi tArA, yAdera puraskAra tAdera pratipAlakera kSamA Ara jAnnAta, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM satkarmazIladera puraskAra kata uttama!
tomAdera pUrve vahu vidhAna-vyavasthA gata haYeche, sutarAM tomarA pRthivI bhramaNa kara Ara dekha mithyAzraYIdera kI pariNAma!
eTA mAnavajAtira janye spaSTa varNanA evaM muttAkIdera janye hidAYAta o upadeza|
tomarA hInavala haYo nA evaM duHkhitao haYo nA; tomarAi vijaYI yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|

yadi tomAdera AghAta lege thAke, anurUpa AghAta to ederao legechila| mAnuSera madhye e dinagulira paryAYakrame Ami Avartana ghaTAi, yAte AllAh mu’minagaNake jAnate pArena evaM tomAdera madhya hate katakake zahIdarUpe grahaNa karate pArena Ara AllAh jAlimadera pachanda karena nA;
Ara yAte AllAh mu’minadera parizodhana karate pArena evaM kAphiradera nizcihna karate pArena|
tomarA ki mane kara ye, tomarA jAnnAte praveza karave, athaca AllAh tomAdera madhye ke jihAda kareche Ara ke dhairyazIla tA ekhanao prakAza karena nAi?
mRtyura sammukhIna haoYAra pUrve tomarA to eTA kAmanA karate, ekhana to tomarA tA svacakSe dekhale|

muhAmmada ekajana rAsUla mAtra; tAra pUrve vahu rAsUla gata haYeche| sutarAM yadi se mArA yAYa vA se nihata haYa tave tomarA ki pRSTha pradarzana karave? Ara keu pRSTha pradarzana karale se kakhanao AllAh ra kSati karate pArave nA; varaM AllAh zIghrai kRtajJadera puraskRta karavena|

AllAh ra anumati vyatIta kArao mRtyu hate pAre nA, yehetu era meYAda avadhArita| keu pArthiva puraskAra cAile Ami tAke tAra kichu dei Ara keu pAralaukika puraskAra cAile Ami tAke tAra kichu dei evaM zIghrai kRtajJadera puraskRta karava|

evaM kata navI yuddha kareche, tAdera saGge vahu AllAhoYAlA chila| AllAh ra pathe tAdera ye viparyaYa ghaTechila tAte tArA hInavala haYa nAi, durvala haYa nAi evaM nata haYa nAi| AllAh dhairyazIladera bhAlavAsena|

e kathA vyatIta tAdera Ara kona kathA chila nA, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera pApa o AmAdera kAje sImAlaMghana tumi kSamA kara, AmAdera pA sudRr3ha rAkha Ara kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya kara|’
erapara AllAh tAderake pArthiva puraskAra o uttama pAralaukika puraskAra dAna karena| AllAh satkarmaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|
he mu’minagaNa! yadi tomarA kAphiradera Anugatya kara tave tArA tomAderake viparIta dike phiriYe dive Ara tomarA kSatigrasta haYe par3ave|
AllAhi to tomAdera abhibhAvaka Ara tinii zreSTha sAhAyyakArI|
Ami kAphiradera hRdaYe bhItira saJcAra karava, yehetu tArA AllAh ra saGge zarIka kareche, yAra svapakSe AllAh kona sanada pAThAna nAi| jAhAnnAma tAdera AvAsa; kata nikRSTa AvAsasthala jAlimadera!

AllAh tomAdera saGge tA~ra pratizruti pUrNa karechilena yakhana tomarA AllAh ra anumatikrame tAderake vinAza karachile, ye paryanta nA tomarA sAhasa hArAle evaM nirdeza samvandhe matabheda sRSTi karale Ara yA tomarA bhAlavAsa tA tomAdera dekhAnora para tomarA avAdhya hale| tomAdera kataka ihakAla cAcchilo Ara kataka parakAla cAcchilo| erapara tini parIkSA karAra janye tomAderake tAdera hate phiriYe dilena| avazyai tini tomAderake kSamA karalena evaM AllAh mu’minadera prati anugrahazIla|

smaraNa kara, tomarA yakhana uparera dike chuTachile Ara pichana phire kArao prati lakSya karachile nA, Ara rAsUla tomAderake pichana dika hate AhvAna karachila| phale tini tomAderake vipadera opara vipada dilena yAte tomarA yA hAriYecha vA ye vipada tomAdera opara eseche tAra janye tomarA duHkhita nA hao| tomarA yA kara AllAh tA vizeSabhAve avahita|

erapara duHkhera para tini tomAderake pradAna karalena prazAnti tandrArUpe, yA tomAdera ekadalake Acchanna karechila| Ara ekadala jAhilI yugera ajJera nyAYa AllAh samvandhe avAstava dhAraNA kare nijerAi nijederake udvigna karechila e vale ye, ‘AmAdera ki kona adhikAra Ache?’ vala, ‘samasta viSaYa AllAh ra i ikhtiYAra|’ yA tArA tomAra nikaTa prakAza kare nA, tArA tAdera antare tA gopana rAkhe, Ara vale, ‘e vyApAre AmAdera kona adhikAra thAkale AmarA ei sthAne nihata hatAma nA|’ vala, ‘yadi tomarA tomAdera gRhe avasthAna karate tavuo nihata haoYA yAdera janye avadhArita chila tArA nijedera mRtyusthAne vera hata| eTA ejanye ye, AllAh tomAdera antare yA Ache tA parIkSA karena Ara tomAdera antare yA Ache tA parizodhana karena| antare yA Ache AllAh se samparke vizeSabhAve avahita|

yedina dui dala parasparera sammukhIna haYechila sei dina tomAdera madhya hate yArA pRSTha pradarzana karechila, tAdera kona kRtakarmera janye zaYatAnai tAdera padaskhalana ghaTiYechila| avazya AllAh tAdera kSamA karechena| AllAh kSamAparAYaNa o parama sahanazIla|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA kupharI kare Ara tAdera bhAigaNa yakhana deze deze saphara kare vA yuddhe lipta haYa, tAdera samparke vale, ‘tArA yadi AmAdera nikaTa thAkata tave tArA marata nA Ara nihata hata nA|’ phale AllAh eTAi tAdera manastApe pariNata karena; AllAhi jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna, tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|
tomarA AllAh ra pathe nihata hale vA mRtyuvaraNa karale, yA tArA jamA kare, AllAh ra kSamA o daYA avazya tA apekSA zreYa|
evaM tomAdera mRtyu hale vA tomarA nihata hale AllAh ra i nikaTa tomAderake ekatra karA have|

AllAh ra daYAYa tumi tAdera prati komala-hRdaYa haYechile; yadi tumi rUr3ha o kaThoracitta hate tave tArA tomAra AzapAza hate sare par3ata| sutarAM tumi tAdera kSamA kara evaM tAdera janye kSamA prArthanA kara Ara kAjekarme tAdera saGge parAmarza kara, erapara tumi kona saMkalpa karale AllAh ra opara nirbhara karave, yArA nirbhara kare AllAh tAdera bhAlavAsena|

AllAh tomAdera sAhAyya karale tomAdera opara jaYI haoYAra keui thAkave nA| Ara tini tomAderake sAhAyya nA karale, tini chAr3A ke emana Ache, ye tomAdera sAhAyya karave? mu’minagaNa AllAh ra oparai nirbhara karuka|

anyAYabhAve kona vastu gopana karave, eTA navIra pakSe asambhava| Ara keu anyAYabhAve kichu gopana karale, yA se anyAYabhAve gopana karave kiYAmatera dina se tA niYe Asave| erapara pratyekake, yA se arjana kareche tA pUrNamAtrAYa deoYA have| tAdera prati kona juluma karA have nA|
ye AllAh ra santuSTira anusArI, se ki era mata ye AllAh ra krodhera pAtra haYeche evaM jAhAnnAmai yAra AvAsa? evaM eTA kata nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!
AllAh ra nikaTa tArA vibhinna starera; tArA yA kare AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|

AllAh mu’minadera prati avazyai anugraha karechena ye, tini tAdera nijedera madhya hate tAdera nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechena, ye tA~ra AYAtasamUha tAdera nikaTa tilAoYAta kare, tAderake parizodhana kare Ara kitAva o hikmata zikSA deYa, yadio tArA pUrve spaSTa vibhrAntitei chila|

kI vyApAra! yakhana tomAdera opara musIvata elo takhana tomarA valile, ‘eTA kothA hate elo?’ athaca tomarA to dviguNa vipada ghaTiYechile| vala, ‘eTA tomAdera nijederai nikaTa hate’; nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
yedina dui dala parasparera sammukhIna haYechila, sedina tomAdera opara ye viparyaYa ghaTechila tA AllAh ra i hukume; eTA mu’minagaNake jAnavAra janye|

evaM munAphikaderake jAnavAra janye Ara tAderake valA haYechila, ‘Asa, tomarA AllAh ra pathe yuddha kara vA pratirodha kara|’ tArA valechila, ‘yadi yuddha jAnatAma tave nizcitabhAve tomAdera anusaraNa karatAma|’ sedina tArA ImAna apekSA kupharIra nikaTatara chila| yA tAdera antare nei tArA tA mukhe vale; tArA yA gopana rAkhe AllAh tA vizeSabhAve avahita|
yArA ghare vase thAkalo Ara tAdera bhAidera samvandhe valala, tArA AmAdera kathAmata calale nihata hata nA, tAderake vala, ‘yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tave nijederake mRtyu hate rakSA kara|’
yArA AllAh ra pathe nihata haYeche tAdera kakhanai mRta mane kara nA, varaM tArA jIvita evaM tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tArA jIvikAprApta|

AllAh nija anugrahe tAderake yA diYechena tAte tArA Anandita evaM tAdera pichane yArA ekhanao tAdera saGge milita haYa nAi tAdera janye Ananda prakAza kare, eijanye ye, tAdera kona bhaYa nei Ara tArA duHkhitao have nA|
AllAh ra niYAmata o anugrahera janye tArA Ananda prakAza kare Ara eTA e kAraNe ye, AllAh mu’minadera zramaphala naSTa karena nA|
yakhama haoYAra para yArA AllAh o rAsUlera DAke sAr3A diYeche tAdera madhye yArA satkAja kare evaM tAkoYA avalamvana kare cale tAdera janye mahApuraskAra raYeche|

ederake loke valechila, tomAdera viruddhe loka jamAYeta haYeche, sutarAM tomarA tAderake bhaYa kara; kintu eTA tAdera ImAna dRr3hatara karechila Ara tArA valechila, ‘AllAhi AmAdera janye yatheSTa evaM tini kata uttama karmavidhAYaka!’
tArapara tArA AllAh ra niYAmata o anugrahasaha phire esechila, kona aniSTa tAderake sparza kare nAi evaM AllAh yAte rAyI tArA tArai anusaraNa karechila Ara AllAh mahAanugrahazIla|
erAi zaYatAna, tomAderake tAra vandhudera bhaYa dekhAYa; sutarAM yadi tomarA mu’mina hao tave tomarA tAderake bhaYa kara nA, AmAkei bhaYa kara|

yArA kupharIte tvaritagati, tAdera AcaraNa yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa| tArA kakhanao AllAh ra kona kSati karate pArave nA| AllAh AkhirAte tAderake kona aMza deoYAra icchA karena nA, tAdera janye mahAzAsti raYeche|
yArA ImAnera vinimaYe kupharI kraYa kareche tArA kakhanao AllAh ra kona kSati karate pArave nA| tAdera janye yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
kAphirarA yena kichutei mane nA kare ye, Ami avakAza dei tAdera maGgalera janye; Ami avakAza diYe thAki yAte tAdera pApa vRddhi pAYa Ara tAdera janye lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

asatke sat hate pRthaka nA karA paryanta tomarA ye avasthAYa Acha AllAh mu’minagaNake sei avasthAYa cher3e dite pArena nA| adRzya samparke tomAderake AllAh avahita karAra nana; tave AllAh tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye yAke icchA manonIta karena| sutarAM tomarA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera opara ImAna Ana| tomarA ImAna Anale o tAkoYA avalamvana kare calile tomAdera janye mahApuraskAra raYeche|

Ara AllAh nija anugrahe yA tAdera diYechena tAte yArA kRpaNatA kare tAdera janye tA maGgala, eTA yena tArA kichutei mane nA kare| nA, eTA tAdera janye amaGgala| yAte tArA kRpaNatA karave kiYAmatera dina seTAi tAdera galAYa ver3i have| AsamAna o yamInera svatvAdhikAra ekamAtra AllAh ra i| tomarA yA kara AllAh tA vizeSabhAve avahita|

yArA vale, ‘AllAh avazyai abhAvagrasta Ara AmarA abhAvamukta’, tAdera kathA AllAh zunechena| tArA yA valeche tA Ara navIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karAra viSaYa Ami likhe rAkhava evaM valiva, ‘tomarA dahana-yantraNA bhoga kara|’
eTA tomAdera kRtakarmera phala Ara eTA e kAraNe ye, AllAh vAndAdera prati jAlima nana|

yArA vale, ‘AllAh AmAderake Adeza diYechena, AmarA yena kona rAsUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana nA kari yatakSaNa paryanta se AmAdera nikaTa emana kuravAnI upasthita nA karave yA agni grAsa karave; tAderake vala, ‘AmAra pUrve aneka rAsUla spaSTa nidarzanasaha evaM tomarA yA valatecha tAsaha tomAdera nikaTa esechila, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tave kena tAderake hatyA karechile?’
tArA yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare, tomAra pUrve ye sakala rAsUla spaSTa nidarzana, AsamAnI sahIphA o dIptimAna kitAvasaha esechila tAderakeo to asvIkAra karA haYechila|

jIvamAtrai mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave| kiYAmatera dina tomAderake tomAdera karmaphala pUrNa mAtrAYa deoYA have| yAke agni hate dUre rAkhA have evaM jAnnAte dAkhila karA have se-i saphalakAma Ara pArthiva jIvana chalanAmaYa bhoga vyatIta kichui naYa|

tomAderake nizcaYai tomAdera dhanaizvarya o jIvana samvandhe parIkSA karA have| tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila tAdera Ara muzarikadera nikaTa hate tomarA aneka kaSTadAYaka kathA zunave| yadi tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM tAkoYA avalamvana kara tave nizcaYai tA have dRr3hasaMkalpera kAja|

smaraNa kara, yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila AllAh tAdera pratizruti niYechilena: ‘tomarA tA mAnuSera nikaTa spaSTabhAve prakAza karave evaM tA gopana karave nA|’ era parao tArA tA agrAhya kare o tuccha mUlye vikraYa kare; sutarAM tArA yA kraYa kare tA kata nikRSTa!

yArA nijerA yA kareche tAte Ananda prakAza kare Ara yA nijerA kare nAi emana kAjera janye prazaMsita hate bhAlavAse, tArA zAsti hate mukti pAve-eirUpa tumi kakhanao mane kara nA| tAdera janye marmantuda zAsti Ache|
AsamAna o yamInera sArvabhauma kSamatA ekamAtra AllAh ra i; AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
nizcaYai AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sRSTite, divasa o rAtrira parivartane nidarzanAvalI Ache vodhazaktisampanna lokera janye|

yArA da~A~r3iYe, vase o zuYe AllAhke smaraNa kare evaM AkAzamaNDala o pRthivIra sRSTi samvandhe cintakare o vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi eTA nirarthaka sRSTi kara nAi, tumi pavitra, tumi AmAderake dojakhera zAsti hate rakSA kara|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! kAukeo tumi dojakhe nikSepa karale tAke to tumi nizcaYai lAJchita karale Ara jAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei;

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA eka AhaŸAYakake ImAnera dike AhvAna karate zunechi, ‘tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera prati ImAna Ana|’ sutarAM AmarA ImAna enechi| ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAdera pApa kSamA kara, AmAdera manda kAjaguli dUrIbhUta kara evaM AmAderake satkarmaparAYaNadera sahagAmI kare mRtyu dio|

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tomAra rAsUlagaNera mAdhyame AmAderake yA dite pratizruti diYecha tA AmAderake dAo evaM kiYAmatera dina AmAderake heYa kara nA| nizcaYai tumi pratizrutira vyatikrama kara nA|’

erapara tAdera pratipAlaka tAdera DAke sAr3A diYe valena, ‘Ami tomAdera madhye karmaniSTha kona nara vA nArIra karma viphala kari nA; tomarA eke aparera aMza| sutarAM yArA hijarata kareche, nija gRha hate utkhAta haYeche, AmAra pathe niryAtita haYeche Ara yuddha kareche o nihata haYeche Ami tAdera pApa kAjaguli avazyai dUrIbhUta karava evaM avazyai tAderake dAkhila karava jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| eTA AllAh ra nikaTa hate puraskAra; uttama puraskAra AllAh ra i nikaTa|
yArA kupharI kareche, deze deze tAdera avAdha vicaraNa yena kichutei tomAke vibhrAnta nA kare|
eTA svalpakAlIna bhogamAtra; erapara jAhAnnAma tAdera AvAsa; Ara tA kata nikRSTa ThikAnA!

kintu yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare tAdera janye Ache jAnnAta, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| eTA AllAh ra pakSa hate Atithya; AllAh ra nikaTa yA Ache tA satkarmaparAYaNadera janye zreYa|

kitAvIdera madhye emana loka Ache yArA AllAh ra prati vinaYAvanata haYe tA~ra prati evaM tini yA tomAdera o tAdera prati avatIrNa karechena tAte avazyai ImAna Ane Ara AllAh ra AYAta tuccha mUlye vikraYa kare nA; erAi tArA yAdera janye AllAh ra nikaTa puraskAra Ache| nizcaYa AllAh druta hiseva grahaNakArI|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara, dhairye pratiyogitA kara Ara sarvadA yuddhera janye prastuta thAka, AllAhke bhaYa kara yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

he mAnavamaNDalI! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kara yini tomAderake eka vyakti hatei sRSTi karechena o yini tA hate tAra strI sRSTi karena, yini tAdera dujana hate vahu nara-nArI char3iYe dena; Ara AllAhke bhaYa kara yAra nAme tomarA eke aparera nikaTa yAcJA kara, Ara satarka thAka jJAtivandhana samparke| nizcaYai AllAh tomAdera opara tIkSNa dRSTi rAkhena|
iYAtImaderake tAdera dhana-sampada samarpaNa karave evaM bhAlara saGge manda vadala karave nA| tomAdera sampadera saGge tAdera sampada miziYe grAsa kara nA; nizcaYai eTA mahApApa|

tomarA yadi AzaMkA kara, iYAtIma meYedera prati suvicAra karate pArave nA, tave vivAha karave nArIdera madhye yAke tomAdera bhAla lAge, dui, tina vA cAra; Ara yadi AzaMkA kara ye, suvicAra karate pArave nA tave ekajanake vA tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsIke| ete pakSapAtitva nA karAra sambhAvanA adhikatara|
Ara tomarA nArIderake tAdera mAhra svataHpravRtta haYe pradAna karave; santuSTacitte tArA mAharera kiYadaMza cher3e dile tomarA tA svacchande bhoga karave|
tomAdera sampada, yA AllAh tomAdera janye upajIvikA karechena, tA nirveAdha mAlikagaNera hAte arpaNa kara nA; eTA hate tAdera grAsAcchAdanera vyavasthA karave evaM tAdera saGge sadAlApa karave|

iYAtImaderake yAcAi karave ye paryanta nA tArA vivAhayogya haYa; Ara tAdera madhye bhAla-manda vicArera jJAna dekhale tAdera sampada tAdera phiriYe dive| tArA var3a haYe yAve vale apacaYa kare tAr3AtAr3i kheYe phela nA| ye abhAvamukta se yena nivRtta thAke Ara ye vittahIna se yena saMgata parimANe bhoga kare| tomarA yakhana tAderake tAdera sampada samarpaNa karave takhana sAkSI rekha| hiseva grahaNe AllAhi yatheSTa|
pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera parityakta sampattite puruSera aMza Ache evaM pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera parityakta sampattite nArIrao aMza Ache, eTA alpai hoka vA vezii hoka, eka nirdhArita aMza|
sampatti vaNTanakAle AtmIYa, iYAtIma o abhAvagrasta loka upasthita thAkale tAderake tA hate kichu dive evaM tAdera saGge sadAlApa karave|
tArA yena bhaYa kare ye, asahAYa santAna pichane cher3e gele tArAo tAdera samvandhe udvigna hata| sutarAM tArA yena AllAhke bhaYa kare evaM saMgata kathA vale|
yArA iYAtImadera sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa kare tArA to tAdera udare agni bhakSaNa kare; tArA acirei dojakhera jvalanta Agune praveza karave|

AllAh tomAdera santAna samvandhe nirdeza dicchena: eka putrera aMza dui kanyAra aMzera samAna, kintu kevala kanyA dui-era adhika thAkale tAdera janye parityakta sampattira dui-tRtIYAMza, Ara mAtra eka kanyA thAkale tAra janye ardhAMza| tAra santAna thAkale tAra pitA-mAtA pratyekera janye parityakta sampattira eka-SaSThAMza; se niHsantAna hale evaM pitA-mAtAi uttarAdhikArI hale tAra mAtAra janye eka-tRtIYAMza; tAra bhAi-vona thAkale mAtAra janye eka-SaSThAMza; e savai se yA osiYAta kare tA deoYAra evaM RNa parizodhera para| tomAdera pitA o santAnadera madhye upakAre ke tomAdera nikaTatara tA tomarA avagata nao| nizcaYai eTA AllAh ra vidhAna; AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera strIdera parityakta sampattira ardhAMza tomAdera janye, yadi tAdera kona santAna nA thAke evaM tAdera santAna thAkale tomAdera janye tAdera parityakta sampattira eka-caturthAMza; tAdera osiYAta pAlana evaM RNa parizodhera para| tomAdera santAna nA thAkale tAdera janye tomAdera parityakta sampattira eka-caturthAMza, Ara tomAdera santAna thAkale tAdera janye tomAdera parityakta sampattira eka-aSTamAMza; tomarA yA osiYAta karave tA deoYAra para evaM RNa parizodhera para| yadi pitA-mAtA o santAnahIna kona puruSa vA nArIra uttarAdhikArI thAke tAra eka vaipitreYa bhAi vA bhagnI, tave pratyekera janye eka-SaSThAMza| tArA era adhika hale sakale samaaMzIdAra have eka-tRtIYAMze; eTA yA osiYAta karA haYa tA deoYAra evaM RNa parizodhera para, yadi kArao janye kSatikara nA haYa| eTA AllAh ra nirdeza, AllAh sarvajJa, sahanazIla|
eisava AllAh ra nirdhArita sImA| keu AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karale AllAh tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM eTA mahAsAphalya|
Ara keu AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera avAdhya hale evaM tA~ra nirdhArita sImAlaMghana karale tini tAke dojakhe nikSepa karavena; sekhAne se sthAYI have Ara tAra janye lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

tomAdera nArIdera madhye yArA vyabhicAra kare tAdera viruddhe tomAdera madhya hate cArajana sAkSI talava karave| yadi tArA sAkSya deYa tave tAderake gRhe avaruddha karave, ye paryanta nA tAdera mRtyu haYa vA AllAh tAdera janye anya kona vyavasthA karena|

tomAdera madhye ye dujana ete lipta have tAderake zAsti dive| yadi tArA taovA kare evaM nijederake saMzodhana kare neYa tave tA hate nivRtta thAkave| nizcaYai AllAh parama taovA kavulakArI o parama daYAlu|
AllAh avazyai seisava lokera taovA kavUla karavena yArA bhulavazata manda kAja kare evaM satvara taovA kare, erAi tArA, yAdera taovA AllAh kavUla karena| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

taovA tAdera janye naYa yArA AjIvana manda kAja kare, avazeSe tAdera kArao mRtyu upasthita hale se vale, ‘Ami ekhana taovA karachi’ Ara tAdera janyeo naYa, yAdera mRtyu haYa kAphira avasthAYa| erAi tArA yAdera janye marmantuda zAstira vyavasthA karechi|

he ImAnadAragaNa! nArIderake javaradasti uttarAdhikAra gaNya karA tomAdera janye vaidha naYa| tomarA tAderake yA diYecha tA hate kichu AtmasAt karAra uddezye tAderake avaruddha kare rekha nA, yadi nA tArA spaSTa vyabhicAra kare| tAdera saGge satbhAve jIvana yApana karave; tomarA yadi tAderake apachanda kara tave emana hate pAre ye, AllAh yAte prabhUta kalyANa rekhechena tomarA tAkei apachanda karacho|

tomarA yadi eka strIra sthale anya strI grahaNa karA sthira kara Ara tAdera ekajanake agAdha arthao diYe thAka, tavuo eTA hate kichui pratigrahaNa kara nA| tomarA ki mithyA apavAda o prakAzya pApAcaraNa diYe tA grahaNa karave?
Ara kirUpe tomarA tA grahaNa karave, yakhana tomarA eke aparera saGge saMgata haYecha Ara tArA tomAdera nikaTa hate dRr3ha pratizruti niYeche?
nArIdera madhye tomAdera pitRpuruSa yAdera vivAha kareche, tomarA tAdera vivAha kara nA; pUrve yA haYeche nizcaYai tA azlIla, atizaYa ghRNya o nikRSTa AcaraNa|

tomAdera janye hArAma karA haYeche tomAdera mAtA, kanyA, bhagnI, phuphu, khAlA, bhrAtuSputrI, bhAgineYI, dugdha-mAtA, dugdha-bhaginI, zAzur3i o tomAdera strIdera madhye yAra saGge saMgata haYecha tAra pUrva svAmIra aurase tAra garbhajAta kanyA, yArA tomAdera abhibhAvakatve Ache, tave yadi tAdera saGge saMgata nA haYe thAka, tAte tomAdera kona aparAdha nei| evaM tomAdera janye niSiddha tomAdera aurasajAta putrera strI o dui bhagnIke ekatra karA, pUrve yA haYeche| nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara nArIra madhye tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsI vyatIta sakala sadhavA tomAdera janye niSiddha, tomAdera janye eTA AllAh ra vidhAna| ullikhita nArIgaNa vyatIta anya nArIke arthavyaYe vivAha vandhane Avaddha karate cAoYA tomAdera janye vaidha karA hala, avaidha yauna samparkera janye naYa| tAdera madhye yAderake tomarA sambhoga karecha tAdera nirdhArita mAhra arpaNa karave| mAhra nirdhAraNera para kona viSaYe paraspara rAjI hale tAte tomAdera kona doSa nei| nizcaYai AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera madhye kArao svAdhInA ImAnadAra nArI vivAhera sAmarthya nA thAkale tomarA tomAdera adhikArabhukta ImAnadAra dAsI vivAha karave; AllAh tomAdera ImAna samvandhe parijJAta| tomarA eke aparera samAna; sutarAM tAderake vivAha karave tAdera mAlikera anumatikrame Ara tAderake tAdera mAhra nyAYasaMgatabhAve dive| tArA have saccaritrA, vyabhicAriNI naYa o upapati grahaNakAriNIo naYa| vivAhitA haoYAra para yadi tArA vyabhicAra kare tave tAdera zAsti svAdhInA nArIra ardheka; tomAdera madhye yArA vyabhicArake bhaYa kare eTA tAdera janye; dhairya dhAraNa karA tomAdera janye kalyANakara| AllAh kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
AllAh icchA karena tomAdera nikaTa vizadabhAve vivRta karate, tomAdera pUrvavartIdera rItinIti tomAderake avahita karate Ara tomAdera kSamA karate| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
AllAh tomAdera kSamA karate cAna, Ara yArA kupravRttira anusaraNa kare tArA cAYa ye, tomarA bhISaNabhAve pathacyuta hao|
AllAh tomAdera bhAra laghu karate icchA karena; mAnuSa sRSTi karA haYeche durvalarUpe|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA eke aparera sampatti anyAYabhAve grAsa kara nA; kintu tomAdera paraspare rAjI haYe vyavasAYa karA vaidha; Ara eke aparake hatyA kara nA; nizcaYai AllAh tomAdera prati parama daYAlu|
Ara ye keu sImAlaMghana kare anyAYabhAve tA karave tAke agnite dagdha karava; eTA AllAh ra pakSe sahaja|
tomAderake yA niSedha karA haYeche tAra madhye yA gurutara tA hate virata thAkale tomAdera laghutara pApaguli mocana karava Ara tomAderake sammAnajanaka sthAne dAkhila karava|

yAra mAdhyame AllAh tomAdera kAukeo kArao opara zreSThatva dAna karechena tomarA tAra lAlasA kara nA| puruSa yA arjana kare tA tAra prApya aMza Ara nArI yA arjana kare tA tAra prApya aMza| AllAh ra nikaTa tA~hAra anugraha prArthanA kara, nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera parityakta sampattira pratyekaTira janye Ami uttarAdhikArI sthira karechi evaM yAdera saGge tomarA aGgIkArAvaddha tAderake tAdera aMza dive| nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYera draSTA|

puruSa nArIra kartA, kAraNa AllAh tAdera eka-ke aparera opara zreSThatva dAna karechena evaM eijanye ye, puruSa tAdera dhana-sampada vyaYa kare| sutarAM sAdhvI strIrA anugatA o lokacokhara antarAle AllAh yA saMrakSita karechena, tA hiphAyata kare| strIdera madhye yAdera avAdhyatAra AzaMkA kara tAdera sadupadeza dAo, tArapara tAdera zayyA varjana kara o tAderake prahAra kara| yadi tArA tomAdera anugata haYa tave tAdera viruddhe kona patha ane¦SaNa kara nA| nizcaYai AllAh mahAna, zreSTha|

tAdera ubhaYera madhye virodha AzaMkA karale tomarA tAra parivAra hate ekajana o tAra parivAra hate ekajana sAlisa niyukta karave; tArA ubhaYe niSpatti cAile AllAh tAdera madhye mImAMsAra anuka‚la avasthA sRSTi karavena| nizcaYai AllAh sarvajJa, savizeSa avahita|

tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata karave o kona kichuke tA~ra zarIka karave nA; evaM pitA-mAtA, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, abhAvagrasta, nikaTa-prativezI, dUra-prativezI, saGgI-sAthI, musAphira o tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIdera prati sadvyavahAra karave| nizcaYai AllAh pachanda karena nA dAmbhika, ahaMkArIke|
yArA kRpaNatA kare evaM mAnuSake kRpaNatAra nirdeza deYa evaM AllAh nija anugrahe tAderake yA diYechena tA gopana kare, Ara Ami AkhirAte kAphiradera janye lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
evaM yArA mAnuSake dekhAnora janye tAdera dhana-sampada vyaYa kare evaM AllAh o AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA AllAh tAderake bhAlavAsena nA| Ara zaYatAna kArao saGgI hale se saGgI kata manda!
tArA AllAh o AkhirAte vizvAsa karale evaM AllAh tAderake yA pradAna karechena tA hate vyaYa karale tAdera kI kSati hata? AllAh tAderake bhAlabhAve jAnena|
AllAh aNu parimANao juluma karena nA| Ara kona puNyakarma hale AllAh tAke dviguNa karena evaM AllAh tA~ra nikaTa hate mahApuraskAra pradAna karena|
yakhana Ami pratyeka ummata hate ekajana sAkSI upasthita karava Ara tomAke tAdera viruddhe sAkSIrUpe upasthita karava takhana kI avasthA have?
yArA kupharI kareche Ara rAsUlera avAdhya haYeche tArA sedina kAmanA karave, yadi tArA mATira saGge mize yeta! Ara tArA AllAh hate kona kathAi gopana karate pArave nA|

he mu’minagaNa! nezAgrasta avasthAYa tomarA sAlAtera nikaTavartI haYo nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA yA vala tA vujhate pAra, Ara yadi tomarA musAphira nA hao tave apavitra avasthAteo naYa, yatakSaNa paryanta nA tomarA gosala kara| Ara yadi tomarA pIr3ita hao vA saphare thAka vA tomAdera keu zaucasthAna hate Ase vA tomarA nArI-sambhoga kara evaM pAni nA pAo tave pavitra mATira diYe tAYAmmuma karave Ara mAseh karave mukhamaNDala o hAta, nizcaYai AllAh pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|
tumi ki tAderake dekha nAi yAderake kitAvera eka aMza deoYA haYechila? tArA bhrAnta patha kraYa kare evaM tomarAo pathabhraSTa hao-eTAi tArA cAYa|
AllAh tomAdera zatruderake bhAlabhAve jAnena| abhibhAvakatve AllAhi yatheSTa Ara sAhAyye AllAhi yatheSTa|

iYAhUdIdera madhye kichu saMkhyaka loka kathAguli sthAnacyuta kare vikRta kare Ara vale, ‘zunalAma karalAma o amAnya karalAma’ evaM zona, nA zonAra mata; Ara nijedera jihvA kuJcita kare evaM dInera prati tAcchilya kare vale, ‘rAinA’| kintu tArA yadi valata, ‘zunalAma o mAnya karalAma evaM zono o AmAdera prati lakSya kara’, tave tA tAdera janye bhAla o saMgata hata| kintu tAdera kupharIra janye AllAh tAderake lA‘nata karechena| tAdera alpasaMkhyakai vizvAsa kare|

ohe! yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche, tomAdera nikaTa yA Ache tAra pratyAYanakArIrUpe Ami yA avatIrNa karechi tAte tomarA ImAna Ana, Ami mukhamaNDalasamUha vikRta kare erapara seigulike pichanera dike phiriYe deoYAra pUrve vA AshAvusa sAvtake yerUpa lA‘nata karechilAma seirUpa tAderake lA‘nata karAra pUrve| AllAh ra Adeza kAryakarI haYei thAke|
nizcaYai AllAh tA~ra saGge zarIka karA kSamA karena nA| eTA vyatIta anyAnya aparAdha yAke icchA kSamA karena; Ara ye keu AllAh ra zarIka kare se eka mahApApa kare|
tumi ki tAderake dekha nAi, yArA nijederake pavitra mane kare? varaM AllAh yAke icchA pavitra karena| evaM tAdera opara sAmAnya parimANao juluma karA have nA|
dekha! tArA AllAh samvandhe kirUpa mithyA udbhAvana kare; evaM prakAzya pApa hiseve eTAi yatheSTa|
tumi ki tAderake dekha nAi yAderake kitAvera eka aMza deoYA haYechila, tArA jivta o tAgUte vizvAsa kare? tArA kAphiradera samvandhe vale, ‘ederai patha mu’minadera apekSA prakRSTatara|’
erAi tArA, yAderake AllAh lA‘nata karechila Ara AllAh yAke lA‘nata karena tumi kakhanao tAra kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
tave ki rAjazaktite tAdera kona aMza Ache? se kSetreo to tArA kAukeo eka kapardaka o dive nA|
vA AllAh nija anugrahe mAnuSake yA diYechena sejanye ki tArA tAderake IrSA kare? Ami ivrAhImera vaMzadharakeo to kitAva o hikamata pradAna karechilAma evaM tAderake vizAla rAjya dAna karechilAma|
erapara tAdera kataka ete vizvAsa karechila Ara kataka tA hate mukha phiriYe niYechila; dagdha karAra janye jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa|

yArA AmAra AYAtake pratyAkhyAna kare tAderake agnite dagdha karavai; yakhanai tAdera carma dagdha have takhanai tAra sthale nUtana carma sRSTi karava, yAte tArA zAsti bhoga kare| nizcaYai AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

yArA ImAna Ane o bhAla kAja kare tAderake dAkhila karava jAnnAte yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have, sekhAne tAdera janye pavitra strI thAkave evaM tAderake cirasnigdha chAYAYa dAkhila karava|

nizcaYai AllAh tomAderake nirdeza dicchena AmAnata tAra hakadArake soparda karate| tomarA yakhana mAnuSera madhye vicArakArya paricAlanA karave takhana nyAYaparAYaNatAra saGge vicAra karave| AllAh tomAderake ye upadeza dena tA kata utkRSTa! nizcaYai AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

he mu’minagaNa! yadi tomarA AllAh o AkhirAte vizvAsa kara tave tomarA Anugatya kara AllAh ra, Anugatya kara rAsUlera evaM tAdera, yArA tomAdera madhye kSamatAra adhikArI; kona viSaYe tomAdera madhye matabheda ghaTile tA upasthApana kara AllAh o rAsUlera nikaTa| eTAi uttama evaM pariNAme prakRSTatara|

tumi ki tAderake dekha nAi yArA dAvi kare ye, tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche Ara tomAra pUrve yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte tArA vizvAsa kare, athaca tArA tAgUtera kAche vicAraprArthI hate cAYa, yadio tA pratyAkhyAna karAra janye tAderake nirdeza deoYA haYeche evaM zaYatAna tAderake bhISaNabhAve pathabhraSTa karate cAYa?
tAderake yakhana valA haYa, AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena tAra dike evaM rAsUlera dike Asa, takhana munAphikaderake tumi tomAra nikaTa hate mukha ekevAre phiriYe nite dekhave|

tAdera kRtakarmera janye yakhana tAdera kona musIvata have takhana tAdera kI avasthA have? erapara tArA AllAh ra nAme zapatha kare tomAra nikaTa ese valave, ‘AmarA kalyANa o samprIti vyatIta anya kichui cAi nAi|’
erAi tArA, yAdera antare kI Ache AllAh tA jAnena| sutarAM tumi tAderake upekSA kara, tAderake sadupadeza dAo evaM tAderake tAdera marma sparza kare emana kathA vala|

rAsUla ei uddezyei preraNa karechi ye, AllAh ra nirdeza anusAre tAra Anugatya karA have| yakhana tArA nijedera prati juluma kare takhana tArA tomAra nikaTa Asale o AllAh ra kSamA prArthanA karale evaM rAsUlao tAdera janye kSamA cAile tArA avazyai AllAhke parama kSamAzIla o parama daYAlurUpe pAve|

kintu nA, tomAra pratipAlakera zapatha! tArA mu’mina have nA yatakSaNa paryanta tArA tAdera nijedera vivAda-visamvAdera vicArabhAra tomAra opara arpaNa nA kare; erapara tomAra siddhAnta samvandhe tAdera mane kona dvidhA nA thAke evaM sarvAntakaraNe tA mene neYa|

yadi tAderake Adeza ditAma, tomarA nijederake hatyA kara vA Apana gRha tyAga kara tave tAdera alpasaMkhyakai tA karata| yA karate tAderake upadeza deoYA haYechila tArA tA karale tAdera bhAla hata Ara cittasthiratAYa tArA dRr3hatara hata|
evaM takhana Ami AmAra nikaTa hate tAderake nizcaYai mahApuraskAra pradAna karatAma;
evaM tAderake nizcaYai sarala pathe paricAlita karatAma|
Ara keu AllAh evaM rAsUlera Anugatya karale se navI, satyaniSTha, zahIda o satkarmaparAYaNa-yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechena-tAdera saGgI have evaM tArA kata uttama saGgI!
eTA AllAh ra anugraha| sarvajJa hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
he mu’minagaNa! satarkatA avalamvana kara; erapara haYa dale dale vibhakta haYe agrasara hao vA ekasaGge agrasara hao|
tomAdera madhye emana loka Ache, ye gar3imasi karavei| tomAdera kona musIvata hale se valave, ‘tAdera saGge nA thAkAYa AllAh AmAra prati anugraha karechena|’
Ara tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha hale, yena tomAdera o tAra madhye kona samparka nei emanabhAve valavei, ‘hAYa! yadi tAdera saGge thAkatAma tave Amio virATa sAphalya lAbha karatAma|’
sutarAM yArA AkhirAtera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvana vikraYa kare tArA AllAh ra pathe yuddha karuka Ara keu AllAh ra pathe yuddha karale se nihata hoka vA vijaYI hoka Ami tAke mahApuraskAra dAna karavai|

tomAdera kI hala ye, tomarA yuddha karave nA AllAh ra pathe Ara asahAYa naranArI o zizugaNera janye, yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ei janapada-yAra adhivAsI jAlima, tA hate AmAderake anyatra niYe yAo; tomAra nikaTa hate kAukeo AmAdera abhibhAvaka kara evaM tomAra nikaTa hate kAukeo AmAdera sahAYa kara|’
yArA mu’mina tArA AllAh ra pathe yuddha kare Ara yArA kAphira tArA tAgUtera pathe yuddha kare| sutarAM tomarA zaYatAnera vandhudera viruddhe yuddha kara; zaYatAnera kauzala avazyai durvala|

tumi ki tAderake dekha nAi yAderake valA haYechila, ‘tomarA tomAdera hAta saMvaraNa kara, sAlAta kAYema kara evaM yAkAta dAo?’ erapara yakhana tAderake yuddhera vidhAna deoYA hala takhana tAdera ekadala mAnuSake bhaYa karachila AllAhke bhaYa karAra mata vA tadapekSA adhika, evaM valite lAgala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera janye yuddhera vidhAna kena dile? AmAderake kichu dinera avakAza dAo nA!’ vala, ‘pArthiva bhoga sAmAnya Ara ye muttAkI tAra janye parakAlai uttama| tomAdera prati sAmAnya parimANao juluma karA have nA|’

tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena mRtyu tomAdera nAgAla pAvei, emanaki suucca sudRr3ha durge avasthAna karaleo| yadi tAdera kona kalyANa haYa tave tArA vale ‘eTA AllAh ra nikaTa hate|’ Ara yadi tAdera kona akalyANa haYa tave tArA vale, ‘eTA tomAra nikaTa hate|’ vala, ‘savakichui AllAh ra nikaTa hate|’ ei sampradAYera hala kI ye, erA ekevArei kona kathA vojhe nA!
kalyANa yA tomAra haYa tA AllAh ra nikaTa hate Ara akalyANa yA tomAra haYa tA tomAra nijera kAraNe evaM tomAke mAnuSera janye rAsUlarUpe preraNa karechi; sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
keu rAsUlera Anugatya karale se to AllAh ra i Anugatya karala Ara keu mukha phiriYe nile tomAke tAdera opara tattvAvadhAYaka preraNa kari nAi|

tArA vale, ‘Anugatya kari’, erapara yakhana tArA tomAra nikaTa hate cale yAYa takhana rAtre tAdera ekadala yA vale tAra viparIta parAmarza kare| tArA yA rAtre parAmarza kare AllAh tA lipivaddha kare rAkhena| sutarAM tumi tAderake upekSA kara Ara AllAh ra prati bharasA kara; karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
tave ki tArA kuraAna samvandhe anudhAvana kare nA? eTA yadi AllAh vyatIta anya kArao nikaTa hate Asata tave tArA tAte aneka asaMgati peta|

yakhana zAnti vA zaMkAra kona saMvAda tAdera nikaTa Ase takhana tArA tA pracAra kare thAke| yadi tArA tA rAsUla kiMvA tAdera madhye yArA kSamatAra adhikArI tAdera gocare Anata, tave tAdera madhye yArA tathya anusandhAna kare tArA tAra yathArthatA nirNaYa karate pArata| tomAdera prati yadi AllAh ra anugraha o daYA nA thAkata tave tomAdera alpasaMkhyaka vyatIta sakale zaYatAnera anusaraNa karata|

sutarAM AllAh ra pathe yuddha kara; tomAke zudhu tomAra nijera janye dAYI karA have evaM mu’minagaNake udvuddha kara, haYato AllAh kAphiradera zakti saMyata karavena| AllAh zaktite pravalatara o zAstidAne kaThoratara|
keu kona bhAla kAjera supAriza karale tAte tAra aMza thAkave Ara keu kona manda kAjera supAriza karale tAte tAra aMza thAkave| AllAh sarvaviSaYe najara rAkhena|
tomAderake yakhana abhivAdana karA haYa takhana tomarAo tA apekSA uttama pratyAbhivAdana karave vA tArai anurUpa karave; nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe hiseva grahaNakArI|
AllAh, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei; tini tomAderake kiYAmatera dina ekatra karavenai, ete kona sandeha nei| ke AllAh apekSA adhika satyavAdI?

tomAdera kI hala ye, tomarA munAphikadera samvandhe dui dala haYe gele, yakhana AllAh tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera janye pUrvAvasthAYa phiriYe diYechena! AllAh yAke pathabhraSTa karena tomarA ki tAke satpathe paricAlita karate cAo? evaM AllAh kAukeo pathabhraSTa karale tumi tAra janye kakhanao kona patha pAve nA|

tArA eTAi kAmanA kare ye, tArA yerUpa kupharI kareche tomarAo seirUpa kupharI kara, yAte tomarA tAdera samAna haYe yAo| sutarAM AllAh ra pathe hijarata nA karA paryanta tAdera madhya hate kAukeo vandhurUpe grahaNa karave nA| yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave tAderake yekhAne pAve grephatAra karave Ara hatyA karave evaM tAdera madhya hate kAukeo vandhu o sahAYarUpe grahaNa karave nA|

kintu tAderake naYa yArA emana eka sampradAYera saGge milita haYa yAdera saGge tomarA aGgIkArAvaddha, vA yArA tomAdera nikaTa emana avasthAYa Agamana kare yakhana tAdera mana tomAdera saGge vA tAdera sampradAYera saGge yuddha karate saMkucita haYa| AllAh yadi icchA karatena tave tAderake tomAdera opara kSamatA ditena Ara tArA nizcaYa tomAdera saGge yuddha karata| sutarAM tArA yadi tomAdera nikaTa hate sare dA~r3AYa, tomAdera saGge yuddha nA kare evaM tomAdera nikaTa zAnti prastAva kare tave AllAh tomAdera janye tAdera viruddhe kona vyavasthA avalamvanera patha rAkhena nA|

tomarA apara kichu loka pAve yArA tomAdera saGge o tAdera sampradAYera saGge zAnti cAive| yakhanai tAderake phitnAra dike AhvAna karA haYa takhanai e vyApAre tArA tAdera pUrvAvasthAYa pratyAvRtta haYa| yadi tArA tomAdera nikaTa hate cale nA yAYa, tomAdera nikaTa zAnti prastAva nA kare Ara tAdera hAta saMvaraNa nA kare tave tAderake yekhAnei pAve grephatAra karave o hatyA karave evaM tomAderake edera viruddhAcaraNera spaSTa adhikAra diYechi|

kona mu’minake hatyA karA kona mu’minera kAja naYa, tave bhulavazata karale tA svatantra; evaM keu kona mu’minake bhulavazata hatyA karale eka mu’mina dAsa mukta karA evaM tAra parijanavargake raktapaNa arpaNa karA vidheYa, yadi nA tArA kSamA kare| yadi se tomAdera zatrupakSera loka haYa evaM mu’mina haYa tave eka mu’mina dAsa mukta karA vidheYa| Ara yadi se emana eka sampradAYabhukta haYa yAra saGge tomarA aGgIkArAvaddha tave tAra parijanavargake raktapaNa arpaNa evaM mu’mina dAsa mukta karA vidheYa, evaM ye saMgatihIna se ekAdikrame dui mAsa siYAma pAlana karave| taovAra janye eTA AllAh ra vyavasthA evaM AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
keu icchAkRtabhAve kona mu’minake hatyA karale tAra zAsti jAhAnnAma; sekhAne se sthAYI have evaM AllAh tAra prati ruSTa havena, tAke lA‘nata karavena evaM tAra janye mahAzAsti prastuta rAkhavena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana AllAh ra pathe yAtrA karave takhana parIkSA kare nive evaM keu tomAderake sAlAma karale ihajIvanera sampadera AkAksakSAYa tAke vala nA-‘tumi mu’mina nao’, kAraNa AllAh ra nikaTa anAYAsalabhya sampada pracura raYeche| tomarA to pUrve eirUpai chile, erapara AllAh tomAdera prati anugraha karechena; sutarAM tomarA parIkSA kare nive| tomarA yA kara AllAh to se viSaYe savizeSa avahita|

mu’minadera madhye yArA akSama naYa athaca ghare vase thAke o yArA AllAh ra pathe svIYa dhana-prANa diYe jihAda kare tArA samAna naYa| yArA svIYa dhana-prANa diYe jihAda kare AllAh tAderake, yArA ghare vase thAke tAdera opara maryAdA diYechena; AllAh sakalakei kalyANera pratizruti diYechena| yArA ghare vase thAke tAdera opara yArA jihAda kare tAderake AllAh mahApuraskArera kSetre zreSThatva diYechena|
eTA tA~ra nikaTa hate maryAdA, kSamA o daYA; AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yArA nijedera opara juluma kare tAdera prANa grahaNera samaYa pherezatAgaNa vale, ‘tomarA kI avasthAYa chile?’ tArA vale, ‘duniYAYa AmarA asahAYa chilAma|’ tArA vale, ‘AllAh ra yamIna ki emana prazasta chila nA yekhAne tomarA hijarata karate?’ ederai AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma, Ara tA kata manda AvAsa!
tave yesava asahAYa puruSa, nArI o zizu kona upAYa avalamvana karate pAre nA evaM kona pathao pAYa nA,
AllAh acirei tAdera pApa mocana karavena, kAraNa AllAh pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|

keu AllAh ra pathe hijarata karale se duniYAYa vahu AzraYasthala evaM prAcurya lAbha karave Ara keu AllAh o rAsUlera uddezye nija gRha hate muhAjira haYe vera hale Ara tAra mRtyu ghaTile tAra puraskArera bhAra AllAh ra opara; AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana deza-videze saphara karave takhana yadi tomAdera AzaMkA haYa, kAphirarA tomAdera janye phitanA sRSTi karave, tave sAlAta saMkSipta karale tomAdera kona doSa nei| nizcaYai kAphirarA tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

Ara tumi yakhana tAdera madhye avasthAna karave o tAdera saGge sAlAta kAYema karave takhana tAdera ekadala tomAra saGge yena dA~r3AYa evaM tArA yena sazastra thAke| tAdera sijdA karA hale tArA yena tomAdera pichane avasthAna kare; Ara apara ekadala yArA sAlAte zarIka haYa nAi tArA tomAra saGge yena sAlAte zarIka haYa evaM tArA yena satarka o sazastra thAke| kAphirarA kAmanA kare yena tomarA tomAdera astrazastra o AsavAvapatra samvandhe asatarka hao yAte tArA tomAdera opara ekevAre jhA~piYe par3ate pAre| yadi tomarA vRSTira janye kaSTa pAo vA pIr3ita thAka tave tomarA astra rekhe dile tomAdera kona doSa nei; kintu tomarA satarkatA avalamvana karave| nizcaYai AllAh kAphiradera janye lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta rekhechena|

yakhana tomarA sAlAta samApta karave takhana dA~r3iYe, vase evaM zuYe AllAhke smaraNa karave, yakhana tomarA nirApada have takhana yathAyatha sAlAta kAYema karave; nirdhArita samaYe sAlAta kAYema karA mu’minadera janye avazyakartavya|

zatru sampradAYera sandhAne tomarA hatodyama haYo nA| yadi tomarA yantraNA pAo tave tArAo to tomAdera matai yantraNA pAYa evaM AllAh ra nikaTa tomarA yA AzA kara tArA tA AzA kare nA| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
Ami to tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechi yAte tumi AllAh tomAke yA jAniYechena sei anusAre mAnuSera madhye vicAra mImAMsA kara Ara tumi vizvAsabhaGgakArIdera samarthane tarka kara nA|
Ara AllAh ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara; nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA nijederake pratArita kare tAdera pakSe vAda-visamvAda kara nA, nizcaYai AllAh vizvAsabhaGgakArI pApIke pachanda karena nA|

tArA mAnuSa hate gopana karate cAYa kintu AllAh hate gopana kare nA; athaca tini tAdera saGgei Achena rAtre yakhana tArA, tini yA pachanda karena nA-emana viSaYe parAmarza kare o tArA yA kare tA sarvatobhAve AllAh ra jJAnAYatta|
dekha, tomarAi ihajIvane tAdera pakSe vitarka karacho; kintu kiYAmatera dina AllAh ra sAmane ke tAdera pakSe vitarka karave vA ke tAdera ukIla have?
keu kona manda kAja kare vA nijera prati juluma kare pare AllAh ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karale AllAhke se kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu pAve|
keu pApa kAja karale se tA nijera kSatira janyei kare| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
keu kona doSa vA pApa kare pare tA kona nirdeASa vyaktira prati Aropa karale se to mithyA apavAda o spaSTa pApera vojhA vahana kare|

tomAra prati AllAh ra anugraha o daYA nA thAkale tAdera ekadala tomAke pathabhraSTa karate cAitai| kintu tArA nijederake vyatIta Ara kAukeo pathabhraSTa kare nA evaM tomAra konai kSati karate pAre nA| AllAh tomAra prati kitAva o hikamata avatIrNa karechena evaM tumi yA jAnate nA tA tomAke zikSA diYechena; tomAra prati AllAh ra mahA anugraha raYeche|

tAdera adhikAMza gopana parAmarze kona kalyANa nei, tave kalyANa Ache ye nirdeza deYa dAna-khaYarAta, satkarma o mAnuSera madhye zAnti sthApanera; AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhera AkAksakSAYa keu tA karale tAke avazyai Ami mahApuraskAra diva|

kArao nikaTa satpatha prakAza haoYAra para se yadi rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare evaM mu’minadera patha vyatIta anya patha anusaraNa kare, tave yedike se phire yAYa sedikei tAke phiriYe diva evaM jAhAnnAme tAke dagdha karava, Ara tA kata manda AvAsa!
nizcaYai AllAh tA~ra saGge zarIka karAke kSamA karena nA; eTA vyatIta sava kichu yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM keu AllAh ra zarIka karale se bhISaNabhAve pathabhraSTa haYa|
tA~ra parivarte tArA devIrai pUjA kare evaM vidrohI zaYatAnerai pUjA kare-
AllAh tAke lA‘nata karena evaM se vale, ‘Ami avazyai tomAra vAndAdera eka nirdiSTa aMzake AmAra anusArI kare niva|

Ami tAderake pathabhraSTa karavai; tAdera hRdaYe mithyA vAsanAra sRSTi karavai, Ami tAderake nizcaYai nirdeza diva Ara tArA pazura karNaccheda karavei, Ara tAderake nizcaYai nirdeza diva Ara tArA AllAh ra sRSTi vikRta karavei| AllAh ra parivarte keu zaYatAnake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karale se spaSTatai kSatigrasta haYa|
se tAderake pratizruti deYa Ara tAdera hRdaYe mithyA vAsanAra sRSTi kare; Ara zaYatAna tAderake ye pratizruti deYa tA chalanAmAtra|
ederai AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma, tA hate tArA niSkRtira upAYa pAve nA|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare tAderake dAkhila karava jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have; AllAh ra pratizruti satya, ke AllAh apekSA kathAYa adhika satyavAdI?
tomAdera kheYAla-khuzi o kitAvIdera kheYAla-khuzi anusAre kAja have nA; keu manda kAja karale tAra pratiphala se pAve Ara AllAh vyatIta tAra janye se kona abhibhAvaka o sahAYa pAve nA|
puruSa vA nArIra madhye keu satkAja karale o mu’mina hale tArA jAnnAte dAkhila have evaM tAdera prati aNu parimANao juluma karA have nA|
tAra apekSA dIne ke uttama, ye satkarmaparAYaNa haYe AllAh ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa kare evaM ekaniSThabhAve ivrAhImera dharmAdarza anusaraNa kare? evaM AllAh ivrAhImake vandhurUpe grahaNa karechena|
AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu Ache sava AllAh ra i evaM savakichuke AllAh pariveSTana kare Achena|

Ara loke tomAra nikaTa nArIdera viSaYe vyavasthA jAnate cAYa| vala, ‘AllAh tomAderake tAdera samvandhe vyavasthA jAnAcchena Ara iYAtIma nArI samparke yAdera prApya tomarA pradAna kara nA, athaca tomarA tAderake vivAha karate cAo evaM asahAYa zizudera samvandhe o iYAtImadera prati tomAdera nyAYavicAra samparke yA kitAve tomAderake zonAna haYa, tAo pariSkArabhAve jAniYe dena|’ Ara ye kona satkAja tomarA kara AllAh to tA savizeSa avahita|

kona strI yadi tAra svAmIra durvyavahAra kiMvA upekSAra AzaMkA kare tave tArA Aposa-niSpatti karate cAile tAdera kona gunAha nei evaM Aposa-niSpattii zreYa| mAnuSa lobhahetu svabhAvata kRpaNa; Ara yadi tomarA satkarmaparAYaNa hao o muttAkI hao, tave tomarA yA kara nizcaYai AllAh tAra khavara rAkhena|

Ara tomarA yatai icchA kara nA kena tomAdera strIdera prati samAna vyavahAra karate kakhanai pArave nA; yadio tomarA era AzA kara| tave tomarA kona ekajanera dike sampUrNabhAve jhu~kiYA par3io nA o aparake jhulAno avasthAYa rekha nA| yadi tomarA nijederake saMzodhana kara o sAvadhAna hao tave nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yadi tArA paraspara pRthaka haYe yAYa, tave AllAh tA~ra prAcurya diYe tAdera pratyekake abhAvamukta karavena| AllAh prAcuryamaYa, prajJAmaYa|

AsamAne yA Ache o yamIne yA Ache sava AllAh ra i; tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tAderake o tomAderakeo nirdeza diYechi ye, tomarA AllAhke bhaYa karave evaM tomarA kupharI karaleo AsamAne yA Ache o yamIne yA Ache tA AllAh ra i Ara AllAh abhAvamukta, prazaMsAbhAjana|
AsamAne yA Ache o yamIne yA Ache sava AllAh ra i Ara karmavidhAne AllAhi yatheSTa|
he mAnuSa! tini icchA karale tomAderake apasArita karate o aparake Anate pArena; AllAh eTA karate sampUrNa sakSama|
keu duniYAra puraskAra cAile tave AllAh ra nikaTa duniYA o AkhirAte puraskAra raYeche| AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA nyAYavicAre dRr3hapratiSThita thAkave AllAh ra sAkSIsvarUpa; yadio eTA tomAdera nijedera vA pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera viruddhe haYa; se vittavAna hoka vA vittahIna hoka AllAh ubhaYerai ghaniSThatara| sutarAM tomarA nyAYavicAra karate pravRttira anugAmI haYo nA| yadi tomarA pe~cAlo kathA vala vA pAza kATAiYA yAo tave tomarA yA kara AllAh to tAra samyaka khavara rAkhena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhe, tA~ra rAsUle, tini ye kitAva tA~ra rAsUlera prati avatIrNa karechena tAte evaM ye kitAva tini pUrve avatIrNa karechena tAte ImAna Ana| Ara keu AllAh, tA~ra pherezatAgaNa, tA~ra kitAvasamUha, tA~ra rAsUlagaNa o AkhirAtake pratyAkhyAna karale se to bhISaNabhAve pathabhraSTa haYe par3ave|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane o pare kupharI kare evaM AvAra ImAna Ane, AvAra kupharI kare; erapara tAdera kupharI pravRtti vRddhi pAYa, AllAh tAderake kichutei kSamA karavena nA evaM tAderake kona pathao dekhAvena nA|
munAphikaderake zubha saMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janye marmantuda zAsti raYeche|
mu’minagaNera parivarte yArA kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare tArA ki odera nikaTa ijjata cAYa? samasta ijjata to AllAh ra i|

kitAve tomAdera prati tini to avatIrNa karechena ye, yakhana tomarA zunave, AllAh ra AYAta pratyAkhyAta hacche Ara eke vidrupa karA hacche, takhana ye paryanta tArA anya prasaGge lipta nA have tomarA tAdera saGge vasa nA; anyathAYa tomarAo edera mata have| munAphika o kAphira sakalakei AllAh to jAhAnnAme ekatra karavena|

yArA tomAdera amaGgalera pratIkSAYa thAke tArA AllAh ra pakSa hate tomAdera jaYa hale vale, ‘AmarA ki tomAdera saGge chilAma nA?’ Ara yadi kAphiradera kichu vijaYa haYa, tave tArA vale, ‘AmarA ki tomAdera pariveSTana kare rekhechilAma nA Ara AmarA ki tomAderake mu’minadera hAta hate rakSA kari nAi?’ AllAh kiYAmatera dina tomAdera madhye vicAra mImAMsA karavena Ara AllAh kakhanai mu’minadera viruddhe kAphiradera janye kona patha rAkhavena nA|

nizcaYai munAphikarA AllAh ra saGge dheA~kAvAji kare; vastuta tini tAderake era zAsti dena, Ara yakhana tArA sAlAte dA~r3AYa takhana zaithilyera saGge dA~r3AYa-kevala loka dekhAnora janye evaM AllAhke tArA alpai smaraNa kare;
doTAnAYa dodulyamAna-nA edera dike, nA odera dike! evaM AllAh yAke pathabhraSTa karena tumi tAra janye kakhanao kona patha pAve nA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA mu’minagaNera parivarte kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kara nA| tomarA ki AllAhke tomAdera viruddhe spaSTa pramANa dite cAo?
munAphikarA to jAhAnnAmera nimnatama stare thAkave Ara tAdera janye tumi kakhanao kona sahAYa pAve nA|

kintu yArA taovA kare, nijederake saMzodhana kare, AllAhke dRr3habhAve avalamvana kare Ara AllAh ra uddezye tAdera dIne ekaniSTha thAke, tArA mu’minadera saGge thAkave evaM mu’minagaNake AllAh avazyai mahApuraskAra divena|
tomarA yadi kRtajJatA prakAza kara o ImAna Ana tave tomAdera zAstite AllAh ra ki kAja? AllAh puraskAradAtA, sarvajJa|
manda kathAra pracAraNA AllAh pachanda karena nA; tave yAra opara juluma karA haYeche se vyatIta| Ara AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tomarA satkarma prakAzye karale vA tA gopane karale kiMvA doSa kSamA karale tave AllAho doSa mocanakArI, zaktimAna|

yArA AllAhke asvIkAra kare o tA~ra rAsUladerakeo evaM AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera madhye ImAnera vyApAre tAratamya karate cAYa Ara vale, ‘AmarA katakake vizvAsa kari o katakake avizvAsa kari’; Ara tArA madhyavartI kona patha avalamvana karate cAYa,
erAi prakRta kAphira, evaM kAphiradera janye lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta rekhechi|
yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlagaNe ImAna Ane Ara tAdera ekera saGge aparera pArthakya kare nA tAderake tini avazyai puraskAra divena Ara AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

kitAvIgaNa tomAke tAdera janye AsamAna hate kitAva avatIrNa karate vale; athaca tArA mUsAra nikaTa eTA apekSAo var3a dAvi karechila| tArA valechila, ‘AmAderake prakAzye AllAhke dekhAo|’ tAdera sImAlaMghanera janye tArA vajrAhata haYechila; erapara spaSTa pramANa tAdera nikaTa prakAza haoYAra parao tArA go-vatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechila; eTAo kSamA karechilAma Ara mUsAke spaSTa pramANa pradAna karechilAma|

tAdera aGgIkArera janye ‘tUra’ parvatake Ami tAdera Urdhve uttolana karechilAma Ara tAderake valechilAma, ‘natazire dvAra diYe praveza kara|’ tAderake Arao valechilAma, ‘zanivAra samparke’ sImAlaMghana kara nA, evaM tAdera nikaTa hate dRr3ha aGgIkAra niYechilAma|

evaM tArA lA‘natagrasta haYechila tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGgera janye, AllAh ra AYAtake pratyAkhyAna karAra janye, navIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karAra janye Ara ‘AmAdera hRdaYa AcchAdita’- tAdera e uktira janye; varaM tAdera kupharIra kAraNe AllAh tA mohara karechena| sutarAM tAdera alpasaMkhyaka lokai vizvAsa kare|
Ara tArA lA‘natagrasta haYechila tAdera kupharIra janye o mAraiya়Amera viruddhe gurutara apavAdera janye,

Ara ‘AmarA AllAh ra rAsUla mAraiya়AmatanaYa ‘IsA masIhke hatyA kariYechi’ tAdera e uktira janye| athaca tArA tAke hatyA kare nAi, kruzaviddhao kare nAi; kintu tAdera eirUpa vibhrama haYechila| yArA tAra samvandhe matabheda karechila tArA nizcaYai e samvandhe saMzaYayukta chila; e samparke anumAnera anusaraNa vyatIta tAdera kona jJAnai chila nA| eTA nizcita ye, tArA tAke hatyA kare nAi;
varaM AllAh tAke tA~ra nikaTa tule niYechena Ara AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
kitAvIdera madhye pratyeke nija mRtyura pUrve tAke vizvAsa karavei Ara kiYAmatera dina se tAdera viruddhe sAkSya dive|
bhAla bhAla yA iYAhUdIdera janye vaidha chila Ami tA tAdera janye avaidha karechi tAdera sImAlaMghanera janye evaM AllAh ra pathe anekake vAdhA deoYAra janye,

evaM tAdera suda grahaNera janye, yadio tA tAdera janye niSiddha karA haYechila; Ara anyAYabhAve lokera dhana-sampada grAsa karAra janye| tAdera madhye yArA kAphira tAdera janye marmantuda zAsti prastuta rekhechi|

kintu tAdera madhye yArA jJAne sugabhIra tArA o mu’minagaNa tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karA haYeche Ara tomAra pUrve yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tAteo ImAna Ane evaM yArA sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AllAh o parakAle ImAna rAkhe, Ami tAderake mahApuraskAra diva|

Ami to tomAra nikaTa ‘ohI’ preraNa karechi yemana nUha o tAra paravartI navIgaNera nikaTa ohI preraNa karechilAma; ivrAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAka‚va o tAra vaMzadharagaNa, ‘IsA, Aiuva, iunusa, hArUna o sulAYamAnera nikaTao ‘ohI’ preraNa karechilAma evaM dAUdake yAvUra diYechilAma|
aneka rAsUla preraNa karechi yAdera kathA pUrve Ami tomAke valechi Ara aneka rAsUla, yAdera kathA tomAke vali nAi| evaM mUsAra saGge AllAh sAkSAt vAkyAlApa karechilena|
susaMvAdadAtA o sAvadhAnakArI rAsUla preraNa karechi, yAte rAsUla AsAra para AllAh ra viruddhe mAnuSera kona abhiyoga nA thAke| AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
parantu AllAh sAkSya dena tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karechena tAra mAdhyame| tini tA avatIrNa karechena nija jJAne evaM pherezatAgaNao sAkSI deYa| Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
yArA kupharI kare o AllAh ra pathe vAdhA deYa tArA to bhISaNabhAve pathabhraSTa haYeche|
yArA kupharI kareche o sImAlaMghana kareche AllAh tAderake kakhanao kSamA karavena nA evaM tAderake kona pathao dekhAvena nA,
jAhAnnAmera patha vyatIta; sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have evaM eTA AllAh ra pakSe sahaja|

he mAnavamaNDalI! rAsUla tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate satya eneche; sutarAM tomarA ImAna Ana, eTA tomAdera janye kalyANakara have| Ara tomarA asvIkAra karaleo AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache sava AllAh ra i evaM AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

he kitAvIgaNa! dInera vyApAre vAr3AvAr3i kara nA o AllAh samvandhe satya vyatIta vala nA| mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsA masIh to AllAh ra rAsUla evaM tA~ra vANI, yA tini mAraiya়Amera nikaTa preraNa karechilena o tA~ra Adeza| sutarAM tomarA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlagaNe ImAna Ana Ara vala nA, ‘tina!’ nivRtta hao, eTA tomAdera janye kalyANakara have| AllAh to ekamAtra ilAh; tA~ra santAna have-tini eTA hate pavitra| AsamAne yA kichu Ache o yamIne yA kichu Ache sava AllAh ra i; karma-vidhAne AllAhi yatheSTa|

masIh AllAh ra vAndA haoYAke kakhanao heYa jJAna kare nA Ara ghaniSTha pherezatAgaNao kare nA| Ara keu tA~ra ‘ivAdatake heYa jJAna karale evaM ahaMkAra karale tini avazyai tAdera sakalake tA~ra nikaTa ekatra karavena|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare tini tAderake pUrNa puraskAra dAna karavena o nija anugrahe Arao vezi divena| kintu yArA heYa jJAna kare o ahaMkAra kare tAderake tini marmantuda zAsti dAna karavena Ara AllAh vyatIta tAdera janye tArA kona abhibhAvaka o sahAYa pAve nA|
he mAnavamaNDalI! tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera nikaTa pramANa eseche Ara Ami tomAdera prati spaSTa jyoti avatIrNa karechi|
yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane o tA~ke dRr3habhAve avalamvana kare tAderake tini avazyai tA~ra daYA o anugrahera madhye dAkhila karavena evaM tAderake sarala pathe tA~ra dike paricAlita karavena|

loke tomAra nikaTa vyavasthA jAnate cAYa| vala, ‘pitA-mAtAhIna niHsantAna vyakti samvandhe tomAderake AllAh vyavasthA jAnAcchena: kona puruSa mArA gele se yadi santAnahIna haYa evaM tAra eka bhagni thAke tave tAra janye parityakta sampattira ardhAMza Ara se yadi santAnahInA haYa tave tAra bhAi tAra uttarAdhikArI have, Ara dui bhagni thAkale tAdera janye tAra parityakta sampattira dui-tRtIYAMza, Ara yadi bhAi-vona ubhaYe thAke tave eka puruSera aMza dui nArIra aMzera samAna|’ tomarA pathabhraSTa have-ei AzaMkAYa AllAh tomAderake pariSkArabhAve jAnAcchena Ara AllAh sarvaviSaYe savizeSa avahita|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA aGgIkAra pUrNa karave| yA tomAdera nikaTa varNita hacche tA vyatIta catuSpada Ana‘Ama tomAdera janye hAlAla karA hala, tave iharAma avasthAYa zikAra karAke vaidha mane karave nA| nizcaYai AllAh yA icchA Adeza karena|

he mu’minagaNa! AllAh ra nidarzanera, pavitra mAsera, kuravAnIra janye kA‘vAYa prerita pazura, galAYa parAna cihnaviziSTa pazura evaM nija pratipAlakera anugraha o santoSa lAbhera AzAYa pavitra gRha abhimukhe yAtrIdera pavitratAra avamAnanA karave nA| yakhana tomarA iharAma mukta have takhana zikAra karate pAra| tomAderake masjidula hArAme praveze vAdhA deoYAra kAraNe kona sampradAYera prati vidveSa tomAderake yena kakhanai sImAlaMghane prarocita nA kare| satkarma o tAkoYAYa tomarA paraspara sahayogitA karave evaM pApa o sImAlaMghane eke anyera sahayogitA karave nA| AllAhke bhaYa karave| nizcaYai AllAh zAstidAne kaThora|

tomAdera janye hArAma karA haYeche mRta jantu, rakta, zUkara-mAMsa, AllAh vyatIta aparera nAme yavehkRta pazu Ara zvAsarodhe mRta jantu, prahAre mRta jantu, patane mRta jantu, zRMgAghAte mRta jantu evaM hiMsra pazute khAoYA jantu; tave yA tomarA yaveh karate perecha tA vyatIta, Ara yA mUrti pUjAra vedIra opara vali deoYA haYa tA o juYAra tIra diYe bhAgya nirNaYa karA-e sava pApakAja| Aja kAphirarA tomAdera dInera viruddhAcaraNe hatAza haYeche; sutarAM tAderake bhaYa kara nA, zudhu AmAke bhaYa kara| Aja tomAdera janye tomAdera dIna pUrNAMga karalAma o tomAdera prati AmAra anugraha sampUrNa karalAma Ara isalAmake tomAdera dIna manonIta karalAma| tave keu pApera dike nA jhu~kiYA kSudhAra tAr3anAYa vAdhya hale takhana AllAh to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

loke tomAke prazna kare, tAdera janye kI kI hAlAla karA haYeche? vala, ‘samasta bhAla jinisa tomAdera janye hAlAla karA haYeche Ara zikArI pazu-pAkhi yAderake tomarA zikAra zikSA diYecha yebhAve AllAh tomAderake zikSA diYechena, tArA yA tomAdera janye dhare Ane tA bhakSaNa karave evaM ete AllAh ra nAma nive Ara AllAhke bhaYa karave; nizcaYai AllAh hiseva grahaNe atyanta tatpara|’

Aja tomAdera janye samasta bhAla jinisa hAlAla karA hala, yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tAdera khAdyadravya tomAdera janye hAlAla o tomAdera khAdyadravya tAdera janye hAlAla; evaM mu’mina saccaritrA nArI o tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tAdera saccaritrA nArI tomAdera janye vaidha karA hala yadi tomarA tAdera mAhra pradAna kara vivAhera janye-prakAzya vyabhicAra vA gopana praNaYinI grahaNera janye naYa| keu ImAna pratyAkhyAna karale tAra karma niSphala have Ara se AkhirAte kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|

he mu’minagaNa! yakhana tomarA sAlAtera janye prastuta have takhana tomarA tomAdera mukhamaNDala o hAta kanui paryanta dhauta karave Ara tomAdera mAthA maseh karave evaM pA granthi paryanta dhauta karave; yadi tomarA apavitra thAka, tave vizeSabhAve pavitra have| tomarA yadi pIr3ita hao vA saphare thAka vA tomAdera keu zaucasthAna hate Ase, vA tomarA strIra saGge saMgata hao evaM pAni nA pAo tave pavitra mATi diYe tAYAmmuma karave evaM tA diYe tomAdera mukhamaNDala o hAta maseh karave| AllAh tomAderake kaSTa dite cAna nA; varaM tini tomAderake pavitra karate cAna o tomAdera prati tA~ra anugraha sampUrNa karate cAna; yAte tomarA kRtajJatA jJApana kara|

smaraNa kara, tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha evaM ye aGgIkAre tini tomAderake Avaddha karechilena tA| yakhana tomarA valechile, ‘zunalAma o mAnya karalAma’ evaM AllAhke bhaYa kara; antare yA Ache se samvandhe AllAh to savizeSa avahita|

he mu’minagaNa! AllAh ra uddezye nyAYa sAkSyadAne tomarA avicala thAkave; kona sampradAYera prati vidveSa tomAderake yena kakhanao suvicAra varjane prarocita nA kare, suvicAra karave, eTA tAkoYAra nikaTatara evaM AllAhke bhaYa karave, tomarA yA kara nizcaYai AllAh tAra samyaka khavara rAkhena|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare AllAh tAderake pratizruti diYechena, tAdera janye kSamA evaM mahApuraskAra Ache|
yArA kupharI kare Ara AmAra AYAtake mithyA jJAna kare tArA prajvalita agnira adhivAsI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha smaraNa kara, yakhana eka sampradAYa tomAdera viruddhe hAta uttolana karate ceYechila, takhana AllAh tAdera hAta tomAdera dika hate nivRtta karechilena; evaM AllAhke bhaYa kara, Ara AllAh ra i prati mu’minagaNa nirbhara karuka|

Ara AllAh to vanI isarAIlera aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilena o tAdera madhya hate dvAdaza netA niyukta karechilAma; Ara AllAh valechilena, ‘Ami tomAdera saGge Achi; tomarA yadi sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo, AmAra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna Ana o tAderake sammAna kara evaM AllAhke uttama RNa pradAna kara, tave tomAdera pApa avazyai mocana karava evaM nizcaYa tomAderake dAkhila karava jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| era parao keu kupharI karale se to sarala patha hArAive|

tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGgera janye Ami tAderake lA‘nata karechi evaM tAdera hRdaYa kaThina karechi; tArA zavdagulira Asala artha vikRta kare evaM tArA yA upadiSTa haYechila era eka aMza bhule geche| tumi sarvadA edera alpasaMkhyaka vyatIta sakalakei vizvAsaghAtakatA karate dekhate pAve, sutarAM ederake kSamA kara o upekSA kara, nizcaYai AllAh satkarmaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|

yArA vale, ‘AmarA khrisTAna’, tAderao aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma; kintu tArA yA upadiSTa haYechila tAra eka aMza bhule geche| sutarAM Ami tAdera madhye kiYAmata paryanta sthAYI zatrutA o vidveSa jAgarUka rekhechi; tArA yA karata AllAh tAderake acirei tA jAniYe divena|

he kitAvIgaNa! AmAra rAsUla tomAdera nikaTa eseche, tomarA kitAvera yA gopana karate se era aneka kichu tomAdera nikaTa prakAza kare evaM aneka kichu upekSA kare thAke| AllAh ra nikaTa hate eka jyoti o spaSTa kitAva tomAdera nikaTa eseche|

yArA AllAh ra santuSTi lAbha karate cAYa, eTA diYe tini tAderake zAntira pathe paricAlita karena evaM nija anumatikrame andhakAra hate vera kare Alora dike niYe yAna evaM ederake sarala pathe paricAlita karena|

yArA vale, ‘mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa masIhi AllAh’, tArA to kupharI karechei| vala, ‘AllAh mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa masIh, tA~ra mAtA evaM duniYAra sakalake yadi dhvaMsa karate icchA karena tave tA~ke vAdhA deoYAra zakti kAhAra Ache?’ AsamAna o yamInera evaM edera madhye yA kichu Ache tAra sArvabhaumatva AllAh ra i| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

iYAha‚dI o khrisTAnagaNa vale, ‘AmarA AllAh ra putra o tA~ra priYa|’ vala, ‘tave kena tini tomAdera pApera janye tomAderake zAsti dena? nA, tomarA mAnuSa tAderai mato yAderake AllAh sRSTi karechena|’ yAke icchA tini kSamA karena Ara yAke icchA tini zAsti dena; AsamAna o yamInera evaM edera madhye yA kichu Ache tAra sArvabhaumatva AllAh ra i, Ara pratyAvartana tA~rai dike|
