he kitAvIgaNa! rAsUla preraNe viratira para AmAra rAsUla tomAdera nikaTa eseche| se tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa vyAkhyA karateche yAte tomarA valite nA pAra, ‘kona susaMvAdavAhI o satarkakArI AmAdera nikaTa Ase nAi|’ ekhana to tomAdera nikaTa ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI eseche| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha smaraNa kara, yakhana tini tomAdera madhya hate navI karechilena o tomAderake rAjyAdhipati karechilena evaM vizvajagate kAukeo yA tini dena nAi tA tomAderake diYechilena|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAh tomAdera janye ye pavitra bha‚mi nirdiSTa karechena tAte tomarA praveza kara evaM pazcAdapasaraNa kara nA; karale tomarA kSatigrasta haYe par3ave|’

tArA valala, ‘he mUsA! sekhAne eka durdAnta sampradAYa Ache evaM tArA sei sthAna hate vera nA haoYA paryanta AmarA kakhanai sekhAne kichutei praveza karava nA; tArA sei sthAna hate vera haYe gelei AmarA praveza karava|’

yArA bhaYa karachila tAdera madhye du’jana-yAdera prati AllAh anugraha karechilena, tArA valala, ‘tomarA tAdera mukAvilA kare dvAra diYe praveza kara, praveza karalena tomarA jaYI have Ara tomarA mu’mina hale AllAh ra oparai nirbhara kara|’
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA! tArA yata dina sekhAne thAkave tata dina AmarA sekhAne praveza karavai nA; sutarAM tumi Ara tomAra pratipAlaka yAo evaM yuddha kara, AmarA ekhAnei vase thAkava|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra o AmAra bhAi vyatIta apara kArao opara AmAra Adhipatya nei; sutarAM tumi AmAdera o satyatyAgI sampradAYera madhye phaYasAlA kare dAo|’
AllAh valalena, ‘tave eTA calliza vatsara tAdera janye niSiddha thAkala, tArA pRthivIte udbhrAnta haYe ghure ver3Ave, sutarAM tumi satyatyAgI sampradAYera janye duHkha kara nA|’

Adamera dui putrera vRttAnta tumi tAderake yathAyathabhAve zonAo| yakhana tArA ubhaYe kuravAnI karechila takhana ekajanera kuravAnI kavUla hala evaM anyajanera kavUla hala nA| se valala, ‘Ami tomAke hatyA karavai|’ aparajana valala, ‘avazyai AllAh muttAkIdera kuravAnI kavUla karena|’
‘AmAke hatyA karAra janye tumi hAta tulaleo tomAke hatyA karAra janye Ami hAta tulava nA; Ami to jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAhke bhaYa kari|’
‘tumi AmAra o tomAra pApera bhAra vahana kara Ara dojakhavAsI hao-eTAi Ami cAi Ara eTA jAlimadera karmaphala|’
erapara tAra citta bhAi hatyAYa tAke uttejita karala| phale se tAke hatyA karala; tAi se kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hala|

erapara AllAh ekaTi kAka pAThAlena, ye tAra bhAi era zavadeha kibhAve gopana karA yAYa tA dekhAnora janye mATi khanana karate lAgala| se valala, ‘hAYa! Ami ki ei kAkera matao hate pAralAma nA, yAte AmAra bhAiYera zavadeha gopana karate pAri!’ erapara se anutapta hala|

e kAraNei vanI isarAIlera prati vidhAna dilAma ye, narahatyA vA duniYAYa dhvaMsAtmaka kAja karA hetu vyatIta keu kAukeo hatyA karale se yena duniYAra sakala mAnuSakei hatyA karala; Ara keu kArao prANa rakSA karale se yena sakala mAnuSera prANa rakSA karala| tAdera nikaTa to AmAra rAsUlagaNa spaSTa pramANa enechila, kintu era parao tAdera aneke duniYAYa sImAlaMghana-kArIi theke gela|

yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhe yuddha kare evaM duniYAYa dhvaMsAtmaka kAja kare ver3AYa eTAi tAdera zAsti ye, tAderake hatyA karA have vA kruzaviddha karA have vA viparIta dika hate tAdera hAta o pA keTe phelA have vA tAderake deza hate nirvAsita karA have| duniYAYa eTAi tAdera lAJchanA o parakAle tAdera janye mahAzAsti raYeche;
tave, tomAdera AYattAdhIne AsAra pUrve yArA taovA karave tAdera janye naYa| sutarAM jene rAkha, AllAh avazyai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAhke bhaYa kara, tA~ra naikaTya lAbhera upAYa ane¦SaNa kara o tA~ra pathe saMgrAma kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

yArA kupharI kareche, kiYAmatera dina zAsti hate muktira janye paNasvarUpa duniYAYa yA kichu Ache, yadi tAdera tAra samastai thAke evaM tAra saGge samaparimANa Arao thAke, tavuo tAdera nikaTa hate tA gRhIta have nA evaM tAdera janye marmantuda zAsti Ache|
tArA dojakha hate vera hate icchA karave; kintu tArA tA hate vera haoYAra naYa evaM tAdera janye sthAYI zAsti raYeche|
puruSa cora o nArI cora, tAdera hastacchedana kara; eTA tAdera kRtakarmera phala evaM AllAh ra pakSa hate dRSTAntamUlaka daNDa; AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
kintu sImAlaMghana karAra para keu taovA karale o nijeke saMzodhana karale avazyai AllAh tAra taovA kavUla karavena; AllAh to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tumi ki jAna nA, AsamAna o yamInera sArvabhaumatva AllAh ra i? yAke icchA tini zAsti dena Ara yAke icchA tini kSamA karena evaM AllAh sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

he rAsUla! tomAke yena duHkha nA deYa yArA kupharIra dike druta dhAvita haYa-yArA mukhe vale, ‘ImAna enechi’, athaca tAdera antara ImAna Ane nA evaM iYAha‚dIdera madhye yArA asatya zunate tatpara, tomAra nikaTa Ase nA emana eka bhinna dalera pakSe yArA kAna pete thAke| zavdaguli yathAyatha suvinyasta thAkAra parao tArA segulira artha vikRta kare| tArA vale, ‘ei prakAra vidhAna dile grahaNa kara evaM tA nA dile varjana kara|’ evaM AllAh yAra pathacyuti cAna tAra janye AllAh ra nikaTa tomAra kichu karAra nei| tAdera hRdaYake AllAh vizuddha karate cAna nA; tAdera janye Ache duniYAYa lAJchanA Ara AkhirAte Ache tAdera janye mahAzAsti|

tArA mithyA kathA zunate atyanta AgrahazIla evaM avaidha khAdya grahaNe atyanta Asakta; tArA yadi tomAra kAche Ase tave tAdera vicAra niSpatti kara vA tAderake upekSA kara| tumi yadi tAderake upekSA kara tave tArA tomAra kona kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yadi vicAra niSpatti kara tave tAdera madhye nyAYavicAra kara; nizcaYai AllAh nyAYaparAYaNadera bhAlavAsena|
tArA tomAra opara kemana kare vicArabhAra nyasta karave athaca tAdera nikaTa raYeche tAorAta yAte AllAh ra Adeza Ache? era parao tArA mukha phiriYe neYa evaM orA mu’mina naYa|

nizcaYai Ami tAorAta avatIrNa karechilAma; ete chila pathanirdeza o Alo; navIgaNa, yArA AllAh ra anugata chila tArA iYAha‚dIderake se anusAre vidhAna dita, Arao vidhAna dita rAvvAnIgaNa Ara vidvAnagaNa; kAraNa tAderake AllAh ra kitAvera rakSaka karA haYechila evaM tArA chila era sAkSI| sutarAM mAnuSake bhaYa kara nA, AmAkei bhaYa kara Ara AmAra AYAtasamUha tuccha mUlye vikraYa kara nA| AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena se anusAre yArA vidhAna deYa nA, tArAi kAphira|

Ami tAdera janye ete vidhAna diYechilAma, prANera vadale prANa, cokhera vadale cokha, nAkera vadale nAka, kAnera vadale kAna, dA~tera vadale dA~ta o yakhamera vadale anurUpa yakhama| erapara keu eTA kSamA karale ete tArai pApa mocana have| AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena se anusAre yArA vidhAna deYa nA, tArAi jAlima|

mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsAke tAra pUrve avatIrNa tAorAtera pratyAYanakArIrUpe edera pazcAte preraNa karechilAma evaM tAra pUrve avatIrNa tAorAtera pratyAYanakArIrUpe Ara muttAkIdera janye pathanirdeza o upadezarUpe tAke injIla diYechilAma; ete chila pathanirdeza o Alo|
injIla-anusArigaNa yena, AllAh ete yA avatIrNa karechena se anusAre vidhAna deYa| AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena se anusAre yArA vidhAna deYa nA, tArAi phAsika|

Ami tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechi eTAra pUrve avatIrNa kitAvera pratyAYanakArI o saMrakSakarUpe| sutarAM AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena se anusAre tumi tAdera vicAra niSpatti kara Ara ye satya tomAra nikaTa eseche tA tyAga kare tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara nA| tomAdera pratyekera janye zarI‘Ata o spaSTa patha nirdhAraNa karechi| icchA karale AllAh tomAderake eka jAti karate pAratena, kintu tini tomAderake yA diYechena tA diYe tomAderake parIkSA karate cAna| sutarAM satkarme tomarA pratiyogitA kara| AllAh ra dikei tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana| erapara tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda karachile, se samvandhe tini tomAderake avahita karavena|

kitAva avatIrNa karechi yAte tumi AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena se anuyAYI tAdera vicAraniSpatti kara, tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa nA kara Ara tAdera samvandhe satarka hao yAte AllAh yA tomAra prati avatIrNa karechena tArA tAra kichu hate tomAke vicyuta nA kare| yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave jene rAkha ye, tAdera kona kona pApera janye AllAh tAderake zAsti dite cAna Ara mAnuSera madhye anekei to satyatyAgI|
tave ki tArA jAhilI yugera vidhi-vidhAna kAmanA kare? nizcita vizvAsI sampradAYera janye vidhAnadAne AllAh apekSA ke zreSThatara?

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA iYAha‚dI o khrisTAnaderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kara nA, tArA paraspara parasparera vandhu| tomAdera madhye keu tAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karale se tAderai ekajana have| nizcaYai AllAh jAlima sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

Ara yAdera antaHkaraNe vyAdhi Ache tumi tAderake satvara tAdera saGge milita hate dekhave ei vale, ‘AmAdera AzaMkA haYa AmAdera bhAgya viparyaYa ghaTave|’ haYato AllAh vijaYa vA tA~ra nikaTa hate emana kichu divena yAte tArA tAdera antare yA gopana rekhechila se janya anutapta have|
Ara mu’minagaNa valave, ‘erAi ki tArA, yArA AllAh ra nAme dRr3habhAve zapatha karechila ye, tArA tomAdera saGgei Ache?’ tAdera kAja niSphala haYeche; phale tArA kSatigrasta haYeche|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera madhye keu dIna hate phire gele nizcaYai AllAh emana eka sampradAYa Anavena yAderake tini bhAlavAsavena evaM yArA tA~ke bhAlavAsave; tArA mu’minadera prati komala o kAphiradera prati kaThora have; tArA AllAh ra pathe jihAda karave evaM kona nindukera nindAra bhaYa karave nA; eTA AllAh ra anugraha, yAke icchA tini dAna karena evaM AllAh prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
tomAdera vandhu to AllAh, tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minagaNa-yArA vinata haYe sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa|
keu AllAh, tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minaderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karale AllAh ra dalai to vijaYI have|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tAdera madhye yArA tomAdera dInake hAsi-tAmAzA o krIr3Ara vasturUpe grahaNa kare tAderake o kAphiraderake tomarA vandhurUpe grahaNa kara nA evaM yadi tomarA mu’mina hao tave AllAhke bhaYa kara|
tomarA yakhana sAlAtera janye AhvAna kara takhana tArA eke hAsi-tAmAzA o krIr3Ara vasturUpe grahaNa kare-eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA emana eka sampradAYa yAdera vodhazakti nei|

vala, ‘he kitAvIgaNa! ekamAtra e kAraNei nA tomarA AmAdera prati zatrutA poSaNa kara ye, AmarA AllAh o AmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche evaM yA pUrve avatIrNa haYeche tAte AmarA ImAna enechi evaM tomAdera adhikAMzai to phAsika|’

vala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake eTA apekSA nikRSTa pariNAmera saMvAda diva yA AllAh ra nikaTa Ache? yAke AllAh lA‘nata karechena, yAra opara tini krodhAnvita, yAdera katakake tini vAnara o katakake zUkara karechena Ara yArA tAgUtera ‘ivAdata kare, maryAdAYa tArAi nikRSTa o sarala patha hate sarvAdhika vicyuta|’
tArA yakhana tomAdera nikaTa Ase takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’, kintu tArA kuphara niYei praveza kare evaM seTA niYei vera haYe yAYa| tArA yA gopana kare, AllAh tA vizeSabhAve avahita|
tAdera anekakei tumi dekhave pApe, sImAlaMghane o avaidha bhakSaNe tatpara; tArA yA kare nizcaYa tA nikRSTa|
rAvvAnIgaNa o paNDitagaNa kena tAderake pApa kathA valite o avaidha bhoge niSedha kare nA? erA yA kare nizcaYa tAo nikRSTa|

iYAha‚dIrA vale, ‘AllAh ra hAta ruddha’; tArAi ruddhahasta Ara tArA yA vale tAra janye tArA abhizapta, varaM AllAh ra ubhaYa hAtai prasArita; yebhAve icchA tini dAna karena| tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate yA tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tA tAdera anekera dharmadrohitA o kupharI vRddhi karavei| tAdera madhye Ami kiYAmata paryanta sthAYI zatrutA o vidveSa saJcAra karechi| yatavAra tArA yuddhera agni prajvalita kare tatavAra AllAh eTA nirvApita karena evaM tArA duniYAYa dhvaMsAtmaka kAja kare ver3AYa; AllAh dhvaMsAtmaka kAje liptaderake bhAlavAsena nA|
kitAvIgaNa yadi ImAna Anata o bhaYa karata tA hale Ami tAdera doSa avazyai apanodana karatAma evaM tAderake sukhamaYa jAnnAte dAkhila karatAma|

tArA yadi tAorAta, injIla o tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA pratiSThita karata, tA hale tArA tAdera opara o padatala hate AhArya lAbha karata| tAdera madhye ekadala raYeche yArA madhyapanthI; kintu tAdera adhikAMza yA kare tA nikRSTa|

he rAsUla! tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA pracAra kara; yadi nA kara tave to tumi tA~ra vArtA pracAra karale nA| AllAh tomAke mAnuSa hate rakSA karavena| nizcaYai AllAh kAphira sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

vala, ‘he kitAvIgaNa! tAorAta, injIla o yA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche tomarA tA pratiSThita nA karA paryanta tomAdera kona bhittii nei|’ tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA tAdera anekera dharmadrohitA o avizvAsai vardhita karave| sutarAM tumi kAphira sampradAYera janye duHkha kara nA|
mu’minagaNa, iYAha‚dIgaNa, sAvIgaNa o khrisTAnagaNera madhye keu AllAh o AkhirAte ImAna Anale evaM satkAja karale tAdera kona bhaYa nei Ara tArA duHkhita have nA|

Ami vanI isarAIlera nikaTa hate aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma o tAdera nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechilAma| yakhanai kona rAsUla tAdera nikaTa emana kichu Ane yA tAdera manaHpUta naYa, takhanai tArA katakake mithyAvAdI vale o katakake hatyA kare|

tArA mane karechila, tAdera kona zAsti have nA; phale tArA andha o vadhira haYe giYechila| erapara AllAh tAdera prati kSamAzIla haYechilena| punarAYa tAdera anekei andha o vadhira haYechila| tArA yA kare AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|

yArA vale, ‘AllAhi mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa masIh’, tArA to kupharI karechei| athaca masIh valechila, ‘he vanI isrAIla! tomarA AmAra pratipAlaka o tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara|’ keu AllAh ra zarIka karale AllAh tAra janye jAnnAta avazyai niSiddha karavena Ara tAra AvAsa jAhAnnAma| jAlimadera janye kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

yArA vale, ‘AllAh to tinera madhye ekajana, tArA to kupharI karechei-yadio eka ilAh vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| tArA yA vale tA hate nivRtta nA hale tAdera madhye yArA kupharI kareche, tAdera opara avazyai marmantuda zAsti Apatita havei|
tave ki tArA AllAh ra dike pratyAvartana karave nA o tA~ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karave nA? AllAh to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa masIh to kevala ekajana rAsUla| tAra pUrve vahu rAsUla gata haYeche evaM tAra mAtA parama satyaniSTha chila| tArA ubhaYe khAdyAhAra karata| dekha, Ami tAdera janye AYAtasamUha kemana vizadabhAve varNanA kari; Arao dekha, tArA kibhAve satyavimukha haYa|
vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAh vyatIta emana kichura ‘ivAdata kara, tomAdera kSati vA upakAra karAra kona kSamatA yAra nei? AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|’

vala, ‘he kitAvIgaNa! tomarA tomAdera dIna samvandhe anyAYa vAr3AvAr3i kara nA; Ara ye sampradAYa itopUrve pathabhraSTa haYeche, anekake pathabhraSTa kareche o sarala patha hate vicyuta haYeche, tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara nA|’
vanI isrAIlera madhye yArA kupharI karechila tArA dAUda o mAraiYAma-tanaYa kartRka abhizapta haYechila-eTA ekAraNe ye, tArA chila avAdhya o sImAlaMghanakArI|
tArA yesava garrhita kAja karata tA hate tArA eke anyake vAraNa karata nA| tArA yA karata tA katai nA nikRSTa|
tAdera anekake tumi kAphiradera saGge vandhutva karate dekhave| kata nikRSTa tAdera kRtakarma!-ye kAraNe AllAh tAdera opara krodhAnvita haYechena| tAdera zAstibhoga sthAYI have|
tArA AllAhe, navIte o tAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte ImAna Anale tAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karata nA, kintu tAdera aneke phAsika|

avazya mu’minadera prati zatrutAYa mAnuSera madhye iYAha‚dI o muzarikaderakei tumi sarvAdhika ugra dekhave evaM yArA vale ‘AmarA khrisTAna’ mAnuSera madhye tAderakei tumi mu’minadera nikaTatara vandhutve dekhave; kAraNa tAdera madhye aneka paNDita o saMsAra-virAgI Ache, Ara tArA ahaMkArao kare nA|

rAsUlera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA yakhana tArA zone takhana tArA ye satya upalavdhi kare tAra janye tumi tAdera cokha azru-vigalita dekhave| tArA vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi; sutarAM tumi AmAderake sAkSyadAnakArIdera tAlikAbhukta kara|’
‘AllAhe o AmAdera kAche Agata satye AmAdera ImAna nA AnAra kI kAraNa thAkate pAre yakhana AmarA pratyAzA kari, ‘AllAh AmAderake satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta karuna?’
Ara tAdera ei kathAra janye AllAh tAdera puraskAra nirdiSTa karechena jAnnAta-yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; tArA sekhAne sthAYI have| eTA satkarmaparAYaNadera puraskAra|
yArA kupharI kareche o AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche tArAi jAhAnnAmavAsI|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAh tomAdera janye utkRSTa yesava vastu hAlAla karechena sei savake tomarA hArAma kara nA evaM sImAlaMghana kara nA| nizcaYai AllAh sImAlaMghanakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
AllAh tomAderake ye hAlAla o utkRSTa jIvikA diYechena tA hate khAo evaM bhaYa kara AllAhke, yA~hAra prati tomarA vizvAsI|

tomAdera vRthA zapathera janye AllAh tomAderake dAYI karavena nA, kintu yesava zapatha tomarA icchAkRtabhAve kara sei sakalera janye tini tomAderake dAYI karavena| erapara era kAphphArA dazajana daridrake madhyama dharanera AhArya dAna, yA tomarA tomAdera parijanadera khete dAo, vA tAderake vastradAna, kiMvA ekajana dAsa mukti evaM yAra sAmarthya nei tAra janye tinadina siYAma pAlana| tomarA zapatha karale eTAi tomAdera zapathera kAphphArA, tomarA tomAdera zapatha rakSA kara| eibhAve AllAh tomAdera janye tA~ra vidhAnasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena yena tomarA kRtajJatA jJApana kara|
he mu’minagaNa! mada, juYA, mUrtipUjAra vedI o bhAgya nirNAYaka zara ghRNya vastu, zaYatAnera kAja| sutarAM tomarA oTA varjana kara-yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|
zaYatAna to mada o juYA diYe tomAdera madhye zatrutA o vidveSa ghaTAte cAYa evaM tomAderake AllAh ra smaraNe o sAlAte vAdhA dite cAYa| tave ki tomarA nivRtta have nA?
tomarA AllAh ra Anugatya kara o rAsUlera Anugatya kara evaM satarka hao; yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tave jene rAkha, spaSTa pracArai AmAra rAsUlera kartavya|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tArA pUrve yA khAdya grahaNa kareche tAra janye tAdera kona gunAh nei; yadi tArA sAvadhAna haYa Ara ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, sAvadhAna haYa o vizvAsa kare, punarAYa sAvadhAna haYa o satkarma kare evaM AllAh satkarmaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera hAta o varzA yA zikAra kare se viSaYe AllAh avazyai tomAderake parIkSA karavena, yAte AllAh avahita hana ke tA~ke nA dekheo bhaYa kare| sutarAM era para keu sImAlaMghana karale tAra janye marmantuda zAsti Ache|

he mu’minagaNa! iharAme thAkAkAle tomarA zikAra-jantu hatyA kara nA; tomAdera madhye keu icchAkRtabhAve eTA hatyA karale yA se hatyA karala tAra vinimaYa hacche anurUpa gRhapAlita jantu, yAra phaYasAlA karave tomAdera madhye du’jana nyAYavAna loka-kA‘vAYa pAThAno kuravAnIrUpe| vA era kAphphArA have daridrake khAdya dAna karA kiMvA samasaMkhyaka siYAma pAlana karA, yAte se Apana kRtakarmera phala bhoga kare| yA gata haYeche AllAh tA kSamA karechena| keu eTA punarAYa karale AllAh tAra zAsti divena evaM AllAh parAkramazAlI, zAstidAtA|

tomAdera janye samudrera zikAra o tA bhoga hAlAla karA haYeche, tomAdera o paryaTakadera bhogera janye| tomarA yatakSaNa iharAme thAkave tatakSaNa sthalera zikAra tomAdera janye hArAma| tomarA bhaYa kara AllAhke, yA~hAra nikaTa tomAderake ekatra karA have|

pavitra kA‘vAgRha, pavitra mAsa, kuravAnIra janye kA‘vAYa prerita pazu o galAYa mAlA parihita pazuke AllAh mAnuSera kalyANera janye nirdhAraNa karechena| eTA ekAraNe ye, tomarA yena jAnate pAra-yA kichu AsamAna o yamIne Ache AllAh tA jAnena evaM AllAh to sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|
jene rAkha, nizcaYai AllAh zAstidAne kaThora evaM AllAh parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
pracAra karAi kevala rAsUlera kartavya| Ara tomarA yA prakAza kara o gopana rAkha AllAh tA jAnena|
vala, ‘manda o bhAla eka naYa; yadio mandera Adhikya tomAke camatkRta kare| sutarAM he vodhazaktisampannerA! AllAhke bhaYa kara-yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|’

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA sei sava viSaYe prazna kara nA yA tomAdera nikaTa prakAza hale tA tomAderake kaSTa dive| kuraAna nAyilera samaYa tomarA yadi sei sava viSaYe prazna kara tave tA tomAdera nikaTa prakAza karA have| AllAh sei sava kSamA karechena evaM AllAh kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|
tomAdera pUrveo to eka sampradAYa ei prakAra prazna karechila; erapara tArA oTA pratyAkhyAna kare|
vAhIrAH, sAivAH, oYAsIlAH o hAma AllAh sthira karena nAi; kintu kAphiragaNa AllAh ra prati mithyA Aropa kare Ara tAdera adhikAMzai upalavdhi kare nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena tAra dike o rAsUlera dike Asa’, tArA vale, ‘AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake yAte peYechi tAi AmAdera janye yatheSTa|’ yadio tAdera pUrvapuruSagaNa kichui jAnata nA Ara satpathaprAptao chila nA, tavuo ki?

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera dAYitva tomAderai opara| tomarA yadi satpathe paricAlita hao tave ye pathabhraSTa haYeche se tomAdera kona kSati karate pArave nA| AllAh ra dikei tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana; erapara tomarA yA karate tini se samvandhe tomAderake avahita karavena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera kArao yakhana mRtyu upasthita haYa, takhana osiYAta karAra samaYa tomAdera madhya hate du’jana nyAYaparAYaNa lokake sAkSI rAkhave; tomarA saphare thAkale evaM tomAdera mRtyura vipada upasthita hale tomAdera chAr3A anya lokadera madhya hate du’jana sAkSI manonIta karave| tomAdera sandeha hale sAlAtera para tAderake apekSamANa rAkhave| erapara tArA AllAh ra nAme zapatha kare valave, ‘AmarA era vinimaYe kona mUlya grahaNa karava nA-yadi se AtmIYao haYa evaM AmarA AllAh ra sAkSya gopana karava nA; karale avazyai pApIdera antarbhukta hava|’

yadi eTA prakAza pAYa ye, tArA du’jana aparAdhe lipta haYeche tave yAdera svArthahAni ghaTeche tAdera madhya hate nikaTatama du’jana tAdera sthalavartI have Ara AllAh ra nAme zapatha kare valave, ‘AmAdera sAkSya avazyai tAdera sAkSya hate adhikatara satya Ara AmarA sImAlaMghana kari nAi- karale avazyai AmarA jAlimadera antarbhukta hava|’

e paddhatitei adhikatara sambhAvanA Ache lokera yathAyatha sAkSyadAnera vA zapathera para AvAra tAderake zapatha karAna have-ei bhaYera| AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM zono, AllAh phAsika sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

smaraNa kara, ye dina AllAh rAsUlagaNake ekatra karavena Ara jijJAsA karavena, ‘tomarA kI uttara peYechile?’ tArA valave, ‘e viSaYe AmAdera kona jJAnai nei; tumii to adRzya samvandhe samyaka parijJAta|’

smaraNa kara, AllAh valavena, ‘he mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsA! tomAra prati o tomAra jananIra prati AmAra anugraha smaraNa kara, pavitra AtmA diYe Ami tomAke zaktizAlI karechilAma evaM tumi dolanAYa thAkA avasthAYa o pariNata vaYase mAnuSera saGge kathA valate; tomAke kitAva, hikmata, tAorAta o injIla zikSA diYechilAma; tumi kardama diYe AmAra anumatikrame pAkhisadRza AkRti gaThana karate evaM ete phutkAra dite; phale AmAra anumatikrame tA pAkhi haYe yeta; janmAndha o kuSTha vyAdhigrastake tumi AmAra anumatikrame nirAmaYa karate evaM AmAra anumatikrame tumi mRtake jIvita karate; Ami tomA hate vanI isrAIlake nivRtta rekhechilAma; tumi yakhana tAdera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzana enechile takhana tAdera madhye yArA kupharI karechila tArA valachila, ‘eTA to spaSTa jAdu|’

Arao smaraNa kara, Ami yakhana ‘hAoYArIderake ei hukuma diYechilAma ye, ‘tomarA AmAra prati o AmAra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana’, tArA valechila, ‘AmarA ImAna AnalAma evaM tumi sAkSI thAka ye, AmarA to musalima|’

smaraNa kara, hAoYArIgaNa valechila, ‘he mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsA! tomAra pratipAlaka ki AmAdera janye AsamAna hate khAdya-paripUrNa khAJcA preraNa karate sakSama?’ se valechila, ‘AllAhke bhaYa kara, yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|’
tArA valechila, ‘AmarA cAi ye, eTA hate kichu khAva o AmAdera citta prazAnti lAbha karave| Ara AmarA jAnate cAi ye, tumi AmAderake satya valecha evaM AmarA era sAkSI thAkate cAi|’

mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsA valala, ‘he AllAh AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera janye AsamAna hate khAdyapUrNa khAJcA preraNa kara; eTA AmAdera o AmAdera pUrvavartI o paravartI sakalera janye have AnandotsavasvarUpa evaM tomAra nikaTa hate nidarzana| Ara AmAderake jIvikA dAna kara; tumii to zreSTha jIvikAdAtA|’
AllAh valalena, ‘Amii tomAdera nikaTa eTA preraNa karava; kintu erapara tomAdera madhye keu kupharI karale tAke emana zAsti diva, ye zAsti vizvajagatera apara kAukeo diva nA|’

AllAh yakhana valavena, ‘he mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsA! tumi ki lokaderake valechile, tomarA AllAh vyatIta AmAke o AmAra jananIke dui ilAha rUpe grahaNa kara?’ se valave, ‘tumii mahimAnvita! yA valAra adhikAra AmAra nei tA valA AmAra pakSe zobhana naYa| yadi Ami tA valatAma tave tumi to tA jAnate| AmAra antarera kathA to tumi avagata Acha, kintu tomAra antarera kathA Ami avagata nai; tumi adRzya samvandhe samyaka parijJAta|’

tumi AmAke ye AjJA karecha tA vyatIta tAderake Ami kichui vali nAi, tA ei: ‘tomarA AmAra pratipAlaka o tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara evaM yata dina Ami tAdera madhye chilAma tata dina Ami chilAma tAdera kAryakalApera sAkSI; kintu yakhana tumi AmAke tule nile takhana tumii to chile tAdera kAryakalApera tattvAvadhAYaka Ara tumii sarvaviSaYe sAkSI|’
‘tumi yadi tAderake zAsti dAo tave tArA to tomArai vAndA, Ara yadi tAderake kSamA kara tave tumi to parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’

AllAh valavena, ‘ei se dina yedina satyavAdigaNa tAdera satyatAra janye upakRta have, tAdera janye Ache jAnnAta yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have; AllAh tAdera prati prasanna Ara tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa; eTA mahAsaphalatA|’
AsamAna o yamIna evaM edera madhye yA kichu Ache tAra sArvabhaumatva AllAh ra i Ara tini sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra i yini AsamAna o yamIna sRSTi karechena, Ara sRSTi karechena andhakAra o Alo| etadsattveo kAphiragaNa tAdera pratipAlakera samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa|
tinii tomAderake mRttikA hate sRSTi karechena, erapara eka kAla nirdiSTa karechena evaM Ara ekaTi nirdhArita kAla Ache yA tinii jJAta, etadsattveo tomarA sandeha kara|
AsamAna o yamIne tinii AllAh, tomAdera gopana o prakAzya savakichu tini jAnena evaM tomarA yA arjana kara tAo tini avagata Achena|
tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalIra emana kona nidarzana tAdera nikaTa upasthita haYa nA yA hate tArA mukha nA phirAYa|
satya yakhana tAdera nikaTa eseche tArA tA pratyAkhyAna kareche| yA niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata tAra yathArtha saMvAda acirei tAdera nikaTa peৗ~chAve|

tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAdera pUrve kata mAnavagoSThIke vinAza karechi? tAderake duniYAYa emanabhAve pratiSThita karechilAma yemanaTi tomAderakeo kari nAi evaM tAdera opara muSaladhAre vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma, Ara tAdera pAdadeze nadI pravAhita karechilAma; erapara tAdera pApera daruna tAderake vinAza karechi evaM tAdera pare apara mAnavagoSThI sRSTi karechi|
Ami yadi tomAra prati kAgaje likhita kitAvao nAyila karatAma Ara tArA yadi oTA hAta diYe sparzao karata tavuo kAphiragaNa valata, ‘eTA spaSTa jAdu vyatIta Ara kichui naYa|’
tArA vale, ‘tAra nikaTa kona pherezatA kena prerita haYa nA?’ yadi Ami pherezatA preraNa karatAma tA hale cUr3Anta phaYasAlAi to haYe yeta; Ara tAderake kona avakAza deoYA hata nA|
yadi tAke pherezatA karatAma tave tAke mAnuSera AkRtitei preraNa karatAma; Ara tAderake serUpa vibhrame phelatAma, yerUpa vibhrame tArA ekhana raYeche|
tomAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlakei ThATTA-vidrupa karA haYeche| tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karachila pariNAme tAi vidrupakArIderake pariveSTana kareche|
vala, ‘tomarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara, erapara dekha, yArA satyake asvIkAra kareche tAdera pariNAma kI haYechila|’

vala, ‘AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache tA kAra?’ vala, ‘AllAh ra i’, daYA karA tini tA~ra kartavya vale sthira karechena| kiYAmatera dina tini tomAderake avazyai ekatra karavena- ete konai sandeha nei| yArA nijerAi nijedera kSati kareche tArA ImAna Anave nA|
rAtri o divase yA kichu thAke tA tA~rai evaM tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

vala, ‘Ami ki AsamAna o yamInera sraSTA AllAh vyatIta anyake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karava? tinii AhArya dAna karena kintu tA~ke keu AhArya dAna kare nA’; evaM vala, ‘Ami AdiSTa haYechi yena AtmasamarpaNakArIdera madhye Ami prathama vyakti hai’; AmAke Arao AjJA karA haYeche, ‘tumi muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|’
vala, ‘Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhyatA kari tave Ami bhaYa kari mahAdinera zAstira|
‘sei dina yAke tA hate rakSA karA have tAra prati tini to daYA karavena evaM eTAi spaSTa saphalatA|’
AllAh tomAke kleza dile tini vyatIta tA mocanakArI Ara keu nei| Ara tini tomAra kalyANa karale tave tinii to sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
tini Apana vAndAdera opara parAkramazAlI, tini prajJAmaYa, jJAtA|

vala, ‘sAkSyate sarvazreSTha viSaYa kI?’ vala, ‘AllAh AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI evaM ei kuraAna AmAra nikaTa prerita haYeche yena tomAderake evaM yAra nikaTa eTA peৗ~chive tAderake ediYe Ami satarka kari| tomarA ki ei sAkSya dAo ye, AllAh ra saGge anya ilAho Ache? vala, ‘Ami se sAkSya dei nA|’ vala, ‘tini to eka ilAh evaM tomarA ye zarIka kara tA hate Ami avazyai nirlipta|’
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA tAke serUpa cene yerUpa cene tAdera santAnagaNake| yArA nijerAi nijedera kSati kareche, tArA vizvAsa karave nA|
ye vyakti AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA kare vA tA~ra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna kare tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? jAlimarA Adau saphalakAma haYa nA|
smaraNa kara, yedina tAdera sakalake ekatra karava, erapara muzarikaderake valiva, ‘yAderake tomarA AmAra zarIka mane karate, tArA kothAYa?’
erapara tAdera eTA chAr3A valAra anya kona ajuhAta thAkave nA: ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAh ra zapatha! AmarA to muzarikai chilAma nA|’
dekha, tArA nijedera prati kirUpa mithyA Aropa kare Ara ye mithyA tArA racanA karata tA kibhAve tAdera nikaTa hate udhAo haYe gela!

tAdera madhye kataka tomAra dike kAna pete rAkhe, kintu Ami tAdera antarera opara AvaraNa diYechi yena tArA tA upalavdhi karate nA pAre; tAderake vadhira karechi Ara samasta nidarzana pratyakSa karaleo tArA ete ImAna Anave nA; emanaki tArA yakhana tomAra nikaTa upasthita haYe vitarke lipta haYa takhana kAphiragaNa vale, ‘eTA to pUrvavartIdera upakathA vyatIta Ara kichui naYa|’
tArA anyake tA zonAte virata rAkhe evaM nijerAo tA hate dUre thAke, Ara tArA nijerAi zudhu nijederake dhvaMsa kare, athaca tArA upalavdhi kare nA|

tumi yadi dekhate pete yakhana tAderake dojakhera pArzve dA~r3a karAna have Ara tArA valave, ‘hAYa! yadi AmAdera pratyAvartana ghaTata tave AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanake asvIkAra karatAma nA evaM AmarA mu’minadera antarbhukta hatAma!’
nA, pUrve tArA yA gopana karata tA ekhana tAdera nikaTa prakAza peYeche evaM tArA pratyAvartita haleo yA karate tAderake niSedha karA haYechila punarAYa tArA tAi karata Ara nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|
tArA vale, ‘AmAdera pArthiva jIvanai ekamAtra jIvana evaM AmarA punarutthitao hava nA|’

tumi yadi dekhate pete tAderake yakhana tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane dA~r3a karAna have Ara tini valavena, ‘eTA ki prakRta satya naYa?’ tArA valave, ‘AmAdera pratipAlakera zapatha! nizcaYai satya|’ tini valavena, ‘tave tomarA ye kupharI karate tAra janye tomarA ekhana zAsti bhoga kara|’

yArA AllAh ra sammukhIna haoYAke mithyA valeche tArA avazyai kSatigrasta haYeche, emanaki akasmAt tAdera nikaTa yakhana kiYAmata upasthita have takhana tArA valave, ‘hAYa! eke AmarA ye avahelA karechi tAra janye AkSepa!’ tArA tAdera pRSThe nijedera pApa vahana karave; dekha, tArA yA vahana karave tA ati nikRSTa!
pArthiva jIvana to krIr3A-kautuka vyatIta Ara kichui naYa Ara yArA tAkoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janye AkhirAtera AvAsai zreYa; tomarA ki anudhAvana kara nA?
Ami avazya jAni ye, tArA yA vale tA tomAke nizcitai kaSTa deYa; kintu tArA tomAke to mithyAvAdI vale nA; varaM jAlimerA AllAh ra AYAtake asvIkAra kare|

tomAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlake avazyai mithyAvAdI valA haYechila; kintu tAderake mithyAvAdI valA o kleza deoYA sattveo tArA dhairya dhAraNa karechila ye paryanta nA AmAra sAhAyya tAdera nikaTa eseche| AllAh ra Adeza keu parivartana karate pAre nA, rAsUlagaNera samvandhe kichu saMvAda to tomAra nikaTa eseche|

yadi tAdera upekSA tomAra nikaTa kaSTakara haYa tave pArale bhUgarbhe sur3aGga vA AkAzera sopAna ane¦SaNa kara evaM tAdera nikaTa kona nidarzana Ana| AllAh icchA karale tAdera sakalake avazyai satpathe ekatra karatena| sutarAM tumi mUrkhadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
yArA zone zudhu tArAi DAke sAr3A deYa| Ara mRtake AllAh punarjIvita karavena; erapara tA~ra dikei tArA pratyAnIta have|
tArA vale, ‘tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tAra nikaTa kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ vala, ‘nidarzana nAyila karate AllAh avazyai sakSama,’ kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

bhUpRSThe vicaraNazIla jIva o nija DAnAra sAhAyye ur3anta pAkhi-tArA sakale tomAdera matai eka-ekaTi jAti| kitAve kona kichui Ami vAda dei nAi; erapara svIYa pratipAlakera dike tAderake ekatra karA have|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare tArA vadhira o mUka, andhakAre raYeche| yAke icchA AllAh vipathagAmI karena Ara yAke icchA tini sarala pathe sthApana karena|
vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekha ye, AllAh ra zAsti tomAdera opara Apatita hale vA tomAdera nikaTa kiYAmata upasthita hale tomarA ki AllAh vyatIta anya kAukeo DAkave, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao?
‘nA, tomarA zudhu tA~kei DAkave, tomarA ye duHkhera janye tA~ke DAkacha tini icchA karale tomAdera sei duHkha dUra karavena Ara yAke tomarA tA~ra zarIka karate, tA tomarA vismRta have|’
tomAra pUrveo Ami vahu jAtira nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechi; erapara tAderake arthasaMkaTa o duHkha-kleza diYe pIr3ita karechi, yAte tArA vinIta haYa|
AmAra zAsti yakhana tAdera opara Apatita hala takhana tArA kena vinIta hala nA? adhikantu tAdera hRdaYa kaThina haYechila evaM tArA yA karachila zaYatAna tA tAdera dRSTite zobhana karechila|

tAderake ye upadeza deoYA haYechila tArA yakhana tA vismRta hala takhana Ami tAdera janye samasta kichura dvAra unmukta kare dilAma; avazeSe tAderake yA deoYA hala yakhana tArA tAte ullasita hala takhana akasmAt tAderake dharalAma; phale takhani tArA nirAza hala|
erapara jAlima sampradAYera mUloccheda karA hala evaM samasta prazaMsA AllAh ra i- yini jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|

vala, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, AllAh yadi tomAdera zonezakti o dRSTizakti ker3e nena evaM tomAdera hRdaYa mohara kare dena tave AllAh vyatIta kon ilAh Ache ye tomAderake eiguli phiriYe dive?’ dekha, Ami kirUpe AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA kari; etadasattveo tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
vala, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, AllAh ra zAsti akasmAt vA prakAzye tomAdera opara Apatita hale jAlima sampradAYa vyatIta Ara keu dhvaMsa have ki?’
Ami rAsUlagaNake to zudhu susaMvAdavAhI o satarkakArIrUpei preraNa kari| keu ImAna Anale o nijake saMzodhana karale tAra kona bhaYa nei Ara se duHkhitao have nA|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valeche satya tyAgera janye tAdera opara zAsti Apatita have|

vala, ‘Ami tomAderake eTA vali nA ye, AmAra nikaTa AllAh ra dhanabhANDAra Ache, adRzya samvandheo Ami avagata nai; evaM tomAderake eTAo vali nA ye, Ami pherezatA; AmAra prati yA ohI haYa Ami zudhu tArai anusaraNa kari| vala, ‘andha o cakSuSmAna ki samAna?’ tomarA ki anudhAvana kara nA?

tumi eTA diYe tAderake satarka kare dAo yArA bhaYa kare ye, tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa samaveta karA have emana avasthAYa ye, tini vyatIta tAdera kona abhibhAvaka vA supArizakArI thAkave nA; haYata tArA sAvadhAna have|

yArA tAdera pratipAlakake sakAle o sandhyAYa tA~ra santuSTi lAbhArthe DAke tAderake tumi vitAr3ita kara nA| tAdera karmera javAvadihira dAYitva tomAra naYa Ara tomAra kona karmera javAvadihira dAYitva tAdera naYa ye, tumi tAderake vitAr3ita karave; karale tumi jAlimadera antarbhukta have|
Ami ebhAve tAdera ekadalake anyadala diYe parIkSA karechi yena tArA vale, ‘AmAdera madhye ki edera pratii AllAh anugraha karalena?’ AllAh ki kRtajJa lokadera samvandhe savizeSa avahita nana?

yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna Ane tArA yakhana tomAra nikaTa Ase takhana tAderake tumi vala: ‘tomAdera prati zAnti varSita hoka’, tomAdera pratipAlaka daYA karA tA~ra kartavya vale sthira karechena| tomAdera madhye keu ajJatAvazata yadi manda kAja kare, erapara taovA kare Ara saMzodhana kare tave to AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ebhAve Ami AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA kari; Ara ete aparAdhIdera patha spaSTabhAve prakAza pAYa|

vala, ‘tomarA AllAh vyatIta yAderake AhvAna kara tAdera ‘ivAdata karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche| vala, ‘Ami tomAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kari nA; karale Ami vipathagAmI hava evaM satpathaprAptadera antarbhukta thAkava nA|’

vala, ‘avazyai Ami AmAra pratipAlakera spaSTa pramANera opara pratiSThita; athaca tomarA eTAke pratyAkhyAna karecha| tomarA yA satvara cAicho tA AmAra nikaTa nei| kartRtva to AllAh ra i; tini satya vivRta karena evaM phaYasAlAkArIdera madhye tinii zreSTha|’
vala, ‘tomarA yA satvara cAicho tA yadi AmAra nikaTa thAkata tave AmAra o tomAdera madhyakAra vyApAre to phaYasAlAi haYe yeta Ara AllAh jAlimadera samvandhe savizeSa avahita|’

adRzyera kuJji tA~rai nikaTa Ache, tini vyatIta anya keu tA jAne nA| jale o sthale yA kichu Ache tA tinii avagata, tA~ra ajJAtasAre ekaTi pAtAo par3e nA| mRttikAra andhakAre emana kona zasyakaNAo aMkurita haYa nA vA rasayukta kiMvA zuSka emana kona vastu nei yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|

tinii rAtrikAle tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna Ara divase tomarA yA kara tA tini jAnena| erapara divase tomAderake tini punarjAgarita karena yAte nirdhArita kAla pUrNa haYa| erapara tA~ra dikei tomAdera pratyAvartana| anantara tomarA yA kara se samvandhe tomAderake tini avahita karavena|

tinii svIYa vAndAdera opara parAkramazAlI Ara tinii tomAdera rakSaka preraNa karena| avazeSe yakhana tomAdera kArao mRtyu upasthita haYa takhana AmAra preritarA tAra mRtyu ghaTAYa Ara tArA kona truTi kare nA|
erapara tAdera prakRta pratipAlaka AllAh ra dike tArA pratyAnIta haYa| dekha, kartRtva to tA~rai Ara hiseva grahaNe tinii sarvApekSA tatpara|

vala, ‘ke tomAderake trANa kare sthalabhAgera o samudrera andhakAra hate yakhana tomarA kAtarabhAve o gopane tA~ra nikaTa anunaYa kara?’ AmAderake eTA hate trANa karale AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava|’
vala, ‘AllAhi tomAderake tA hate evaM samasta duHkhakaSTa hate paritrANa karena| etadasattveo tomarA tA~ra zarIka kara|’

vala, ‘tomAdera Urdhvadeza vA pAdadeza hate zAsti preraNa karate, vA tomAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta karate vA eka dalake apara dalera saMgharSera AsvAda grahaNa karAte tinii sakSama|’ dekha, Ami kirUpe vibhinna prakAre AYAtasamUha vivRta kari yAte tArA anudhAvana kare|
tomAra sampradAYa to eke mithyA valeche athaca eTA satya| vala, ‘Ami tomAdera kAryanirvAhaka nai|’
pratyeka vArtAra janye nirdhArita kAla Ache evaM zIghrai tomarA avahita have|

tumi yakhana dekha, tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha samvandhe upahAsamUlaka AlocanAYa magna haYa takhana tumi tAdera hate sare par3ave, ye paryanta nA tArA anya prasaGge pravRtta haYa Ara zaYatAna yadi tomAke bhrame phele tave smaraNa haoYAra pare jAlima sampradAYera saGge vasave nA|
odera karmera javAvadihira dAYitva tAdera naYa yArA tAkoYA avalamvana kare| tave upadeza deoYA tAdera kartavya yAte tArAo tAkoYA avalamvana kare|

yArA tAdera dInake krIr3A-kautukarUpe grahaNa kare Ara pArthiva jIvana yAderake pratArita kare tumi tAdera saGga varjana kara evaM eTA diYe tAderake upadeza dAo, yAte keu nija kRtakarmera janye dhvaMsa nA haYa, yakhana AllAh vyatIta tAra kona abhibhAvaka o supArizakArI thAkave nA evaM vinimaYe sava kichu dileo tA gRhIta have nA| erAi nijedera kRtakarmera janye dhvaMsa have; kupharIra kAraNe edera janye raYeche atyuSNa pAnIYa o marmantuda zAsti|

vala, ‘AllAh vyatIta AmarA ki emana kichuke DAkava yA AmAdera kona upakAra kiMvA apakAra karate pAre nA? ‘AllAh AmAderake satpatha pradarzanera para AmarA ki sei vyaktira nyAYa pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAva yAke zaYatAna duniYAYa patha bhuliYe haYarAna kareche, yadio tAra sahacaragaNa tAke Thika pathe AhvAna kare vale, ‘AmAdera nikaTa Asa?’ vala, ‘AllAh ra pathai to patha Ara AmarA AdiSTa haYechi jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karate,
‘evaM sAlAta kAYema karate o tA~ke bhaYa karate; Ara tA~rai nikaTa tomAderake samaveta karA have|’

tinii yathAvidhi AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena| yakhana tini valena, ‘hao’ takhanai haYe yAYa| tA~ra kathAi satya| yedina ziMgAYa phutkAra deoYA have sedinakAra kartRtva to tA~rai| adRzya o dRzya savakichu samvandhe tini parijJAta; Ara tinii prajJAmaYa savizeSa avahita|
smaraNa kara, ivrAhIma tAra pitA Ayarake valechila, ‘Apani ki mUrtike ilAha rUpe grahaNa karena? Ami to ApanAke o ApanAra sampradAYake spaSTa bhrAntite dekhatechi|’
eibhAve Ami ivrAhImake AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra paricAlana-vyavasthA dekhAi, yAte se nizcita vizvAsIdera antarbhukta haYa|

erapara rAtrira andhakAra yakhana tAke Acchanna karala takhana se nakSatra dekhe valala, ‘eTAi AmAra pratipAlaka|’ erapara yakhana oTA astamita hala takhana se valala, ‘yA astamita haYa tA Ami pachanda kari nA|’

erapara yakhana se cA~dake samujjvala rUpe udita hate dekhala takhana valala, ‘eTA AmAra pratipAlaka|’ yakhana eTAo astamita hala takhana valala, ‘AmAke AmAra pratipAlaka satpatha pradarzana nA karale Ami avazyai pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta hava|’

erapara yakhana se sUryake dIptimAnarUpe udita hate dekhala takhana valala, ‘eTA AmAra pratipAlaka, eTA sarvavRhat| yakhana eTAo astamita hala, takhana se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA yAke AllAh ra zarIka kara tAra saGge AmAra kona saMzrava nei|
‘Ami ekaniSThabhAve tA~ra dike mukha phirAcchi yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena Ara Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai|’

tAra sampradAYa tAra saGge vitarke lipta hala| se valala, ‘tomarA ki AllAh samvandhe AmAra saGge vitarke lipta have? tini to AmAke satpathe paricAlita karechena| AmAra pratipAlaka anyavidha icchA nA karale tomarA yAke tA~ra zarIka kara tAke Ami bhaYa kari nA, sava kichui AmAra pratipAlakera jJAnAYatta, tave ki tomarA anudhAvana karave nA?

‘tomarA yAke AllAh ra zarIka kara Ami tAke kirUpe bhaYa karava? athaca tomarA AllAh ra zarIka karate bhaYa kara nA, ye viSaYe tini tomAderake kona sanada dena nAi| sutarAM yadi tomarA jAna tave vala, dui dalera madhye kon dala nirApattA lAbhera vezi hakdAra|’
yArA ImAna eneche Ara tAdera ImAnake juluma diYe kaluSita kare nAi, nirApattA tAderai janye Ara tArAi satpathaprApta|
Ara eTA AmAra yukti-pramANa yA ivrAhImake diYechilAma tAra sampradAYera mukAvilAYa; Ami yAke icchA maryAdAYa unnIta kari| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

Ara Ami tAke dAna karechilAma isahAka o iYA‘ka‚va, edera pratyekake satpathe paricAlita karechilAma; pUrve nUhkeo satpathe paricAlita karechilAma evaM tAra vaMzadhara dAUda, sulAYamAna o Aiuva, iusupha, mUsA o hArUnakeo; Ara ebhAvei satkarmaparAYaNadera puraskRta kari;
evaM yAkAriYA, iYAhiYA, ‘IsA o ilYAsakeo satpathe paricAlita karechilAma| erA sakale sajjanadera antarbhukta;
Arao satpathe paricAlita karechilAma isamAIla, Al-YAsA‘A, iYUnus o lUtake; Ara zreSThatva dAna karechilAma vizvajagatera opara pratyekake-
Ara edera pitRpuruSa, vaMzadhara o bhrAtRvRndera kaYekajanake| Ami tAderake manonIta karechilAma evaM sarala pathe paricAlita karechilAma|
eTA AllAh ra hidAYAta; nija vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA tini eTA diYe satpathe paricAlita karena| tArA yadi ziraka karata tave tAdera kRtakarma niSphala hatai|

Ami oderake kitAva, kartRtva o navUoYAta dAna karechi, erapara yadi erA eigulike pratyAkhyAnao kare tave Ami to emana eka sampradAYera prati egulira bhAra arpaNa karechi yArA eguli pratyAkhyAna karave nA|
tAderakei AllAh satpathe paricAlita karechena, sutarAM tumi tAdera pathera anusaraNa kara| vala, ‘era janye Ami tomAdera nikaTa pArizramika cAi nA, eTA to zudhu vizvajagatera janye upadeza|’

tArA AllAh ra yathArtha maryAdA upalavdhi kare nAi yakhana tArA vale, ‘AllAh mAnuSera nikaTa kichui nAyila karena nAi|’ vala, ‘ke nAyila karechena mUsAra AnIta kitAva yA mAnuSera janye Alo o pathanirdeza chila, tA tomarA vibhinna pRSThAYa lipivaddha kare kichu prakAza kara o yAra anekAMza gopana rAkha evaM yA tomAdera pitRpuruSagaNa o tomarA jAnate nA tAo zikSA deoYA haYechila? vala, ‘AllAhi’; erapara tAderake tAdera nirarthaka AlocanArUpa khelAYa magna hate dAo|

Ami e kalyANamaYa kitAva nAyila karechi yA era pUrvekAra kitAvera pratyAYanakArI evaM yA diYe tumi makkA o tAra catuSpArzvera lokaderake satarka kara| yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare tArA ete vizvAsa kare evaM tArA tAdera sAlAtera hiphAyata kare|

tAra ceYe var3a jAlima Ara ke, ye AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA kare kiMvA vale, ‘AmAra nikaTa ohI haYa,’ yadio tAra prati nAyila haYa nA evaM ye vale, ‘AllAh yA nAyila karechena Amio oTAra anurUpa nAyila karava?’ yadi tumi dekhate pete yakhana jAlimarA mRtyuyantraNAYa thAkave evaM pherezatAgaNa hAta vAr3iYe valave, ‘tomAdera prANa vera kara! tomarA AllAh samvandhe anyAYa valate o tA~ra vidhAna samvandhe auddhatya prakAza karate, sejanye Aja tomAderake avamAnanAkara zAsti deoYA have|’

tomarA to AmAra nikaTa niHsaMga avasthAYa esecho, yemana Ami prathame tomAderake sRSTi karechilAma; tomAderake yA diYechilAma tA tomarA pazcAte pheliYA esecho, tomarA yAderake tomAdera vyApAre zarIka mane karate| tomAdera sei supArizakArigaNakeo tomAdera saGge dekhachi nA; tomAdera madhyakAra samparka avazyai chinna haYeche Ara tomarA yA dhAraNA karechile tAo niSphala haYeche|
AllAhi zasya-vIja o A~Ti aMkurita karena, tinii prANahIna hate jIvantake vera karena Ara jIvanta hate prANahInake vera karena| tinii to AllAh; sutarAM tomarA kothAYa phire yAve?
tinii USAra unmeSa ghaTAna, tinii vizrAmera janye rAtri Ara gaNanAra janye sUrya o candra sRSTi karechena; e savai parAkramazAlI sarvajJera nirUpaNa|
tinii tomAdera janye nakSatra sRSTi karechena yena tA diYe sthalera o samudrera andhakAre tomarA patha pAo| jJAnI sampradAYera janye Ami to nidarzana vizadabhAve vivRta karechi|
tinii tomAderake ekai vyakti hate sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janye dIrgha o svalpakAlIna vAsasthAna Ache| anudhAvanakArI sampradAYera janye Ami to nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta karechi|

tinii AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena, erapara tA diYe Ami sarvaprakAra udbhidera cArA udgama kari; anantara tA hate savuja pAtA udgata kari, pare oTA hate ghana sanniviSTa zasyadAnA utpAdana kari, Ara khejuravRkSera mAthi hate jhulanta kA~di vera kari Ara AMgurera udyAna sRSTi kari evaM yAYatUna o dAr3imvao| erA eke anyera sadRza Ara visadRzao| lakSya kara era phalera prati, yakhana tA phalavAna haYa Ara ora paripakvatA prAptira prati| mu’mina sampradAYera janye ote avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
tArA jinake AllAh ra zarIka kare, athaca tinii ederake sRSTi karechena Ara tArA ajJatAvazata AllAh ra prati putra-kanyA Aropa kare; tini pavitra- mahimAnvita! Ara erA yA vale tini tAra Urdhve|
tini AsamAna o yamInera sraSTA, tA~ra santAna have kirUpe? tA~ra to kona strI nei| tinii to samasta kichu sRSTi karechena Ara pratyeka vastu samvandhe tinii savizeSa avahita|
tinii to AllAh, tomAdera pratipAlaka; tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei| tinii sava kichura sraSTA; sutarAM tomarA tA~ra ‘ivAdata kara; tini sava kichura tattvAvadhAYaka|
dRSTi tA~ke avadhAraNa karate pAre nA; kintu tini avadhAraNa karena sakala dRSTi Ara tinii sUkSmadarzI, samyaka parijJAta|

tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANa avazyai eseche| sutarAM keu oTA dekhale tA diYe se nijei lAbhavAna have; Ara keu nA dekhale tAte se nijei kSatigrasta have| Ami tomAdera saMrakSaka nai|
Ami ebhAve nidarzanAvalI vibhinna prakAre vivRta kari| phale, orA vale, ‘tumi par3e niYecha?’ kintu Ami to suspaSTabhAve vivRta kari jJAnI sampradAYera janye|
tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA ohI haYa tumi tArai anusaraNa kara, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei Ara muzarikadera hate mukha phiriYe nAo|
AllAh yadi icchA karatena tave tArA ziraka karata nA evaM tomAke tAdera janye rakSaka niyukta kari nAi; Ara tumi tAdera abhibhAvakao nao|

AllAhke cher3e yAderake tArA DAke tAderake tomarA gAli dio nA| kenanA tArA sImAlaMghana kare ajJAnatAvazata AllAhkeo gAli dive| ebhAve Ami pratyeka jAtira dRSTite tAdera kAryakalApa suzobhana karechi; erapara tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tAdera pratyAvartana| anantara tini tAderake tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe avahita karavena|

tArA AllAh ra nAme kaThina zapatha kare vale, tAdera nikaTa yadi kona nidarzana Asata tave avazyai tArA ete ImAna Anata| vala, ‘nidarzana to AllAh ra ikhtiYArabhukta|’ tAdera nikaTa nidarzana Asaleo tArA ye ImAna Anave nA eTA kibhAve tomAdera vodhagamya karAna yAve?
tArA yemana prathamavAra ete ImAna Ane nAi temani Amio tAdera manobhAvera o dRSTibhaGgira parivartana kare diva Ara tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa udbhrAntera mato ghure ver3Ate diva|

Ami tAdera nikaTa phirizatA preraNa karaleo evaM mRtarA tAdera sAthe kathA valaleo evaM sakala vastuke tAdera sammukhe hAyira karaleo yadi AllAh icchA nA karena tave tArA ImAna Anave nA; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai ajJa|

eirUpe Ami mAnava o jinera madhye zaYatAnadigake pratyeka navIra zatru karechi, pratAraNAra uddezye tAdera eke anyake camakaprada vAkya dvArA prarocita kare| yadi tomAra pratipAlaka icchA karatena tave tArA ihA karata nA; sutarAM tumi tAhAgadike o tAdera mithyA racanAke varjana kara|
Ara tArA ei uddezye prarocita kare ye, yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tAdera mana yena era prati anurAgI haYa evaM ete yena tArA parituSTa haYa Ara tArA ye apakarma kare tAi yena tArA karate thAke|

vala, ‘tave ki Ami AllAh vyatIta anyake sAlisa mAnava-yadio tinii tomAdera prati suspaSTa kitAva avatIrNa karechena!’ Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA jAne ye, eTA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate satyasaha avatIrNa haYeche| sutarAM tumi sandihAnadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
satya o nyAYera dika diYe tomAra pratipAlakera vANI paripUrNa| tA~ra vAkya parivartana karAra keu nei| Ara tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yadi tumi duniYAra adhikAMza lokera kathAmata cala tave tArA tomAke AllAh ra patha hate vicyuta karave| tArA to zudhu anumAnera anusaraNa kare; Ara tArA zudhu anumAnabhittika kathA vale|
tA~ra patha cher3e ke vipathagAmI haYa se samvandhe tomAra pratipAlaka to savizeSa avahita evaM satpathe yArA Ache tAo tini savizeSa avahita|
tomarA tA~ra vidhAne vizvAsI hale yAte AllAh ra nAma neoYA haYeche tA hate AhAra kara;

tomAdera kI haYeche ye, yAte AllAh ra nAma neoYA haYeche tomarA tA hate AhAra karave nA? yA tomAdera janye tini hArAma karechena tA tini vizadabhAvei tomAdera nikaTa vivRta karechena, tave tomarA nirupAYa hale tA svatantra| aneke ajJAnatAvazata nijedera kheYAla-khuzi diYe avazyai anyake vipathagAmI kare; nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka sImAlaMghanakArIdera samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
tomarA prakAzya o gopana pApa varjana kara; yArA pApa kare tAderake acirei tAdera pApera samucita zAsti deoYA have|

yAte AllAh ra nAma neoYA haYa nAi tAra kichui tomarA AhAra kara nA; eTA avazyai pApa| nizcaYai zaYatAnerA tAdera vandhuderake tomAdera saGge vivAda karate prarocanA deYa; yadi tomarA tAdera kathAmata cala tave tomarA avazyai muzarika have|

ye vyakti mRta chila, yAke Ami pare jIvita karechi Ara yAke mAnuSera madhye calAra janye Aloka diYechi sei vyakti ki ai vyaktira nyAYa, ye andhakAre raYeche Ara sei sthAna hate vera haoYAra naYa? eirUpe kAphiradera dRSTite tAdera kRtakarma zobhana kare deoYA haYeche|
eirUpe Ami pratyeka janapade sekhAnakAra aparAdhIdera pradhAnake sekhAne cakrAnta karAra avakAza diYechi; kintu tArA zudhu tAdera nijedera viruddhe cakrAnta kare; athaca tArA upalavdhi kare nA|

yakhana tAdera nikaTa kona nidarzana Ase tArA takhana vale, ‘AllAh ra rAsUlagaNake yA deoYA haYechila AmAderakeo tA nA deoYA paryanta AmarA kakhanao vizvAsa karava nA|’ AllAh tA~ra risAlAtera dAYitva kAra opara arpaNa karavena tA tinii bhAla jAnena| yArA aparAdha kareche, cakrAntera janye AllAh ra nikaTa hate lAJchanA o kaThora zAsti tAdera opara Apatita havei|

AllAh kAukeo satpathe paricAlita karate icchA karale tini tAra vakSa isalAmera janye prazasta kare dena Ara kAukeo vipathagAmI karate icchA karale tini tAra vakSa atizaYa saMkIrNa kare dena; tAra kAche isalAma anusaraNa AkAze ArohaNera matai duHsAdhya haYe par3e| yArA vizvAsa kare nA AllAh tAderake eibhAve lAJchita karena|
eTAi tomAra pratipAlaka-nirdezita sarala patha| yArA upadeza grahaNa kare Ami tAdera janye nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta karechi|
tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tAdera janye Ache zAntira AvAsa evaM tArA yA karata tAra janye tinii tAdera abhibhAvaka|

yedina tini tAdera sakalake ekatra karavena Ara valavena, ‘he jina sampradAYa! tomarA to aneka lokake tomAdera anugAmI karechile’ evaM mAnava samAjera madhye tAdera vandhugaNa valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera madhye kataka aparake diYe lAbhavAna haYeche Ara tumi AmAdera janye ye samaYa nirdhAraNa karechile ekhana AmarA tAte upanIta haYechi|’ sedina AllAh valavena, ‘jAhAnnAmai tomAdera vAsasthAna, tomarA sekhAne sthAYI have,’ yadi nA AllAh anya rakama icchA karena| tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai prajJAmaYa, savizeSa avahita|
eibhAve odera kRtakarmera janye Ami jAlimadera ekadalake anyadalera vandhu kare thAki|

Ami tAderake valava, ‘he jina o mAnava sampradAYa! tomAdera madhya hate ki rAsUlagaNa tomAdera nikaTa Ase nAi-yArA AmAra nidarzana tomAdera nikaTa vivRta karata Ara tomAderake ei dinera sammukhIna haoYA samvandhe satarka karata?’ tArA valave, ‘AmarA AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya dilAma|’ vastuta pArthiva jIvana tAderake pratArita karechila, Ara tArA nijedera viruddhe e sAkSyao dive ye, tArA kAphira chila|
eTA ekAraNe ye, adhivAsIvRnda yakhana anavahita, takhana kona janapadake tAra anyAYa AcaraNera janye dhvaMsa karA tomAra pratipAlakera kAja naYa|
pratyeke yA kare se anusAre tAra sthAna Ache evaM erA yA kare se samvandhe tomAra pratipAlaka anavahita nana|

tomAra pratipAlaka abhAvamukta, daYAzIla| tini icchA karale tomAderake apasArita karate evaM tomAdera pare yAke icchA tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karate pArena-yemana tomAderake tini anya eka sampradAYera vaMza hate sRSTi karechena|
tomAdera saGge yA oYAdA karA haYeche tA vAstavAYita havei, tomarA tA vyartha karate pArave nA|
vala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA yekhAne yA karacho, karate thAka; Amio AmAra kAja karachi| tomarA zIghrai jAnate pArave, kAra pariNAma maGgalamaYa| jAlimagaNa kakhanao saphalakAma have nA|’

AllAh ye zasya o gavAdipazu sRSTi karechena tAra madhya hate tArA AllAh ra janye eka aMza nirdiSTa kare o nijedera dhAraNA anuyAYI vale, ‘eTA AllAh ra janye Ara eTA AmAdera devatAdera janye|’ yA tAdera devatAdera aMza tA AllAh ra kAche peৗ~chAYa nA evaM yA AllAh ra aMza tA tAdera devatAdera kAche peৗ~chAYa, tArA yA mImAMsA kare tA nikRSTa!

eibhAve tAdera devatArA vahu muzarikera dRSTite tAdera santAnadera hatyAke zobhana kareche tAdera dhvaMsa sAdhanera janye evaM tAdera dharma samvandhe tAdera vibhrAnti sRSTira janye; AllAh icchA karale tArA eTA karata nA| sutarAM tAderake tAdera mithyA niYe thAkate dAo|

tArA tAdera dhAraNA anusAre vale, ‘esava gavAdipazu o zasyakSetra niSiddha; AmarA yAke icchA kari se vyatIta keu eisava AhAra karate pArave nA’, evaM kataka gavAdipazura pRSThe ArohaNa niSiddha karA haYeche evaM kataka pazu yaveh karAra samaYa tArA AllAh ra nAma neYa nA| e samastai tArA AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanAra uddezye vale; tAdera e mithyA racanAra pratiphala tini avazyai tAderake divena|

tArA Arao vale, ‘esava gavAdipazura garbhe yA Ache tA AmAdera puruSadera janye nirdiSTa Ara eTA AmAdera strIdera janye avaidha; Ara tA yadi mRta haYa tave sakalei ete aMzIdAra|’ tini tAdera eirUpa valAra pratiphala acirei tAderake divena| nizcaYai tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

yArA nirvuddhitAra daruna o ajJAnatAvazata nijedera santAnadera hatyA kare evaM AllAh-pradatta jIvikAke AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA karAra uddezye niSiddha gaNya kare tArA to kSatigrasta haYeche| tArA avazyai vipathagAmI haYeche Ara tArA satpathaprApta chila nA|

tinii latA o vRkSa-udyAnasamUha sRSTi karechena evaM khejura vRkSa, vibhinna svAda-viziSTa khAdyazasya, yAYatUna o dAr3imvao sRSTi karechena-eguli eke anyera sadRza o visadRzao| yakhana oTA phalavAna haYa takhana ora phala AhAra karave Ara phasala tulavAra dine ora haka pradAna karave Ara apacaYa karave nA; nizcaYai tini apacaYakArIdera pachanda karena nA|

gavAdipazura madhye kataka bhAravAhI o kataka kSudrAkAra pazu sRSTi karechena| AllAh yA riyikarUpe tomAderake diYechena tA hate AhAra kara Ara zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa kara nA; se to tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

nara o mAdI ATaTi: meSera du’Ti o chAgalera du’Ti; vala, ‘nara du’Tii ki tini niSiddha karechena kiMvA mAdI du’Tii vA mAdI du’Tira garbhe yA Ache tA? tomarA satyavAdI hale pramANasaha AmAke avahita kara;’

Ara uTera du’Ti o garura du’Ti| vala, ‘nara du’Tii ki tini niSiddha karechena kiMvA mAdI du’Tii vA mAdI du’Tira garbhe yA Ache tA? Ara AllAh yakhana tomAderake eisava nirdeza dAna karena takhana ki tomarA upasthita chile?’ sutarAM ye vyakti ajJAnatAvazata mAnuSake vibhrAnta karAra janye AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA kare tAra ceYe adhika jAlima Ara ke? AllAh to jAlima sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

vala, ‘AmAra prati ye ohI haYeche tAte, loke yA AhAra kare tAra madhye Ami kichui hArAma pAi nA-mRta, vahamAna rakta o zUkarera mAMsa vyatIta| kenanA eguli avazyai apavitra vA yA avaidha, AllAh chAr3A anyera nAme utsargera kAraNe|’ tave keu avAdhya nA haYe evaM sImAlaMghana nA kare nirupAYa haYe oTA AhAra karale tomAra pratipAlaka to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ami iYAha‚dIdera janye nakharayukta samasta pazu hArAma karechilAma evaM garu o chAgalera carvio tAdera janye hArAma karechilAma; tave eigulira piThera vA antrera kiMvA asthisaMlagna carvi vyatIta, tAdera avAdhyatAra daruna tAderake ei pratiphala diYechilAma| nizcaYai Ami satyavAdI|
erapara yadi tArA tomAke pratyAkhyAna kare tave vala, ‘tomAdera pratipAlaka sarvavyApI daYAra mAlika Ara aparAdhI sampradAYera opara hate tA~ra zAsti rada karA haYa nA|’

yArA ziraka kareche tArA valave, ‘AllAh yadi icchA karatena tave AmarA o AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNa ziraka karatAma nA evaM kona kichui hArAma karatAma nA|’ eibhAve tAdera pUrvavartIrA pratyAkhyAna karechila, avazeSe tArA AmAra zAsti bhoga karechila, vala, ‘tomAdera nikaTa kona yukti Ache ki? thAkale AmAra nikaTa tA peza kara; tomarA zudhu kalpanArai anusaraNa kara Ara zudhu managar3A kathA vala|’
vala, ‘cUr3Anta pramANa to AllAh ra i; tini yadi icchA karatena tave tomAdera sakalake avazyai satpathe paricAlita karatena|’

vala, ‘AllAh ye eTA niSiddha karechena e samvandhe yArA sAkSya dive tAderake hAyira kara|’ tArA sAkSya dileo tumi tAdera saGge eTA svIkAra kara nA| yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake pratyAkhyAna kareche, yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA Ara tAdera pratipAlakera samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa, tumi tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara nA|

vala, ‘Asa, tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera janye yA hArAma karechena tomAderake tA par3e zunAi| eTA ei: ‘tomarA tA~ra kona zarIka karave nA, pitAmAtAra prati sadvyavahAra karave, dAridryera bhaYe tomarA tomAdera santAnaderake hatyA karave nA, Amii tomAdera o tAderake riyika diYe thAki| prakAzye hoka kiMvA gopane hoka, azlIla kAjera nikaTeo yAve nA| AllAh yAra hatyA niSiddha karechena yathArtha kAraNa vyatireke tomarA tAke hatyA karave nA|’ tomAderake tini ei nirdeza dilena, yena tomarA anudhAvana kara|

iYAtIma vaYaHprApta nA haoYA paryanta uttama vyavasthA vyatIta tomarA tAra sampattira nikaTavartI have nA evaM parimANa o ojana nyAyyabhAve purApuri dive| Ami kAukeo tAra sAdhyAtIta bhAra arpaNa kari nA| yakhana tomarA kathA valave takhana nyAyya valave-svajanera samparke haleo Ara AllAhke pradatta aGgIkAra pUrNa karave| eibhAve AllAh tomAderake nirdeza dilena, yena tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

Ara e pathai AmAra sarala patha| sutarAM tomarA erai anusaraNa karave evaM vibhinna patha anusaraNa karave nA, karale tA tomAderake tA~ra patha hate vicchinna karave| eibhAve AllAh tomAderake nirdeza dilena, yena tomarA sAvadhAna hao|

erapara Ami mUsAke diYechilAma kitAva yA satkarmaparAYaNera janye pUrNAGga, yA samasta kichura vizada vivaraNa, pathanirdeza Ara daYAsvarUpa- yAte tArA tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAt samvandhe vizvAsa kare|
e kitAva Ami nAyila karechi yA kalyANamaYa| sutarAM era anusaraNa kara Ara sAvadhAna hao, tA hale tomAdera prati daYA pradarzana karA have;
pAche tomarA vala, ‘kitAva to zudhu AmAdera pUrve dui sampradAYera pratii avatIrNa haYechila; AmarA tAdera paThana-pAThana samvandhe to gAphila chilAma;’

kiMvA tomarA vala, ‘yadi kitAva AmAdera prati avatIrNa hata tave AmarA to tAdera apekSA adhika hidAYAtaprApta hatAma|’ ekhana to tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate spaSTa pramANa, hidAYAta o rahamata eseche| erapara ye keu AllAh ra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna karave Ara tA hate mukha phiriYe nive tAra ceYe var3a jAlima Ara ke? yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha hate mukha phiriYe neYa satyavimukhitAra janye, Ami tAderake nikRSTa zAsti diva|

tArA zudhu erai nA pratIkSA kare, tAdera nikaTa pherezatA Asave, kiMvA tomAra pratipAlaka Asavena, kiMvA tomAra pratipAlakera kona nidarzana Asave? yedina tomAra pratipAlakera kona nidarzana Asave sedina tAra ImAna kAje Asave nA, ye vyakti pUrve ImAna Ane nAi kiMvA ye vyakti ImAnera mAdhyame kalyANa arjana kare nAi| vala, ‘tomarA pratIkSA kara, AmarAo pratIkSAYa thAkalAma|’

yArA dIna samvandhe nAnA matera sRSTi kareche Ara vibhinna dale vibhakta haYeche tAdera kona dAYitva tomAra naYa; tAdera viSaYa AllAh ra ikhtiYArabhukta| AllAh tAderake tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe avahita karavena|
keu kona satkAja karale se tAra dazaguNa pAve Ara keu kona asat kAja karale tAke zudhu tArai pratiphala deoYA have, Ara tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka to AmAke satpathe paricAlita karechena| eTAi supratiSThita dIna, ivrAhImera dharmAdarza, se chila ekaniSTha Ara se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|’
vala, ‘AmAra sAlAta, AmAra ‘ivAdata, AmAra jIvana o AmAra maraNa jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAh ra i uddezye|’
‘tA~ra kona zarIka nei evaM Ami erai janye AdiSTa haYechi Ara Amii prathama musalima|

vala, ‘Ami ki AllAhke cher3e anya pratipAlakake khu~jiva? athaca tinii sava kichura pratipAlaka|’ pratyeke nija kRtakarmera janye dAYI evaM keu anya kArao bhAra grahaNa karave nA| erapara tomAdera pratyAvartana tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTei, tatpara ye viSaYe tomarA matabheda karate tA tini tomAderake avahita karavena|

tinii tomAderake duniYAra pratinidhi karechena Ara yA tini tomAderake diYechena se samvandhe parIkSAra uddezye tomAdera katakake katakera opara maryAdAYa unnIta karechena| tomAra prati-pAlaka to zAsti pradAne druta Ara tini avazyai kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa|
Alipha, lAma, mIma, soYAda|
tomAra nikaTa kitAva avatIrNa karA haYeche, tomAra mane yena era samparke kona saGkoca nA thAke era mAdhyame satarkIkaraNera vyApAre Ara mu’minadera janye eTA upadeza|

tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera nikaTa yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara evaM tA~ke chAr3A anyAnya abhibhAvakera anusaraNa kara nA| tomarA khuva alpai upadeza grahaNa kara|
kata janapadake Ami dhvaMsa karechi! AmAra zAsti tAdera opara Apatita haYechila rAtrite vA dviprahare yakhana tArA vizrAmarata chila|
yakhana AmAra zAsti tAdera opara Apatita haYechila takhana tAdera kathA zudhu eTAi chila ye, ‘nizcaYa AmarA jAlima chilAma|’
erapara yAdera nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karA haYechila tAderake Ami jijJAsA karavai Ara rAsUlagaNakeo jijJAsA karava|
tArapara tAdera nikaTa pUrNa jJAnera saGge tAdera kAryAvalI vivRta karavai, Ara Ami to anupasthita chilAma nA|
sedinera ojana karA satya| yAdera pAllA bhArI have tArAi saphalakAma have|
Ara yAdera pAllA hAlakA have tArAi nijedera kSati kareche, yehetu tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake pratyAkhyAna karata|
Ami to tomAderake duniYAYa pratiSThita karechi evaM ete tomAdera jIvikAra vyavasthAo karechi; tomarA khuva alpai kRtajJatA jJApana kara|
Amii tomAderake sRSTi kari, erapara tomAdera AkRti dAna kari Ara tArapara pherezatAderake Adamake sijadA karate vali; ivalIsa vyatIta sakalei sijdA karala| se sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hala nA|

tini valalena, ‘Ami yakhana tomAke hukuma dilAma takhana kI tomAke nivRtta karala ye, tumi sijadA karale nA?’ se valala, ‘Ami tAra apekSA zreSTha; tumi AmAke agni diYe sRSTi karecha Ara tAke kardama diYe sRSTi karecha|’
tini valalena, ‘e sthAna hate neme yAo, ekhAne theke ahaMkAra karave, eTA hate pAre nA| sutarAM vera haYe yAo, tumi adhamadera antarbhukta|’
se valala, ‘punarutthAna divasa paryanta AmAke avakAza dAo|’
tini valalena, ‘yAderake avakAza deoYA haYeche tumi avazyai tAdera antarbhukta hale|’
se valala, ‘tumi AmAke zAstidAna karale, ejanye Amio tomAra sarala pathe mAnuSera janye nizcaYa OMt pete thAkava|
‘tArapara Ami tAdera nikaTa Asavai tAdera sAmane, pechane, DAna o vAma dika hate evaM tumi tAdera adhikAMzake kRtajJa pAve nA|’
tini valalena, ‘e sthAna hate dhikRta o vitAr3ita avasthAYa vera haYe yAo| mAnuSera madhye yArA tomAra anusaraNa karave nizcaYa Ami tomAdera savAike diYe jAhAnnAma pUrNa karavai|’
‘he Adama! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa kara evaM yA icchA AhAra kara, kintu ei vRkSera nikaTavartI haYo nA; hale tomarA jAlimadera antarbhukta have|’

evAre tAdera lajjAsthAna, yA tAdera nikaTa gopana rAkhA haYechila tA tAdera kAche prakAza karAra janye zaYatAna tAderake kumantraNA dila Ara valala, ‘pAche tomarA ubhaYe phirizatA haYe yAo kiMvA tomarA sthAYI hao eijanyei tomAdera pratipAlaka e vRkSa samvandhe tomAderake niSedha karechena|’
se tAdera ubhaYera nikaTa zapatha kare valala, ‘Ami to tomAdera hitAkAksakSIdera ekajana|’

ebhAve se tAderake pravaJcanA diYe adhaHpatita karala| tArapara yakhana tArA sei vRkSa-phalera AsvAda grahaNa karala, takhana tAdera lajjAsthAna tAdera nikaTa prakAza haYe par3ala evaM tArA jAnnAtera pAtA diYe nijederake AvRta karate lAgala| takhana tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake samvodhana kare valalena, ‘Ami ki tomAderake e vRkSera nikaTavartI hate vAraNa kari nAi Ara Ami ki tomAderake vali nAi ye, zaYatAna to tomAdera prakAzya zatru?’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA nijedera prati anyAYa karechi, yadi tumi AmAderake kSamA nA kara Ara daYA nA kara tave to AmarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hava|’
tini valalena, ‘tomarA neme yAo, tomarA eke anyera zatru Ara pRthivIte kichukAlera janye tomAdera vasavAsa o jIvikA thAkala|’
tini valalena, ‘sekhAnei tomarA jIvana yApana karave, sekhAnei tomAdera mRtyu have evaM sekhAna hatei tomAderake vera kare AnA have|’

he vanI Adama! tomAdera lajjAsthAna DhAkAra o veza-bha‚SAra janye Ami tomAderake paricchada diYechi evaM tAkoYAra paricchada, eTAi sarveAtkRSTa| eTA AllAh ra nidarzanasamUhera anyatama, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

he vanI Adama! zaYatAna yena tomAderake kichutei praluvdha nA kare-yebhAve tomAdera pitAmAtAke se jAnnAta hate vahiSkAra karechila, tAderake tAdera lajjAsthAna dekhAvAra janye vivastra karechila| se nije Ara tAra dala tomAderake emanabhAve dekhe ye, tomarA tAderake dekhate pAo nA| yArA ImAna Ane nA, zaYatAnake Ami tAdera abhibhAvaka karechi|

yakhana tArA kona azlIla AcaraNa kare takhana vale, ‘AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSake eTA karate dekhechi evaM AllAho AmAderake era nirdeza diYechena|’ vala, ‘AllAh azlIla AcaraNera nirdeza dena nA| tomarA ki AllAh samvandhe emana kichu valatecha yA tomarA jAna nA?’

vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka nirdeza diYechena nyAYavicArera|’ pratyeka sAlAte tomAdera lakSya sthira rAkhave Ara tA~rai Anugatye vizuddhacitta haYe ekaniSThabhAve tA~ke DAkave| tini yebhAve prathame tomAderake sRSTi karechena tomarA seibhAve phire Asave|
ekadalake tini satpathe paricAlita karechena Ara apara dalera pathabhrAnti nirdhArita haYeche| tArA AllAhke cher3e zaYatAnake tAdera abhibhAvaka karechila Ara mane karata tArAi satpathaprApta|
he vanI Adama! pratyeka sAlAtera samaYa tomarA sundara paricchada paridhAna karave, AhAra karave o pAna karave kintu apacaYa karave nA| nizcaYai tini apacaYakArIdera pachanda karena nA|

vala, ‘AllAh svIYa vAndAdera janye yesava zobhAmaYa vastu o vizuddha jIvikA sRSTi karechena tA ke hArAma kareche?’ vala, ‘pArthiva jIvane, vizeSa kare kiYAmatera dine ei samasta tAdera janye, yArA ImAna Ane| eibhAve Ami jJAnI sampradAYera janye nidarzana vizadabhAve vivRta kari|

vala, ‘nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka hArAma karechena prakAzya o gopana azlIlatA Ara pApa o asaMgata virodhitA evaM kona kichuke AllAh ra zarIka karA-yAra kona sanada tini preraNa karena nAi, Ara AllAh samvandhe emana kichu valA yA tomarA jAna nA|’
pratyeka jAtira eka nirdiSTa samaYa Ache| yakhana tAdera samaYa Asave takhana tArA mRtyukAla vilamva karate pArave nA Ara tvarAo karate pArave nA|

he vanI Adama! yadi tomAdera madhya hate kona rAsUla tomAdera nikaTa ese AmAra nidarzana vivRta kare takhana yArA sAvadhAna have Ara nijedera saMzodhana karave, tA hale tAdera kona bhaYa thAkave nA Ara tArA duHkhitao have nA|
yArA AmAra nidarzanake asvIkAra kareche evaM se samvandhe ahaMkAra kareche tArAi dojakhavAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|

ye vyakti AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA kare kiMvA tA~ra nidarzanake asvIkAra kare tAra apekSA var3a jAlima Ara ke? tAdera janye ye hissA lipivaddha Ache tA tAdera nikaTa pau~chave| yatakSaNa nA AmAra pherezatAgaNa jAna kavajera janye tAdera nikaTa Asave o jijJAsA karave, ‘AllAh chAr3A yAderake tomarA DAkate tArA kothAYa?’ tArA valave, ‘tArA AmAdera nikaTa hate antarhita haYeche’ evaM tArA svIkAra karave ye, tArA kAphira chila|

AllAh valavena, ‘tomAdera pUrve ye jina o mAnavadala gata haYeche tAdera saGge tomarA dojakhe praveza kara|’ yakhanai kona dala ote praveza karave takhanai apara dalake tArA abhisampAta karave, emanaki yakhana sakale ote ekatra have takhana tAdera paravartIrA pUrvavartIdera samparke valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! erAi AmAderake vibhrAnta karechila; sutarAM ederake dviguNa agni-zAsti dAo|’ AllAh valavena, ‘pratyekera janye dviguNa raYeche, kintu tomarA jAna nA|’
tAdera pUrvavartIrA paravartIderake valave, ‘AmAdera opara tomAdera kona zreSThatva nei, sutarAM tomarA tomAdera kRtakarmera zAsti AsvAdana kara|’

yArA AmAra nidarzanake asvIkAra evaM se samvandhe ahaMkAra kare, tAdera janye AkAzera dvAra ummukta karA have nA Ara tArA jAnnAteo praveza karate pArave nA yatakSaNa nA sU~cera chidra pathe uSTra praveza kare| eibhAve Ami aparAdhIdera pratiphala diva|
tAdera zayyA have jAhAnnAmera Ara tAdera oparera AcchAdanao; eibhAve Ami jAlimaderake pratiphala diva|
Ami kAukeo tAra sAdhyAtIta bhAra arpaNa kari nA| yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tArAi jAnnAtavAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|

Ami tAdera antara hate IrSA dUra karava, tAdera pAdadeze pravAhita have nadI evaM tArA valave, ‘prazaMsA AllAh ra i yini AmAderake era patha dekhiYechena| AllAh AmAderake patha nA dekhAle AmarA kakhanao patha petAma nA| AmAdera pratipAlakera rAsUlagaNa to satyavANI enechilena,’ evaM tAderake samvodhana kare valA have, ‘tomarA yA karate tArai janye tomAderake ei jAnnAtera uttarAdhikArI karA haYeche|’

jAnnAtavAsigaNa dojakhavAsIderake samvodhana kare valave, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAderake ye pratizruti diYechilena AmarA to tA satya peYechi| tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAderake ye pratizruti diYechilena tomarA tA satya peYecha ki?’ tArA valave, ‘hyA~’| erapara janaika ghoSaNAkArI tAdera madhye ghoSaNA karave, ‘AllAh ra lA‘nata jAlimadera opara-
‘yArA AllAh ra pathe prativandhakatA sRSTi karata Ara tAte vakratA anusandhAna karata; tArAi AkhirAta samvandhe avizvAsI|’

ubhaYera madhye pardA Ache Ara A‘rAphe kichu loka thAkave yArA pratyekake tAra lakSaNa diYe cinave evaM jAnnAtavAsIderake samvodhana kare valave, ‘tomAdera zAnti hoka|’ tArA takhanao jAnnAte praveza kare nAi, kintu AkAksakSA kare|
yakhana tAdera dRSTi dojakhavAsIdera prati phiriYe deoYA have takhana tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake jAlimadera saGgI kara nA|’
A‘rAphavAsigaNa ye lokaderake lakSaNa diYe cinave tAderake samvodhana kare valave, ‘tomAdera dala o tomAdera ahaMkAra kona kAje Asalo nA|’

erAi ki tArA, yAdera samvandhe tomarA zapatha kare valite ye, AllAh odera prati daYA pradarzana karavena nA? oderakei valA have, ‘tomarA jAnnAte praveza kara, tomAdera kona bhaYa nei Ara tomarA duHkhitao have nA|’

jAhAnnAmIrA jAnnAtavAsIderake samvodhana kare valave, ‘AmAdera opara kichu pAni Dhele dAo, vA AllAh jIvikArUpe tomAderake yA diYechena tA hate kichu dAo|’ tArA valave, ‘AllAh to ei du’Ti hArAma karechena kAphiradera janye-

‘yArA tAdera dInake krIr3A-kautukarUpe grahaNa karechila Ara pArthiva jIvana yAderake pratArita karechila|’ sutarAM Aja Ami tAderake vismRta hava, yebhAve tArA tAdera e dinera sAkSAtke bhule giYechila evaM yebhAve tArA AmAra nidarzanake asvIkAra karechila|
avazya Ami tAderake pau~chiYechilAma emana eka kitAva yA pUrNajJAna diYe vizada vyAkhyA karechilAma Ara yA chila mu’mina sampradAYera janye pathanirdeza o daYA|

tArA ki zudhu era pariNAmera pratIkSA kare, yedina era pariNAma prakAza pAve! sedina yArA pUrve era kathA bhule giYechila tArA valave, ‘AmAdera pratipAlakera rAsUlagaNa to satyavANI enechila, AmAdera ki emana kona supArizakArI Ache ye AmAdera janye supAriza karave vA AmAderake ki punarAYa phire yete deoYA have, yena AmarA pUrve yA karatAma tA hate bhinnatara kichu karate pAri?’ tArA nijederai kSati kareche Ara tArA ye mithyA racanA karata tAo antarhita haYeche|

tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAh yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI chaYa dine sRSTi karena; erapara tini Araze samAsIna hana| tinii divasake rAtri diYe AcchAdita karena yAte edera eke anyake drutagatite anusaraNa kare; Ara sUrya, cA~da o nakSatrarAji- yA tA~rai AjJAdhIna, tA tinii sRSTi karechena| jene rAkha, sRjana o AjJA tA~rai| mahimamaYa vizvajagatera pratipAlaka AllAh|
tomarA vinItabhAve o gopane tomAdera pratipAlakake DAka; tini sImAlaMghana-kArIderake pachanda karena nA|
duniYAYa zAnti sthApanera para tomarA tAte viparyaYa ghaTio nA, tA~ke bhaYa o AzAra saGge DAkave| nizcaYai AllAh ra anugraha satkarmaparAYaNadera nikaTavartI|

tinii nija anugrahera prAkkAle vAYuke susaMvAdavAhIrUpe preraNa karena| yakhana tA ghana megha vahana kare takhana Ami tA nirjIva bha‚khaNDera dike cAlanA kari, pare tA hate vRSTi varSaNa kari; erapara tAra mAdhyame sarvaprakAra phala utpAdana kari| eibhAve Ami mRtake jIvita kari yAte tomarA zikSA lAbha kara|

Ara utkRSTa bha‚mi-era phasala era pratipAlakera Adeze utpanna haYa o yA nikRSTa tAte kaThora parizrama nA karale kichui janmAYa nA| eibhAve Ami kRtajJa sampradAYera janye nidarzana vibhinnabhAve vivRta kari|

Ami to nUhke pAThiYechilAma tAra sampradAYera nikaTa Ara se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei| Ami tomAdera janye mahAdinera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|’
tAra sampradAYera pradhAnagaNa valechila, ‘AmarA to tomAke spaSTa bhrAntite dekhatechi|’
se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAte kona bhrAnti nei, varaM Ami to jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera rAsUla|
‘AmAra pratipAlakera vANI Ami tomAdera nikaTa pau~che dicchi o tomAderake hitopadeza dicchi Ara tomarA yA jAna nA Ami tA AllAh ra nikaTa hate jAni|’

‘tomarA ki vismita haccho ye, tomAderai ekajanera mAdhyame tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera nikaTa upadeza eseche yAte se tomAderake satarka kare, tomarA sAvadhAna hao evaM tomarA anukampA lAbha kara?’

erapara tArA tAke mithyAvAdI vale| tAke o tAra saGge yArA taraNIte chila Ami tAderake uddhAra kari Ara yArA AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra karechila tAderake nimajjita kari| tArA to chila eka andha sampradAYa|
Ada jAtira nikaTa Ami edera bhAi ha‚dake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| tomarA ki sAvadhAna have nA?’
tAra sampradAYera pradhAnagaNa-yArA kupharI karechila, tArA valechila, ‘AmarA to dekhachi tumi nirveAdha evaM tomAke AmarA to mithyAvAdI mane kari|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami nirveAdha nai, varaM Ami jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera rAsUla|
‘Ami AmAra pratipAlakera vANI tomAdera nikaTa peৗ~che dicchi Ara Ami tomAdera ekajana vizvasta hitAkAksakSI|

‘tomarA ki vismita haccho ye, tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera ekajanera mAdhyame tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAderake satarka karAra janye upadeza eseche? Ara smaraNa kara, AllAh tomAderake nUhera sampradAYera pare tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena evaM tomAdera daihika gaThane adhikatara hRSTapuSTa-valiSTha karechena| sutarAM tomarA AllAh ra anugraha smaraNa kara, haYata tomarA saphalakAma have|’

tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa e uddezye esecho ye, AmarA yena eka AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kari Ara AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNa yAra ‘ivAdata karata tA varjana kari? sutarAM tumi satyavAdI hale AmAderake yAra bhaYa dekhAccha tA AnaYana kara|’

se valala, ‘tomAdera pratipAlakera zAsti o krodha to tomAdera janye nirdhArita haYei Ache; tave ki tomarA AmAra saGge vitarke lipta hate cAo emana katakaguli nAma samvandhe yA tomarA o tomAdera pUrvapuruSagaNa sRSTi karecha Ara ye samvandhe AllAh kona sanada pAThAna nAi? sutarAM tomarA pratIkSA kara, Amio tomAdera saGge pratIkSA karachi|’
erapara Ami tAke o tAra saGgIderake AmAra anugrahe uddhAra karechilAma; Ara AmAra nidarzanake yArA asvIkAra karechila evaM yArA mu’mina chila nA tAderake nirmUla karechilAma|

sAmUda jAtira nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihke pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara| tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei| tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera pratipAlaka hate spaSTa nidarzana eseche| AllAh ra e uSTrI tomAdera janye ekaTi nidarzana| eke AllAh ra jamite care khete dAo evaM eke kona kleza dio nA, dile marmantuda zAsti tomAdera opara Apatita have|

‘smaraNa kara, Ada jAtira para tini tomAderake tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena, tini tomAderake pRthivIte emanabhAve pratiSThita karechena ye, tomarA samatala bha‚mite prAsAda nirmANa o pAhAr3a keTe vAsagRha nirmANa karacho| sutarAM tomarA AllAh ra anugraha smaraNa kara evaM pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi kare ver3io nA|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika pradhAnerA sei sampradAYera ImAnadAra-yAderake durvala mane karA hata tAderake valala, ‘tomarA ki jAna ye, sAlih AllAh kartRka prerita?’ tArA valala, ‘tAra prati ye vANI prerita haYeche AmarA tAte vizvAsI|’
dAmbhikerA valala, ‘tomarA yA vizvAsa kara AmarA to tA pratyAkhyAna kari|’
erapara tArA sei uSTrI vadha kare Ara AllAh ra hukuma amAnya kare Ara vale, ‘he sAlih! tumi rAsUla hale AmAderake yAra bhaYa dekhAccho tA AnaYana kara|’
erapara tArA bhUmikampa diYe AkrAnta haYa, phale tAdera prabhAta hala nijagRhe adhaHmukhe patita avasthAYa|

erapara se tAdera nikaTa hate mukha phiriYe niYe valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami to AmAra pratipAlakera vANI tomAdera nikaTa peৗ~chechilAma Ara tomAderake hitopadeza diYechilAma, kintu tomarA to hitopadeza dAnakArIderake pachanda kara nA|’
Ara Ami lUtakeo pAThiYechilAma| se tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘tomarA emana kukarma karacho yA tomAdera pUrve vizve keu kare nAi|
‘tomarA to kAma-tRptira janye nArI cher3e puruSera nikaTa gamana kara; tomarA to sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|’
uttare tAra sampradAYa zudhu valala, ‘ederake tomAdera janapada hate vera kare dAo, erA to emana loka yArA ati pavitra hate cAYa|’
erapara Ami tAke o tAra strI vyatIta tAra parijanavargake uddhAra karechilAma, tAra strI chila pechane avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|
Ami tAdera opara bhISaNabhAve vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma| sutarAM aparAdhIdera pariNAma kI haYechila tA lakSya kara|

Ami mAdYAnavAsIdera nikaTa tAdera bhAi zu‘AYavake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei; tomAdera pratipAlaka hate tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANa eseche| sutarAM tomarA mApa o ojana ThikabhAve dive, lokaderake tAdera prApya vastu kama dive nA Ara duniYAYa zAnti sthApanera para viparyaYa ghaTAve nA; tomarA mu’mina hale tomAdera janye eTA kalyANakara|

‘tA~ra prati yArA ImAna eneche tAderake bhaYa pradarzanera janye tomarA kona pathe vase thAkave nA, AllAh ra pathe tAderake vAdhA dive nA Ara ete vakratA anusandhAna karave nA|’ smaraNa kara, ‘tomarA yakhana saMkhyAYa kama chile, AllAh takhana tomAdera saMkhyA vRddhi karechena Ara viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNAma kirUpa chila, tA lakSya kara|

‘Ami yA niYe prerita haYechi tAte yadi tomAdera kona dala ImAna Ane evaM kona dala ImAna nA Ane tave dhairya dhAraNa kara, yatakSaNa nA AllAh AmAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dena; Ara tinii zreSTha mImAMsAkArI|’

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika pradhAnarA valala, ‘he zu‘AYava! AmarA tomAke o tomAra saGge yArA ImAna eneche tAderake AmAdera janapada hate vahiSkAra karavai vA tomAderake AmAdera dharmAdarze phire Asate have|’ se valala, ‘yadi AmarA tA ghRNA kari tavuo?’

‘tomAdera dharmAdarza hate AllAh AmAderake uddhAra karAra para yadi AmarA ete phire yAi tave to AmarA AllAh ra prati mithyA Aropa karava| AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAh icchA nA karale Ara ote phire yAoYA AmAdera janye samIcIna naYa| savakichui AmAdera pratipAlakera jJAnAYatta, AmarA AllAh ra prati nirbhara kari| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera o AmAdera sampradAYera madhye nyAyyabhAve mImAMsA kare dAo Ara tumii zreSTha mImAMsAkArI|’
tAra sampradAYera avizvAsI pradhAnarA valala, ‘tomarA yadi zu‘AYavake anusaraNa kara tave tomarA to kSatigrasta havei|’
erapara tArA bhUmikampa diYe AkrAnta hala, phale tAdera prabhAta hala nijagRhe adhaHmukhe patita avasthAYa|
mane hala, zu‘AYavake yArA mithyAvAdI valechila tArA yena kakhanao sekhAne vasavAsa karei nAi| zu‘AYavake yArA mithyAvAdI valechila tArAi kSatigrasta haYechila|
