se tAdera hate mukha phirAla Ara valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra pratipAlakera vANI Ami to tomAderake peৗ~che diYechi evaM tomAderake upadeza diYechi, sutarAM Ami kAphira sampradAYera janye kI kare AkSepa kari!’
Ami kona janapade navI pAThAle era adhivAsIvRndake artha-saMkaTa o duHkha-kleza diYe AkrAnta kari, yAte tArA kAkuti-minati kare|

erapara Ami akalyANake kalyANe parivartita kari| avazeSe tArA prAcuryera adhikArI haYa Ara vale, ‘AmAdera pUrvapuruSarAo to duHkha-sukha bhoga kareche|’ erapara akasmAt tAderake Ami pAkar3Ao kari, kintu tArA upalavdhi karate pAre nA|

yadi sei sakala janapadera adhivAsIvRnda ImAna Anata o tAkoYA avalamvana karata tave Ami tAdera janye AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra kalyANa unmukta karatAma, kintu tArA pratyAkhyAna karechila; sutarAM tAdera kRtakarmera janye tAderake zAsti diYechi|
tave ki janapadera adhivAsIvRnda bhaYa rAkhe nA ye, AmAra zAsti tAdera opara Asave rAtrite yakhana tArA thAkave nidrAmagna?
athavA janapadera adhivAsIvRnda ki bhaYa rAkhe nA ye, AmAra zAsti tAdera opara Asave pUrvAhne yakhana tArA thAkave krIr3Arata?
tArA ki AllAh ra kauzalera bhaYa rAkhe nA? vastuta kSatigrasta sampradAYa vyatIta keu AllAh ra kauzala hate nirApada mane kare nA|

kona dezera janagaNera para yArA ai dezera uttarAdhikArI haYa tAdera nikaTa eTA ki pratIYamAna haYa nAi ye, Ami icchA karale tAdera pApera daruna tAderake zAsti dite pAri? Ara Ami tAdera hRdaYa mohara kare diva, phale tArA zunave nA|

ei sakala janapadera kichu vRttAnta Ami tomAra nikaTa vivRta karachi, tAdera nikaTa tAdera rAsUlagaNa to spaSTa pramANasaha esechila; kintu yA tArA pUrve pratyAkhyAna karechila tAte ImAna AnAra pAtra tArA chila nA, eibhAve AllAh kAphiradera hRdaYa mohara kare dena|
Ami tAdera adhikAMzake pratizruti pAlanakArI pAi nAi; varaM tAdera adhikAMzake to pApAcArIi peYechi|
tAdera para mUsAke AmAra nidarzanasaha phira‘Aona o tAra pAriSadavargera nikaTa pAThAi; kintu tArA tA asvIkAra kare| viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNAma ki haYechila tA lakSya kara|
mUsA valala, ‘he phira‘Aona! Ami to jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate prerita|
‘eTA sthira nizcita ye, Ami AllAh samvandhe satya vyatIta valiva nA| tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate spaSTa pramANa Ami tomAdera nikaTa enechi, sutarAM vanI isarAIlake tumi AmAra saGge yete dAo|’
phira‘Aona valala, ‘yadi tumi kona nidarzana ene thAka tave tumi satyavAdI hale tA peza kara|’
erapara mUsA tAra lAThi nikSepa karala Ara tatkSaNAt tA eka sAkSAt ajagara hala|
Ara se tAra hAta vera karala Ara tatkSaNAt tA darzakadera dRSTite zubhra ujjvala pratibhAta hala|
phira‘Aona-sampradAYera pradhAnarA valala, ‘e to ekajana sudakSa jAdukara,
‘e tomAderake tomAdera deza hate vahiSkAra karate cAYa, ekhana tomarA kI parAmarza dAo?’
tArA valala, ‘tAke o tAra bhAike kiJcita avakAza dAo evaM nagare nagare saMgrAhakaderake pAThAo,
‘yena tArA tomAra nikaTa pratiTi sudakSa jAdukara upasthita kare|’
jAdukarerA phira‘Aonera nikaTa ese valala, ‘AmarA yadi vijaYI hai tave AmAdera janye puraskAra thAkave to?’
se valala, ‘hyA~ evaM tomarA avazyai AmAra sAnnidhya prAptadera antarbhukta have|’
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA! tumii ki nikSepa karave, nA AmarAi nikSepa karava?’
se valala, ‘tomarAi nikSepa kara’| yakhana tArA nikSepa karala takhana tArA lokera cokhe jAdu karala, tAderake AtaMkita karala Ara tArA eka var3a rakamera jAdu dekhAla|
Ami mUsAra prati pratyAdeza karalAma, ‘tumio tomAra lAThi nikSepa kara|’ sahasA oTA tAdera alIka sRSTigulike grAsa karate lAgala;
phale satya pratiSThita hala evaM tArA yA karachila tA mithyA pratipanna hala|
sekhAne tArA parAbha‚ta hala o lAJchita hala,
evaM jAdukarerA sijadAvanata hala|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ImAna AnalAma jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera prati-
‘yini mUsA o hArUnerao pratipAlaka|’

phira‘Aona valala, ‘kI! Ami tomAderake anumati deoYAra pUrve tomarA ete vizvAsa karale? e to eka cakrAnta; tomarA sajJAne ei cakrAnta karecha nagaravAsIderake oTA hate vahiSkArera janye| AcchA, tomarA zIghrai era pariNAma jAnive|
‘Ami to tomAdera hAta pA viparIta dika hate kartana karavai; erapara tomAdera sakalake zUlaviddha karavai|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa avazyai pratyAvartana karava;

‘tumi to AmAderake zAsti diccho zudhu ejanye ye, AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera nidarzane ImAna enechi yakhana tA AmAdera nikaTa eseche| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake dhairya dAna kara Ara musalamAnarUpe AmAderake mRtyu dAo|’

phira‘Aona sampradAYera pradhAnarA valala, ‘Apani ki mUsAke o tAra sampradAYake rAjye viparyaYa sRSTi karate evaM ApanAke o ApanAra devatAderake varjana karate divena?’ se valala, ‘AmarA tAdera putradera hatyA karava Ara tAdera nArIdera jIvita rAkhiva Ara AmarA to tAdera opara pravala|’

mUsA tAra sampradAYake valala, ‘AllAh ra nikaTa sAhAyya prArthanA kara Ara dhairya dhAraNa kara; yamIna to AllAh ra i| tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA era uttarAdhikArI karena Ara zubha pariNAma to muttAkIdera janye|’

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera nikaTa tomAra AsAra pUrve AmarA niryAtita haYechi Ara tomAra AsAra pareo|’ se valala, zIghrai tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera zatru dhvaMsa karavena evaM tini tomAderake yamIne tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena, erapara tomarA kI kara tA tini lakSya karavena|’
Ami to phira‘Aonera anusArIderake durbhikSa o phala-phasalera kSati diYe AkrAnta karechi, yAte tArA anudhAvana kare|

‘yakhana tAdera kona kalyANa hata, tArA valata, ‘eTA AmAdera prApya|’ Ara yakhana kona akalyANa hata takhana tArA mUsA o tAra saGgIderake alakSuNe gaNya karata, tAdera akalyANa AllAh ra niYantraNAdhIna; kintu tAdera adhikAMza eTA jAne nA|
tArA valala, ‘AmAderake jAdu karAra janye tumi ye kona nidarzana AmAdera nikaTa peza kara nA kena AmarA tomAte vizvAsa karava nA|’
erapara Ami tAderake plAvana, paGgapAla, ukuna, bheka o rakta diYe kliSTa kari| eiguli spaSTa nidarzana; kintu tArA dAmbhikai theke gela; Ara tArA chila eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|

Ara yakhana tAdera opara zAsti Asata tArA valata, ‘he mUsA! tumi tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa AmAdera janye prArthanA kara tomAra saGge tini ye aGgIkAra karechena se anuyAYI; yadi tumi AmAdera opara hate zAsti apasArita kara tave AmarA to tomAte ImAna Anavai Ara vanI isarAIlakeo tomAra saGge avazyai yete diva|’
Ami yakhanai tAdera opara hate zAsti apasArita karatAma eka nirdiSTa kAlera janye yA tAdera janye nirdhArita chila, tArA takhanai tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGga karata|
sutarAM Ami tAderake zAsti diYechi Ara tAderake atala samudre nimajjita karechi| kAraNa tArA AmAra nidarzanake asvIkAra karata evaM ei samvandhe tArA chila gAphila|

ye sampradAYake durvala gaNya karA hata tAderake Ami AmAra kalyANaprApta rAjyera pUrva o pazcimera uttarAdhikArI kari; evaM vanI isarAIla samvandhe tomAra pratipAlakera zubha vANI satye pariNata hala, yehetu tArA dhairya dhAraNa karechila, Ara phira‘Aona o tAra sampradAYera zilpa o yesava prAsAda tArA nirmANa karechila tA dhvaMsa karechi|

Ara Ami vanI isarAIlake samudra pAra kariYe dei; erapara tArA pratimA pUjAYa rata eka jAtira nikaTa upasthita haYa| tArA valala, ‘he mUsA! tAdera devatAra nyAYa AmAdera janyeo eka devatA gar3e dAo|’ se valala, ‘tomarA to eka mUrkha sampradAYa|’
‘esava loka yAte lipta raYeche tA to vidhvasta have Ara tArA yA karache tAo amUlaka|’
se Arao valala, ‘AllAh vyatIta tomAdera janye Ami ki anya ilAh khu~java athaca tini tomAderake vizvajagatera opara zreSThatva diYechena?’

smaraNa kara, Ami tomAderake phira‘Aonera anusArIdera hAta hate uddhAra karechi yArA tomAderake nikRSTa zAsti dita| tArA tomAdera putra santAnadera hatyA karata Ara tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhata; ete chila tomAdera pratipAlakera eka mahAparIkSA|

smaraNa kara, mUsAra janye Ami triza rAtri nirdhAraNa kari o Arao daza diYe tA pUrNa kari| ebhAve tAra pratipAlakera nirdhArita samaYa calliza rAtrite pUrNa haYa| evaM mUsA tAra bhAi hArUnake valala, ‘AmAra anupasthitite AmAra sampradAYera madhye tumi AmAra pratinidhitva karave, saMzodhana karave Ara viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera patha anusaraNa karave nA|’

mUsA yakhana AmAra nirdhArita sthAne upasthita hala Ara tAra pratipAlaka tAra saGge kathA valalena takhana se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke darzana dAo, Ami tomAke dekhava|’ tini valalena, ‘tumi AmAke kakhanai dekhate pAve nA| tumi varaM pAhAr3era prati lakSya kara, eTA svasthAne sthira thAkale tave tumi AmAke dekhave|’ yakhana tAra pratipAlaka pAhAr3e jyoti prakAza karalena takhana tA pAhAr3ake cUrNa-vicUrNa karala evaM mUsA saMjJAhIna haYe par3ala| yakhana se jJAna phire pela takhana valala, ‘mahimamaYa tumi, Ami anutapta haYe tomAtei pratyAvartana karalAma Ara mu’minadera madhye Amii prathama|’
tini valalena, ‘he mUsA! Ami tomAke AmAra risAlAta o vAkyAlApa diYe mAnuSera madhye viziSTa karechi; sutarAM Ami yA dilAma tA grahaNa kara evaM kRtajJa hao|’

Ami tAra janye phalake sarvaviSaYe upadeza o sakala viSaYera spaSTa vyAkhyA likhe diYechi; sutarAM eiguli zaktabhAve dhara Ara tomAra sampradAYake edera yA uttama tA grahaNa karate nirdeza dAo| Ami zIghra satyatyAgIdera vAsasthAna tomAderake dekhAva|

pRthivIte yArA anyAYabhAve dambha kare ver3AYa tAdera dRSTi AmAra nidarzana hate phiriYe diva, tArA AmAra pratyekaTi nidarzana dekhaleo ete vizvAsa karave nA, tArA satpatha dekhaleo eke patha vale grahaNa karave nA; kintu tArA bhrAntapatha dekhale eke tArA patha hiseve grahaNa karave| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA AmAra nidarzanake asvIkAra kareche Ara se samvandhe tArA chila gAphila|
yArA AmAra nidarzana o AkhirAtera sAkSAtke asvIkAra kare tAdera kArya niSphala haYa| tArA yA kare tadanuyAYIi tAderake pratiphala deoYA have|

mUsAra sampradAYa tAra anupasthitite nijedera alaMkAra diYe gar3ala eka go-vatsa, eka avaYava, yA ‘hAmvA’ rava karata| tArA ki dekhala nA ye, tA tAdera saGge kathA vale nA o tAderake pathao dekhAYa nA? tArA eke upAsyarUpe grahaNa karala Ara tArA chila jAlima|

tArA yakhana anutapta hala o dekhala ye, tArA vipathagAmI haYe geche, takhana tArA valala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka yadi AmAdera prati daYA nA karena o AmAderake kSamA nA karena tave AmarA to kSatigrasta havai|’

mUsA yakhana kruddha o kSuvdha haYe nija sampradAYera nikaTa pratyAvartana karala takhana valala, ‘AmAra anupasthitite tomarA AmAra kata nikRSTa pratinidhitva karecha! tomAdera pratipAlakera Adezera pUrve tomarA tvarAnvita karale?’ Ara se phalakaguli phele dila Ara nija bhAike cule dhare nijera dike Tone Anala| hArUna valala, ‘he AmAra sahodara! lokerA to AmAke durvala mane karechila Ara AmAke prAYa hatyA karei phelechila| tumi AmAra saGge emana kara nA yAte zatrurA Anandita haYa Ara AmAke jAlimadera antarbhukta kara nA|’
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke o AmAra bhAike kSamA kara Ara AmAderake tomAra rahamatera madhye dAkhila kara| tumii zreSTha daYAlu|’
yArA go-vatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa kareche pArthiva jIvane tAdera opara tAdera pratipAlakera krodha o lAJchunA Apatita havei| Ara eibhAve Ami mithyA racanAkArIderake pratiphala diYe thAki|
yArA asatkArya kare tArA pare taovA karale o ImAna Anale tomAra pratipAlaka to parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
mUsAra krodha yakhana prazamita hala takhana se phalakaguli tule nila| yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare tAdera janye ete yA likhita chila tAte chila pathanirdeza o rahamata|

mUsA nija sampradAYa hate sattarajana lokake AmAra nirdhArita sthAne samaveta haoYAra janye manonIta karala| tArA yakhana bhUmikampa diYe AkrAnta hala, takhana mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi icchA karale pUrvei to ederake o AmAkeo dhvaMsa karate pArate! AmAdera madhye yArA nirveAdha, tArA yA kareche seijanye ki tumi AmAderake dhvaMsa karave? eTA to zudhu tomAra parIkSA, yA diYe tumi yAke icchA vipathagAmI kara Ara yAke icchA satpathe paricAlita kara| tumii to AmAdera abhibhAvaka; sutarAM AmAderake kSamA kara o AmAdera prati daYA kara Ara kSamAzIladera madhye tumii to zreSTha|

‘AmAdera janye nirdhArita kara duniYA o AkhirAte kalyANa, AmarA tomAra nikaTa pratyAvartana karechi|’ AllAh valalena, ‘AmAra zAsti yAke icchA diYe thAki Ara AmAra daYA-tA to pratyeka vastute vyApta| sutarAM Ami eTA tAdera janye nirdhArita karava yArA tAkoYA avalamvana kare, yAkAta deYa o AmAra nidarzane vizvAsa kare|

‘yArA anusaraNa kare vArtAvAhaka ummI navIra, yAra ullekha tAorAta o injIla, yA tAdera nikaTa Ache tAte lipivaddha pAYa, ye tAderake satkAjera nirdeza deYa o asatkAje vAdhA deYa, ye tAdera janye pavitra vastu hAlAla kare o apavitra vastu hArAma kare Ara ye mukta kare tAderake tAdera gurubhAra hate evaM zRMkhala hate- yA tAdera opara chila| sutarAM yArA tAra prati ImAna Ane tAke sammAna kare, tAke sAhAyya kare evaM ye nUra tAra saGge avatIrNa haYeche tAra anusaraNa kare tArAi saphalakAma|

vala, ‘he mAnuSa! Ami tomAdera sakalera janye AllAh ra rAsUla, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatvera adhikArI| tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei; tinii jIvita karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| sutarAM tomarA ImAna Ana AllAh ra prati o tA~ra vArtAvAhaka ummI navIra prati; ye AllAh o tA~ra vANIte ImAna Ane Ara tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara, yAte tomarA saThika patha pAo|’
mUsAra sampradAYera madhye emana dala raYeche yArA anyake nyAYabhAve patha dekhAYa o seibhAvei vicAra kare|

tAderake Ami dvAdaza gotre vibhakta karechi| mUsAra sampradAYa yakhana tAra nikaTa pAni prArthanA karala, takhana tAra prati pratyAdeza karalAma, ‘tomAra lAThi diYe pAthare AghAta kara’, phale eTA hate dvAdaza prasravaNa utsArita hala| pratyeka gotra nija nija pAnasthAna cine nila, Ara megha diYe tAdera opara chAYA vistAra karechilAma, tAdera nikaTa mAnnA o sAlaoYA pAThiYechilAma Ara valechilAma, ‘uttama yA tomAderake diYechi tA hate AhAra kara|’ tArA AmAra prati kona juluma kare nAi, kintu tArA nijedera pratii juluma karachila|

smaraNa kara, tAderake valA haYechila, ‘tomarA ei janapade vAsa kara o yethA icchA AhAra kara evaM vala, ‘kSamA cAi’ evaM natazire dvAre praveza kara; Ami tomAdera aparAdha kSamA karava| Ami satkarmaparAYaNaderake Arao adhika dAna karava|’

kintu tAdera madhye yArA jAlima chila tAderake yA valA haYechila, tAra parivarte tArA anya kathA valala| sutarAM Ami AkAza hate tAdera prati zAsti preraNa karalAma, yehetu tArA sImAlaMghana karachila|

tAderake samudratIravartI janapadavAsIdera samvandhe jijJAsA kara, tArA zanivArera sImAlaMghana karata; zanivAra udyApanera dina mAcha pAnite bhese tAdera nikaTa Asata| kintu yedina tArA zanivAra udyApana karata nA sedina tArA tAdera nikaTa Asata nA| eibhAve Ami tAderake parIkSA karechilAma, ye kAraNe tArA satya tyAga karata|

smaraNa kara, tAdera ekadala valechila, ‘AllAh yAderake dhvaMsa karavena kiMvA kaThora zAsti divena, tomarA tAderake sadupadeza dAo kena?’ tArA valechila, ‘tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa dAYitvamuktira janye evaM yAte tArA sAvadhAna haYa ejanye|’

ye upadeza tAderake deoYA haYechila tArA yakhana tA vismRta haYa, takhana yArA asatkArya hate nivRtta karata tAderake Ami uddhAra kari Ara yArA juluma kare tArA kupharI karata vale Ami tAderake kaThora zAsti dei|
tArA yakhana niSiddha kAja auddhatyasahakAre karate lAgala takhana tAderake valalAma, ‘ghRNita vAnara hao!’

smaraNa kara, tomAra pratipAlaka ghoSaNA karena, tini to kiYAmata paryanta tAdera opara emana lokaderake preraNa karavena yArA tAderake kaThina zAsti dite thAkave, Ara tomAra pratipAlaka to zAstidAne tatpara Ara tini to kSamAzIla, parama daYAmaYa|
duniYAYa Ami tAderake vibhinna dale vibhakta kari; tAdera kataka satkarmaparAYaNa o kataka anyarUpa evaM maGgala o amaGgala diYe Ami tAderake parIkSA kari, yAte tArA pratyAvartana kare|

erapara ayogya uttarapuruSagaNa ekera para eka tAdera sthalAbhiSiktarUpe kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYa; tArA e tuccha duniYAra sAmagrI grahaNa kare Ara vale, ‘AmAderake kSamA karA have|’ kintu era anurUpa sAmagrI tAdera nikaTa Asale tAo tArA grahaNa kare; kitAvera aGgIkAra ki tAdera nikaTa hate neoYA haYa nAi ye, tArA AllAh samvandhe satya vyatIta valave nA? Ara tArA to ete yA Ache tA adhyaYanao kare| yArA tAkoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janye parakAlera AvAsai zreYa; tomarA ki eTA anudhAvana kara nA?
yArA kitAvake dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare o sAlAta kAYema kare, Ami to eirUpa satkarmaparAYaNadera zramaphala naSTa kari nA|

smaraNa kara, Ami parvatake tAdera Urdhve uttolana kari, Ara eTA chila yena eka candrAtapa| tArA mane karala, eTA tAdera opara par3e yAve| valalAma, ‘Ami yA dilAma tA dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kara Ara ote yA Ache tA smaraNa kara, yAte tomarA tAkoYAra adhikArI hao|’

smaraNa kara, tomAra pratipAlaka AdamasantAnera pRSThadeza hate tAra vaMzadharake vera karena Ara tAdera nijedera samvandhe svIkArokti grahaNa karena evaM valena, ‘Ami ki tomAdera pratipAlaka nai?’ tArA vale, ‘hyA~, avazyai AmarA sAkSI thAkalAma|’ eTA ejanye ye, tomarA yena kiYAmatera dina nA vala, ‘AmarA to e viSaYe gAphila chilAma|’

kiMvA tomarA yena nA vala, ‘AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNai to AmAdera pUrve ziraka kareche, Ara AmarA to tAdera paravartI vaMzadhara; tave ki pathabhraSTadera kRtakarmera janye tumi AmAderake dhvaMsa karave?’
eibhAve nidarzana vizadabhAve vivRta kari yAte tArA pratyAvartana kare|
tAderake ai vyaktira vRttAnta par3e zonAo yAke Ami diYechilAma nidarzana, tArapara se tAke varjana kare, pare zaYatAna tAra pichane lAge, Ara se vipathagAmIdera antarbhukta haYa|

Ami icchA karale eTA diYe tAke ucca maryAdA dAna karatAma, kintu se duniYAra prati jhu~ke par3e o tAra pravRttira anusaraNa kare| tAra avasthA kukurera nyAYa; era opara tumi vojhA cApAle se hA~pAte thAke Ara tumi vojhA nA cApAleo hA~pAYa| ye sampradAYa AmAra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna kare tAdera avasthAo eirUpa, tumi vRttAnta vivRta kara yAte tArA cintA kare|
ye sampradAYa AmAra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna kare o nijedera prati juluma kare tAdera avasthA kata manda!
AllAh yAke patha dekhAna se-i patha pAYa Ara yAderake tini vipathagAmI karena tArAi kSatigrasta|

Ami to vahu jina o mAnavake jAhAnnAmera janye sRSTi karechi; tAdera hRdaYa Ache kintu tA diYe tArA upalavdhi kare nA, tAdera cokha Ache tA diYe dekhe nA Ara tAdera kAna Ache tA diYe zone nA; erA pazura nyAYa, varaM erA adhika pathabhraSTa| erAi gAphila|
AllAh ra janye Ache sundara sundara nAma| kAjei tomarA tA~ke sei sakala nAmei DAkave; yArA tA~ra nAma vikRta kare tAderake varjana karave; tAdera kRtakarmera phala tAderake deoYA have|
yAderake Ami sRSTi karechi tAdera madhye ekadala loka Ache yArA nyAYabhAve patha dekhAYa evaM nyAYabhAve vicAra kare|
yArA AmAra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna kare Ami tAderake emanabhAve krame krame dhvaMsera dike niYe yAi ye, tArA jAnateo pArave nA|
Ami tAderake samaYa diYe thAki; AmAra kauzala atyanta valiSTha|
tArA ki cintA kare nA ye, tAdera sahacara Adau unmAda naYa; se to eka spaSTa satarkakArI|

tArA ki lakSya kare nA, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhauma kartRtva samparke evaM AllAh yA kichu sRSTi karechena tAra samparke Ara era samparkeo ye, sambhavata tAdera nirdhArita kAla nikaTavartI, sutarAM era para tArA Ara kon kathAYa ImAna Anave!
AllAh yAderake vipathagAmI karena tAdera kona pathapradarzaka nei, Ara tAderake tini tAdera avAdhyatAYa udbhrAntera mato ghure ver3Ate dena|

tArA tomAke jijJAsA kare kiYAmata kakhana ghaTave| vala, ‘e viSaYera jJAna zudhu AmAra pratipAlakerai Ache| zudhu tinii yathAsamaYe eTA prakAza karavena; eTA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte ekaTi bhaYaMkara ghaTanA have| AkasmikabhAvei eTA tomAdera opara Asave|’ tumi e viSaYe savizeSa avahita mane kare tArA tomAke prazna kare| vala, ‘ei viSaYera jJAna zudhu AllAh ra i Ache, kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA|’

vala, ‘AllAh yA icchA karena tA vyatIta AmAra nijera bhAla-mandera oparao AmAra kona adhikAra nei| Ami yadi adRzyera khavara jAnatAma tave to Ami prabhUta kalyANai lAbha karatAma Ara kona akalyANai AmAke sparza karata nA| Ami to zudhu mu’mina sampradAYera janye satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA vai Ara kichui nai|’

tinii tomAderake eka vyakti hate sRSTi karechena o tA hate tAra strI sRSTi karena yAte se tAra nikaTa zAnti pAYa| erapara yakhana se tAra saGge saMgata haYa takhana se eka laghu garbhadhAraNa kare Ara tA niYe se anAYAse calApherA kare| garbha yakhana gurubhAra haYa takhana tArA ubhaYe tAdera pratipAlaka AllAh ra nikaTa prArthanA kare, ‘yadi tumi AmAderake eka pUrNAGga santAna dAo tave to AmarA kRtajJa thAkavai|’
tini yakhana tAderake eka pUrNAGga santAna dAna karena, tArA tAderake yA deoYA haYa se samvandhe AllAh ra zarIka kare; kintu tArA yAke zarIka kare AllAh tA apekSA aneka Urdhve|
erA ki emana vastuke zarIka kare yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA? varaM erA nijerAi sRSTa,
erA nA tAderake sAhAyya karate pAre, Ara nA karate pAre nijaderake sAhAyya|
tomarA ederake satpathe AhvAna karaleo erA tomAderake anusaraNa karave nA; tomarA ederake AhvAna kara vA cupa kare thAka, tomAdera pakSe ubhaYai samAna|
AllAh vyatIta tomarA yAderake AhvAna kara tArA to tomAderai nyAYa vAndA; tomarA tAderake AhvAna kara, tArA tomAdera DAke sAr3A dika, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

tAdera ki pA Ache yA diYe erA cale? tAdera ki hAta Ache yA diYe erA dhare? tAdera ki cokha Ache, yA diYe erA dekhe? kiMvA tAdera ki kAna Ache yA diYe erA zone? vala, tomarA yAderake AllAh ra zarIka karecha tAderake DAka; tArapara AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra kara Ara AmAke avakAza dio nA;
‘AmAra abhibhAvaka to AllAh, yini kitAva avatIrNa karechena Ara tinii satkarmaparAYaNadera abhibhAvakatva kare thAkena|’
AllAh vyatIta tomarA yAke AhvAna kara tArA to tomAderake sAhAyya karate pAre nA Ara tAdera nijedera-keo naYa|
yadi tAderake satpathe AhvAna kara tave tArA zunave nA evaM tumi dekhate pAve ye, tArA tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache; kintu tArA dekhe nA|
tumi kSamAparAYaNatA avalamvana kara, satkAjera nirdeza dAo Ara ajJaderake er3iYe cala|
yadi zaYatAnera kumantraNA tomAke prarocita kare tave AllAh ra zaraNa nive; tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yArA tAkoYAra adhikArI haYa tAderake zaYatAna yakhana kumantraNA deYa takhana tArA AllAhke smaraNa kare Ara tatkSaNAt tAdera cokha khule yAYa|
tAdera saGgI-sAthigaNa tAderake bhrAntira dike Tene neYa evaM e viSaYe tArA kona truTi kare nA|

tumi yakhana tAdera nikaTa kona nidarzana upasthita kara nA, takhana tArA vale, ‘tumi nijei ekaTi nidarzana veche nAo nA kena?’ vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlakera mAdhyame Ami ye viSaYe pratyAdiSTa hai, Ami to zudhu tArai anusaraNa kari; ei kuraAna tomAdera pratipAlakera nidarzana, vizvAsI sampradAYera janye eTA hidAYAta o rahamata|’
yakhana kuraAna pATha karA haYa takhana tomarA manoyogera saGge tA zono Ara nizcupa haYe thAkave, yAte tomAdera prati daYA karA haYa|
tomAra pratipAlakake mane mane vinIta o sazaMkacitte anuccasvare sakAle o sandhyAYa smaraNa karave Ara tumi udAsIna have nA|
yArA tomAra pratipAlakera sAnnidhye Ache tArA ahaMkAravazata tA~ra ‘ivAdate vimukha haYa nA o tA~rai mahimA ghoSaNA kare Ara tA~rai nikaTa sijdAvanata haYa|

loke tomAke yuddhalavdha sampada samvandhe prazna kare; vala, ‘yuddhalavdha sampada AllAh evaM rAsUlera; sutarAM AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM nijedera madhye sadbhAva sthApana kara, Ara AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|’

mu’mina to tArAi, yAdera hRdaYa kampita haYa yakhana AllAhke smaraNa karA haYa evaM yakhana tA~ra AYAta tAdera nikaTa pATha karA haYa, takhana tA tAdera ImAna vRddhi kare Ara tArA tAdera pratipAlakera oparai nirbhara kare,
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami yA diYechi tA hate vyaYa kare;
tArAi prakRta mu’mina| tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tAderai janye raYeche maryAdA, kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
eTA erUpa, yemana tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke nyAYabhAve tomAra gRha hate vera karechilena athaca mu’minadera eka dala eTA pachanda kare nAi|
satya spaSTabhAve prakAzita haoYAra parao tArA tomAra saGge vitarke lipta haYa| mane hacchila tArA yena mRtyura dike cAlita hacche Ara tArA yena tA pratyakSa karache|

smaraNa kara, AllAh tomAderake pratizruti dena ye, dui dalera ekadala tomAdera AYattAdhIna have; athaca tomarA cAcchile, nirastra dalaTi tomAdera AYattAdhIna hoka| Ara AllAh cAcchilena ye, tini satyake tA~ra vANI diYe pratiSThita karena Ara kAphiraderake nirmUla karena;
eTA ejanya ye, tini satyake satya o asatyake asatya pratipanna karena, yadio aparAdhIrA eTA pachanda kare nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa sAhAyya prArthanA karechile; takhana tini tomAderake javAva diYechilena, ‘Ami tomAderake sAhAyya karava eka sahasra pherezatA diYe, yArA ekera para eka Asave|’
AllAh eTA karena kevala zubha saMvAda deoYAra janye Ara e uddezye, yAte tomAdera citta prazAnti lAbha kare; Ara sAhAyya to zudhu AllAh ra nikaTa hatei Ase; nizcaYai AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

smaraNa kara, tini tA~ra pakSa hate svastira janye tomAderake tandrAYa Acchanna karena Ara AkAza hate tomAdera opara vAri varSaNa karena eTA diYe tomAderake pavitra karAra janye, tomAdera madhya hate zaYatAnera kumantraNA apasAraNera janye, tomAdera hRdaYa dRr3ha karAra janye Ara tomAdera pA sthira rAkhAra janye|

smaraNa kara, tomAdera pratipAlaka pherezatAgaNera prati pratyAdeza karena, ‘Ami tomAdera saGge Achi, sutarAM mu’minagaNake avicalita rAkha|’ yArA kupharI kare Ami tAdera hRdaYe bhItira saJcAra karava; sutarAM tomarA AghAta kara tAdera kA~dhe o AghAta kara tAdera pratyeka AGgulera agrabhAge|
eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare Ara keu AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA karale AllAh to zAstidAne kaThora|
sutarAM era AsvAda grahaNa kara evaM kAphiradera janye dojakhera zAsti Ache|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana kAphira vAhinIra sammukhIna have takhana tomarA tAdera pRSThapradarzana karave nA;

sedina yuddha-kauzala avalamvana kiMvA dale sthAna neoYA vyatIta keu tAderake pRSThapradarzana karale se to AllAh ra virAgabhAjana have evaM tAra AzraYa jAhAnnAma, Ara tA kata nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!

tomarA tAderake hatyA kara nAi, AllAhi tAderake hatyA karechena, Ara tumi yakhana nikSepa karechile takhana tumi nikSepa kara nAi, AllAhi nikSepa karechilena, evaM eTA mu’minagaNake AllAh ra pakSa hate uttamarUpe parIkSA karAra janye; AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
eTAi tomAdera janye, AllAh kAphiradera Sar3ayantra durvala karena|

tomarA mImAMsA ceYechile, tA to tomAdera nikaTa eseche; yadi tomarA virata hao tave tA tomAdera janye kalyANakara; yadi tomarA punarAYa kara tAte Amio punarAYa zAsti diva evaM tomAdera dala saMkhyAYa adhika haleo tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA, Ara nizcaYai AllAh mu’minadera saGge Achena|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara Ara tomarA yakhana tAra kathA zunacho takhana tA hate mukha phirio nA;
Ara tomarA tAdera mato haYo nA, yArA vale, ‘zunalAma’, vastuta tArA zone nA|
AllAh ra nikaTa nikRSTatama jIva sei vadhira o mUka yArA kichui vojhe nA|
AllAh yadi tAdera madhye bhAla kichu dekhatena tave tini tAderakeo zunAtena, kintu tini tAderake zunAleo tArA upekSA kare mukha phirAta|

he mu’minagaNa! rAsUla yakhana tomAderake emana kichura dike AhvAna kare yA tomAderake prANavanta kare, takhana AllAh o rAsUlera AhvAne sAr3A dive Ara jene rAkha, AllAh mAnuSa o tAra antarera madhyavartI haYe thAkena, Ara tA~rai nikaTa tomAderake ekatra karA have|
tomarA emana phitnAke bhaYa kara yA vizeSa kare tomAdera madhye yArA jAlima kevala tAderakei kliSTa karave nA evaM jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAh zAstidAne kaThora|

smaraNa kara, tomarA chile svalpasaMkhyaka; pRthivIte tomarA durvalarUpe parigaNita hate| tomarA AzaMkA karate ye, lokerA tomAderake akasmAt dhare niYe yAve| tArapara tini tomAderake AzraYa dena, nija sAhAyya diYe tomAderake zaktizAlI karena evaM tomAderake uttama vastusamUha jIvikArUpe dAna karena, yAte tomarA kRtajJa hao|
he mu’minagaNa! jene-zune AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera saGge vizvAsa bhaMga karave nA Ara tomAdera parasparera AmAnata samparkeo vizvAsa bhaMga kara nA;
Ara jene rAkha, tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati to eka parIkSA Ara AllAh ra i nikaTa mahApuraskAra Ache|

he mu’minagaNa! yadi tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara tave AllAh tomAderake nyAYa-anyAYa pArthakya karAra zakti divena, tomAdera pApa mocana karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA karavena Ara AllAh atizaYa maGgalamaYa|

smaraNa kara, kAphirarA tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra kare tomAke vandI karAra janye, hatyA karAra vA nirvAsita karAra janye evaM tArA Sar3ayantra kare Ara AllAho kauzala karena; Ara AllAhi sarvazreSTha kauzalI|
yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa tArA takhana vale, ‘AmarA to zunalAma, icchA karale AmarAo era anurUpa valate pAri, eTA to zudhu sekAlera lokadera upakathA|’
smaraNa kara, tArA valechila, ‘he AllAh! eTA yadi tomAra pakSa hate satya haYa, tave AmAdera opara AkAza hate prastara varSaNa kara kiMvA AmAderake marmantuda zAsti dAo|’
AllAh emana nana ye, tumi tAdera madhye thAkave, athaca tini tAderake zAsti divena, Ara AllAh emanao nana ye, tArA kSamA prArthanA karave athaca tini tAderake zAsti divena|

evaM tAdera kI vA valAra Ache ye, AllAh tAderake zAsti divena nA, yakhana tArA lokaderake masajidula hArAma hate nivRtta kare? tArA era tattvAvadhAYaka naYa, zudhu muttAkIgaNai era tattvAvadhAYaka; kintu tAdera adhikAMza eTA avagata naYa|
kA‘vAgRhera nikaTa zudhu zisa o karatAli deoYAi tAdera sAlAta, sutarAM kupharIra janye tomarA zAsti bhoga kara|

AllAh ra patha hate lokake nivRtta karAra janye kAphirarA tAdera dhanasampada vyaYa kare, tArA dhana-sampada vyaYa karatei thAkave; tArapara eTA tAdera manastApera kAraNa have; era para tArA parAbhUta have Ara yArA kupharI kare tAderake jAhAnnAme ekatra karA have|
eTA ejanye ye, AllAh kujanake sujana hate pRthaka karavena Ara kujanadera ekake aparera opara rAkhavena, erapara sakalake stUpIkRta kare jAhAnnAme nikSepa karavena, erAi kSatigrasta|
yArA kupharI kare tAderake vala, ‘yadi tArA virata haYa tave yA atIte haYeche AllAh tA kSamA karavena; kintu tArA yadi anyAYera punarAvRtti kare tave pUrvavartIdera dRSTAnta to Ache|

evaM tomarA tAdera viruddhe saMgrAma karate thAkave yatakSaNa nA phitnA dUrIbhUta haYa evaM AllAh ra dIna sAmagrikabhAve pratiSThita haYa Ara yadi tArA virata haYa tave tArA yA kare AllAh to tAra samyaka draSTA|
yadi tArA mukha phirAYa tave jene rAkha, AllAhi tomAdera abhibhAvaka; kata uttama abhibhAvaka o kata uttama sAhAyyakArI!

Arao jene rAkha, yuddhe yA tomarA lAbha kara tAra eka-paJcamAMza AllAh ra, rAsUlera, rAsUlera svajanadera, iYAtImadera, misakInadera o musAphiradera, yadi tomarA ImAna rAkha AllAhe Ara tAte yA mImAMsAra dina Ami AmAra vAndAra prati avatIrNa karechilAma, yedina dui dala parasparera sammukhIna haYechila Ara AllAh sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|

smaraNa kara, tomarA chile upatyakAra nikaTaprAnte evaM tArA chila dUraprAnte Ara uSTrArohI dala chila tomAdera apekSA niæbhUmite| yadi tomarA parasparera madhye yuddha samparke kona siddhAnta karate icchA karata tave e siddhAnta samparke tomAdera madhye matabheda ghaTata| kintu yA ghaTAra chila, AllAh tA sampanna karalena, yAte ye keu dhvaMsa have se yena satyAsatya spaSTa prakAzera para dhvaMsa haYa evaM ye jIvita thAkave se yena satyAsatya spaSTa prakAzera para jIvita thAke; AllAh to sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

smaraNa kara, AllAh tomAke svapeè dekhiYechilena ye, tArA saMkhyAYa alpa; yadi tomAke dekhAtena, tArA saMkhyAYa adhika tave tomarA sAhasa hArAte Ara yuddha viSaYe nijedera madhye virodha sRSTi karate| kintu AllAh tomAderake rakSA karechilena Ara antare yA Ache se samvandhe tini vizeSabhAve avahita|

smaraNa kara, tomarA yakhana parasparera sammukhIna haYechile takhana tini tAderake tomAdera dRSTite svalpasaMkhyaka dekhiYechilena evaM tomAderake tAdera dRSTite svalpasaMkhyaka dekhiYechilena, yA ghaTivAra chila tA sampanna karAra janye| samasta viSaYa AllAh ra dikei pratyAvartita haYa|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana kona dalera sammukhIna have takhana avicala thAkave Ara AllAhke adhika smaraNa karave, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|

tomarA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave o nijedera madhye vivAda karave nA; karale tomarA sAhasa hArAve Ara tomAdera zakti vilupta have| tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara; nizcaYai AllAh dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|
tomarA tAdera nyAYa haYo nA yArA dambhabhare o loka dekhAnora janye nija gRha hate vera haYechila Ara lokake AllAh ra patha hate nivRtta kare| tArA yA kare AllAh tA pariveSTana kare Achena|

smaraNa kara, zaYatAna yakhana tAdera kAryAvalI tAdera dRSTite zobhana karechila Ara valechila, ‘Aja mAnuSera madhye keui tomAdera opara vijaYI have nA, Ami tomAdera pAzei thAkava;’ tArapara dui dala yakhana parasparera sammukhIna hala takhana se pichane sare par3ala o valala, ‘tomAdera saGge AmAra kona samparka thAkala nA, tomarA yA dekhate pAo nA Ami to tA dekhi, nizcaYai Ami AllAhke bhaYa kari,’ Ara AllAh zAstidAne kaThora|
smaraNa kara, munAphika o yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA vale, ‘edera dIna ederake vibhrAnta kareche|’ keu AllAh ra opara nirbhara karale AllAh to parAkrAnta o prajJAmaYa|
tumi yadi dekhate pete pherezatAgaNa kAphiradera mukhamaNDale o pRSThadeze AghAta kare tAdera prANa haraNa karache Ara valache, ‘tomarA dahanayantraNA bhoga kara|’
eTA tA, tomAdera hAta yA pUrve preraNa karechila, AllAh to tAra vAndAdera prati atyAcArI nana|

phira‘Aonera svajana o edera pUrvavartIdera abhyAsera nyAYa erA AllAh ra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna kare; sutarAM AllAh edera pApera janye ederake zAsti dena| nizcaYai AllAh zaktimAna, zAstidAne kaThora;

eTA ejanye ye, yadi kona sampradAYa nijera avasthAra parivartana nA kare tave AllAh emana nana ye, tini ederake ye sampada dAna karechena, tA parivartana karavena; Ara nizcaYai AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

phira‘Aonera svajana o tAdera pUrvavartIdera abhyAsera nyAYa erA edera pratipAlakera nidarzanake asvIkAra kare| tAdera pApera janye Ami tAderake dhvaMsa karechi evaM phira‘Aonera svajanake nimajjita karechi Ara tArA sakalei chila jAlima|
AllAh ra nikaTa nikRSTa jIva tArAi yArA kupharI kare evaM ImAna Ane nA|
edera madhye tumi yAdera saGge cuktite Avaddha, tArA pratyekavAra tAdera cukti bhaGga kare o tArA sAvadhAna haYa nA;
yuddhe ederake tomarA yadi tomAdera AYatte pAo tave ederake edera pichane yArA Ache, tAdera hate vicchinna kare emanabhAve vidhvasta karave, yAte erA zikSA lAbha kare|
yadi tumi kona sampradAYera cuktibhaGgera AzaMkA kara tave tomAra cuktio tumi yathAyatha vAtila karave; nizcaYai AllAh cukti bhaGgakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
kAphirarA yena kakhanao mane nA kare ye, tArA paritrANa peYeche; nizcaYai tArA mu’minagaNake hatavala karate pArave nA|

tomarA tAdera mukAvilAra janye yathAsAdhya zakti o azva vAhinI prastuta rAkhave| era mAdhyame tomarA santrasta karave AllAh ra zatruke, tomAdera zatruke evaM etadvyatIta anyaderake yAderake tomarA jAna nA, AllAh tAderake jAnena| AllAh ra pathe tomarA yA kichu vyaYa karave tAra pUrNapratidAna tomAderake deoYA have Ara tomAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
tArA yadi sandhira dike jhu~ke par3e tave tumio sandhira dike jhu~kave Ara AllAh ra opara nirbhara karave; tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yadi tArA tomAke pratArita karate cAYa tave tomAra janye AllAhi yatheSTa; tini tomAke nija sAhAyya o mu’minadera mAdhyame zaktizAlI karechena,

evaM tini edera parasparera hRdaYera madhye prIti sthApana karechena| pRthivIra yAvatIYa sampada vyaYa karaleo tumi tAdera hRdaYe prIti sthApana karate pArate nA; kintu AllAh tAdera madhye prIti sthApana karechena; nizcaYai tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he navI! tomAra janye o tomAra anusArI mu’minadera janye AllAhi yatheSTa|

he navI! mu’minaderake yuddhera janye udvuddha kara; tomAdera madhye kur3ijana dhairyazIla thAkale tArA dui zata janera opara vijaYI have evaM tomAdera madhye eka zata jana thAkale eka sahasra kAphirera opara vijaYI have| kAraNa tArA emana eka sampradAYa, yAra vodhazakti nei|

AllAh ekhana tomAdera bhAra lAghava karalena| tini avagata Achena ye, tomAdera madhye durvalatA Ache; sutarAM tomAdera madhye eka zata jana dhairyazIla thAkale tArA dui zata janera opara vijaYI have| Ara tomAdera madhye eka sahasra thAkale AllAh ra anujJAkrame tArA dui sahasrera opara vijaYI have| AllAh dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|

deze vyApakabhAve zatruke parAbhUta nA karA paryanta vandI rAkhA kona navIra janye saMgata naYa| tomarA kAmanA kara pArthiva sampada Ara AllAh cAna paralokera kalyANa; AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
AllAh ra pUrva vidhAna nA thAkale tomarA yA grahaNa karecha tAra janye tomAdera opara mahAzAsti Apatita hata|
yuddhe yA tomarA lAbha karecha tA vaidha o uttama vale bhoga kara Ara AllAhke bhaYa kara; AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he navI! tomAdera karAYatta yuddhavandIderake vala, ‘AllAh yadi tomAdera hRdaYe bhAla kichu dekhena tave tomAdera nikaTa hate yA neoYA haYeche tA apekSA uttama kichu tini tomAderake dAna karavena Ara tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
tArA tomAra saGge vizvAsa bhaGga karate cAile, tArA to pUrve AllAh ra saGgeo vizvAsa bhaGga kareche; erapara tini tomAderake tAdera opara zaktizAlI karechena| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche, nijedera jIvana o sampada diYe AllAh ra pathe jihAda kareche; Ara yArA AzraYa dAna kareche o sAhAyya kareche tArA paraspara parasparera vandhu| Ara yArA ImAna eneche kintu hijarata kare nAi, hijarata nA karA paryanta tAdera abhibhAvakatvera dAYitva tomAdera nei; Ara dIna samvandhe yadi tArA tomAdera sAhAyya prArthanA kare tave tAderake sAhAyya karA tomAdera kartavya, kintu ye sampradAYa o tomAdera madhye cukti raYeche tAdera viruddhe naYa| tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|
yArA kupharI kareche tArA paraspara parasparera vandhu, yadi tomarA tA nA kara tave deze phitnA o mahAviparyaYa dekhA dive|
yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche o AllAh ra pathe jihAda kareche Ara yArA AzraYa dAna kareche o sAhAyya kareche, tArAi prakRta mu’mina; tAdera janye kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA raYeche|

yArA pare ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche o tomAdera saGge theke jihAda kareche tArAo tomAdera antarbhukta Ara AtmIYagaNa AllAh ra vidhAne eke anya apekSA adhika hakadAra| nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe samyaka avahita|
eTi samparkaccheda AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa hate sei samasta muzarikadera saGge yAdera saGge tomarA pArasparika cuktite Avaddha haYechile|
ataHpara tomarA deze cAra mAsakAla paribhramaNa kara o jene rAkha, tomarA AllAhke hInavala karate pArave nA Ara nizcaYai AllAh kAphiradera lAJchita kare thAkena|

mahAna hajjera divase AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa hate mAnuSera prati eTA eka ghoSaNA ye, nizcaYai muzarikadera samparke AllAh dAYamukta evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| tomarA yadi taovA kara tave tA tomAdera janye kalyANakara| Ara tomarA yadi mukha phirAo tave jene rAkha, tomarA AllAhke hInavala karate pArave nA Ara kAphiraderake marmantuda zAstira saMvAda dAo,

tave muzarikadera madhye yAdera saGge tomarA cuktite Avaddha o pare yArA tomAdera cukti rakSAYa kona truTi kare nAi Ara tomAdera viruddhe kAukeo sAhAyya kare nAi, tAdera saGge nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta cukti pUrNa karave; nizcaYai AllAh muttAkIderake pachandakarena|

ataHpara niSiddha mAsasamUha ativAhita hale muzarikaderake yekhAne pAve hatyA karave, tAderake vandI karave, avarodha karave Ara pratyeka ghA~Tite tAdera janye OMt pete thAkave| kintu yadi tArA taovA kare, sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa tave tAdera patha cher3e dive; nizcaYai AllAh atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
muzarikadera madhye keu tomAra kAche AzraYa prArthanA karale tumi tAke AzraYa dive yAte se AllAh ra vANI zunate pAYa; erapara tAke tAra nirApada sthAne peৗ~che dive; kAraNa tArA ajJa loka|

AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera nikaTa muzarikadera cukti ki kare valavat thAkave? tave yAdera saGge masajidula hArAmera sannikaTe tomarA pArasparika cuktite Avaddha haYechile, yAvat tArA tomAdera cuktite sthira thAkave tomarAo tAdera cuktite sthira thAkave; nizcaYai AllAh muttAkIderake pachandakarena|

kemana kare thAkave? tArA yadi tomAdera opara jaYI haYa, tave tArA tomAdera AtmIYatAra o aGgIkArera kona maryAdA dive nA; tArA mukhe tomAderake santuSTa rAkhe; kintu tAdera hRdaYa tA asvIkAra kare; tAdera adhikAMza satyatyAgI|
tArA AllAh ra AYAtasamUha tuccha mUlye vikraYa kare evaM tArA lokaderake tA~ra patha hate nivRtta kare; nizcaYai tArA yA kare thAke tA ati nikRSTa!
tArA kona mu’minera saGge AtmIYatAra o aGgIkArera maryAdA rakSA kare nA, tArAi sImAlaMghanakArI|
ataHpara tArA yadi taovA kare, sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa tave tArA tomAdera dInI bhAi; jJAnI sampradAYera janye Ami nidarzana spaSTarUpe vivRta kari|

tAdera cuktira para tArA yadi tAdera pratizruti bhaGga kare Ara tomAdera dIna samvandhe vidrupa kare tave kAphiradera pradhAnadera saGge yuddha kara; erA emana loka yAdera kona pratizruti thAkala nA; yena tArA nivRtta haYa|

tomarA ki sei sampradAYera saGge yuddha karave nA, yArA nijedera pratizruti bhaGga kareche o rAsUlake vahiSkArera janye saMkalpa kareche? erAi prathama tomAdera viruddhAcaraNa kareche| tomarA ki tAderake bhaYa kara? AllAhke bhaYa karAi tomAdera pakSe adhika samIcIna, yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|
tomarA tAdera saGge yuddha karave| tomAdera hAte AllAh ederake zAsti divena, ederake lAJchita karavena, edera opara tomAderake vijaYI karavena o mu’minadera citta prazAnta karavena,
evaM tini edera antarera kSobha dUra karavena| AllAh yAke icchA tAra prati kSamAparAYaNa hana, AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA ki mane kara ye, tomAderake emani cher3e deoYA have yakhana paryanta AllAh nA prakAza karena tomAdera madhye kAhArA mujAhida evaM kAhArA AllAh, tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minagaNa vyatIta anya kAukeo antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa kare nAi? tomarA yA kara, se samvandhe AllAh savizeSa avahita|

muzarikarA yakhana nijerAi nijedera kupharI svIkAra kare takhana tArA AllAh ra masajidera rakSaNAvekSaNa karave- emana hate pAre nA| erA emana, yAdera samasta karma vyartha haYeche evaM tArA dojakhei sthAYibhAve avasthAna karave|

tArAi to AllAh ra masajidera rakSaNAvekSaNa karave, yArA ImAna Ane AllAh o AkhirAte Ara sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AllAh vyatIta anya kAukeo bhaYa kare nA| kAjei AzA karA yAYa, tArA have satpathaprAptadera antarbhukta|

hAjIdera janye pAni saravarAha Ara masajidula hArAmera rakSaNAvekSaNa karAke tomarA ki tAdera puNyera samajJAna kara, yArA AllAh o AkhirAte ImAna Ane evaM AllAhra pathe jihAda kare? AllAh ra nikaTa erA samatulya naYa| AllAh jAlima sampradAYake satpatha pradarzana karena nA|
yArA ImAna Ane, hijarata kare Ara nijedera sampada o nijedera jIvana diYe AllAh ra pathe jihAda kare tArA AllAh ra nikaTa maryAdAYa zreSTha, Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
edera pratipAlaka ederake susaMvAda dicchena nija daYA o santoSera Ara jAnnAtera, yekhAne Ache tAdera janye sthAYI sukha-zAnti|
sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have| nizcaYai AllAh ra nikaTa Ache mahApuraskAra|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera pitA o bhAi yadi ImAnera mukAvilAYa kupharIke zreYa jJAna kare, tave ederake antaraGgarUpe grahaNa kara nA| tomAdera madhye yArA ederake antaraGgarUpe grahaNa kare, tArAi jAlima|

vala, ‘tomAdera nikaTa yadi AllAh, tA~ra rAsUla Ara AllAh ra pathe jihAda karA apekSA adhika priYa haYa tomAdera pitA, tomAdera santAna, tomAdera bhAi, tomAdera strI, tomAdera svagoSThI, tomAdera arjita sampada, tomAdera vyavasA-vANijya-yAra mandA par3Ara AzaMkA kara evaM tomAdera vAsasthAna -yA tomarA bhAlavAsa, tave apekSA kara AllAh ra nirdeza AsA paryanta|’ AllAh satyatyAgI sampradAYake satpatha pradarzana karena nA|

AllAh tomAderake to sAhAyya karechena vahu kSetre Ara hunAYanera yuddhera dine yakhana tomAderake utphulla karechila tomAdera saMkhyAdhikya; kintu eTA tomAdera kona kAje Ase nAi evaM vistRta haoYA sattveo pRthivI tomAdera janye saMkucita haYechila, pare tomarA pRSThapradarzana kare palAYana karechile|

ataHpara AllAh tA~ra nikaTa hate tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minadera opara prazAnti varSaNa karena evaM emana eka sainyavAhinI avatIrNa karena yA tomarA dekhate pAo nAi Ara tini kAphiraderake zAsti pradAna karena; eTAi kAphiradera karmaphala|
era parao yAra prati icchA AllAh kSamAparAYaNa havena; AllAh ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa! muzarikarA to apavitra; sutarAM ei vatsarera para tArA yena masajidula hArAmera nikaTa nA Ase| yadi tomarA dAridryera AzaGkA kara tave AllAh icchA karale tA~ra nija karuNAYa tomAderake abhAvamukta karavena| nizcaYai AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yAdera prati kitAva avatIrNa haYeche tAdera madhye yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane nA, zeSadineo naYa Ara AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla yA hArAma karechena tA hArAma gaNya kare nA evaM satya dIna anusaraNa kare nA, tAdera saGge yuddha karave, ye paryanta nA tArA nata haYe nija hAte jiyiYA deYa|

iYAha‚dIrA vale, ‘uyAYara AllAh ra putra’ Ara khrisTAnarA vale, ‘masIh AllAh ra putra|’ eTA tAdera mukhera kathA| pUrve yArA kupharI karechila erA tAdera mata kathA vale| AllAh ederake dhvaMsa karuna| Ara kon dike tAderake phiriYe deoYA haYeche!

tArA AllAh vyatIta tAdera paNDitagaNake o saMsAra-virAgigaNake tAdera prabhurUpe grahaNa kareche Ara mAraiYAma-tanaYa masIhkeo| kintu erA eka ilAhera ‘ivAdata karAra janyei AdiSTa haYechila| tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| tArA yAke zarIka kare tA hate tini kata pavitra!
tArA tAdera mukhera phutkAre AllAh ra jyoti nirvApita karate cAYa| kAphirarA aprItikara mane karaleo AllAh tA~ra jyotira pUrNa udbhAsana vyatIta anya kichu cAna nA|
muzarikarA aprItikara mane karaleo apara samasta dInera opara jaYayukta karAra janye tinii pathanirdeza o satya dInasaha tA~ra rAsUla preraNa karechena|

he mu’minagaNa! paNDita o saMsAra virAgIdera madhye anekei lokera dhana-sampada anyAYabhAve bhoga kare thAke evaM lokake AllAh ra patha hate nivRtta kare| Ara yArA svarNa o raupya puJjIbhUta kare evaM tA AllAh ra pathe vyaYa kare nA tAderake marmantuda zAstira saMvAda dAo|

yedina jAhAnnAmera agnite tA uttapta karA have Ara eTA diYe tAdera lalATa, pArzvadeza o pRSThadeze dAga deoYA have sedina valA have, ‘eTAi tA yA tomarA nijedera janye puJjIbhUta karate| sutarAM tomarA yA puJjIbhUta karechile tA AsvAdana kara|’

nizcaYai AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTira dina hatei AllAh ra vidhAne AllAh ra nikaTa mAsa gaNanAYa mAsa vAraTi; tanmadhye cAraTi niSiddha mAsa, eTAi supratiSThita vidhAna| sutarAM era madhye tomarA nijedera prati juluma kara nA Ara tomarA muzarikadera saGge sarvAtmakabhAve yuddha karave, yemana tArA tomAdera viruddhe sarvAtmakabhAve yuddha kare thAke| Ara jene rAkha, AllAh to muttAkIdera saGge Achena|

ei ye mAsake pichiYe deoYA kevala kupharI vRddhi karA, yA diYe kAphiraderake vibhrAnta karA haYa| tArA eke kona vatsara vaidha kare evaM kona vatsara avaidha kare yAte tArA AllAh yeigulike niSiddha karechena, seigulira gaNanA pUrNa karate pAre; anantara AllAh yA hArAma karechena tA hAlAla karate pAre| tAdera manda kAjaguli tAdera janye zobhanIYa karA haYeche| AllAh kAphira sampradAYake satpatha pradarzana karena nA|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera kI hala ye, tomAderake yakhana AllAh ra pathe abhiyAne vera hate valA haYa takhana tomarA bhArAkrAnta haYe bhUtale jhu~ke par3a? tomarA ki AkhirAtera parivarte pArthiva jIvane parituSTa haYecha? AkhirAtera tulanAYa pArthiva jIvanera bhogera upakaraNa to akiJcitkara!

yadi tomarA abhiyAne vera nA hao, tave tini tomAderake marmantuda zAsti divena evaM apara jAtike tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena Ara tomarA tA~ra konai kSati karate pArave nA| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yadi tomarA tAke sAhAyya nA kara, tave AllAh to tAke sAhAyya karechilena yakhana kAphirarA tAke vahiSkAra karechila Ara se chila duijanera dvitIYa jana, yakhana tArA ubhaYe guhAra madhye chila; se takhana tAra saGgIke valechila, ‘viSaNNa haYo nA, AllAh to AmAdera saGge Achena|’ erapara AllAh tA~ra opara tA~ra prazAnti varSaNa karena evaM tAke zaktizAlI karena emana eka sainyavAhinI diYe yA tomarA dekha nAi; Ara tini kAphiradera kathA heYa karena| AllAh ra kathAi sarveApari evaM AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
abhiyAne vera haYe par3a, hAlakA avasthAYa hoka vA bhAri avasthAYa, evaM saMgrAma kara AllAh ra pathe tomAdera sampada o jIvana diYe| eTAi tomAdera janye zreYa, yadi tomarA jAnate!

Azu sampada lAbhera sambhAvanA thAkale o saphara sahaja hale erA nizcaYai tomAra anusaraNa karata; kintu edera nikaTa yAtrApatha sudIrgha mane hala| erA acirei AllAh ra nAme zapatha kare valave, ‘pArale AmarA nizcaYai tomAdera saGge vera hatAma|’ erA nijederakei dhvaMsa kare| AllAh jAnena erA avazyai mithyAcArI|
AllAh tomAke kSamA karechena| kAhArA satyavAdI tA tomAra nikaTa spaSTa nA haoYA paryanta evaM kAhArA mithyAvAdI tA nA jAnA paryanta tumi kena tAderake avyAhati dile?
yArA AllAhe o zeSa divase ImAna Ane tArA nija sampada o jIvana diYe jihAde avyAhati pAoYAra prArthanA tomAra nikaTa kare nA| AllAh muttAkIdera samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
tomAra nikaTa avyAhati prArthanA kare kevala tArAi yArA AllAh o zeSa divase ImAna Ane nA evaM yAdera citta saMzaYayukta| erA to Apana saMzaYe dvidhAgrasta|

erA vera hate icchA karale erA nizcaYai era janye prastutira vyavasthA karata, kintu edera abhiyAtrA AllAh ra manaHpUta chila nA| sutarAM tini ederake virata rAkhena evaM ederake valA haYa, ‘yArA vase Ache tAdera saGge vase thAka|’

tArA tomAdera saGge vera hale tomAdera vibhrAntii vRddhi karata Ara tomAdera madhye phitanA sRSTira uddezye tomAdera madhye chuTAchuTi karata| tomAdera madhye edera janye kathA zunAra loka Ache| AllAh jAlimadera samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
pUrveo erA phitnA sRSTi karate ceYechila o erA tomAra vahu karme ulaTa-pAlaTa karechila yatakSaNa nA edera icchAra viruddhe satya elo Ara AllAh ra Adeza vijaYI hala|
evaM edera madhye emana loka Ache ye vale, ‘AmAke avyAhati dAo evaM AmAke phitnAYa phelio nA|’ sAvadhAna! erAi phitanAte par3e Ache| jAhAnnAma to kAphiraderake veSTana karei Ache|
tomAra maGgala hale tA tAderake pIr3A deYa evaM tomAra vipada ghaTile erA vale, ‘AmarA to pUrvAhnei AmAdera vyApAre satarkatA avalamvana karechilAma’ evaM erA utphullacitte sare par3e|
vala, ‘AmAdera janye AllAh yA nirdiSTa karechena tA vyatIta AmAdera anya kichu have nA; tini AmAdera karmavidhAYaka Ara AllAh ra oparai mu’minadera nirbhara karA ucita|’

vala, ‘tomarA AmAdera duiTi maGgalera ekaTira pratIkSA karacho Ara AmarA pratIkSA karachi, AllAh tomAderake zAsti divena sarAsari nija pakSa hate vA AmAdera hAta diYe| kAjei tomarA pratIkSA kara, AmarAo tomAdera saGge pratIkSA karachi|’
vala, ‘tomarA svecchAYa vyaYa kara vA anicchAYa, tomAdera nikaTa hate tA kichutei gRhIta have nA; tomarA to satyatyAgI sampradAYa|’
edera arthasAhAyya grahaNa karA niSedha karA haYeche eijanye ye, erA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlake asvIkAra kare, sAlAte zaithilyera saGge upasthita haYa evaM anicchAkRtabhAve artha sAhAyya kare|
sutarAM edera sampada o santAna-santati tomAke yena vimugdha nA kare, AllAh to era diYei ederake pArthiva jIvane zAsti dite cAna| erA kAphira thAkA avasthAYa edera AtmA deha tyAga karave|
tArA AllAh ra nAme zapatha kare ye, tArA tomAderai antarbhukta, kintu tArA tomAdera antarbhukta naYa, vastuta tArA emana eka sampradAYa yArA bhaYa kare thAke|
erA kona AzraYasthala, kona giriguhA vA kona pravezasthala pele seTAra dike palAYana karave kSipragatite|

edera madhye emana loka Ache, ye sAdAkA vaNTana samparke tomAke doSAropa kare; ataHpara tAra kichu ederake deoYA hale tArA parituSTa haYa, Ara eTAra kichu tAderake nA deoYA hale tatkSaNAt tArA vikSuvdha haYa|

bhAla hata yadi tArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla tAderake yA diYechena tAte parituSTa hata evaM valata, ‘AllAhi AmAdera janye yatheSTa, acirei AllAh AmAderake divena nija karuNAYa evaM tA~ra rAsUlao; AmarA AllAh ra i prati anurakta|’

sAdAkA to kevala niHsva, abhAvagrasta o tatsaMziSTa karmacArIdera janye, yAdera citta AkarSaNa karA haYa tAdera janye, dAsamuktira janye, RNa bhArAkrAntadera, AllAh ra pathe o musAphiradera janye| eTA AllAh ra vidhAna| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara edera madhye emanao loka Ache yArA navIke kleza deYa evaM vale, ‘se to karNapAtakArI|’ vala, ‘tAra kAna tomAdera janye yA maGgala tAi zune|’ se AllAhe ImAna Ane evaM mu’minaderake vizvAsa kare; tomAdera madhye yArA mu’mina se tAdera janye rahamata Ara yArA AllAh ra rAsUlake kleza deYa tAdera janye Ache marmantuda zAsti|
tArA tomAderake santuSTa karAra janye tomAdera nikaTa AllAh ra zapatha kare| AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla erai adhika hakadAra ye, tArA tAderakei santuSTa kare, yadi tArA mu’mina haYa|
erA ki jAne nA, ye vyakti AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare tAra janye to Ache jAhAnnAmera agni, yekhAne se sthAYI have? eTAi carama lAJchanA|
munAphikerA bhaYa kare, tAdera samparke emana eka sUrA nA avatIrNa haYa, yA tAdera antarera kathA vyakta kare dive! vala, ‘vidrupa karate thAka; tomarA yA bhaYa kara AllAh tA prakAza kare divena|’
Ara tumi tAderake prazna karale tArA nizcaYai valave, ‘AmarA to AlApa-AlocanA o krIr3A-kautuka karachilAma|’ vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAh, tA~hAra nidarzana o tA~ra rAsUlake vidrupa karachile?’
‘tomarA doSa skhAlanera ceSTA kara nA| tomarA to ImAna AnAra para kupharI karecha| tomAdera madhye kona dalake kSamA karaleo anya dalake zAsti diva-kAraNa tArA aparAdhI|’

munAphika nara o munAphika nArI eke aparera anurUpa, tArA asatkarmera nirdeza deYa evaM satkarma niSedha kare, erA hAtavaddha kare rAkhe, tArA AllAhke vismRta haYeche, phale tinio tAderake vismRta haYechena; munAphikerA to pApAcArI|

munAphika nara, munAphika nArI o kAphiraderake AllAh pratizruti diYechena jAhAnnAmera agnira, yekhAne tArA sthAYI have, eTAi tAdera janye yatheSTa evaM AllAh tAderake lA‘nata karechena Ara tAdera janye raYeche sthAYI zAsti;

tomarAo tomAdera pUrvavartIdera mata yArA zaktite tomAdera apekSA pravala chila Ara yAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati chila tomAdera apekSA adhika, evaM tArA tAdera bhAgye yA chila tA bhoga kareche; tomAdera bhAgye yA chila tomarAo tA bhoga karale, yemana tomAdera pUrvavartIrA tAdera bhAgye yA chila tA bhoga kareche| tArA yeirUpa anarthaka AlApa-AlocanAYa lipta chila tomarAo seirUpa AlApa-AlocanAYa lipta Acha| erAi tArA yAdera karma duniYA o AkhirAte vyartha evaM erAi kSatigrasta|

tAdera pUrvavartI nUh, ‘Ada o sAmUdera sampradAYa, ivrAhImera sampradAYa evaM mAdiYAna o vidhvasta nagarera adhivAsIdera saMvAda ki tAdera nikaTa Ase nAi? edera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzanasaha tAdera rAsUlagaNa esechila| AllAh emana nana ye, tAdera opara juluma karena, kintu erA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma kare|

mu’mina nara o mu’mina nArI eke aparera vandhu, tArA satkAjera nirdeza deYa evaM asatkAja niSedha kare, sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare; ederakei AllAh kRpA karavena| nizcaYai AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAh mu’mina nara o mu’mina nArIke pratizruti diYechena jAnnAtera- yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita, yekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM sthAYI jAnnAte uttama vAsasthAnera| AllAh ra santuSTii sarvazreSTha Ara eTAi mahAsAphalya|
he navI! kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe jihAda kara o edera prati kaThora hao; edera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma, uhA kata nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!

tArA AllAh ra zapatha kare ye, tArA kichu vale nAi; kintu tArA to kupharIra kathA valeche evaM isalAma grahaNera para tArA kAphira haYeche; tArA yA saMkalpa karechila tA pAYa nAi| AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla nija kRpAYa tAderake abhAvamukta karechilena valei tArA virodhitA karechila| tArA taovA karale edera janye bhAla have, kintu tArA mukha phiriYe nile AllAh duniYAYa o AkhirAte ederake marmantuda zAsti divena; pRthivIte edera kona abhiAbhAvaka nei evaM kona sAhAyyakArIo nei|
edera madhye keu keu AllAh ra nikaTa aGgIkAra karechila, ‘AllAh nija kRpAYa AmAderake dAna karale AmarA nizcaYai sAdAkA diva evaM avazyai satkarmazIladera antarbhukta hava|’
ataHpara yakhana tini nija kRpAYa tAderake dAna karalena, takhana tArA ei viSaYe kArpaNya karala evaM viruddhabhAvApanna haYe mukha phirAila|
pariNAme tini edera antare kapaTatA sthita karalena, AllAh ra saGge tAdera sAkSAt-divasa paryanta, kAraNa tArA AllAh ra nikaTa ye aGgIkAra karechila tA bhaGga karechila; kAraNa tArA chila mithyAcArI|
erA ki jAnata nA ye, tAdera antarera gopana kathA o tAdera gopana parAmarza AllAh avazyai jAnena Ara yA adRzya tAo tini vizeSabhAve jAnena?

mu’minadera madhye yArA svataHspha‚rtabhAve sAdAkA deYa evaM yArA nija zrama vyatireke kichui pAYa nA, tAderake yArA doSAropa kare o vidrupa kare, AllAh tAderake vidrupa karena, tAdera janye Ache marmantuda zAsti|

tumi tAdera janye kSamA prArthanA kara vA tAdera janye kSamA prArthanA nA kara ekai kathA; tumi sattara vAra tAdera janye kSamA prArthanA karaleo AllAh tAderake kakhanai kSamA karavena nA| eTA eijanye ye, tArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera saGge kupharI kareche| AllAh pApAcArI sampradAYake satpatha pradarzana karena nA|

yArA pechane theke gela tArA AllAh ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare vase thAkAtei Anandavodha karala Ara tAdera dhana-sampada o jIvana diYe AllAh ra pathe jihAda karA apachanda karala evaM tArA valala, ‘garamera madhye abhiyAne vera haYo nA|’ vala, ‘uttApe jAhAnnAmera Aguna pracaNDatama’, yadi tArA vujhata!
kAjei tArA kiJcit hese nika, tArA pracura kA~dave, tAdera kRtakarmera phalasvarUpa|

AllAh yadi tomAke edera kona dalera nikaTa pherata Anena Ara erA abhiyAne vera haoYAra janye tomAra anumati prArthanA kare, takhana tumi valave, ‘tomarA to AmAra saGge kakhanao vera have nA Ara tomarA AmAra saGgI haYe kakhanao zatrura saGge yuddha karave nA| tomarA to prathamavAra vase thAkAi pachanda karechile; sutarAM yArA pichane thAke tAdera saGge vasei thAka|’

tAdera madhye kArao mRtyu hale tumi kakhanao tAra janye jAnAyAra sAlAta par3ave nA evaM tAra kavara-pArzve dA~r3Ave nA; erA to AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlake asvIkAra karechila Ara pApAcArI avasthAYa tAdera mRtyu haYeche|
sutarAM tAdera sampada o santAna-santati tomAke yena vimugdha nA kare; AllAh to eTA diYei tAderake pArthiva jIvane zAsti dite cAna; tArA kAphira thAkA avasthAYa edera AtmA dehatyAga karave|

‘AllAh ra opara ImAna Ana evaM rAsUlera saGgI haYe jihAda kara’-ei marme yakhana kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa takhana tAdera madhye yAdera zakti-sAmarthya Ache tArA tomAra nikaTa avyAhati cAYa evaM vale, ‘AmAderake rehAi dAo, yArA vase thAke AmarA tAdera saGgei thAkava|’
tArA antaHpuravAsinIdera saGge avasthAna karAi pachanda kareche evaM tAdera antara mohara karA haYeche; phale tArA vujhate pAre nA|
kintu rAsUla evaM yArA tAra saGge ImAna enechila tArA nija sampada o jIvana diYe AllAh ra pathe jihAda kareche; tAdera janyei kalyANa Ache evaM tArAi saphalakAma|
AllAh tAdera janye prastuta kare rekhechena jAnnAta, yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita, yekhAne tArA sthAYI have; eTAi mahAsAphalya|

maruvAsIdera madhye kichu loka ajuhAta peza karate ela yena tAderake avyAhati deoYA haYa evaM yArA vase thAkala tArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera saGge mithyA valechila, tAdera madhye yArA kupharI kareche tAdera marmantuda zAsti havei|

yArA durvala, yArA pIr3ita evaM yArA arthasAhAyye asamartha, tAdera kona aparAdha nei, yadi AllAh o rAsUlera prati tAdera avimizra anurAga thAke| yArA satkarmaparAYaNa tAdera viruddhe abhiyogera kona kAraNa nei; AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tAderao kona aparAdha nei yArA tomAra nikaTa vAhanera janye Asale tumi valechile, ‘tomAdera janye kona vAhana Ami pAcchi nA’; tArA arthavyaYe asAmarthyajanita duHkhe azruvigalita naYane phire gela|

yArA abhAvamukta haYeo avyAhati prArthanA kareche, avazyai tAdera viruddhe abhiyogera kAraNa Ache| tArA antaHpuravAsinIdera saGge thAkAi pachanda karechila; AllAh tAdera antara mohara kare diYechena, phale tArA vujhate pAre nA!

tomarA tAdera nikaTa phire ele tArA tomAdera nikaTa ajuhAta peza karave| vala, ‘ajuhAta peza kara nA, AmarA tomAderake kakhanao vizvAsa karava nA; AllAh AmAderake tomAdera khavara jAniYe diYechena Ara AllAh avazyai tomAdera kAryakalApa lakSya karavena evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| tArapara yini adRzya o dRzyera parijJAtA tA~ra nikaTa tomAderake pratyAvartita karA have Ara tini tomarA yA karate, tA tomAderake jAniYe divena|’

tomarA tAdera nikaTa phire Asale acirei tArA AllAh ra zapatha karave yAte tomarA tAdera upekSA kara| sutarAM tomarA tAderake upekSA karave; tArA apavitra o tAdera kRtakarmera phalasvarUpa jAhAnnAma tAdera AvAsasthala|
tArA tomAdera nikaTa zapatha karave yAte tomarA tAdera prati tuSTa hao| tomarA tAdera prati tuSTa haleo AllAh to satyatyAgI sampradAYera prati tuSTa havena nA|
kupharI o kapaTatAYa maruvAsIrA kaThoratara; Ara AllAh tA~hAra rAsUlera prati yA avatIrNa karechena, tAra sImArekhA samparke ajJa thAkAra yogyatA edera adhika| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
maruvAsIdera keu keu, yA tArA AllAh ra pathe vyaYa kare tA arthadaNDa vale gaNya kare evaM tomAdera bhAgya viparyaYera pratIkSA kare| manda bhAgyacakra tAderai hoka| AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

maruvAsIdera keu keu AllAhe o parakAle ImAna rAkhe evaM yA vyaYa kare tAke AllAh ra sAnnidhya o rAsUlera du‘A lAbhera upAYa mane kare| vAstavikai tA tAdera janye AllAh ra sAnnidhya lAbhera upAYa; AllAh tAderake nija rahamate dAkhila karavena| nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

muhAjira o AnasAradera madhye yArA prathama agragAmI evaM yArA niSThAra saGge tAdera anusaraNa kare AllAh tAdera prati prasanna evaM tArAo tAte santuSTa Ara tini tAdera janye prastuta karechena jAnnAta, yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita, yekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have| eTA mahAsAphalya|

maruvAsIdera madhye yArA tomAdera AzepAze Ache tAdera keu keu munAphika o madInAvAsIdera madhyeo keu keu, erA kapaTatAYa siddha| tumi ederake jAna nA; Ami ederake jAni| Ami tAderake duivAra zAsti diva o pare tArA pratyAvartita have mahAzAstira dike|
Ara apara kataka loke nijedera aparAdha svIkAra kareche, tArA eka satkarmera saGge apara asatkarma mizrita kareche; AllAh haYata tAderake kSamA karavena; nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

edera sampada hate ‘sAdAkA’ grahaNa karave| eTA diYe tumi tAderake pavitra karave evaM parizodhita karave| tumi tAderake du‘A karave| tomAra du‘A to tAdera janye citta svastikara| AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAh to tA~ra vAndAdera taovA kavula karena evaM ‘sAdAkA’ grahaNa karena, nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu?

Ara vala, ‘tomarA karma karate thAka; AllAh to tomAdera kAryakalApa lakSya karavena evaM tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minagaNao karave Ara acirei tomarA pratyAvartita have adRzya o dRzyera parijJAtAra nikaTa, ataHpara tini tomarA yA karate tA tomAderake jAniYe divena|’
Ara AllAh ra Adezera pratIkSAYa apara katakera samparke siddhAnta sthagita thAkala tini tAderake zAsti divena, nA kSamA karavena| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yArA masajida nirmANa kareche kSatisAdhana, kupharI o mu’minadera madhye vibheda sRSTira uddezye evaM itipUrve AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhe ye vyakti saMgrAma kareche tAra gopana ghA~TisvarUpa vyavahArera uddezye, tArA avazyai zapatha karave, ‘AmarA sada uddezye eTA karechi’; AllAh sAkSI, tArA to mithyAvAdI|

tumi tAte kakhanao da~A~r3io nA| ye masajidera bhitti prathama dina hatei sthApita haYeche tAkoYAra opara, tAi tomAra sAlAtera janye adhika yogya| sekhAne emana loka Ache yArA pavitratA arjana bhAlavAse Ara pavitratA arjanakArIderake AllAh pachandakarena|

ye vyakti tAra gRhera bhitti AllAhbhIti o AllAh ra santuSTira opara sthApana kare se uttama, nA ai vyakti uttama ye tAra gRhera bhitti sthApana kare eka khAdera dhasonmukha kinArAYa, phale yA eTAkesaha jAhAnnAmera agnite patita haYa? AllAh jAlima sampradAYake patha pradarzana karena nA|
edera gRha yA erA nirmANa kareche tA tAdera antare sandehera kAraNa haYe thAkave| ye paryanta nA edera antara chinna-vicchinna haYe yAYa| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai AllAh mu’minadera nikaTa hate tAdera jIvana o sampada kraYa kare niYechena, tAdera janye jAnnAta Ache eTAra vinimaYe| tArA AllAh ra pathe yuddha kare, nidhana kare o nihata haYa| tAorAta, inajIla o kuraAne e samparke tAdera dRr3ha pratizruti Ache| nija pratijJA pAlane AllAh apekSA zreSThatara ke Ache? tomarA ye saodA karecha sei saodAra janye Anandita hao Ara eTAi to mahAsAphalya|

tArA taovAkArI, ‘ivAdatakArI, AllAh ra prazaMsAkArI, siYAma pAlanakArI, ruka‚‘kArI, sijdAkArI, satkAjera nirdezadAtA, asatkAje niSedhakArI evaM AllAh ra nirdhArita sImArekhA saMrakSaNakArI; ei mu’minaderake tumi zubha saMvAda dAo|
AtmIYa-svajana haleo muzarikadera janye kSamA prArthanA karA navI o mu’minadera janye saMgata naYa yakhana tA suspaSTa haYe geche ye, nizcitai tArA jAhAnnAmI|

ivrAhIma tAra pitAra janye kSamA prArthanA karechila, tAke era pratizruti diYechila vale; tArapara yakhana eTA tAra nikaTa suspaSTa hala ye, se AllAh ra zatru takhana ivrAhIma tAra samparka chinna karala| ivrAhIma to komala hRdaYa o sahanazIla|

AllAh emana nana ye, tini kona sampradAYake pathapradarzana karAra para tAderake vibhrAnta karavena-tAderake kI viSaYe tAkoYA avalamvana karate have, tA suspaSTarUpe vyakta nA karA paryanta; nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe savizeSa avahita|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhauma kSamatA AllAharai; tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM tinii mRtyu ghaTAna| AllAh vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|

AllAh avazyai anugrahaparAYaNa halena navIra prati evaM muhAjira o AnasAradera prati yArA tAra anusaraNa karechila saMkaTakAle-emanaki yakhana tAdera ekadalera citta-vaikalyera upakrama haYechila| pare AllAh tAderake kSamA karalena; tini to tAdera prati daYArdra, parama daYAlu|

Ara tini kSamA karalena apara tinajanakeo, yAdera samparke siddhAnta sthagita rAkhA haYechila, ye paryanta nA pRthivI vistRta haoYA sattveo tAdera janye eTA saMkucita haYechila evaM tAdera jIvana tAdera janye durviSaha haYechila Ara tArA upalavdhi karechila ye, AllAh vyatIta kona AzraYasthala nei, tA~ra dike pratyAvartana vyatIta, pare tini tAdera taovA kavula karalena yAte tArA taovAYa sthira thAke| nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM satyavAdIdera antarbhukta hao|

madInAvAsI o edera pArzvavartI maruvAsIdera janye saGgata naYa AllAhara rAsUlera sahagAmI nA haYe pichane theke yAoYA evaM tAra jIvana apekSA tAdera nijedera jIvanake priYa jJAna karA; kAraNa AllAh ra pathe tAdera tRSNA, klAnti o kSudhAYa kliSTa haoYA Ara kAphiradera krodha udreka kare emana padakSepa grahaNa karA evaM zatrudera nikaTa hate kichu prApta haoYA tAdera satkarmarUpe gaNya haYa| nizcaYai AllAh satkarmaparAYaNadera zramaphala naSTa karena nA|
evaM tArA kSudra vA vRhat yAi vyaYa kare Ara ye kona prAntarai atikrama kare tA tAdera anuka‚le lipivaddha haYa-yAte tArA yA kare AllAha tA apekSA utkRSTatara puraskAra tAderake dite pArena|

mu’minadera sakalera ekasaGge abhiyAne vera haoYA saMgata naYa, edera pratyeka dalera eka aMza vahirgata haYa nA kena, yAte tArA dIna samvandhe jJAnAnuzIlana karate pAre Ara tAdera sampradAYake satarka karate pAre, yakhana tArA tAdera nikaTa phire Asave yAte tArA satarka haYa|
he mu’minagaNa! kAphiradera madhye yArA tomAdera nikaTavartI tAdera saGge yuddha kara Ara tArA yena tomAdera madhye kaThoratA dekhate pAYa| jene rAkha, AllAh to muttAkIdera saGge Achena|
yakhanai kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa takhana tAdera keu keu vale, ‘eTA tomAdera madhye kAra ImAna vRddhi karala?’ yArA mu’mina eTA tAderai ImAna vRddhi kare Ara tArAi Anandita haYa|
Ara yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache, eTA tAdera kaluSera saGge Arao kaluSa yukta kare evaM tAdera mRtyu ghaTe kAphira avasthAYa|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, ‘tAderake prati vatsara ekavAra vA duivAra viparyasta karA haYa?’ era parao tArA taovA kare nA Ara upadeza grahaNa kare nA,

Ara yakhanai kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa, takhana tArA eke aparera dike tAkAYa Ara izArAYa jijJAsA kare ‘tomAderake keu lakSya karateche ki?’ tArapara tArA sare par3e| AllAh tAdera hRdaYake satyavimukha karechena, kAraNa tArA emana eka sampradAYa yAdera vodhazakti nei|
avazyai tomAdera madhya hatei tomAdera nikaTa eka rAsUla eseche| tomAderake yA vipanna kare tA tAra janye kaSTadAYaka| se tomAdera maGgalakAmI, mu’minadera prati se daYArdra o parama daYAlu|
erapara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tave tumi vala, ‘AmAra janye AllAhai yatheSTa, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| Ami tArai opara nirbhara kari Ara tini mahArAzera adhipati|’
Alipha-lAma-rA| eiguli jJAnagarbha kitAvera AYAta|

mAnuSera janye eTA ki Azcaryera viSaYa ye, Ami tAderai ekajanera nikaTa ohI preraNa karechi ei marme ye, tumi mAnuSake satarka kara Ara mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo, tAdera janye tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache ucca maryAdA! kAphirarA vale, ‘e to eka suspaSTa jAdukara!’

tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAh, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI chaYa dine sRSTi karena, tArapara tini rAze samAsIna hana| tini sakala viSaYa paricAlanA karena| tAra anumati lAbha nA kare supAriza karAra keu nei| inii AllAh, tomAdera pratipAlaka, sutarAM tAra ‘ivAdata kara| tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

tA~rai nikaTa tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana; AllAh ra pratizruti satya| sRSTike tinii prathama astitve Anena, ataHpara era punarAvartana ghaTAna, yArA mu’mina o satkarmaparAYaNa tAderake nyAYavicArera saGge karmaphala pradAnera janye| Ara yArA kAphira tArA kupharI karata vale tAdera janye Ache atyuSNa pAnIYa o marmantuda zAsti|

tinii sUryake tejaskara o candrake jyotirmaYa karechena evaM era manyila nirdiSTa karechena yAte tomarA vatsara gaNanA o samaYera hiseva jAnate pAra| AllAh eTA nirarthaka sRSTi karena nAi| jJAnI sampradAYera janye tini e samasta nidarzana vizadabhAve vivRta karena|
nizcaYai divasa o rAtrira parivartane evaM AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA sRSTi karechena tAte nidarzana raYeche muttAkI sampradAYera janye|
nizcaYai yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA poSaNa kare nA evaM pArthiva jIvanei santuSTa Ara etei paritRpta thAke evaM yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI samvandhe gAphila|
ederai AvAsa dojakha, edera kRtakarmera janye|
yArA mu’mina o satkarmaparAYaNa tAdera pratipAlaka tAdera ImAnera kAraNe tAderake pathanirdeza karavena; sukhada kAnane tAdera pAdadeze naharasamUha pravAhita have|

sekhAne tAdera dhvani have: ‘he AllAh! tumi mahAna, pavitra!’ Ara sekhAne tAdera abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’ evaM tAdera zeSa dhvani have ei: ‘sakala prazaMsA jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAh ra prApya!’

AllAh yadi mAnuSera akalyANa tvarAnvita karatena, yebhAve tArA tAdera kalyANa tvarAnvita karate cAYa, tave avazyai tAdera mRtyu ghaTata| sutarAM yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA poSaNa kare nA tAderake Ami tAdera avAdhyatAYa udbhrAntera nyAYa ghure ver3Ate dei|

Ara mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-dainya sparza kare takhana se zuYe, vase vA dA~r3iYe AmAke Deke thAke| ataHpara Ami yakhana tAra duHkha-dainya dUrIbhUta kari, se emana patha avalamvana kare, yena tAke ye duHkha-dainya sparza karechila tAra janye se AmAke DAkei nAi| yArA sImAlaMghana kare tAdera karma tAdera nikaTa eibhAve zobhanIYa kare deoYA haYeche|

tomAdera pUrve vahu mAnavagoSThIke Ami to dhvaMsa karechi yakhana tArA sImA atikrama karechila| spaSTa nidarzanasaha tAdera nikaTa tAdera rAsUlagaNa esechila, kintu tArA ImAna AnavAra janye prastuta chila nA| eibhAve Ami aparAdhI sampradAYake pratiphala diYe thAki|
ataHpara Ami tAdera para pRthivIte tomAderake sthalAbhiSikta karechi, tomarA kirUpa karma kara tA dekhanora janye|

yakhana AmAra AYAta, yA suspaSTa, tAdera nikaTa pATha karA haYa takhana yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA poSaNa kare nA tArA vale, ‘anya eka kuraAna Ana eTA chAr3A, vA eke vadalAo|’ vala, ‘nija hate eTA vadalAna AmAra kAja naYa| AmAra prati yA ohI haYa, Ami kevala tArai anusaraNa kari| Ami AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhyatA karale avazyai Ami mahAdivasera zAstira AzaMkA kari|

vala, ‘AllAh yadi icchA karatena Amio tomAdera nikaTa eTA tilAoYAta karatAma nA evaM tinio tomAderake e viSaYe avahita karatena nA| Ami to era pUrve tomAdera madhye jIvanera dIrghakAla avasthAna karechi; tavuo ki tomarA vujhate pAra nA?’
ye vyakti AllAh samparke mithyA racanA kare vA AllAh ra nidarzanake asvIkAra kare tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? nizcaYai aparAdhigaNa saphalakAma haYa nA|

erA AllAh vyatIta yAra ‘ivAdata kare tA edera kSatio karate pAre nA, upakArao karate pAre nA| erA vale, ‘eiguli AllAh ra nikaTa AmAdera supArizakArI|’ vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAhke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra emana kichura saMvAda dive yA tini jAnena nA? tini mahAna, pavitra’ Ara tArA yAke zarIka kare tA hate tini Urdhve|
mAnuSa chila ekai ummata, pare tArA matabheda sRSTi kare| tomAra pratipAlakera pUrva-ghoSaNA nA thAkale tArA ye viSaYe matabheda ghaTAYa tAra mImAMsA to haYei yeta|

tArA vale, ‘tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tAra nikaTa kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ vala, ‘adRzyera jJAna to kevala AllAharai Ache| sutarAM tomarA pratIkSA kara, Amio tomAdera saGge pratIkSA karachi|’

Ara duHkha-dainya tAderake sparza karAra para, yakhana Ami mAnuSake anugrahera AsvAdana karAi tArA takhanai AmAra nidarzanera viruddhe apakauzala kare| vala, ‘AllAh apakauzalera zAstidAne drutatara|’ tomarA ye apakauzala kara tA avazyai AmAra pherezatAgaNa likhe rAkhe|

tinii tomAderake jalesthale bhramaNa karAna Ara tomarA yakhana naukArohI hao evaM eiguli ArohI niYe anuka‚la vAtAse vaYe yAYa Ara tArA ete Anandita haYa; ataHpara eiguli vAtyAhata evaM sarvadika hate taraGgAhata haYa Ara tArA eTA diYe pariveSTita haYe par3eche mane kare, takhana tArA Anugatye vizuddhacitta haYe AllAhke Deke vale: ‘tumi AmAderake eTA hate trANa karale AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava|’

ataHpara tini yakhanai ederake vipadamukta karena takhanai erA pRthivIte anyAYabhAve juluma karate thAke| he mAnuSa! tomAdera juluma vastuta tomAdera nijedera pratii haYe thAke; pArthiva jIvanera sukha bhoga kare nAo, pare AmArai nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana| takhana Ami tomAderake jAniYe diva tomarA yA karate|

vastuta pArthiva jIvanera dRSTAnta eirUpa: yemana Ami AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kari yA diYe bhUmija udbhida ghana-sanniviSTa haYe udgata haYa, yA hate mAnuSa o jIvajantu AhAra kare thAke| ataHpara yakhana bhUmi tAra zobhA dhAraNa kare o naYanAbhirAma haYa Ara era adhikArigaNa mane kare tA tAdera AYattAdhIna, takhana divase vA rajanIte AmAra nirdeza ese par3e o Ami eTA emanabhAve nirmUla kare dei, yena gatakAlao era astitva chila nA| eibhAve Ami nidarzanAvalI vizadabhAve vivRta kari cintAzIla sampradAYera janye|
AllAh zAntira AvAsera dike AhvAna karena evaM yAke icchA sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
yArA kalyANakara kAja kare tAdera janye Ache kalyANa evaM Arao adhika| kAlimA o hInatA edera mukhamaNDalake Acchanna karave nA| erAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne erA sthAYI have|

yArA manda kAja kare tAdera pratiphala anurUpa manda evaM tAderake hInatA Acchanna karave; AllAh hate ederake rakSA karAra keu nei; edera mukhamaNDala yena rAtrira andhakAra AstaraNe AcchAdita| erA dojakhera adhivAsI, sekhAne erA sthAYI have|

Ara yedina Ami edera sakalake ekatra kare, yArA muzarika tAderake valiva, ‘tomarA evaM tomarA yAderake zarIka karechile tArA sva sva sthAne avasthAna kara;’ Ami ederake paraspara hate pRthaka kare diva evaM erA yAderake zarIka karechila tArA valave, ‘tomarA to AmAdera ‘ivAdata karate nA|’
‘AllAhai AmAdera o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve yatheSTa ye, tomarA AmAdera ‘ivAdata karate e viSaYe AmarA to gAphila chilAma|’
sekhAne tAdera pratyeke tAra pUrvakRta karma parIkSA kare nive evaM ederake edera prakRta abhibhAvaka AllAh ra nikaTa phiriYe AnA have Ara edera udbhAvita mithyA edera nikaTa hate antarhita have|

vala, ‘ke tomAderake AkAza o pRthivI hate jIvanopakaraNa saravarAha kare vA zonAra o dekhAra kAra kartRtvAdhIna, jIvitake mRta hate ke vera kare Ara mRtake jIvita hate ke vera kare evaM sakala viSaYa ke niYantraNa kare? takhana tArA valave, ‘AllAh’| vala, ‘tavuo ki tomarA sAvadhAna have nA?’
tinii AllAh, tomAdera satya pratipAlaka| satya tyAga karAra para vibhrAnti vyatIta Ara kI thAke? sutarAM tomarA kothAYa cAlita haccho?
eibhAve satyatyAgIdera samparke tomAra pratipAlakera ei vANI satya pratipanna haYeche ye, tArA to ImAna Anave nA|

vala, ‘tomarA yAdera zarIka kara tAdera madhye ki emana keu Ache, ye sRSTike astitve AnaYana kare o pare era punarAvartana ghaTAYa?’ vala, ‘AllAhi sRSTike astitve AnaYana karena o pare era punarAvartana ghaTAna,’ sutarAM tomarA kemana kare satya-vicyuta haccho?

vala, ‘tomarA yAderake zarIka kara tAdera madhye ki emana keu Ache, ye satyera patha nirdeza kare?’ vala, ‘AllAhi satyera patha nirdeza karena| yini satyera patha nirdeza karena tini Anugatyera adhikatara hakdAra, nA yAke patha nA dekhAle patha pAYa nA-se? tomAdera kI haYeche? tomarA kIbhAve siddhAnta kare thAka?’
edera adhikAMza anumAnerai anusaraNa kare, satyera parivarte anumAna kona kAje Ase nA, erA yA kare nizcaYai AllAh se viSaYe savizeSa avahita|

ei kuraAna AllAha vyatIta apara kArao racanA naYa| pakSAntare, eTAra pUrve yA avatIrNa haYeche eTA tAra samarthana Ara eTA vidhAnasamUhera vizada vyAkhyA| ete kona sandeha nei ye, eTA jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera pakSa hate|
tArA ki vale, ‘se eTA racanA kareche?’ vala, ‘tave tomarA eTAra anurUpa ekaTi sUrA AnaYana kara evaM AllAh vyatIta apara yAke pAra AhvAna kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’

parantu erA ye viSaYera jJAna AYatta kare nAi tA asvIkAra kare evaM ekhanao eTAra pariNAma edera nikaTa upasthita haYa nAi| eibhAve edera pUrvavartIgaNao mithyA Aropa karechila, sutarAM dekha, jAlimadera pariNAma kI haYeche|
edera madhye keu ete vizvAsa kare Ara keu ete vizvAsa kare nA Ara tomAra pratipAlaka azAnti sRSTikArIdera samvandhe samyaka avahita|

Ara tArA yadi tomAra prati mithyA Aropa kare tave tumi vala, ‘AmAra karmera dAYitva AmAra evaM tomAdera karmera dAYitva tomAdera| Ami yA kari se viSaYe tomarA dAYamukta Ara tomarA yA kara se viSaYe Amio dAYamukta|’
edera madhye keu keu tomAra dike kAna pete rAkhe| tumi ki vadhirake zunAve, tArA nA vujhaleo?
edera madhye keu keu tomAra dike tAkiYe thAke| tumi ki andhake patha dekhAve, tArA nA dekhaleo?
nizcaYai AllAh mAnuSera prati kona juluma karena nA, varaM mAnuSai nijedera prati juluma kare thAke|

yedina tini ederake ekatra karavena sedina edera mane have, edera avasthiti divasera muhUrtakAla mAtra chila; erA parasparake cinave| AllAh ra sAkSAt yArA asvIkAra kareche tArA kSatigrasta haYeche Ara tArA satpathaprApta chila nA|
Ami ederake ye bhIti pradarzana karechi tAra kichu yadi tomAke dekhiYe dei vA tomAra kAla pUrNa kare dei, edera pratyAvartana to AmArai nikaTa; evaM erA yA kare AllAh tAra sAkSI|
pratyeka jAtira janye Ache ekajana rAsUla Ara yakhana edera rAsUla eseche takhana nyAYavicArera saGge edera mImAMsA haYeche Ara edera prati juluma karA haYa nAi|
erA vale, ‘yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao, tave ‘vala ei pratizruti kave phalave?’

vala, ‘AllAh yA icchA karena tA vyatIta AmAra nijera bhAlamandera opara AmAra kona adhikAra nei|’ pratyeka jAtira eka nirdiSTa samaYa Ache; yakhana tAdera samaYa Asave takhana tArA muhUrtakAlao vilamva vA tvarA karate pArave nA|
vala, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, yadi tA~ra zAsti tomAdera opara rajanIte vA divase ese par3e tave aparAdhIrA era kI tvarAnvita karate cAYa?’
tomarA ki eTA ghaTAnora para eTA vizvAsa karave? ekhana? tomarA to eTAi tvarAnvita karate ceYechile!
pare jAlimaderake valA have, ‘sthAYI zAsti AsvAdana kara; tomarA yA karate, tomAderake tArai pratiphala deoYA hacche|’
erA tomAra nikaTa jAnate cAYa, ‘eTA ki satya?’ vala, ‘hyA~, AmAra pratipAlakera zapatha! eTA avazyai satya| Ara tomarA eTA vyartha karate pArave nA|’

pratyeka sImAlaMghanakArIi pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA yadi tAra hata tave se muktira vinimaYe tA diYe dita; Ara yakhana erA zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana manastApa gopana karave| edera mImAMsA nyAYavicArera saGge karA have Ara edera prati juluma karA have nA|
sAvadhAna! AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA AllAh ra i| sAvadhAna! AllAh ra pratizruti satya, kintu edera adhikAMzai avagata naYa|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna Ara tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|
he mAnuSa! tomAdera prati tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate eseche upadeza o tomAdera antare yA Ache tAra Arogya evaM mu’minadera janye hidAYAta o rahamata|
vala, ‘eTA AllAh ra anugrahe o tA~ra daYAYa; sutarAM ete tArA Anandita hoka|’ erA yA puJjIbhUta kare tA apekSA eTA zreYa|

vala, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, AllAh tomAdera ye riyika diYechena tomarA ye tAra kichu hAlAla o kichu hArAma karecha? vala, ‘AllAh ki tomAderake eTAra anumati diYechena, nA tomarA AllAh ra prati mithyA Aropa karacho?’
yArA AllAh samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kare, kiYAmata divasa samvandhe tAdera kI dhAraNA? nizcaYai AllAh mAnuSera prati anugrahaparAYaNa, kintu edera adhikAMzai kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|

tumi ye kona avasthAYa thAka evaM tumi tatsamparke kuraAna hate yA tilAoYAta kara evaM tomarA ye kona kAja kara, Ami tomAdera paridarzaka-yakhana tomarA ete pravRtta hao| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra aNu parimANao tomAra pratipAlakera agocara naYa Ara eTA apekSA kSudratara vA vRhattara kichui nei yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|
jene rAkha! AllAh ra vandhudera kona bhaYa nei Ara tArA duHkhitao have nA|
yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAkoYA avalamvana kare,
tAdera janye Ache susaMvAda duniYAra jIvane o AkhirAte, AllAh ra vANIra kona parivartana nei; eTAi mahAsAphalya|
edera kathA tomAke yena duHkha nA deYa| samasta zaktii AllAh ra; tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

jene rAkha! yArA AkAzamaNDale Ache evaM yArA pRthivIte Ache tArA AllAh ra i| yArA AllAh vyatIta aparake zarIkarUpe DAke, tArA kisera anusaraNa kare? tArA to zudhu anumAnerai anusaraNa kare Ara tArA zudhu mithyAi vale|
tinii sRSTi karechena tomAdera janye rAta, yena ete tomarA vizrAma karate pAra evaM divasa dekhAra janye| ye sampradAYa kathA zune nizcaYai tAdera janye ete Ache nidarzana|
