tArA vale ‘AllAh santAna grahaNa karechena|’ tini mahAna pavitra! tini abhAvamukta! yA kichu Ache AkAzamaNDale o yA kichu Ache pRthivIte tA tA~rai| e viSaYe tomAdera nikaTa kona sanada nei| tomarA ki AllAh samvandhe emana kichu valacho, ye viSaYe tomAdera kona jJAna nei?
vala, ‘yArA AllAh samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana karave tArA saphalakAma have nA|’
pRthivIte edera janye Ache kichu sukha-sambhoga; pare AmArai nikaTa edera pratyAvartana| ataHpara kupharIra kAraNe ederake Ami kaThora zAstira AsvAda grahaNa karAva|

ederake nUh-era vRttAnta zonAo| se tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra avasthiti o AllAh ra nidarzana diYe AmAra upadezadAna tomAdera nikaTa yadi duHsaha haYa tave Ami to AllAh ra opara nirbhara kari| tomarA yAderake zarIka karecha tatsaha tomAdera kartavya sthira kare nAo, pare yena kartavya viSaYe tomAdera kona saMzaYa nA thAke| AmAra samvandhe tomAdera karma niSpanna kare phela Ara AmAke avakAza dio nA|
‘ataHpara tomarA mukha phiriYe nile nite pAra, tomAdera nikaTa Ami to kona pArizramika cAi nAi, AmAra pArizramika Ache AllAh ra nikaTa, Ami to AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta hate AdiSTa haYechi|’

Ara erA tAke mithyAvAdI vale; ataHpara tAke o tAra saGge yArA taraNIte chila tAderake Ami uddhAra kari evaM tAderake sthalAbhiSikta kari o yArA AmAra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna karechila tAderake nimajjita kari| sutarAM dekha, yAderake satarka karA haYechila tAdera pariNAma kI haYechila!

anantara tAra pare Ami rAsUlagaNake preraNa kari, tAdera sampradAYera nikaTa; tArA edera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanasaha esechila| kintu erA pUrve yA pratyAkhyAna karechila tAra prati ImAna AnAra janye prastuta chila nA| eibhAve Ami sImAlaMghanakArIdera hRdaYa mohara kare dei|
pare AmAra nidarzanasaha mUsA o hArUnake phira‘Aona o tAra pAriSadavargera nikaTa preraNa kari| kintu erA ahaMkAra kare Ara erA chila aparAdhI sampradAYa|
ataHpara yakhana edera nikaTa AmAra nikaTa hate satya elo takhana erA valala, ‘eTA to nizcaYai spaSTa jAdu|’
mUsA valala, ‘satya yakhana tomAdera nikaTa elo takhana tAra samparke tomarA eirUpa valacho? eTA ki jAdu? jAdukarerA to saphalakAma haYa nA|’

erA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNake yAte peYechi tumi ki tA hate AmAderake vicyuta karAra janye AmAdera nikaTa esecho evaM yAte deze tomAdera du’janera pratipatti haYa, eijanye? AmarA tomAdera prati vizvAsI nai|’
phira‘Aona valala, ‘tomarA AmAra nikaTa sakala sudakSa jAdukarake niYe Asa|’
ataHpara yakhana jAdukarerA elo takhana ederake mUsA valala, ‘tomAdera yA nikSepa karAra, nikSepa kara|’
ataHpara yakhana tArA nikSepa karala takhana mUsA valala, ‘tomarA yA enecho tA jAdu, nizcaYai AllAh eke asAra kare divena| AllAh avazyai azAnti sRSTikArIdera karma sArthaka karena nA|’
aparAdhIrA aprItikara mane karaleo AllAh tA~ra vANI anuyAYI satyake pratiSThita karavena|

phira‘Aona o tAra pAriSadavarga niryAtana karave e AzaMkAYa mUsAra sampradAYera ekadala vyatIta Ara keu tAra prati ImAna Ane nAi| vastuta phira‘Aona chila deze parAkramazAlI Ara se avazyai sImAlaMghanakArIdera antarbhukta|
mUsA valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! yadi tomarA AllAhte ImAna ene thAka, yadi tomarA AtmasamarpaNakArI hao tave tomarA tA~rai opara nirbhara kara|’
ataHpara tArA valala, ‘AmarA AllAh ra opara nirbhara karalAma| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake jAlima sampradAYera utpIr3anera pAtra kara nA;
‘Ara AmAderake tomAra anugrahe kAphira sampradAYa hate rakSA kara|’
Ami mUsA o tAra bhAike pratyAdeza karalAma, ‘misare tomAdera sampradAYera janye gRha sthApana kara evaM tomAdera gRhagulike ‘ivAdatagRha kara, sAlAta kAYema kara Ara mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo|’

mUsA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi to phira‘Aona o tAra pAriSadavargake pArthiva jIvane zobhA o sampada dAna karecha yA diYe, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! erA mAnuSake tomAra patha hate bhraSTa kare| he AmAdera prati-pAlaka! edera sampada vinaSTa kara, edera hRdaYa kaThina kare dAo, erA to marmantuda zAsti pratyakSa nA karA paryanta ImAna Anave nA|’
tini valalena, ‘tomAdera du’janera du‘A kavUla hala, sutarAM tomarA dRr3ha thAka Ara tomarA kakhanao ajJadera patha anusaraNa kara nA|’

Ami vanI isarAIlake samudra pAra karAlAma Ara phira‘Aona o tAra sainyavAhinI auddhatya sahakAre sImAlaMghana kare tAdera pazcAddhAvana karala| parizeSe yakhana se nimajjamAna hala takhana valala, ‘Ami vizvAsa karalAma vanI isarAIla yAte vizvAsa kare| nizcaYai tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei Ara Ami AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta|’
‘ekhana! itipUrve to tumi amAnya karecha Ara tumi azAnti sRSTikArIdera antarbhukta chile|
‘Aja Ami tomAra dehaTi rakSA karava yAte tumi tomAra paravartIdera janye nidarzana haYe thAka| avazyai mAnuSera madhye aneke AmAra nidarzana samvandhe gAphila|’

Ami to vanI isarAIlake utkRSTa AvAsabhUmite vasavAsa karAilAma evaM Ami ederake uttama jIvanopakaraNa dilAma, erapara edera nikaTa jJAna Asale erA vibheda sRSTi karala| erA ye viSaYe vibheda sRSTi karechila tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai tAdera madhye kiYAmatera dina era phaYasAlA kare divena|

Ami tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karechi ete yadi tumi sandehe thAka tave tomAra pUrvera kitAva yArA pATha kare tAderake jijJAsA kara; tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra nikaTa satya avazyai eseche| tumi kakhanao sandigdhacittadera antarbhukta haYo nA,
Ara yArA AllAh ra nidarzana pratyAkhyAna kareche tumi kakhanao tAdera antarbhukta haYo nA-tA hale tumio kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|
nizcaYai yAdera viruddhe tomAra pratipAlakera vAkya sAvyasta haYe geche, tArA ImAna Anave nA,
yadio edera nikaTa pratyekaTi nidarzana Ase yatakSaNa nA erA marmantuda zAsti pratyakSa karave|

tave iunusera sampradAYa vyatIta kona janapadavAsI kena emana hala nA yArA ImAna Anata evaM tAdera ImAna tAdera upakAre Asata? tArA yakhana ImAna Anala takhana Ami tAdera nikaTa hate pArthiva jIvanera hInatAjanaka zAsti dUra karalAma evaM ederake kichukAlera janye jIvana upabhoga karate dilAma|
tomAra pratipAlaka icchA karale pRthivIte yArA Ache tArA sakalei avazyai ImAna Anata; tave ki tumi mu’mina haoYAra janye mAnuSera opara javaradasti karave?
AllAh ra anumati vyatIta ImAna AnA kArao sAdhya naYa Ara yArA anudhAvana kare nA AllAh tAderake kaluSalipta karena|
vala, ‘AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tAra prati lakSya kara|’ nidarzanAvalI o bhIti pradarzana avizvAsI sampradAYera upakAre Ase nA|
erA ki edera pUrve yA ghaTeche era anurUpa ghaTanArai pratIkSA kare? vala, ‘tomarA pratIkSA kara, Amio tomAdera saGge pratIkSA karachi|’
parizeSe Ami AmAra rAsUlagaNake evaM mu’minagaNakeo uddhAra kari| eibhAve AmAra dAYitva mu’minagaNake uddhAra karA|

vala, ‘he mAnuSa! tomarA yadi AmAra dInera prati saMzaYayukta hao tave jene rAkha, tomarA AllAh vyatIta yAdera ‘ivAdata kara Ami edera ‘ivAdata kari nA| parantu Ami ‘ivAdata kari AllAh ra yini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna evaM Ami mu’minadera antarbhukta haoYAra janye AdiSTa haYechi,
Ara era ei ye, ‘tumi ekaniSThabhAve dIne pratiSThita hao evaM kakhanai muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA,
‘evaM AllAh vyatIta anya kAukeo DAkave nA, yA tomAra upakArao kare nA, apakArao kare nA, kAraNa eTA karale takhana tumi avazyai jAlimadera antarbhukta have|’

‘evaM AllAh tomAke kleza dile tini vyatIta eTA mocanakArI Ara keu nei evaM AllAh yadi tomAra maGgala cAna tave tA~ra anugraha rada karAra keu nei| tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA tini maGgala dAna karena| tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’

vala, ‘he mAnuSa! tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera nikaTa satya eseche| sutarAM yArA satpatha avalamvana karave tArA to nijederai maGgalera janye satpatha avalamvana karave evaM yArA pathabhraSTa have tArA to pathabhraSTa have nijederai dhvaMsera janye evaM Ami tomAdera karmavidhAYaka nai|’
tomAra prati ye ohI avatIrNa haYeche tumi tAra anusaraNa kara evaM tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, ye paryanta nA AllAh phaYasAlA karena evaM AllAhi sarveAttama vidhAnakartA|
Alipha-lAma-rA, ei kitAva prajJAmaYa, sarvajJera nikaTa hate; eTAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTa, suvinyasta o pare vizadabhAve vivRta ye,
tomarA AllAh vyatIta anyera ‘ivAdata karave nA, avazyai Ami tA~ra pakSa hate tomAdera janye satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA|

Arao ye, tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara o tA~ra dike pratyAvartana kara, tini tomAderake eka nirdiSTa kAlera janye uttama jIvana upabhoga karate divena evaM tini pratyeka guNIjanake tAra prApya maryAdA dAna karavena| yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tave Ami tomAdera janye AzaMkA kari mahAdivasera zAstira|
AllAh ra i nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana evaM tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

sAvadhAna! nizcaYai erA tA~ra nikaTa gopana rAkhAra janye edera vakSa dvibhA~ja kare| sAvadhAna! erA yakhana nijederake vastre AcchAdita kare takhana erA yA gopana kare o prakAza kare, tini tA jAnena| antare yA Ache, nizcaYai tini tA savizeSa avahita|
bhUpRSThe vicaraNakArI sakalera jIvikAra dAYitva AllAh ra i| tini edera sthAYI o asthAYI avasthiti samvandhe avahita; suspaSTa kitAve sava kichui Ache|

Ara tinii AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI chaYa dine sRSTi karena, takhana tA~ra Araza chila pAnira opara, tomAdera madhye ke karme zreSTha tA parIkSA karAra janye| tumi yadi vala, ‘mRtyura para tomarA avazyai utthita have,’ kAphirarA nizcaYai valave, ‘eTA to suspaSTa jAdu|’

nirdiSTa kAlera janye Ami yadi edera hate zAsti sthagita rAkhi tave erA nizcaYa valave, ‘kise tA nivAraNa karache?’ sAvadhAna! ye dina edera nikaTa eTA Asave sedina edera nikaTa hate tA nivRtta karA have nA evaM yA niYe erA ThATTA-vidrupa kare tA ederake pariveSTana karave|
yadi Ami mAnuSake AmAra nikaTa hate anugraha AsvAdana karAi o pare tAra nikaTa hate tA pratyAhAra kari takhana se avazyai hatAza o akRtajJa have|
Ara yadi duHkha-dainya sparza karAra para Ami tAke sukha-sampada AsvAdana karAi takhana se avazyai valave, ‘AmAra vipada-Apada keTe geche’, Ara se to haYa utphula¬ o ahaMkArI|
kintu yArA dhairyazIla o satkarmaparAYaNa tAderai janye Ache kSamA o mahApuraskAra|

tave ki tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAra kichu tumi varjana karave evaM ete tomAra mana saMkucita have eijanye ye, tArA vale, ‘tAra nikaTa dhanabhANDAra prerita haYa nA kena vA tAra saGge phirizatA Ase nA kena?’ tumi to kevala satarkakArI evaM AllAh sarvaviSaYera karmavidhAYaka|
tArA ki vale, ‘se eTA nije racanA kareche?’ vala, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave tomarA eTAra anurUpa dazaTi svaracita sUrA AnaYana kara evaM AllAh vyatIta apara yAke pAra, Deke nAo|’
yadi tArA tomAdera AhvAne sAr3A nA deYa tave jene rAkha, eTA to AllAh ra ilma mutAvika avatIrNa evaM tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| tA hale tomarA AtmasamarpaNakArI have ki?
ye keu pArthiva jIvana o era zobhA kAmanA kare, duniYAYa Ami edera karmera pUrNaphala dAna kari evaM sekhAne tAderake kama deYA have nA|
edera janye AkhirAte doyakha vyatIta anya kichui nei evaM erA yA kare AkhirAte tA niSphala have evaM erA yA kare thAke tA nirarthaka|

tArA ki edera samatulya yArA pratiSThita edera pratipAlaka-prerita spaSTa pramANera opara, yAra anusaraNa kare tA~ra prerita sAkSI evaM yAra pUrve chila mUsAra kitAva Adarza o anugrahasvarUpa? erAi ete vizvAsI| anyAnya dalera yArA eTAke asvIkAra kare, doyakhai tAdera pratizruta sthAna| sutarAM tumi ete sandigdha haYo nA| eTA to tomAra pratipAlaka-prerita satya, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa vizvAsa kare nA|

yArA AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA kare tAdera apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? ederake upasthita karA have edera pratipAlakera sAmane evaM sAkSigaNa valave, ‘erAi edera pratipAlakera viruddhe mithyA Aropa karechila|’ sAvadhAna! AllAh ra lA‘nata jAlimadera opara,
yArA AllAh ra pathe vAdhA deYa evaM ete vakratA anusandhAna kare; evaM erAi AkhirAta pratyAkhyAna kare|
erA pRthivIte AllAhke apAraga karate pArata nA evaM AllAh vyatIta edera apara kona abhibhAvaka chila nA; edera zAsti dviguNa karA have; edera zunavAra sAmarthyao chila nA evaM erA dekhatao nA|
erA nijederai kSati karala evaM erA ye alIka kalpanA karata tA edera nikaTa hate udhAo haYe gela|
niHsandehe erAi AkhirAte sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
yArA mu’mina, satkarmaparAYaNa evaM tAdera pratipAlakera prati vinaYAvanata, tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|
dala duiTira upamA andha o vadhirera evaM cakSuSmAna o zravaNa zaktisampannera nyAYa, tulanAYa ei dui ki samAna? tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?
Ami to nUhke tAra sampradAYera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘Ami avazyai tomAdera janye prakAzya satarkakArI,
yena tomarA AllAh vyatIta apara kichura ‘ivAdata nA kara; Ami to tomAdera janye eka marmantuda divasera zAsti AzaMkA kari|’

tAra sampradAYera pradhAnerA, yArA chila kAphira tArA valala, ‘AmarA tomAke to AmAdera mata mAnuSa vyatIta kichu dekhachi nA; AmarA to dekhachi, tomAra anusaraNa karache tArAi, yArA AmAdera madhye vAhya dRSTitei adhama evaM AmarA AmAdera opara tomAdera kona zreSThatva dekhachi nA; varaM AmarA tomAderake mithyAvAdI mane kari|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAke vala, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlaka prerita spaSTa nidarzane pratiSThita thAki evaM tini yadi AmAke tA~ra nija anugraha hate dAna kare thAkena, Ara eTA tomAdera nikaTa gopana rAkhA haYeche; Ami ki ei viSaYe tomAderake vAdhya karate pAri, yakhana tomarA eTA apachandakara?

‘he AmAra sampradAYa! eTAra parivarte Ami tomAdera nikaTa dhanasampada yAcJA kari nA| AmAra pArizramika to AllAh ra i nikaTa evaM mu’minaderake tAr3AiYA deoYA AmAra kAja naYa; tArA nizcitabhAve tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAt lAbha karave| kintu Ami to dekhachi tomarA eka ajJa sampradAYa|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami yadi tAderake tAr3AiYA dei, tave AllAh hate AmAke ke rakSA karave? tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

‘Ami tomAderake vali nA, ‘AmAra nikaTa AllAh ra dhanabhANDAra Ache,’ Ara nA adRzya samvandhe Ami avagata evaM Ami eTAo vali nA ye, Ami pherezatA| tomAdera dRSTite yArA heYa tAdera samvandhe Ami vali nA ye, AllAh tAderake kakhanai maGgala dAna karavena nA; tAdera antare yA Ache tA AllAh samyaka avagata| tA hale Ami avazyai jAlimadera antarbhukta hava|’
tArA valala, ‘he nUh! tumi to AmAdera saGge vitaNDA karecha-tumi vitaNDA karecha AmAdera saGge ati mAtrAYa; sutarAM tumi satyavAdI hale AmAderake yAra bhaYa dekhAccho tA AnaYana kara|’
se valala, ‘icchA karale AllAhi tA tomAdera nikaTa upasthita karavena evaM tomarA tA vyartha karate pArave nA|
‘Ami tomAderake upadeza dite cAileo AmAra upadeza tomAdera upakAre Asave nA, yadi AllAh tomAderake vibhrAnta karate cAna| tinii tomAdera pratipAlaka evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana|’
tArA ki vale ye, se eTA racanA kareche? vala, ‘Ami yadi eTA racanA kare thAki, tave Amii AmAra aparAdhera janye dAYI hava| tomarA ye aparAdha karacho tA hate Ami dAYamukta|’
nUhera prati pratyAdeza haYechila, ‘yArA ImAna eneche tArA vyatIta tomAra sampradAYera anya keu kakhanao ImAna Anave nA| sutarAM tArA yA kare tAra janye tumi duHkhita haYo nA|
‘tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne o AmAra pratyAdeza anuyAYI naukA nirmANa kara evaM yArA sImAlaMghana kareche tAdera samparke tumi AmAke kichu vala nA; tArA to nimajjita have|’

se naukA nirmANa karate lAgala evaM yakhanai tAra sampradAYera pradhAnerA tAra nikaTa diYe yeta, tAke upahAsa karata; se valata, ‘tomarA yadi AmAke upahAsa kara tave AmarAo tomAderake upahAsa karava, yemana tomarA upahAsa karacho;
‘evaM tomarA acire jAnate pArave- kAhAra opara Asave lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti Ara tAra opara Apatita have sthAYI zAsti|’

avazeSe yakhana AmAra Adeza elo evaM ununa uthale uThala; Ami valalAma, ‘ete uThiYe nAo pratyeka zreNIra yugalera duiTi, yAdera viruddhe pUrva-siddhAnta haYeche tArA vyatIta tomAra parivAra-parijanake evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAderake|’ tAra saGge ImAna enechila alpa kaYekajana|
se valala, ‘ete ArohaNa kara, AllAh ra nAme eTAra gati o sthiti, AmAra pratipAlaka avazyai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
parvata-pramANa taraGgera madhye eTA tAderake niYe vaYe calala; nUh tAra putrake-ye pRthaka chila, AhvAna kare valala, ‘he AmAra putra! AmAdera saGge ArohaNa kara evaM kAphiradera saGgI haYo nA|’

se valala, ‘Ami emana eka parvate AzraYa niva yA AmAke pla¬Avana hate rakSA karave|’ se valala, ‘Aja AllAh ra hukuma hate rakSA karAra keu nei, tave yAke AllAh daYA karavena se vyatIta|’ eTAra para taraGga ederake vicchinna kare dila evaM se nimajjitadera antarbhukta hala|

eTAra para valA hala, ‘he pRthivI! tumi tomAra pAni grAsa kare nAo evaM he AkAza! kSAnta hao|’ eTAra para vanyA prazamita hala evaM kArya samApta hala, naukA judI parvatera opara sthira hala evaM valA hala, jAlima sampradAYa dhvaMsa hoka|
nUh tAra pratipAlakake samvodhana kare valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra putra AmAra parivArabhukta evaM ApanAra pratizruti satya; Ara Apani to vicArakadera madhye zreSTha vicAraka|’

tini valalena, ‘he nUh! se to tomAra parivArabhukta naYa| se avazyai asatkarmaparAYaNa| sutarAM ye viSaYe tomAra jJAna nei se viSaYe AmAke anurodha kara nA| Ami tomAke upadeza dicchi, tumi yena ajJadera antarbhukta nA hao|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ye viSaYe AmAra jJAna nei, se viSaYe yAte ApanAke anurodha nA kari, eijanye Ami ApanAra zaraNa nicchi| Apani yadi AmAke kSamA nA karena evaM AmAke daYA nA karena, tave Ami kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hava|’

valA hala, ‘he nUh! avataraNa kara AmAra pakSa hate zAnti o kalyANasaha evaM tomAra prati o ye samasta sampradAYa tomAra saGge Ache tAdera prati; apara sampradAYasamUhake Ami jIvana upabhoga karate diva, pare AmA hate marmantuda zAsti ederake sparza karave;

‘ei samasta adRzyalokera saMvAda Ami tomAke ohI diYe avahita karachi, yA eTAra pUrve tumi jAnate nA evaM tomAra sampradAYao jAnata nA| sutarAM dhairya dhAraNa kara, zubha pariNAma muttAkIderai janye|’
Ada jAtira nikaTa edera bhAi hUdake pAThiYechilAma, se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara| tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei| tomarA to kevala mithyA racanAkArI|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami eTAra parivarte tomAdera nikaTa pArizramika yAcJA kari nA| AmAra pArizramika Ache tA~rai nikaTa, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| tomarA ki tavuo anudhAvana karave nA?

‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara, erapara tA~ra dikei phire Asa| tini tomAdera janye pracura vAri varSaNa karavena| tini tomAderake Arao zakti diYe tomAdera zakti vRddhi karavena evaM tomarA aparAdhI haYe mukha phiriYe nio nA|’
erA valala, ‘he hUda! tumi AmAdera nikaTa kona spaSTa pramANa AnaYana kara nAi, tomAra kathAYa AmarA AmAdera upAsyaderake parityAga karAra nai evaM AmarA tomAra prati vizvAsI nai|

‘AmarA to eTAi vali, AmAdera upAsyadera madhye keu tomAke azubha diYe AviSTa kareche|’ se valala, ‘Ami to AllAhke sAkSI karachi evaM tomarAo sAkSI hao, nizcaYai Ami tA hate mukta yAke tomarA AllAh ra zarIka kara,
‘AllAh vyatIta| tomarA sakale AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra kara; erapara AmAke avakAza dio nA|
‘Ami nirbhara kari AmAra o tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAh ra opara; emana kona jIvajantu nAi, ye tA~ra pUrNa AYattAdhIna naYa; nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka Achena sarala pathe|

‘erapara tomarA mukha phiriYe nileo Ami yAsaha tomAdera nikaTa prerita haYechi, Ami to tA tomAdera nikaTa peৗ~che diYechi; evaM AmAra pratipAlaka tomAdera hate bhinna kona sampradAYake tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena evaM tomarA tA~ra kona kSati sAdhana karate pArave nA| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka samasta kichura rakSaNAvekSaNakArI|’
evaM yakhana AmAra nirdeza elo takhana Ami hUda o tAra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra anugrahe rakSA karalAma evaM rakSA karalAma tAderake kaThina zAsti hate|
ei ‘Ada jAti tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzana asvIkAra karechila evaM amAnya karechila tA~ra rAsUlagaNake evaM erA pratyeka uddhata svairAcArIra nirdeza anusaraNa karechila|

ei duniYAYa ederake karA haYechila lA‘natagrasta evaM lA‘natagrasta have erA kiYAmatera dineo| jene rAkha! ‘Ada sampradAYa to tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra karechila| jene rAkha! dhvaMsai hala pariNAma ‘Adera, yArA hUdera sampradAYa|

Ami sAmUda jAtira nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihke pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! ‘tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei| tini tomAderake mRttikA hate sRSTi karechena evaM etei tini tomAderake vasavAsa kariYechena| sutarAM tomarA tA~ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara Ara tA~ra dikei pratyAvartana kara| nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka nikaTe, tini AhvAne sAr3A dena|’

tArA valala, ‘he sAlih! eTAra pUrve tumi chile AmAdera AzAsthala| tumi ki AmAderake niSedha karacho ‘ivAdata karate tAdera, yAdera ‘ivAdata karata AmAdera pitRpuruSerA? AmarA avazyai vibhrAntikara sandehe raYechi se viSaYe, yAra prati tumi AmAderake AhvAna karacho|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlaka-prerita spaSTa pramANe pratiSThita haYe thAki evaM tini yadi AmAke tA~ra nija anugraha dAna kare thAkena, tave AllAh ra zAsti hate AmAke ke rakSA karave, Ami yadi tA~ra avAdhyatA kari? sutarAM tomarA to kevala AmAra kSatii vAr3iYe diccha|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! eTA AllAh ra uSTrI, tomAdera janye nidarzanasvarUpa| eTAke AllAh ra jamite care khete dAo| eTAke kona kaSTa dio nA, kaSTa dile Azu zAsti tomAdera opara Apatita have|’
kintu erA eke vadha karala| erapara se valala, ‘tomarA tomAdera gRhe tina dina jIvana upabhoga kare nAo| eTA ekaTi pratizruti yA mithyA haoYAra naYa|’

yakhana AmAra nirdeza elo takhana Ami sAlih o tA~ra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra anugrahe rakSA karalAma evaM rakSA karalAma sei dinera lAJchanA hate| tomAra pratipAlaka to mahAzaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|
erapara yArA sImAlaGghana karechila mahAnAda tAderake AghAta karala; phale erA nija nija gRhe natajAnu avasthAYa zeSa haYe gela;
yena tArA sekhAne kakhanao vasavAsa kare nAi| jene rAkha! sAmUda sampradAYa to tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra karechila| jene rAkha! dhvaMsai hala sAmUda sampradAYera pariNAma|
AmAra pherezatAgaNa to susaMvAda niYe ivrAhImera nikaTa elo| tArA valala, ‘sAlAma’| seo valala, ‘sAlAma’| se avilamve eka kAvAvakRta go-vatsa niYe elo|

se yakhana dekhala tAdera hasta era dike prasArita hacche nA, takhana tAderake avAJchita mane karala evaM tAdera samvandhe tAra mane bhIti saJcAra hala| tArA valala, ‘bhaYa kara nA, AmarA to lUtera sampradAYera prati prerita haYechi|’
Ara tAra strI daNDAYamAna evaM se hese phelala| erapara Ami tAke ishAkera o ishAkera paravartI iYA‘ka‚vera susaMvAda dilAma|
se valala, ‘kI Azcarya! santAnera jananI hava Ami, yakhana Ami vRddhA evaM ei AmAra svAmI vRddha! eTA avazyai eka adbhuta vyApAra!’
tArA valala, ‘AllAh ra kAje tumi vismaYa vodha karacho? he parivAravarga! tomAdera prati raYeche AllAh ra anugraha o kalyANa| tini to prazaMsArha o sammAnArha|’
erapara yakhana ivrAhImera bhIti dUrIbhUta hala evaM tAra nikaTa susaMvAda elo takhana se lUtera sampradAYera samvandhe AmAra saGge vAdAnuvAda karate lAgala|
ivrAhIma to avazyai sahanazIla, komalahRdaYa, satata AllAh-abhimukhI|
he ivrAhIma! eTA hate virata hao; tomAra pratipAlakera vidhAna ese par3eche; edera prati to Asave zAsti, yA anivArya|
evaM yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa lUtera nikaTa elo takhana tAdera Agamane se viSaNNa hala evaM nijeke tAdera rakSAYa asamartha mane karala evaM valala, ‘eTA nidAruNa dina!’

tAra sampradAYa tAra nikaTa udbhrAnta haYe chuTe elo evaM pUrva hate tArA kukarme lipta chila| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! erA AmAra kanyA, tomAdera janye erA pavitra| sutarAM AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM AmAra mehamAnadera vyApAre AmAke heYa kara nA| tomAdera madhye ki kona bhAla mAnuSa nei?’
tArA valala, ‘tumi to jAna, tomAra kanyAderake AmAdera kona praYojana nei; AmarA ki cAi tA to tumi jAnai|’
se valala, ‘tomAdera opara yadi AmAra zakti thAkata vA yadi Ami AzraYa nite pAratAma kona sRdRr3ha stambhera!’

tArA valala, ‘he lUta! nizcaYai AmarA tomAra pratipAlaka-prerita phirizatA| erA kakhanai tomAra nikaTa peৗ~chate pArave nA| sutarAM tumi rAtrira kona eka samaYe tomAra parivAravargasaha vera haYe par3a evaM tomAdera madhye keu pichana dike tAkAve nA, tomAra strI vyatIta| edera yA ghaTave tArao tAi ghaTave| nizcaYai prabhAta edera janye nirdhArita kAla| prabhAta ki nikaTavartI naYa?
erapara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asala takhana Ami janapadake ulTe dilAma evaM edera opara kramAgata varSaNa karalAma prastara-kaGkara,
yA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa cihnita chila| eTA jAlimadera hate dUre naYa|

mAdaiYAnavAsIdera nikaTa tAdera bhAi zu‘AYavake Ami pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei, mApe o ojane kama kara nA; Ami tomAderake samRddhizAlI dekhachi, kintu Ami tomAdera janye AzaGkA karachi eka sarvagrAsI divasera zAsti|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA nyAYasaGgatabhAve mApa o ojana kara, lokaderake tAdera prApya vastu kama dio nA evaM pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi kare ver3io nA|
‘yadi tomarA mu’mina hao tave AllAh-anumodita yA vAki thAkave tomAdera janye tA uttama; Ami tomAdera tattvAvadhAYaka nai|’

erA valala, ‘he zu‘AYava! tomAra sAlAta ki tomAke nirdeza deYa ye, AmAdera pitRpuruSerA yAra ‘ivAdata karata AmAderake tA varjana karate have vA AmarA AmAdera dhana-sampada samparke yA kari tAo? tumi to avazyai sahiSNu, bhAla mAnuSa!’

se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlaka-prerita spaSTa pramANe pratiSThita haYe thAki evaM tini yadi tA~ra nikaTa hate AmAke utkRSTa jIvanopakaraNa dAna kare thAkena tave kI kare Ami AmAra kartavya hate virata thAkava! Ami tomAderake yA niSedha kari Ami nije tA karate icchA kari nA| Ami to AmAra sAdhyamata saMskArai karate cAi| AmAra kAryasAdhana to AllAh ra i sAhAyye; Ami tA~rai opara nirbhara kari evaM Ami tA~rai abhimukhI|

‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra saGge virodha yena kichutei tomAderake emana aparAdha nA karAYa yAte tomAdera opara tAra anurUpa vipada Apatita have yA Apatita haYechila nUhera sampradAYera opara vA hUdera sampradAYera opara kiMvA sAlihera sampradAYera opara; Ara lUtera sampradAYa to tomAdera hate dUre naYa|
‘tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara o tA~ra dike pratyAvartana kara; AmAra pratipAlaka to parama daYAlu, premamaYa|’

erA valala, ‘he zu‘AYava! tumi yA vala tAra aneka kathA AmarA vujhi nA evaM AmarA to AmAdera madhye tomAke durvalai dekhachi| tomAra svajanavarga nA thAkale AmarA tomAke prastara nikSepa kare more phelatAma; Ara AmAdera opara tumi zaktizAlI nao|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera nikaTa ki AmAra svajanavarga AllAh apekSA adhika zaktizAlI? tomarA tA~ke sampUrNa pazcAte phele rekhecha| tomarA yA kara AmAra pratipAlaka avazyai tA pariveSTana kare Achena|

‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA sva sva avasthAYa kAja karate thAka, Amio AmAra kAja karachi| tomarA zIghrai jAnate pArave kAhAra opara Asave lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti evaM ke mithyAvAdI| sutarAM tomarA pratIkSA kara, Amio tomAdera saGge pratIkSA karachi|’

yakhana AmAra nirdeza elo takhana Ami zu‘AYava o tAra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra anugrahe rakSA karechilAma| erapara yArA sImAlaMghana karechila mahAnAda tAderake AghAta karala, phale erA nija nija gRhe natajAnu avasthAYa par3e raila,
yena tArA sekhAne kakhanao vasavAsa kare nAi| jene rAkha! dhvaMsai chila mAdiYAna-vAsIdera pariNAma, yebhAve dhvaMsa haYechila sAmUda sampradAYa|
Ami to mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI o spaSTa pramANasaha pAThiYechilAma,
phira‘Aona o tAra pradhAnadera nikaTa| kintu tArA phira‘Aonera kAryakalApera anusaraNa karata evaM phira‘Aonera kAryakalApa bhAla chila nA|
se kiYAmatera dina tAra sampradAYera agrabhAge thAkave evaM se ederake niYe dojakhe praveza karave| yekhAne praveza karAno have tA kata nikRSTa sthAna!
ei duniYAYa ederake karA haYechila abhizApagrasta evaM abhizApagrasta have erA kiYAmatera dineo| kata nikRSTa se puraskAra yA ederake deoYA have!
eTA janapadasamUhera kataka saMvAda yA Ami tomAra nikaTa varNanA karachi| edera madhye kataka ekhanao vidyamAna evaM kataka nirmUla haYeche|

Ami edera prati juluma kari nAi kintu erAi nijedera prati juluma karechila| yakhana tomAra pratipAlakera vidhAna elo takhana AllAh vyatIta ye ilAhsamUhera tArA ‘ivAdata karata tArA edera kona kAje elo nA| tArA dhvaMsa vyatIta edera anya kichu vRddhi karala nA|
eirUpai tomAra pratipAlakera zAsti! tini zAsti dAna karena janapadasamUhake yakhana erA juluma kare thAke| nizcaYai tA~ra zAsti marmantuda, kaThina|
ye AkhirAtera zAstike bhaYa kare ete to tAra janye nidarzana Ache| eTA sei dina, yedina samasta mAnuSake ekatra karA have; eTA sei dina yedina sakalake upasthita karA have;
evaM Ami nirdiSTa kichukAlera janye tA sthagita rAkhi mAtra|
yakhana sedina Asave takhana AllAh ra anumati vyatIta keu kathA valate pArave nA; edera madhye keu have hatabhAgya Ara keu bhAgyavAna|
erapara yArA hatabhAgya tArA thAkave dojakhe evaM sekhAne tAdera janye thAkave citkAra o ArtanAda,
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have yata dina AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI vidyamAna thAkave yadi nA tomAra pratipAlaka anyarUpa icchA karena; nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka tAi karena yA tini icchA karena|

pakSAntare, yArA bhAgyavAna tArA thAkave jAnnAte, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, yata dina AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI vidyamAna thAkave, yadi nA tomAra pratipAlaka anyarUpa icchA karena; eTA eka niravacchinna puraskAra|

sutarAM erA yAdera ‘ivAdata kare tAdera samvandhe saMzaYe theka nA, pUrve edera pitRpuruSerA yAdera ‘ivAdata karata erA tAderai ‘ivAdata kare| avazyai Ami ederake edera prApya purApuri diva-kichumAtra kama karava nA|

nizcaYai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, erapara ete matabheda ghaTechila| tomAra pratipAlakera pUrvasiddhAnta nA thAkale edera mImAMsA haYe yeta| erA avazyai eTAra samvandhe vibhrAntikara sandehe chila|
yakhana samaYa Asave takhana avazyai tomAra pratipAlaka edera pratyekake tAra karmaphala purApuri divena| erA yA kare tini to se viSaYe savizeSa avahita;
sutarAM tumi yebhAve AdiSTa haYecha tAte sthira thAka evaM tomAra saGge yArA ImAna eneche tArAo sthira thAkuka; evaM sImAlaMghana kara nA| tomarA yA kara nizcaYai tini tAra samyaka draSTA|

yArA sImAlaMghana kareche tomarA tAdera prati jhu~kiYA par3io nA; par3ile agni tomAderake sparza karave| ei avasthAYa AllAh vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA evaM tomAdera sAhAyya karA have nA|
tumi sAlAta kAYema kara divasera dui prAntabhAge o rajanIra prathamAMze| satkarma avazyai asatkarma miTAiYA deYa| yArA upadeza grahaNa kare, eTA tAdera janye eka upadeza|
tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, kAraNa nizcaYai AllAh satkarmaparAYaNadera zramaphala naSTa karena nA|

tomAdera pUrvayuge Ami yAderake rakSA karechilAma tAdera madhye alpa kataka vyatIta sajjana chila nA, yArA pRthivIte viparyaYa ghaTAite niSedha karata| sImAlaMghanakArIrA yAte sukha-svAcchandya peta tArai anusaraNa karata evaM erA chila aparAdhI|
tomAra pratipAlaka eirUpa nana ye, tini anyAYabhAve janapada dhvaMsa karavena, athaca era adhivAsIrA puNyavAna|
tomAra pratipAlaka icchA karale samasta mAnuSake eka jAti karate pAratena, kintu tArA matabheda karatei thAkave,
tave erA naYa, yAderake tomAra pratipAlaka daYA karena evaM tini ederake eijanyei sRSTi karechena| ‘Ami jina o mAnuSa ubhaYa diYe jAhAnnAma pUrNa karavai’, tomAra pratipAlakera ei kathA pUrNa havei|

rAsUladera ai sakala vRttAnta Ami tomAra nikaTa varNanA karachi, yA diYe Ami tomAra cittake dRr3ha kari, eTAra mAdhyame tomAra nikaTa eseche satya evaM mu’minadera janye eseche upadeza o sAvadhAnavANI|
yArA ImAna Ane nA tAderake vala, ‘tomarA sva sva avasthAne kAja karate thAka, AmarAo AmAdera kAja karachi,
‘evaM tomarA pratIkSA kara, AmarAo pratIkSA karachi|’

AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYera jJAna AllAh ra i evaM tA~rai nikaTa samasta kichu pratyAnIta have| sutarAM tumi tA~ra ‘ivAdata kara evaM tA~ra opara nirbhara kara| tomarA yA kara se samvandhe tomAra pratipAlaka anavahita nana|
Alipha-lAma-rA; eiguli suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
eTA Amii avatIrNa karechi AravI bhASAYa kuraAna, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
Ami tomAra nikaTa uttama kAhinI varNanA karachi, ohIra mAdhyame tomAra nikaTa ei kuraAna preraNa kare; yadio eTAra pUrve tumi chile anavahitadera antarbhukta|
smaraNa kara, iusupha tAra pitAke valechila, ‘he AmAra pitA! Ami to dekhechi ekAdaza nakSatra, sUrya evaM candrake; dekhechi ederake AmAra prati sijdAvanata avasthAYa|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra vatsa! tomAra svapna-vRttAnta tomAra bhAidera nikaTa varNanA kara nA; karale tArA tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karave| zaYatAna to mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|’

ebhAve tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke manonIta karavena evaM tomAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA divena evaM tomAra prati o iYA‘ka‚vera parivAra-parijanera prati tA~ra anugraha pUrNa karavena, yebhAve tini eTA pUrve pUrNa karechilena tomAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma o isahAkera prati| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
iusupha evaM tAra bhAidera ghaTanAYa jijJAsudera janye avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
smaraNa kara, erA valechila, ‘AmAdera pitAra nikaTa iusupha evaM tAra bhAii AmAdera apekSA adhika priYa, athaca AmarA ekaTi saMhata dala; AmAdera pitA to spaSTa vibhrAntitei Ache|
tomarA iusuphake hatyA kara vA tAke kona sthAne pheliYA Asa, phale tomAdera pitAra dRSTi zudhu tomAdera pratii niviSTa have evaM tAra para tomarA bhAla loka haYe yAve|’
edera madhye ekajana valala, tomarA iusuphake hatyA kara nA evaM yadi kichu karatei cAo tave tAke kona ka‚pera gabhIre nikSepa kara, yAtrIdalera keu tAke tule niYe yAve|’
erA valala, “he AmAdera pitA! iusuphera vyApAre tumi AmAderake vizvAsa karacho nA kena, athaca AmarA to tAra zubhAkAGkhI?
‘tumi AgAmIkAla tAke AmAdera saGge preraNa kara, se tRpti sahakAre khAve o khelAdhulA karave| AmarA avazyai tAra rakSaNAvekSaNa karava|’
se valala, ‘eTA AmAke avazyai kaSTa dive ye, tomarA tAke niYe yAve evaM Ami AzaMkA kari tAke nekar3e vAgha kheYe phelave, Ara tomarA tAra prati amanoyogI thAkave|’
erA valala, ‘AmarA ekaTi saMhata dala haoYA sattveo yadi nekar3e vAgha tAke kheYe phele, tave to AmarA kSatigrastai hava|’

erapara erA yakhana tAke niYe gela evaM tAke ka‚pera gabhIre nikSepa karate ekamata hala, ematAvasthAYa Ami tAke jAniYe dilAma, ‘tumi ederake edera ei karmera kathA avazyai vale dive yakhana erA tomAke cinave nA|’
erA rAtrira prathama prahare kA~date kA~date edera pitAra nikaTa elo|

erA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! AmarA daur3era pratiyogitA karachilAma evaM iusuphake AmAdera mAlapatrera nikaTa rekhe giYechilAma, erapara nekar3e vAgha tAke kheYe pheleche; kintu tumi to AmAderake vizvAsa karave nA, yadio AmarA satyavAdI|’

erA tAra jAmAYa mithyA rakta lepana kare enechila| se valala, ‘nA, tomAdera mana tomAdera janye ekaTi kAhinI sAjiYe diYeche| sutarAM pUrNa dhairyai zreYa, tomarA yA valacha se viSaYe ekamAtra AllAhi AmAra sAhAyyasthala|’

eka yAtrIdala elo, erA edera pAni saMgrAhakake preraNa karala| se tAra pAnira Dola nAmAiYA dila| se vale uThala, ‘kI sukhavara! e ye eka kizora!’ erapara erA tAke paNyarUpe lukiYe rAkhalo| erA yA karachila se viSaYe AllAh savizeSa avahita chilena|
evaM erA tAke vikraYa karala svalpa mUlye-mAtra kaYeka dirahAmera vinimaYe, erA chila tAra vyApAre nirleAbha|

misarera ye vyakti tAke kraYa karechila, se tAra strIke valala, ‘era thAkavAra sammAnajanaka vyavasthA kara, sambhavata se AmAdera upakAre Asave vA AmarA eke putrarUpeo grahaNa karate pAri|’ evaM ebhAve Ami iusuphake sei deze pratiSThita karalAma tAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA divAra janye| AllAh tA~ra kArya sampAdane apratihata; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa|
se yakhana pUrNa yauvane upanIta hala takhana Ami tAke hikmata o jJAna dAna karalAma evaM ebhAvei Ami satkarmaparAYaNaderake puraskRta kari|

se ye strIlokera gRhe chila se tA hate asatkarma kAmanA karala evaM darajAguli vandha kare dila o valala, ‘Asa|’ se valala, ‘Ami AllAh ra zaraNa nicchi, tini AmAra prabhu; tini AmAra thAkavAra sundara vyavasthA karechena| nizcaYai sImAlaMghanakArIrA saphalakAma haYa nA|’

sei ramaNI to tAra prati Asakta haYechila evaM seo era prati Asakta haYe par3ata yadi nA se tAra pratipAlakera nidarzana pratyakSa karata| Ami tAke manda karma o azlIlatA hate virata rAkhavAra janye ebhAve nidarzana dekhiYechilAma| se to chila AmAra vizuddhacitta vAndAdera antarbhukta|

erA ubhaYe daur3iYe darajAra dike gela evaM strIlokaTi pichana hate tAra jAmA chi~r3e phelala, tArA strIlokaTira svAmIke darajAra nikaTa pela| strIlokaTi valala, ‘ye tomAra parivArera saGge kukarma kAmanA kare tAra janye kArAgAre preraNa vA anya kona marmantuda zAsti vyatIta Ara kI daNDa hate pAre?’

iusupha valala, ‘se-i AmA hate asatkarma kAmanA karechila|’ strIlokaTira parivArera ekajana sAkSI sAkSya dila, ‘yadi era jAmAra sammukha dika chinna karA haYe thAke tave strIlokaTi satya kathA valeche evaM puruSaTi mithyAvAdI,
‘kintu era jAmA yadi pichana dika hate chinna karA haYe thAke tave strIlokaTi mithyA valeche evaM puruSaTi satyavAdI|’
gRhasvAmI yakhana dekhala ye, tAra jAmA pichana dika hate chinna karA haYeche takhana se valala, ‘nizcaYai eTA tomAdera nArIdera chalanA, tomAdera chalanA to bhISaNa|’
‘he iusupha! tumi eTA upekSA kara evaM he nArI! tumi tomAra aparAdhera janye kSamA prArthanA kara; tumii to aparAdhI|’
nagare katipaYa nArI valala, ‘AyIyera strI tAra yuvaka dAsa hate asat karma kAmanA karache, prema tAke unmatta kareche, AmarA to tAke dekhatechi spaSTa vibhrAntite|’

strIlokaTi yakhana edera Sar3ayantrera kathA zunala, takhana se ederake Deke pAThAla, edera janye Asana prastuta karala, edera pratyekake ekaTi kare churi dila evaM iusuphake valala, ‘edera sAmane vera hao|’ erapara erA yakhana tAke dekhala takhana erA tAra garimAYa abhibhUta hala evaM nijedera hAta keTe phelala| erA valala, ‘adbhuta AllAh ra mAhAtmya! e to mAnuSa naYa, e to eka mahimAnvita pherezatA!’

se valala, ‘e-i se yAra samvandhe tomarA AmAra nindA karecha| Ami to tA hate asat karma kAmanA karechi| kintu se nijeke pavitra rekheche; Ami tAke yA Adeza karechi se yadi tA nA kare, tave se kArAruddha havei evaM hInadera antarbhukta have|

iusupha valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ei nArIgaNa AmAke yAra prati AhvAna karache tA apekSA kArAgAra AmAra nikaTa adhika priYa| Apani yadi edera chalanA hate AmAke rakSA nA karena tave Ami edera prati AkRSTa haYe par3ava evaM ajJadera antarbhukta hava|’
erapara tAra pratipAlaka tAra AhvAne sAr3A dilena evaM tAke edera chalanA hate rakSA karalena| tini to sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
nidarzanAvalI dekhAra para edera mane hala ye, tAke kichu kAlera janye kArAruddha karatei have|

tAra saGge du’jana yuvaka kArAgAre praveza karala| edera ekajana valala, ‘Ami svapne dekhalAma, Ami AMgura niMr3iYe rasa vera karachi’, evaM aparajana valala, ‘Ami svapne dekhalAma, Ami AmAra mastake ruTi vahana karachi evaM pAkhi tA hate khAcche| AmAderake tumi eTAra tAtparya jAniYe dAo, AmarA to tomAke satkarmaparAYaNa dekhachi|’

iusupha valala, ‘tomAderake ye khAdya deoYA haYa tA AsAra pUrvei Ami tomAderake svapnera tAtparya jAniYe diva| Ami yA tomAderake valiva tA, AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke yA zikSA diYechena tA hate valava| ye sampradAYa AllAhe vizvAsa kare nA o AkhirAte avizvAsI Ami tAdera matavAda varjana karechi|

‘Ami AmAra pitRpuruSa ivrAhIma, ishAka evaM iYA‘ka‚vera matavAda anusaraNa kari| AllAh ra saGge kona vastuke zarIka karA AmAdera kAja naYa| eTA AmAdera o samasta mAnuSera prati AllAh ra anugraha; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
‘he kArA-saGgIdvaYa! bhinna bhinna vahu pratipAlaka zreYa, nA parAkramazAlI eka AllAh?

‘tA~ke cher3e tomarA kevala katakaguli nAmera ‘ivAdata karacho, ye nAmaguli tomAdera pitRpuruSa o tomarA rekhecha; eigulira kona pramANa AllAh pAThAna nAi| vidhAna divAra adhikAra kevala AllAh ra i| tini Adeza diYechena anya kArao ‘ivAdata nA karate, kevala tA~ra vyatIta; eTAi zAzvata dIna, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa|

‘he kArA-saGgIdvaYa! tomAdera duijanera ekajana tAra prabhuke madya pAna karAve evaM aparajana zUlaviddha have; erapara tAra mastaka hate pAkhi AhAra karave| ye viSaYe tomarA jAnate ceYecha tAra siddhAnta haYe geche|’

iusupha edera madhye ye mukti pAve mane karala, tAke valala, ‘tomAra prabhura nikaTa AmAra kathA vala’, kintu zaYatAna eke era prabhura nikaTa tAra viSaYa valAra kathA bhuliYe dila; sutarAM iusupha kaYeka vatsara kArAgAre raila|

rAjA valala, ‘Ami svapne dekhalAma, sAtaTi sthUlakAYa gAbhI, ederake sAtaTi zIrNakAYa gAbhI bhakSaNa karache evaM dekhalAma sAtaTi savuja zISa o apara sAtaTi zuSka| he pradhAnagaNa! yadi tomarA svapnera vyAkhyA karate pAra tave AmAra svapna samvandhe abhimata dAo|’
erA valala, ‘eTA arthahIna svapna evaM AmarA eirUpa svapna vyAkhyAYa abhijJa nai|’
du’jana kArAruddhera madhye ye mukti peYechila evaM dIrghakAla pare yAra smaraNa hala se valala, ‘Ami eTAra tAtparya tomAderake jAniYe diva| sutarAM tomarA AmAke pAThAo|’

se valala, ‘he iusupha! he satyavAdI! sAtaTi sthUlakAYa gAbhI, ederake sAtaTi zIrNakAYa gAbhI bhakSaNa karache evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa o apara sAtaTi zuSka zISa samvandhe tumi AmAderake vyAkhyA dAo, yAte Ami lokadera nikaTa phire yete pAri o yAte tArA avagata hate pAre|’
iusupha valala, ‘tomarA sAta vatsara ekAdikrame cASa karave, erapara tomarA ye zasya kartana karave era madhye ye sAmAnya parimANa tomarA bhakSaNa karave, tA vyatIta samasta zISasameta rekhe dive;
‘eTAra para Asave sAtaTi kaThina vatsara, ei sAta vatsara, yA pUrve saJcaYa kare rAkhave, loke tA khAve; kevala sAmAnya kichu yA tomarA saMrakSaNa karave, tA vyatIta|
‘erapara Asave eka vatsara, sei vatsara mAnuSera janye pracura vRSTipAta have evaM sei vatsara mAnuSa pracura phalera rasa niMr3Ave|’

rAjA valala, ‘tomarA iusuphake AmAra nikaTa niYe Asa|’ yakhana dUta tAra nikaTa upasthita hala takhana se valala, ‘tumi tomAra prabhura nikaTa phire yAo evaM tAke jijJAsA kara, ye nArIgaNa hAta keTe phelechila tAdera avasthA kI! nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka tAdera chalanA samyaka avagata|’

rAjA nArIgaNake valala, ‘yakhana tomarA iusupha hate asat karma kAmanA karechile, takhana tomAdera kI haYechila?’ tArA valala, ‘adbhuta AllAh ra mAhAtmya! AmarA era madhye kona doSa dekhi nAi|’ ‘AyIyera strI valala, ‘ekSaNe satya prakAza hala, Amii tAke phusalAiYAchilAma, nizcaYai se to satyavAdI|’
eTA eijanye ye, yAte se jAnate pAre, tAra anupasthitite Ami tAra prati vizvAsaghAtakatA kari nAi evaM nizcaYai AllAh vizvAsaghAtakadera Sar3ayantra saphala karena nA|’
se valala, ‘Ami nijeke nirdeASa mane kari nA, mAnuSera mana avazyai manda karmapravaNa, kintu se naYa, yAra prati AmAra pratipAlaka daYA karena| AmAra pratipAlaka to ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’

rAjA valala, ‘iusuphake AmAra nikaTa niYe Asa; Ami tAke AmAra ekAnta sahacara niyukta karava|’ erapara rAjA yakhana tAra saGge kathA valala, takhana rAjA valala, ‘Aja tumi to AmAdera nikaTa maryAdAzIla, vizvAsabhAjana hale|’
iusupha valala, ‘AmAke dezera dhanabhANDArera opara kartRtva pradAna karuna; Ami to uttama rakSaka, suvijJa|’
eibhAve iusuphake Ami sedeze pratiSThita karalAma; se sedeze yathA icchA avasthAna karate pArata| Ami yAke icchA tAra prati daYA kari; Ami satkarmaparAYaNadera zramaphala naSTa kari nA|
yArA mu’mina evaM muttAkI tAdera AkhirAtera puraskArai uttama|
iusuphera bhAigaNa elo evaM tAra nikaTa upasthita hala| se ederake cinala, kintu erA tAke cinate pArala nA|

evaM se yakhana edera sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dila takhana se valala, ‘tomarA AmAra nikaTa tomAdera vaimAtreYa bhAike niYe Asa| tomarA ki dekhacha nA ye, Ami mApe pUrNamAtrAYa dei evaM Ami uttama atithiparAYaNa|
‘kintu tomarA yadi tAke AmAra nikaTa niYe nA Asa tave AmAra nikaTa tomAdera janye kona varAdda thAkave nA evaM tomarA AmAra nikaTavartI have nA|
erA valala, ‘era viSaYe AmarA era pitAke sammata karAra ceSTA karava evaM AmarA nizcaYai eTA karava|’
iusupha tAra bhRtya-gaNake valala, ‘erA ye paNyamUlya diYeche tA edera mAlapatrera madhye rekhe dAo-yAte svajanadera nikaTa pratyAvartanera para erA tA cinate pAre, tA hale erA punarAYa Asate pAre|’

erapara erA yakhana edera pitAra nikaTa phire elo, takhana erA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! AmAdera janye varAdda niSiddha karA haYeche| sutarAM AmAdera bhAike AmAdera saGge pAThiYe dina yAte AmarA rasada pete pAri| AmarA avazyai tAra rakSaNA-vekSaNa karava|’
se valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake era samvandhe serUpa vizvAsa karava, yerUpa vizvAsa pUrve tomAderake karechilAma era bhAi samvandhe? AllAhi rakSaNAvekSaNe zreSTha evaM tini sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’

yakhana erA edera mAlapatra khulala takhana erA dekhate pela edera paNyamUlya ederake pratyarpaNa karA haYeche| erA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! AmarA Ara ki pratyAzA karate pAri? eTA AmAdera pradatta paNyamUlya, AmAderake pratyarpaNa karA haYeche| punarAYa AmarA AmAdera parivAravargake khAdya-sAmagrI ene diva evaM AmarA AmAdera bhAira rakSaNAvekSaNa karava evaM AmarA atirikta Ara eka uSTravojhAi paNya Anava; yA enechi tA parimANe alpa|’

pitA valala, ‘Ami eke kakhanai tomAdera saGge pAThAva nA yatakSaNa nA tomarA AllAh ra nAme aGgIkAra kara ye, tomarA eke AmAra nikaTa niYe Asavei, avazya yadi tomarA ekAnta asahAYa haYe nA par3a|’ erapara yakhana erA tAra nikaTa pratijJA karala takhana se valala, ‘AmarA ye viSaYe kathA valachi, AllAh tAra vidhAYaka|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra putragaNa! tomarA eka dvAra diYe praveza kara nA, bhinna bhinna dvAra diYe praveza karave| AllAh ra vidhAnera viruddhe Ami tomAdera janye kichu karate pAri nA| vidhAna AllAh ra i| Ami tA~rai opara nirbhara kari evaM yArA nirbhara karate cAYa tArA AllAh ra i opara nirbhara karuka|’

yakhana tArA, tAdera pitA tAderake yebhAve Adeza karechila, seibhAvei praveza karala, takhana AllAh ra vidhAnera viruddhe tA tAdera kona kAje elo nA; iYA‘ka‚va kevala tAra manera ekaTi abhiprAYa pUrNa karechila evaM se avazyai jJAnI chila, kAraNa Ami tAke zikSA diYechilAma| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa|
erA yakhana iusuphera sAmane upasthita hala, takhana iusupha tAra sahodarake nijera kAche rAkhalo evaM valala, ‘nizcaYai Amii tomAra sahodara, sutarAM erA yA karata tAra janye duHkha kara nA|’

erapara se yakhana edera sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dila, takhana se tAra sahodarera mAlapatrera madhye pAnapAtra rekhe dila| erapara eka AhaŸAYaka citkAra kare valala, ‘he yAtrIdala! tomarA nizcaYai cora|’
erA tAdera dike phire valala, ‘tomarA kI hAriYecha?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA rAjAra pAnapAtra hAriYechi; ye tA ene dive se eka uSTravojhAi mAla pAve evaM Ami era jAmina|’
erA valala, ‘AllAh ra zapatha! tomarA to jAna AmarA ei deze duSkRti karate Asi nAi evaM AmarA corao nai|’
tArA valala, ‘yadi tomarA mithyAvAdI hao tave tAra zAsti kI?
erA valala, ‘eTAra zAsti yAra mAlapatrera madhye pAtraTi pAoYA yAve, se-i tAra vinimaYa|’ ebhAve AmarA sImAlaMghanakArIderake zAsti diYe thAki|

erapara se tAra sahodarera mAlapatra tallAzira pUrve edera mAlapatra tallAzi karate lAgala, pare tAra sahodarera mAlapatrera madhya hate pAtraTi vera karala| ebhAve Ami iusuphera janye kauzala karechilAma| rAjAra Aine tAra sahodarake se ATaka karate pArata nA, AllAh icchA nA karale| Ami yAke icchA maryAdAYa unnIta kari| pratyeka jJAnavAna vyaktira opara Achena sarvajJAnI|

erA valala, ‘se yadi curi kare thAke tave tAra sahodarao to pUrve curi karechila|’ kintu iusupha prakRta vyApAra nijera mane gopana rAkhalo evaM edera nikaTa prakAza karala nA; se mane mane valala, ‘tomAdera avasthA to hInatara evaM tomarA yA valacha se samvandhe AllAh savizeSa avahita|’
erA valala, ‘he ‘AyIya! era pitA to atizaYa vRddha; sutarAM era sthale Apani AmAdera ekajanake rAkhuna| AmarA to ApanAke dekhachi mahAnubhava vyaktidera ekajana|’
se valala, ‘yAra nikaTa AmarA AmAdera mAla peYechi, tAke chAr3A anyake rAkhAra aparAdha hate AmarA AllAh ra zaraNa nicchi| eirUpa karale AmarA avazyai sImAlaMghanakArI hava|’

yakhana erA tAra nikaTa hate sampUrNa nirAza hala, takhana erA nirjane giYA parAmarza karate lAgala| edera vaYojyeSTha vyakti valala, ‘tomarA ki jAna nA ye, tomAdera pitA tomAdera nikaTa hate AllAh ra nAme aGgIkAra niYechena evaM pUrveo tomarA iusuphera vyApAre truTi karechile? sutarAM Ami kichutei ei deza tyAga karava nA, yatakSaNa nA AmAra pitA AmAke anumati dena vA AllAh AmAra janye kona vyavasthA karena evaM tinii zreSTha vicAraka|
‘tomarA tomAdera pitAra nikaTa phire yAo evaM vala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! ApanAra putra to curi kareche evaM AmarA yA jAni tArai pratyakSa vivaraNa dilAma| Ara ajAnA vyApAre AmarA saMrakSaNakArI nai|
‘ye janapade AmarA chilAma era adhivAsIgaNa ke jijJAsA karuna evaM ye yAtrIdalera saGge AmarA esechi tAderakeo| AmarA avazyai satya valachi|’

iYA‘ka‚va valala, ‘nA, tomAdera mana tomAdera janye ekaTi kAhinI sAjiYe diYeche, sutarAM pUrNa dhairyai zreYa; haYato AllAh ederake ekasaGge AmAra nikaTa ene divena| avazya tinii sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|’
se edera hate mukha phiriYe nila evaM valala, ‘Aphasosa iusuphera janye|’ zoke tAra cokhadvaYa sAdA haYe giYechila evaM se chila asahanIYa manastApe kliSTa|
erA valala, ‘AllAh ra zapatha! Apani to iusuphera kathA sadA smaraNa karate thAkavena yatakSaNa nA Apani mumUrSu havena, vA mRtyuvaraNa karavena|’
se valala, ‘Ami AmAra asahanIYa vedanA, AmAra duHkha zudhu AllAh ra nikaTa nivedana karachi evaM Ami AllAh ra nikaTa hate jAni yA tomarA jAna nA|
‘he AmAra putragaNa! tomarA yAo, iusupha o tAra sahodarera anusandhAna kara evaM AllAh ra Azisa hate tomarA nirAza haYo nA| kAraNa AllAh ra Azis hate keui nirAza haYa nA, kAphira sampradAYa vyatIta|’

yakhana erA tAra nikaTa upasthita hala takhana valala, ‘he ‘AyIya! AmarA o AmAdera parivAra-parijana vipanna haYe par3echi evaM AmarA tuccha pu~ji niYe esechi; Apani AmAdera rasada pUrNamAtrAYa dina evaM AmAderake dAna karuna; AllAh avazyai dAtAgaNake puraskRta kare thAkena|’
se valala, ‘tomarA ki jAna, tomarA iusupha o tAra sahodarera prati kirUpa AcaraNa karechile, yakhana tomarA chile ajJa?’

erA valala, ‘tave ki tumii iusupha?’ se valala, ‘Amii iusupha evaM ei AmAra sahodara; AllAh to AmAdera prati anugraha karechena| nizcaYai ye vyakti muttAkI evaM dhairyazIla, AllAh to serUpa satkarmaparAYaNadera zramaphala naSTa karena nA|’
erA valala, AllAh ra zapatha! AllAh nizcaYai tomAke AmAdera opara prAdhAnya diYechena evaM AmarA to aparAdhI chilAma|’
se valala, ‘Aja tomAdera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei| AllAh tomAderake kSamA karuna evaM tinii zreSTha daYAlu|’
tomarA AmAra ei jAmATi niYe yAo evaM eTA AmAra pitAra mukhamaNDalera opara rekha; tini dRSTizakti phire pAvena| Ara tomAdera parivArera sakalakei AmAra nikaTa niYe eso|’
erapara yAtrIdala yakhana vera haYe par3ala takhana edera pitA valala, ‘tomarA yadi AmAke aprakRtistha mane nA kara tave vali, Ami iusuphera ghrANa pAcchi|’
tArA valala, ‘AllAh ra zapatha! Apani to ApanAra pUrva-vibhrAntitei raYechena

erapara yakhana susaMvAdavAhaka upasthita hala evaM tAra mukhamaNDalera opara jAmATi rAkhalo takhana se dRSTizakti phire pela| se valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake vali nAi ye, Ami AllAh ra nikaTa hate jAni yA tomarA jAna nA?’
erA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! AmAdera pApera janye kSamA prArthanA karuna; AmarA to aparAdhI|’
se valala, ‘Ami AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa tomAdera janye kSamA prArthanA karava| tini to ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
erapara erA yakhana iusuphera nikaTa upasthita hala, takhana se tAra pitA-mAtAke AliMgana karala evaM valala, ‘ApanArA AllAh ra icchAYa nirApade misare praveza karuna|’

evaM iusupha tAra mAtA-pitAke uccAsane vasAla evaM erA sakale tAra sammAne sijdAYa luTiYe par3ala| se valala, ‘he AmAra pitA! eTAi AmAra pUrvekAra svapnera vyAkhyA; AmAra pratipAlaka tA satye pariNata karechena evaM tini AmAke kArAgAra hate mukta kare evaM zaYatAna AmAra o AmAra bhAidera samparka naSTa karAra parao ApanAderake maru aJcala hate ekhAne ene diYe AmAra prati anugraha karechena| AmAra pratipAlaka yA icchA tA nipuNatAra saGge karena| tini to sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|’

‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke rAjya dAna karecha evaM svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA diYecha| he AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sraSTA! tumii ihaloka o paraloke AmAra abhibhAvaka| tumi AmAke musalima hiseve mRtyu dAo evaM AmAke satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta kara|’
eTA adRzyalokera saMvAda yA tomAke Ami ohI diYe avahita karachi; Sar3ayantrakAle yakhana erA mataikye pau~chiYAchila, takhana tumi edera saGge chile nA|
tumi yatai cAo nA kena, adhikAMza lokai vizvAsa karAra naYa|
evaM tumi tAdera nikaTa eTAra janye kona pArizramika dAvi karacho nA| eTA to vizvajagatera janye upadeza vyatIta kichu naYa|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte aneka nidarzana raYeche; tArA ei samasta pratyakSa kare, kintu tArA ei sakalera prati udAsIna|
tAdera adhikAMza AllAhe vizvAsa kare, kintu tA~ra zarIka kare|
tave ki tArA AllAh ra sarvagrAsI zAsti hate vA tAdera ajJAtasAre kiYAmatera Akasmika upasthiti hate nirApada?
vala, ‘eTAi AmAra patha: AllAh ra prati mAnuSake Ami AhvAna kari sajJAne-Ami evaM AmAra anusArigaNao| AllAh mahimAnvita evaM yArA AllAh ra zarIka kare Ami tAdera antarbhukta nai|’

tomAra pUrveo janapadavAsIdera madhya hate puruSagaNakei preraNa karechilAma, yAdera nikaTa ohI pAThAtAma| tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nAi evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera ki pariNAma haYechila tA ki dekhe nAi? yArA muttAkI tAdera janye paralokai zreYa; tomarA ki vujha nA?

avazeSe yakhana rAsUlagaNa nirAza hala evaM loke bhAvala ye, rAsUlagaNake mithyA AzvAsa deoYA haYeche takhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra sAhAyya elo| eibhAve Ami yAke icchA kari se uddhAra pAYa| aparAdhI sampradAYa hate AmAra zAsti rada karA yAYa nA|

edera vRttAnte vodhazaktisampanna vyaktidera janye Ache zikSA| eTA emana vANI yA mithyA racanA naYa| kintu mu’minadera janye eTA pUrvagranthe yA Ache tAra pratyaYana evaM samasta kichura vizada vivaraNa, hidAYAta o rahamata|
Aliph-lAma-mIm-rA, eiguli kuraAnera AYAta, yA tomAra pratipAlaka hate tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tAi satya; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa ete ImAna Ane nA|

AllAhi Urdhvadeze AkAzamaNDalI sthApana karechena stambha vyatIta-tomarA eTA dekhacha| erapara tini rAze samAsIna halena evaM sUrya o candrake niYamAdhIna karalena; pratyeke nirdiSTa kAla paryanta Avartana kare| tini sakala viSaYa niYantraNa karena evaM nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera saGge sAkSAt samvandhe nizcita vizvAsa karate pAra|

tinii bhUtalake vistRta karechena evaM ete parvata o nadI sRSTi karechena evaM pratyeka prakArera phala sRSTi karechena jor3AYa jor3AYa| tini divasake rAtri diYe AcchAdita karena| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche cintAzIla sampradAYera janye|

pRthivIte raYeche paraspara-saMlagna bha‚khaNDa, ete Ache drAkSA kAnana, zasyakSetra, ekAdhika ziraviziSTa vA eka ziraviziSTa kharjura-vRkSa siJcita ekai pAnite, evaM phala hiseve edera katakake katakera opara Ami zreSThatva diYe thAki| avazyai vodhazaktisampanna sampradAYera janye ete raYeche nidarzana|

yadi tumi vismita hao, tave vismaYera viSaYa edera kathA-‘mATite pariNata haoYAra parao ki AmarA nUtana jIvana lAbha karava?’ erAi edera pratipAlakake asvIkAra kare evaM ederai galadeze thAkave lauhazR´khala| erAi doyakhavAsI o sekhAne erA sthAYI have|

maGgalera pUrve erA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale, yadio edera pUrve eTAra vahu dRSTAnta gata haYeche| mAnuSera sImAlaMghana sattveo tomAra pratipAlaka to mAnuSera prati kSamAzIla evaM tomAra pratipAlaka zAstidAne to kaThora|
yArA kupharI kareche tArA vale, ‘tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tAra nikaTa kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ tumi to kevala satarkakArI evaM pratyeka sampradAYera janye Ache pathapradarzaka|
pratyeka nArI yA garbhe dhAraNa kare evaM jarAYute yA kichu kame o vAr3e AllAh tA jAnena evaM tA~ra vidhAne pratyeka vasturai eka nirdiSTa parimANa Ache|
yA adRzya o yA dRzyamAna tini tA avagata; tini mahAna, sarveAcca maryAdAvAna|
tomAdera madhye ye kathA gopana rAkhe vA ye tA prakAza kare, rAtrite ye Atmagopana kare evaM divase ye prakAzye vicaraNa kare, tArA samabhAve AllAh ra jJAnagocara|

mAnuSera janye tAra sAmane o pazcAte ekera para eka praharI thAke; erA AllAh ra Adeze tAra rakSaNAvekSaNa kare| evaM AllAh kona sampradAYera avasthA parivartana karena nA yatakSaNa nA erA nija avasthA nije parivartana kare| kona sampradAYa samparke yadi AllAh azubha kichu icchA karena tave tA rada haoYAra naYa evaM tini vyatIta edera kona abhibhAvaka nei|
tinii tomAderake dekhAna vijalI, bhaYa o bharasA saJcAra karAna evaM tinii sRSTi karena bhArI megha;

vajradhvani tA~ra saprazaMsa mahimA o pavitratA ghoSaNA kare, pherezatAgaNao kare tAra bhaYe| tini vajrapAta karena evaM yAke icchA tA diYe AghAta karena| Ara erA AllAh samvandhe vitaNDA kare, athaca tini mahAzaktizAlI|

satyera AhvAna tA~rai| yArA tA~ke vyatIta AhvAna kare aparake, tAderake konai sAr3A deYa nA erA; tAdera dRSTAnta sei vyaktira mata, ye tAra mukhe pAni pau~chive-ei AzAYa tAra hastadvaYa prasArita kare pAnira dike, athaca tA tAra mukhe pau~chivAra naYa, kAphiradera AhvAna niSphala|
AllAh ra prati sijdAvanata haYa AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache icchAYa vA anicchAYa evaM tAdera chAYAgulio sakAla o sandhyAYa|

vala, ‘ke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra pratipAlaka?’ vala, ‘AllAh’| vala, ‘tave ki tomarA abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karecha AllAh ra parivarte aparake yArA nijedera lAbha vA kSati sAdhane sakSama naYa?’ vala, ‘andha o cakSuSmAna ki samAna vA andhakAra o Alo ki eka?’ tave kI tArA AllAh ra emana zarIka kareche, yArA AllAh ra sRSTira mata sRSTi kareche, ye kAraNe sRSTi edera nikaTa sadRza mane haYeche? vala, ‘AllAh sakala vastura sraSTA; tini eka, parAkramazAlI|’

tini AkAza hate vRSTipAta karena, phale upatyakAsamUha edera parimANa anuyAYI plAvita haYa evaM plAvana tAra uparisthita AvarjanA vahana kare, erUpe AvarjanA uparibhAge Ase yakhana alaMkAra vA taijasapatra nirmANa uddezye kichu agnite uttapta karA haYa| ebhAve AllAh satya o asatyera dRSTAnta diYe thAkena| yA AvarjanA tA phele deYA haYa evaM yA mAnuSera upakAre Ase tA jamite theke yAYa| eibhAve AllAh upamA diYe thAkena|

maGgala tAdera yArA tAdera pratipAlakera AhvAne sAr3A deYa| evaM yArA tA~ra DAke sAr3A deYa nA, tAdera yadi pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA samastai thAkata evaM tAra saGge samaparimANa Aro thAkata erA muktipaNasvarUpa tA dita| edera hiseva have kaThora evaM jAhAnnAma have edera AvAsa, tA kata nikRSTa AzraYasthala|
tomAra pratipAlaka hate tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA ye vyakti satya vale jAne Ara ye andha tArA ki samAna? upadeza grahaNa kare zudhu vivekazakti sampannagaNai,
yArA AllAhke pradatta aGgIkAra rakSA kare evaM pratijJA bhaGga kare nA,
evaM AllAh ye samparka akSuNNa rAkhate Adeza karechena yArA tA akSuNNa rAkhe, bhaYa kare tAdera pratipAlakake evaM bhaYa kare kaThora hisevake,

evaM yArA tAdera pratipAlakera santuSTi lAbhera janye dhairya dhAraNa kare, sAlAta kAYema kare, Ami tAderake ye jIvanopakaraNa diYechi tA hate gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare evaM yArA bhAla diYe manda dUrIbhUta kare, edera janye zubha pariNAma-

sthAYI jAnnAta, ete tArA praveza karave evaM tAdera pitA-mAtA, pati-pataèI o santAna-santatidera madhye yArA satkarma kareche tArAo evaM pherezatAgaNa tAdera nikaTa upasthita have pratyeka dvAra diYe,
evaM valave, ‘tomarA dhairya dhAraNa karecha vale tomAdera prati zAnti; kata uttama ei pariNAma|

yArA AllAh ra saGge dRr3ha aGgIkAre Avaddha haoYAra para tA bhaGga kare, ye samparka akSuNNa rAkhate AllAh Adeza karechena, tA chinna kare evaM pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare ver3AYa, tAdera janye Ache lA‘nata evaM tAdera janye Ache manda AvAsa|
AllAh yAra janye icchA tAra jIvanopakaraNa vardhita karena evaM saMkucita karena; kintu erA pArthiva jIvane ullasita, athaca duniYAra jIvana to AkhirAtera tulanAYa kSaNasthAYI bhogamAtra|

yArA kuphrI kareche tArA vale, ‘tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tAra nikaTa kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ vala, ‘AllAh yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM tini tAderake tA~ra patha dekhAna yArA tA~ra abhimukhI,
‘yArA ImAna Ane evaM AllAh ra smaraNe yAdera citta prazAnta haYa; jene rAkha, AllAh ra smaraNei citta prazAnta haYa;
‘yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, parama Ananda evaM zubha pariNAma tAderai|’

eibhAve Ami tomAke pAThiYechi eka jAtira prati yAra pUrve vahu jAti gata haYeche, edera nikaTa tilAoYAta karAra janye, yA Ami tomAra prati pratyAdeza karechi| tathApi erA daYAmaYake asvIkAra kare| vala, ‘tinii AmAra pratipAlaka; tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| tA~rai opara Ami nirbhara kari evaM AmAra pratyAvartana tA~rai nikaTa|’

yadi kona kuraAna emana hata yA diYe parvatake gatizIla karA yeta vA pRthivIke vidIrNa karA yeta vA mRtera saGge kathA valA yeta, tavuo erA ete vizvAsa karata nA| kintu samasta viSaYai AllAh ra ikhtiYArabhukta| tave ki yArA ImAna eneche tAdera pratyaYa haYa nAi ye, AllAh icchA karale nizcaYai sakalake satpathe paricAlita karate pAratena? yArA kupharI kareche tAdera karmaphalera janye tAdera viparyaYa ghaTatei thAkave, vA viparyaYa tAdera AzepAze Apatita hatei thAkave yatakSaNa paryanta nA AllAh ra pratizruti ese par3ave| nizcaYai AllAh pratizrutira vyatikrama karena nA|
tomAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlake ThATTA-vidrupa karA haYeche evaM yArA kupharI kareche tAderake Ami kichu avakAza diYechilAma, tAra para ederake zAsti diYechilAma| kemana chila AmAra zAsti!

tave ki pratyeka mAnuSa yA kare tAra yini paryavekSaka tini edera akSama ilAhgulira mata? athaca erA AllAh ra vahu zarIka kareche| vala, ‘edera paricaYa dAo|’ tomarA ki pRthivIra madhye emana kichura saMvAda dite cAo-yA tini jAnena nA? vA eTA vAhyika kathA mAtra? nA, kAphiradera nikaTa edera chalanA zobhana pratIYamAna haYeche evaM ederake satpatha hate nivRtta karA haYeche, Ara AllAh yAke vibhrAnta karena tAra kona pathapradarzaka nAi|
edera janye duniYAra jIvane Ache zAsti evaM AkhirAtera zAsti to Aro kaThora! evaM AllAh ra zAsti hate rakSA karAra edera keu nei|

muttAkIderake ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deoYA haYeche, tAra upamA eirUpa: era pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, era phalasamUha o chAYA cirasthAYI| yArA muttAkI eTA tAdera karmaphala evaM kAphiradera karmaphala doyakha|

Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA yA tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tAte Ananda pAYa, kintu kona kona dala era kataka aMza asvIkAra kare| vala, ‘Ami to AllAh ra ‘ivAdata karate o tA~ra kona zarIka nA karate AdiSTa haYechi| Ami tA~rai prati AhvAna kari evaM tA~rai nikaTa AmAra pratyAvartana|’
ebhAve Ami kuraAna avatIrNa karechi vidhAnarUpe AravI bhASAYa| jJAna prAptira para tumi yadi tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara tave AllAh ra viruddhe tomAra kona abhibhAvaka o rakSaka thAkave nA|

tomAra pUrve Ami to aneka rAsUla preraNa karechilAma evaM tAderake strI o santAna-santati diYechilAma| AllAh ra anumati vyatIta kona nidarzana upasthita karA kona rAsUlera kAja naYa| pratyeka viSaYera nirdhArita kAla lipivaddha|
AllAh yA icchA tA nizcihna karena evaM yA icchA tA pratiSThita rAkhena evaM tA~rai nikaTa Ache ummula kitAva|
ederake ye zAstira pratizruti diYechi tAra kichu yadi tomAke dekhAi vA yadi eTAra pUrve tomAra kAla pUrNa kare dei-tomAra kartavya to kevala pracAra karA evaM hiseva-nikAza to AmAra kAja|
erA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami edera dezake caturdika hate saMkucita kare Anachi? AllAh Adeza karena, tA~ra Adeza rada karAra keu nei evaM tini hiseva grahaNe tatpara|
edera pUrve yArA chila tArAo cakrAnta karechila; kintu samasta cakrAnta AllAh ra ikhatiYAre| pratyeka vyakti yA kare tA tini jAnena evaM kAphirarA zIghrai jAnive zubha pariNAma kAdera janye|
yArA kupharI kareche tArA vale, ‘tumi AllAh ra prerita nao|’ vala, ‘AllAh evaM yAdera nikaTa kitAvera jJAna Ache, tArA AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve yatheSTa|’

Alipha-lAm-rA, ei kitAva, eTA tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi yAte tumi mAnavajAtike tAdera pratipAlakera nirdezakrame vera kare Anate pAra andhakAra hate Aloke, tA~ra pathe yini parAkramazAlI, prazaMsArha,
AllAh-AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai| kaThina zAstira durbheAga kAphiradera janye,
yArA duniYAra jIvanake AkhirAtera ceYe bhAlavAse, mAnuSake nivRtta kare AllAh ra patha hate evaM AllAh ra patha vakra karate cAYa; erAi to ghora vibhrAntite raYeche|

Ami pratyeka rAsUlakei tAra svajAtira bhASAbhASI kare pAThiYechi tAdera nikaTa pariSkArabhAve vyAkhyA karAra janye, AllAh yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM yAke icchA satpathe paricAlita karena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

mUsAke Ami to AmAra nidarzanasaha preraNa karechilAma evaM valechilAma, ‘tomAra sampradAYake andhakAra hate Alote AnaYana kara, evaM ederake AllAh ra divasagulira diYe upadeza dAo|’ ete to nidarzana raYeche pratyeka parama dhairyazIla o parama kRtajJa vyaktira janye|

smaraNa kara, mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘tomarA AllAh ra anugraha’ smaraNa kara yakhana tini tomAderake rakSA karechilena phira‘AonI sampradAYera kavala hate, yArA tomAderake nikRSTa zAsti dita, tomAdera putragaNake yaveh karata o tomAdera nArIgaNake jIvita rAkhita; evaM ete chila tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka mahAparIkSA|’
smaraNa kara, tomAdera pratipAlaka ghoSaNA karena, ‘tomarA kRtajJa hale tomAderake avazyai adhika diva Ara akRtajJa hale avazyai AmAra zAsti have kaThora|’
mUsA valechila, ‘tomarA evaM pRthivIra sakalei yadi akRtajJa hao tathApi AllAh abhAvamukta evaM prazaMsArha|

‘tomAdera nikaTa ki saMvAda Ase nAi tomAdera pUrvavartIdera, nUhera sampradAYera, ‘Adera o sAmUdera evaM tAdera paravartIdera? edera viSaYa AllAh vyatIta anya keu jAne nA|’ edera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzanasaha edera rAsUla esechila, erA edera hAta edera mukhe sthApana karata evaM valata, ‘yAsaha tomarA prerita haYecha tA AmarA avazyai asvIkAra kari evaM AmarA avazyai vibhrAntikara sandehe raYechi se viSaYe, yAra prati tomarA AmAderake AhvAna karacho|’

edera rAsUlagaNa valechila, ‘AllAh samvandhe ki kona sandeha Ache, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA? tini tomAderake AhvAna karena tomAdera pApa mArjanA karAra janye evaM nirdiSTa kAla paryanta tomAderake avakAza divAra janye|’ erA valata, ‘tomarA to AmAderai mata mAnuSa| AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNa yAdera ‘ivAdata karata tomarA tAdera ‘ivAdata hate AmAderake virata rAkhate cAo| ataeva tomarA AmAdera nikaTa kona akATya pramANa upasthita kara|’

edera rAsUlagaNa ederake valata, ‘satya vaTe, AmarA tomAdera mata mAnuSai kintu AllAh tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA anugraha karena| AllAh ra anumati vyatIta tomAdera nikaTa pramANa upasthita karA AmAdera kAja naYa| AllAh ra oparai mu’minagaNera nirbhara karA ucita|

AmAdera ki haYeche ye, ‘AmarA AllAh ra opara nirbhara karava nA? tinii to AmAderake patha pradarzana karechena| tomarA AmAderake ye kleza ditecha, AmarA tAte avazyai dhairya dhAraNa karava evaM AllAh ra i opara nirbharakArigaNa nirbhara karuka|’

kAphirarA edera rAsUlagaNake valechila, ‘AmarA tomAderake AmAdera deza hate avazyai vahiSkAra karava vA tomAderake AmAdera dharmAdarze phire Asatei have|’ erapara rAsUlagaNake tAdera pratipAlaka ohI preraNa karalena, jAlimaderake Ami avazyai vinAza karava;
‘edera pare Ami tomAderake deze pratiSThita karavai; eTA tAdera janye yArA bhaYa rAkhe AmAra sAmane upasthita haoYAra evaM bhaYa rAkhe AmAra zAstira|’
erA vijaYa kAmanA karala evaM pratyeka uddhata svairAcArI vyarthamanoratha hala|
edera pratyekera janye pariNAme jAhAnnAma raYeche evaM pAna karAno have galita pu~ja;

yA se ati kaSTe ekeka Dhoka kare galAdhaHkaraNa karave evaM tA galAdhaHkaraNa karA prAYa sahaja have nA| sarvadika hate tAra nikaTa Asave mRtyuyantraNA, kintu tAra mRtyu ghaTave nA evaM eTAra para kaThora zAsti bhoga karatei thAkave|

yArA tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra kare tAdera upamA-tAdera karmasamUha bhasmasadRza yA jhar3era dinera vAtAsa pracaNDa vege ur3iYe niYe yAYa| yA tArA upArjana kare tAra kichui tArA tAdera kAje lAgAte pAre nA| eTA to ghora vibhrAnti|
tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI yathAvidhi sRSTi karechena? tini icchA karale tomAdera astitva vilopa karate pArena evaM eka nUtana sRSTi astitve Anate pArena,
Ara eTA AllAh ra janye Adau kaThina naYa|

sakale AllAh ra nikaTa upasthita have| yArA ahaMkAra karata takhana durvalerA tAderake valave, ‘AmarA to tomAdera anusArI chilAma; ekhana tomarA AllAh ra zAsti hate AmAderake kichumAtra rakSA karate pArave?’ erA valave, ‘AllAh AmAderake satpathe paricAlita karale AmarAo tomAderake satpathe paricAlita karatAma| ekhana AmarA dhairyacyuta hai vA dhairyazIla hai ekai kathA; AmAdera kona niSkRti nei|’

yakhana vicArakArya sampanna have takhana zaYatAna valave, ‘AllAh to tomAderake pratizruti diYechilena satya pratizruti, Amio tomAderake pratizruti diYechilAma, kintu Ami tomAderake pradatta pratizruti bhaGga karechi| AmAra to tomAdera opara kona Adhipatya chila nA, Ami kevala tomAderake AhvAna karechilAma evaM tomarA AmAra AhvAne sAr3A diYechile| sutarAM tomarA AmAra prati doSAropa kara nA, tomarA nijederai prati doSAropa kara| Ami tomAdera uddhAre sAhAyya karate sakSama nai evaM tomarAo AmAra uddhAre sAhAyya karate sakSama nao| tomarA ye pUrve AmAke AllAh ra zarIka karechile Ami tA asvIkAra karachi, jAlimadera janye to marmantuda zAsti raYeche|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAderake dAkhila karA have jAnnAte yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, tAdera pratipAlakera anumatikrame, sekhAne tAdera abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’|
tumi ki lakSya kara nA AllAh kibhAve upamA diYe thAkena? satvAkyera tulanA utkRSTa vRkSa yAra mUla sudRr3ha o yAra zAkhA-prazAkhA Urdhve vistRta,
yA pratyeka maosume era phaladAna kare era pratipAlakera anumatikrame| evaM AllAh mAnuSera janye upamA diYe thAkena, yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|
kuvAkyera tulanA eka manda vRkSa yAra mUla bhUpRSTha hate vicchinna, yAra kona sthAYitva nei|
yArA zAzvata vANIte vizvAsI tAderake duniYAra jIvane o AkhirAte AllAh supratiSThita rAkhavena evaM yArA jAlima AllAh ederake vibhrAntite rAkhavena| AllAh yA icchA tA karena|
tumi ki ederake lakSya kara nA, yArA AllAh ra anugrahera vadale akRtajJatA prakAza kare evaM erA edera sampradAYake nAmAiYA Ane dhvaMsera kSetre-
jAhAnnAme, yAra madhye erA praveza karave, kata nikRSTa ei AvAsasthala!
evaM erA AllAh ra samakakSa nirdhAraNa kare tA~ra patha hate vibhrAnta karAra janye| vala, ‘bhoga kare lao, pariNAme doyakhai tomAdera pratyAvartanasthala|’

AmAra vAndAdera madhye yArA mu’mina tAderake tumi vala, sAlAta kAYema karate evaM Ami tAderake jIvikA hiseve yA diYechi tA hate gopane o prakAzye vyaYa karate-sei dinera pUrve yedina kraYa-vikraYa o vandhutva thAkave nA|’

tinii AllAh yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena, yini AkAza hate pAni varSaNa kare tA diYe tomAdera jIvikAra janye phalamUla utpAdana karena, yini nauyAnake tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena yAte tA~ra vidhAne tA samudre vicaraNa kare evaM yini tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena nadIsamUhake|
tini tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena sUrya o candrake, yArA avirAma ekai niYamera anuvartI evaM tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena rAtri o divasake|
evaM tini tomAderake diYechena tomarA tA~ra nikaTa yA kichu ceYecha tA hate| tomarA AllAh ra anugraha gaNanA karale era saMkhyA nirNaYa karate pArave nA| mAnuSa avazyai atimAtrAYa jAlima, akRtajJa|
smaraNa kara, ivrAhIma valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ei nagarIke nirApada kara evaM AmAke o AmAra putragaNake pratimA pUjA hate dUre rekha|
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ei sakala pratimA to vahu mAnuSake vibhrAnta kareche| sutarAM ye AmAra anusaraNa karave se-i AmAra dalabhukta, kintu keu AmAra avAdhya hale tumi to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Ami AmAra vaMzadharadera katakake vasavAsa karAlAma anurvara upatyakAYa tomAra pavitra gRhera nikaTa, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! eijanye ye, erA yena sAlAta kAYema kare| ataeva tumi kichu lokera antara edera prati anurAgI kare dAo evaM phalAdi diYe edera riyikera vyavasthA kara, yAte erA kRtajJatA prakAza kare|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi to jAna yA AmarA gopana kari o yA AmarA prakAza kari; AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra kichui AllAh ra nikaTa gopana thAke nA|
samasta prazaMsA AllAh ra i, yini AmAke AmAra vArdhakye ismAIla o ishAkake dAna karechena| AmAra pratipAlaka avazyai prArthanA zune thAkena|
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke sAlAta kAYemakArI kara evaM AmAra vaMzadharadera madhya hateo| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAra prArthanA kavUla kara|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! yei dina hiseva anuSThita have sei dina AmAke, AmAra pitA-mAtAke evaM mu’minagaNake kSamA kara|’
tumi kakhanao mane kara nA ye, jAlimarA yA kare se viSaYe AllAh gAphila, tave tini ederake sei dina paryanta avakAza dena yedina tAdera cokha have sthira|
bhIta-vihaŸla citte AkAzera dike cAhiYA erA chuTAchuTi karave, nijedera prati edera dRSTi phirive nA evaM edera antara have udAsa|

yedina tAdera zAsti Asave sei dina samparke tumi mAnuSake satarka kara, takhana jAlimarA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake kichu kAlera janye avakAza dAo, AmarA tomAra AhvAne sAr3A diva evaM rAsUlagaNera anusaraNa karava|’ tomarA ki pUrve zapatha kare valite nA ye, tomAdera patana nei?

athaca tomarA vAsa karate tAdera vAsabhUmite, yArA nijedera prati juluma karechila evaM tAdera prati Ami ki karechilAma tAo tomAdera nikaTa suvidita chila evaM tomAdera nikaTa Ami edera dRSTAntao upasthita karechilAma|
erA bhISaNa cakrAnta karechila, kintu edera cakrAnta AllAh rahita karechena, yadio edera cakrAnta emana chila, yAte parvata Tale yeta|
tumi kakhanao mane kara nA ye, AllAh tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati pradatta pratizruti bhaGga karena| nizcaYai AllAh parAkramazAlI, daNDa-vidhAYaka|
yedina ei pRthivI parivartita haYe anya pRthivI have evaM AkAzamaNDalIo; evaM mAnuSa upasthita have AllAh ra sAmane-yini eka parAkramazAlI|
sei dina tumi aparAdhIderake dekhave zRMkhalita avasthAYa,
edera jAmA have AlakAtarAra evaM agni Acchanna karave edera mukhamaNDala;
eTA eijanye ye, AllAh pratyekera kRtakarmera pratiphala divena| nizcaYai AllAh druta hiseva grahaNa karena|
eTA mAnuSera janye eka vArtA, yAte eTA diYe erA satarka haYa evaM jAnate pAre ye, tini ekamAtra ilAh evaM yAte vodhazakti-sampannerA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Alipha-lAma-rA, eiguli AYAta mahAgranthera, suspaSTa kuraAnera|
kakhanao kakhanao kAphirarA AkAksakSA karave ye, tArA yadi musalima hata!
ederake chAr3a, erA khete thAkuka, bhoga karate thAkuka evaM AzA ederake mohAcchanna rAkhuka; acirei erA jAnate pArave|
Ami ye kona janapadake dhvaMsa karechi tAra janye chila ekaTi nirdiSTa lipivaddha kAla|
kona jAti tAra nirdiSTa kAlake tvarAnvita karate pAre nA, vilamvitao karate pAre nA|
erA vale, ‘ohe, yAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa haYeche! tumi to nizcaYa unmAda|
‘tumi satyavAdI hale AmAdera nikaTa phirizatAgaNake upasthita karacho nA kena?’
Ami pherezatAgaNake preraNa kari nA yathArtha kAraNa vyatIta; pherezatAgaNa upasthita hale erA avakAza pAve nA|
Amii kuraAna avatIrNa karechi evaM avazya Amii era saMrakSaka|
tomAra pUrve Ami AgekAra aneka sampradAYera nikaTa rAsUla pAThiYechilAma|
tAdera nikaTa Ase nAi emana kona rAsUla yAke tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata nA|
eibhAve Ami aparAdhIdera antare tA saJcAra kari,
erA kuraAnera prati ImAna Anave nA evaM atIte pUrvavartIderao ei AcaraNa chila|
yadi edera janye AkAzera duYAra khule dei evaM erA sArAdina ete ArohaNa karate thAke,
tavuo erA valave, ‘AmAdera dRSTi sammohita karA haYeche; nA, varaM AmarA eka jAdugrasta sampradAYa|’
Ami AkAze graha-nakSatra sRSTi karechi evaM eke suzobhita karechi darzakadera janye;
evaM pratyeka abhizapta zaYatAna hate Ami eke rakSA kare thAki;
kintu keu curi kare saMvAda zunate cAile era pazcAddhAvana kare pradIpta zikhA|
Ara pRthivI, eke Ami vistRta karechi, ete parvatamAlA sthApana karechi; evaM Ami ete pratyeka vastu udgata karechi suparimitabhAve,
evaM ete jIvikAra vyavasthA karechi tomAdera janye, Ara tomarA yAdera jIvikAdAtA nao tAdera janyeo|
AmArai nikaTa Ache pratyeka vastura bhANDAra evaM Ami tA parijJAta parimANei saravarAha kare thAki|
Ami vRSTi-garbha vAYu preraNa kari, erapara AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kari evaM tA tomAderake pAna karate dei; Ara tomarA era bhANDAra rakSaka nao|
Amii jIvana dAna kari o mRtyu ghaTAi evaM Amii cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI|
tomAdera madhya hate pUrve yArA gata haYeche Ami tAderake jAni evaM pare yArA Asave tAderakeo jAni|
tomAra pratipAlakai ederake samaveta karavena; tini to prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
Ami to mAnuSa sRSTi karechi gandhayukta kardamera zuSka ThanThanA mRttikA hate,
evaM eTAra pUrve sRSTi karechi jina atyuSNa agni hate|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka pherezatAgaNake valalena, ‘Ami gandhayukta kardamera zuSka ThanThanA mRttikA hate mAnuSa sRSTi karachi;
‘yakhana Ami eke suThAma karava evaM ete AmAra pakSa hate rUh saJcAra karava takhana tomarA era prati sijdAvanata haYo’,
takhana pherezatAgaNa sakalei ekatre sijdA karala,
ivalIsa vyatIta, se sijdAkArIdera antarbhukta hate asvIkAra karala|
AllAh valalena, ‘he ivalisa! tomAra ki hala ye, tumi sijdAkArIdera antarbhukta hale nA?’
se valala, ‘Apani gandhayukta kardamera zuSka ThanaThanA mRttikA hate ye mAnuSa sRSTi karechena Ami tAke sijdA karAra nai|’
tini valalena, ‘tave tumi ekhAna hate vera haYe yAo, kAraNa tumi to abhizapta;
‘evaM karmaphala divasa paryanta avazyai tomAra prati raila lA‘nata|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! punarutthAna divasa paryanta AmAke avakAza dina|’
tini valalena, ‘yAderake avakAza deoYA haYeche tumi tAdera antarbhukta hale,
‘avadhArita samaYa upasthita haoYAra dina paryanta|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Apani ye AmAke vipathagAmI karalena tAra janye Ami pRthivIte mAnuSera nikaTa pApakarmake avazyai zobhana kare tulava evaM Ami edera sakalakei vipathagAmI karava,
‘tave edera madhye ApanAra nirvAcita vAndAgaNa vyatIta|’
AllAh valalena, ‘eTAi AmAra nikaTa peৗ~chivAra sarala patha,
‘vibhrAntadera madhye yArA tomAra anusaraNa karave tArA vyatIta AmAra vAndAdera opara tomAra konai kSamatA thAkave nA;
‘avazyai jAhAnnAma tAdera sakalerai pratizruta sthAna,
‘era sAtaTi darajA Ache, pratyeka darajAra janye pRthaka pRthaka zreNI Ache|’
muttAkIrA thAkave jAnnAte o prasravaNasamUhera madhye|
tAderake valA have, ‘tomarA zAnti o nirApattAra saGge ete praveza kara|’
Ami tAdera antara hate vidveSa dUra karava; tArA bhrAtRbhAve paraspara mukhomukhi haYe Asane avasthAna karave,
sekhAne tAderake avasAda sparza karave nA evaM tArA sei sthAna hate vahiSkRtao have nA|
AmAra vAndAderake vale dAo ye, Ami to parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu,
evaM AmAra zAsti-tA ati marmantuda zAsti!
Ara ederake vala, ivrAhImera atithidera kathA,
yakhana erA tAra nikaTa upasthita haYe valala, ‘sAlAma’, takhana se valechila, ‘AmarA to tomAdera Agamane AtaGkita|’
erA valala, ‘bhaYa kara nA, AmarA to tomAke eka jJAnI putrera zubha saMvAda dicchi|’
se valala, ‘tomarA ki AmAke zubha saMvAda ditecha Ami vArdhakyagrasta haoYA sattveo? tomarA kI viSaYe zubha saMvAda ditecha?’
erA valala, ‘AmarA tomAke satya saMvAda dicchi; sutarAM tumi hatAza haYo nA|’
se valala, ‘yArA pathabhraSTa tArA vyatIta Ara ke tAra pratipAlakera anugraha hate hatAza haYa?’
se valala, ‘he pherezatAgaNa! tomAdera Ara vizeSa ki kAja Ache?’
erA valala, ‘AmAderake eka aparAdhI sampradAYera viruddhe preraNa karA haYeche-
‘tave lUtera parivAravargera viruddhe naYa, AmarA avazyai edera sakalake rakSA karava,
‘kintu tAra strIke naYa; AmarA sthira karechi ye, se avazyai pazcAte avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|’
pherezatAgaNa yakhana lUta-parivArera nikaTa elo,
takhana lUta valala, ‘tomarA to aparicita loka|’
tArA valala, ‘nA, erA ye viSaYe sandigdha chila AmarA tomAra nikaTa tAi niYe esechi;
‘AmarA tomAra nikaTa satya saMvAda niYe esechi evaM avazyai AmarA satyavAdI;

‘sutarAM tumi rAtrira kona eka samaYe tomAra parivAravargasaha vera haYe par3a evaM tumi tAdera pazcAdanusaraNa kara evaM tomAdera madhye keu yena pichana dike nA tAkAYa; tomAderake yekhAne yete valA hacche tomarA sekhAne cale yAo|’
Ami tAke ei viSaYe phAYasAlA jAniYe dilAma ye, pratyUSe ederake samUle vinAza karA have|
nagaravAsigaNa ullasita haYe upasthita hala|
se valala, ‘erA AmAra atithi; sutarAM tomarA AmAke veijjata kara nA|
‘tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara o AmAke heYa kara nA|’
erA valala, ‘AmarA ki duniYAsuddha lokake AzraYa dite tomAke niSedha kari nAi?’
lUta valala, ‘ekAntai yadi tomarA kichu karate cAo tave AmAra ei kanyAgaNa raYeche|’
tomAra jIvanera zapatha, erA to mattatAYa vimUr3ha haYeche|
erapara sUryeAdaYera samaYe mahAnAda ederake AghAta karala;
Ara Ami janapadake ulTiYe opara nIca kare dilAma evaM edera opara prastara-kaMkara varSaNa karalAma|
avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche paryavekSaNa-zaktisampanna vyaktidera janye|
tA to loka calAcalera pathipArzve ekhanao vidyamAna|
avazyai ete mu’minadera janye raYeche nidarzana|
Ara ‘AYakA’vAsIrAo to chila sImAlaMghanakArI,
sutarAM Ami ederake zAsti diYechi, avazya ubhaYaTii prakAzya pathipArzve avasthita|
hijravAsigaNao rAsUladera prati mithyA Aropa karechila;
Ami ederake AmAra nidarzana diYechilAma, kintu erA tA upekSA karechila|
erA pAhAr3a keTe gRha nirmANa karata nirApada vAsera janye|
erapara prabhAtakAle mahAnAda ederake AghAta karala|
sutarAM erA yA arjana karata tA edera kona kAje Ase nAi|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM edera antarvartI kona kichui Ami ayathA sRSTi kari nAi evaM kiYAmata avazyambhAvI| sutarAM tumi parama saujanyera saGge ederake kSamA kara|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka mahAsraSTA, mahAjJAnI|
Ami to tomAke diYechi sAta AYAta yA punaH punaH AvRtta haYa evaM diYechi mahAna kuraAna|

Ami tAdera vibhinna zreNIke bhoga-vilAsera ye upakaraNa diYechi, tAra prati tumi kakhanao tomAra cokhadvaYa prasArita kara nA| tAdera janye tumi duHkha kara nA; tumi mu’minadera janye tomAra pakSapuTa avanamita kara,
evaM vala, ‘Ami to kevala eka prakAzya satarkakArI|’
yebhAve Ami avatIrNa karechilAma vibhaktakArIdera opara;
yArA kuraAnake vibhinnabhAve vibhakta kareche|
