sutarAM zapatha tomAra pratipAlakera! Ami edera sakalake prazna karavai,
sei viSaYe, yA erA kare|
ataeva tumi ye viSaYe AdiSTa haYecha tA prakAzye pracAra kara evaM muzarikaderake upekSA kara|
Amii yatheSTa tomAra janye vidrupakArIdera viruddhe,
yArA AllAh ra saGge apara ilAha nirdhAraNa kareche| sutarAM zIghrai erA jAnate pArave|
Ami to jAni, erA yA vale tAte tomAra antara saMkucita haYa;
sutarAM tumi tomAra pratipAlakera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara evaM tumi sijdAkArIdera antarbhukta hao;
tomAra mRtyu upasthita haoYA paryanta tumi tomAra pratipAlakera ‘ivAdata kara|
AllAh ra Adeza Asavei; sutarAM tA tvarAnvita karate ceYo nA| tini mahimAnvita evaM erA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|
tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA svIYa nirdeze ohIsaha pherezatA preraNa karena ei vale ye, tomarA satarka kara, nizcaYai Ami vyatIta kona ilAh nei; sutarAM AmAke bhaYa kara|
tini yathAyathabhAve AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena; erA yA zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|
tini zukra hate mAnuSa sRSTi karechena; athaca dekha, se prakAzya vitaNDAkArI!
tini catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechena; tomAdera janye ete zIta nivAraka upakaraNa o vahu upakAra raYeche| evaM tA hate tomarA AhAra kare thAka|
evaM tomarA yakhana godhUli lagne ederake cAraNabhUmi hate gRhe niYe Asa evaM prabhAte yakhana ederake cAraNabhUmite niYe yAo takhana tomarA era saundarya upabhoga kara|
evaM erA tomAdera bhAra vahana kare niYe yAYa emana deze yekhAne prANAnta kleza vyatIta tomarA peৗ~chate pArate nA| tomAdera pratipAlaka avazyai daYArdra, parama daYAlu|
tomAdera ArohaNera janye o zobhAra janye tini sRSTi karechena azva, azvatara o gardabha evaM tini sRSTi karena emana aneka kichu, yA tomarA avagata nao|
sarala patha AllAh ra kAche peৗ~chAYa, kintu pathagulira madhye vakra pathao Ache| tini icchA karale tomAdera sakalakei satpathe paricAlita karatena|
tinii AkAza hate vArivarSaNa karena| ete tomAdera janye raYeche pAnIYa evaM tA hate janmAYa udbhida yAte tomarA pazucAraNa kare thAka|
tini tomAdera janye era diYe janmAna zasya, yAYatUna, kharjura vRkSa, drAkSA evaM sarvaprakAra phala| avazyai ete cintAzIla sampradAYera janye raYeche nidarzana|

tinii tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena rajanI, divasa, sUrya evaM candrake; Ara nakSatrarAjio adhIna haYeche tA~rai nirdeze| avazyai ete vodhazaktisampanna sampradAYera janye raYeche nizcita nidarzana-
evaM tini vividha prakAra vastuo yA tomAdera janye pRthivIte sRSTi karechena, ete raYeche nizcita nidarzana sei sampradAYera janye yArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

tinii samudrake adhIna karechena, yAte tomarA tA hate tAjA matsya AhAra karate pAra evaM yAte tA hate AharaNa karate pAra rataèAvalI, yA tomarA bhUSaNarUpe paridhAna kara; evaM tomarA dekhate pAo, era vuka ciriYA nauyAna calAcala kare evaM tA eijanye ye, tomarA yena tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM tomarA yena kRtajJatA prakAza kara;
evaM tini pRthivIte sudRr3ha parvata sthApana karechena, yAte pRthivI tomAderake niYe Andolita nA haYa evaM sthApana karechena nada-nadI o patha, yAte tomarA tomAdera gantavyasthale peৗ~chate pAra;
evaM pathanirNAYaka cihnasamUhao| Ara erA nakSatrera sAhAyyeo pathera nirdeza pAYa|
sutarAM yini sRSTi karena tini ki tArai mata, ye sRSTi kare nA? tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?
tomarA AllAh ra anugraha gaNanA karale era saMkhyA nirNaYa karate pArave nA| AllAh to avazyai kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
tomarA yA gopana rAkha evaM yA prakAza kara AllAh tA jAnena|
erA AllAh vyatIta apara yAderake AhvAna kare tArA kichui sRSTi kare nA, tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa|
tArA ni®prANa, nirjIva evaM kakhana tAderake punarutthita karA have se viSaYe tAdera kona cetanA nei|
tomAdera ilAh eka ilAh, sutarAM yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tAdera antara satyavimukha evaM tArA ahaMkArI|
eTA niHsandeha ye, AllAh jAnena yA erA gopana kare evaM yA erA prakAza kare| tini to ahaMkArIderake pachanda karena nA|
yakhana ederake valA haYa, ‘tomAdera pratipAlaka ki avatIrNa karechena?’ takhana erA vale, ‘pUrvavartIdera upakathA!’
phale kiYAmata divase erA vahana karave edera pApabhAra pUrNa mAtrAYa evaM pApabhAra tAderao yAderake erA ajJatAhetu vibhrAnta kareche| dekha, erA yA vahana karave tA kata nikRSTa!

edera pUrvavartIrAo cakrAnta karechila; AllAh edera imAratera bhittimUle AghAta karechilena; phale imAratera chAda edera opara dhase par3ala evaM edera prati zAsti elo emana dika hate yA chila edera dhAraNAra atIta|

pare kiYAmatera dina tini ederake lAJchita karavena evaM tini valavena, ‘kothAYa AmAra sei samasta zarIka yAdera samvandhe tomarA vitaNDA karate?’ yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYechila tArA valave, ‘Aja lAJchanA o amaGgala kAphiradera-’

yAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa pherezatAgaNa erA nijedera prati juluma karate thAkA avasthAYa; erapara erA AtmasamarpaNa kare valave, ‘AmarA kona manda karma karatAma nA|’ evaM nizcaYai tomarA yA karate se viSaYe AllAh savizeSa avahita|
sutarAM tomarA dvAraguli diYe jAhAnnAme praveza kara, sekhAne tomarA sthAYI have| dekha, ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala kata nikRSTa!

evaM yArA muttAkI chila tAderake valA have, ‘tomAdera pratipAlaka kI avatIrNa karechilena?’ tArA valave, ‘mahAkalyANa’| yArA satkarma kare tAdera janye Ache ei duniYAYa maGgala evaM AkhirAtera AvAsa Arao utkRSTa evaM muttAkIdera AvAsasthala kata uttama!-
tA sthAYI jAnnAta yAte tArA praveza karave; era pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; tArA yA kichu kAmanA karave ete tAdera janye tAi thAkave| eibhAvei AllAh puraskRta karena muttAkIderake,
pherezatAgaNa yAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa pavitra thAkA avasthAYa| phirizatAgaNa valave, ‘tomAdera prati zAnti! tomarA yA karate tAra phale jAnnAte praveza kara|’

erA zudhu pratIkSA kare edera nikaTa pherezatA Agamanera vA tomAra pratipAlakera zAsti Agamanera| edera pUrvavartIrA eirUpai karata| AllAh edera prati kona juluma karena nAi, kintu erAi nijedera prati juluma karata|
sutarAM edera opara Apatita haYechila ederai manda karmera zAsti evaM ederake pariveSTana karechila tAi, yA niYe erA ThATTA-vidrupa karata|

muzarikarA valave, ‘AllAh icchA karale AmAdera pitRpuruSerA o AmarA tA~ke vyatIta apara kona kichura ‘ivAdata karatAma nA evaM tA~ra anujJA vyatIta AmarA kona kichu niSiddha karatAma nA|’ edera pUrvavartIrA erUpai karata| rAsUladera kartavya to kevala suspaSTa vANI peৗ~che deoYA|

AllAh ra ‘ivAdata karAra o tAgUtake varjana karAra nirdeza divAra janye Ami to pratyeka jAtira madhyei rAsUla pAThiYechi| erapara edera katakake AllAh satpathe paricAlita karena evaM edera katakera opara pathabhrAnti sAvyasta haYechila; sutarAM pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM dekha, yArA satyake mithyA valeche tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche!
tumi edera patha pradarzana karate AgrahI haleo AllAh yAke vibhrAnta karechena, tAke tini satpathe paricAlita karavena nA evaM edera kona sAhAyyakArIo nAi|
erA dRr3hatAra saGge AllAh ra zapatha kare vale, ‘yAra mRtyu haYa AllAh tAke punarjIvita karavena nA|’ kena naYa, tini tA~ra pratizruti pUrNa karavenai| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa-
tini punarutthita karavena ye viSaYe edera matAnaikya chila tA ederake spaSTabhAve dekhAvAra janye evaM yAte kAphirarA jAnate pAre ye, erAi chila mithyAvAdI|
Ami kona kichu icchA karale se viSaYe AmAra kathA kevala ei ye, Ami vali, ‘hao’, phale tA haYe yAYa|
yArA atyAcArita haoYAra para AllAh ra pathe hijarata kareche, Ami avazyai tAderake duniYAYa uttama AvAsa diva; evaM AkhirAtera puraskArai to zreSTha| hAYa, erA yadi tA jAnata!
yArA dhairya dhAraNa kare o tAdera pratipAlakera opara nirbhara kare|
tomAra pUrve Ami ohIsaha puruSai preraNa karechilAma, tomarA yadi nA jAna tave jJAnIgaNake jijJAsA kara-

preraNa karechilAma spaSTabhAve pramANAdi o granthAvalIsaha evaM tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi, mAnuSake suspaSTa vujhAiYA divAra janye yA tAdera prati avatIrNa karA haYechila, yAte erA cintA kare|
yArA kukarmera Sar3ayantra kare tArA ki e viSaYe nirbhaYa haYeche ye, AllAh ederake bhUgarbhe vilIna karavena nA vA emana dika hate zAsti Asave nA, yA edera dhAraNAtIta?
athavA calApherA karate thAkAkAle tini edera dhRta karavena nA? erA to eTA vyartha karate pArave nA|
athavA ederake tini bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa dhRta karavena nA? tomAdera pratipAlaka to avazyai daYArdra, parama daYAlu|
erA ki lakSya kare nA AllAh ra sRSTa vastura prati, yAra chAYA dakSiNe o vAme Dhale par3e AllAh ra prati sijdAvanata haYa?
AllAhkei sijdA kare yA kichu Ache AkAzamaNDalIte, pRthivIte yata jIvajantu Ache se samasta evaM phirizatAgaNao, erA ahaMkAra kare nA|
erA bhaYa kare edera opara edera pratipAlakake evaM ederake yA Adeza karA haYa erA tA kare|
AllAh valalena, ‘tomarA dui ilAh grahaNa kara nA; tinii to ekamAtra ilAh| sutarAM AmAkei bhaYa kara|’
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai evaM niravacchinna Anugatya tA~rai prApya| tomarA ki AllAh vyatIta aparake bhaYa karave?
tomAdera nikaTa ye samasta niYAmata raYeche tA to AllAh ra i nikaTa hate; AvAra yakhana duHkha-dainya tomAderake sparza kare takhana tomarA tA~kei vyAkulabhAve AhvAna kara|
AvAra yakhana AllAh tomAdera duHkha-dainya dUrIbhUta karena takhana tomAdera ekadala edera pratipAlakera zarIka kare-
Ami ederake yA dAna karechi tA asvIkAra karAra janye| sutarAM bhoga kare lao, acirei jAnate pArave|

Ami ederake ye riyika dAna kari erA tAra eka aMza nirdhAraNa kare tAdera janye yAdera samvandhe erA kichui jAne nA| zapatha AllAh ra! tomarA ye mithyA udbhAvana kara sei samvandhe tomAderake avazyai prazna karA have|
erA nirdhAraNa kare AllAh ra janye kanyA santAna-tini pavitra, mahimAnvita evaM edera janye tAi, yA erA kAmanA kare!
edera kAukeo yakhana kanyA santAnera susaMvAda deoYA haYa takhana tAra mukhamaNDala kAlo haYe yAYa evaM se asahanIYa manastApe kliSTa haYa|

eke ye saMvAda deoYA haYa, tAra gaøAni hetu se nija sampradAYa hate Atmagopana kare| se cintA kare hInatA sattveo se eke rekhe dive, nA mATite pu~tiYA dive! sAvadhAna! erA yA siddhAnta neYa tA kata nikRSTa|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA erA nikRSTa prakRtira, Ara AllAh to mahattama prakRtira; evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAh yadi mAnuSake tAdera sImAlaMghanera janye zAsti ditena tave bhUpRSThe kona jIva-jantukei rehAi ditena nA; kintu tini eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta tAderake avakAza diYe thAkena| erapara yakhana tAdera samaYa Ase takhana tArA muhUrtakAla vilamva vA tvarA karate pAre nA|

yA tArA apachanda kare tAi tArA AllAh ra prati Aropa kare| tAdera jihvA mithyA varNanA kare ye, maGgala tAderai janye| niHsandehe tAdera janye Ache doyakha evaM tAderakei sarvAgre ete nikSepa karA have|

zapatha AllAh ra! Ami tomAra pUrveo vahu jAtira nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechi; kintu zaYatAna aisava jAtira kAryakalApa edera dRSTite zobhana karechila; sutarAM se-i Aja edera abhibhAvaka evaM ederai janye marmantuda zAsti|
Ami to tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechi yArA e viSaYe matabheda kare tAderake suspaSTabhAve vujhiYe deYAra janye evaM mu’minadera janye pathanirdeza o daYAsvarUpa|
AllAh AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena evaM tA diYe tini bhUmike era mRtyura para punarjIvita karena| avazyai ete nidarzana Ache, ye sampradAYa kathA zune tAdera janye|
avazyai gavAdipazura madhye tomAdera janye zikSA raYeche| edera udarasthita govara o raktera madhya hate tomAderake pAna karAi vizuddha dugdha, yA pAnakArIdera janye susvAdu|
evaM kharjura-vRkSera phala o AGgura hate tomarA mAdaka o uttama khAdya grahaNa kare thAka; ete avazyai vodhazaktisampanna sampradAYera janye raYeche nidarzana|
tomAra pratipAlaka maumAchike era antare iGgita diYe nirdeza diYechena, ‘gRha nirmANa kara pAhAr3e, vRkSe o mAnuSa ye gRha nirmANa kare tAte;

‘eTAra para pratyeka phala hate kichu kichu AhAra kara, erapara tomAra pratipAlakera sahaja patha anusaraNa kara|’ era udara hate nirgata haYa vividha varNera pAnIYa; yAte mAnuSera janye raYeche Arogya| avazyai ete raYeche nidarzana cintAzIla sampradAYera janye|

AllAhi tomAderake sRSTi karechena; erapara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena evaM tomAdera madhye kAukeo kAukeo upanIta karA have nikRSTatama vaYase; phale erA yA kichu jAnata se samvandhe erA sajJAna thAkave nA| nizcaYai AllAh sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

AllAh jIvanopakaraNe tomAdera kAukeo kArao opara zreSThatva diYechena| yAderake zreSThatva deoYA haYeche tArA tAdera adhInastha dAsa-dAsIderake nijedera jIvanopakaraNa hate emana kichu deYa nA yAte erA e viSaYe tAdera samAna haYe yAYa| tave ki erA AllAh ra anugraha asvIkAra kare?

evaM AllAh tomAdera hatei tomAdera jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera yugala hate tomAdera janye putra-pautrAdi sRSTi karechena evaM tomAderake uttama jIvanopakaraNa dAna karechena| tavuo ki erA mithyAYa vizvAsa karave evaM erA ki AllAh ra anugraha asvIkAra karave?-
evaM erA ki ‘ivAdata karave AllAh vyatIta aparera yAdera AkAzamaNDalI vA pRthivI hate kona jIvanopakaraNa saravarAha karAra zakti nei!- evaM erA kichui karate sakSama naYa|
sutarAM tomarA AllAh ra kona sadRza sthira kara nA| AllAh jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|

AllAh upamA dicchena aparera adhikArabhukta eka dAsera, ye kona kichura opara zakti rAkhe nA evaM emana eka vyaktira yAke tini nija hate uttama riyika dAna karechena evaM se tA hate gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare; erA ki eke aparera samAna? sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra i prApya; athaca edera adhikAMzai eTA jAne nA|

AllAh Arao upamA dicchena dui vyaktira: edera ekajana mUka, kona kichurai zakti rAkhe nA evaM se tAra prabhura bhArasvarUpa; tAke yekhAnei pAThAna hoka nA kena se bhAla kichui kare Asate pAre nA; se ki samAna have ai vyaktira, ye nyAYera nirdeza deYa evaM ye Ache sarala pathe?
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYera jJAna AllAh ra i evaM kiYAmatera vyApAra to cokhera palakera nyAYa, varaM tA apekSAo satvara| nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

evaM AllAh tomAderake vera karechena tomAdera mAtRgarbha hate emana avasthAYa ye, tomarA kichui jAnate nA| tini tomAderake diYechena zonezakti, dRSTizakti evaM hRdaYa, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tArA ki lakSya kare nA AkAzera zUnyagarbhe niYantraNAdhIna vihaMgera prati? AllAh vyatIta anya keui segulike sthira rAkhe nA| avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janye|

evaM AllAh tomAdera gRhake karena tomAdera AvAsasthala evaM tini tomAdera janye pazucarmera tA~vura vyavasthA karena, tomarA eke sahaja mane kara bhramaNakAle evaM avasthAnakAle| evaM tini tomAdera janye vyavasthA karena edera pazama, loma o keza hate kichu kAlera gRha-sAmagrI o vyavahAra-upakaraNa|

evaM AllAh yA kichu sRSTi karechena tA hate tini tomAdera janye chAYAra vyavasthA karena evaM tomAdera janye pAhAr3e AzraYera vyavasthA karena evaM tomAdera janye vyavasthA karena paridheYa vastrera; tA tomAderake tApa hate rakSA kare evaM tini vyavasthA karena tomAdera janye varmera, tA tomAderake yuddhe rakSA kare| eibhAve tini tomAdera prati tA~ra anugraha pUrNa karena yAte tomarA AtmasamarpaNa kara|
erapara erA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tave tomAra kartavya to kevala spaSTabhAve vANI peৗ~che deoYA|
erA AllAh ra niYAmata cinite pAre; tAraparao seguli erA asvIkAra kare evaM edera adhikAMzai kAphira|
yedina Ami pratyeka sampradAYa hate eka ekajana sAkSI utthita karava sedina kAphiraderake anumati deoYA have nA evaM edera kona oyarao gRhIta have nA|
yakhana jAlimarA zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana edera zAsti laghu karA have nA evaM ederake kona avakAza deoYA have nA|

muzarikarA yAderake AllAh ra zarIka karechila, tAderake yakhana dekhave takhana tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! erAi tArA, yAderake AmarA tomAra zarIka karechilAma, yAderake AmarA AhvAna karatAma tomAra parivarte; erapara taduttare erA valave, ‘tomarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|’
sei dina tArA AllAh ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karave evaM tArA ye mithyA udbhAvana karata tA tAdera janye niSphala have|
Ami zAstira para zAsti vRddhi karava kAphiradera o AllAh ra pathe vAdhAdAnakArIdera; kAraNa tArA azAnti sRSTi karata|

sei dina Ami utthita karava pratyeka sampradAYe tAderai madhya hate tAdera viSaYe eka ekajana sAkSI evaM tomAke Ami Anava sAkSIrUpe edera viSaYe| Ami Atma-samarpaNakArIdera janye pratyeka viSaYe spaSTa vyAkhyAsvarUpa, pathanirdeza, daYA o susaMvAdasvarUpa tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karalAma|

nizcaYai AllAh nyAYaparAYaNatA, sadAcaraNa o AtmIYa-svajanake dAnera nirdeza dena evaM tini niSedha karena azlIlatA, asatkarma o sImAlaMghana; tini tomAderake upadeza dena yAte tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|
tomarA AllAh ra aGgIkAra pUrNa kara yakhana paraspara aGgIkAra kara evaM tomarA AllAhke tomAdera yAmina kare zapatha dRr3ha karAra para tA bhaGga kara nA| tomarA yA kara nizcaYai AllAha tA jAnena|

tomarA sei nArIra mata haYo nA, ye tAra sUtA mayavuta kare pAkAivAra para era pAka khule naSTa kare deYa| tomAdera zapatha tomarA parasparake pravaJcanA karAra janye vyavahAra kare thAka, yAte ekadala anyadala apekSA adhika lAbhavAna hao| AllAh to eTA diYe kevala tomAderake parIkSA karena| AllAh kiYAmatera dina tA nizcaYai spaSTabhAve prakAza kare divena ye viSaYe tomarA matabheda karate|

icchA karale AllAh tomAderake eka jAti karate pAratena, kintu tini yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM yAke icchA satpathe paricAlita karena| tomarA yA kara se viSaYe avazyai tomAderake prazna karA have|

paraspara pravaJcanA karAra janye tomarA tomAdera zapathake vyavahAra kara nA; karale pA sthira haoYAra para pichale yAve evaM AllAh ra pathe vAdhA deoYAra kAraNe tomarA zAstira AsvAda grahaNa karave; tomAdera janye raYeche mahAzAsti|
tomarA AllAh ra saGge kRta aGgIkAra tuccha mUlye vikraYa kara nA| AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache kevala tAi tomAdera janye uttama-yadi tomarA jAnate!
tomAdera nikaTa yA Ache tA niHzeSa have evaM AllAh ra nikaTa yA Ache tA sthAYI| yArA dhairya dhAraNa kare Ami nizcaYai tAderake tArA yA kare tA apekSA zreSTha puraskAra dAna karava|
mu’mina haYe puruSa o nArIra madhye ye keu satkarma karave tAke Ami nizcaYai pavitra jIvana dAna karava evaM tAderake tAdera karmera zreSTha puraskAra dAna karava|
yakhana kuraAna pATha karave takhana abhizapta zaYatAna hate AllAh ra zaraNa nive
nizcaYai era kona Adhipatya nei tAdera opara yArA ImAna Ane o tAdera pratipAlakerai opara nirbhara kare|
era Adhipatya to kevala tAderai opara yArA eke abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare evaM yArA AllAh ra zarIka kare|

Ami yakhana eka AYAtera parivarte anya eka AYAta upasthita kari-AllAh yA avatIrNa karena tA tinii bhAla jAnena, takhana tArA vale, ‘tumi to kevala mithyA udbhAvanakArI’; kintu edera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

vala, ‘tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate ruhula-kudusa jivrAIla satyasaha kuraAna avatIrNa kareche, yArA mu’mina tAderake dRr3ha pratiSThita karAra janye evaM hidAYAta o susaMvAdasvarUpa musalimadera janye|’
Ami to jAni, tArA vale, ‘tAke zikSA deYa eka mAnuSa|’ erA yAra prati eTA Aropa kare tAra bhASA to AravI naYa; kintu kuraAnera bhASA spaSTa AravI bhASA|
yArA AllAh ra nidarzane vizvAsa kare nA, tAderake AllAh hidAYAta karena nA evaM tAdera janye Ache marmantuda zAsti|
yArA AllAh ra nidarzane vizvAsa kare nA tArA to kevala mithyA udbhAvana kare evaM tArAi mithyAvAdI|

keu tAra ImAna AnAra para AllAhke asvIkAra karale evaM kupharIra janye hRdaYa unmukta rAkhale tAra opara Apatita have AllAh ra gayava evaM tAra janye Ache mahAzAsti; tave tAra janye naYa, yAke kupharIra janye vAdhya karA haYa kintu tAra citta ImAne avicalita|
eTA eijanye ye, tArA duniYAra jIvanake AkhirAtera opara prAdhAnya deYa evaM AllAha kAphira sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|
erAi tArA, AllAh yAdera antara, karNa o cokha mohara kare diYechena evaM erAi gAphila|
nizcaYai erA to AkhirAte have kSatigrasta|
yArA niryAtita haoYAra para hijarata kare, pare jihAda kare evaM dhairya dhAraNa karena, tomAra pratipAlaka ei savera para, tAdera prati avazyai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
smaraNa kara sei dinake, yedina pratyeka vyakti Atmasamarthane yukti upasthita karate Asave evaM pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pUrNaphala deoYA have| evaM tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|

AllAh dRSTAnta dicchena eka janapadera yA chila nirApada o nizcinta, yekhAne Asata sarvadika hate era pracura jIvanopakaraNa; erapara tA AllAh ra anugraha asvIkAra karala, phale tArA yA karata tAra janye AllAh tAderake svAda grahaNa karAlena kSudhA o bhItira AcchAdanera|
tAdera nikaTa to esechila eka rAsUla tAderai madhya hate, kintu tArA tAke asvIkAra karechila| phale sImAlaMghana karA avasthAYa zAsti tAderake grAsa karala|
AllAh tomAderake hAlAla o pavitra yA diYechena tA hate tomarA AhAra kara evaM AllAh ra anugrahera janye kRtajJatA prakAza kara, yadi tomarA kevala tA~rai ‘ivAdata kara|

AllAha to kevala mRta jantu, rakta, zUkara-mAMsa evaM yA yavehkAle AllAh ra parivarte anyera nAma neYA haYeche tAi tomAdera janye hArAma karechena, kintu keu avAdhya kiMvA sImAlaMghanakArI nA haYe ananyopAYa hale AllAh to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomAdera jihvA mithyA Aropa kare vale AllAh ra prati mithyA Aropa karAra janye tomarA vala nA, ‘eTA hAlAla evaM tA hArAma|’ nizcaYai yArA AllAh samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana karave tArA saphalakAma have nA|
edera sukha-sambhoga sAmAnyai evaM edera janye raYeche marmantuda zAsti|
iYAhUdIdera janye Ami to kevala tAi hArAma karechilAma yA tomAra nikaTa Ami pUrve ullekha karechi evaM Ami edera opara kona juluma kari nAi, kintu erAi juluma karata nijedera prati|
erapara yArA ajJatAvazata manda karma kare tArA pare taovA karale o nijederake saMzodhana karale tAdera janye tomAra pratipAlaka avazya ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ivrAhIma chila eka ‘ummata’, AllAh ra anugata, ekaniSTha evaM se chila nA muzarikadera antarbhukta;
se chila AllAh ra anugrahera janye kRtajJa; AllAh tAke manonIta karechilena evaM tAke paricAlita karechilena sarala pathe|
Ami tAke duniYAYa diYechilAma maGgala evaM AkhirAteo, se nizcaYai satkarmaparAYaNadera anyatama|
ekhana Ami tomAdera prati pratyAdeza karalAma, ‘tumi ekaniSTha ivrAhImera dharmAdarza anusaraNa kara; evaM se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|

zanivAra pAlana to kevala tAdera janye vAdhyatAmUlaka karA haYechila, yArA e samvandhe matabheda karata| ye viSaYe erA matabheda karata tomAra pratipAlaka to avazyai kiYAmatera dina se viSaYe edera vicAra-mImAMsA kare divena|

tumi mAnuSake tomAra pratipAlakera pathe AhvAna kara hikmata o sadupadeza diYe evaM edera saGge tarka karave uttama panthAYa| tomAra pratipAlaka, tA~ra patha cher3e ke vipathagAmI haYa, se samvandhe savizeSa avahita evaM kArA satpathe Ache tAo tini savizeSa avahita|
yadi tomarA zAsti dAoi, tave Thika tatakhAni zAsti dive yatakhAni anyAYa tomAdera prati karA haYeche| tave tomarA dhairya dhAraNa karale dhairyazIladera janye eTAi to uttama|
tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, tomAra dhairya to AllAh ra i sAhAyye| edera daruna duHkha kara nA evaM edera Sar3ayantre tumi manaHkSuNNa haYo nA|
AllAh tAderai saGge Achena yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM yArA satkarmaparAYaNa|

pavitra o mahimamaYa tini yini tA~ra vAndAke rajanIte bhramaNa kariYechilena Ala-masajidula hArAma hate Ala-masajidula AksA paryanta, yAra pariveza Ami karechilAma varakatamaYa, tAke AmAra nidarzana dekhAvAra janye; tinii sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma o eke karechilAma vanI isrAIlera janye pathanirdezaka| Ami Adeza karechilAma ‘tomarA AmAke vyatIta apara kAukeo karmavidhAYakarUpe grahaNa kara nA;
‘he tAdera vaMzadhara! yAderake Ami nUhera saGge ArohaNa kariYechilAma; se to chila parama kRtajJa vAndA|’
evaM Ami kitAve pratyAdeza diYe vanI isrAIlake jAniYechilAma, ‘nizcaYai tomarA pRthivIte duivAra viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM tomarA atizaYa ahaMkAra sphIta have|’

erapara ei duiYera prathamaTira nirdhArita kAla yakhana upasthita hala takhana Ami tomAdera viruddhe preraNa karechilAma AmAra vAndAderake, yuddhe atizaYa zaktizAlI; erA ghare ghare praveza kare samasta dhvaMsa karechila| Ara pratizruti kAryakarI haYei thAke|
erapara Ami tomAderake punarAYa edera opara pratiSThita karalAma, tomAderake dhana o santAna-santati diYe sAhAyya karalAma o saMkhyAYa gariSTha karalAma|

tomarA satkarma karale satkarma nijedera janye karave evaM manda karma karale tAo karave nijedera janye| erapara paravartI nirdhArita kAla upasthita hale Ami AmAra vAndAderake preraNa karalAma tomAdera mukhamaNDala kAlimAcchanna karAra janye, prathamavAra tArA yebhAve masajide praveza karechila punarAYa seibhAvei ete praveza karAra janye evaM tArA yA adhikAra karechila tA sampUrNabhAve dhvaMsa karAra janye|

sambhavata tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera prati daYA karavena kintu tomarA yadi tomAdera pUrva-AcaraNera punarAvRtti kara tave Amio punarAvRtti karava| jAhAnnAmake Ami karechi kAphiradera janye kArAgAra|
nizcaYai ei kuraAna hidAYAta kare sei pathera dike yA sudRr3ha evaM satkarmaparAYaNa mu’minaderake susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janye raYeche mahApuraskAra|
evaM yArA AkhirAte ImAna Ane nA tAdera janye prastuta rekhechi marmantuda zAsti|
Ara mAnuSa akalyANa kAmanA kare; yeibhAve kalyANa kAmanA kare; mAnuSa to ati mAtrAYa tvarApriYa|

Ami rAtri o divasake karechi duiTi nidarzana, rAtrira nidarzanake apasArita karechi evaM divasera nidarzanake Alokaprada karechi yAte tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA varSa saMkhyA o hiseva jAnate pAra; evaM Ami sava kichu vizadabhAve varNanA karechi|
pratyeka mAnuSera karma Ami tAra grIvAlagna karechi evaM kiYAmatera dina Ami tAra janye vera karava eka kitAva, yA se pAve unmukta|
‘tumi tomAra kitAva pATha kara, Aja tumi nijei tomAra hiseva-nikAzera janye yatheSTa|’

yArA satpatha avalamvana karave tArA to nijederai maGgalera janye satpatha avalamvana karave evaM yArA pathabhraSTa have tArA to pathabhraSTa have nijederai dhvaMsera janye evaM keu anya kArao bhAra vahana karave nA| Ami rAsUla nA pAThAna paryanta kAukeo zAsti dei nA|

Ami yakhana kona janapada dhvaMsa karate cAi takhana era samRddhizAlI vyaktiderake satkarma karate Adeza kari, kintu erA sekhAne asatkarma kare; erapara era prati daNDAjJA nyAYasaMgata haYe yAYa evaM Ami tA sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta kari|
nUhera para Ami kata mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa karechi! tomAra pratipAlakai tA~ra vAndAdera pApAcaraNera saMvAda rAkhA o paryavekSaNera janye yatheSTa|
keu Azu sukha-sambhoga kAmanA karale Ami yAke yA icchA eikhAnei satvara diYe thAki; pare era janye jAhAnnAma nirdhArita kari yekhAne se praveza karave nindita o anugraha hate dUrIkRta avasthAYa|
yArA mu’mina haYe AkhirAta kAmanA kare evaM era janye yathAyatha ceSTA kare tAdera praceSTA puraskArayogya|
tomAra pratipAlaka tA~ra dAna diYe ederake o ederake sAhAyya karena evaM tomAra pratipAlakera dAna avArita|
lakSya kara, Ami kIbhAve edera eka dalake aparera opara zreSThatva diYechi, AkhirAta to nizcaYai maryAdAYa mahattara o guNe zreSThatara|
AllAh ra saGge apara kona ilAh sAvyasta kara nA; karale nindita o lAJchita haYe par3ave|

tomAra pratipAlaka Adeza diYechena tini vyatIta anya kArao ‘ivAdata nA karate o pitAmAtAra prati sadvyavahAra karate| tAdera ekajana vA ubhaYei tomAra jIvaddazAYa vArdhakye upanIta hale tAderake ‘uph’ vala nA evaM tAderake dhamaka dio nA; tAdera saGge sammAnasUcaka kathA vala|
mamatAvaze tAdera prati namratAra pakSapuTa avanamita kara evaM vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAdera prati daYA kara yebhAve zaizave tArA AmAke pratipAlana karechilena|’
tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera antare yA Ache tA bhAla jAnena; yadi tomarA satkarmaparAYaNa hao tavei to tini AllAh-abhimukhIdera prati atizaYa kSamAzIla|
AtmIYa-svajanake dive tAra prApya evaM abhAvagrasta o musAphirakeo evaM kichutei apavyaYa kara nA|
yArA apavyaYa kare tArA to zaYatAnera bhAi evaM zaYatAna tAra pratipAlakera prati atizaYa akRtajJa|
evaM yadi edera hate tomAra mukha phirAtei haYa, tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate anugraha lAbhera pratyAzAYa, tA hale edera saGge namrabhAve kathA vala;
tumi tomAra hasta tomAra grIvAYa Avaddha kare rekha nA evaM tA sampUrNa prasAritao kara nA, tA hale tumi tiraskRta o niHsva haYe par3ave|
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka yAra janye icchA tAra riyika vardhita karena evaM yAra janye icchA tA sImita karena| tini to tA~ra vAndAdera samvandhe samyaka parijJAta, sarvadraSTA|
tomAdera santAnaderake dAridrya-bhaYe hatyA kara nA| ederakeo Amii riyika dei evaM tomAderakeo| nizcaYai ederake hatyA karA mahApApa|
Ara yinAra nikaTavartI haYo nA, eTA azlIla o nikRSTa AcaraNa|

AllAh yAra hatyA niSiddha karechena yathArtha kAraNa vyatireke tAke hatyA kara nA| keu anyAYabhAve nihata hale tAra uttarAdhikArIke to Ami tA pratikArera adhikAra diYechi; kintu hatyAra vyApAre se yena vAr3AvAr3i nA kare; se to sAhAyyaprApta haYechei|
iYAtIma vaYoprApta nA haoYA paryanta sadupAYe chAr3A tomarA tAra sampattira nikaTavartI haYo nA evaM pratizruti pAlana kara; nizcaYai pratizruti samparke kaiphiYata talava karA have|
mApiYA divAra samaYa pUrNa mApe dive evaM ojana karave saThika dA~r3ipAla¬AYa, eTAi uttama evaM pariNAme utkRSTa|
ye viSaYe tomAra jJAna nei era anusaraNa kara nA; karNa, cokha, hRdaYa- edera pratyekaTi samparkei kaiphiYata talava karA have|
bhUpRSThe dambhabhare vicaraNa kara nA; tumi to kakhanai padabhare bhUpRSTha vidIrNa karate pArave nA evaM uccatAYa tumi kakhanai parvatapramANa hate pArave nA|
ei samastera madhye yeguli manda seiguli tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa ghRNya|

tomAra pratipAlaka ohIra diYe tomAke ye hikmata dAna karechena eiguli tAra antarbhukta| tumi AllAh ra saGge apara ilAh sthira kara nA, karale tumi nindita o vitAr3ita avasthAYa jAhAnnAme nikSipta have|
tomAdera pratipAlaka ki tomAderake putra santAnera janye nirvAcita karechena evaM tini ki nije pherezatAgaNake kanyArUpe grahaNa karechena? tomarA to nizcaYai bhaYAnaka kathA vale thAka!
Ara avazyai Ami ei kuraAne vahu viSaYa vAravAra vivRta karechi yAte erA upadeza grahaNa kare| kintu ete edera vimukhatAi vRddhi pAYa|
vala, ‘yadi tA~ra saGge Arao ilAh thAkata yemana erA vale, tave tArA Araza-adhipatira pratidvandi¡tA karAra upAYa ane¦SaNa karata|’
tini pavitra, mahimAnvita evaM erA yA vale tA hate tini vahu Urdhve|

sapta AkAza, pRthivI evaM edera antarvartI samasta kichu tA~rai pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM emana kichu nei yA tA~ra saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare nA; kintu edera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA tomarA anudhAvana karate pAra nA; nizcaYai tini sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|
tumi yakhana kuraAna pATha kara takhana tomAra o yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tAdera madhye eka pracchanna pardA rekhe dei|

Ami edera antarera opara AvaraNa diYechi yena erA tA upalavdhi karate nA pAre evaM ederake vadhira karechi; ‘tomAra pratipAlaka eka’, eTA yakhana tumi kuraAna hate AvRtti kara takhana pRSTha pradarzana kare erA sariYA par3e|
yakhana erA kAna pete tomAra kathA zune takhana erA kena kAna pete zune tA Ami bhAla jAni, evaM eTAo jAni, gopane AlocanAkAle jAlimarA vale, ‘tomarA to eka jAdugrasta vyaktira anusaraNa karacho|’
dekha, erA tomAra kI upamA deYa! erA pathabhraSTa haYeche, phale erA patha pAve nA|
erA vale, ‘AmarA asthite pariNata o cUrNa-vicUrNa haleo ki nUtana sRSTirUpe utthita hava?’
vala, ‘tomarA haYe yAo pAthara vA lauha|

‘athavA emana kichu yA tomAdera dhAraNAYa khuvai kaThina’; tArA valave, ‘ke AmAderake punarutthita karave?’ vala, ‘tinii, yini tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena|’ erapara erA tomAra sAmane mAthA nAr3ive o valave, ‘tA kave?’ vala, ‘have sambhavata zIghrai,
yedina tini tomAderake AhvAna karavena, evaM tomarA tA~ra prazaMsAra saGge tA~ra AhvAne sAr3A dive evaM tomarA mane karave, tomarA alpakAlai avasthAna karechile|’
AmAra vAndAderake yA uttama tA valate vala| nizcaYai zaYatAna edera madhye vibheda sRSTira uskAni deYa; zaYatAna to mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|
tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAderake bhAlabhAve jAnena| icchA karale tini tomAdera prati daYA karena evaM icchA karale tomAderake zAsti dena; Ami tomAke edera abhibhAvaka kare pAThAi nAi|
yArA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte Ache tAderake tomAra pratipAlaka bhAlabhAve jAnena| Ami to navIgaNera katakake katakera opara maryAdA diYechi; dAUdake Ami yAvUra diYechi|
vala, ‘tomarA AllAh vyatIta yAderake ilAh mane kara tAderake AhvAna kara, karale dekhave tomAdera duHkha-dainya dUra karAra vA parivartana karAra zakti edera nei|’

erA yAderake AhvAna kare tArAi to tAdera pratipAlakera naikaTya lAbhera upAYa sandhAna kare ye, tAdera madhye ke kata nikaTatara hate pAre, tA~ra daYA pratyAzA kare o tA~ra zAstike bhaYa kare| nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlakera zAsti bhaYAvaha|
emana kona janapada nei yA Ami kiYAmatera dinera pUrve dhvaMsa karava nA vA yAke kaThora zAsti diva nA; eTA to kitAve lipivaddha Ache|

pUrvavartIgaNa kartRka nidarzana asvIkAra karAi AmAke nidarzana preraNa karA hate virata rAkhe| Ami zikSAprada nidarzanasvarUpa sAmUda jAtike uSTrI diYechilAma, erapara tArA era prati juluma karechila| Ami kevala bhIti pradarzanera janyei nidarzana preraNa kari|

smaraNa kara, Ami tomAke valechilAma ye, nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka mAnuSake pariveSTana kare Achena| Ami ye dRzya tomAke dekhiYechi tA evaM kuraAne ullikhita abhizapta vRkSaTio kevala mAnuSera parIkSAra janye| Ami ederake bhIti pradarzana kari, kintu eTA edera ghora avAdhyatAi vRddhi kare|
smaraNa kara, yakhana phirizatAderake valalAma, ‘Adamake sijadA kara’, takhana ivalIsa vyatIta sakalei sijadA karala| se valechila, ‘Ami ki tAke sijdA karava yAke Apani kardama hate sRSTi karechena?’

se valechila, “Apani ki vivecanA karechena, Apani AmAra opara ei vyaktike maryAdA dAna karalena, kiYAmatera dina paryanta yadi AmAke avakAza dena tA hale Ami alpa kaYekajana vyatIta tAra vaMzadharake avazyai kartRtvAdhIna kare phelava|”
AllAh valalena, ‘yAo, tAdera madhye yArA tomAra anusaraNa karave, tave jAhAnnAmai tomAdera sakalera zAsti, pUrNa zAsti|

‘tomAra AhvAne edera madhye yAke pAra padaskhalita kara, tomAra azvArohI o padAtika vAhinI diYe ederake AkramaNa kara evaM edera dhane o santAna-santatite zarIka haYe yAo o ederake pratizruti dAo| zaYatAna ederake ye pratizruti deYa tA chalanA mAtra|
nizcaYai ‘AmAra vAndAdera opara tomAra kona kSamatA nei|’ karmavidhAYaka hiseve tomAra pratipAlakai yatheSTa|
tomAdera pratipAlaka tinii yini tomAdera janye samudre nauyAna paricAlita karena, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra| tini to tomAdera prati parama daYAlu|

samudre yakhana tomAderake vipada sparza kare takhana kevala tini vyatIta apara yAderake tomarA AhvAna kare thAka tArA antarhita haYe yAYa; erapara tini yakhana tomAderake uddhAra kare sthale Anena takhana tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo| mAnuSa atizaYa akRtajJa|
tomarA ki nirbhaYa haYecha ye, tini tomAderakesaha kona aJcala dhasiYe divena nA vA tomAdera opara zilA varSaNakArI jhaJjhA preraNa karavena nA? takhana tomarA tomAdera kona karmavidhAYaka pAve nA|

athavA tomarA ki nirbhaYa haYecha ye, tini tomAderake Ara ekavAra samudre niYe yAvena nA evaM tomAdera viruddhe pracaNDa jhaTikA pAThAivena nA evaM tomAdera kupharI karAra janye tomAderake nimajjita karavena nA? takhana tomarA e viSaYe AmAra viruddhe kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

Ami to AdamasantAnake maryAdA dAna karechi; sthale o samudre edera calAcalera vAhana diYechi; ederake uttama riyika dAna karechi evaM Ami yAderake sRSTi karechi tAdera anekera opara ederake zreSThatva diYechi|

smaraNa kara, sei dinake yakhana Ami pratyeka sampradAYake edera netAsaha AhavAna karava| yAdera dakSiNa haste tAdera AmalanAmA deoYA have, tArA tAdera AmalanAmA pATha karave evaM tAdera opara sAmAnya parimANao juluma karA have nA|
Ara ye vyakti eikhAne andha se AkhirAteo andha evaM adhikatara pathabhraSTa|

Ami tomAra prati yA pratyAdeza karechi tA hate erA padaskhalana ghaTAivAra ceSTA prAYa cUr3Anta karechila yAte tumi AmAra samvandhe era viparIta mithyA udbhAvana kara; tavei erA avazyai tomAke vandhurUpe grahaNa karata|
Ami tomAke avicalita nA rAkhale tumi edera dike prAYa kichuTA jhu~ke par3ate;
tA hale avazyai tomAke ihajIvane dviguNa o parajIvane dviguNa zAsti AsvAdana karAtAma; takhana AmAra viruddhe tomAra janye kona sAhAyyakArI pete nA|
erA tomAke deza hate utkhAta karAra cUr3Anta ceSTA karechila tomAke sethA hate vahiSkAra karAra janye; tA hale tomAra para erAo sekhAne alpakAla Tike thAkata|
AmAra rAsUlagaNera madhye tomAra pUrve yAderake pAThiYechilAma tAdera kSetreo chila erUpa niYama evaM tumi AmAra niYamera kona parivartana pAve nA|
sUrya hele par3avAra para hate rAtrira ghana andhakAra paryanta sAlAta kAYema karave evaM kAYema karave phajarera sAlAta| nizcaYai phajarera sAlAta upasthitira samaYa|
evaM rAtrira kichu aMze tAhAjjuda kAYema karave, eTA tomAra eka atirikta kartavya| AzA karA yAYa tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke pratiSThita karavena prazaMsita sthAne|
vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke praveza karAo kalyANera saGge evaM AmAke niSkrAnta karAo kalyANera saGge evaM tomAra nikaTa hate AmAke dAna kara sAhAyyakArI zakti|’
evaM vala, ‘satya eseche evaM mithyA vilupta haYeche;’ mithyA to vilupta haoYArai|
Ami avatIrNa kari kuraAna, yA mu’minadera janye Arogya o rahamata, kintu tA jAlimadera kSatii vRddhi kare|
Ami yakhana mAnuSera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa o dUre sare yAYa evaM tAke aniSTa sparza karale se ekevAre hatAza haYe par3e|
vala, ‘pratyekei nija prakRti anuyAYI kAja kare thAke evaM tomAra pratipAlaka samyaka avagata Achena calAra pathe ke sarvApekSA nirbhula|’
tomAke erA rUh samparke prazna kare| vala, ‘rUh AmAra pratipAlakera Adeza ghaTata evaM tomAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche sAmAnyai|’
icchA karale Ami tomAra prati yA ohI karechi tA avazyai pratyAhAra karate pAratAma; tA hale ei viSaYe tumi AmAra viruddhe kona karmavidhAYaka pete nA|
eTA pratyAhAra nA karA tomAra pratipAlakera daYA; tomAra prati Ache tA~ra mahAanugraha|
vala, ‘yadi kuraAnera anurUpa kuraAna AnaYanera janye mAnuSa o jina samaveta haYa evaM yadio tArA parasparake sAhAyya kare tavuo tArA eTAra anurUpa AnaYana karate pArave nA|
‘Ara avazyai Ami mAnuSera janye ei kuraAne vibhinna upamA vizadabhAve varNanA karechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kuphrI karA vyatIta kSAnta hala nA|’
evaM erA vale, ‘AmarA kakhanai tomAte ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera janye bha‚mi hate eka prasravaNa utsArita karave,
‘athavA tomAra khejurera o AMgurera eka vAgAna have yAra phA~ke phA~ke tumi ajasra dhArAYa pravAhita kare dive nadI-nAlA|
‘athavA tumi yemana vale thAka, tadanuyAYI AkAzake khaNDa-vikhaNDa kare AmAdera opara phelive, vA AllAh o pherezatAgaNake AmAdera sAmane upasthita karave,

‘athavA tomAra ekaTi svarNa nirmita gRha have, vA tumi AkAze ArohaNa karave, kintu tomAra AkAza ArohaNe AmarA kakhanao ImAna Anava nA yatakSaNa tumi AmAdera prati eka kitAva avatIrNa nA karave yA AmarA pATha karava|’ vala, ‘pavitra mahAna AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami to hacchi kevala ekajana mAnuSa, ekajana rAsUla|’
yakhana edera nikaTa Ase pathanirdeza takhana lokaderake ImAna AnA hate virata rAkhe edera ei ukti, ‘AllAh ki mAnuSake rAsUla kare pAThiYechena?’
vala, ‘pherezatAgaNa yadi nizcinta haYe pRthivIte vicaraNa karata tave Ami AkAza hate edera nikaTa avazyai pherezatA rAsUla kare pAThAtAma|’
vala, ‘AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa; tini to tA~ra vAndAderake savizeSa jAnena o dekhena|’

AllAh yAderake pathanirdeza karena tArA to pathaprApta evaM yAderake tini pathabhraSTa karena tumi kakhanai tA~ke vyatIta anya kAukeo edera abhibhAvaka pAve nA| kiYAmatera dina Ami ederake samaveta karava edera mukhe bhara diYe calA avasthAYa andha, mUka o vadhira kare| edera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma; yakhanai tA stimita have Ami takhanai edera janye agnizikhA vRddhi kare diva|
eTAi edera pratiphala, kAraNa erA AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra karechila o valechila, ‘asthite pariNata o cUrNa-vicUrNa haleo AmarA ki nUtana sRSTirUpe punarutthita hava?’

erA ki lakSya kare nA ye, AllAh, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena tini edera anurUpa sRSTi karate kSamatAvAna? tini edera janye sthira karechena eka nirdiSTa kAla, yAte kona sandeha nei| tathApi sImAlaMghanakArIrA kupharI karA vyatIta kSAnta hala nA|
vala, ‘yadi tomarA AmAra pratipAlakera daYAra bhANDArera adhikArI hate, tavuo ‘vyaYa haYe yAve’ ei AzaMkAYa tomarA tA dhare rAkhate; mAnuSa to atizaYa kRpaNa|’
tumi vanI isrAIlake jijJAsA kare dekha Ami mUsAke naYaTi spaSTa nidarzana diYechilAma; yakhana se tAdera nikaTa esechila, phira‘Aona tAke valechila, ‘he mUsA! Ami mane kari tumi to jAdugrasta|’

mUsA valechila, ‘tumi avazyai avagata Acha ye, ei samasta spaSTa nidarzana AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra pratipAlakai avatIrNa karechena-pratyakSa pramANasvarUpa| he phira‘Aona! Ami to dekhachi tomAra dhvaMsa Asanna!’
erapara phira‘Aona tAderake deza hate uccheda karAra saMkalpa karala; takhana Ami phira‘Aona o tAra saGgIdera sakalake nimajjita karalAma|
eTAra para Ami vanI isrAIlake valalAma, ‘tomarA bha‚pRSThe vasavAsa kara evaM yakhana kiYAmatera pratizruti vAstavAYita have takhana tomAdera sakalake Ami ekatra kare upasthita karava|
Ami satyasahai kuraAna avatIrNa karechi evaM tA satyasahai avatIrNa haYeche| Ami to tomAke kevala susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe preraNa karechi|
Ami kuraAna avatIrNa karechi khaNDa khaNDabhAve yAte tumi tA mAnuSera nikaTa pATha karate pAra krame krame evaM Ami tA kramaza avatIrNa karechi|
vala, ‘tomarA kuraAne vizvAsa kara vA vizvAsa nA kara, yAderake eTAra pUrve jJAna deoYA haYeche tAdera nikaTa yakhana eTA pATha karA haYa takhanai tArA sijdAYa luTiYe par3e|’
tArA vale, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka pavitra, mahAna| AmAdera pratipAlakera pratizruti kAryakarI haYei thAke|
‘evaM tArA kA~date kA~date bha‚mite luTiYe par3e evaM eTA edera vinaYa vRddhi kare|’

vala, ‘tomarA ‘AllAh’ nAme AhvAna kara vA ‘rAhmAna’ nAme AhvAna kara, tomarA ye nAmei AhvAna kara sakala sundara nAmai to tA~ra| tomarA sAlAte svara ucca kara nA evaM atizaYa kSINao kara nA; ei duiYera madhyapatha avalamvana kara|’

vala, ‘prazaMsA AllAh ra i yini kona santAna grahaNa karena nAi, tA~ra sArvabhaumatve kona aMzI nei evaM yini durdazAgrasta hana nA ye kAraNe tA~ra abhibhAvakera praYojana hate pAre| sutarAM sasambhrame tA~ra mAhAtmya ghoSaNA kara|’
samasta prazaMsA AllAh ra i yini tA~ra vAndAra prati ei kitAva avatIrNa karechena evaM ete tini vakratA rAkhena nAi;
eTAke karechena supratiSThita tA~ra kaThina zAsti samparke satarka karAra janye, evaM mu’minagaNa, yArA satkarma kare, tAderake ei susaMvAda divAra janye ye, tAdera janye Ache uttama puraskAra,
yAte tArA have cirasthAYI,
evaM satarka karAra janye ederake yArA vale ye, AllAh santAna grahaNa karechena,
ei viSaYe edera kona jJAna nei evaM edera pitRpuruSaderao chila nA| edera mukhaniHsRta vAkya kI sAMghAtika! erA to kevala mithyAi vale|
erA ei vANI vizvAsa nA karale sambhavata edera pichane ghure tumi duHkhe AtmavinAzI haYe par3ave|
pRthivIra opara yA kichu Ache Ami segulike era zobhA karechi, mAnuSake ei parIkSA karAra janye ye, edera madhye karme ke zreSTha|
era opara yA kichu Ache tA avazyai Ami udbhidazUnya maYadAne pariNata karava|
tumi ki mane kara ye, guhA o rAkImera adhivAsIrA AmAra nidarzanAvalIra madhye vismaYakara?

yakhana yuvakarA guhAYa AzraYa nila takhana tArA valechila, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi nija hate AmAderake anugraha dAna kara evaM AmAdera janye AmAdera kAjakarma saThikabhAve paricAlanAra vyavasthA kara|’
erapara Ami ederake guhAYa kaYeka vatsara ghumanta avasthAYa rAkhalAma,
pare Ami ederake jAgarita karalAma jAnivAra janye ye, dui dalera madhye konTi edera avasthitikAla saThikabhAve nirNaYa karate pAre|
Ami tomAra nikaTa edera vRttAnta saThikabhAve varNanA karachi: erA chila kaYekajana yuvaka, erA edera pratipAlakera prati ImAna enechila evaM Ami edera satpathe calAra zakti vRddhi karechilAma,

evaM Ami edera citta dRr3ha kare dilAma; erA yakhana uThiYA dA~r3Aila takhana valala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra pratipAlaka| AmarA kakhanai tA~ra parivarte anya kona ilAhke AhvAna karava nA; yadi kare vasi, tave tA atizaYa garhita have|

‘AmAderai ei svajAtigaNa, tA~ra parivarte aneka ilAh grahaNa kareche| erA ei samasta ilAh samvandhe spaSTa pramANa upasthita kare nA kena? ye AllAh samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kare tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke?’

tomarA yakhana vicchinna hale edera hate o erA AllAh ra parivarte yAdera ‘ivAdata kare tAdera hate takhana tomarA guhAYa AzraYa grahaNa kara| tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera janye tA~ra daYA vistAra karavena evaM tini tomAdera janye tomAdera kAjakarmake phalaprasU karAra vyavasthA karavena|

tumi dekhate pete erA guhAra prazasta catvare avasthita, sUrya udaYakAle edera guhAra dakSiNa pArzve heliYA yAYa evaM astakAle ederake atikrama kare vAma pArzva diYe, ei samasta AllAh ra nidarzana| AllAh yAke satpathe paricAlita karena, se satpathaprApta evaM tini yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tumi kakhanao tAra kona pathapradarzanakArI abhibhAvaka pAve nA|

tumi mane karate erA jAgrata, kintu erA chila nidrita| Ami ederake pArzva parivartana karAtAma DAna dike o vAma dike evaM edera kukura chila sAmanera pA duiTi guhAdvAre prasArita kare| tAkiYe ederake dekhale tumi pichana phire palAYana karate o edera bhaYe AtaMkagrasta haYe par3ate;

evaM ebhAvei Ami ederake jAgarita karalAma yAte erA parasparera madhye jijJAsAvAda kare| edera ekajana valala, ‘tomarA kata kAla avasthAna karecha?’ keu keu valala, ‘AmarA avasthAna karechi eka dina vA eka dinera kichu aMza|’ keu keu valala, ‘tomarA kata kAla avasthAna karecha tA tomAdera pratipAlakai bhAla jAnena| ekhana tomAdera ekajanake tomAdera ei mudrAsaha nagare preraNa kara| se yena dekhe kon khAdya uttama o tA hate yena kichu khAdya niYe Ase tomAdera janye| se yena vicakSaNatAra sahita kAja kare o kichutei yena tomAdera samvandhe kAukeo kichu jAnate nA deYa|
‘erA yadi tomAdera viSaYa jAnate pAre tave tomAderake prastarAghAte hatyA karave vA tomAderake edera dharme phiriYe nive evaM sekSetre tomarA kakhanao sAphalya lAbha karave nA|’

eibhAve Ami mAnuSake edera viSaYa jAniYe dilAma yAte tArA jJAta haYa ye, AllAh ra pratizruti satya evaM kiYAmate kona sandeha nei| yakhana tArA tAdera kartavya viSaYe nijedera madhye vitarka karachila takhana aneke valala, ‘edera opara saudha nirmANa kara|’ edera pratipAlaka edera viSaYa bhAla jAnena| tAdera kartavya viSaYe yAdera mata pravala hala tArA valala, AmarA to nizcaYai edera pArzve masajida nirmANa karava|’

keu keu valave, ‘erA chila tinajana, edera caturthaTi chila edera kukura’ evaM keu keu valave, ‘erA chila pA~cajana, edera SaSThaTi chila edera kukura’, ajAnA viSaYe anumAnera opara nirbhara kare| AvAra keu keu valave, ‘erA chila sAtajana, edera aSTamaTi chila edera kukura|’ vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlakai edera saMkhyA bhAla jAnena’; edera saMkhyA alpa kaYekajanai jAne| sAdhAraNa AlocanA vyatIta tumi edera viSaYe vitarka kara nA evaM edera kAukeo edera viSaYe jijJAsAvAda kara nA|
kakhanai tumi kona viSaYe vala nA, “Ami tA AgAmI kAla karava,
‘AllAh icchA karale’ ei kathA nA vale|” yadi bhule yAo tave tomAra pratipAlakake smaraNa kara evaM vala, ‘sambhavata AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke eTA apekSA satyera nikaTatara pathanirdeza karavena|’
erA edera guhAYa chila tinazata vatsara, Arao naYa vatsara|

tumi vala, ‘tArA katakAla chila tA AllAhi bhAla jAnena’, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra ajJAta viSaYera jJAna tA~rai| tini kata sundara draSTA o zrotA! tini vyatIta edera anya kona abhibhAvaka nei| tini kAukeo nija kartRtvera zarIka karena nA|
tumi tomAra prati pratyAdiSTa tomAra pratipAlakera kitAva hate pATha kare zonAo| tA~ra vAkya parivartana karAra keui nei| tumi kakhanai tA~ke vyatIta anya kona AzraYa pAve nA|

tumi nijeke dhairya sahakAre rAkhave ederai saMsarge yArA sakAla o sandhyAYa AhvAna kare edera pratipAlakake tA~ra santuSTi lAbhera uddezye evaM tumi pArthiva jIvanera zobhA kAmanA kare edera hate tomAra dRSTi phiriYe nio nA| tumi tAra Anugatya kara nA-yAra cittake Ami AmAra smaraNe amanoyogI kare diYechi, ye tAra kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kare o yAra kAryakalApa sImA atikrama kare|

vala, ‘satya tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate; sutarAM yAra icchA vizvAsa karuka o yAra icchA satya pratyAkhyAna karuka|’ nizcaYai Ami jAlimadera janye prastuta rekhechi agni, yAra veSTanI ederake pariveSTana kare thAkave| erA pAnIYa cAile ederake deoYA have galita dhAtura nyAYa pAnIYa, yA edera mukhamaNDala dagdha karave; eTA nikRSTa pAnIYa| Ara jAhAnnAma kata nikRSTa AzraYa|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare-Ami to tAra zramaphala naSTa kari nA-se uttamarUpe kArya sampAdana kare|

ederai janye Ache sthAYI jAnnAta yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne ederake svarNa-kaMkane alaMkRta karA have, erA paridhAna karave sU² o puru rezamera savuja vastra o sekhAne samAsIna have susajjita Asane; kata sundara puraskAra o uttama AzraYasthala!

tumi edera nikaTa peza kara dui vyaktira upamA: edera ekajanake Ami diYechilAma duiTi drAkSA-udyAna evaM ei duiTike Ami kharjura-vRkSa diYe pariveSTita karechilAma o ei duiYera madhyavartI sthAnake karechilAma zasyakSetra|
ubhaYa udyAnai phaladAna karata evaM ete kona truTi karata nA Ara ubhaYera phA~ke phA~ke pravAhita karechilAma nahara|
evaM tAra pracura dhanasampada chila| erapara kathA prasaGge se tAra vandhuke valala, ‘dhanasampade Ami tomAra apekSA zreSTha evaM janavale tomAra apekSA zaktizAlI|’
eibhAve nijera prati juluma kare se tAra udyAne praveza karala| se valala, ‘Ami mane kari nA ye, eTA kakhanao dhvaMsa haYe yAve;
‘Ami mane kari nA ye, kiYAmata have; Ara Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa pratyAvRtta hai-i tave Ami to nizcaYai eTA apekSA utkRSTa sthAna pAiva|’
taduttare tAra vandhu tAke valala, ‘tumi ki tA~ke asvIkAra karacho yini tomAke sRSTi karechena mRttikA o pare zukra hate evaM tAra para pUrNAGga karechena manuSya-AkRtite?’
‘kintu tinii AllAh, AmAra pratipAlaka evaM Ami kAukeo AmAra pratipAlakera zarIka kari nA|’

‘tumi yakhana tomAra udyAne praveza karale takhana kena valile nA, ‘AllAh yA cAna tAi haYa, AllAh ra sAhAyya vyatIta kona zakti nei?’ tumi yadi dhane o santAne AmAke tomAra apekSA nikRSTatara mane kara-

‘tave haYata AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke tomAra udyAna apekSA utkRSTatara kichu divena evaM tomAra udyAne AkAza hate nirdhArita viparyaYa preraNa karavena; yAra phale tA udbhidazUnya maYadAne pariNata have|
‘athavA era pAni bha‚garbhe antarhita have evaM tumi kakhanao era sandhAna lAbhe sakSama have nA|’

tAra phala-sampada viparyaYe veSTita haYe gela evaM se ete yA vyaYa karechila tAra janye AkSepa karate lAgala yakhana tA mAcAnasaha bhUmisAt haYe gela| se valite lAgala, ‘hAYa, Ami yadi kAukeo AmAra pratipAlakera zarIka nA karatAma!’
Ara AllAh vyatIta tAke sAhAyya karAra kona lokajana chila nA evaM se nijeo pratikAre samartha hala nA|
e kSetre kartRtva AllAh ra i, yini satya| puraskAra dAne o pariNAma nirdhAraNe tinii zreSTha|

edera nikaTa peza kara upamA pArthiva jIvanera: eTA pAnira nyAYa yA Ami varSaNa kari AkAza hate, yA diYe bha‚mija udbhida ghana-sanniviSTa haYe udgata haYa, erapara tA vizuSka haYe emana cUrNa-vicUrNa haYa ye, vAtAsa eke ur3iYe niYe yAYa| AllAh sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna|
dhanaizvarya o santAna-santati pArthiva jIvanera zobhA; evaM sthAYI satkarma tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa puraskAra prAptira janye zreSTha evaM kAksikSata hiseveo utkRSTa|
smaraNa kara, yedina Ami parvatamAlAke karava saJcAlita evaM tumi pRthivIke dekhave unmukta prAntara, sedina tAdera sakalake Ami ekatra karava evaM edera kAukeo avyAhati diva nA,

evaM ederake tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa upasthita karA have sArivaddhabhAve evaM valA have, ‘tomAderake prathamavAra yebhAve sRSTi karechilAma seibhAvei tomarA AmAra nikaTa upasthita haYecha, athaca tomarA mane karate ye, tomAdera janye pratizruta kSaNa Ami kakhanao upasthita karava nA|’

evaM upasthita karA have AmalanAmA evaM ete yA lipivaddha Ache tAra kAraNe tumi aparAdhIderake dekhave AtaMkagrasta evaM erA valave, ‘hAYa, durbhAgya AmAdera! eTA kemana grantha! tA to choTa-var3a kichui vAda deYa nA; varaM tA samasta hiseva rekheche|’ erA edera kRtakarma sAmane upasthita pAve; tomAra pratipAlaka kArao prati juluma karena nA|

evaM smaraNa kara, Ami yakhana pherezatAgaNake valechilAma, ‘Adamera prati sijdA kara’, takhana tArA sakalei sijdA karala ivalisa vyatIta; se jinadera ekajana, se tAra pratipAlakera Adeza amAnya karala| tave ki tomarA AmAra parivarte eke evaM era vaMzadharake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karacho? erA to tomAdera zatru| jAlimadera ei vinimaYa kata nikRSTa!
AkAzamaNDalIra o pRthivIra sRSTikAle Ami ederake DAki nAi evaM edera sRjanakAleo naYa, Ami vibhrAntakArIderake sAhAyyakArIrUpe grahaNa karAra nai|

evaM sei dinera kathA smaraNa kara, yedina tini valavena, ‘tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tAderake AhvAna kara|’ erA takhana tAderake AhvAna karave kintu tArA edera AhvAne sAr3A dive nA evaM edera ubhaYera madhyasthale rekhe diva eka dhvaMsa-gahvara|
aparAdhIrA Aguna dekhe vujhave ye, erA sekhAne patita hacche evaM erA tA hate kona paritrANa sthala pAve nA|
Ami mAnuSera janye ei kuraAne vibhinna upamAra diYe AmAra vANI vizadabhAve varNanA karechi| mAnuSa adhikAMza vyApArei vitarkapriYa|

yakhana edera nikaTa pathanirdeza Ase takhana mAnuSake ImAna AnA evaM tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karA hate virata rAkhe kevala eTA ye, tAdera nikaTa pUrvavartIdera velAYa anusRta rIti Asuka vA Asuka tAdera nikaTa sarAsari AyAva|

Ami kevala susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei rAsUlagaNake pAThiYe thAki, kintu kAphirarA mithyA avalamvane vitaNDA kare, tA diYe satyake vyartha kare divAra janye evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o yA diYe ederake satarka karA haYeche sei samastake erA vidrupera viSaYarUpe grahaNa kare thAke|

kona vyaktike tAra pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI smaraNa kariYe deoYAra para se yadi tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa evaM tAra kRtakarmasamUha bhule yAYa tave tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? Ami nizcaYai edera antarera opara AvaraNa diYechi yena erA kuraAna vujhate nA pAre evaM edera kAne vadhiratA e~Te diYechi| tumi ederake satpathe AhvAna karaleo erA kakhanao satpathe Asave nA|

evaM tomAra pratipAlaka parama kSamAzIla, daYAvAna, edera kRtakarmera janye yadi tini ederake pAkar3Ao karate cAitena, tave tini avazyai edera zAsti tvarAnvita karatena; kintu edera janye raYeche eka pratizruta muha‚rta, yA hate erA kakhanai kona AzraYasthala pAve nA|
aisava janapada-edera adhivAsIvRndake Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma, yakhana erA sImAlaMghana karechila evaM edera dhvaMsera janye Ami sthira karechilAma eka nirdiSTa kSaNa|
smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra saGgIke valechila, ‘dui samudrera saMgamasthale nA peৗ~che Ami thAmava nA vA Ami yuga yuga dhare calate thAkava|’
erA ubhaYe yakhana dui samudrera saMgamasthale peৗ~chila erA nijedera matsyera kathA bhule gela; tA sur3aMgera mata nijera patha kare samudre neme gela|
yakhana erA Aro agrasara hala mUsA tAra saGgIke valala, ‘AmAdera prAtaHrAza Ana, AmarA to AmAdera ei saphare klAnta haYe par3echi|’

se valala, ‘Apani ki lakSya karechena, AmarA yakhana zilAkhaNDe vizrAma karachilAma takhana Ami matsyera kathA bhule giYechilAma? zaYatAnai era kathA valite AmAke bhulAiYA diYechila; matsyaTi AzcaryajanakabhAve nijera patha kare neme gela samudre|’
mUsA valala, ‘AmarA to sei sthAnaTirai anusandhAna karachilAma|’ erapara erA nijedera padacihna dhare phire calila|
erapara erA sAkSAt pela AmAra vAndAdera madhye ekajanera, yAke Ami AmAra nikaTa hate anugraha dAna karechilAma o AmAra nikaTa hate zikSA diYechilAma eka vizeSa jJAna|
mUsA tAke valala, ‘satya pathera ye jJAna ApanAke dAna karA haYeche tA hate AmAke zikSA divena, ei zarte Ami ApanAra anusaraNa karava ki?
se valala, Apani kichutei AmAra saGge dhairya dhAraNa kare thAkate pAravena nA,
‘ye viSaYa ApanAra jJAnAYatta naYa se viSaYe Apani dhairya dhAraNa karavena kemana kare?’
mUsA valala, ‘AllAh cAile Apani AmAke dhairyazIla pAvena evaM ApanAra kona Adeza Ami amAnya karava nA|’
se valala, ‘AcchA, Apani yadi AmAra anusaraNa karavenai tave kona viSaYe AmAke prazna karavena nA, yatakSaNa nA Ami se samvandhe ApanAke kichu vali|’

erapara ubhaYe calate lAgala, pare yakhana erA naukAYa ArohaNa karala takhana se tA vidIrNa kare dila| mUsA valala, ‘Apani ki ArohIderake nimajjita kare divAra janye tA vidIrNa karalena? Apani to eka gurutara anyAYa kAja karalena|’
se valala, ‘Ami ki vali nAi ye, Apani AmAra saGge kichutei dhairya dhAraNa karate pAravena nA?’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAra bhulera janye AmAke aparAdhI karavena nA o AmAra vyApAre atyadhika kaThoratA avalamvana karavena nA|’

erapara ubhaYe calate lAgala, calate calate edera saGge eka vAlakera sAkSAt hale se eke hatyA karala| takhana mUsA valala, ‘Apani ki eka ni®pApa jIvana nAza karalena, hatyAra aparAdha chAr3Ai? Apani to eka gurutara anyAYa kAja karalena|
se valala, ‘Ami ki ApanAke vali nAi ye, Apani AmAra saGge kichutei dhairya dhAraNa karate pAravena nA?
mUsA valala, ‘eTAra para, yadi Ami ApanAke kona viSaYe jijJAsA kari tave Apani AmAke saGge rAkhavena nA; AmAra ‘oyara-Apattira cUr3Anta haYeche|

erapara ubhaYe calate lAgala; calate calate erA eka janapadera adhivAsIdera nikaTa peৗ~che tAdera nikaTa khAdya cAila; kintu tArA tAdera mehamAnadArI karate asvIkAra karala| erapara sekhAne tArA eka patanonmukha prAcIra dekhate pela evaM se eke sudRr3ha kare dila| mUsA valala, ‘Apani to icchA karale eTAra janye pArizramika grahaNa karate pAratena|’
se valala, ‘eikhAnei ApanAra evaM AmAra madhye samparkaccheda hala, ye viSaYe Apani dhairya dhAraNa karate pArena nAi Ami tAra tAtparya vyAkhyA karachi|

‘naukATira vyApAra-eTA chila katipaYa daridra vyaktira, erA samudre jIvikA ane¦SaNa karata; Ami, icchA karalAma naukATike truTiyukta karate; kAraNa edera pazcAte chila eka rAjA, ye valapraYoge naukAsakala chiniYe nita|
‘Ara kizoraTi, tAra pitAmAtA chila mu’mina| Ami AzaMkA karalAma ye, se vidrohAcaraNa o kupharIra diYe ederake vivrata karave|
‘erapara Ami cAilAma ye, edera pratipAlaka yena ederake era parivarte eka santAna dAna karena, ye have pavitratAYa mahattara o bhakti-bhAlavAsAYa ghaniSThatara|

‘Ara ai prAcIraTi, eTA chila nagaravAsI dui pitRhIna kizorera, eTAra nimnadeze Ache edera guptadhana evaM edera pitA chila satkarmaparAYaNa| sutarAM ApanAra pratipAlaka daYAparavaza haYe icchA karalena ye, erA vaYaHprApta hoka evaM erA edera dhanabhANDAra uddhAra karuka| Ami nija hate kichu kari nAi; Apani ye viSaYe dhairya dhAraNe apAraga haYechilena, eTAi tAra vyAkhyA|’
erA tomAke yula-kAranAina samvandhe jijJAsA kare| vala, ‘Ami tomAdera nikaTa tAra viSaYa varNanA karava|’
Ami to tAke pRthivIte kartRtva diYechilAma evaM pratyeka viSaYera upAYa-upakaraNa dAna karechilAma|
erapara se eka patha avalamvana karala|

calate calate se yakhana sUryera astagamana sthAne peৗ~chila takhana se sUryake eka paMkila jalAzaYe astagamana karate dekhala evaM se sekhAne eka sampradAYake dekhate pela| Ami valalAma, ‘he yula-rkAnAina! tumi ederake zAsti dite pAra vA edera vyApAra sadaYabhAve grahaNa karate pAra|’
se valala, ‘ye keu sImAlaMghana karave Ami tAke zAsti diva, erapara se tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa pratyAvartita have evaM tini tAke kaThina zAsti divena|
‘tave ye ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare tAra janye pratidAnasvarUpa Ache kalyANa evaM tAra prati vyavahAre Ami namra kathA valiva|’
AvAra se eka patha dharila,
calate calate yakhana se sUryeAdaYa-sthale peৗ~chila takhana se dekhala tA emana eka sampradAYera opara udaYa hacche yAdera janye sUryatApa hate kona antarAla Ami sRSTi kari nAi;
prakRta ghaTanA eTAi, tAra nikaTa yA kichu chila Ami samyaka avagata Achi|
AvAra se eka patha dharala,
calate calate se yakhana dui parvata-prAcIrera madhyavartI sthale peৗ~chila takhana sekhAne se eka sampradAYake pela yArA kona kathA vujhAra mata chila nA|
erA valala, ‘he yula-rkAnAina! iYAjUja o mAjUja to pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi karache| AmarA ki ApanAke kharaca diva ye, Apani AmAdera o edera madhye eka prAcIra gar3e divena’?
se valala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke ei viSaYe ye kSamatA diYechena, tAi utkRSTa| sutarAM tomarA AmAke zrama diYe sAhAyya kara, Ami tomAdera o edera madhyasthale eka mayavuta prAcIra gar3e diva|

‘tomarA AmAra nikaTa lauhapiNDasamUha AnaYana kara’, erapara madhyavartI phA~kA sthAna pUrNa haYe yakhana lauhastUpa dui parvatera samAna hala takhana se valala, ‘tomarA hA~pare dama dite thAka|’ yakhana tA agnivat uttapta hala, takhana se valala, ‘tomarA galita tAmra AnaYana kara, Ami tA Dhele dei eTAra opara|’
era para tArA tA atikrama karate pArala nA evaM tA bhedao karate pArala nA|
se valala, ‘eTA AmAra pratipAlakera anugraha| yakhana AmAra pratipAlakera pratizruti pUrNa have takhana tini eke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare divena evaM AmAra pratipAlakera pratizruti satya|’

evaM sei dina Ami jAhAnnAmake pratyakSabhAve upasthita karava kAphiradera nikaTa,
yAdera cokha chila andha AmAra nidarzanera prati evaM yArA zunateo chila akSama|
yArA kupharI kareche tArA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmAra vAndAderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? nizcaYai Ami kAphiradera ApyAYanera janye prastuta rekhechi jAhAnnAma|
vala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake saMvAda diva karme vizeSa kSatigrastadera?’
erAi tArA, ‘pArthiva jIvane yAdera praceSTA paNDa haYa, yadio tArA mane kare ye, tArA satkarmai karache,

‘erAi tArA, yArA asvIkAra kare edera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI o tA~ra saGge edera sAkSAtera viSaYa| phale edera karma niSphala haYe yAYa; sutarAM kiYAmatera dina edera janye ojanera kona vyavasthA rAkhava nA|
‘jAhAnnAma-eTAi edera pratiphala, yehetu erA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o rAsUlagaNake grahaNa kareche vidrupera viSaYasvarUpa|’

vala, ‘Ami to tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSai, AmAra prati pratyAdeza haYa ye, tomAdera ilAh ekamAtra ilAh| sutarAM ye tAra pratipAlakera sAkSAt kAmanA kare, se yena satkarma kare o tAra pratipAlakera ‘ivAdate kAukeo zarIka nA kare|’
kAph-hA-iYA-Aina-soYAda;
eTA tomAra pratipAlakera anugrahera vivaraNa tA~ra vAndA yAkAriYyAra prati,
yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake AhvAna karechila nibhRte,
se valechila, ‘he AmAra rava! AmAra asthi durvala haYeche, vArdhakye AmAra mastaka zubhrojjvala haYeche; he AmAra pratipAlaka! tomAke AhvAna kare Ami kakhanao vyarthakAma hai nAi|
‘Ami AzaMkA kari AmAra para AmAra svagotrIYadera samparke; AmAra strI vandhyA| sutarAM tumi tomAra nikaTa hate AmAke dAna kara uttarAdhikArI,
‘ye AmAra uttarAdhikAritva karave evaM uttarAdhikAritva karave iYA‘ka‚vera vaMzera evaM he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAke kara santoSabhAjana’|
tini valalena, ‘ he yAkAriYyA! Ami tomAke eka putrera susaMvAda dicchi, tAra nAma have iYAhiYA; ei nAme pUrve Ami kArao nAmakaraNa kari nAi|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! kemana kare AmAra putra have yakhana AmAra strI vandhyA o Ami vArdhakyera zeSa sImAYa upanIta|’
tini valalena, ‘eirUpai have|’ tomAra pratipAlaka valalena, ‘eTA AmAra janye sahajasAdhya; Ami to pUrve tomAke sRSTi karechi yakhana tumi kichui chile nA|’
yAkAriYyA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke ekaTi nidarzana dAo|’ tini valalena, ‘tomAra nidarzana ei ye, tumi sustha thAkA sattveo kArao saGge tina dina vAkyAlApa karave nA|’
erapara se kakSa hate vera haYe tAra sampradAYera nikaTa elo evaM iGgite tAderake sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAh ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karate valala|
‘he iYAhiYA! ei kitAva dRr3hatAra saGge grahaNa kara|’ Ami tAke zaizavei dAna karechilAma jJAna,
evaM AmAra nikaTa hate hRdaYera komalatA o pavitratA; se chila muttAkI,
pitA-mAtAra anugata evaM se chila nA uddhata o avAdhya|
tAra prati zAnti yedina se janmalAbha kare, yedina tAra mRtyu have evaM yedina se jIvita avasthAYa utthita have|

erapara edera hate se pardA karala| erapara Ami tAra nikaTa AmAra rUhke pAThAlAma, se tAra nikaTa pUrNa mAnavAkRtite AtmaprakAza karala|
mAraiya়Ama valala, AllAhke bhaYa kara yadi tumi ‘muttAkI hao’, Ami tomA hate daYAmaYera zaraNa nicchi|
se valala, ‘Ami to tomAra pratipAlaka-prerita, tomAke eka pavitra putra dAna karAra janye|’
mAraiya়Ama valala, ‘kemana kare AmAra putra have yakhana AmAke kona puruSa sparza kare nAi evaM Ami vyabhicAriNIo nai?’

se valala, ‘eirUpai have|’ tomAra pratipAlaka valechena, ‘eTA AmAra janye sahajasAdhya evaM Ami eke ejanye sRSTi karava yena se haYa mAnuSera janye eka nidarzana o AmAra nikaTa hate eka anugraha; eTA to eka sthirIkRta vyApAra|’
tatpara se garbhe eke dhAraNa karala; erapara tatsaha eka dUravartI sthAne cale gela;
prasava-vedanA tAke eka kharjura-vRkSatale AzraYa nite vAdhya karala| se valala, ‘hAYa, eTAra pUrve Ami yadi mariYA yetAma o lokera smRti hate sampUrNa vilupta hatAma!’
pherezatA tAra nimnapArzva hate AhvAna kare tAke valala, ‘tumi duHkha kara nA, tomAra pAdadeze tomAra pratipAlaka eka nahara sRSTi karechena;
‘tumi tomAra dike kharjura-vRkSera kANDe nAr3A dAo, tA tomAke supakva tAjA kharjura dAna karave|

sutarAM AhAra kara, pAna kara o cokha jur3Ao| mAnuSera madhye kAukeo yadi tumi dekha takhana vala, ‘Ami daYAmaYera uddezye maunatA avalamvanera mAnata karechi| sutarAM Aja Ami kichutei kona mAnuSera saGge vAkyAlApa karava nA|’
erapara se santAnake niYe tAra sampradAYera nikaTa upasthita hala; erA valala, ‘he mAraiya়Ama! tumi to eka adbhuta kANDa kare vasecha|
‘he hArUna-bhagni! tomAra pitA asat vyakti chila nA evaM tomAra mAtAo chila nA vyabhicAriNI|’

se valala, ‘Ami to AllAh ra vAndA| tini AmAke kitAva diYechena, AmAke navI karechena,
‘yekhAnei Ami thAki nA kena tini AmAke varakatamaYa karechena, tini AmAke nirdeza diYechena yata dina jIvita thAki tata dina sAlAta o yAkAta AdAYa karate-
‘Ara AmAke AmAra mAtAra prati anugata karechena evaM tini AmAke karena nAi uddhata o hatabhAgya;
‘AmAra prati zAnti yedina Ami janmalAbha karechi, yedina AmAra mRtyu have evaM yedina jIvita avasthAYa Ami utthita hava|’

AllAhi AmAra pratipAlaka o tomAdera pratipAlaka; sutarAM tomarA tA~ra ‘ivAdata kara, eTAi sarala patha|
erapara dalaguli nijedera madhye matAnaikya sRSTi karala, sutarAM durbheAga kAphiradera janye mahAdivasa AgamanakAle|

ederake satarka kare dAo paritApa divasa samvandhe, yakhana sakala siddhAnta haYe yAve| ekhana erA gAphila evaM erA vizvAsa kare nA|
nizcaYai pRthivIra o era opara yArA Ache tAdera cUr3Anta mAlikAnA AmArai thAkave evaM erA AmArai nikaTa pratyAnIta have|
smaraNa kara, ei kitAve ullikhita ivrAhImera kathA; se chila satyaniSTha, navI|
yakhana se tAra pitAke valala, ‘he AmAra pitA! tumi tAra ‘ivAdata kara kena ye zune nA, dekhe nA evaM tomAra konai kAje Ase nA?’
‘he AmAra pitA! AmAra nikaTa to eseche jJAna yA tomAra nikaTa Ase nAi; sutarAM AmAra anusaraNa kara, Ami tomAke saThika patha dekhAva|
‘he AmAra pitA! zaYatAnera ‘ivAdata kara nA| zaYatAna to daYAmaYera avAdhya|
‘he AmAra pitA! Ami to AzaMkA kari ye, tomAke daYAmaYera zAsti sparza karave, takhana tumi haYe par3ave zaYatAnera vandhu|’
pitA valala, ‘he ivrAhIma! tumi ki AmAra deva-devI hate vimukha? yadi tumi nivRtta nA hao tave Ami prastarAghAte tomAra prANa nAza karavai; tumi ciradinera janye AmAra nikaTa hate dUra haYe yAo|’
ivrAhIma valala, ‘tomAra prati sAlAma| Ami AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa tomAra janye kSamA prArthanA karava, nizcaYa tini AmAra prati atizaYa anugrahazIla|
‘Ami tomAdera hate o tomarA AllAh vyatIta yAdera ‘ivAdata kara tAdera hate pRthaka hacchi; Ami AmAra pratipAlakake AhvAna kari; AzA kari, AmAra pratipAlakake AhvAna kare Ami vyarthakAma hava nA|’
erapara se yakhana tAdera hate o tArA AllAh vyatIta yAdera ‘ivAdata karata sei sakala hate pRthaka haYe gela takhana Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o iYA‘ka‚va evaM pratyekake navI karalAma|
evaM tAderake Ami dAna karalAma AmAra anugraha o tAdera nAma-yaza samucca karalAma|
smaraNa kara, ei kitAve mUsAra kathA, se chila vizeSa manonIta evaM se chila rAsUla, navI|
tAke Ami AhvAna karechilAma tUra parvatera dakSiNa dika hate evaM Ami antaraGga AlApe tAke naikaTya dAna karechilAma|
Ami nija anugrahe tAke dilAma tAra bhAi hArUnake navIrUpe|
smaraNa kara, ei kitAve isamAIlera kathA, se to chila pratizruti pAlane satyAzraYI evaM se chila rAsUla, navI;
se tAra parijanavargake sAlAta o yAkAtera nirdeza dita evaM se chila tAra pratipAlakera santoSabhAjana|
smaraNa kara, ei kitAve idrIsera kathA, se chila satyaniSTha, navI;
evaM Ami tAke unnIta karechilAma ucca maryAdAYa|

erAi tArA, navIdera madhye yAderake AllAh anugraha karechena, Adamera vaMza hate o yAderake Ami nUhera saGge naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechilAma evaM ivrAhIma o isarAIlera vaMzodbhUta o yAderake Ami pathanirdeza karechilAma o manonIta karechilAma; tAdera nikaTa daYAmaYera AYAta AvRtti karA hale tArA sijdAYa luTiYe par3ita krandana karate karate|
edera pare elo apadArtha paravartIrA, tArA sAlAta naSTa karala o lAlasA-paravaza hala| sutarAM erA acirei kukarmera zAsti pratyakSa karave,
kintu erA naYa-yArA taovA kareche, ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche| erA to jAnnAte praveza karave| edera prati kona juluma karA have nA|
eTA sthAYI jAnnAta, ye adRzya viSaYera pratizruti daYAmaYa tA~ra vAndAderake diYechena| tA~ra pratizruta viSaYa avazyambhAvI|
sekhAne tArA ‘zAnti’ vyatIta kona asAra vAkya zunave nA evaM sekhAne sakAla-sandhyA tAdera janye thAkave jIvanopakaraNa|
ei sei jAnnAta, yAra adhikArI karava AmAra vAndAdera madhye muttAkIderake|
‘AmarA ApanAra pratipAlakera Adeza vyatIta avataraNa kari nA; yA AmAdera sAmane o pazcAte Ache o yA ei dui-era antarvartI tA tA~rai evaM ApanAra pratipAlaka bhulAra nana|’
tini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o tAdera antarvartI yA kichu, tAra pratipAlaka| sutarAM tA~rai ‘ivAdata kara evaM tA~ra ‘ivAdate dhairyazIla thAka| tumi ki tA~ra samaguna sampanna kAukeo jAna?
mAnuSa vale, ‘AmAra mRtyu hale Ami ki jIvita avasthAYa utthita hava?’
mAnuSa ki smaraNa kare nA ye, Ami tAke pUrve sRSTi karechi yakhana se kichui chila nA?
sutarAM zapatha tomAra pratipAlakera| Ami to ederake evaM zaYatAnaderakesaha ekatra samaveta karavai o pare Ami ederake natajAnu avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera caturdike upasthita karavai|
erapara pratyeka dalera madhye ye daYAmaYera prati sarvAdhika avAdhya Ami tAke Tene vera karavai|
evaM Ami to edera madhye yArA jAhAnnAme pravezera adhikatara yogya tAdera viSaYa bhAla jAni|
evaM tomAdera pratyekei tA atikrama karave; eTA tomAra pratipAlakera anivArya siddhAnta|
pare Ami muttAkIderake uddhAra karava evaM jAlimaderake sekhAne natajAnu avasthAYa rekhe diva|
edera nikaTa AmAra spaSTa AYAtasamUha AvRtta hale kAphirarA mu’minaderake vale, ‘dui dalera madhye konTi maryAdAYa zreSThatara o majalisa hiseve uttama?’
edera pUrve Ami kata mAnavagoSThIke vinAza karechi-yArA edera apekSA sampada o vAhyadRSTite zreSTha chila|

vala, ‘yArA vibhrAntite Ache, daYAmaYa tAderake pracura Dhila divena yatakSaNa nA tArA, ye viSaYe tAderake satarka karA hacche tA pratyakSa karave, tA zAsti hoka vA kiYAmatai hoka| erapara tArA jAnate pArave, ke maryAdAYa nikRSTa o ke dalavale durvala|
evaM yArA satpathe cale AllAh tAderake adhika hidAYAta dAna karena; evaM sthAYI satkarma tomAra pratipAlakera puraskAra prAptira janye zreSTha evaM pratidAna hiseveo zreSTha|
tumi ki lakSya karecha sei vyaktike, ye AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kareche evaM se vale, ‘AmAke dhanasampada o santAna-santati deoYA havei?’

kakhanai naYa; erA to tAdera ‘ivAdata asvIkAra karave evaM tAdera virodhI haYe yAve|

tAdera pUrve Ami kata mAnavagoSThIke vinAza karechi! tumi ki tAdera kAukeo dekhate pAo vA kSINatama zavdao zunate pAo?
tA-hA,
tumi kleza pAve ejanye Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa kari nAi,
varaM ye bhaYa kare kevala tAra upadezArthe,
yini pRthivI o samucca AkAzamaNDalI sRSTi karechena tA~ra nikaTa hate eTA avatIrNa|
daYAmaYa Araze samAsIna|
yA Ache AkAzamaNDalIte, pRthivIte, ei duiYera antarvartI sthAne o bha‚garbhe tA tA~rai|
yadi tumi uccakaNThe kathA vala, tave tini to yA gupta o avyakta sakalai jAnena|
AllAh, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei, sundara sundara nAma tA~rai|
mUsAra vRttAnta tomAra nikaTa peৗ~cheche ki?

se yakhana Aguna dekhala takhana tAra parivAravargake valala, ‘tomarA ekhAne thAka Ami Aguna dekhechi| sambhavata Ami tomAdera janye tA hate kichu jvalanta aGgAra Anate pAriva vA Ami Agunera nikaTe kona pathanirdeza pAiva|’
erapara yakhana se Agunera nikaTa elo takhana AhvAna kare valA hala, ‘he mUsA!
Amii tomAra pratipAlaka, ataeva tomAra pAdukA khule phela, kAraNa tumi pavitra ‘tuoYA’ upatyakAYa raYecha|
‘evaM Ami tomAke manonIta karechi| ataeva yA ohI preraNa karA hacche tumi tA manoyogera saGge zono|
‘Amii AllAh, Ami vyatIta kona ilAh nei| ataeva AmAra ‘ivAdata kara evaM AmAra smaraNArthe sAlAta kAYema kara|
‘kiYAmata avazyambhAvI, Ami eTA gopana rAkhate cAhi yAte pratyekei nija karmAnuyAYI phala lAbha karate pAre|
‘sutarAM ye vyakti kiYAmate vizvAsa kare nA o nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare, se yena tomAke ete vizvAsa sthApane nivRtta nA kare, nivRtta hale tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
‘he mUsA! tomAra dakSiNa haste oTA kI?’
se valala, ‘tA AmAra lAThi; Ami ete bhara dei evaM eTA diYe AghAta kare Ami AmAra meSapAlera janye vRkSapatra pheliYA thAki evaM eTA AmAra anyAnya kAjeo lAge|’
AllAh valalena, ‘he mUsA! tumi eTA nikSepa kara|’
erapara se tA nikSepa karala, saGge saGge tA sApa haYe chuTite lAgala,
tini valalena, ‘tumi eTAke dhara, bhaYa kara nA, Ami eTAke eTAra pUrvarUpe phiriYe diva|
‘evaM tomAra hAta tomAra vagale rAkha, eTA vera haYe Asave nirmala ujjvala haYe apara eka nidarzanasvarUpa|
‘eTA eijanye ye, Ami tomAke dekhAva AmAra mahAnidarzanagulira kichu|
‘phira‘Aonera nikaTa yAo, se to sImAlaMghana kareche|’
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra vakSa prazasta kare dAo|
evaM AmAra karma sahaja kare dAo|
AmAra jihvAra jar3atA dUra kare dAo-
yAte erA AmAra kathA vujhate pAre|
AmAra janye kare dAo ekajana sAhAyyakArI AmAra svajanavargera madhya hate;
AmAra bhAi hArUnake;
tAra diYe AmAra zakti sudRr3ha kara,
o tAke AmAra karme aMzI kara,
yAte AmarA tomAra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karate pAri pracura;
evaM tomAke smaraNa karate pAri adhika|
‘tumi to AmAdera samyaka draSTA|’
tini valalena, he mUsA! tumi yA cAhiYAcha tA tomAke deoYA hala|
evaM Ami to tomAra prati Arao ekavAra anugraha karechilAma;
yakhana Ami tomAra mAtAke jAniYechilAma yA chila jAnAvAra,

‘ye, tumi tAke sindukera madhye rAkha, erapara tA dariYAYa bhAsAiYA dAo yAte dariYA eke tIre Thele deYa, eke AmAra zatru o era zatru niYe yAve| Ami AmAra nikaTa hate tomAra opara bhAlavAsA Dhele diYechilAma, yAte tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne pratipAlita hao|’

‘yakhana tomAra bhagnI ese valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake vale diva ke ei zizura bhAra nive?’ takhana Ami tomAke tomAra mAYera nikaTa phiriYe dilAma yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa evaM se duHkha nA pAYa; evaM tumi eka vyaktike hatyA karechile; erapara Ami tomAke manaHpIr3A hate mukti dei, Ami tomAke vahu parIkSA karechi| erapara tumi kaYeka vatsara mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye chile, he mUsA! eTAra pare tumi nirdhArita samaYe upasthita hale|
‘evaM Ami tomAke AmAra nijera janye prastuta kare niYechi|
‘tumi o tomAra bhAi AmAra nidarzanasaha yAtrA kara evaM AmAra smaraNe zaithilya kara nA,
‘tomarA ubhaYe phira‘Aonera nikaTa yAo, se to sImA-laMghana kareche|
‘tomarA tAra saGge namra kathA valave, haYato se upadeza grahaNa karave vA bhaYa karave|’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA to AzaMkA kari se AmAdera opara vAr3AvAr3i karave vA anyAYa AcaraNe sImAlaMghana karave|’
tini valalena, ‘tomarA bhaYa kara nA, Ami to tomAdera saGge Achi, Ami zuni o Ami dekhi|’

sutarAM tomarA tAra nikaTa yAo evaM vala, ‘AmarA tomAra pratipAlakera rAsUla, sutarAM AmAdera saGge vanI isrAIlake yete dAo evaM tAderake kaSTa dio nA, AmarA to tomAra nikaTa enechi tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate nidarzana evaM zAnti tAdera prati yArA anusaraNa kare satpatha|
‘AmAdera prati ohI preraNa karA haYeche ye, zAsti to tAra janye, ye mithyA Aropa kare o mukha phiriYe neYa|’
phira‘Aona valala, ‘he mUsA! ke tomAdera pratipAlaka?’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka tini, yini pratyeka vastuke tAra AkRti dAna karechena, erapara pathanirdeza karechena|’
phira‘Aona valala, ‘tA hale atIta yugera lokadera avasthA kI?’
mUsA valala, ‘eTAra jJAna AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa kitAve raYeche, AmAra pratipAlaka bhula karena nA evaM vismRtao hana nA|’
‘yini tomAdera janye pRthivIke karechena vichAnA evaM ete kare diYechena tomAdera calAra patha, tini AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena|’ evaM Ami tA diYe vibhinna prakArera udbhida utpanna kari|
tomarA AhAra kara o tomAdera gavAdipazu carAo; avazyai ete nidarzana Ache vivekasampannadera janye|
Ami mRttikA hate tomAderake sRSTi karechi, etei tomAderake phiriYe diva evaM tA hate punarvAra tomAderake vera karava|
Ami to tAke AmAra samasta nidarzana dekhiYechilAma; kintu se mithyA Aropa kareche o amAnya kareche|
se valala, ‘he mUsA! tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa esecho tomAra jAdu diYe AmAderake AmAdera deza hate vahiSkAra kare divAra janye?

‘AmarAo avazyai tomAra nikaTa upasthita karava eTAra anurUpa jAdu, sutarAM AmAdera o tomAra madhye nirdhAraNa kara eka nirdiSTa samaYa eka madhyavartI sthAne, yAra vyatikrama AmarAo karava nA evaM tumio karave nA|’
mUsA valala, ‘tomAdera nirdhArita samaYa utsavera dina evaM yei dina pUrvAhne janagaNake samaveta karA have|’
erapara phira‘Aona uThiYA gela evaM pare tAra kauzalasamUha ekatra karala, erapara elo|
mUsA ederake valala, ‘durbheAga tomAdera! tomarA AllAh ra prati mithyA Aropa kara nA| karale, tini tomAderake zAsti diYe samUle dhvaMsa karavena| ye mithyA udbhAvana kareche se-i vyartha haYeche|’
erA nijedera madhye nijedera karma samvandhe vitarka karala evaM erA gopane parAmarza karala|
erA valala, ‘ei du’jana avazyai jAdukara, tArA cAYa tAdera jAdu diYe tomAderake tomAdera deza hate vahiSkAra karate evaM tomAdera utkRSTa jIvana-vyavasthA dhvaMsa karate|
‘ataeva tomarA tomAdera jAdukriYA saMhata kara, erapara sArivaddha haYe upasthita hao evaM ye Aja jaYI have se-i saphala have|’
erA valala, ‘he mUsA! haYa tumi nikSepa kara vA prathame AmarAi nikSepa kari|’
mUsA valala, ‘varaM tomarAi nikSepa kara|’ edera jAdu-prabhAve akasmAt mUsAra mane hala edera dar3i o lAThiguli chuTAchuTi karateche|
mUsA tAra antare kichu bhIti anubhava karala|
Ami valalAma, ‘bhaYa kara nA, tumii pravala|’
‘tomAra dakSiNa haste yA Ache tA nikSepa kara, eTA erA yA kareche tA grAsa kare phelave| erA yA kareche tA to kevala jAdukarera kauzala| jAdukara yekhAnei Asuka, saphala have nA|’
erapara jAdukarerA sijadAvanata hala o valala, ‘AmarA hArUna o mUsAra pratipAlakera prati ImAna AnalAma|’

phira‘Aona valala, ‘kI, Ami tomAderake anumati deoYAra pUrvei tomarA mUsAte vizvAsa sthApana karale! dekhatechi, se to tomAdera pradhAna, se tomAderake jAdu zikSA diYeche| sutarAM Ami to tomAdera hastapada viparIta dika hate kartana karavai evaM Ami tomAderake kharjura vRkSera kANDe zUlaviddha karavai evaM tomarA avazyai jAnate pArave AmAdera madhye kAhAra zAsti kaThoratara o adhika sthAYI|’

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera nikaTa ye spaSTa nidarzana eseche tAra opara evaM yini AmAderake sRSTi karechena tA~ra opara tomAke AmarA kichutei prAdhAnya diva nA| sutarAM tumi kara yA tumi karate cAo| tumi to kevala ei pArthiva jIvanera opara kartRtva karate pAra|’
‘AmarA nizcaYai AmAdera pratipAlakera prati ImAna enechi yAte tini kSamA karena AmAdera aparAdha evaM tumi AmAderake ye jAdu karate vAdhya karecha tA| Ara AllAh zreSTha o cirasthAYI|’
ye tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa aparAdhI haYe upasthita have tAra janye to Ache jAhAnnAma, sekhAne se maraveo nA, vA~caveo nA|
evaM yArA tA~ra nikaTa upasthita have mu’mina avasthAYa satkarma kare, tAdera janye Ache samucca maryAdA-
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM ei puraskAra tAderai, yArA pavitra|

Ami avazyai mUsAra prati pratyAdeza karechilAma ei marme ye, AmAra vAndAderake niYe rajanIyoge vahirgata hao evaM tAdera janye samudrera madhya diYe eka zuSka patha nirmANa kara| pazcAt hate ese tomAke dhare phelA have-ei AzaMkA kara nA evaM bhaYao kara nA|
erapara phira‘Aona tAra sainyavAhinIsaha tAdera pazcAddhAvana karala, erapara samudra ederake sampUrNarUpe nimajjita karala|
Ara phira‘Aona tAra sampradAYake pathabhraSTa karechila evaM satpatha dekhAYa nAi|
he vanI isarAIla! Ami to tomAderake zatru hate uddhAra karechilAma, Ami tomAderake pratizruti diYechilAma tUra parvatera dakSiNa pArzve evaM tomAdera nikaTa mAnnA o sAloYA preraNa karechilAma,

tomAderake yA dAna karechi tA hate bhAla bhAla vastu AhAra kara evaM ei viSaYe sImAlaMghana kara nA, karale tomAdera opara AmAra krodha avadhArita evaM yAra opara AmAra krodha avadhArita se to dhvaMsa haYe yAYa|
evaM Ami avazyai kSamAzIla tAra prati, ye taovA kare, ImAna Ane, satkarma kare o satpathe avicalita thAke|
he mUsA! tomAra sampradAYake pazcAte pheliYA tomAke tvarA karate vAdhya karala kise?
se valala, ‘ei to erA AmAra pazcAte evaM he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami tvarAYa tomAra nikaTa eloAma, tumi santuSTa have ejanye|’
tini valalena, ‘Ami to tomAra sampradAYake parIkSAYa phelechi tomAra cale AsAra para evaM sAmirI ederake pathabhraSTa kareche|’

erapara mUsA tAra sampradAYera nikaTa phire gela kruddha o kSuvdha haYe| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera pratipAlaka ki tomAderake eka uttama pratizruti dena nAi? tave ki pratizrutikAla tomAdera nikaTa sudIrgha haYeche, nA tomarA cAhiYAcha tomAdera prati Apatita hoka tomAdera pratipAlakera krodha, ye kAraNe tomarA AmAra prati pradatta aGgIkAra bhaGga karale?’

erA valala, ‘AmarA tomAra prati pradatta aGgIkAra svecchAYa bhaGga kari nAi; tave AmAdera opara cApAiYA deoYA haYechila lokera alaMkArera vojhA evaM AmarA tA agnikuNDe nikSepa kari, anurUpabhAve sAmirIo nikSepa kare|
‘erapara se edera janye gar3ala eka go-vatsa, eka avaYava, yA hAmvA rava karata|’ erA valala, ‘eTA tomAdera ilAh evaM mUsArao ilAh, kintu mUsA bhule geche|’
