tave ki erA bheve dekhe nA ye, tA tAdera kathAYa sAr3A deYa nA evaM tAdera kona kSati vA upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA?

hArUna ederake pUrvei valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! eTA diYe to kevala tomAderake parIkSAYa phelA haYeche| tomAdera pratipAlaka to daYAmaYa; sutarAM tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara evaM AmAra Adeza mene cala|’
erA valechila, ‘AmAdera nikaTa mUsA phire nA AsA paryanta AmarA eTAra pUjA hate kichutei virata hava nA|’
mUsA valala, ‘he hArUna! tumi yakhana dekhale erA pathabhraSTa haYeche takhana kise tomAke nivRtta karala-
‘AmAra anusaraNa karA hate? tave ki tumi AmAra Adeza amAnya karale?’

hArUna valala, ‘he AmAra sahodara! AmAra zmazru o keza dhario nA| Ami AzaMkA karechilAma ye, tumi valave, ‘tumi vanI isarAIladera madhye vibheda sRSTi karecha o tumi AmAra vAkya pAlane yatnavAna hao nAi|’
mUsA valala, ‘he sAmirI! tomAra vyApAra kI?’
se valala, ‘Ami dekhechilAma yA erA dekhe nAi, erapara Ami sei dUtera padacihna hate ekamuSTi niYechilAma evaM Ami tA nikSepa karechilAma; AmAra mana AmAra janye zobhana karechila eirUpa karA|’

mUsA valala, ‘dUra hao; tomAra jIvaddazAYa tomAra janye eTAi raila ye, tumi valave, ‘Ami aspRzya’, evaM tomAra janye raila eka nirdiSTa kAla, tomAra velAYa yAra vyatikrama have nA evaM tumi tomAra sei ilAhera prati lakSya kara yAra pUjAYa tumi rata chile; AmarA eke jvAlAiYA divai, erapara eke vikSipta kare sAgare nikSepa karavai|’
tomAdera ilAh to kevala AllAhi yini vyatIta anya kona ilAha nei, tA~ra jJAna sarvaviSaYe vyApta|
pUrve yA ghaTeche tAra saMvAda Ami eibhAve tomAra nikaTa vivRta kari evaM Ami AmAra nikaTa hate tomAke dAna karechi upadeza,
eTA hate ye vimukha have se avazyai kiYAmatera dina mahAbhAra vahana karave|
ete erA sthAYI have evaM kiYAmatera dina ei vojhA edera janye have kata manda!
yedina ziMgAYa phutkAra deoYA have evaM yei dina Ami aparAdhIderake dRSTihIna avasthAYa samaveta karava|
sei dina erA nijedera madhye cupicupi valAvali karave, ‘tomarA mAtra daza dina avasthAna karechile|’
Ami bhAla jAni erA ki valave, edera madhye ye apekSAkRta satpathe chila se valave, ‘tomarA mAtra ekadina avasthAna karechile|’
erA tomAke parvatasamUha samparke jijJAsA kare| vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka ederake samUle utpATana kare vikSipta kare divena|
‘erapara tini eke pariNata karavena masRNa samatala maYadAne,
‘yAte tumi vakratA o uccatA dekhave nA|’
sei dina erA AhvAnakArIra anusaraNa karave, ei vyApAre edika-odika karate pArave nA| daYAmaYera sAmane sakala zavda stavdha haYe yAve; sutarAM mRdu padadhvani vyatIta tumi kichui zunave nA|
daYAmaYa yAke anumati divena o yAra kathA tini pachanda karavena se vyatIta kArao supAriza sei dina kona kAje Asave nA|
tAdera sAmane o pazcAte yA kichu Ache tA tini avagata, kintu erA jJAna diYe tA~ke AYatta karate pAre nA|
ciraJjIva, sarvasattAra dhArakera nikaTa sakalei have adhovadana evaM se-i vyartha have, ye julumera bhAra vahana karave|
evaM ye satkarma kare mu’mina haYe, tAra kona AzaMkA nei avicArera evaM anya kona kSatira|
eirUpei Ami kuraAnake avatIrNa karechi AravI bhASAYa evaM ete vizadabhAve vivRta karechi satarkavANI yAte erA bhaYa kare vA eTA haYa edera janye upadeza|
AllAh ati mahAna, prakRta adhipati| tomAra prati AllAh ra ohI sampUrNa haoYAra pUrve kuraAna pAThe tumi tvarA kara nA evaM vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke jJAne samRddha kara|’
Ami to itipUrve Adamera prati nirdeza dAna karechilAma, kintu se bhule giYechila; Ami tAke saMkalpe dRr3ha pAi nAi|
smaraNa kara, yakhana pherezatAgaNake valalAma, ‘Adamera prati sijdA kara,’ takhana ivalIsa vyatIta sakalei sijadA karala, se amAnya karala|
erapara Ami valalAma, ‘he Adama! nizcaYai e tomAra o tomAra strIra zatru, sutarAM se yena kichutei tomAderake jAnnAta hate vera kare nA deYa, dile tomarA duHkha-kaSTa pAve|
‘tomAra janye eTAi raila ye, tumi jAnnAte kSudhArtao have nA o nagnao have nA;
evaM sekhAne pipAsArta have nA evaM raudra-kliSTao have nA|’
erapara zaYatAna tAke kumantraNA dila; se valala, ‘he Adama! Ami ki tomAke vale diva ananta jIvanaprada vRkSera kathA o akSaYa rAjyera kathA?’

erapara tArA ubhaYe tA hate bhakSaNa karala; takhana tAdera lajjAsthAna tAdera nikaTa prakAza haYe par3ala evaM tArA jAnnAtera vRkSapatra diYe nijederake AvRta karate lAgala| Adama tAra pratipAlakera hukuma amAnya karala, phale se bhrame patita hala|
eTAra para tAra pratipAlaka tAke manonIta karalena, tAra taovA kavula karalena o tAke pathanirdeza karalena|

tini valalena, ‘tomarA ubhaYe ekai saGge jAnnAta hate neme yAo| tomarA paraspara parasparera zatru| pare AmAra pakSa hate tomAdera nikaTa satpathera nirdeza Asale ye AmAra patha anusaraNa karave se vipathagAmI have nA o duHkha-kaSTa pAve nA|
‘ye AmAra smaraNe vimukha thAkave, avazyai tAra jIvana-yApana have saMkucita evaM Ami tAke kiYAmatera dina utthita karava andha avasthAYa|’
se valave, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! kena AmAke andha avasthAYa utthita karale? Ami to chilAma cakSuSmAna|’
tini valavena, ‘eirUpai AmAra nidarzanAvalI tomAra nikaTa esechila, kintu tumi tA bhule giYAchile evaM sebhAve Aja tumio vismRta hale|’
evaM ebhAvei Ami pratiphala dei tAke, ye vAr3AvAr3i kare o tAra pratipAlakera nidarzane vizvAsa sthApana kare nA| parakAlera zAsti to avazyai kaThinatara o adhika sthAYI|
eTAo ki tAderake satpatha dekhAla nA ye, Ami edera pUrve dhvaMsa karechi kata mAnavagoSThI yAdera vAsabha‚mite erA vicaraNa kare thAke? avazyai ete vivekasampannadera janye Ache nidarzana|
tomAra pratipAlakera pUrvasiddhAnta o ekaTA kAla nirdhArita nA thAkale avazyambhAvI hata Azu zAsti|

sutarAM erA yA vale, se viSaYe tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM sUryeAdaYera pUrve o sUryAstera pUrve tomAra pratipAlakera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara evaM rAtrikAle pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara, evaM divasera prAntasamUheo, yAte tumi santuSTa hate pAra|

tumi tomAra cokhadvaYa kakhanao prasArita kara nA era prati, yA Ami tAdera vibhinna zreNIke pArthiva jIvanera saundaryasvarUpa upabhogera upakaraNa hiseve diYechi, tA diYe tAderake parIkSA karAra janye| tomAra pratipAlaka-pradatta jIvanopakaraNa utkRSTa o adhika sthAYI|
evaM tomAra parivAravargake sAlAtera Adeza dAo o ete avicalita thAka, Ami tomAra nikaTa kona jIvanopakaraNa cAi nA; Amii tomAke jIvanopakaraNa dei evaM zubha pariNAma to muttAkIdera janye|
erA vale, ‘se tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate AmAdera nikaTa kona nidarzana AnaYana kare nA kena?’ edera nikaTa ki Ase nAi suspaSTa pramANa yA Ache pUrvavartI granthasamUhe?

yadi Ami ederake itipUrve zAsti diYe dhvaMsa karatAma tave erA valata, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAdera nikaTa ekajana rAsUla preraNa karale nA kena? karale AmarA lAJchita o apamAnita haoYAra pUrve tomAra nidarzana mene calitAma|’
vala, ‘pratyekei pratIkSA karateche, sutarAM tomarAo pratIkSA kara| erapara tomarA jAnate pArave kAhArA raYeche sarala pathe evaM kArA satpatha avalamvana kareche|’
mAnuSera hiseva-nikAzera samaYa Asanna, kintu erA udAsInatAYa mukha phiriYe raYeche|
yakhanai edera nikaTa edera pratipAlakera kona nUtana upadeza Ase erA tA zravaNa kare kautukacchale,
edera antara thAke amanoyogI| yArA jAlima tArA gopane parAmarza kare, ‘e to tomAdera mato ekajana mAnuSai, tavuo ki tomarA dekhe-zune jAdura kavale par3ave?’
se valala, ‘AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra samasta kathAi AmAra pratipAlaka avagata Achena evaM tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|’

erA eTAo vale, ‘ei samasta alIka kalpanA, haYa se tA udbhAvana kareche, nA haYa se ekajana kavi| ataeva se AnaYana karuka AmAdera nikaTa eka nidarzana yerUpa nidarzanasaha prerita haYechila pUrvavartIgaNa|’
edera pUrve yesava janapada Ami dhvaMsa karechi era adhivAsIrA ImAna Ane nAi; tave ki erA ImAna Anave?
tomAra pUrve Ami ohIsaha mAnuSai pAThiYechilAma; tomarA yadi nA jAna tave jJAnIderake jijJAsA kara|
evaM Ami tAderake emana dehaviziSTa kari nAi ye, tArA AhArya grahaNa karata nA; tArA cirasthAYIo chila nA|
erapara Ami tAdera prati AmAra pratizruti pUrNa karalAma,-yathA, Ami ederake o yAderake icchA rakSA karechilAma evaM jAlimaderake karechilAma dhvaMsa|
Ami to tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechi kitAva yAte Ache tomAdera janye upadeza, tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?
Ami dhvaMsa karechi kata janapada, yAra adhivAsIrA chila jAlima evaM tAdera pare sRSTi karechi apara jAti|
erapara yakhana erA AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala takhanai erA janapada hate palAYana karate lAgala|
ederake valA haYechila, ‘palAYana kara nA evaM phire Asa tomAdera bhoga-sambhArera nikaTa o tomAdera AvAsagRhe, haYata e viSaYe tomAderake jijJAsA karA yete pAre|’
erA valala, ‘hAYa, durbheAga AmAdera! AmarA to chilAma jAlima|’
edera ei ArtanAda calate thAke Ami ederake kartita zasya o nirvApita agnisadRza nA karA paryanta|
AkAza o pRthivI evaM yA edera antarvartI tA Ami krIr3Acchale sRSTi kari nAi|
Ami yadi krIr3Ara upakaraNa cAitAma tave Ami AmAra nikaTa yA Ache tA niYei tA karatAma; Ami tA kari nAi|
kintu Ami satya diYe AghAta hAni mithyAra opara; phale tA mithyAke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare deYa evaM tatkSaNAt mithyA nizcihna haYe yAYa| durbheAga tomAdera! tomarA yA valacha tAra janye|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yArA Ache tArA tA~rai: tA~ra sAnnidhye yArA Ache tArA ahaGkAravaze tA~ra ‘ivAdata karA hate vimukha haYa nA evaM klAntio vodha kare nA|
tArA divArAtra tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, tArA zaithilya kare nA|
erA mRttikA hate tairi yesava devatA grahaNa kareche seguli ki mRtake jIvita karate sakSama?
yadi AllAh vyatIta vahu ilAh thAkata AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte, tave ubhaYei dhvaMsa haYe yeta| ataeva erA yA vale tA hate Arazera adhipati AllAh pavitra, mahAna|
tini yA karena se viSaYe tA~ke prazna karA yAve nA; varaM ederakei prazna karA have|

erA ki tA~ke vyatIta vahu ilAh grahaNa kareche? vala, ‘tomarA tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara| eTAi, AmAra saGge yArA Ache tAdera janye upadeza evaM eTAi upadeza chila AmAra pUrvavartIdera janye|’ kintu edera adhikAMzai prakRta satya jAne nA, phale erA mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ami tomAra pUrve emana kona rAsUla preraNa kari nAi tAra prati ei ohI vyatIta ye, ‘Ami vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei; sutarAM AmArai ‘ivAdata kara|’
erA vale, ‘daYAmaYa AllAh santAna grahaNa karechena|’ tini pavitra, mahAna! tArA to tA~ra sammAnita vAndA|
tArA Age vAr3iYe kathA vale nA; tArA to tA~ra Adeza anusArei kAja kare thAke|
tAdera sAmane o pazcAte yA kichu Ache tA tini avagata| tArA supAriza kare zudhu edera janye yAdera prati tini santuSTa evaM tArA tA~ra bhaYe bhIta-santrasta|
tAdera madhye ye valave, ‘Amii ilAh tini vyatIta,’ tAke Ami pratiphala diva jAhAnnAma; ebhAvei Ami jAlimaderake zAsti diYe thAki|

yArA kupharI kare tArA ki bheve dekhe nA ye, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI mize chila otaprotabhAve, erapara Ami ubhaYake pRthaka kare dilAma; evaM prANavAna samasta kichu sRSTi karalAma pAni hate; tavu ki erA ImAna Anave nA?
evaM Ami pRthivIte sRSTi karechi sudRr3ha parvata, yAte pRthivI ederake niYe edika-odika Dhale nA yAYa evaM Ami ete kare diYechi prazasta patha, yAte erA gantavyasthale pau~chite pAre|
evaM AkAzake karechi surakSita chAda; kintu erA AkAzasthita nidarzanAvalI hate mukha phiriYe laYa|
AllAhi sRSTi karechena rAtri o divasa evaM sUrya o candra; pratyekei nija nija kakSapathe vicaraNa kare|
Ami tomAra pUrveo kona mAnuSake ananta jIvana dAna kari nAi; sutarAM tomAra mRtyu hale erA ki cirajIvI haYe thAkave?
jIvamAtrai mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave; Ami tomAderake manda o bhAla diYe vizeSabhAve parIkSA kare thAki evaM AmArai nikaTa tomarA pratyAnIta have|

kAphirarA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana erA tomAke kevala vidrupera pAtrarUpei grahaNa kare| erA vale, ‘ei ki sei, ye tomAdera deva-devIgulira samAlocanA kare?’ athaca erAi to ‘rahamAna’-era ullekhera virodhitA kare|
mAnuSa sRSTigatabhAve tvarApravaNa, zIghrai Ami tomAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI dekhAva; sutarAM tomarA AmAke tvarA karate vala nA|
evaM erA vale, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala ei pratizruti kakhana pUrNa have?’
hAYa, yadi kAphirarA se samaYera kathA jAnata yakhana erA edera sammukha o pazcAt hate agni pratirodha karate pArave nA evaM ederake sAhAyya karAo have nA!
vastuta tA edera opara Asave atarkitabhAve evaM ederake hatabhamva kare dive| phale erA tA rodha karate pArave nA evaM ederake avakAzao deoYA have nA|
tomAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlakei ThATTA-vidrupa karA haYechila; pariNAme tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karata tA vidrupakArIderake pariveSTana karechila|
vala, ‘rahamAna hate ke tomAderake rakSA karave rAtrite o divase?’ tavuo erA edera pratipAlakera smaraNa hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
tave ki Ami vyatIta edera emana deva-devIo Ache yArA ederake rakSA karate pAre? erA to nijederakei sAhAyya karate pAre nA evaM AmAra viruddhe edera sAhAyyakArIo thAkave nA|

vastuta Amii ederake evaM edera pitR-puruSaderake bhogasambhAra diYechilAma; adhikantu edera AYuSkAlao haYechila dIrgha| erA ki dekhateche nA ye, Ami edera dezake caturdika hate saMkucita kare Anatechi| tavuo ki erA vijaYI have?
vala, ‘Ami to kevala ohI diYei tomAderake satarka kari’, kintu yArA vadhira tAderake yakhana satarka karA haYa takhana tArA satarkavANI zune nA|
tomAra pratipAlakera zAstira kichumAtrao ederake sparza karale erA nizcaYai vale uThave, ‘hAYa, durbheAga AmAdera, AmarA to chilAma jAlima!’

evaM kiYAmata divase Ami sthApana karava nyAYavicArera mAnadaNDa| sutarAM kArao prati kona avicAra karA have nA evaM karma yadi tila parimANa ojanerao haYa tavu tA Ami upasthita karava; hiseva grahaNakArIrUpe Amii yatheSTa|
Ami to mUsA o hArUnake diYechilAma ‘phurakAna’, jyoti o upadeza muttAkIdera janye-
yArA nA dekheo tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare evaM tArA kiYAmata samparke bhIta-santrasta|
eTA kalyANamaYa upadeza; Ami eTA avatIrNa karechi| tavuo ki tomarA eTAke asvIkAra kara?
Ami to eTAra pUrve ivrAhImake satpathera jJAna diYechilAma evaM Ami tAra samvandhe chilAma samyaka parijJAta|
yakhana se tAra pitA o tAra sampradAYake valala, ‘ei mUrtiguli kI, yAdera pUjAYa tomarA rata raYecha!’
erA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNake edera pUjA karate dekhechi|’
se valala, ‘tomarA nijerA evaM tomAdera pitRpuruSagaNao raYeche spaSTa vibhrAntite|’
erA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa satya enecha, nA tumi kautuka karacho?’
se valala, ‘nA, tomAdera pratipAlaka to AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra pratipAlaka, yini edera sRSTi karechena evaM ei viSaYe Ami anyatama sAkSI|’
‘zapatha AllAh ra, tomarA cale gele Ami tomAdera mUrtiguli samvandhe avazyai kauzala avalamvana karava|’
erapara se cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dila mUrtigulike, edera pradhAnaTi vyatIta; yAte erA tAra dike phire Ase|
erA valala, ‘AmAdera upAsyagulira prati eirUpa karala ke? se nizcaYai sImAlaMghanakArI|’
keu keu valala, ‘eka yuvakake edera samAlocanA karate zunechi; tAke valA haYa ivrAhIma|’
erA valala, ‘tAke upasthita kara lokasAmane, yAte erA pratyakSa karate pAre|’
erA valala ‘he ivrAhIma! tumii ki AmAdera upAsyagulira prati eirUpa karecha?’
se valala, ‘varaM edera ei pradhAna, se-i to eTA kareche, ederake jijJAsA kara yadi erA kathA valate pAre|’
takhana erA mane mane cintA kare dekhala evaM eke aparake valate lAgala, ‘tomarAi to sImAlaMghanakArI!’
erapara edera mastaka avanata haYe gela evaM erA valala, ‘tumi to jAnai ye, erA kathA vale nA|’
ivrAhIma valala, ‘tave ki tomarA AllAh ra parivarte emana kichura ‘ivAdata kara yA tomAdera kona upakAra karate pAre nA, kSatio karate pAre nA?’
‘dhik tomAderake evaM AllAh ra parivarte tomarA yAdera ‘ivAdata kara tAderake! tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?’
erA valala, ‘tAke pur3iYe dAo, sAhAyya kara tomAdera devatAgulike, tomarA yadi kichu karate cAo|’
Ami valalAma, ‘he agni! tumi ivrAhImera janye zItala o nirApada haYe yAo|’
erA tAra kSati sAdhanera icchA karechila| kintu Ami ederake kare dilAma sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
evaM Ami tAke o lUtake uddhAra kare niYe gelAma sei deze, yekhAne Ami kalyANa rekhechi vizvavAsIra janye|
evaM Ami ivrAhImake dAna karechilAma ishAka evaM pautrarUpe iYA‘ka‚va; Ara pratyekakei karechilAma satkarmaparAYaNa;

evaM tAderake karechilAma netA; tArA AmAra nirdeza anusAre mAnuSake patha pradarzana karata; tAderake ohI preraNa karechilAma satkarma karate, sAlAta kAYema karate evaM yAkAta pradAna karate; tArA AmArai ‘ivAdata karata|
evaM lUtake diYechilAma prajJA o jJAna evaM tAke uddhAra karechilAma emana eka janapada hate yAra adhivAsIrA lipta chila azlIla karme; erA chila eka manda sampradAYa, satyatyAgI|
evaM tAke Ami AmAra anugrahabhAjana karechilAma; se chila satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta|
smaraNa kara nUhke, pUrve se yakhana AhvAna karechila takhana Ami sAr3A diYechilAma tAra AhvAne evaM tAke o tAra parijanavargake mahAsaMkaTa hate uddhAra karechilAma,
evaM Ami tAke sAhAyya karechilAma sei sampradAYera viruddhe yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra karechila; nizcaYai erA chila eka manda sampradAYa| eijanye edera sakalakei Ami nimajjita karechilAma|
evaM smaraNa kara dAUda o sulAYamAnera kathA, yakhana tArA vicAra karachila zasyakSetra samparke; ete rAtrikAle praveza karechila kona sampradAYera meSa; Ami pratyakSa karachilAma tAdera vicAra|

evaM Ami sulAYamAnake e viSaYera mImAMsA vujhAiYA diYechilAma evaM tAdera pratyekake Ami diYechilAma prajJA o jJAna| Ami parvata o vihaGgakulake adhIna kare diYechilAma-erA dAUdera saGge AmAra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karata; Amii chilAma ei samastera kartA|
Ara Ami tAke tomAdera janye varma nirmANa zikSA diYechilAma, yAte tA tomAdera yuddhe tomAderake rakSA kare; sutarAM tomarA ki kRtajJa have nA?
evaM sulAYamAnera vazIbhUta kare diYechilAma uddAma vAYuke; tA tAra Adezakrame pravAhita hata sei dezera dike yekhAne Ami kalyANa rekhechi; pratyeka viSaYa samparke Amii samyaka avagata|
evaM zaYatAnadera madhye kataka tAra janye DuvurIra kAja karata, eTA vyatIta anya kAjao karata; Ami edera rakSAkArI chilAma|
evaM smaraNa kara Aiuvera kathA, yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake AhvAna kare valechila, ‘Ami duHkha-kaSTe par3echi, Ara tumi to sarvazreSTha daYAlu!’

takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A dilAma, tAra duHkha-kaSTa dUrIbhUta kare dilAma, tAke tAra parivAra-parijana phiriYe dilAma evaM tAdera saGge tAdera mata Aro dilAma AmAra vizeSa rahamatarUpe evaM ‘ivAdatakArIdera janye upadezasvarUpa|
evaM smaraNa kara isamAIla, idrIsa o yula-kiphla-era kathA, tAdera pratyekei chila dhairyazIla;
evaM tAderake Ami AmAra anugrahabhAjana karechilAma; tArA to chila satkarmaparAYaNa|

evaM smaraNa kara yun-nUna-era kathA, yakhana se krodhabhare vera haYe giYechila evaM mane karechila Ami tAra janye zAsti nirdhAraNa karava nA| erapara se andhakAra hate AhvAna karechila: ‘tumi vyatIta kona ilAh nei; tumi pavitra, mahAna! Ami to sImAlaMghanakArI|’
takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma evaM tAke uddhAra karechilAma duzcintA hate evaM eibhAvei Ami mu’minaderake uddhAra kare thAki|
evaM smaraNa kara yAkAriYAra kathA, yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake AhvAna kare valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke ekA rekha nA, tumi to zreSTha mAlikAnAra adhikArI|’

erapara Ami tAra AhvAne sAr3A diYechilAma evaM tAke dAna karechilAma iYAhiYA evaM tAra janye tAra strIke yogyatAsampanna karechilAma| tArA satkarme pratiyogitA karata, tArA AmAke DAkata AzA o bhItira saGge evaM tArA chila AmAra nikaTa vinIta|
evaM smaraNa kara sei nArIke, ye nija satItvake rakSA karechila, erapara tAra madhye Ami AmAra rUh phu~kiYA diYechilAma evaM tAke o tAra putrake karechilAma vizvavAsIra janye eka nidarzana|
ei ye tomAdera jAti-eTA to ekai jAti evaM Amii tomAdera pratipAlaka, ataeva AmAra ‘ivAdata kara|
kintu tArA nijedera kAryakalApe parasparera madhye bheda sRSTi kareche| pratyekei pratyAnIta have AmAra nikaTa|
sutarAM yadi keu mu’mina haYe satkarma kare tAra karmapraceSTA agrAhya have nA evaM Ami to tA likhe rAkhi|
ye janapadake Ami dhvaMsa karechi tAra samparke niSiddha haYeche ye, tAra adhivAsIvRnda phire Asave nA,
emanaki yakhana iYA‘jUja o mA‘jUjake mukti deoYA have evaM erA prati uccabhUmi hate chuTiYA Asave|
amogha pratizruta kAla Asanna hale akasmAt kAphiradera cokha sthira haYe yAve, erA valave, ‘hAYa, durbheAga AmAdera! AmarA to chilAma e viSaYe udAsIna; nA, AmarA sImAlaMghanakArIi chilAma|’
tomarA evaM AllAh ra parivarte tomarA yAdera ‘ivAdata kara seguli to jAhAnnAmera indhana; tomarA sakale ete praveza karave|
yadi erA ilAh hata tave erA jAhAnnAme praveza karata nA; edera sakalei ete sthAYI have,
sekhAne thAkave edera ArtanAda evaM sekhAne erA kichui zunate pAve nA;
yAdera janye AmAra nikaTa hate pUrva hate kalyANa nirdhArita raYeche, tAderake tA hate dUre rAkhA have|
tArA era kSINatama zavdao zunave nA evaM sekhAne tArA tAdera mana yA cAYa cirakAla tA bhoga karave|
mahAbhIti tAderake viSAdakliSTa karave nA evaM pherezatAgaNa tAderake abhyarthanA karave ei vale, ‘ei tomAdera sei dina yAra pratizruti tomAderake deoYA haYechila|’

sei dina AkAzamaNDalIke guTiYe phelava, yebhAve guTAna haYa likhita daphatara; yebhAve Ami prathama sRSTira sUcanA karechilAma sebhAve punarAYa sRSTi karava; pratizruti pAlana AmAra kartavya, Ami eTA pAlana karavai|
Ami ‘upadezera’ para kitAve likhe diYechi ye, AmAra yogyatAsampanna vAndAgaNa pRthivIra adhikArI have|
nizcaYai ete raYeche vANI sei sampradAYera janye yArA ‘ivAdata kare|
Ami to tomAke vizvajagatera prati kevala rahamatarUpei preraNa karechi|
vala, ‘AmAra prati ohI haYa ye, tomAdera ilAh ekai ilAh, sutarAM tomarA haYe yAo AtmasamarpaNakArI|’
tave erA mukha phiriYe nile tumi vala, ‘Ami tomAderake yathAyathabhAve jAniYe diYechi evaM tomAderake ye viSaYera pratizruti deoYA haYeche, Ami jAni nA, tA Asanna, nA dUrasthita|
tini jAnena yA kathAYa vyakta evaM yA tomarA gopana kara|
‘Ami jAni nA haYata eTA tomAdera janye eka parIkSA evaM jIvanopabhoga kichu kAlera janye|’
rAsUla valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi nyAYera saGge phaYasAlA kare dio, AmAdera pratipAlaka to daYAmaYa, tomarA yA valatecha se viSaYe ekamAtra sahAYasthala tinii|’
he mAnuSa! bhaYa kara tomAdera pratipAlakake; kiYAmatera prakampana eka bhaYaMkara vyApAra!

yedina tomarA tA pratyakSa karave sei dina pratyeka stanyadAtrI vismRta have tAra dugdhapoSya zizuke evaM pratyeka garbhavatI tAra garbhapAta kare phelive; mAnuSake dekhave nezAgrastasadRza, yadio erA nezAgrasta naYa| vastuta AllAh ra zAsti kaThina|
mAnuSera madhye kataka ajJAnatAvazata AllAh samvandhe vitaNDA kare evaM anusaraNa kare pratyeka vidrohI zaYatAnera,
tAra samvandhe ei niYama kare deoYA haYeche ye, ye keu tAra saGge vandhutva karave se tAke pathabhraSTa karave evaM tAke paricAlita karave prajvalita agnira zAstira dike|

he mAnuSa! punarutthAna samvandhe yadi tomarA sandigdha hao tave avadhAna kara-Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi mRttikA hate, tAra para zukra hate, tAra para ‘AlAkA’ hate, tAra para pUrNAkRti vA apUrNAkRti goztapiNDa hate-tomAdera nikaTa vyakta karAra janye, Ami yA icchA kari tA eka nirdiSTa kAlera janye mAtRgarbhe sthita rAkhi, tAra para Ami tomAderake zizurUpe vera kari, pare yAte tomarA pariNata vaYase upanIta hao| tomAdera madhye kArao kArao mRtyu ghaTAna haYa evaM tomAdera madhye kAukeo kAukeo pratyAvRtta karA haYa hInatama vaYase, yAra phale erA yA kichu jAnata se samvandhe erA sajJAna thAke nA| tumi bhUmike dekha zuSka, erapara ete Ami vAri varSaNa karale tA zasya-zyAmalA haYe Andolita o sphIta haYa evaM udgata kare sarvaprakAra naYanAbhirAma udbhida;
eTA eijanye ye, AllAh satya evaM tinii mRtake jIvana dAna karena evaM tini sarvaviSaYe zaktimAna;
evaM kiYAmata Asavei, ete kona sandeha nei evaM kavare yArA Ache tAderake nizcaYai AllAh utthita karavena|
mAnuSera madhye keu keu AllAh samvandhe vitaNDA kare; tAdera nA Ache jJAna, nA Ache pathanirdeza, nA Ache kona dIptimAna kitAva|
se vitaNDA kare ghAr3a vA~kiYe lokaderake AllAh ra patha hate bhraSTa karAra janye| tAra janye lAJchanA Ache ihaloke evaM kiYAmata divase Ami tAke AsvAda karAva dahana-yantraNA|
sedina tAke valA have, ‘eTA tomAra kRtakarmerai phala, kAraNa AllAh vAndAdera prati juluma karena nA|’

mAnuSera madhye keu keu AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kare dvidhAra saGge; tAra maGgala hale tAte tAra citta prazAnta haYa evaM kona viparyaYa ghaTale se tAra pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAYa| se kSatigrasta haYa duniYAte o AkhirAte; eTAi to suspaSTa kSati|
se AllAh ra parivarte emana kichuke DAke yA era kona apakAra karate pAre nA, upakArao karate pAre nA; eTAi carama vibhrAnti|
se DAke emana kichuke yAra kSatii era upakAra apekSA nikaTatara| kata nikRSTa ei abhibhAvaka evaM kata nikRSTa ei sahacara!
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare AllAh avazyai tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita; AllAh yA icchA tAi karena|

ye keu mane kare, AllAh tAke kakhanai duniYA o AkhirAte sAhAyya karavena nA, se AkAzera dike ekaTi rajju vilamvita karuka, pare tA vicchinna karuka; erapara dekhuka tAra praceSTA tAra Akrozera hetu dUra kare ki nA|
eibhAvei Ami suspaSTa nidarzanarUpe tA avatIrNa karechi; Ara AllAh to yAke icchA satpatha pradarzana karena|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA iYAhUdI haYeche, yArA sAviYI, khrisTAna o agnipUjaka evaM yArA muzarika haYeche kiYAmatera dina AllAh tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare divena| AllAh to samasta kichura samyaka pratyakSakArI|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAhke sijdA kare yA kichu Ache AkAzamaNDalIte o pRthivIte, sUrya, candra, nakSatramaNDalI, parvatarAji, vRkSalatA, jIvajantu evaM sijdA kare mAnuSera madhye aneke? AvAra anekera prati avadhArita haYeche zAsti| AllAh yAke heYa karena tAra sammAnadAtA keui nei; AllAh yA icchA tA karena|
erA duiTi vivadamAna pakSa, tArA tAdera pratipAlaka samvandhe vitarka kare; yArA kupharI kare tAdera janye prastuta karA haYeche Agunera pozAka, tAdera mAthAra opara DhAliYA deoYA have phuTanta pAni,
yA diYe edera udare yA Ache tA evaM edera carma vigalita karA have|
evaM edera janye thAkave lauhamudagara|
yakhanai erA yantraNAkAtara haYe jAhAnnAma hate vera hate cAive takhanai tAderake phiriYe deoYA have ete; ederake valA have, ‘AsvAdana kara dahana-yantraNA|’

yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare AllAh tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tAderake alaGkRta karA have svarNa-kaGkana o muktA diYe evaM sekhAne tAdera pozAka-paricchada have rezamera|
tAderake pavitra vAkyera anugAmI karA haYechila evaM tArA paricAlita haYechila parama prazaMsAbhAjana AllAh ra pathe|

yArA kupharI kare evaM mAnuSake nivRtta kare AllAh ra patha hate o masajidula hArAma hate, yA Ami karechi sthAnIYa o vahirAgata sakalera janye samAna, Ara ye icchA kare sImAlaMghana kare ete pApa kAryera, tAke Ami AsvAdana karAiva marmantuda zAstira|

evaM smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami ivrAhImera janye nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma sei gRhera sthAna, takhana valechilAma, ‘AmAra saGge kona zarIka sthira kara nA evaM AmAra gRhake pavitra rekha tAdera janye yArA tAoYApha kare evaM yArA sAlAte dA~r3AYa, ruka‚‘ kare o sijdA kare|
evaM mAnuSera nikaTa hajja-era ghoSaNA kare dAo, erA tomAra nikaTa Asave padavraje o sarvaprakAra kSINakAYa uSTrera piThe, erA Asave dUra-dUrAntara patha atikrama kare,

yAte tArA tAdera kalyANamaYa sthAnagulite upasthita hate pAre evaM tini tAderake catuSpada jantu hate yA riyika hiseve dAna karechena era opara nirdiSTa dinagulite AllAh ra nAma uccAraNa karate pAre| erapara tomarA tA hate AhAra kara evaM dustha, abhAvagrastake AhAra karAo|
erapara tArA yena tAdera aparicchannatA dUra kare evaM tAdera mAnata pUrNa kare evaM tAoYApha kare prAcIna gRhera|

eTAi vidhAna evaM keu AllAh kartRka nirdhArita pavitra anuSThAnagulira sammAna karale tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa tAra janye eTAi uttama| tomAdera janye hAlAla karA haYeche gavAdipazu jantu-eguli vyatIta yA tomAderake zonAna haYeche| sutarAM tomarA varjana kara mUrtipUjAra apavitratA evaM dUre thAka mithyA kathana hate,

AllAh ra prati ekaniSTha haYe evaM tA~ra kona zarIka nA kare; evaM ye keu AllAh ra zarIka kare se yena AkAza hate par3ala, erapara pAkhi tAke cheA~ mere niYe gela, kiMvA vAYu tAke ur3iYe niYe giYe eka dUravartI sthAne nikSepa karala|
eTAi AllAh ra vidhAna evaM keu AllAh ra nidarzanAvalIke sammAna karale eTA to tAra hRdaYera tAkoYA-saJjAta|
ei samasta Ana‘Ame tomAdera janye nAnAvidha upakAra raYeche eka nirdiSTa kAlera janye; erapara edera kuravAnIra sthAna prAcIna gRhera nikaTa|

Ami pratyeka sampradAYera janye kuravAnIra niYama kare diYechi; tini tAderake jIvanopakaraNasvarUpa ye sakala catuSpada jantu diYechena, segulira opara yena tArA AllAh ra nAma uccAraNa kare| tomAdera ilAh eka ilAh, sutarAM tArai nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa kara evaM susaMvAda dAo vinItagaNake-
yAdera hRdaYa bhaYe kampita haYa AllAh ra nAma smaraNa karA hale, yArA tAdera vipada-Apade dhairya dhAraNa kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi tA hate vyaYa kare|

evaM uSTrake karechi AllAh ra nidarzanagulira anyatama; tomAdera janye ete maGgala raYeche| sutarAM sArivaddhabhAve daNDAYamAna avasthAYa edera opara tomarA AllAh ra nAma uccAraNa kara| yakhana erA kAta haYe par3e yAYa takhana tomarA tA hate AhAra kara evaM AhAra karAo dhairyazIla abhAvagrastake o yAcJAkArI abhAvagrastake; eibhAve Ami ederake tomAdera adhIna kare diYechi yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

kakhanai AllAh ra nikaTa pau~~chAYa nA edera gozta evaM rakta, varaM peৗ~chAYa tomAdera tAkoYA| eibhAve tini ederake tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena yAte tomarA AllAh ra zreSThatva ghoSaNA kara eijanye ye, tini tomAderake pathapradarzana karechena; sutarAM tumi susaMvAda dAo satkarmaparAYaNaderake|
avazyai AllAh rakSA karena mu’minaderake, tini kona vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJake pachanda karena nA|
yuddhera anumati deoYA hala tAderake yArA AkrAnta haYeche; kAraNa tAdera prati atyAcAra karA haYeche| AllAh nizcaYai tAderake sAhAyya karate samyaka sakSama;

tAderake tAdera ghara-vAr3i hate anyAYabhAve vahiSkAra karA haYeche zudhu e kAraNe ye, tArA vale, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAh|’ AllAh yadi mAnava jAtira eka dalake anya dala diYe pratihata nA karatena, tA hale vidhvasta haYe yeta khrisTAna saMsAravirAgIdera upAsanAsthAna, girjA, iYAhUdIdera upAsanAlaYa evaM masajidasamUha-yAte adhika smaraNa karA haYa AllAh ra nAma| AllAh nizcaYai tAke sAhAyya karena ye tA~ke sAhAyya kare| AllAh nizcaYai zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|
Ami ederake pRthivIte pratiSThA dAna karale erA sAlAta kAYema karave, yAkAta dive evaM satkarmera nirdeza dive o asatkarma niSedha karave; Ara sakala karmera pariNAma AllAh ra ikhtiYAre|
evaM lokerA yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare tave edera pUrve asvIkAra karechila to nUh, ‘Ada o sAmUdera sampradAYa,
ivrAhIma o lUtera sampradAYa,
evaM mAdiYAnavAsIrA Ara asvIkAra karA haYechila mUsAkeo| Ami kAphiraderake avakAza diYechilAma, erapara tAderake zAsti diYechilAma| ataeva kemana chila zAsti!

Ami dhvaMsa karechi kata janapada yeigulira vAsindA chila jAlima| eisava janapada tAdera gharera chAdasaha dhvaMsastUpe pariNata haYechila evaM kata ka‚pa parityakta haYechila o kata sudRr3ha prAsAdao|
tArA ki deza bhramaNa kare nAi? tA hale tArA jJAnavuddhisampanna hRdaYa o zrutizaktisampanna zravaNera adhikArI hate pArata| vastuta cokha to andha naYa, varaM andha hacche vakSasthita hRdaYa|
tArA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale, athaca AllAh tAra pratizruti kakhanao bhaGga karena nA| tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa ekadina tomAdera gaNanAra sahasra vatsarera samAna;
evaM Ami avakAza diYechi kata janapadake yakhana erA chila jAlima; erapara ederake zAsti diYechi evaM pratyAvartana AmArai nikaTa|
vala, ‘he mAnuSa! Ami to tomAdera janye eka spaSTa satarkakArI;
sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAdera janye Ache kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA;
evaM yArA AmAra AYAtake vyartha karAra ceSTA kare tArAi have jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

Ami tomAra pUrve ye samasta rAsUla kiMvA navI preraNa karechi tAdera keu yakhanai kichu AkAksakSA kareche, takhanai zaYatAna tAra AkAksakSAYa kichu prakSipta kareche, kintu zaYatAna yA prakSipta kare AllAh tA vidUrita karena| erapara AllAh tA~ra AYAtasamUhake supratiSThita karena evaM AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa;
eTA ejanye ye, zaYatAna yA prakSipta kare tini eke parIkSAsvarUpa karena tAdera janye yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche o yArA pASANa hRdaYa| nizcaYai jAlimarA dustara matabhede raYeche|

evaM ejanyeo ye, yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche tArA yena jAnate pAre ye, eTA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate prerita satya; erapara tArA yena ete vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM tAdera antara yena era prati anugata haYa| yArA ImAna eneche tAderake avazyai AllAh sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
yArA kupharI kareche tArA ete sandeha poSaNa hate virata have nA, yatakSaNa nA edera nikaTa kiYAmata ese par3ave AkasmikabhAve, vA ese par3ave eka vandhyA dinera zAsti|
sei dina AllAh ra i Adhipatya; tinii tAdera vicAra karavena| sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tArA avasthAna karave sukhada kAnane|
Ara yArA kupharI kare o AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare tAderai janye raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
evaM yArA hijarata kareche AllAh ra pathe, erapara nihata haYeche vA mArA geche tAderake AllAh avazyai utkRSTa jIvikA dAna karavena; Ara nizcaYai AllAh, tini to sarveAtkRSTa riyikadAtA|
tini tAderake avazyai emana sthAne dAkhila karavena yA tArA pachanda karave evaM AllAh to samyaka prajJAmaYa, parama sahanazIla|
eTAi haYe thAke, kona vyakti nipIr3ita haYe tulya pratizodha grahaNa karale o punarAYa se atyAcArita hale AllAh tAke avazyai sAhAyya karavena; AllAh nizcaYai pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|
tA eijanye ye, AllAh rAtrike praviSTa karAna divasera madhye evaM divasake praviSTa karAna rAtrira madhye evaM AllAh sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA;
eijanyeo ye, AllAh, tinii satya evaM erA tA~ra parivarte yAke DAke tA to asatya, evaM AllAh, tinii to samucca, mahAna|
tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, AllAh vAri varSaNa karena AkAza hate yAte savuja zyAmala haYe uThe pRthivI? nizcaYai AllAh samyaka sUkSmadarzI, parijJAta|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai, evaM AllAh, tinii to abhAvamukta, prazaMsArha|

tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, AllAh tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tatsamudaYake evaM tA~ra nirdeze samudre vicaraNazIla nauyAnasamUhake? Ara tinii AkAzake sthira rAkhena yAte tA patita nA haYa pRthivIra opara tA~ra anumati vyatIta| AllAh nizcaYai mAnuSera prati daYArdra, parama daYAlu|
evaM tinii tomAderake jIvana dAna karechena; erapara tinii tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, punarAYa tomAderake jIvana dAna karavena| mAnuSa to ati mAtrAYa akRtajJa|

Ami pratyeka sampradAYera janye nirdhArita kare diYechi ‘ivAdata paddhati-yA erA anusaraNa kare| sutarAM erA yena tomAra saGge vitarka nA kare ei vyApAre| tumi ederake tomAra pratipAlakera dike AhvAna kara, tumi to sarala pathei pratiSThita|
erA yadi tomAra saGge vitaNDA kare tave vala, ‘tomarA yA kara se samvandhe AllAh samyaka avahita|
‘tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda karacho AllAh kiYAmatera dina se viSaYe tomAdera madhye vicAra-mImAMsA kare divena|’
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AkAza o pRthivIte yA kichu raYeche AllAh tA jAnena? ei sakalai Ache eka kitAve; nizcaYai eTA AllAh ra nikaTa sahaja|
evaM erA ‘ivAdata kare AllAh ra parivarte emana kichura yAra samparke tini kona dalIla preraNa karena nAi evaM yAra samvandhe tAdera kona jJAna nei| Ara jAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

evaM edera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA hale tumi kAphiradera mukhamaNDale asantoSa lakSya karave| yArA edera nikaTa AmAra AYAta tilAoYAta kare tAderake erA AkramaNa karate udyata haYa| vala, ‘tave ki Ami tomAderake eTA apekSA manda kichura saMvAda diva?-eTA Aguna| ei viSaYe AllAh pratizruti diYechena kAphiraderake evaM eTA kata nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|’

he mAnuSa! ekaTi upamA deoYA hacche, manoyoga sahakAre tA zone kara: tomarA AllAh ra parivarte yAderake DAka tArA to kakhanao ekaTi mAchio sRSTi karate pArave nA, ei uddezye tArA sakale ekatra haleo| evaM mAchi yadi kichu chiniYe niYe yAYa tAdera nikaTa hate, eTAo tArA era nikaTa hate uddhAra karate pArave nA| ane¦Saka o ane¦Sita katai durvala;
erA AllAh ra yathocita maryAdA upalavdhi kare nA, AllAh nizcaYai kSamatAvAna, parAkramazAlI|
AllAh pherezatAdera madhya hate manonIta karena vANIvAhaka evaM mAnuSera madhya hateo; AllAh to sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|
tAdera sAmane o pazcAte yA kichu Ache tini tA jAnena evaM samasta viSaYa AllAh ra nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA ruka‚‘ kara, sijdA kara evaM tomAdera pratipAlakera ‘ivAdata kara o satkarma kara, yAte saphalakAma hate pAra|

evaM jihAda kara AllAh ra pathe yebhAve jihAda karA ucita| tini tomAderake manonIta karechena| tini dInera vyApAre tomAdera opara kona kaThoratA Aropa karena nAi| eTA tomAdera pitA ivrAhImera mila¬Ata| tini pUrve tomAdera nAmakaraNa karechena ‘musalima’ evaM ei kitAveo; yAte rAsUla tomAdera janye sAkSIsvarUpa haYa evaM tomarA sAkSIsvarUpa hao mAnava jAtira janye| sutarAM tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAhake avalamvana kara; tinii tomAdera abhibhAvaka, kata uttama abhibhAvaka evaM kata uttama sAhAyyakArI tini!
avazyai saphalakAma haYeche mu’minagaNa,
yArA vinaYa-namra nijedera sAlAte,
yArA asAra kriYAkalApa hate virata thAke,
yArA yAkAtadAne sakriYa,
yArA nijedera yauna aGgake saMyata rAkhe,
nijedera patnI vA adhikArabhukta dAsigaNa vyatIta, ete tArA nindanIYa have nA,
evaM keu ederake chAr3A anyake kAmanA karale tArA have sImAlaMghanakArI,
evaM yArA nijedera AmAnata o pratizruti rakSA kare,
evaM yArA nijedera sAlAtasamUhe yataèvAna thAke,
tArAi have adhikArI-
adhikArI have phiradAosera yAte erA sthAYI have|
Ami to mAnuSake sRSTi karechi mRttikAra upAdAna hate,
erapara Ami eke zukravindurUpe sthApana kari eka nirApada AdhAre;

pare Ami zukravinduke pariNata kari AlAka-e, erapara AlAkke pariNata kari piNDe evaM piNDake pariNata kari asthi-paJjare; erapara asthi-paJjarake DhAkiYA dei gozta diYe; avazeSe eke gar3e tuli anya eka sRSTirUpe| ataeva sarveAttama sraSTA AllAh kata mahAna!
eTAra para tomarA avazyai marave,
erapara kiYAmatera dina avazyai tomAderake utthita karA have|
Ami to tomAdera Urdhve sRSTi karechi saptastara evaM Ami sRSTi viSaYe asatarka nai,
evaM Ami AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kari parimitabhAve; erapara Ami tA mRttikAYa saMrakSaNa kari; Ami eke apasArita karateo sakSama|
erapara Ami tA diYe tomAdera janye kharjura o AMgurera vAgAna sRSTi kari; ete tomAdera janye Ache pracura phala; Ara tA hate tomarA AhAra kare thAka;
evaM sRSTi kari eka vRkSa yA janmAYa sinAi parvate, ete utpanna haYa taila evaM AhArakArIdera janye vyaJjana|
evaM tomAdera janye avazyai zikSaNIYa viSaYa Ache Ana‘Ama-e; tomAderake Ami pAna karAi edera udare yA Ache tA hate evaM ete tomAdera janye raYeche pracura upakAritA; tomarA tA hate AhAra kara,
evaM tomarA ete o nauyAne ArohaNao kare thAka|
Ami to nUhke pAThiYechilAma tAra sampradAYera nikaTa| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei, tavuo ki tomarA sAvadhAna have nA?’

tAra sampradAYera pradhAnarA, yArA kupharI karechila, tArA valala, ‘e to tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSai, tomAdera opara zreSThatva lAbha karate cAcche, AllAh icchA karale pherezatAi pAThAtena; AmarA to AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNera kAle eirUpa ghaTeche, ekathA zuni nAi|
‘e to emana loka yAke unmattatA peYe vaseche; sutarAM tomarA eTAra samparke kichukAla apekSA kara|’
nUh valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke sAhAyya kara, kAraNa erA AmAke mithyAvAdI valiteche|’

erapara Ami tAra nikaTa ohI pAThAlAma, ‘tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne o AmAra ohI anuyAYI nauyAna nirmANa kara, erapara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asave o ununa uthale uThave takhana uThiYe nio pratyeka jIvera eka eka jor3A evaM tomAra parivAra-parijanake, tAderake chAr3A tAdera madhye yAdera viruddhe pUrve siddhAnta haYeche| Ara tAdera samparke tumi AmAke kichu vala nA yArA juluma kareche| tArA to nimajjita have|
yakhana tumi o tomAra saGgIrA nauyAne Asana grahaNa karave takhana vala, ‘samasta prazaMsA AllAh ra i, yini AmAderake uddhAra karechena jAlima sampradAYa hate|’
Arao vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke emanabhAve avataraNa karAo yA have kalyANakara; Ara tumii zreSTha avataraNakArI|’
ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche| Ara Ami to ederake parIkSA karechilAma|
erapara tAdera pare anya eka sampradAYa sRSTi karechilAma;
evaM ederai ekajanake edera nikaTa rAsUla kare pAThiYechilAma! se valechila, ‘tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, tini vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh nei, tavuo ki tomarA sAvadhAna have nA?’

tAra sampradAYera pradhAnagaNa, yArA kupharI karechila o AkhirAtera sAkSAtkArake asvIkAra karechila evaM yAderake Ami diYechilAma pArthiva jIvane pracura bhogasambhAra, tArA valechila, ‘e to tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa; tomarA yA AhAra kara, se tAi AhAra kare evaM tomarA yA pAna kara, seo tAi pAna kare;
‘yadi tomarA tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya kara tave tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta have;
‘se ki tomAderake ei pratizrutii deYa ye, tomAdera mRtyu hale evaM tomarA mRttikA o asthite pariNata haleo tomAderake utthita karA have?
‘asambhava, tomAderake ye viSaYe pratizruti deoYA haYeche tA asambhava|
‘ekamAtra pArthiva jIvanai AmAdera jIvana, AmarA mari vA~ci ekhAnei evaM AmarA utthita hava nA|
‘se to emana vyakti ye AllAh samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kareche evaM AmarA tAke vizvAsa karAra nai|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke sAhAyya kara; kAraNa erA AmAke mithyAvAdI vale|’
AllAh valalena, ‘acire erA to anutapta have|’
erapara satya satyai eka vikaTa AoYAja ederake AghAta karala evaM Ami ederake taraGga-tAr3ita AvarjanAsadRza kare dilAma| sutarAM dhvaMsa haYe gela jAlima sampradAYa|
erapara tAdera pare Ami vahu jAti sRSTi karechi|
kona jAtii tAra nirdhArita kAlake tvarAnvita karate pAre nA, vilamvitao karate pAre nA|

erapara Ami ekera para eka AmAra rAsUla preraNa karechi| yakhanai kona jAtira nikaTa tAra rAsUla eseche takhanai erA tAke mithyAvAdI valeche| erapara Ami edera ekera para ekake dhvaMsa karalAma| Ami ederake kAhinIra viSaYa karechi| sutarAM dhvaMsa hoka avizvAsIrA!
erapara Ami AmAra nidarzana o suspaSTa pramANasaha mUsA o tAra bhAi hArUnake pAThAilAma,
phira‘Aona o tAra pAriSadavargera nikaTa| kintu erA ahaMkAra karala; erA chila uddhata sampradAYa|
erA valala, ‘AmarA ki emana dui vyaktite vizvAsa sthApana karava yArA AmAderai mata evaM yAdera sampradAYa AmAdera dAsatva kare?’
erapara erA tAderake asvIkAra karala, phale erA dhvaMsaprApta hala|
Ami to mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma yAte erA satpatha pAYa|
evaM Ami mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa o tAra jananIke karechilAma eka nidarzana, tAderake AzraYa diYechilAma eka nirApada o prasravaNaviziSTa ucca bhUmite|
‘he rAsUlagaNa! tomarA pavitra vastu hate AhAra kara o satkarma kara; tomarA yA kara se samvandhe Ami savizeSa avahita|
‘evaM tomAdera ei ye jAti eTA to ekai jAti evaM Amii tomAdera pratipAlaka; ataeva AmAke bhaYa kara|’
kintu tArA nijedera madhye tAdera dInake vahudhA vibhakta kareche| pratyeka dalai tAdera nikaTa yA Ache tA niYe Anandita|
sutarAM kichukAlera janye ederake svIYa vibhrAntite thAkate dAo|
erA ki mane kare ye, Ami ederake sAhAyyasvarUpa ye dhanaizvarya o santAna-santati dAna kari, tA diYe
edera janye sakala prakAra maGgala tvarAnvita karachi? nA, erA vujhe nA|
nizcaYa yArA tAdera pratipAlakera bhaYe santrasta,
yArA tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalIte ImAna Ane,
yArA tAdera pratipAlakera saGge zarIka kare nA,
evaM yArA tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa pratyAvartana karave ei vizvAse tAdera yA dAna karAra tA dAna kare bhIta-kampita hRdaYe,
tArAi druta sampAdana kare kalyANakara kAja evaM tArA ete agragAmI haYa|
Ami kAukeo tAra sAdhyAtIta dAYitva arpaNa kari nA evaM AmAra nikaTa Ache eka kitAva yA satya vyakta kare evaM edera prati juluma karA have nA|
varaM ei viSaYe edera antara ajJAnatAYa Acchanna, etadvyatIta tAdera Arao kAja Ache yA erA kare thAke|
Ara Ami yakhana edera aizvaryazAlI vyaktiderake zAsti diYe dhRta kari takhanai erA ArtanAda kare uThe|
tAderake valA have, ‘Aja ArtanAda kara nA, tomarA AmAra sAhAyya pAve nA|’
AmAra AYAta to tomAdera nikaTa AvRtti karA hata, kintu tomarA pichane phire sare par3ate-
dambhabhare, ei viSaYe arthahIna galpa-gujava karate karate|
tave ki erA ei vANI anudhAvana kare nA? vA edera nikaTa ki emana kichu eseche yA edera pUrvapuruSadera nikaTa Ase nAi?
athavA erA ki edera rAsUlake cine nA vale tAke asvIkAra kare?
athavA erA ki vale ye, se unmAdanAgrasta, vastuta se edera nikaTa satya eneche evaM edera adhikAMza satyake apachanda kare|

satya yadi edera kAmanA-vAsanAra anugAmI hata tave vizRMkhala haYe par3ata AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI evaM edera madhyavartI samasta kichui| pakSAntare Ami ederake diYechi upadeza, kintu erA upadeza hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
athavA tumi ki edera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAo? tomAra pratipAlakera pratidAnai zreSTha evaM tinii zreSTha riyikadAtA|
tumi to ederake sarala pathe AhvAna karacho|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tArA to sarala patha hate vicyuta,
Ami ederake daYA karaleo evaM edera duHkha-dainya dUra karaleo erA avAdhyatAYa vibhrAntera nyAYa ghurite thAkave|
Ami to ederake zAsti diYe dhRta karalAma, kintu erA edera pratipAlakera prati vinata hala nA evaM kAtara prArthanAo kare nA|
avazeSe yakhana Ami edera janye kaThina zAstira duYAra khule dei takhanai erA ete hatAza haYe par3e|
tinii tomAdera janye karNa, cokha o antaHkaraNa sRSTi karechena; tomarA alpai kRtajJatA prakAza kare thAka|
tinii tomAderake pRthivIte vistRta karechena evaM tomAderake tA~rai nikaTa ekatra karA have|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna evaM tA~rai adhikAre rAtri o divasera parivartana| tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?
etadasattveo erA vale, yemana valechila pUrvavartIrA|
erA vale, ‘AmAdera mRtyu ghaTale o AmarA mRttikA o asthite pariNata haleo ki AmarA utthita hava?
‘AmAderake to ei viSaYei pratizruti pradAna karA haYeche evaM atIte AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNakeo| eTA to se kAlera upakathA vyatIta Ara kichui naYa|’
jijJAsA kara, ‘ei pRthivI evaM ete yArA Ache tArA kAra, yadi tomarA jAna?’
erA valave, ‘AllAh ra ’| vala, ‘tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?’
jijJAsA kara, ‘ke sapta AkAza evaM mahA‘rAzera adhipati?’
erA valave, ‘AllAh’| vala, ‘tavuo ki tomarA sAvadhAna have nA?’
jijJAsA kara, ‘sakala kichura kartRtva kAra hAte, yini AzraYa dAna karena evaM yA~hAra opara AzraYadAtA nei, yadi tomarA jAna?’
erA valave, ‘AllAh ra ’| vala, ‘tavuo tomarA kemana kare mohagrasta hatecha?’
varaM Ami to edera nikaTa satya peৗ~chechi; kintu erA to nizcita mithyAvAdI|

AllAh kona santAna grahaNa karena nAi evaM tA~ra saGge apara kona ilAh nei; yadi thAkata tave pratyeka ilAh svIYa sRSTi niYe pRthaka haYe yeta evaM eke aparera opara prAdhAnya vistAra karata| erA yA vale tA hate AllAh kata pavitra!
tini dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtA, erA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|
vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ye viSaYe tAderake pratizruti pradAna karA hacche, tumi yadi tA AmAke dekhete cAo,
‘tave, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke jAlima sampradAYera antarbhukta kara nA|’
Ami tAderake ye viSaYe pratizruti pradAna karachi Ami tA tomAke dekhete avazyai sakSama|
mandera mukAvilA kara yA uttama tA diYe; erA yA vale Ami se samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
vala, ‘he AmAra prati-pAlaka! Ami tomAra AzraYa prArthanA kari zaYatAnera prarocanA hate,
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami tomAra AzraYa prArthanA kari AmAra nikaTa edera upasthiti hate|’
yakhana edera kArao mRtyu upasthita haYa takhana se vale, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke punarAYa preraNa kara,
‘yAte Ami satkarma karate pAri yA Ami pUrve kari nAi|’ nA, eTA haoYAra naYa| eTA to era ekaTi ukti mAtra| edera sAmane vArayAkha thAkave utthAna divasa paryanta|
evaM yedina ziMgAYa phutkAra deoYA have sedina parasparera madhye AtmIYatAra vandhana thAkave nA, evaM eke aparera kheA~ja-khavara nive nA,
evaM yAdera pAllA bhArI have tArAi have saphalakAma,
evaM yAdera pAllA hAlakA have tArAi nijedera kSati kareche; erA jAhAnnAme sthAYI have|
agni edera mukhamaNDala dagdha karave evaM erA sekhAne thAkave vIbhatsa cehArAYa;
tomAdera nikaTa ki AmAra AYAtasamUha AvRtti karA hata nA? athaca tomarA sei sakala asvIkAra karate|
erA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! durbhAgya AmAderake peYe vasechila evaM AmarA chilAma eka vibhrAnta sampradAYa;
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ei agni hate AmAderake uddhAra kara; erapara AmarA yadi punarAYa kupharI kari tave to AmarA avazyai sImAlaMghanakArI hava|’
AllAh valavena, ‘torA hIna avasthAYa ekhAne thAk evaM AmAra saGge kona kathA valis nA|’
AmAra vAndAgaNera madhye ekadala chila yArA valata, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi, tumi AmAderake kSamA kara o daYA kara, tumi to sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’
‘kintu tAderake niYe tomarA eto ThATTA-vidrupa karate ye, tA tomAderake AmAra kathA bhuliYe diYechila| tomarA to tAderake niYe hAsi-ThATTAi karate|’
‘Ami Aja tAderake tAdera dhairyera kAraNe emanabhAve puraskRta karalAma ye, tArAi hala saphalakAma|’
AllAh valavena, ‘tomarA pRthivIte kata vatsara avasthAna karechile?’
erA valave, ‘AmarA avasthAna karechilAma ekadina vA dinera kichu aMza; Apani nA haYa, gaNanAkArIderake jijJAsA karuna|’
tini valavena, ‘tomarA alpa kAlai avasthAna karechile, yadi tomarA jAnate!
‘tomarA ki mane karechile ye, Ami tomAderake anarthaka sRSTi karechi evaM tomarA AmAra nikaTa pratyAvartita have nA?’
mahimAnvita AllAh yini prakRta mAlika, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei; sammAnita rAzera tini adhipati|
ye vyakti AllAh ra saGge DAke anya ilAhke, ei viSaYe tAra nikaTa kona sanada nei; tAra hiseva tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache; nizcaYai kAphirarA saphalakAma have nA|
vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! kSamA kara o daYA kara, tumii to sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’
eTA ekaTi sUrA, eTA Ami avatIrNa karechi evaM eTAra vidhAna-ke avazyapAlanIYa karechi, ete Ami avatIrNa karechi suspaSTa AYAtasamUha yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

vyabhicAriNI o vyabhicArI-edera pratyekake eka zata kazAghAta karave, AllAh ra vidhAna kAryakarIkaraNe edera prati daYA yena tomAderake prabhAvAnvita nA kare, yadi tomarA AllAhe evaM parakAle vizvAsI hao; mu’minadera ekaTi dala yena edera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI-vyabhicAriNIke vA muzarika nArIke vyatIta vivAha kare nA evaM vyabhicAriNI-tAke vyabhicArI vA muzarika vyatIta keu vivAha kare nA, mu’minadera janye eTA niSiddha karA haYeche|
yArA sAdhvI ramaNIra prati apavAda Aropa kare evaM cArajana sAkSI upasthita kare nA, tAderake AziTi kazAghAta karave evaM kakhanao tAdera sAkSya grahaNa karave nA; erAi to satyatyAgI|
tave yadi eTAra para erA taovA kare o nijederake saMzodhana kare, AllAh to atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

evaM yArA nijedera strIra prati apavAda Aropa kare athaca nijerA vyatIta tAdera kona sAkSI nei, tAdera pratyekera sAkSya ei have ye, se AllAh ra nAme cAravAra zapatha kare valave ye, se avazyai satyavAdI,
evaM paJcamavAre valave ye, se mithyAvAdI hale tAra opara neme Asave AllAhara lA‘nata|
tave strIra zAsti rahita have yadi se cAravAra AllAh ra nAme zapatha kare sAkSya deYa ye, tAra svAmIi mithyAvAdI,
evaM paJcamavAre vale ye, tAra svAmI satyavAdI hale tAra nijera opara neme Asave AllAh ra gayava|
tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha o daYA nA thAkale tomAdera keui avyAhati pete nA; evaM AllAh taovA grahaNakArI o prajJAmaYa|

yArA ei apavAda racanA kareche tArA to tomAderai ekaTi dala; eTAke tomarA tomAdera janye aniSTakara mane kara nA; varaM eTA to tomAdera janye kalyANakara; edera pratyekera janye Ache edera kRta pApakarmera phala evaM edera madhye ye ei vyApAre pradhAna bhUmikA grahaNa kareche, tAra janye Ache mahAzAsti|
yakhana tArA eTA zunala takhana mu’mina puruSa evaM mu’mina nArIgaNa Apana lokadera samparke kena bhAla dhAraNA karala nA evaM valala nA, ‘eTA to suspaSTa apavAda!’
tArA kena ei vyApAre cArajana sAkSI upasthita kare nAi? yehetu tArA sAkSI upasthita kare nAi, se kAraNe tArA AllAh ra nikaTa mithyAvAdI|
duniYA o AkhirAte tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha o daYA nA thAkale, tomarA yAte lipta chile tAra janye mahAzAsti avazyai tomAderake sparza karata,

yakhana tomarA mukhe mukhe eTA char3Acchile evaM emana viSaYa mukhe uccAraNa karachile yAra kona jJAna tomAdera chila nA evaM tomarA eTAke tuccha gaNya karechile, yadio AllAh ra nikaTa eTA chila gurutara viSaYa|
evaM tomarA yakhana eTA zunale takhana kena valale nA, ‘e viSaYe valAvali karA AmAdera ucita naYa; AllAh pavitra, mahAna| eTA to eka gurutara apavAda!’
AllAh tomAderake upadeza dicchena, ‘tomarA yadi mu’mina hao tave kakhanao anurUpa AcaraNera punarAvRtti kara nA|’
AllAh tomAdera janye AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAve vivRta karena evaM AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
yArA mu’minadera madhye azlIlatAra prasAra kAmanA kare tAdera janye Ache duniYA o AkhirAtera marmantuda zAsti evaM AllAh jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|
tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha o daYA nA thAkale tomAdera keui avyAhati pete nA evaM AllAh daYArdra o parama daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA zaYatAnera padAMka anusaraNa kara nA| keu zaYatAnera padAMka anusaraNa karale zaYatAna to azlIlatA o manda kAjera nirdeza deYa| AllAh ra anugraha o daYA nA thAkale tomAdera keui kakhanao pavitra hate pArate nA, tave AllAh yAke icchA pavitra kare thAkena evaM AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

tomAdera madhye yArA aizvarya o prAcuryera adhikArI tArA yena zapatha grahaNa nA kare ye, tArA AtmIYa-svajana o abhAvagrastake evaM AllAh ra rAstAYa yArA hijarata kareche tAderake kichui dive nA; tArA yena ederake kSamA kare evaM edera doSatruTi upekSA kare| tomarA ki cAo nA ye, AllAh tomAderake kSamA karuna? evaM AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA sAdhvI, saralamanA o ImAnadAra nArIra prati apavAda Aropa kare tArA duniYA o AkhirAte abhizapta evaM tAdera janye Ache mahAzAsti|
yei dina tAdera viruddhe sAkSya dive tAdera jihvA, tAdera hasta o tAdera caraNa tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe-
sei dina AllAh tAdera prApya pratiphala puropuri divena evaM tArA jAnive, AllAhi satya, spaSTa prakAzaka|

duzcaritrA nArI duzcaritra puruSera janye; duzcaritra puruSa duzcaritrA nArIra janye; saccaritrA nArI saccaritra puruSera janye evaM saccaritra puruSa saccaritrA nArIra janye| loke yA vale erA tA hate pavitra; edera janye Ache kSamA evaM sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA nijedera gRha vyatIta anya kArao gRhe gRhavAsIdera anumati nA niYe evaM tAderake sAlAma nA kare praveza kara nA| eTAi tomAdera janye zreYa, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

yadi tomarA gRhe kAukeo nA pAo tA hale ete praveza karave nA yatakSaNa nA tomAderake anumati deoYA haYa| yadi tomAderake valA haYa, ‘phire yAo’, tave tomarA phire yAve, eTAi tomAdera janye uttama, evaM tomarA yA kara se samvandhe AllAh savizeSa avahita|
ye gRhe keu vAsa kare nA tAte tomAdera janye dravyasAmagrI thAkale sekhAne tomAdera praveze konao pApa nei evaM AllAh jAnena yA tomarA prakAza kara evaM yA tomarA gopana kara|
mu’minaderake vala, tArA yena tAdera dRSTike saMyata kare evaM tAdera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyata kare; eTAi tAdera janye uttama| erA yA kare nizcaYa AllAh se viSaYe samyaka avahita|

Ara mu’mina nArIderake vala, tArA yena tAdera dRSTike saMyata kare o tAdera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyata kare; tArA yena yA sAdhAraNata prakAza thAke tA vyatIta tAdera AbharaNa pradarzana nA kare, tAdera grIvA o vakSadeza yena mAthAra kApar3a diYe AvRta kare, tArA yena tAdera svAmI, pitA, zvazura, putra, svAmIra putra, bhAi, bhrAtuSputra, bhagniputra, Apana nArIgaNa, tAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsI, puruSadera madhye yauna kAmanA-rahita puruSa evaM nArIdera gopana aGga samvandhe ajJa vAlaka vyatIta kArao nikaTa tAdera AbharaNa prakAza nA kare, tArA yena tAdera gopana AbharaNa prakAzera uddezye sajore padakSepa nA kare| he mu’minagaNa! tomarA sakale AllAh ra dike pratyAvartana kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

tomAdera madhye yArA ‘AYyima’ tAdera vivAha sampAdana kara evaM tomAdera dAsa o dAsIdera madhye yArA sat tAderao| tArA abhAvagrasta hale AllAh nija anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta kare divena; AllAh to prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yAdera vivAhera sAmarthya nei, AllAh tAderake nija anugrahe abhAvamukta nA karA paryanta tArA yena saMyama avalamvana kare evaM tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa-dAsIdera madhye keu tAra muktira janye likhita cukti cAile, tAdera saGge cuktite Avaddha hao, yadi tomarA edera madhye maGgalera sandhAna pAo| AllAh tomAderake ye sampada diYechena tA hate tomarA ederake dAna karave| tomAdera dAsigaNa, satItva rakSA karate cAile pArthiva jIvanera dhanalAlasAYa tAderake vyabhicAriNI hate vAdhya kara nA, Ara ye tAderake vAdhya kare, tave tAdera opara javaradastira para AllAh to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ami to tomAdera nikaTa avatIrNa karechi suspaSTa AYAta, tomAdera pUrvavartIdera dRSTAnta evaM muttAkIdera janye upadeza|

AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra jyoti, tA~ra jyotira upamA yena ekaTi dIpAdhAra yAra madhye Ache eka pradIpa, pradIpaTi ekaTi kAcera AvaraNera madhye sthApita, kAcera AvaraNaTi ujjvala nakSatrasadRza; eTA prajvalita karA haYa pUta-pavitra yAYatUna vRkSera taila diYe yA prAcyera naYa, pratIcyerao naYa, agni eke sparza nA karaleo yena era taila ujjvala Alo diteche; jyotira opara jyoti! AllAh yAke icchA pathanirdeza karena tA~ra jyotira dike| AllAh mAnuSera janye upamA diYe thAkena evaM AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|
se sakala gRhe yAke samunnata karate evaM yAte tA~ra nAma smaraNa karate AllAh nirdeza diYechena, sakAla o sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare,

sesava loka, yAderake vyavasA-vANijya evaM kraYa-vikraYa AllAh ra smaraNa hate evaM sAlAta kAYema o yAkAta pradAna hate virata rAkhe nA, tArA bhaYa kare sei dinake yei dina aneka antara o dRSTi viparyasta haYe par3ave-
yAte tArA ye karma kare tAra janye AllAh tAderake uttama puraskAra dena evaM nija anugrahe tAdera prApyera adhika dena| AllAh yAke icchA aparimita jIvikA dAna karena|

yArA kupharI kare tAdera karma marubhUmira marIcikAsadRza, pipAsArta yAke pAni mane kare thAke, kintu se era nikaTa upasthita hale dekhave tA kichu naYa evaM se pAve sekhAne AllAhke, erapara tini tAra karmaphala pUrNa mAtrAYa divena| AllAh hiseva grahaNe tatpara|

athavA tAdera karma gabhIra samudra talera andhakAra sadRza, yAke Acchanna kare taraGgera opara taraGga, yAra Urdhve meghapuJja, andhakArapuJja starera opara stara, emanaki se hAta vera karale tA Adau dekhate pAve nA| AllAha yAke jyoti dAna karena nA tAra janye kona jyotii nei|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yArA Ache tArA evaM uDDIYamAna vihaGgakula AllAh ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare? pratyekei jAne tAra ‘ivAdatera o pavitratA ghoSaNAra paddhati evaM erA yA kare se viSaYe AllAh samyaka avagata|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva AllAh ra i evaM AllAh ra i dike pratyAvartana|

tumi ki dekha nA, AllAh saJcAlita karena meghamAlAke, tatpara tAderake ekatra karena evaM pare puJjIbhUta karena, erapara tumi dekhate pAo, era madhya hate nirgata haYa vAridhArA; AkAzasthita zilAstUpa hate tini varSaNa karena zilA evaM eTA diYe tini yAke icchA AghAta karena evaM yAke icchA tAra opara hate eTA anya dike phiriYe dena| meghera vidyut jhalaka dRSTizakti prAYa ker3e neYa|
AllAh divasa o rAtrira parivartana ghaTAna, ete zikSA raYeche antardRSTisampannadera janye|

AllAh samasta jIva sRSTi karechena pAni hate, edera kataka peTe bhara diYe cale, kataka dui pAYe cale evaM kataka cale cAra pAYe, AllAh yA icchA sRSTi karena, nizcaYa AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
Ami to suspaSTa nidarzana avatIrNa karechi, AllAh yAke icchA sarala saThika patha pradarzana karena|
erA vale, ‘AmarA AllAh o rAsUlera prati ImAna AnalAma evaM AmarA Anugatya svIkAra karalAma’, kintu eTAra para edera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa; vastuta erA mu’mina naYa|
evaM yakhana ederake AhvAna karA haYa AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera dike edera madhye phaYasAlA kare divAra janye takhana edera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ara yadi edera prApya thAke tA hale erA vinItabhAve rAsUlera nikaTa chuTe Ase|
edera antare ki vyAdhi Ache, nA erA saMzaYa poSaNa kare? nA erA bhaYa kare ye, AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla edera prati juluma karavena? varaM erAi to jAlima|

mu’minadera ukti to ei-yakhana tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare divAra janye AllAh evaM tA~ra rAsUlera dike AhvAna karA haYa takhana tArA vale, ‘AmarA zunalAma o Anugatya karalAma|’ Ara erAi to saphalakAma|
yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare, AllAhke bhaYa kare o tA~ra avAdhyatA hate sAvadhAna thAke tArAi saphalakAma|

erA dRr3habhAve AllAh ra zapatha kare vale ye, tumi ederake Adeza karale erA avazyai vera have; tumi vala, ‘zapatha kara nA, yathArtha Anugatyai kAmya| tomarA yA kara nizcaYai AllAh se viSaYe savizeSa avahita|’

vala, ‘AllAh ra Anugatya kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara|’ erapara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe lao, tave tAra opara arpita dAYitvera janye se-i dAYI evaM tomAdera opara arpita dAYitvera janye tomarAi dAYI; evaM tomarA tAra Anugatya karale satpatha pAve, Ara rAsUlera kAja to kevala spaSTabhAve peৗ~che deoYA|

tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare AllAh tAderake pratizruti dicchena ye, tini avazyai tAderake pRthivIte pratinidhitva dAna karavena, yemana tini pratinidhitva dAna karechilena tAdera pUrvavartIderake evaM tini avazyai tAdera janye pratiSThita karavena tAdera dInake yA tini tAdera janye pachanda karechena evaM tAdera bhaYabhItira parivarte tAderake avazya nirApattA dAna karavena| tArA AmAra ‘ivAdata karave, AmAra kona zarIka karave nA, erapara yArA akRtajJa have tArA to satyatyAgI|
tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yAte tomarA anugrahabhAjana hate pAra|
tumi kAphiraderake pRthivIte kakhano pravala mane kara nA| edera AzraYasthala doyakha; kata nikRSTa ei pariNAma!

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa-dAsigaNa evaM tomAdera madhye yArA vaYaHprApta haYa nAi tArA yena tomAdera kakSe praveza karate tina samaYera anumati grahaNa kare, phajarera sAlAtera pUrve, dviprahare yakhana tomarA tomAdera pozAka khule rAkha takhana evaM ‘izAra sAlAtera para; ei tina samaYa tomAdera gopanIYatAra samaYa| ei tina samaYa vyatIta anya samaYe vinA anumatite praveza karale tomAdera janye evaM tAdera janye kona doSa nei| tomAdera eka-ke aparera nikaTa to yAtAYAta karatei haYa| eibhAve AllAh tomAdera nikaTa tA~ra nirdeza suspaSTabhAve vivRta karena| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tomAdera santAna-santati vaYaHprApta hale tArAo yena anumati prArthanA kare yemana anumati prArthanA kare thAke tAdera vaYojyeSThagaNa| eibhAve AllAh tomAdera janye tA~ra nirdeza suspaSTabhAve vivRta karena, AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

vRddhA nArI, yArA vivAhera AzA rAkhe nA, tAdera janye aparAdha nei, yadi tArA tAdera saundarya pradarzana nA kare tAdera vahirvAsa khule rAkhe; tave eTA hate tAdera virata thAkAi tAdera janye uttama| AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

andhera janye doSa nAi, khaJjera janye doSa nAi, rugnera janye doSa nAi evaM tomAdera nijedera janyeo doSa nAi AhAra karA tomAdera gRhe vA tomAdera pitRgaNera gRhe, mAtRgaNera gRhe, bhrAtRgaNera gRhe, bhagnigaNera gRhe, pitRvyadera gRhe, phuphudera gRhe, mAtuladera gRhe, khAlAdera gRhe vA seisava gRhe yAra cAvira mAlika tomarA vA tomAdera vandhudera gRhe| tomarA ekatre AhAra kara vA pRthaka pRthakabhAve AhAra kara tAte tomAdera janye kona aparAdha nei| tave yakhana tomarA gRhe praveza karave takhana tomarA tomAdera svajanadera prati sAlAma karave abhivAdanasvarUpa yA AllAh ra nikaTa hate kalyANamaYa o pavitra| eibhAve AllAh tomAdera janye tA~ra nirdeza vizadabhAve vivRta karena yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

mu’mina to tArAi yArA AllAh evaM tA~ra rAsUle ImAna Ane evaM rAsUlera saGge samaSTigata vyApAre ekatra hale tArA anumati vyatIta sare par3e nA; yArA tomAra anumati prArthanA kare tArAi AllAh evaM tA~ra rAsUle vizvAsI| ataeva tArA tAdera kona kAje vAhire yAvAra janye tomAra anumati cAile tAdera madhye yAderake icchA tumi anumati dio evaM tAdera janye AllAh ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara| nizcaYa AllAh parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

rAsUlera AhvAnake tomarA tomAdera eke aparera prati AhvAnera mata gaNya kara nA; tomAdera madhye yArA alakSye sare par3e AllAh to tAderake jAnena| sutarAM yArA tA~ra Adezera viruddhAcaraNa kare tArA satarka hoka ye, viparyaYa tAdera opara Apatita have vA Apatita have tAdera opara marmantuda zAsti|

jene rAkha, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA AllAh ra i; tomarA yAte vyApRta tini tA jAnena| yedina tArA tA~ra nikaTa pratyAvartita have sedina tini tAderake jAniYe divena tArA yA karata| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|
kata mahAna tini yini tA~ra vAndAra prati phurakAna avatIrNa karechena yAte se vizvajagatera janye satarkakArI hate pAre!

yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatvera adhikArI; tini kona santAna grahaNa karena nAi; sArvabhaumatve tA~ra kona zarIka nAi| tini samasta kichu sRSTi karechena evaM pratyekake parimita karechena yathAyatha anupAte|

Ara tArA tA~ra parivarte ilAha rUpe grahaNa kareche anyaderake, yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA, varaM erA nijerAi sRSTa evaM erA nijedera apakAra vA upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM mRtyu, jIvana o utthAnera oparao kona kSamatA rAkhe nA|
kAphirarA vale, ‘eTA mithyA vyatIta kichui naYa, se eTA udbhAvana kareche evaM bhinna sampradAYera loka tAke ei vyApAre sAhAyya kareche|’ eirUpe erA avazyai juluma o mithyAYa upanIta haYeche|
erA vale, ‘eiguli to sekAlera upakathA, yA se likheYe niYeche; eiguli sakAla-sandhyA tAra nikaTa pATha karA haYa|’
vala, ‘eTA tinii avatIrNa karechena yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra samudaYa rahasya avagata Achena; nizcaYai tini parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
erA vale, ‘e kemana rAsUla’ ye AhAra kare evaM hATe-vAjAre calApherA kare; tAra nikaTa kona pherezatA kena avatIrNa karA hala nA, ye tAra saGge thAkata satarkakArIrUpe?’

athavA tAke dhanabhANDAra deoYA haYa nA kena vA tAra ekaTi vAgAna nAi kena, yA hate se AhAra saMgraha karate pAre?’ sImAlaMghanakArIrA Arao vale, ‘tomarA to eka jAdugrasta vyaktirai anusaraNa karacho|’
dekha, erA tomAra kI upamA deYa! erA pathabhraSTa haYeche, phale erA patha pAve nA|
kata mahAna tini yini icchA karale tomAke dite pArena eTA apekSA utkRSTa vastu-udyAnasamUha yAra nimnadeze nadI-nAlA pravAhita evaM tini dite pArena tomAke prAsAdasamUha!
kintu erA kiYAmatake asvIkAra kareche evaM ye kiYAmatake asvIkAra kare tAra janye Ami prastuta rekhechi jvalanta agni|
dUra hate agni yakhana ederake dekhave takhana erA zunate pAve eTAra kruddha garjana o cItkAra;
evaM yakhana ederake zRMkhalita avasthAYa era kona saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have takhana erA sekhAne dhvaMsa kAmanA karave|
ederake valA have, ‘Aja tomarA ekavArera janye dhvaMsa kAmanA kara nA, vahuvAra dhvaMsa haoYAra kAmanA karate thAka|’
ederake jijJAsA kara, ‘eTAi zreYa, nA sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra pratizruti deoYA haYeche muttAkIderake?’ eTAi to tAdera puraskAra o pratyAvartanasthala|
sekhAne tArA yA cAive tAdera janye tAi thAkave evaM tArA sthAYI have; ei pratizruti pUraNa tomAra pratipAlakerai dAYitva|

evaM yedina tini ekatra karavena ederake evaM erA AllAh ra parivarte yAdera ‘ivAdata karata tAderake, sedina tini jijJAsA karavena, ‘tomarAi ki AmAra ei vAndAderake vibhrAnta karechile, nA erA nijerAi pathabhraSTa haYechila?’

erA valave, ‘pavitra o mahAna tumi! tomAra parivarte AmarA anyake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karate pAri nA; tumii to ederake evaM edera pitRpuruSaderake bhogasambhAra diYechile; pariNAme erA upadeza vismRta haYechila evaM pariNata haYechila eka dhvaMsaprApta jAtite|

AllAh muzarikaderake valavena, ‘tomarA yA valate erA tA mithyA sAvyasta kareche| sutarAM tomarA zAsti pratirodha karate pArave nA evaM sAhAyyao pAve nA| tomAdera madhye ye sImAlaMghana karave Ami tAke mahAzAsti AsvAda karAva|’

tomAra pUrve Ami ye sakala rAsUla preraNa karechi tArA sakalei to AhAra karata o hATe vAjAre calApherA karata| he mAnuSa! Ami tomAdera madhye eka-ke aparera janye parIkSAsvarUpa karechi| tomarA dhairya dhAraNa karave ki? tomAra pratipAlaka samasta kichu dekhena|

yArA AmAra sAkSAt kAmanA kare nA tArA vale, ‘AmAdera nikaTa phirizatA avatIrNa karA haYa nA kena? vA AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakake pratyakSa kari nA kena? erA to edera antare ahaMkAra poSaNa kare evaM erA sImAlaMghana kareche gurutararUpe|
yedina erA pherezatAderake pratyakSa karave sedina aparAdhIdera janye susaMvAda thAkave nA evaM erA valave, ‘rakSA kara, rakSA kara|’
Ami edera kRtakarmera prati lakSya karava, erapara segulike vikSipta dhUlikaNAYa pariNata karava|
sei dina have jAnnAtavAsIdera vAsasthAna utkRSTa evaM vizrAmasthala manorama|
Ara sedina AkAza meghapuJjasaha vidIrNa have evaM phirizatAderake nAmiYe deYA have-
sedina kartRtva have vastuta daYAmaYera evaM kAphiradera janye sedina have kaThina|
jAlima vyakti sedina nija hastadvaYa daMzana karate karate valave, ‘hAYa, Ami yadi rAsUlera saGge satpatha avalamvana karatAma!
‘hAYa, durbheAga AmAra, Ami yadi amukake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA karatAma!
‘AmAke to se vibhrAnta karechila AmAra nikaTa upadeza peৗ~chivAra para|’ zaYatAna to mAnuSera janye mahApratAraka|
rAsUla valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra sampradAYa to ei kuraAnake parityAjya mane kare|’
AllAh valena, eibhAvei pratyeka navIra zatru karechilAma Ami aparAdhIderake| tomAra janye tomAra pratipAlakai pathapradarzaka o sAhAyyakArIrUpe yatheSTa|’
kAphirarA vale, ‘samagra kuraAna tAra nikaTa ekavAra avatIrNa hala nA kena? eibhAvei Ami avatIrNa karechi tomAra hRdaYake tA diYe mayavuta karAra janye evaM tA krame krame spaSTabhAve AvRtti karechi|
erA tomAra nikaTa emana kona samasyA upasthita kare nA, yAra saThika samAdhAna o sundara vyAkhyA Ami tomAke dAna kari nA|
yAderake mukhe bhara diYe calA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike ekatra karA have, erA sthAnera dika diYe ati nikRSTa evaM adhika pathabhraSTa|
Ami to mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma evaM tAra saGge tAra bhAi hArUnake sAhAyyakArI karechilAma,
evaM valechilAma, ‘tomarA sei sampradAYera nikaTa yAo yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra kareche|’ erapara Ami ederake sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta karechilAma|

evaM nUhera sampradAYakeo, yakhana tArA rAsUlagaNera prati mithyA Aropa karala takhana Ami ederake nimajjita karalAma evaM ederake mAnavajAtira janye nidarzanasvarUpa kare rAkhalAma| jAlimadera janye Ami marmantuda zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma ‘Ada, sAmUda o ‘rAs’-era adhivAsIke evaM edera antarvartIkAlera vahu sampradAYakeo|
Ami edera pratyekera janye dRSTAnta varNanA karechilAma, Ara edera sakalakei Ami sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa karechilAma|
erA to sei janapada diYei yAtAYAta kare yAra opara varSita haYechila akalyANera vRSTi, tave ki erA eTA pratyakSa kare nA? vastuta erA punarutthAnera AzaMkA kare nA|
erA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana erA tomAke kevala ThATTA-vidrupera pAtrarUpe gaNya kare evaM vale, ‘ei-i ki se, yAke AllAh rAsUla kare pAThiYechena?
‘se to AmAderake AmAdera devatAgaNa hate dUre sarAiYAi dita, yadi nA AmarA tAdera Anugatye dRr3ha pratiSThita thAkatAma| yakhana erA zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana erA jAnave ke adhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki dekha nA tAke, ye tAra kAmanA-vAsanAke ilAha rUpe grahaNa kare? tavuo ki tumi tAra karmavidhAYaka have?
tumi ki mane kara ye, edera adhikAMza zune o vujhe? erA to pazura matai; varaM erA adhika pathabhraSTa!
tumi ki tomAra pratipAlakera prati lakSya kara nA kibhAve tini chAYA samprasArita karena? tini icchA karale eTAke to sthira rAkhate pAratena; anantara Ami sUryake karechi eTAra nirdezaka|
erapara Ami eTAke AmAra dike dhIre dhIre guTiYe Ani|
evaM tinii tomAdera janye rAtrike karechena AvaraNasvarUpa, vizrAmera janye tomAdera diYechena nidrA evaM samutthAnera janye diYechena divasa|
tinii svIYa anugrahera prAkkAle susaMvAdavAhIrUpe vAYu preraNa karena evaM Ami AkAza hate vizuddha pAni varSaNa kari-
yA diYe Ami mRta bha‚khaNDake saJjIvita kari evaM AmAra sRSTira madhye vahu jIvajantu o mAnuSake tA pAna karAi,
evaM Ami to ei pAni edera madhye vitaraNa kari yAte erA smaraNa kare| kintu adhikAMza loka kevala akRtajJatAi prakAza kare|
Ami icchA karale pratiTi janapade ekajana satarkakArI preraNa karate pAratAma|
sutarAM tumi kAphiradera Anugatya kara nA evaM tumi kuraAnera sAhAyye edera saGge pravala saMgrAma cAliYe yAo|
tinii dui dariYAke militabhAve pravAhita karechena, ekaTi miSTa, supeYa evaM aparaTi lonA, khara; ubhaYera madhye rekhe diYechena eka antarAYa, eka anatikramya vyavadhAna|
evaM tinii mAnuSake sRSTi karechena pAni hate; erapara tini tAra vaMzagata o vaivAhika samvandha sthApana karechena| tomAra pratipAlaka sarvazaktimAna|
erA AllAh ra parivarte emana kichura ‘ivAdata kare yA ederake upakAra karate pAre nA evaM edera apakArao karate pAre nA, kAphira to svIYa pratipAlakera virodhI|
Ami to tomAke kevala susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei preraNa karechi|
vala, ‘Ami tomAdera nikaTa eTAra janye kona pratidAna cAhi nA, tave ye icchA kare se tAra pratipAlakera dikera patha avalamvana karuka|’
tumi nirbhara kara tA~ra opara yini ciraJjIva, yini marivena nA evaM tA~ra saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara, tini tA~ra vAndAdera pApa samparke samyaka avahita|
tini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o edera madhyavartI samasta kichu chaYa divase sRSTi karena; erapara tini rAze samAsIna hana| tinii ‘rAhamAna’, tA~ra samvandhe ye avagata Ache, tAke jijJAsA kare dekha|
yakhana ederake valA haYa, ‘sijdAvanata hao ‘rAhmAna’era prati’, takhana erA vale, ‘rAhamAna AvAra ke? tumi kAukeo sijdA karate valalena ki AmarA tAke sijdA karava?’ ete edera vimukhatAi vRddhi pAYa|
kata mahAna tini yini nabhomaNDale sRSTi karechena rAzicakra evaM ete sthApana karechena pradIpa o jyotirmaYa candra|
tinii sRSTi karechena rAtri evaM divasake parasparera anugAmIrUpe tAra janye-ye upadeza grahaNa karate o kRtajJa hate cAYa|
‘rahamAna’-era vAndA tArAi, yArA pRthivIte namrabhAve calApherA kare evaM tAderake yakhana ajJa vyaktirA samvodhana kare, takhana tArA vale, ‘sAlAma’;
evaM tArA rAtri ativAhita kare tAdera pratipAlakera uddezye sijdAvanata haYe o daNDAYamAna theke;
evaM tArA vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera hate jAhAnnAmera zAsti vidUrita kara, era zAsti to nizcita vinAza,’
nizcaYai tA asthAYI o sthAYI AvAsa hiseve nikRSTa|
evaM yakhana tArA vyaYa kare takhana apavyaYa kare nA, kArpaNyao kare nA, varaM tArA Ache etadubhaYera mAjhe madhyama panthAYa|
evaM tArA AllAh ra saGge kona ilAhke DAke nA| AllAh yAra hatyA niSedha karechena, yathArtha kAraNa vyatireke tAke hatyA kare nA evaM vyabhicAra kare nA| ye eiguli kare se zAsti bhoga karave|
kiYAmatera dina era zAsti dviguNa karA have evaM sekhAne se sthAYI have hIna avasthAYa;
tArA naYa, yArA taovA kare, ImAna Ane o satkarma kare| AllAh edera pApa parivartana kare divena puNyera diYe| AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ye vyakti taovA kare o satkarma kare se sampUrNarUpe AllAh ra abhimukhI haYa|
evaM yArA mithyA sAkSya deYa nA evaM asAra kriYAkalApera sammukhIna hale svIYa maryAdAra saGge tA parihAra kare cale|
evaM yArA tAdera pratipAlakera AYAta smaraNa kariYe dile era prati andha evaM vadhirasadRza AcaraNa kare nA,
evaM yArA prArthanA kare, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera janye emana strI o santAna-santati dAna kara yArA have AmAdera janye naYanaprItikara evaM AmAderake kara muttAkIdera janye anusaraNayogya|
tAderake pratidAna deoYA have jAnnAtera suucca kakSa yehetu tArA chila dhairyazIla, tAderake sekhAne abhyarthanA karA have abhivAdana o sAlAma sahakAre|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| AzraYasthala o vasati hiseve tA kata utkRSTa|
vala, ‘tomarA AmAra pratipAlakake nA DAkile tA~ra kichui Ase yAYa nA| tomarA asvIkAra karecha, phale acire neme Asave aparihArya zAsti|
tA-sIna-mIma|
eiguli suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
erA mu’mina hacche nA vale tumi haYata manokaSTe AtmavinAzI haYe par3ave|
Ami icchA karale AkAza hate edera nikaTa eka nidarzana preraNa karatAma, phale edera grIvA vinata haYe par3ata era prati|
yakhanai edera kAche daYAmaYera nikaTa hate kona nUtana upadeza Ase, takhanai erA tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa|

yArA sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa Ara tArAi AkhirAte nizcita vizvAsI|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tAdera dRSTite tAdera karmake Ami zobhana karechi, phale erA vibhrAntite ghure ver3AYa;
ederai janye raYeche kaThina zAsti evaM erAi AkhirAte sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
nizcaYai tomAke Ala-kuraAna deoYA hacche prajJAmaYa, sarvajJera nikaTa hate|

smaraNa kara sei samaYera kathA, yakhana mUsA tAra parivAravargake valechila, ‘Ami Aguna dekhechi, satvara Ami sekhAna hate tomAdera janye kona khavara Anava vA tomAdera janye Anava jvalanta aGgAra, yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|
erapara se yakhana era nikaTa elo, takhana ghoSita hala ‘dhanya, yArA Ache ei Alora madhye evaM yArA Ache eTAra catuSpArzve, jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAh pavitra o mahimAnvita|
‘he mUsA! Ami to AllAh, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa,

‘tumi tomAra lAThi nikSepa kara|’ erapara yakhana se eke sarpera nyAYa chuTAchuTi karate dekhala takhana se pichanera dike chuTite lAgala evaM phireo tAkAla nA| valA hala, ‘he mUsA! bhIta haYo nA, nizcaYai Ami emana, AmAra sAnnidhye rAsUlagaNa bhaYa pAYa nA;
‘tave yArA juluma karAra para manda karmera parivarte satkarma kare, tAdera prati Ami kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
‘evaM tomAra hAta tomAra vagale rAkha, eTA vera haYe Asave zubhra nirmala avasthAYa| eTA phira‘Aona o tAra sampradAYera nikaTa AnIta naYaTi nidarzanera antargata| erA to satyatyAgI sampradAYa|’
erapara yakhana edera nikaTa AmAra spaSTa nidarzana elo, erA valala, ‘eTA suspaSTa jAdu|’
erA anyAYa o uddhatabhAve nidarzanaguli pratyAkhyAna karala, yadio edera antara egulike satya vale grahaNa karechila| dekha, viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila!
Ami avazyai dAUda o sulAYamAnake jJAna dAna karechilAma evaM tArA ubhaYe valechila, sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra yini AmAderake tAra vahu mu’mina vAndAdera opara zreSThatva diYechena|’
sulAYamAna haYechila dAUdera uttarAdhikArI evaM se valechila, ‘he mAnuSa! AmAke vihaMgakulera bhASA zikSA deoYA haYeche evaM AmAke sakala kichu deoYA haYeche, eTA avazyai suspaSTa anugraha|’
sulAYamAnera sAmane samaveta karA hala tAra vAhinIke-jina, mAnuSa o vihaMgakulake evaM ederake vinyasta karA hala vibhinna vyUhe|

yakhana erA pipIlikA-adhyuSita upatyakAYa peৗ~chila takhana eka pipIlikA valala, ‘he pipIlikA-vAhinI! tomarA tomAdera gRhe praveza kara, yena sulAYamAna evaM tAra vAhinI tAdera ajJAtasAre tomAderake padatale piSiYA nA phele|’

sulAYamAna era uktite mRdu hAsya karala evaM valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke sAmarthya dAo yAte Ami tomAra prati kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAri, AmAra prati o AmAra pitAmAtAra prati tumi ye anugraha karecha tAra janye evaM yAte Ami satkArya karate pAri, yA tumi pachanda kara evaM tomAra anugrahe AmAke tomAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAdera zAmila kara|’
sulAYamAna vihaMgadalera sandhAna nila evaM valala, ‘vyApAra ki, hudhudke dekhachi nA ye! se anupasthita nA ki?
‘se upayukta kAraNa nA darzAile Ami avazyai eke kaThina zAsti diva vA yaveha karava|’
anativilamve hudhud ese par3ala evaM valala, ‘Apani yA avagata nana Ami tA avagata haYechi evaM ‘sAvA’ hate sunizcita saMvAda niYe esechi|
‘Ami to eka nArIke dekhalAma edera opara rAjatva karache| tAke deoYA haYeche sakala kichu hatei evaM tAra Ache eka virATa siMhAsana|

‘Ami tAke o tAra sampradAYake dekhalAma tArA AllAh ra parivarte sUryake sijdA karateche| zaYatAna edera kAryAvalI edera nikaTa zobhana kareche evaM ederake satpatha hate nivRtta kareche, phale erA satpatha pAYa nA;
‘nivRtta kareche eijanye ye, erA yena sijdA nA kare AllAhke yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra lukkAYita vastuke prakAza karena, yini jAnena, yA tomarA gopana kara evaM yA tomarA vyakta kara|
‘AllAh, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei, tini mahAArazera adhipati|’
sulAYamAna valala, ‘Ami dekhiva tumi ki satya valecha, nA tumi mithyAvAdI?
‘tumi yAo AmAra ei patra niYe evaM eTA tAdera nikaTa arpaNa kara; erapara tAdera nikaTa hate sare theka evaM lakSya kara tAdera pratikriYA kI?’
sei nArI valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga! AmAke eka sammAnita patra deoYA haYeche;
‘eTA sulAYamAnera nikaTa hate evaM eTA ei: daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu AllAh ra nAme,
‘ahamikAvaze AmAke amAnya kara nA, evaM Anugatya svIkAra kare AmAra nikaTa upasthita hao|’
sei nArI valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga! AmAra ei samasyAYa tomAdera abhimata dAo| Ami kona vyApAre cUr3Anta siddhAnta grahaNa kari nA tomAdera upasthiti vyatIta|
erA valala, ‘AmarA to zaktizAlI o kaThora yoddhA; tave siddhAnta grahaNera kSamatA ApanArai, kI Adeza karavena tA Apani bheve dekhuna|’
se valala, ‘rAjA-vAdazAhrA yakhana kona janapade praveza kare takhana eke viparyasta kare deYa evaM sekhAnakAra maryAdAvAna vyaktiderake apadastha kare, erAo eirUpai karave;
‘Ami tAdera nikaTa upaDhaukana pAThAcchi, dekhi, dUterA kI niYe phire Ase|’

dUta sulAYamAnera nikaTa Asale sulAYamAna valala, ‘tomarA ki AmAke dhana-sampada diYe sAhAyya karacho? AllAh AmAke yA diYechena, tA tomAderake yA diYechena tA hate utkRSTa athaca tomarA tomAdera upaDhaukana niYe utphulla vodha karacho|

‘edera nikaTa phire yAo, Ami avazyai edera viruddhe niYe Asiva eka sainyavAhinI yAra mukAvilA karAra zakti edera nei| Ami avazyai ederake sekhAna hate vahiSkAra karava lAJchitabhAve evaM erA have avanamita|’
sulAYamAna Aro valala, ‘he AmAra pAriSadavarga! tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare AmAra nikaTa AsAra pUrve tomAdera madhye ke tAra siMhAsana AmAra nikaTa niYe Asave?’
eka zaktizAlI jina valala, ‘Apani ApanAra sthAna hate uThavAra pUrvei Ami tA ene diva evaM ei vyApAre Ami avazyai kSamatAvAna, vizvasta|’

kitAvera jJAna yAra chila, se valala, ‘Apani cokhera palaka phelAra pUrvei Ami tA ApanAke ene diva|’ sulAYamAna yakhana tA sAmane rakSita avasthAYa dekhala takhana se valala, ‘eTA AmAra pratipAlakera anugraha, yAte tini AmAke parIkSA karate pArena-Ami kRtajJa nA akRtajJa| ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare, se to kRtajJatA prakAza kare nijerai kalyANera janye evaM ye akRtajJa, se jene rAkhuka ye, AmAra pratipAlaka abhAvamukta, mahAnubhava|’
