sulAYamAna valala, ‘tAra siMhAsanera AkRti aparicita kare vadaliYe dAo; dekhi se saThika dizA pAYa, nA se vibhrAntadera zAmila haYa;

sei nArI yakhana elo, takhana tAke jijJAsA karA hala, ‘tomAra siMhAsana ki eirUpai?’ se valala, ‘eTA to yena oTAi|’ AmAderake itipUrvei prakRta jJAna dAna karA haYeche evaM AmarA AtmasamarpaNao karechi|’
AllAh ra parivarte se yAra pUjA karata tAi tAke satya hate nivRtta kareche, se chila kAphira sampradAYera antarbhukta|

tAke valA hala, ‘ei prAsAde praveza kara|’ yakhana se tA dekhala takhana se eke eka gabhIra jalAzaYa mane karala evaM se tAra padadvaYa anAvRta karala| sulAYamAna valala, ‘eTA to svaccha sphaTika maNDita prAsAda|’ sei nArI valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami to nijera prati juluma karechilAma, Ami sulAYamAnera saGge jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAh ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karachi|’
Ami avazyai sAmUda sampradAYera nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihke pAThiYechilAma ei Adezasaha: ‘tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara’, kintu erA dvidhAvibhakta haYe vitarke lipta hala|
se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA kena kalyANera pUrve akalyANa tvarAnvita karate cAicho? kena tomarA AllAh ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karacho nA, yAte tomarA anugrahabhAjana hate pAra?’

erA valala, ‘tomAke o tomAra saGge yArA Ache tAderake AmarA amaGgalera kAraNa mane kari|’ sAlih valala, ‘tomAdera zubhAzubha AllAh ra ikhtiYAre, vastuta tomarA emana eka sampradAYa yAderake parIkSA karA hacche|’
Ara sei zahare chila emana naYa vyakti, yArA deze viparyaYa sRSTi karata evaM satkarma karata nA|

erA valala, ‘tomarA AllAh ra nAme zapatha grahaNa kara, ‘AmarA rAtrikAle tAke o tAra parivAra-parijanake avazyai AkramaNa karava; erapara tAra abhibhAvakake nizcaYa valiva, ‘tAra parivAra-parijanera hatyA AmarA pratyakSa kari nAi; AmarA avazyai satyavAdI|’
erA eka cakrAnta karechila evaM Amio eka kauzala avalamvana karalAma, kintu erA vujhate pAre nAi|
ataeva dekha, edera cakrAntera pariNAma kI haYeche-Ami avazyai ederake o edera sampradAYera sakalake dhvaMsa karechi|
ei to edera gharavAr3i-sImAlaMghanahetu yA janazUnya avasthAYa par3e Ache; ete jJAnI sampradAYera janye avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
evaM yArA mu’mina o muttAkI chila tAderake Ami uddhAra karechi|
smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, se tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘tomarA jene-zune kena azlIla kAja karacho,
‘tomarA ki kAmatRptira janye nArIke cher3e puruSe upagata have? tomarA to eka ajJa sampradAYa|’
uttare tAra sampradAYa zudhu valala, ‘lUta-parivArake tomAdera janapada hate vahiSkAra kara, erA to emana loka yArA pavitra sAjite cAYa|
erapara Ami tAke o tAra parijanavargake uddhAra karalAma, tAra strI vyatIta, tAke karechilAma dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta|
tAdera opara bhaYaMkara vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma, bhIti pradarzitadera janye ei varSaNa chila kata nikRSTa!
vala, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra i evaM zAnti tA~ra manonIta vAndAdera prati!’ zreSTha ki AllAh, nA erA yAderake zarIka kare tArA?

varaM tini, yini sRSTi karechena AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM AkAza hate tomAdera janye varSaNa karena vRSTi; erapara Ami tA diYe manorama udyAna sRSTi kari, era vRkSAdi udgata karAra kSamatA tomAdera nei| AllAh ra saGge anya kona ilAh Ache ki? tavuo erA emana eka sampradAYa yArA satyavicyuta haYa|

varaM tini, yini pRthivIke karechena vAsopayogI evaM era mAjhe mAjhe pravAhita karechena nadInAlA evaM ete sthApana karechena sudRr3ha parvata o dui dariYAra madhye sRSTi karechena antarAYa; AllAh ra saGge anya kona ilAh Ache ki? tavuo edera anekei jAne nA|

varaM tini, yini Artera AhvAne sAr3A dena, yakhana se tA~ke DAke evaM vipada-Apada dUrIbha‚ta karena evaM tomAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karena| AllAh ra saGge anya kona ilAh Ache ki? tomarA upadeza ati sAmAnyai grahaNa kare thAka|

varaM tini, yini tomAderake sthalera o pAnira andhakAre patha pradarzana karena evaM yini svIYa anugrahera prAkkAle susaMvAdavAhI vAYu preraNa karena| AllAh ra saGge anya kona ilAh Ache ki? erA yAke zarIka kare AllAh tA hate vahu Urdhve|

varaM tini, yini Adite sRSTi karena, erapara era punarAvRtti karavena evaM yini tomAderake AkAza o pRthivI hate jIvanopakaraNa dAna karena| AllAh ra saGge anya kona ilAh Ache ki? vala, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave tomAdera pramANa peza kara|’
vala, ‘AllAh vyatIta AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte keui adRzya viSaYera jJAna rAkhe nA evaM erA jAne nA erA kakhana utthita have|’
AkhirAta samparke edera jJAna to niHzeSa haYeche; erA to e viSaYe sandigdha, varaM e viSaYe erA andha|
kAphirarA vale, ‘AmarA o AmAdera pitRpuruSerA mRttikAYa paryavasita haYe geleo ki AmAderake utthita karA have?
‘ei viSaYe to AmAderake evaM pUrve AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNakeo bhIti pradarzana karA haYechila| eTA to pUrvavartIdera upakathA vyatIta Ara kichu naYa|’
vala, ‘pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM dekha aparAdhIdera pariNAma kirUpa haYeche|’
edera samparke tumi duHkha kara nA evaM edera Sar3ayantre manaHkSuNNa haYo nA|
erA vale, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala, kakhana ei pratizruti pUrNa have?’
vala, ‘tomarA ye viSaYa tvarAnvita karate cAicho sambhavata tAra kichu tomAdera nikaTavartI haYeche|’
nizcaYai tomAra pratipAlaka mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla; kintu edera adhikAMzai akRtajJa|
edera antara yA gopana kare evaM erA yA prakAza kare tA tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai jAnena|
AkAze o pRthivIte emana kona gopana rahasya nei, yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|
vanI isarAIla yei samasta viSaYe matabheda kare, ei kuraAna tAra adhikAMza tAdera nikaTa vivRta kare|
evaM nizcaYai eTA mu’minadera janye hidAYAta o rahamata|
tomAra pratipAlaka to tA~ra vidhAna anuyAYI edera madhye phAYasAlA kare divena| tini parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa|
ataeva AllAh ra opara nirbhara kara; tumi to spaSTa satye pratiSThita|
mRtake to tumi kathA zonAte pArave nA, vadhirakeo pArave nA AhvAna zonAite, yakhana erA piTha phiriYe cale yAYa|
tumi andhaderake edera pathabhraSTatA hate pathe Anate pArave nA| tumi zonAte pArave kevala tAderake, yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa kare| Ara tArAi AtmasamarpaNakArI|
yakhana ghoSita zAsti edera nikaTa Asave takhana Ami mRttikAgarbha hate vera karava eka jIva, yA edera saGge kathA valave, eijanye ye, mAnuSa AmAra nidarzane avizvAsI|
smaraNa kara sei dinera kathA, yei dina Ami samaveta karava pratyeka sampradAYa hate eka-ekaTi dalake, yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI pratyAkhyAna karata Ara ederake sArivaddha karA have|
yakhana erA samAgata have takhana AllAh ederake valavena, ‘tomarA ki AmAra nidarzana pratyAkhyAna karechile, athaca tA tomarA jJAnAYatta karate pAra nAi? varaM tomarA Arao kichu karachile?’
sImAlaMghana hetu edera opara ghoSita zAsti ese par3ave; phale erA kichui valite pArave nA|
erA ki anudhAvana kare nA ye, Ami rAtri sRSTi karechi edera vizrAmera janye evaM divasake karechi Alokaprada? ete mu’mina sampradAYera janye avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

evaM yedina ziMgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, sei dina AkAzamaNDalIra o pRthivIra sakalei bhIta-vihavala haYe par3ave, tave AllAh yAderake cAivena tArA vyatIta evaM sakalei tA~ra nikaTa Asave vinIta avasthAYa|

tumi parvatamAlA dekhacho, mane karacho tA acala, athaca erA have meghapuJjera nyAYa saJcaramANa| eTA AllAh ra i sRSTi naipuNya, yini samasta kichuke karechena suSama| tomarA yA kara se samvandhe tini samyaka avagata|
ye keu satkarma niYe Asave, se tA hate utkRSTa pratiphala pAve evaM sei dina erA zaMkA hate nirApada thAkave|
ye keu asatkarma niYe Asave, tAke adhomukhe nikSepa karA have doyakhe evaM ederake valA have, ‘tomarA yA karate tArai pratiphala tomAderake deoYA hacche|’
Ami to AdiSTa haYechi ei nagarIra prabhura ‘ivAdata karate, yini eTAke karechena sammAnita| samasta kichu tA~rai| Ami Arao AdiSTa haYechi, yena Ami AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta hai|

Ami Arao AdiSTa haYechi, kuraAna tilAoYAta karate; ataeva ye vyakti satpatha anusaraNa kare, se satpatha anusaraNa kare nijerai kalyANera janye| Ara keu bhrAnta patha avalamvana karale tumi vala, ‘Ami to kevala satarkakArIdera madhye ekajana|’
Ara vala, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra i, tini tomAderake satvara dekhAvena tA~ra nidarzana; takhana tomarA tA vujhate pArave|’ tomarA yA kara se samvandhe tomAra pratipAlaka gAphila nana|
tA-sIna-mIma;
ei AYAtaguli suspaSTa kitAvera|
Ami tomAra nikaTa mUsA o phira‘Aonera kichu vRttAnta yathAyathabhAve vivRta karachi, mu’mina sampradAYera uddezye|

phira‘Aona deze parAkramazAlI haYechila evaM sekhAnakAra adhivAsIvRndake vibhinna zreNIte vibhakta kare edera ekaTi zreNIke se hInavala karechila; edera putragaNake se hatyA karata evaM nArIgaNake jIvita thAkate dita| se to chila viparyaYa sRSTikArI|
Ami icchA karalAma, se deze yAderake hInavala karA haYechila, tAdera prati anugraha karate, tAderake netRtva dAna karate o uttarAdhikArI karate;
evaM tAderake deze kSamatAYa pratiSThita karate, Ara phira‘Aona, hAmAna o tAdera vAhinIke tA dekhiYe dite, yA edera nikaTa tArA AzaMkA karata|

mUsA-jananIra antare Ami iGgite nirdeza karalAma, ‘zizuTike stanya dAna karate thAka| yakhana tumi tAra samparke kona AzaMkA karave takhana eTAke dariYAYa nikSepa kara evaM bhaYa kara nA, duHkhao kara nA| Ami avazyai eTAke tomAra nikaTa phiriYe diva evaM eTAke rAsUladera ekajana karava|’
erapara phira‘Aonera lokajana tAke uThiYe nila| eTAra pariNAma to ei chila ye, se edera zatru o duHkhera kAraNa have| avazyai phira‘Aona, hAmAna o edera vAhinI chila aparAdhI|

phira‘Aonera strI valala, ‘ei zizu AmAra o tomAra naYana-prItikara| eTAke hatyA kara nA, se AmAdera upakAre Asate pAre, AmarA tAke santAna hiseveo grahaNa karate pAri|’ prakRtapakSe erA eTAra pariNAma vujhate pAre nAi|
mUsA-jananIra hRdaYa asthira haYe par3echila| yAte se AsthAzIla haYa tAra janye Ami tAra hRdaYake dRr3ha kare nA dile se tAra paricaYa to prakAza karei dita|
se mUsAra bhagnike valala, ‘eTAra pichane pichane yAo|’ se edera ajJAtasAre dUra hate tAke dekhatechila|

pUrva hatei Ami dhAtrI-stanyapAne tAke virata rekhechilAma| mUsAra bhagni valala, ‘tomAderake ki Ami emana eka parivArera sandhAna diva yArA tomAdera haYe eTAke lAlana-pAlana karave evaM eTAra maGgalakAmI have?’
erapara Ami tAke phiriYe dilAma tAra jananIra nikaTa yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa, se duHkha nA kare evaM vujhate pAre ye, AllAh ra pratizruti satya; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai eTA jAne nA|
yakhana mUsA pUrNa yauvane upanIta o pariNata vaYaska hala takhana Ami tAke hikmata o jJAna dAna karalAma; eibhAve Ami satkarmaparAYaNaderake puraskAra pradAna kare thAki|

se nagarIte praveza karala, yakhana eTAra adhivAsIrA chila asatarka| sekhAne se duiTi lokake saMgharSe lipta dekhala, ekajana tAra nija dalera evaM apara jana tAra zatrudalera| mUsAra dalera lokaTi era zatrura viruddhe tAra sAhAyya prArthanA karala, takhana mUsA eke ghuSi mArala; ebhAve se tAke hatyA kare vasala| mUsA valala, ‘eTA zaYatAnera kANDa| se to prakAzya zatru o vibhrAntakArI|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami to AmAra nijera prati juluma karechi; sutarAM AmAke kSamA kara|’ erapara tini tAke kSamA karalena| tini to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
se Arao valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi yehetu AmAra prati anugraha karecha, Ami kakhanao aparAdhIdera sAhAyyakArI hava nA|’

erapara bhIta satarka avasthAYa sei nagarIte tAra prabhAta hala| haThAt se zunate pela pUrvadina ye vyakti tAra sAhAyya cAhiYAchila, se tAra sAhAyyera janye citkAra karateche| mUsA tAke valala, ‘tumi to spaSTai ekajana vibhrAnta vyakti|’

erapara mUsA yakhana ubhaYera zatruke dharate udyata hala, takhana se vyakti vale uThala, ‘he mUsA! gatakAla tumi yemana eka vyaktike hatyA karecha, sebhAve AmAkeo ki hatyA karate cAicho? tumi to pRthivIte svecchAcArI hate cAicho, zAnti sthApanakArI hate cAo nA|’
nagarIra dUra prAnta hate eka vyakti chuTe elo o valala, ‘he mUsA! pAriSadavarga tomAke hatyA karAra parAmarza karache| sutarAM tumi vAire cale yAo, Ami to tomAra maGgalakAmI|’
bhIta satarka avasthAYa se sekhAna hate vera haYe par3ala evaM valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi jAlima sampradAYa hate AmAke rakSA kara|’
yakhana mUsA mAdaiYAna abhimukhe yAtrA karala takhana valala, ‘AzA kari AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke sarala patha pradarzana karavena|’

yakhana se mAdaiYAnera ka‚pera nikaTa peৗ~chila, dekhala, ekadala loka tAdera jAnoYAragulike pAni pAna karAcche evaM edera pazcAte du’jana nArI tAdera pazugulike AgalAcche| mUsA valala, ‘tomAdera kI vyApAra?’ erA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera jAnoYAragulike pAni pAna karAte pAri nA, yatakSaNa rAkhAlerA edera jAnoYAragulike niYe sare nA yAYa| AmAdera pitA ati vRddha|’
mUsA takhana edera pakSe jAnoYAragulike pAni pAna karAla| tatpara se chAYAra nice AzraYa grahaNa kare valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra prati ye anugraha karave Ami to tAra kAGgAla|’

takhana nArIdvaYera ekajana zarama-jar3ita caraNe tAra nikaTa elo evaM valala, ‘AmAra pitA ApanAke AmantraNa karachena, AmAdera jAnoYAragulike pAni pAna karAnora pArizramika deYAra janye|’ erapara mUsA tAra nikaTa ese samasta vRttAnta varNanA karale se valala, ‘bhaYa kara nA, tumi jAlima sampradAYera kavala hate ve~ce gecha|’
edera ekajana valala, ‘he pitA! tumi eTAke majura niyukta kara, kAraNa tomAra majura hiseve uttama have sei vyakti, ye zaktizAlI, vizvasta|’

se mUsAke valala, ‘Ami AmAra ei kanyAdvaYera ekajanake tomAra saGge vivAha dite cAi, ei zarte ye, tumi ATa vatsara AmAra kAja karave, yadi tumi daza vatsara pUrNa kara, se tomAra icchA| Ami tomAke kaSTa dite cAi nA| AllAh icchA karale tumi AmAke sadAcArI pAve|’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAra o ApanAra madhye ei cuktii raila| ei duiTi meYAdera kona ekaTi Ami pUrNa karale AmAra viruddhe kona abhiyoga thAkave nA| AmarA ye viSaYe kathA valachi AllAh tAra sAkSI|’

mUsA yakhana tAra meYAda pUrNa karAra para saparivAre yAtrA karala, takhana se tUra parvatera dike Aguna dekhate pela| se tAra parijanavargake valala, ‘tomarA apekSA kara, Ami Aguna dekhechi, sambhavata Ami sekhAna hate tomAdera janye khavara Anate pAri vA ekakhaNDa jvalanta kATha Anate pAri yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|’
yakhana mUsA Agunera nikaTa peৗ~chila takhana upatyakAra dakSiNa pArzve pavitra bha‚misthita eka vRkSera dika hate tAke AhvAna kare valA hala, ‘he mUsA! Amii AllAha, jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka;’

Arao valA hala, ‘tumi tomAra yaSTi nikSepa kara|’ erapara, yakhana se eke sarpera nyAYa chuTAchuTi karate dekhala takhana pichanera dike chuTate lAgala evaM phire tAkAla nA| tAke valA hala, ‘he mUsA! sAmane Asa, bhaYa kara nA; tumi to nirApada|

‘tomAra hAta tomAra vagale rAkha, eTA vera haYe Asave zubhra-samujjvala nirdeASa haYe| bhaYa dUra karAra janye tomAra hastadvaYa nijera dike cApiYA dhara| ei duiTi tomAra pratipAlaka-pradatta pramANa, phira‘Aona o tAra pAriSadavargera janye| erA to satyatyAgI sampradAYa|
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami to edera ekajanake hatyA karechi| phale Ami AzaMkA karachi erA AmAke hatyA karave|
‘AmAra bhAi hArUna AmA apekSA vAgmI; ataeva tAke AmAra sAhAyyakArIrUpe preraNa kara, se AmAke samarthana karave| Ami AzaMkA kari erA AmAke mithyAvAdI valave|’

AllAh valalena, ‘Ami tomAra bhAike diYe tomAra vAhu zaktizAlI karava evaM tomAdera ubhaYake prAdhAnya dAna karava| erA tomAdera nikaTa peৗ~chate pArave nA| tomarA evaM tomAdera anusArIrA AmAra nidarzanavale edera opara pravala have|’
mUsA yakhana edera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa nidarzanaguli niYe elo, erA valala, ‘eTA to alIka indrajAla mAtra| AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNera kAle kakhanao erUpa kathA zuni nAi|’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka samyaka avagata, ke tA~ra nikaTa hate pathanirdeza eneche evaM AkhirAte kAhAra pariNAma zubha have| jAlimarA kakhano saphalakAma have nA|’

phira‘Aona valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga! Ami vyatIta tomAdera anya kona ilAh Ache vale jAni nA| he hAmAna! tumi AmAra janye iTa por3Ao evaM ekaTi suucca prAsAda taiYAra kara; haYata Ami ete uThiYA mUsAra ilAhke dekhate pAri| tave Ami avazyai mane kari se mithyAvAdI|’
phira‘Aona o tAra vAhinI anyAYabhAve pRthivIte ahaMkAra karechila evaM erA mane karechila ye, erA AmAra nikaTa pratyAvartita have nA|
ataeva Ami tAke o tAra vAhinIke dharilAma evaM tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| dekha, jAlimadera pariNAma ki haYe thAke|
ederake Ami netA karechilAma; erA lokaderake jAhAnnAmera dike AhvAna karata; kiYAmatera dina ederake sAhAyya karA have nA|
ei pRthivIte Ami edera pazcAte lAgiYe diYechi abhisampAta evaM kiYAmatera dina erA have ghRNita|
Ami to pUrvavartI vahu mAnavagoSThIke vinAza karAra para mUsAke diYechilAma kitAva, mAnavajAtira janye jJAnavartikA, pathanirdeza o anugrahasvarUpa, yAte erA upadeza grahaNa kare|
mUsAke yakhana Ami vidhAna diYechilAma takhana tumi pazcima prAnte upasthita chile nA evaM tumi pratyakSadarzIo chile nA|

vastuta Ami aneka mAnavagoSThIra AvirbhAva ghaTiYechilAma; erapara edera vahu yuga ativAhita haYe geche| tumi to mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye vidyamAna chile nA edera nikaTa AmAra AYAta AvRtti karAra janye| Amii to chilAma rAsUla preraNakArI|

mUsAke yakhana Ami AhvAna karechilAma takhana tumi ta‚ra parvatapArzve upasthita chile nA| vastuta eTA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate daYAsvarUpa, yAte tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karate pAra, yAdera nikaTa tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Ase nAi, yena erA upadeza grahaNa kare;

rAsUla nA pAThAle edera kRtakarmera janye edera kona vipada hale erA valata, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAdera nikaTa kona rAsUla preraNa karale nA kena? karale AmarA tomAra vidhAna mene calatAma evaM AmarA hatAma mu’mina|’

erapara yakhana AmAra nikaTa hate edera nikaTa satya elo, erA valate lAgala, ‘mUsAke yerUpa deYA haYechila, tAke serUpa deoYA hala nA kena?’ kintu pUrve mUsAke yA deYA haYechila tA ki erA asvIkAra kare nAi? erA valechila, ‘duiTii jAdu, eke aparake samarthana kare|’ evaM erA valechila, ‘AmarA sakalakei pratyAkhyAna kari|’
vala, ‘tomarA satyavAdI hale AllAh ra nikaTa hate eka kitAva AnaYana kara, yA pathanirdeze etadubhaYa hate utkRSTatara have; Ami se kitAva anusaraNa karava|’

erapara erA yadi tomAra AhvAne sAr3A nA deYa, tA hale jAnive erA to kevala nijedera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kare| AllAh ra pathanirdeza agrAhya kare ye vyakti nija kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kare tA apekSA adhika vibhrAnta Ara ke? AllAh jAlima sampradAYake pathanirdeza karena nA|
Ami to edera nikaTa parapara vANI peৗ~che diYechi; yAte erA upadeza grahaNa kare|
eTAra pUrve Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma, tArA ete vizvAsa kare|
yakhana edera nikaTa eTA AvRtti karA haYa takhana erA vale, ‘AmarA ete ImAna Ani, nizcaYai eTA AmAdera pratipAlaka hate Agata satya| AmarA to pUrveo AtmasamarpaNakArI chilAma;
ederake duivAra pArizramika pradAna karA have, yehetu erA dhairyazIla evaM erA bhAla diYe mandera mukAvilA kare o Ami ederake ye riyika diYechi tA hate erA vyaYa kare|

erA yakhana asAra vAkya zone takhana erA tA upekSA kare cale evaM vale, ‘AmAdera kAjera phala AmAdera janye evaM tomAdera kAjera phala tomAdera janye; tomAdera prati ‘sAlAma’| AmarA ajJadera saGga cAhi nA|’
tumi yAke bhAlavAsa, icchA karalena tAke satpathe Anate pArave nA| tave AllAhi yAke icchA satpathe AnaYana karena evaM tinii bhAla jAnena satpatha anusArIderake|

erA vale, ‘AmarA yadi tomAra saGge satpatha anusaraNa kari tave AmAderake deza hate utkhAta karA have|’ Ami ki ederake eka nirApada hArAme pratiSThita kari nAi, yekhAne sarvaprakAra phalamUla AmadAnI haYa AmAra deoYA riyika svarUpa? kintu edera adhikAMzai eTA jAne nA|

kata janapadake Ami dhvaMsa karechi yAra vAsindArA nijedera bhoga-sampadera dambha karata! egulii to edera gharavAr3i; edera para eigulite lokajana sAmAnyai vasavAsa kareche| Ara Ami to cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI!

tomAra pratipAlaka janapadasamUhake dhvaMsa karena nA era kendre tA~ra AYAta AvRtti karAra janye rAsUla preraNa nA kare evaM Ami janapadasamUhake takhanai dhvaMsa kari yakhana eTAra vAsindArA juluma kare|
tomAderake yA kichu deYA haYeche tA to pArthiva jIvanera bhoga o zobhA evaM yA AllAh ra nikaTa Ache tA uttama o sthAYI| tomarA ki anudhAvana karave nA?
yAke Ami uttama puraskArera pratizruti diYechi, yA se pAve, se ki ai vyaktira samAna yAke Ami pArthiva jIvanera bhoga-sambhAra diYechi, yAke pare kiYAmatera dina hAyira karA have?
evaM sei dina tini ederake AhvAna kare valavena, ‘tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka gaNya karate, tArA kothAYa?’

yAdera janye zAsti avadhArita haYeche tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ederakei AmarA vibhrAnta karechilAma; ederake vibhrAnta karechilAma yemana AmarA vibhrAnta haYechilAma; ApanAra samIpe AmarA dAYitva hate avyAhati cAitechi| erA to AmAdera ‘ivAdata karata nA|’
ederake valA have, ‘tomAdera devatAgulike AhvAna kara|’ takhana erA ederake DAkave| kintu erA edera DAke sAr3A dive nA| erA zAsti pratyakSa karave| hAYa! erA yadi satpatha anusaraNa karata|
Ara sei dina AllAh ederake DAkiYA valavena, ‘tomarA rAsUlagaNake kI javAva diYechile?’
sei dina sakala tathya tAdera nikaTa hate vilupta have evaM erA eke aparake jijJAsAvAdao karate pArave nA|
tave ye vyakti taovA karechila evaM ImAna enechila o satkarma karechila, AzA karA yAYa se sAphalya arjanakArIdera antarbhukta have|
tomAra pratipAlaka yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM yAke icchA manonIta karena, ete edera kona hAta nei| AllAh pavitra, mahAna evaM erA yAke zarIka kare tA hate tini Urdhve!
Ara tomAra pratipAlaka jAnena edera antara yA gopana kare evaM erA yA vyakta kare|
tinii AllAh, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei, duniYA o AkhirAte samasta prazaMsA tA~rai; vidhAna tA~rai; tomarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|

vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, AllAh yadi rAtrike kiYAmatera dina paryanta sthAYI karena, AllAh vyatIta emana kon ilAh Ache, ye tomAderake Aloka AniYA dite pAre? tavuo ki tomarA karNapAta karave nA?’

vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, AllAh yadi divasake kiYAmatera dina paryanta sthAYI karena, AllAh vyatIta emana kon ilAh Ache, ye tomAdera janye rAtrira AvirbhAva ghaTAve, yAte tomarA vizrAma karate pAra? tavuo ki tomarA bheve dekhave nA?’
tinii tA~ra daYAYa tomAdera janye karechena rajanI o divasa, yena ete tomarA vizrAma karate pAra evaM tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
sei dina tini ederake AhvAna kare valavena, ‘tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka gaNya karate tArA kothAYa?’

pratyeka sampradAYa hate Ami ekajana sAkSI vera kare Anava evaM valiva, ‘tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara|’ takhana erA jAnate pArave, ilAh haoYAra adhikAra AllAh ra i evaM erA yA udbhAvana karata tA edera nikaTa hate antarhita have|

kArUna chila mUsAra sampradAYabhukta, kintu se tAdera prati auddhatya prakAza karechila| Ami tAke dAna karechilAma emana dhanabhANDAra yAra cAviguli vahana karA ekadala valavAna lokera pakSeo kaSTasAdhya chila| smaraNa kara, tAra sampradAYa tAke valechila, ‘dambha kara nA, nizcaYa AllAh dAmbhikaderake pachanda karena nA|

‘AllAh yA tomAke diYechena tA diYe AkhirAtera AvAsa anusandhAna kara evaM duniYA hate tomAra aMza bhulio nA; tumi anugraha kara yemana AllAh tomAra prati anugraha karechena evaM pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karate cAhio nA| AllAh viparyaYa sRSTikArIke bhAlavAsena nA|’

se valala, ‘ei sampada Ami AmAra jJAnavale prApta haYechi|’ se ki jAnata nA AllAh tAra pUrve dhvaMsa karechena vahu mAnavagoSThIke yArA tA apekSA zaktite chila pravala, janasaMkhyAYa chila adhika? aparAdhIderake edera aparAdha samparke prazna karA have nA|

kArUna tAra sampradAYera sAmane upasthita haYechila jA~kajamakasahakAre| yArA pArthiva jIvana kAmanA karata tArA valala, ‘AhA, kArUnake yeirUpa deoYA haYeche AmAderakeo yadi tA deoYA hata| prakRtai se mahAbhAgyavAna|’
evaM yAderake jJAna deoYA haYechila tArA valala, ‘dhika tomAderake! yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAdera janye AllAh ra puraskArai zreSTha evaM dhairyazIla vyatIta eTA keu pAve nA|’
erapara Ami kArUnake tAra prAsAdasaha bhUgarbhe prothita karalAma| tAra svapakSe emana kona dala chila nA ye AllAh ra zAsti hate tAke sAhAyya karate pArata evaM se nijeo AtmarakSAYa sakSama chila nA|

pUrvadina yArA tAra mata haoYAra kAmanA karechila, tArA valite lAgala, ‘dekhale to, AllAh tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janye icchA tAra riyika vardhita karena evaM yAra janye icchA hrAsa karena| yadi AllAh AmAdera prati sadaYa nA hatena tave AmAderakeo tini bha‚garbhe prothita karatena| dekhale to! kAphirarA saphalakAma haYa nA|’
eTA AkhirAtera sei AvAsa yA Ami nirdhArita kari tAdera janye yArA ei pRthivIte uddhata hate o viparyaYa sRSTi karate cAYa nA| zubha pariNAma muttAkIdera janye|
ye keu satkarma niYe upasthita haYa tAra janye raYeche tA apekSA uttama phala, Ara ye manda karma niYe upasthita haYa, tave yArA manda karma kare tAderake tArA yA kareche erai zAsti deoYA have|
yini tomAra janye kuraAnake karechena vidhAna tini tomAke avazyai phiriYe Anavena janmabha‚mite| vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka bhAla jAnena ke satpathera nirdeza eneche evaM ke spaSTa vibhrAntite Ache|’
tumi AzA kara nAi ye, tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa have| eTA to kevala tomAra pratipAlakera anugraha| sutarAM tumi kakhanao kAphiradera sahAYa haYo nA|
tomAra prati AllAh ra AYAta avatIrNa haoYAra para erA yena tomAke kichutei seguli hate vimukha nA kare| tumi tomAra pratipAlakera dike AhvAna kara evaM kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
tumi AllAh ra saGge anya ilAhke DAkio nA, tini vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei| AllAh ra sattA vyatIta samasta kichui dhvaMsazIla| vidhAna tA~rai evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|
Alipha-lAma-mIma;
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’ ei kathA valalena ederake parIkSA nA kare avyAhati deoYA have?
Ami to edera pUrvavartIderakeo parIkSA karechilAma; AllAh avazyai prakAza kare divena kArA satyavAdI evaM tini avazyai prakAza kare divena kAhArA mithyAvAdI|
tave ki yArA manda karma kare tArA mane kare ye, tArA AmAra AYattera vAire cale yAve? tAdera siddhAnta kata manda!
ye AllAh ra sAkSAt kAmanA kare se jene rAkhuka, AllAh ra nirdhArita kAla Asavei| tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
ye keu sAdhanA kare, se to nijera janyei sAdhanA kare; AllAh to vizvajagat hate amukhApekSI|
evaM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare Ami nizcaYai tAdera hate tAdera manda karmaguli miTAiYA diva evaM Ami avazyai tAderake pratidAna diva, tArA ye uttama karma karata tAra|

Ami mAnuSake nirdeza diYechi tAra pitAmAtAra prati sadvyavahAra karate| tave erA yadi tomAra opara vala praYoga kare AmAra saGge emana kichu zarIka karate yAra samparke tomAra kona jJAna nei, tumi tAderake mAnio nA| AmArai nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana| erapara Ami tomAderake jAniYe diva tomarA kI karachile|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare Ami avazyai tAderake satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta karava|

mAnuSera madhye kataka vale, ‘AmarA AllAhe vizvAsa kari, kintu AllAh ra pathe yakhana erA nigRhIta haYa, takhana erA mAnuSera pIr3anake AllAh ra zAstira mata gaNya kare evaM tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate kona sAhAyya Asale erA valite thAke, ‘AmarA to tomAdera saGgei chilAma|’ vizvavAsIra antaHkaraNe yA Ache, AllAh ki tA samyaka avagata nahena?’
AllAh avazyai prakAza kare divena kAhArA ImAna eneche evaM avazyai prakAza kare divena kAhArA munAphika|
kAphirarA mu’minaderake vale, ‘AmAdera patha anusaraNa kara tA hale AmarA tomAdera pApabhAra vahana karava|’ kintu erA to tAdera pApabhArera kichui vahana karave nA| erA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
erA nijedera bhAra vahana karave evaM nijedera vojhAra saGge Arao kichu vojhA; Ara erA ye mithyA udbhAvana kare se samparke kiYAmata divase avazyai ederake prazna karA have|
Ami to nUhke tAra sampradAYera nikaTa preraNa karechilAma| se edera madhye avasthAna karechila paJcAza kama hAjAra vatsara| erapara plAvana ederake grAsa kare; kAraNa erA chila sImAlaMghanakArI|
erapara Ami tAke evaM yArA taraNIte ArohaNa karechila tAderake rakSA karalAma evaM vizvajagatera janye eTAke karalAma ekaTi nidarzana|
smaraNa kara ivrAhImera kathA, se tAra sampradAYake valechila, tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara evaM tA~ke bhaYa kara; tomAdera janye eTAi zreYa yadi tomarA jAnate!

‘tomarA to AllAh vyatIta kevala mUrtipUjA karacho evaM mithyA udbhAvana karacho| tomarA AllAh vyatIta yAdera pUjA kara tArA tomAdera jIvanopakaraNera mAlika naYa| sutarAM tomarA jIvanopakaraNa kAmanA kara AllAh ra nikaTa evaM tA~ra ‘ivAdata kara o tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| tomarA tA~rai nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
‘tomarA yadi asvIkAra kara tave to tomAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyAvAdI valechila| suspaSTabhAve pracAra kare deoYA vyatIta rAsUlera Ara kona dAYitva nei|
erA ki lakSya kare nA, kibhAve AllAh sRSTike astitva dAna karena, erapara tA punarAYa sRSTi karena? eTA to AllAh ra janye sahaja|
vala, ‘tomarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM anudhAvana kara, kibhAve tini sRSTi Arambha karechena! erapara AllAh sRSTi karavena paravartI sRSTi| AllAh to sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tini yAke icchA zAsti dena evaM yAra prati icchA anugraha karena| tomarA tA~rai nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
tomarA AllAhke vyartha karate pArave nA pRthivIte, Ara nA AkAze evaM AllAh vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
yArA AllAh ra nidarzana o tA~ra sAkSAt asvIkAra kare, tArAi AmAra anugraha hate nirAza haYa| Ara tAdera janye Ache marmantuda zAsti|
uttare ivrAhImera sampradAYa zudhu ei valala, ‘eTAke hatyA kara vA agnidagdha kara|’ kintu AllAh tAke agni hate rakSA karalena| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janye|

ivrAhIma valala, ‘tomarA to AllAh ra parivarte mUrtigulike upAsyarUpe grahaNa karecha, pArthiva jIvane tomAdera pArasparika vandhutvera khAtire| pare kiYAmatera dina tomarA eke aparake asvIkAra karave evaM paraspara parasparake abhisampAta dive| tomAdera AvAsa have jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|’
lUta tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karala| ivrAhIma valala, ‘Ami AmAra pratipAlakera uddezye deza tyAga karachi| tini to parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’

Ami ivrAhImake dAna karalAma isahAka o iYA‘ka‚va evaM tAra vaMzadharadera janye sthira karalAma navuoYAta o kitAva evaM Ami tAke duniYAYa puraskRta karechilAma; AkhirAteo se nizcaYai satkarmaparAYaNadera anyatama have|
smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, se tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘tomarA to emana azlIla karma karacho, yA tomAdera pUrve vizve keu kare nAi|

‘tomarAi to puruSe upagata haccho, tomarAi to rAhAjAni kare thAka evaM tomarAi to nijedera majalise prakAzye ghRNya karma kare thAka|’ uttare tAra sampradAYa zudhu ei valala, ‘AmAdera opara AllAh ra zAsti AnaYana kara-yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! viparyaYa sRSTikArI sampradAYera viruddhe AmAke sAhAyya kara|’
yakhana AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa susaMvAdasaha ivrAhImera nikaTa elo, tArA valechila, ‘AmarA ei janapadavAsIderake dhvaMsa karava, eTAra adhivAsIrA to jAlima|’

ivrAhIma valala, ‘ei janapade to lUta raYeche|’ erA valala, ‘sekhAne kAhArA Ache, tA AmarA bhAla jAni, AmarA to lUtake o tAra parijanavargake rakSA karavai, tAra strIke vyatIta; se to pazcAte avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|’

evaM yakhana AmAra prerita phirizatAgaNa lUtera nikaTa elo, takhana tAdera janye se viSaNNa haYe par3ala evaM nijeke tAdera rakSAYa asamartha mane karala| erA valala, ‘bhaYa kara nA, duHkha kara nA; AmarA tomAke o tomAra parijanavargake rakSA karava, tomAra strI vyatIta; se to pazcAte avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta;
‘AmarA ei janapadavAsIdera opara AkAza hate zAsti nAyila karava, kAraNa erA pApAcAra karachila|’
Ami to vodhazaktisampanna sampradAYera janye ete ekaTi spaSTa nidarzana rekhechi|
Ami mAdiYAnavAsIdera prati tAdera bhAi zu‘AYavake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara, zeSa divasake bhaYa kara evaM pRthivIte viparyaYa ghaTAio nA|’
kintu erA tAra prati mithyA Aropa karala; erapara erA bhUmikampa diYe AkrAnta hala; phale erA nija gRhe natajAnu avasthAYa zeSa haYe gela|

evaM Ami ‘Ada o sAmUdake dhvaMsa karechilAma; edera vAr3igharai tomAdera janye eTAra suspaSTa pramANa| zaYatAna edera kAjake edera dRSTite zobhana karechila evaM ederake satpatha avalamvane vAdhA diYechila, yadio erA chila vicakSaNa|
evaM Ami saMhAra karechilAma kArUna, phira‘Aona o hAmAnake| mUsA edera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanasaha esechila; takhana tArA deze dambha karata; kintu erA AmAra zAsti er3Aite pAre nAi|

edera pratyekakei Ami tAra aparAdhera janye zAsti diYechilAma: edera kArao prati preraNa karechi prastarasaha pracaNDa jhaTikA, edera kAukeo AghAta karechila mahAnAda, kAukeo Ami prothita karechilAma bhUgarbhe evaM kAukeo karechilAma nimajjita| AllAh tAdera prati kona juluma karena nAi; tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karechila|
yArA AllAh ra parivarte aparake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare tAdera dRSTAnta mAkar3asAra nyAYa, ye nijera janye ghara vAnAYa evaM gharera madhye mAkar3asAra gharai to durvalatama, yadi erA jAnata|
erA AllAh ra parivarte yA kichuke AhvAna kare, AllAh to tA jAnena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
ei sakala dRSTAnta Ami mAnuSera janye dei, kintu kevala jJAnI vyaktirAi eTA vujhe|
AllAh yathAyathabhAve AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena; ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’minadera janye|

tumi AvRtti kara kitAva hate yA tomAra prati pratyAdeza karA haYa| evaM sAlAta kAYema kara| sAlAta avazyai virata rAkhe azlIla o manda kArya hate| Ara AllAh ra smaraNai to sarvazreSTha| tomarA yA kara AllAh tA jAnena|

tomarA uttama panthA vyatIta kitAvIdera saGge vitarka karave nA, tave tAdera saGge karate pAra, yArA edera madhye sImAlaMghanakArI| evaM vala, ‘AmAdera prati o tomAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche, tAte AmarA vizvAsa kari evaM AmAdera ilAh o tomAdera ilAh to ekai evaM AmarA tA~rai prati AtmasamarpaNakArI|’

eibhAvei Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi evaM yAderake Ami kitAva diYechilAma tArA ete vizvAsa kare| Ara ederao keu keu ete vizvAsa kare| keu asvIkAra kare nA AmAra nidarzanAvalI kAphira vyatIta|
tumi to eTAra pUrve kona kitAva pATha kara nAi evaM svahaste kona kitAva likha nAi ye, mithyAcArIrA sandeha poSaNa karave|
varaM yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche vastuta tAdera antare eTA spaSTa nidarzana| kevala jAlimarAi AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra kare|
erA vale, ‘tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tAra nikaTa nidarzana prerita haYa nA kena?’ vala, ‘nidarzana AllAh ra i ikhtiYAre| Ami to ekajana prakAzya satarkakArI mAtra|’
eTA ki edera janye yatheSTa naYa ye, Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi, yA edera nikaTa pATha karA haYa? ete avazyai anugraha o upadeza raYeche sei kaomera janye yArA ImAna Ane|
vala, ‘AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA Ache tA tini avagata evaM yArA asatye vizvAsa kare o AllAhke asvIkAra kare tArAi to kSatigrasta|’
erA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale| yadi nirdhArita kAla nA thAkata tave zAsti tAdera opara avazyai Asata| nizcaYai edera opara zAsti Asave AkasmikabhAve, edera ajJAtasAre|
erA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale, jAhAnnAma to kAphiraderake pariveSTana karavei|
sei dina zAsti ederake Acchanna karave Urdhva o adhaHdeza hate evaM tini valavena, ‘tomarA yA karate tA AsvAdana kara|’
he AmAra mu’mina vAndAgaNa! nizcaYa AmAra pRthivI prazasta; sutarAM tomarA AmArai ‘ivAdata kara|
jIvamAtrai mRtyura svAda grahaNakArI; erapara tomarA AmArai nikaTa pratyAvartita have|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare Ami avazyai tAdera vasavAsera janye suucca prAsAda dAna karava jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, kata uttama pratidAna sei sakala karmazIladera janye,
yArA dhairya dhAraNa kare evaM tAdera pratipAlakera opara nirbhara kare|
emana kata jIvajantu Ache yArA nijedera khAdya maojuda rAkhe nA| AllAhi riyika dAna karena ederake o tomAderake; evaM tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yadi tumi ederake jijJAsA kara, ‘ke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM candra-sUryake niYantrita karechena?’ erA avazyai valave, ‘AllAh’| tA hale, erA kothAYa phire yAcche!
AllAh tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janye icchA tAra riyika vardhita karena evaM yAra janye icchA tA sImita karena| nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe samyaka avahita|

yadi tumi ederake jijJAsA kara, AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kare ke bhUmike saJjIvita karena era mRtyura para? erA avazyai valave, ‘AllAh’| vala, ‘samasta prazaMsA AllAh ra i|’ kintu edera adhikAMzai eTA anudhAvana kare nA|
ei pArthiva jIvana to krIr3A-kautuka vyatIta kichui naYa| pAralaukika jIvanai to prakRta jIvana, yadi erA jAnata!
erA yakhana nauyAne ArohaNa kare takhana erA vizuddhacitta haYe ekaniSThabhAve AllAhke DAke| erapara tini yakhana sthale bhir3iYe ederake uddhAra karena, takhana erA zirake lipta haYa,
yAte edera prati AmAra dAna erA asvIkAra kare evaM bhoga-vilAse matta thAke; acirei erA jAnate pArave!

erA ki dekhe nA Ami ‘hArAma’ke nirApada sthAna karechi, athaca eTAra catuSpArzve yesava mAnuSa Ache, tAdera opara hAmalA karA haYa, tave ki erA asatyei vizvAsa karave evaM AllAh ra anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ye vyakti AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA kare vA tA~ra nikaTa hate Agata satyake asvIkAra kare tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? jAhAnnAmai ki kAphiradera AvAsa naYa?
yArA AmAra uddezye saMgrAma kare Ami tAderake avazyai AmAra pathe paricAlita karava| AllAh avazyai satkarmaparAYaNadera saGge thAkena|
Alipha-lAma-mIma,
romakagaNa parAjita haYeche-
nikaTavartI aJcale; kintu erA edera ei parAjaYera para zIghrai vijaYI have,
kaYeka vatsarera madhyei| pUrvera o parera phaYasAlA AllAharai| Ara sei dina mu’minagaNa harSeAtphulla have,
AllAh ra sAhAyye| tini yAke icchA sAhAyya karena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
eTA AllAh ra i pratizruti; AllAh tAra pratizruti vyatikrama karena nA, kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA|
erA pArthiva jIvanera vAhya dika samvandhe avagata, Ara AkhirAta samvandhe erA gAphila|

erA ki nijedera antare bheve dekhe nA? AllAh AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o edera antarvartI samasta kichu sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve evaM eka nirdiSTa kAlera janye| kintu mAnuSera madhye anekei tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAte avizvAsI|

erA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA? tA hale dekhita ye, edera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kirUpa haYechila! zaktite tArA chila edera apekSA pravala, tArA jami cASa karata, tArA tA AvAda karata edera AvAda karA apekSA adhika| tAdera nikaTa esechila tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanasaha; vastuta AllAh emana nana ye, edera prati juluma karena, erA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karechila|
erapara yArA manda karma karechila tAdera pariNAma haYeche manda; kAraNa tArA AllAh ra AYAta asvIkAra karata evaM tA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karata|
AllAh Adite sRSTira sUcanA karena, erapara tini eTAra punarAvRtti karavena, tArapara tomarA tA~rai nikaTa pratyAnIta have|
yei dina kiYAmata have sei dina aparAdhIrA hatAza haYe par3ave|
edera deva-devIguli edera janye supArizakArI have nA evaM erA edera deva-devIgulike pratyAkhyAna karave|
yei dina kiYAmata have sei dina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ataeva yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tArA jAnnAte thAkave;
evaM yArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o AkhirAtera sAkSAt asvIkAra kareche, tArAi zAsti bhoga karate thAkave|
sutarAM tomarA AllAh ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara sandhyAYa o prabhAte-
evaM aparAhne o yoharera samaYe; Ara AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte sakala prazaMsA to tA~hArai|
tinii mRta hate jIvantera AvirbhAva ghaTAna evaM tinii jIvanta hate mRtera AvirbhAva ghaTAna evaM bhUmike punarjIvita karena era mRtyura para| eibhAvei tomarA utthita have|
tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tini tomAderake mRttikA hate sRSTi karechena| tAra para ekhana tomarA mAnuSa, sarvatra char3iYe par3atecha|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tini tomAdera janye tomAdera madhya hate sRSTi karechena tomAdera saMginIderake yAte tomarA edera nikaTa zAnti pAo evaM tomAdera madhye pArasparika bhAlavAsA o daYA sRSTi karechena| cintAzIla sampradAYera janye ete avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche|
Ara tA~hAra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTi evaM tomAdera bhASA o varNera vaicitrya| ete jJAnIdera janye avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche rAtrite o divAbhAge tomAdera nidrA evaM tomAdera ane¦SaNa tA~ra anugraha hate| ete avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche zonekArI sampradAYera janye|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche, tini tomAderake pradarzana karena vidyut, bhaYa o bharasA saJcArakarUpe evaM AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena o tA diYe bhUmike punarujjIvita karena era mRtyura para; ete avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche vodhazaktisampanna sampradAYera janye|

evaM tAra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tA~rai Adeze AkAza o pRthivIra sthiti thAke; erapara AllAh yakhana tomAderake mRttikA hate uThivAra janye ekavAra AhvAna karavena takhana tomarA uThiYA Asave|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai| sakalei tA~ra AjJAvaha|
tini sRSTike astitve AnaYana karena, erapara tini eTAke sRSTi karavena punarvAra; eTA tA~ra janye ati sahaja| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte sarveAcca maryAdA tA~rai; evaM tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAh tomAdera janye tomAdera nijedera madhye ekaTi dRSTAnta peza karachena: tomAderake Ami ye riyika diYechi, tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsigaNera keu ki tAte aMzIdAra? phale tomarA ki ei vyApAre samAna? tomarA ki ederake seirUpa bhaYa kara yeirUpa tomarA paraspara parasparake bhaYa kara? eibhAvei Ami vodhazaktisampanna lokadera nikaTa nidarzanAvalI vivRta kari|
varaM sImAlaMghanakArIrA ajJAnatAvazata tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kare, sutarAM AllAh yAke pathabhraSTa karechena, ke tAke satpathe paricAlita karave? Ara tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ekaniSTha haYe nijake dIne pratiSThita kara| AllAh ra prakRtira anusaraNa kara, ye prakRti anuyAYI tini mAnuSa sRSTi karechena; AllAh ra sRSTira kona parivartana nei| eTAi sarala dIna; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
vizuddhacitte tA~ra abhimukhI haYe tAke bhaYa kara, sAlAta kAYema kara evaM antarbhukta haYo nA muzarikadera,
yArA nijedera dIne matabheda sRSTi kareche evaM vibhinna dale vibhakta haYeche| pratyeka dalai nija nija matavAda niYe utphulla|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-dainya sparza kare takhana erA vizuddhacitte edera pratipAlakake DAke| erapara tini yakhana ederake svIYa anugraha AsvAdana karAna takhana edera ekadala edera pratipAlakera zarIka kare thAke;
phale ederake Ami yA diYechi, tA erA asvIkAra kare| sutarAM bhoga kare lao, zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave|
Ami ki edera nikaTa emana kona dalIla avatIrNa karechi yA ederake zarIka karate vale?
Ami yakhana mAnuSake anugrahera AsvAda dei erA tAte utphulla haYa evaM edera kRtakarmera phale durdazAgrasta halei erA hatAza haYe par3e|
erA ki lakSya kare nA, AllAh yAra janye icchA riyika prazasta karena evaM sImita karena? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janye|
ataeva AtmIYake dive tAra haka evaM abhAvagrasta o musAphirakeo| yArA AllAh ra santuSTi kAmanA kare tAdera janye eTA zreYa evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

mAnuSera dhane vRddhi pAve vale tomarA ye suda diYe thAka, AllAh ra dRSTite tA dhana-sampada vRddhi kare nA| kintu AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhera janye ye yAkAta tomarA diYe thAka tAi vRddhi pAYa; erAi samRddhizAlI|

AllAhi tomAderake sRSTi karechena, erapara tomAderake riyika diYechena, tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena o pare tomAderake jIvita karavena| tomAdera deva-devIgulira emana keu Ache ki, ye e samastera kona kichu karate pAre? erA yAderake zarIka kare, AllAh tA hate pavitra, mahAna|
mAnuSera kRtakarmera daruna sthale o samudre viparyaYa char3iYe par3e; yAra phale ederake edera kona kona karmera zAsti tini AsvAdana karAna, yAte erA phire Ase|
vala, ‘tomarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM dekha tomAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kI haYeche!’ edera adhikAMzai chila muzarika|
tumi sarala dIne nijake pratiSThita kara, AllAh ra pakSa hate ye divasa anivArya tA upasthita haoYAra pUrve, sei dina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ye kupharI kare, kupharIra zAsti tArai prApya; yArA satkarma kare tArA nijederai janye racanA kare sukhazayyA|
kAraNa yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare AllAh tAderake nija anugrahe puraskRta karena| tini kAphiraderake pachanda karena nA|

tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra ekaTi ye, tini vAYu preraNa karena susaMvAda divAra janye o tomAderake tA~ra anugraha AsvAdana karAivAra janye; evaM yAte tA~ra nirdeze nauyAnaguli vicaraNa kare, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra o tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao|

Ami to tomAra pUrve rAsUlagaNake preraNa karechilAma tAdera nija nija sampradAYera nikaTa| tArA edera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila; erapara Ami aparAdhIderake zAsti diYechilAma| mu’minaderake sAhAyya karA AmAra dAYitva|

AllAh, tini vAYu preraNa karena, phale eTA meghamAlAke saJcAlita kare; erapara tini eTAke yemana icchA AkAze char3iYe dena; pare eTAke khaNDa-vikhaNDa karena evaM tumi dekhate pAo tA hate nirgata haYa vAridhArA; erapara yakhana tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAdera nikaTa icchA eTA peৗ~che dena, takhana erA haYa harSeAtphulla,
yadio itipUrve edera prati vRSTi varSaNera Age erA nirAza chila|
AllAh ra anugrahera phala samvandhe cintA kara, kibhAve tini bhUmike jIvita karena era mRtyura para| eibhAvei AllAh mRtake jIvita karena, kAraNa tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
Ara Ami yadi emana vAYu preraNa kari yAra phale erA dekhe zasya pItavarNa dhAraNa kareche, takhana to erA akRtajJa haYe par3e|
tumi to mRtake zonAite pArave nA, vadhirakeo pArave nA AhvAna zonAite, yakhana erA mukha phiriYe cale yAYa|
Ara tumi andhakeo pathe Anate pArave nA edera pathabhraSTatA hate| yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa kare zudhu tAderakei tumi zonAite pArave, kAraNa tArA AtmasamarpaNakArI|
AllAh, tini tomAderake sRSTi karena durvala avasthAYa, durvalatAra para tini dena zakti; zaktira para AvAra dena durvalatA o vArdhakya| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM tinii sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
yedina kiYAmata have sedina aparAdhIrA zapatha kare valave ye, tArA muhUrtakAlera vezi avasthAna kare nAi| ebhAvei tArA satyabhraSTa hata|
kintu yAderake jJAna o ImAna deoYA haYeche tArA valave, ‘tomarA to AllAh ra vidhAne punarutthAna divasa paryanta avasthAna karecha| eTAi to punarutthAna divasa, kintu tomarA jAnate nA|’
sei dina sImAlaMghanakArIdera oyara-Apatti edera kAje Asave nA evaM ederake AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhera suyogao deoYA have nA|
Ami to mAnuSera janye ei kuraAne sarvaprakAra dRSTAnta diYechi| tumi yadi edera nikaTa kona nidarzana upasthita kara, kAphirarA avazyai valave, ‘tomarA to mithyAzraYI|’
yAdera jJAna nei AllAh ebhAve tAdera hRdaYa mohara kare dena|
ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, nizcaYai AllAh ra pratizruti satya| yArA dRr3ha vizvAsI naYa tArA yena tomAke vicalita karate nA pAre|
Alipha-lAma-mIma;
eiguli jJAnagarbha kitAvera AYAta,
pathanirdeza o daYAsvarUpa satkarmaparAYaNadera janye;
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa, Ara tArAi AkhirAte nizcita vizvAsI;
tArAi tAdera pratipAlakera nirdezita pathe Ache evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

mAnuSera madhye keu keu ajJatAvazata AllAh ra patha hate vicyuta karAra janye asAra vAkya kraYa kare neYa evaM AllAh-pradarzita patha niYe ThATTA-vidrupa kare| ederai janye raYeche avamAnanAkara zAsti|
yakhana era nikaTa AmAra AYAta avRtti karA haYa takhana se dambhabhare mukha phiriYe neYa yena se eTA zunate pAYa nAi, yena era karNa duiTi vadhira; ataeva ederake marmantuda zAstira saMvAda dAo|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAdera janye Ache sukhada kAnana;
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| AllAh ra pratizruti satya| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa!

tini AkAzamaNDalI nirmANa karechena stambha vyatIta-tomarA eTA dekhacha; tinii pRthivIte sthApana karechena parvatamAlA yAte eTA tomAderake niYe Dhale nA par3e evaM ete char3iYe diYechena sarvaprakAra jIvajantu| evaM Amii AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kare ete udgata kari sarvaprakAra kalyANakara udbhida|
eTA AllAh ra sRSTi! tini vyatIta anyerA kI sRSTi kareche AmAke dekhAo| sImAlaMghanakArIrA to spaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche|

Ami to lukamAnake jJAna dAna karechilAma evaM valechilAma ye, AllAh ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare se to tA kare nijerai janye evaM keu akRtajJa hale AllAh to abhAvamukta, prazaMsArha|
smaraNa kara, yakhana lukamAna upadezacchale tAra putrake valechila, ‘he vatsa! AllAh ra kona zarIka kara nA| nizcaYai ziraka carama juluma|’

Ami to mAnuSake tAra pitAmAtAra prati sadAcaraNera nirdeza diYechi| jananI santAnake kaSTera para kaSTa varaNa kare garbhe dhAraNa kare evaM tAra dudha chAr3Ana haYa dui vatsare| sutarAM AmAra prati o tomAra pitAmAtAra prati kRtajJa hao| pratyAvartana to AmArai nikaTa|

tomAra pitAmAtA yadi tomAke pIr3ApIr3i kare AmAra samakakSa dA~r3a karAte ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei, tumi tAdera kathA mAnio nA, tave pRthivIte tAdera saGge vasavAsa karave sadbhAve evaM ye vizuddhacitte AmAra abhimukhI haYeche tAra patha avalamvana kara, erapara tomAdera pratyAvartana AmArai nikaTa evaM tomarA yA karate se viSaYe Ami tomAderake avahita karava|
‘he vatsa! kSudra vastuTi yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao haYa evaM tA yadi thAke zilAgarbhe vA AkAze kiMvA mRttikAra nice, AllAh tAo upasthita karavena| nizcaYai AllAh sUkSmadarzI, samyaka avagata|
‘he vatsa! sAlAta kAYema kara, satkarmera nirdeza dio Ara asat karme niSedha kara evaM Apade-vipade dhairya dhAraNa kara| eTAi to dRr3hasaMkalpera kAja|
‘ahaMkAravaze tumi mAnuSake avajJA kara nA evaM pRthivIte uddhatabhAve vicaraNa kara nA; nizcaYai AllAh kona uddhata, ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|
‘tumi padakSepa kara saMyatabhAve evaM tomAra kaNThasvara nicu kara; nizcaYai svarera madhye gardabhera svarai sarvApekSA aprItikara|’

tomarA ki dekha nA, AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena evaM tomAdera prati tA~ra prakAzya o aprakAzya anugraha sampUrNa karechena? mAnuSera madhye keu keu ajJatAvazata AllAh samvandhe vitaNDA kare, tAdera nA Ache pathanirdezaka Ara nA Ache kona dIptimAna kitAva|

ederake yakhana valA haYa, ‘AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena tA anusaraNa kara|’ erA vale, ‘varaM AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake yAte peYechi tArai anusaraNa karava|’ zaYatAna yadi ederake jvalanta agnira zAstira dike AhvAna kare, tavuo ki?
ye keu AllAh ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa kare evaM satkarmaparAYaNa haYa se to dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare eka mayavuta hAtala, yAvatIYa karmera pariNAma AllAh ra ikhtiYAre|

Ara keu kupharI karale tAra kupharI yena tomAke kliSTa nA kare| AmArai nikaTa edera pratyAvartana| erapara Ami ederake avahita karava erA yA karata| antare yA raYeche se samvandhe AllAh savizeSa avahita|
Ami ederake jIvanopakaraNa bhoga karate diva svalpakAlera janye| erapara ederake kaThina zAsti bhoga karate vAdhya karava|
tumi yadi ederake jijJAsA kara, ‘AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI ke sRSTi karechena?’ erA nizcaYai valave, ‘AllAh’| vala, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra i’, kintu edera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA AllAh ra i; AllAh, tini to abhAvamukta, prazaMsArha|
pRthivIra samasta vRkSa yadi kalama haYa Ara samudra haYa kAli evaM eTAra saGge Arao sAta samudra yukta haYa, tavuo AllAh ra vANI niHzeSa have nA| nizcaYai AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomAdera sakalera sRSTi o punarutthAna ekaTi prANIra sRSTi o punarutthAnerai anurUpa| nizcaYai AllAh sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|

tumi ki dekha nA AllAh rAtrike divase evaM divasake rAtrite pariNata karena? tini candra-sUryake karechena niYamAdhIna, pratyekaTi vicaraNa kare nirdiSTa kAla paryanta; tomarA yA kara AllAh se samparke avahita|
eiguli pramANa ye, AllAhi satya evaM erA tA~ra parivarte yAke DAke, tA mithyA| AllAh, tini to samucca, mahAna|

tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, AllAh ra anugrahe nauyAnaguli samudre vicaraNa kare, yA diYe tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra kichu pradarzana karena? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJa vyaktira janye|

yakhana taraMga ederake Acchanna kare meghacchAYAra mata takhana erA AllAhke DAke tAra Anugatye vizuddhacitta haYe| kintu yakhana tini ederake uddhAra kare sthale pau~chAna takhana edera keu keu sarala pathe thAke; kevala vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJa vyaktii AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra kare|

he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kara evaM bhaYa kara sei dinera, yakhana pitA santAnera kona upakAre Asave nA, santAnao kona upakAre Asave nA tAra pitAra| AllAh ra pratizruti satya; sutarAM pArthiva jIvana yena tomAderake kichutei pratArita nA kare evaM sei pravaJcaka yena tomAderake kichutei AllAh samparke pravaJcita nA kare|

kiYAmatera jJAna kevala AllAh ra nikaTa raYeche, tini vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM tini jAnena yA jarAYute Ache| keu jAne nA AgAmIkalya se ki arjana karave evaM keu jAne nA kon sthAne tAra mRtyu ghaTave| nizcaYai AllAh sarvajJa, sarvaviSaYe avahita|
Alipha-lAma-mIma,
ei kitAva jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate avatIrNa, ete kona sandeha nei|

tave ki erA vale, ‘eTA se nije racanA kareche?’ nA, eTA tomAra pratipAlaka hate Agata satya, yAte tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karate pAra, yAdera nikaTa tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Ase nAi, haYata erA satpathe calave|

AllAh, yini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o edera antarvartI samasta kichu sRSTi karechena chaYa dine| erapara tini ‘Araze samAsIna hana| tini vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM supArizakArIo nei; tavu ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
tini AkAza hate pRthivI paryanta samudaYa viSaYa paricAlanA karena, erapara ekadina samasta kichui tA~ra samIpe samutthita have- ye dinera parimApa have tomAdera hiseve sahasra vatsara|
tinii adRzya o dRzya samvandhe parijJAta, parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu,
yini tAra pratyekaTi sRSTike sRjana karechena uttamarUpe, evaM kardama hate mAnava sRSTira sUcanA karechena|
erapara tini tAra vaMza utpanna karena tuccha tarala padArthera niryAsa hate|
pare tini eke karechena suThAma evaM ete phu~ke diYechena tA~ra rUh hate evaM tomAderake diYechena karNa, cokha o antaHkaraNa, tomarA ati sAmAnyai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
erA vale, ‘AmarA mRttikAYa paryavasita haleo ki AmAderake AvAra nUtana kare sRSTi karA have?’ varaM erA edera pratipAlakera sAkSAt asvIkAra kare|
vala, ‘tomAdera janye niyukta mRtyura phirizatA tomAdera prANa haraNa karave| avazeSe tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa pratyAnIta have|’

hAYa, tumi yadi dekhate! yakhana aparAdhIrA tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane adhovadana haYe valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA pratyakSa karalAma o zone karalAma, ekhana tumi AmAderake punarAYa preraNa kara, AmarA satkarma karava, AmarA to dRr3ha vizvAsI|’
Ami icchA karale pratyeka vyaktike satpathe paricAlita karatAma; kintu AmAra ei kathA avazyai satya: Ami nizcaYai jina o mAnuSa ubhaYa diYe jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|
sutarAM ‘zAsti AsvAdana kara, kAraNa AjikAra ei sAkSAtera kathA tomarA vismRta haYechile| Amio tomAderake vismRta haYechi, tomarA yA karate tAra janye tomarA sthAYI zAsti bhoga karate thAka|’
kevala tArAi AmAra nidarzanAvalI vizvAsa kare yArA era diYe upadiSTa hale sijdAYa luTiYe par3e evaM tAdera pratipAlakera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare Ara tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|
tArA zayyA tyAga kare tAdera pratipAlakake DAke AzAYa o AzaMkAYa evaM Ami tAderake ye riyika dAna karechi tA hate tArA vyaYa kare|
keui jAne nA tAdera janye naYana prItikara kI lukkAYita rAkhA haYeche tAdera kRtakarmera puraskArasvarUpa|
tave ye vyakti mu’mina, se ki pApAcArIra nyAYa? erA samAna naYa|
yArA ImAna Ane, satkarma kare tAdera kRtakarmera phalasvarUpa tAdera ApyAYanera janye tAdera sthAYI vAsasthAna have jAnnAta|

evaM yArA pApAcAra kareche tAdera vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma; yakhanai erA jAhAnnAma hate vera hate cAive takhanai ederake phiriYe deoYA have ete evaM ederake valA have, ‘ye agni-zAstike tomarA mithyA valite, tA AsvAdana kara|’
guru zAstira pUrve ederake Ami avazyai laghu zAsti AsvAdana karAiva, yAte erA phire Ase|
ye vyakti tAra pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI diYe upadiSTa haYe tA hate mukha phirAYa tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? Ami avazyai aparAdhIderake zAsti diYe thAki|
Ami to mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataeva tumi tAra sAkSAt samvandhe sandeha kara nA, Ami eTAke vanI isarAIlera janye pathanirdezaka karechilAma|
Ara Ami edera madhya hate netA manonIta karechilAma, yArA AmAra nirdeza anusAre patha pradarzana karata, yehetu erA dhairya dhAraNa karechila| Ara erA chila AmAra nidarzanAvalIte dRr3ha vizvAsI|
erA ye viSaYe matavirodha karache tomAra pratipAlakai kiYAmatera dina tAdera madhye era phaYasAlA kare divena|

eTAo ki tAderake patha pradarzana karala nA ye, Ami to edera pUrve dhvaMsa karechi kata mAnavagoSThI-yAdera vAsabha‚mite erA vicaraNa kare thAke? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche; tavuo ki erA zunave nA?
erA ki lakSya kare nA, Ami USara bha‚mira opara pAni pravAhita kare era sAhAyye udgata kari zasya, yA hate AhArya grahaNa kare edera An‘Ama evaM erAo? erA ki tavuo lakSya karave nA?
erA jijJAsA kare, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave vala, kakhana have ei phaYasAlA?’
vala, ‘phaYasAlAra dine kAphiradera ImAna AnaYana edera kona kAje Asave nA evaM ederake avakAzao deYA have nA|’
ataeva tumi ederake agrAhya kara evaM apekSA kara, erAo apekSA karache|
he navI! AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM kAphiradera o munAphikadera Anugatya kara nA| AllAh to sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA ohI haYa tAra anusaraNa kara; tomarA yA kara, AllAh to se viSaYe samyaka avahita|
Ara tumi nirbhara kara AllAh ra opara evaM karmavidhAne AllAhi yatheSTa|

AllAh kona mAnuSera abhyantare duiTi hRdaYa sRSTi karena nAi| tomAdera strIgaNa, yAdera saGge tomarA jihAra kare thAka, tini tAderake tomAdera jananI karena nAi evaM tomAdera poSya putraderake tini tomAdera putra karena nAi; eiguli tomAdera mukhera kathA| AllAh satya kathAi valena evaM tinii sarala patha nirdeza karena|

tomarA tAderake DAka tAdera pitR-paricaYe; AllAhara dRSTite eTA adhika nyAYasaMgata| yadi tomarA tAdera pitR-paricaYa nA jAna tave tArA tomAdera dInI bhAi evaM vandhu| ei vyApAre tomarA kona bhula karale tomAdera kona aparAdha nei; kintu tomAdera antare saMkalpa thAkale aparAdha have, Ara AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

navI mu’minadera nikaTa tAdera nijedera apekSA ghaniSThatara evaM tAra patnIgaNa tAdera mAtA| AllAh ra vidhAna anusAre mu’mina o muhAjiragaNa apekSA-yArA AtmIYa tArA parasparera nikaTatara| tave tomarA yadi tomAdera vandhu-vAndhavera prati Anuka‚lya pradarzana karate cAo- tA karate pAra| eTA kitAve lipivaddha|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami navIdera nikaTa hate aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma evaM tomAra nikaTa hateo evaM nUha, ivrAhIma, mUsA o mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsAra nikaTa hateo-tAdera nikaTa hate grahaNa karechilAma dRr3ha aGgIkAra-
satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditA samvandhe jijJAsA karAra janye| tini kAphiradera janye prastuta rekhechena marmantuda zAsti|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara, yakhana zatruvAhinI tomAdera viruddhe samAgata haYechila evaM Ami edera viruddhe preraNa karechilena jhaJjhAvAYu evaM eka vAhinI yA tomarA dekha nAi| tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|

yakhana erA tomAdera viruddhe samAgata haYechila tomAdera uparera dika o nicera dika hate, tomAdera cokha visphArita haYechila, tomAdera prANa haYe par3echila kaNThAgata evaM tomarA AllAh samvandhe nAnAvidha dhAraNA poSaNa karachile;
takhana mu’minagaNa parIkSita haYechila evaM tArA bhISaNabhAve prakampita haYechila|
Ara smaraNa kara, munAphikarA o yAdera antare chila vyAdhi, tArA valachila, ‘AllAh evaM tA~ra rAsUla AmAderake ye pratizruti diYechilena tA pratAraNA vyatIta kichui naYa|’

Ara edera ekadala valechila, ‘he iYAsrivavAsI! ekhAne tomAdera kona sthAna nei tomarA phire cala’ evaM edera madhye ekadala navIra nikaTa avyAhati prArthanA kare valachila, ‘AmAdera vAr3ighara arakSita’; athaca aiguli arakSita chila nA, Asale palAYana karAi chila edera uddezya|
yadi vibhinna dika hate tAdera viruddhe zatrudera praveza ghaTata, erapara tAderake vidrohera janye prarocita karA hata, tave tArA avazya tAi kare vasita, tArA ete kAlavilamva karata nA|
erA to pUrvei AllAh ra saGge aGgIkAra karechila ye, erA pRSTha pradarzana karave nA| AllAh ra saGge kRta aGgIkAra samvandhe avazyai jijJAsA karA have|
vala, ‘tomAdera kona lAbha have nA yadi tomarA mRtyu vA hatyAra bhaYe palAYana kara, tave sei kSetre tomAderake sAmAnyai bhoga karate deoYA have|’

vala, ‘ke tomAderake AllAh hate rakSA karave, yadi tini tomAdera amaGgala icchA karena vA tini yadi tomAderake anugraha karate icchA karena, tave ke tomAdera kSati karave?’ erA AllAh vyatIta nijedera kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
AllAh avazyai jAnena tomAdera madhye kAhArA vAdhAdAnakArI evaM kAhArA tAdera bhrAtRvargake vale, ‘AmAdera saGge Asa|’ erA alpai yuddhe aMza neYa-

tomAdera vyApAre kRpaNatAvazata| Ara yakhana bhIti Ase takhana tumi dekhave, mRtyubhaYe mUrcchAtura vyaktira mata cokha ulTiYe erA tomAra dike tAkAYa| kintu yakhana bhaYa cale yAYa takhana erA dhanera lAlasAYa tomAderake tIkSNa bhASAYa viddha kare| erA ImAna Ane nAi, eijanye AllAh edera kAryAvalI niSphala karechena evaM AllAh ra pakSe eTA sahaja|

erA mane kare, sammilita vAhinI cale yAYa nAi| yadi sammilita vAhinI AvAra ese par3e, takhana erA kAmanA karave ye, bhAla hata yadi erA yAyAvara maruvAsIdera saGge theke tomAdera saMvAda nita! erA tomAdera saGge avasthAna karaleo erA yuddha alpai karata|
tomAdera madhye yArA AllAh o AkhirAtake bhaYa kare evaM AllAhke adhika smaraNa kare tAdera janye to rAsUlullAhra madhye raYeche uttama Adarza|

mu’minagaNa yakhana sammilita vAhinIke dekhala, erA vale uThala, ‘eTA to tAi, AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla yAra pratizruti AmAderake diYechilena evaM AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla satyai valechilena|’ Ara ete tAdera ImAna o Anugatyai vRddhi pela|
mu’minadera madhye kataka AllAh ra saGge tAdera kRta aGgIkAra pUrNa kareche, edera keu keu zAhAdata varaNa kareche evaM keu keu pratIkSAYa raYeche| erA tAdera aGgIkAre kona parivartana kare nAi;
kAraNa AllAh satyavAdIderake puraskRta karena tAdera satyavAditAra janye evaM tA~ra icchA hale munAphikaderake zAsti dena vA ederake kSamA karena| nizcaYai AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAh kAphiraderake kruddhAvasthAYa phiriYe dilena, tArA kona kalyANa lAbha kare nAi| yuddhe mu’minadera janye AllAhi yatheSTa; AllAh sarvazaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

kitAvIdera madhye yArA ederake sAhAyya karechila, tAderake tini tAdera durga hate avataraNa karAilena evaM tAdera antare bhIti saJcAra karalena; ekhana tomarA edera katakake hatyA karacho evaM katakake karacho vandI|
Ara tini tomAderake adhikArI karalena edera bha‚mi, gharavAr3i o dhana-sampadera evaM emana bha‚mira yAte tomarA ekhanao padArpaNa kara nAi| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
he navI! tumi tomAra strIderake vala, ‘tomarA yadi pArthiva jIvana o era bha‚SaNa kAmanA kara tave Asa, Ami tomAdera bhoga-sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dei evaM saujanyera saGge tomAderake vidAYa dei|
‘Ara yadi tomarA kAmanA kara AllAh, tA~ra rAsUla o AkhirAta, tave tomAdera madhye yArA satkarmazIla AllAh tAdera janye mahApratidAna prastuta rekhechena|’
he navI-patnIgaNa! ye kAja spaSTata azlIla, tomAdera madhye keu tA karale tAke dviguNa zAsti deoYA have evaM eTA AllAh ra janye sahaja|
tomAdera madhye ye keu AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati anugata have o satkarma karave tAke Ami puraskAra diva duivAra evaM tAra janye Ami prastuta rekhechi sammAnajanaka riyika|

he navI-patnIgaNa! tomarA anya nArIdera mata nao; yadi tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara tave para-puruSera saGge komalakaNThe emanabhAve kathA vala nA, yAte antare yAra vyAdhi Ache, se praluvdha haYa evaM tomarA nyAYasaMgata kathA valave|

Ara tomarA svagRhe avasthAna karave evaM prAcIna yugera mata nijederake pradarzana kare ver3Ave nA| tomarA sAlAta kAYema karave o yAkAta pradAna karave evaM AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera anugata thAkave| he navI-parivAra! AllAh to kevala cAna tomAdera hate apavitratA dUra karate evaM tomAderake sampUrNarUpe pavitra karate|
AllAh ra AYAta o jJAnera kathA yA tomAdera gRhe paThita haYa, tA tomarA smaraNa rAkhave; nizcaYai AllAh ati sUkSmadarzI, sarvaviSaYe avahita|

avazyai AtmasamarpaNakArI puruSa o AtmasamarpaNakArI nArI, mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArI, anugata puruSa o anugata nArI, satyavAdI puruSa o satyavAdI nArI, dhairyazIla puruSa o dhairyazIla nArI, vinIta puruSa o vinIta nArI, dAnazIla puruSa o dAnazIla nArI, sAoma pAlanakArI puruSa o sAoma pAlanakArI nArI, yauna aMga hiphAyatakArI puruSa o yauna aMga hiphAyatakArI nArI, AllAhke adhika smaraNakArI puruSa o adhika smaraNakArI nArI-edera janye AllAh rekhechena kSamA o mahA-pratidAna|

AllAh o tA~ra rAsUla kona viSaYe nirdeza dile kona mu’mina puruSa kiMvA mu’mina nArIra se viSaYe bhinna siddhAntera adhikAra thAkave nA| keu AllAh evaM tA~ra rAsUlake amAnya karale se to spaSTa pathabhraSTa have|

smaraNa kara, AllAh yAke anugraha karechena evaM tumio yAra prati anugraha karecha, tumi tAke valitechile, ‘tumi tomAra strIra saGge samparka vajAYa rAkha evaM AllAhke bhaYa kara|’ tumi tomAra antare yA gopana karacho AllAh tA prakAza kare dicchena; tumi lokabhaYa karachile, athaca AllAhkei bhaYa karA tomAra pakSe adhikatara saMgata| erapara yAYada yakhana yaYanavera saGge vivAha samparka chinna karala, takhana Ami tAke tomAra saGge pariNaYasUtre Avaddha karalAma, yAte mu’minadera poSya putragaNa nija strIra saGge vivAhasUtra chinna karale seisava ramaNIke vivAha karAYa mu’minadera kona vighna nA haYa| AllAh ra Adeza kAryakarI haYei thAke|
AllAh navIra janye yA vidhisammata karechena tA karate tAra janye kona vAdhA nAi| pUrve yesava navI atIta haYe geche, tAdera kSetreo eTAi chila AllAh ra vidhAna| AllAh ra vidhAna sunirdhArita|
tArA AllAh ra vANI pracAra karata evaM tA~ke bhaYa karata, Ara AllAhke vyatIta anya kAukeo bhaYa karata nA| hiseva grahaNe AllAhi yatheSTa|
muhAmmada tomAdera madhye kona puruSera pitA naYa; varaM se AllAh ra rAsUla evaM zeSa navI| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhke adhika smaraNa kara,
evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAh ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
tini tomAdera prati anugraha karena evaM tA~ra pherezatAgaNao tomAdera janye anugraha prArthanA kare| andhakAra hate tomAderake Aloke AnavAra janye, evaM tini mu’minadera prati parama daYAlu|
yedina tArA AllAh ra saGge sAkSAt karave, sedina tAdera prati abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’| tini tAdera janye prastuta rekhechena uttama pratidAna|
he navI! Ami to tomAke pAThiYechi sAkSIrUpe evaM susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe,
AllAh ra anumatikrame tA~ra dike AhvAnakArIrUpe evaM ujjvala pradIparUpe|
tumi mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janye AllAh ra nikaTa raYeche mahAanugraha|
Ara tumi kAphira o munAphikadera kathA zunio nA, edera niryAtana upekSA kara evaM nirbhara kara AllAh ra opara; karmavidhAYakarUpe AllAhi yatheSTa|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA mu’mina nArIgaNake vivAha karAra para ederake sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka dile tomAdera janye tAdera pAlanIYa kona iddata nei yA tomarA gaNanA karave| tomarA ederake kichu sAmagrI dive evaM saujanyera saGge ederake vidAYa karave|

he navI! Ami tomAra janye vaidha karechi tomAra strIgaNake, yAdera mAhra tumi pradAna karecha evaM vaidha karechi phAYa hiseve AllAh tomAke yA dAna karechena tanmadhya hate yArA tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna haYeche tAderake, evaM vivAhera janye vaidha karechi tomAra cAcAra kanyA o phuphura kanyAke, mAmAra kanyA o khAlAra kanyAke, yArA tomAra saGge deza tyAga kareche evaM kona mu’mina nArI navIra nikaTa nijake nivedana karale evaM navI tAke vivAha karate cAile seo vaidha- eTA vizeSa kare tomArai janye, anya mu’minadera janye naYa; yAte tomAra kona asuvidhA nA haYa| mu’minadera strI evaM tAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsigaNa samvandhe yA nirdhArita karechi, tA Ami jAni| AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tumi edera madhye yAke icchA tomAra nikaTa hate dUre rAkhate pAra evaM yAke icchA tomAra nikaTa sthAna dite pAra| Ara tumi yAke dUre rekhecha tAke kAmanA karale tomAra kona aparAdha nei| ei vidhAna eijanye ye, ete edera tuSTi sahajatara have evaM erA duHkha pAve nA Ara ederake tumi yA dive tAte edera pratyekei prIta thAkave| tomAdera antare yA Ache AllAh tA jAnena| AllAh sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

eTAra para, tomAra janye kona nArI vaidha naYa evaM tomAra strIdera parivarte anya strI grahaNao vaidha naYa yadio edera saundarya tomAke mugdha kare; tave tomAra adhikArabhukta dAsIdera vyApAre ei vidhAna prayojya naYa| AllAh samasta kichura opara tIkSNa dRSTi rAkhena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAderake anumati deoYA nA hale tomarA AhArya prastutira janye apekSA nA kare bhojanera janye navIgRhe praveza kara nA| tave tomAderake AhavAna karale tomarA praveza kara evaM bhojanazeSe cale yeo; tomarA kathAvArtAYa mazagula haYe par3o nA| kAraNa tomAdera ei AcaraNa navIke pIr3A deYa, se tomAderake uThAiYA dite saMkoca vodha kare| kintu AllAh satya valate saMkoca vodha karena nA| tomarA tAra patnIdera nikaTa hate kichu cAile pardAra antarAla hate cAive| ei vidhAna tomAdera o tAdera hRdaYera janye adhikatara pavitra| tomAdera kArao pakSe AllAh ra rAsUlake kaSTa deoYA saMgata naYa evaM tAra mRtyura para tAra patnIderake vivAha karA tomAdera janye kakhanao vaidha naYa| AllAh ra dRSTite eTA ghoratara aparAdha|
tomarA kona viSaYa prakAza kara vA gopana rAkha-AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

navI-patnIdera janye tAdera pitRgaNa, putragaNa, bhrAtRgaNa, bhrAtaSputragaNa, bhagnIputragaNa, sevikAgaNa evaM tAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIgaNera vyApAre tA pAlana nA karA aparAdha naYa| he navI-patnIgaNa! AllAhke bhaYa kara, AllAh samasta kichu pratyakSa karena|

AllAha navIra prati anugraha karena evaM tA~ra pherezatAgaNao navIra janye anugraha prArthanA kare| he mu’minagaNa! tomarAo navIra janye anugraha prArthanA kara evaM tAke yathAyathabhAve sAlAma jAnAo|
yArA AllAh o rAsUlake pIr3A deYa, AllAh to tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte abhizapta karena evaM tini tAdera janye prastuta rekhechena lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
yArA mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIderake pIr3A deYa emana kona aparAdhera janye yA tArA kare nAi; tArA apavAdera o spaSTa pApera vojhA vahana kare|

he navI! tumi tomAra strIgaNake, kanyAgaNake o mu’minadera nArIgaNake vala, tArA yena tAdera cAdarera kiYadaMza nijedera opara TAniYA deYa| ete tAderake cenA sahajatara have, phale tAderake uttyakta karA have nA| AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

munAphikarA evaM yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache evaM yArA nagare gujava raTanA kare tArA virata nA hale Ami nizcaYai tAdera viruddhe tomAke pravala karava; eTAra para ei nagarIte tomAra prativezIrUpe erA svalpa samaYai thAkave-
abhizapta haYe; ederake yekhAnei pAoYA yAve sekhAnei dharA have evaM nirdaYabhAve hatyA karA have|
pUrve yArA atIta haYe geche tAdera vyApAre eTAi chila AllAh ra rIti| tumi kakhanao AllAh ra rItite kona parivartana pAve nA|
loke tomAke kiYAmata samparke jijJAsA kare| vala, ‘eTAra jJAna kevala AllAh ra i Ache|’ tumi eTA kI kare jAnave? sambhavata kiYAmata zIghrai haYe yete pAre|
AllAh kAphiraderake abhizapta karechena evaM tAdera janye prastuta rekhechena jvalanta agni|
sekhAne erA sthAYI have evaM erA kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
yedina edera mukhamaNDala agnite ulaTapAlaTa karA have sedina erA valave, ‘hAYa, AmarA yadi AllAhake mAnatAma o rAsUlake mAnatAma!’
tArA Arao valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA AmAdera netA o prabhAvazAlIdera Anugatya karechilAma evaM erA AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila;
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ederake dviguNa zAsti dAo evaM ederake dAo mahAabhisampAta|’
he mu’minagaNa! mUsAke yArA kleza diYeche tomarA edera nyAYa haYo nA; erA yA raTanA karechila AllAh tA hate tAke nirdeASa pramANa karena; evaM AllAh ra nikaTa se maryAdAvAna|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM saThika kathA vala;
tA hale tini tomAdera janye tomAdera karma truTimukta karavena evaM tomAdera pApa kSamA karavena| yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare, tArA avazyai mahAsAphalya arjana karave|

Ami to AsamAna, yamIna o parvatamAlAra prati ei AmAnata peza karechilAma, erA eTA vahana karate asvIkAra karala evaM ete zaMkita hala, kintu mAnuSa tA vahana karala; se to atizaYa jAlima, atizaYa ajJa|
pariNAme AllAh munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArIke zAsti divena evaM mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIke kSamA karavena| AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samasta kichurai mAlika evaM AkhirAteo prazaMsA tA~rai| tini prajJAmaYa, sarvaviSaYe avahita|
tini jAnena yA bhUmite praveza kare, yA tA hate nirgata haYa evaM yA AkAza hate nAyila haYa evaM yA kichu ete utthita haYa| tinii parama daYAlu, atizaYa kSamAzIla|

kAphirarA vale, ‘AmAdera nikaTa kiYAmata Asave nA|’ vala, ‘Asavei, zapatha AmAra pratipAlakera, nizcaYai tomAdera nikaTa tA Asave|’ tini adRzya samvandhe samyaka parijJAta; AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte tA~ra agocara naYa aNu parimANa kichu kiMvA tadapekSA kSudra vA vRhat kichu; eTAra pratyekaTi Ache suspaSTa kitAve|
eTA ejanye ye, yArA mu’mina o satkarmaparAYaNa tini tAderake puraskRta karavena| ederai janye Ache kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyika|
yArA AmAra AYAtake vyartha karAra ceSTA kare tAdera janye raYeche bhaYaMkara marmantuda zAsti|
yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche tArA jAne ye, tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAi satya; eTA parAkramazAlI prazaMsArha AllAh ra pathanirdeza kare|
kAphirarA vale, AmarA ki tomAderake emana vyaktira sandhAna diva ye tomAderake vale, ‘tomAdera deha sampUrNa chinnabhinna haYe par3ileo tomarA nUtana sRSTirUpe utthita havei?’
se ki AllAh samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kare vA se ki unmAda? vastuta yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tArA zAsti o ghora vibhrAntite raYeche|

erA ki edera sAmane o pazcAte AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache tAra prati lakSya kare nA? Ami icchA karale ederakesaha bha‚mi dhasiYe diva vA edera opara AkAzakhaNDera patana ghaTAva; AllAh ra abhimukhI pratiTi vAndAra janye ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
Ami nizcaYai dAUdera prati anugraha karechilAma evaM Adeza karechilAma, ‘he parvatamAlA! tomarA dAUdera saGge AmAra pavitratA ghoSaNA kara’ evaM vihaGgakulakeo, tAra janye namanIYa karechilAma lauha-
‘yAte tumi pUrNa mApera varma taiYAra karate evaM vunane parimANa rakSA karate pAra’ evaM tomarA satkarma kara, tomarA yA kichu kara Ami era samyaka draSTA|

Ami sulAYamAnera adhIna karechilAma vAYuke yA prabhAte eka mAsera patha atikrama karata evaM sandhyAYa eka mAsera patha atikrama karata| Ami tAra janye galita tAmrera eka prasravaNa pravAhita karechilAma| tAra pratipAlakera anumatikrame jinadera kataka tAra sAmane kAja karata| edera madhye ye AmAra nirdeza amAnya kare tAke Ami jvalanta agni-zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

erA sulAYamAnera icchAnuyAYI prAsAda, bhAskarya, hAoyasadRza vRhadAkAra pAtra evaM sudRr3habhAve sthApita Dega nirmANa karata| Ami valechilAma, ‘he dAUda-parivAra! kRtajJatAra saGge tomarA kAja karate thAka| AmAra vAndAdera madhye alpai kRtajJa!’

yakhana Ami sulAYamAnera mRtyu ghaTAilAma takhana jinaderake tAra mRtyu viSaYa jAnAla kevala mATira pokA yA tAra lAThi khAcchila| yakhana se par3e gela takhana jinerA vujhate pArala ye, erA yadi adRzya viSaYa avagata thAkata tA hale erA lAJchanAdAYaka zAstite Avaddha thAkata nA|

sAvAvAsIdera janya to uhAdera vAsabhUmite chila eka nidarzana: duiTi udyAna, ekaTi DAna dike, aparaTi vAma dike, ederake valA haYechila, ‘tomarA tomAdera pratipAlaka-pradatta riyika bhoga kara evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| uttama nagarI evaM kSamAzIla pratipAlaka|’

pare erA avAdhya hala| phale Ami edera opara pravAhita karalAma vA~dhabhAGgA vanyA evaM edera udyAna duiTike parivartana kare dilAma emana duiTi udyAne yAte utpanna haYa visvAda phalamUla, jhAu gAcha evaM kichu kula gAcha|
Ami ederake ei zAsti diYechilAma edera kupharIra janye| Ami kRtaghna vyatIta Ara kAukeo emana zAsti dei nA|

edera o yesava janapadera prati Ami anugraha karechilAma seigulira madhyavartI sthAne dRzyamAna vahu janapada sthApana karechilAma evaM aisava janapade bhramaNera yathAyatha vyavasthA karechilAma evaM ederake valechilAma, ‘tomarA eisava janapade nirApade bhramaNa kara divasa o rajanIte|’

kintu erA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera sapharera manayilera vyavadhAna vardhita kara|’ erA nijedera prati juluma karechila| phale Ami ederake kAhinIra viSaYavastute pariNata karalAma evaM ederake chinnabhinna kare dilAma| ete pratyeka dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janye nidarzana raYeche|
edera samvandhe ivalisa tAra dhAraNA satya pramANa karala, phale edera madhye ekaTi mu’mina dala vyatIta sakalei tAra anusaraNa karala;
edera opara zaYatAnera kona Adhipatya chila nA| kAhArA AkhirAte vizvAsI evaM kArA ete sandihAna tA prakAza kare deoYAi chila AmAra uddezya| tomAra pratipAlaka sarvaviSaYe hiphAyatakArI|

vala, ‘tomarA AhvAna kara ederake yAderake tomarA AllAh ra parivarte ilAh mane karate| erA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte aNu parimANa kichura mAlika naYa evaM etadubhaYe edera kona aMzao nei evaM edera keu tA~ra sahAYakao naYa|’

yAke anumati deoYA haYa se vyatIta AllAh ra nikaTa kArao supAriza phalaprasU have nA| pare yakhana edera antara hate bhaYa vidUrita have takhana erA parasparera madhye jijJAsAvAda karave, ‘tomAdera pratipAlaka kI valalena?’ taduttare tArA valave, ‘yA satya tini tAi valechena|’ tini samucca, mahAna|
vala, ‘AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI hate ke tomAderake riyika pradAna karena?’ vala, ‘AllAh| haYa AmarA nA haYa tomarA satpathe sthita vA spaSTa vibhrAntite patita|’
vala, ‘AmAdera aparAdhera janye tomAderake javAvadihi karate have nA evaM tomarA yA kara se samparke AmAderakeo javAvadihi karate have nA|’
vala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAdera sakalake ekatra karavena, erapara tini AmAdera madhye saThikabhAve phaYasAlA kare divena, tinii zreSTha phaYasAlAkArI, sarvajJa|’
vala, ‘tomarA AmAke dekhAo yAderake zarIkarUpe tA~ra saGge jur3iYA diYecha tAderake| nA, kakhanao nA, varaM tini AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’
Ami to tomAke samagra mAnavajAtira prati susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe preraNa karechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
tArA jijJAsA kare, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala, ei pratizruti kakhana vAstavAYita have?’
vala, ‘tomAdera janye Ache eka nirdhArita divasa, yA tomarA muhUrtakAla vilamvita karate pArave nA, Ara tvarAnvitao karate pArave nA|’

kAphirarA vale, ‘AmarA ei kuraAne kakhanao vizvAsa karava nA, eTAra pUrvavartI kitAvasamUheo naYa| hAYa! tumi yadi dekhate jAlimaderake yakhana tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane daNDAYamAna karA have takhana erA paraspara vAda-prativAda karate thAkave, yAderake durvala mane karA hata tArA kSamatAdarpIderake valave, ‘tomarA nA thAkale AmarA avazyai mu’mina hatAma|’

yArA kSamatAdarpI chila tArA, yAderake durvala mane karA hata tAderake valave, ‘tomAdera nikaTa satpathera dizA AsAra para AmarA ki tomAderake tA hate nivRtta karechilAma? vastuta tomarAi to chile aparAdhI |’

yAderake durvala mane karA hata tArA kSamatAdarpIderake valave, ‘prakRtapakSe tomarAi to divArAtra cakrAnte lipta chile, AmAderake nirdeza diYechile yena AmarA AllAhke amAnya kari evaM tA~ra zarIka sthApana kari|’ yakhana tArA zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana tArA anutApa gopana rAkhave evaM Ami kAphiradera galadeze zRMkhala parAiva| ederake erA yA karata tArai pratiphala deoYA have|
yakhanai Ami kona janapade satarkakArI preraNa karechi era vittazAlI adhivAsIrA valeche, ‘tomarA yAsaha prerita haYecha AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna kari|’
erA Arao valata, ‘AmarA dhane-jane samRddhizAlI; sutarAM AmAderake kichutei zAsti deoYA have nA|’
vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka yAra prati icchA tAra riyika vardhita karena vA sImita karena; kintu adhikAMza lokai eTA jAne nA|’

tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati emana kichu naYa yA tomAderake AmAra nikaTavartI kare dive; tave yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tArAi tAdera karmera janye pAve vahuguNa puraskAra; Ara tArA prAsAde nirApade thAkave|
yArA AmAra AYAtake vyartha karAra ceSTA karave tArA zAsti bhoga karate thAkave|

vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka to tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA riyika vardhita karena evaM yAra prati icchA sImita karena| tomarA yA kichu vyaYa karave tini tAra pratidAna divena| tinii zreSTha riyikadAtA|’
smaraNa kara, yedina tini edera sakalake ekatra karavena, erapara phirizatAderake jijJAsA karavena, ‘erA ki tomAderai pUjA karata?’
pherezatArA valave, ‘tumi pavitra, mahAna! tumii AmAdera abhibhAvaka, erA naYa; varaM erA to pUjA karata jinadera evaM edera adhikAMzai chila edera prati vizvAsI|
‘Aja tomAdera eke anyera upakAra kiMvA apakAra karAra kSamatA nei|’ yArA juluma karechila tAderake valiva, ‘tomarA ye agni-zAsti asvIkAra karate tA AsvAdana kara|’

edera nikaTa yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa takhana erA vale, ‘tomAdera pUrvapuruSa yAra ‘ivAdata karata ei vyaktii to tAra ‘ivAdate tomAderake vAdhA dite cAYa|’ erA Arao vale, ‘eTA to mithyA udbhAvana vyatIta kichu naYa,’ evaM kAphiradera nikaTa yakhana satya Ase takhana erA vale, ‘eTA to eka suspaSTa jAdu|’
Ami ederake pUrve kona kitAva dei nAi yA erA adhyaYana karata evaM tomAra pUrve edera nikaTa kona satarkakArIo preraNa kari nAi|

edera pUrvavartIrAo mithyA Aropa karechila| ederake Ami yA diYechilAma, erA tAra eka-dazamAMzao pAYa nAi, tavuo erA AmAra rAsUladerake mithyAvAdI valechila| phale kata bhaYaMkara haYechila AmAra zAsti|

vala, ‘Ami tomAderake ekaTi viSaYe upadeza dicchi: tomarA AllAh ra uddezye dui-du’jana vA eka-ekajana kare dA~r3Ao, erapara tomarA cintA kare dekha-tomAdera saGgI Adau unmAda naYa| se to Asanna kaThina zAsti samparke tomAdera satarkakArI mAtra|
vala, ‘Ami tomAdera nikaTa kona pArizramika cAi nA, tA to tomAderai; AmAra puraskAra to Ache AllAh ra nikaTa evaM tini sarvaviSaYe draSTA|’
vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka satyera diYe asatyake AghAta karena; tini adRzyera parijJAtA|’
vala, ‘satya eseche evaM asatya nA pAre nUtana kichu sRjana karate, Ara nA pAre punarAvRtti karate|’
