vala, ‘Ami vibhrAnta hale vibhrAntira pariNAma AmArai evaM yadi Ami satpathe thAki tave tA eijanye ye, AmAra prati AmAra pratipAlaka ohI preraNa karena| tini sarvazrotA, sannikaTa|’
tumi yadi dekhate yakhana erA bhIta-vihaŸla haYe par3ave, takhana erA avyAhati pAve nA evaM erA nikaTastha sthAna hate dhRta have,
evaM erA valave, ‘AmarA tAte ImAna AnalAma|’ kintu eta da‚ravartI sthAna hate erA nAgAla pAve kirUpe?
erA to pUrve tA pratyAkhyAna karechila; erA dUravartI sthAna hate adRzya viSaYe vAkya chu~r3iYA mArita|
edera o edera vAsanAra madhye antarAla karA haYeche, yemana pUrve karA haYechila edera samapanthIdera kSetre| erA chila vibhrAntikara sandehera madhye|

sakala prazaMsA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA AllAh ra i-yini vANIvAhaka karena pherezatAderake yArA dui dui, tina tina vA cAra cAra pakSaviziSTa| tini sRSTite yA icchA vRddhi karena| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
AllAh mAnuSera prati kona anugraha avArita karale keu tA nivAraNakArI nei evaM tini kichu niruddha karate cAile tatpara keu era unmuktakArI nei| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa! tomAdera prati AllAh ra anugraha smaraNa kara| AllAh vyatIta ki kona sraSTA Ache, ye tomAderake AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI hate riyika dAna kare? tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei| sutarAM kothAYa tomarA vipathe cAlita haccho?
erA yadi tomAra prati mithyA Aropa kare tave tomAra pUrveo rAsUlagaNera prati mithyA Aropa karA haYechila| AllAh ra nikaTai sakala viSaYa pratyAnIta have|
he mAnuSa! nizcaYai AllAh ra pratizruti satya; sutarAM pArthiva jIvana yena tomAderake kichutei pratArita nA kare evaM sei pravaJcaka yena kichutei AllAh samparke tomAderake pravaJcita nA kare|
zaYatAna to tomAdera zatru; sutarAM tAke zatru hiseve grahaNa kara| se to tAra dalavalake AhvAna kare kevala ejanye ye, erA yena jAhAnnAmI haYa|
yArA kupharI kare tAdera janye Ache kaThina zAsti evaM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAdera janye Ache kSamA o mahApuraskAra|

kAukeo yadi tAra mandakarma zobhana kare dekhAna haYa evaM se eTAke uttama mane kare, sei vyakti ki tAra samAna ye satkarma kare? AllAh yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM yAke icchA satpathe paricAlita karena| ataeva edera janye AkSepa kare tomAra prANa yena dhvaMsa nA haYa| erA yA kare nizcaYai AllAh tA jAnena|

AllAhi vAYu preraNa kare tA diYe meghamAlA saJcArita karena| erapara Ami tA nirjIva bha‚khaNDera dike paricAlita kari, erapara Ami tA diYe dharitrIke era mRtyura para saJjIvita kari| eirUpei mRtyura para punarAYa jIvita kare uThAno have|

keu sammAna o kSamatA cAile se jene rAkhuka, sakala sammAna o kSamatA to AllAh ra i| tA~rai dike pavitra vANIsamUha samutthita haYa evaM satkarma eke unnIta kare, Ara yArA manda kAjera phandi A~Te tAdera janye Ache kaThina zAsti| tAdera phandi vyartha havei|

AllAh tomAderake sRSTi karechena mRttikA hate; erapara zukravindu hate, erapara tomAderake karechena yugala! AllAh ra ajJAtasAre kona nArI garbhadhAraNa kare nA evaM prasavao kare nA| kona dIrghAYu vyaktira AYu vRddhi karA haYa nA evaM tAra AYu hrAsa karA haYa nA, kintu tA to raYeche ‘kitAve’| eTA AllAh ra janye sahaja|

dariYA duiTi ekarUpa naYa: ekaTira pAni sumiSTa o supeYa, aparaTira pAni lonA, khara| pratyekaTi hate tomarA tAjA gozta AhAra kara evaM AharaNa kara alaMkAra yA tomarA paridhAna kara, evaM tomarA dekha era vuka ciriYA nauyAna calAcala kare yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha anusandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

tini rAtrike divase praviSTa karAna evaM divasake praviSTa karAna rAtrite, tini sUrya o candrake karechena niYamAdhIna; pratyeke paribhramaNa kare eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta| tinii AllAh, tomAdera pratipAlaka| Adhipatya tA~rai| evaM tomarA AllAh ra parivarte yAderake DAka tArA to kharjura A~Tira AvaraNerao adhikArI naYa|

tomarA tAderake AhvAna karale tArA tomAdera AhvAna zunave nA evaM zunaleo tomAdera AhavAne sAr3A dive nA| tomarA tAderake ye zarIka karecha tA erA kiYAmatera dina asvIkAra karave| sarvajJera nyAYa keui tomAke avahita karate pAre nA|
he mAnuSa! tomarA to AllAh ra mukhApekSI; kintu AllAh, tini abhAvamukta, prazaMsArha|
tini icchA karale tomAderake apasRta karate pArena evaM eka nUtana sRSTi AnaYana karate pArena|
eTA AllAh ra pakSe kaThina naYa|

kona vahanakArI anyera vojhA vahana karave nA; kona bhArAkrAnta vyakti yadi kAukeo eTA vahana karate AhavAna kare tave era kichui vahana karA have nA-se nikaTa-AtmIYa haleo| tumi kevala tAderakei satarka karate pAra yArA tAdera pratipAlakake nA dekhe bhaYa kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare| ye keu nijake parizodhana kare se to parizodhana kare nijerai kalyANera janye| AllAh ra i dike pratyAvartana|
samAna naYa andha o cakSuSmAna,
Ara nA andhakAra o Alo,
Ara nA chAYA o raudra,
evaM samAna naYa jIvita o mRta| AllAhi yAke icchA zonAna; tumi zonAte samartha have nA yArA kavare raYeche tAderake|
tumi ekajana satarkakArI mAtra|
Ami to tomAke satyasaha preraNa karechi susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe; emana kona sampradAYa nei yAra nikaTa satarkakArI prerita haYa nAi|
erA yadi tomAra prati mithyA Aropa kare tave edera pUrvavartIgaNao to mithyA Aropa karechila-tAdera nikaTa esechila tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzana, granthAdi o dIptimAna kitAvasaha|
erapara Ami kAphiraderake zAsti diYechilAma| kI bhaYaMkara AmAra zAsti!
tumi ki dekha nA, AllAh AkAza hate vRSTipAta karena; evaM Ami eTA diYe vicitra varNera phalamUla udgata kari| Ara pAhAr3era madhye Ache vicitra varNera patha-zubhra, lAla o nikaSa kAla|
eibhAve raM-veraM-era mAnuSa, jantu o Ana‘Ama raYeche| AllAh ra vAndAdera madhye yArA jJAnI tArAi tA~ke bhaYa kare; AllAh parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|
yArA AllAh ra kitAva tilAoYAta kare, sAlAta kAYema kare, Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi tA hate gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, tArAi AzA kare emana vyavasAYera, yAra kSaYa nei|
eijanye ye, AllAh tAdera karmera pUrNa pratiphala divena evaM tini nija anugrahe tAderake Arao vezi divena| tini to kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|
Ami tomAra prati ye kitAva avatIrNa karechi tA satya, eTA pUrvavartI kitAvera pratyAYanakArI| nizcaYai AllAh tA~ra vAndAdera samasta kichu jAnena o dekhena|

erapara Ami kitAvera adhikArI karalAma AmAra vAndAdera madhya hate yAderake Ami manonIta karechi; tave tAdera keu nijera prati atyAcArI, keu madhyapanthI evaM keu AllAh ra icchAYa kalyANakara kAje agragAmI| eTAi mahAanugraha-
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAte tArA praveza karave, sekhAne tAderake svarNa-nirmita kaMkana o muktA diYe alaMkRta karA have evaM sekhAne tAdera pozAka-paricchada have rezamera|
evaM tArA valave, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAh ra, yini AmAdera duHkha-durdazA dUrIbhUta karechena; AmAdera pratipAlaka to kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI;
‘yini nija anugrahe AmAderake sthAYI AvAsa diYechena yekhAne kleza AmAderake sparza kare nA evaM klAntio sparza kare nA|’

kintu yArA kupharI kare tAdera janye Ache jAhAnnAmera Aguna| edera mRtyura Adeza deoYA have nA ye, erA marive evaM edera hate jAhAnnAmera zAstio lAghava karA have nA| eibhAve Ami pratyeka akRtajJake zAsti diYe thAki|

sekhAne tArA ArtanAda kare valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake niSkRti dAo, AmarA satkarma karava, pUrve yA karatAma tA karava nA|’ AllAh valavena, ‘Ami ki tomAderake eto dIrgha jIvana dAna kari nAi ye, takhana keu satarka hate cAile satarka hate pArate? tomAdera nikaTa to satarkakArIo esechila| sutarAM zAsti AsvAdana kara; jAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|’
nizcaYai AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYa avagata Achena| antare yA raYeche se samvandhe tini savizeSa avahita|

tinii tomAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karechena| sutarAM keu kupharI karale tAra kupharIra janye se nijei dAYI have| kAphiradera kupharI kevala edera pratipAlakera krodhai vRddhi kare evaM kAphiradera kupharI edera kSatii vRddhi kare|

vala, ‘tomarA AllAh ra parivarte yAderake DAka sei sakala zarIkera kathA bheve dekhecha ki? tArA pRthivIte kichu sRSTi kare thAkale AmAke dekhAo; vA AkAzamaNDalIra sRSTite edera kona aMza Ache ki? nA ki Ami ederake emana kona kitAva diYechi yAra pramANera opara erA nirbhara kare?’ vastuta jAlimarA eke aparake mithyA pratizruti diYe thAke|-
AllAhi AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIke saMrakSaNa karena, yAte erA sthAnacyuta nA haYa, erA sthAnacyuta hale tini vyatIta ke ederake rakSA karave? tini to ati sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|

erA dRr3hatAra saGge AllAh ra zapatha kare valata ye, edera nikaTa kona satarkakArI Asale erA anya sakala sampradAYa apekSA satpathera adhikatara anusArI have; kintu edera nikaTa yakhana satarkakArI elo takhana tA kevala edera vimukhatAi vRddhi karala-

pRthivIte auddhatya prakAza evaM ka‚Ta Sar3ayantrera kAraNe| ka‚Ta Sar3ayantra era udyoktAderakei pariveSTana kare| tave ki erA pratIkSA karateche pUrvavartIdera prati prayukta vidhAnera? kintu tumi AllAh ra vidhAnera kakhanao kona parivartana pAve nA evaM AllAh ra vidhAnera kona vyatikramao dekhave nA|

erA ki pRthivIte paribhramaNa kare nAi? tA hale edera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kI haYechila tA dekhate peta| erA to edera apekSA adhikatara valazAlI chila| AllAh emana nana ye, AkAzamaNDalI evaM pRthivIra kona kichui tA~ke akSama karate pAre; tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

AllAh mAnuSake tAdera kRtakarmera janye zAsti dile bhUpRSThe kona jIva- jantukei rehAi ditena nA, kintu tini eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta tAderake avakAza diYe thAkena| erapara tAdera nirdiSTa kAla ese gele AllAh to Achena tA~ra vAndAdera samyaka draSTA|
iYA-sIna,
zapatha jJAnagarbha kuraAnera,
tumi avazyai rAsUladera antarbhukta;
tumi sarala pathe pratiSThita|
kuraAna avatIrNa parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu AllAh ra nikaTa hate,
yAte tumi satarka karate pAra emana eka jAtike yAdera pitRpuruSaderake satarka karA haYa nAi, yAra phale erA gAphila|
edera adhikAMzera janye sei vANI avadhArita haYeche; sutarAM erA ImAna Anave nA|
Ami edera galadeze civuka paryanta ver3i parAiYAchi, phale erA UrdhvamukhI haYe geche|
Ami edera sAmane prAcIra o pazcAte prAcIra sthApana karechi evaM ederake AvRta karechi; phale erA dekhate pAYa nA|
tumi ederake satarka kara vA nA kara, edera pakSe ubhaYai samAna; erA ImAna Anave nA|
tumi kevala tAkei satarka karate pAra ye upadeza mene cale evaM nA dekhe daYAmaYa AllAhke bhaYa kare| ataeva tAke tumi kSamA o mahApuraskArera saMvAda dAo|
Amii mRtake kari jIvita evaM likhe rAkhi yA erA agre preraNa kare o yA erA pazcAte rekhe yAYa, Ami to pratyeka jinisa spaSTa kitAve saMrakSita rekhechi|
edera nikaTa varNanA kara eka janapadera adhivAsIdera dRSTAnta; yakhana tAdera nikaTa esechila rAsUlagaNa|

yakhana edera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma du’jana rAsUla, takhana erA tAderake mithyAvAdI valechila, erapara Ami tAderake zaktizAlI karechilAma tRtIYa ekajana diYe| tArA valechila, ‘AmarA to tomAdera nikaTa prerita haYechi|’
erA valala, ‘tomarA AmAdera matai mAnuSa, daYAmaYa AllAh to kichui avatIrNa karena nAi| tomarA kevala mithyAi valacho|’
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka jAnena-AmarA avazyai tomAdera nikaTa prerita haYechi|
‘spaSTabhAve pracAra karAi AmAdera dAYitva|’

erA valala, ‘AmarA to tomAderake amaGgalera kAraNa mane kari, yadi tomarA virata nA hao tomAderake avazyai prastarAghAte hatyA karava evaM AmAdera pakSa hate tomAdera opara marmantuda zAsti avazyai Apatita have|’
tArA valala, ‘tomAdera amaGgala tomAderai saGge; eTA ki eijanye ye, AmarA tomAderake upadeza dicchi? vastuta tomarA eka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|’
nagarIra prAnta hate eka vyakti chuTiYA elo| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA rAsUladera anusaraNa kara;
‘anusaraNa kara tAdera, yArA tomAdera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAYa nA evaM yArA satpathaprApta|
‘AmAra ki yukti Ache ye, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena evaM yA~hAra nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have Ami tA~ra ‘ivAdata karava nA?
‘Ami ki tA~ra parivarte anya ilAh grahaNa karava? daYAmaYa AllAh AmAke kSatigrasta karate cAile edera supAriza AmAra kona kAje Asave nA evaM erA AmAke uddhAra karateo pArave nA|
‘eirUpa karale Ami avazyai spaSTa vibhrAntite par3iva|
‘Ami to tomAdera pratipAlakera opara ImAna enechi, ataeva tomarA AmAra kathA zona|’
tAke valA hala, ‘jAnnAte praveza kara|’ se vale uThila, ‘hAYa! AmAra sampradAYa yadi jAnate pArata-
‘kirUpe AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke kSamA karechena evaM AmAke sammAnita karechena|’
Ami tAra pare tAra sampradAYera viruddhe AkAza hate kona vAhinI preraNa kari nAi evaM preraNera praYojanao chila nA|
tA chila kevala eka mahAnAda| phale erA nithara nistavdha haYe gela|
paritApa vAndAdera janye; edera nikaTa yakhanai kona rAsUla eseche takhanai erA tAke ThATTA-vidrupa kareche|
erA ki lakSya kare nA edera pUrve kata mAnavagoSThI Ami dhvaMsa karechi yArA edera madhye phire Asave nA?
evaM avazyai edera sakalake ekatre AmAra nikaTa upasthita karA have|
edera janye ekaTi nidarzana mRta dharitrI, yAke Ami saJjIvita kari evaM tA hate utpanna kari zasya yA erA AhAra kare|
ete Ami sRSTi kari kharjura o AGurera udyAna evaM ete utsArita kari prasravaNa,
yAte erA AhAra karate pAre era phalamUla hate, athaca edera hasta tA sRSTi kare nAi| tavuo ki erA kRtajJatA prakAza karave nA?
pavitra o mahAna tini, yini udbhida, mAnuSa evaM erA yAderake jAne nA tAdera pratyekake sRSTi karechena jor3A jor3A kare|
edera janye eka nidarzana rAtri, tA hate Ami divAloka apasArita kari, takhana erA andhakArAcchanna haYe par3e|
Ara sUrya bhramaNa kare era nirdiSTa gantavyera dike, eTA parAkramazAlI, sarvajJera niYantraNa|
evaM candrera janye Ami nirdiSTa karechi vibhinna manayila; avazeSe tA zuSka vakra, purAtana kharjura zAkhAra AkAra dhAraNa kare|
sUryera pakSe sambhava naYa candrera nAgAla pAoYA evaM rajanIra pakSe sambhava naYa divasake atikrama karA; evaM pratyeke nija nija kakSapathe santaraNa kare|
edera janye eka nidarzana ei ye, Ami edera vaMzadharaderake vojhAi nauyAne ArohaNa kariYechilAma;
evaM edera janye anurUpa yAnavAhana sRSTi karechi yAte erA ArohaNa kare|
Ami icchA karale ederake nimajjita karate pAri; se avasthAYa edera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA evaM erA paritrANao pAve nA-
AmAra anugraha nA hale evaM kichu kAlera janye jIvanopabhoga karate nA dile|
yakhana ederake valA haYa, ‘yA tomAdera sAmane o tomAdera pazcAte Ache se samvandhe sAvadhAna hao yAte tomarA anugrahabhAjana hate pAra,’
evaM yakhanai edera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalIra kona nidarzana edera nikaTa Ase, takhanai erA tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa|

yakhana ederake valA haYa, ‘AllAh tomAderake ye jIvanopakaraNa diYechena tA hate vyaYa kara’ takhana kAphirarA mu’minaderake vale, ‘yAke AllAh icchA karale khAoYAte pAratena AmarA ki tAke khAoYAva? tomarA to spaSTa vibhrAntite rahiYAcha|’
erA vale, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala, ei pratizruti kakhana pUrNa have?’
erA to apekSAYa Ache eka mahAnAdera yA ederake AghAta karave edera vAka-vitaNDAkAle|
takhana erA osiYAta karate samartha have nA evaM nijedera parivAra-parijanera nikaTa phire Asateo pArave nA|
yakhana ziMgAYa phutkAra deoYA have takhanai tArA kavara hate chuTiYA Asave tAdera pratipAlakera dike|
erA valave, ‘hAYa! durbheAga AmAdera! ke AmAderake AmAdera nidrAsthala hate uThAla? daYAmaYa AllAh to eTArai pratizruti diYechilena evaM rAsUlagaNa satyai valechilena|’
eTA have kevala eka mahAnAda; takhanai edera sakalake upasthita karA have AmAra sAmane,
Aja kArao prati kona juluma karA have nA evaM tomarA yA karate kevala tArai pratiphala deoYA have|
ei dina jAnnAtavAsigaNa Anande magna thAkave,
tArA evaM tAdera strIgaNa suzItala chAYAYa susajjita Asane helAna diYe vasave|
sekhAne thAkave tAdera janye phalamUla evaM tAdera janye vAJchita samasta kichu,
sAlAma, parama daYAlu pratipAlakera pakSa hate sambhASaNa|
Ara ‘he aparAdhigaNa! tomarA Aja pRthaka haYe yAo|’
he vanI Adama! Ami ki tomAderake nirdeza dii nAi ye, tomarA zaYatAnera dAsatva kara nA, kAraNa se to tomAdera prakAzya zatru?
Ara AmArai ‘ivAdata kara, eTAi sarala patha|
zaYatAna to tomAdera vahu dalake vibhrAnta karechila, tavuo ki tomarA vujha nAi?
eTAi sei jAhAnnAma, yAra pratizruti tomAderake deYA haYechila|
Aja tomarA ete praveza kara; kAraNa tomarA eTAke avizvAsa karechile|
Ami Aja edera mukha mohara kare diva, edera hasta kathA valave AmAra saGge evaM edera caraNa sAkSya dive edera kRtakarmera|
Ami icchA karale avazyai edera cokhagulike lopa kare ditAma, takhana erA patha calate cAile ki kare dekhate peta!

Ami yAke dIrgha jIvana dAna kari prakRtigatabhAve tAra avanati ghaTAi| tavuo ki erA vujhe nA?

erA ki lakSya kare nA ye, AmAra hAte sRSTa vastusamUhera madhye edera janye Ami sRSTi karechi ‘Ana‘Ama’ evaM erAi eigulira adhikArI?

erapara Ami tAra truTi kSamA karalAma| AmAra nikaTa tAra janye raYeche naikaTyera maryAdA o zubha pariNAma|

‘he dAUda! Ami tomAke pRthivIte pratinidhi karechi, ataeva tumi lokadera madhye suvicAra kara evaM kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara nA, kenanA eTA tomAke AllAh ra patha hate vicyuta karave|’ yArA AllAh ra patha hate bhraSTa haYa tAdera janye raYeche kaThina zAsti, kAraNa tArA vicAradivasake vismRta haYe Ache|
Ami AkAza, pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera madhyavartI kona kichui anarthaka sRSTi kari nAi| anarthaka sRSTi karAra dhAraNA edera yArA kAphira, sutarAM kAphiradera janye raYeche jAhAnnAmera durbheAga|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare evaM yArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi kare ver3AYa, Ami ki tAderake samAna gaNya karava? Ami ki muttAkIderake aparAdhIdera samAna gaNya karava?
eka kalyANamaYa kitAva, eTA Ami tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi, yAte mAnuSa eTAra AYAtasamUha anudhAvana kare evaM vodhazaktisampanna vyaktigaNa grahaNa kare upadeza|
Ami dAUdake dAna karalAma sulAYamAna| se chila uttama vAndA evaM se chila atizaYa AllAh abhimukhI|
yakhana aparAhne tAra sAmane dhAvanodyata utkRSTa azvarAjike upasthita karA hala,
takhana se valala, ‘Ami to AmAra pratipAlakera smaraNa hate vimukha haYe aizvarya prItite magna haYe par3echi, edike sUrya astamita haYe geche;
‘eigulike punarAYa AmAra sAmane AnaYana kara|’ erapara se edera pada o galadeza chedana karate lAgala|
Ami to sulAYamAnake parIkSA karalAma evaM tAra Asanera opara rAkhalAma ekaTi dhar3a; erapara sulAYamAna AmAra abhimukhI hala|
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke kSamA kara evaM AmAke dAna kara emana eka rAjya yAra adhikArI Ami chAr3A keu nA haYa| tumi to parama dAtA|’
takhana Ami tAra adhIna kare dilAma vAYuke, yA tAra Adeze, se yekhAne icchA karata sekhAne mRdumandabhAve pravAhita hata,
evaM zaYatAnaderake, yArA sakalei chila prAsAda nirmANakArI o DuvurI,
evaM zRGkhale Avaddha Arao anekake|
‘eisava AmAra anugraha, eTA hate tumi anyake dite vA nije rAkhate pAra| eTAra janye tomAke hiseva dite have nA|’
evaM AmAra nikaTa raYeche tAra janye naikaTyera maryAdA o zubha pariNAma|
smaraNa kara, AmAra vAndA Aiuvake, yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake AhavAna kare valechila, ‘zaYatAna to AmAke yantraNA o kaSTe pheleche’,
Ami tAke valalAma, ‘tumi tomAra pada diYe bhUmite AghAta kara, ei to gosalera suzItala pAni Ara pAnIYa|’
Ami tAke dAna karalAma tAra parijanavarga o tAdera mata Arao, AmAra anugrahasvarUpa evaM vodhazaktisampanna lokadera janye upadezasvarUpa|
Ami tAke Adeza karalAma, ‘ekamuSTi tRNa lao o tA diYe AghAta kara evaM zapatha bhaGga kara nA|’ Ami to tAke pelAma dhairyazIla| kata uttama vAndA se! se chila AmAra abhimukhI|
smaraNa kara, AmAra vAndA ivarAhIma, ishAka o iYAkUvera kathA, erA chila zaktizAlI o sUkSmadarzI|
Ami tAderake adhikArI karechilAma eka vizeSa guNera, tA chila paralokera smaraNa|
avazyai tArA chila AmAra manonIta uttama vAndAdera antarbhukta|
smaraNa kara, isamAIla, Ala-iYAsA‘A o yula-kiphalera kathA, erA pratyekei chila sajjana|
eTA eka smaraNIYa varNanA| nizcaYai muttAkIdera janye raYeche uttama AvAsa-
cirasthAYI jAnnAta, yAra dvAra tAdera janye unmukta|
sekhAne tArA AsIna have helAna diYe, sekhAne tArA vahuvidha phalamUla o pAnIYa cAive|
evaM tAdera pArzve thAkave AnatanaYanA samavaYaskAgaNa|
eTA hiseva divasera janye tomAderake pradatta pratizruti|
eTA to AmAra deoYA riyika yA niHzeSa have nA,
eTAi| Ara sImAlaMghanakArIdera janye raYeche nikRSTatama pariNAma-
jAhAnnAma, sekhAne erA praveza karave, kata nikRSTa ThikAnA!
eTA sImAlaMghanakArIdera janye| sutarAM erA AsvAdana karuka phuTanta pAni o pu~ja|
Arao Ache eirUpa vibhinna dharanera zAsti|
‘ei to eka vAhinI, tomAdera saGge praveza karateche|’ ‘edera janye nei abhinandana, erA to jAhAnnAme jvalive|’
anusArIrA valave, ‘varaM tomarAo, tomAdera janyeo abhinandana nei| tomarAi to pUrve tA AmAdera janye vyavasthA karecha| kata nikRSTa ei AvAsasthala!’
erA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ye eTA AmAdera sammukhIna kareche, jAhAnnAme tAra zAsti tumi dviguNa vardhita kara|’
erA Arao valave, ‘AmAdera kI hala ye, AmarA ye sakala lokake manda vale gaNya karatAma tAderake dekhate petechi nA!
‘tave ki AmarA ederake ahetuka ThATTA-vidrupera pAtra mane karatAma, nA edera vyApAre AmAdera dRSTivibhrama ghaTeche?’
eTA nizcita satya-jAhAnnAmIdera ei vAda-prativAda|
vala, ‘Ami to ekajana satarkakArI mAtra evaM kona ilAh nei AllAh vyatIta, yini eka, yini pravala pratApazAlI,
‘yini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o edera madhyavartI samasta kichura pratipAlaka, yini parAkramazAlI, mahAkSamAzIla|’
vala, ‘eTA eka mahAsaMvAda,
‘yA hate tomarA mukha phiriYe niccha|
‘Urdhvaloke tAdera vAdAnuvAda samparke AmAra kona jJAna chila nA|
‘AmAra nikaTa to ei ohI eseche ye, Ami ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|’
smaraNa kara, tomAra pratipAlaka pherezatAderake valechilena, ‘Ami mAnuSa sRSTi karachi kardama hate,
‘yakhana Ami eke suSama karava evaM ete AmAra rUh saJcAra karava, takhana tomarA era prati sijdAvanata haYo|’
takhana pherezatArA sakalei sijdAvanata hala-
kevala ivalIsa vyatIta, se ahaMkAra karala evaM kAphiradera antarbhukta hala|
tini valalena, ‘he ivalIsa! Ami yAke nija hAte sRSTi karechi, tAra prati sijadAvanata hate tomAke kise vAdhA dila? tumi ki auddhatya prakAza karale, nA tumi ucca maryAdAsampanna?’
se valala, ‘Ami tA hate zreSTha| Apani AmAke Aguna hate sRSTi karechena evaM eke sRSTi karechena kardama hate|’
tini valalena, ‘tumi ekhAna hate vera haYe yAo, nizcaYai tumi vitAr3ita|
‘evaM tomAra opara AmAra lA‘nata sthAYI have, karmaphala divasa paryanta|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Apani AmAke avakAza dina utthAna divasa paryanta|’
tini valalena, ‘tumi avakAzaprAptadera antarbhukta hale-
‘avadhArita samaYa upasthita haoYAra dina paryanta|’
se valala, ‘ApanAra kSamatAra zapatha! Ami edera sakalakei pathabhraSTa karava,
‘tave edera madhye ApanAra ekaniSTha vAndAderake naYa|’
tini valalena, ‘tave eTAi satya, Ara Ami satyai vali-
‘tomAra diYe o tomAra anusArIdera diYe Ami jAhAnnAma pUrNa karavai|’
vala, ‘Ami eTAra janye tomAdera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAi nA evaM yArA mithyA dAvi kare Ami tAdera antarbhukta nai|’
eTA to vizvajagatera janye upadeza mAtra|
eTAra saMvAda tomarA avazyai jAnive, kiYatkAla pare|
ei kitAva avatIrNa parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAh ra nikaTa hate|
Ami tomAra nikaTa ei kitAva satyasaha avatIrNa karechi| sutarAM AllAh ra ‘ivAdata kara tA~ra Anugatye vizuddhacitta haYe|

jene rAkha, avimizra Anugatya AllAh ra i prApya| yArA AllAh ra parivarte anyake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare tArA vale, ‘AmarA to edera pUjA eijanyei kari ye, erA AmAderake AllAh ra sAnnidhye AniYA dive|’ erA ye viSaYe nijedera madhye matabheda karateche AllAh tAra phaYasAlA kare divena| ye mithyAvAdI o kAphira, AllAh tAke satpathe paricAlita karena nA|
AllAh santAna grahaNa karate cAile tini tA~ra sRSTira madhye yAke icchA vAchiYA nitena| pavitra o mahAna tini! tini AllAh, eka, pravala parAkramazAlI|

tini yathAyathabhAve AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena| tini rAtri diYe divasake AcchAdita karena evaM rAtrike AcchAdita karena divasa diYe| sUrya o candrake tini karechena niYamAdhIna| pratyekei parikramaNa kare eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta| jene rAkha, tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|

tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena ekai vyakti hate| erapara tini tA hate tAra strI sRSTi karechena| tini tomAderake diYechena ATa prakAra Ana‘Ama| tini tomAderake tomAdera mAtRgarbhera trividha andhakAre paryAYakrame sRSTi karechena| tinii AllAh; tomAdera pratipAlaka; sarvamaYa kartRtva tA~rai; tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei| tave tomarA mukha phiriYe kothAYa calecha?

tomarA akRtajJa hale AllAh tomAdera mukhApekSI nana, tini tA~ra vAndAdera akRtajJatA pachanda karena nA| yadi tomarA kRtajJa hao, tini tomAdera janye eTAi pachanda karena| ekera bhAra anye vahana karave nA| erapara tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana evaM tomarA yA karate tini tomAderake tA avahita karavena| antare yA Ache tini tA samyaka avagata|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-dainya sparza kare takhana se ekaniSThabhAve tAra pratipAlakake DAke| pare yakhana tini tAra prati anugraha karena takhana se vismRta haYe yAYa, tAra pUrve yAra janye se Dekechila tA~ke evaM se AllAh ra samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa, aparake tA~ra patha hate vibhrAnta karAra janye| vala, ‘kupharIra jIvana avasthAYa tumi kichukAla upabhoga kare nAo| vastuta tumi jAhAnnAmIdera anyatama|’

ye vyakti rAtrira vibhinna yAme sijdAvanata haYe o dA~r3iYe Anugatya prakAza kare, AkhirAtake bhaYa kare evaM tA~ra pratipAlakera anugraha pratyAzA kare, se ki tAra samAna, ye tA kare nA? vala, ‘yArA jAne evaM yArA jAne nA, tArA ki samAna?’ vodhazaktisampanna lokerAi kevala upadeza grahaNa kare|

vala, ‘he AmAra mu’mina vAndAgaNa! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kara| yArA ei duniYAte kalyANakara kAja kare tAdera janye Ache kalyANa| Ara AllAh ra yamIna prazasta, dhairyazIla-derake to aparimita puraskAra deoYA have|’
vala, ‘Ami to AdiSTa haYechi, AllAh ra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe tA~ra ‘ivAdata karate;
‘Ara AdiSTa haYechi, Ami yena AtmasamarpaNakArIdera agraNI hai|’
vala, ‘Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhya hai, tave Ami bhaYa kari mahAdivasera zAstira|’
vala, ‘Ami ‘ivAdata kari AllAh ra i tA~ra prati AmAra Anugatyake ekaniSTha rekhe|
‘Ara tomarA AllAh ra parivarte yAra icchA tAra ‘ivAdata kara|’ vala, ‘kSatigrasta tArAi yArA kiYAmatera dina nijedera o nijedera parijanavargera kSatisAdhana kare| jene rAkha, eTAi suspaSTa kSati|’
tAdera janye thAkave tAdera Urdhvadike agnira AcchAdana evaM nimnadikeo AcchAdana| etA diYe AllAh tA~ra vAndAderake satarka karena| he AmAra vAndAgaNa! tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara|
yArA tAgUtera pUjA hate dUre thAke evaM AllAh ra abhimukhI haYa, tAdera janye Ache susaMvAda| ataeva susaMvAda dAo AmAra vAndAderake-
yArA manoyoga sahakAre kathA zune evaM era madhye yA uttama tA grahaNa kare| ederake AllAh satpathe paricAlita karena evaM erAi vodhazaktisampanna|
yAra opara daNDAdeza avadhArita haYeche; tumi ki rakSA karate pArave sei vyaktike, ye jAhAnnAme Ache?
tave yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare, tAdera janye Ache vahu prAsAda yAra opara nirmita Arao prAsAda, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; eTA AllAh ra oYAdA, AllAh oYAdA khelApha karena nA|

tumi ki dekha nA, AllAh AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena, erapara tA bhUmite nirjhararUpe pravAhita karena evaM tA diYe vividha varNera phasala utpanna karena, erapara eTA zukiYe yAYa? phale tomarA eTA pItavarNa dekhate pAo, avazeSe tini tA khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata karena| ete avazyai upadeza raYeche vodhazaktisampannadera janye|

AllAh isalAmera janye yAra vakSa unmukta kare diYechena evaM ye tAra pratipAlaka-pradatta Alote raYeche, se ki tAra samAna ye erUpa naYa? durbheAga sei kaThorahRdaYa vyaktidera janye yArA AllAhara smaraNe vimukha! erA spaSTa vibhrAntite Ache|

AllAh avatIrNa karechena uttama vANI samvalita kitAva yA susamaJjasa evaM yA punaH punaH AvRtti karA haYa| ete, yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare, tAdera gAtra romAJcita haYa, erapara tAdera dehamana vinamra haYe AllAh ra smaraNe jhu~ke par3e| eTAi AllAh ra pathanirdeza, tini tA diYe yAke icchA patha pradarzana karena| AllAh yAke vibhrAnta karena tAra kona pathapradarzaka nei|
ye vyakti kiYAmatera dina tAra mukhamaNDala diYe kaThina zAsti ThekAte cAive, se ki tAra mata ye nirApada? jAlimaderake valA have, ‘tomarA yA arjana karate tAra zAsti AsvAdana kara|’
edera pUrvavartigaNao asvIkAra karechila, phale zAsti emanabhAve ederake grAsa karala ye, erA dhAraNAo karate pAre nAi|
phale AllAh ederake pArthiva jIvane lAJchanA bhoga karAlena evaM AkhirAtera zAsti to kaThinatara| yadi erA jAnata!
Ami ei kuraAne mAnuSera janye sarvaprakAra dRSTAnta upasthita karechi, yAte erA upadeza grahaNa kare,
AravI bhASAYa ei kuraAna vakratAmukta, yAte mAnuSa sAvadhAnatA avalamvana kare|

AllAh ekaTi dRSTAnta peza karachena: eka vyaktira prabhu aneka, yArA paraspara viruddhabhAvApanna evaM Ara eka vyaktira prabhu kevala ekajana; ei duijanera avasthA ki samAna? prazaMsA AllAh ra i prApya; kintu edera adhikAMzai eTA jAne nA|
tumi to maraNazIla evaM erAo maraNazIla|
erapara kiYAmata divase tomarA to paraspara tomAdera pratipAlakera sAmane vAkavitaNDA karave|
ye vyakti AllAh samvandhe mithyA vale evaM satya AsAra para tA asvIkAra kare tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? kAphiradera AvAsasthala ki jAhAnnAma naYa?
yArA satya eneche evaM yArA satyake satya vale meneche tArAi to muttAkI|
edera vAJchita samasta kichui Ache edera pratipAlakera nikaTa| eTAi satkarmaparAYaNadera puraskAra|
yAte erA yesava manda karma karechila AllAh tA kSamA kare dena evaM ederake edera satkarmera janye puraskRta karena|
AllAh ki tA~ra vAndAra janye yatheSTa nana? athaca tArA tomAke AllAh ra parivarte aparera bhaYa dekhAYa| AllAh yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janye kona pathapradarzaka nei|
evaM yAke AllAh hidAYAta karena tAra janye kona pathabhraSTakArI nei; AllAh ki parAkramazAlI, daNDavidhAYaka nana?

tumi yadi ederake jijJAsA kara, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI ke sRSTi karechena? erA avazyai valave, ‘AllAh|’ vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, AllAh AmAra aniSTa cAile tomarA AllAh ra parivarte yAderake DAka tArA ki sei aniSTa dUra karate pArave? vA tini AmAra prati anugraha karate cAile tArA ki sei anugrahake rodha karate pArave?’ vala, ‘AmAra janye AllAhi yatheSTa|’ nirbharakArIgaNa AllAh ra i opara nirbhara kare|
vala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA sva sva avasthAYa kAja karate thAka, Amio AmAra kAja karachi| zIghrai jAnate pArave-
‘kAhAra opara Asave lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti Ara Apatita have tAra opara sthAYI zAsti|’

Ami tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechi mAnuSera janye; erapara ye satpatha avalamvana kare se tA kare nijerai kalyANera janye evaM ye vipathagAmI haYa se to vipathagAmI haYa nijerai dhvaMsera janye evaM tumi edera tattvAvadhAYaka nao|

AllAhi prANa haraNa karena jIvasamUhera tAdera mRtyura samaYa evaM yAdera mRtyu Ase nAi tAdera prANao nidrAra samaYa| erapara tini yAra janye mRtyura siddhAnta karena tAra prANa tini rekhe dena evaM aparaguli phiriYe dena, eka nirdiSTa samaYera janye| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche cintAzIla sampradAYera janye|
tave ki erA AllAha vyatIta aparake supArizakArI dhareche? vala, ‘edera kona kSamatA nA thAkaleo evaM erA nA vujhileo?’
vala, ‘sakala supAriza AllAharai ikhtiYAre, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sarvamaYa kartRtva AllAharai, erapara tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAnIta have|’
zudhu eka AllAh ra kathA valA hale yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tAdera antara vitRSNAYa saMkucita haYa evaM AllAh ra parivarte upAsyagulira ullekha karA hale tArA Anande ullasita haYa|
vala, ‘he AllAh! AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sraSTA, dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtA, tomAra vAndAgaNa ye viSaYe matavirodha kare, tumi tAdera madhye era phaYasAlA kare dive|’

yArA juluma kareche yadi tAdera thAke, duniYAYa yA Ache tA sampUrNa evaM eTAra samaparimANa sampadao, tave kiYAmatera dina kaThina zAsti hate muktipaNasvarUpa sei sakalai tArA diYe dive evaM tAdera janye AllAh ra nikaTa hate emana kichu prakAzita have yA erA kalpanAo kare nAi|
edera kRtakarmera manda phala edera nikaTa prakAza haYe par3ave evaM erA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karata tA ederake pariveSTana karave|

mAnuSake vipada-Apada sparza karale se AmAke AhvAna kare; erapara yakhana Ami AmAra kona niYAmata diYe tAke anugRhIta kari takhana se vale, ‘AmAke to eTA deoYA haYeche AmAra jJAnera kAraNe|’ vastuta eTA eka parIkSA, kintu edera adhikAMzai vujhe nA|
edera pUrvavartigaNao eTAi valata, kintu edera kRtakarma edera kona kAje Ase nAi|
edera kRtakarmera manda phala edera opara Apatita haYeche, edera madhye yArA juluma kare edera oparao edera kRtakarmera manda phala Apatita have evaM erA vyarthao karate pArave nA|
erA ki jAne nA, AllAh yAra janye icchA riyika prazasta karena vA yAra janye icchA sImita karena? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janye|
vala, ‘he AmAra vAndAgaNa! tomarA yArA nijedera prati avicAra karecha-AllAh ra anugraha hate nirAza haYo nA; AllAh samudaYa pApa kSamA kare divena| tini to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera abhimukhI hao evaM tA~ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa kara tomAdera nikaTa zAsti AsAra pUrve; tatpara tomAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|
anusaraNa kara tomAdera prati tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate uttama yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tAra, tomAdera opara atarkitabhAve tomAdera ajJAtasAre zAsti AsAra pUrve-
yAte kAukeo valite nA haYa, ‘hAYa! AllAh ra prati AmAra kartavye Ami ye zaithilya karechi tAra janye Aphasosa! Ami to ThATTAkArIdera antarbhukta chilAma|’
athavA keu yena nA vale, ‘AllAh AmAke pathapradarzana karale Ami to avazyai muttAkIdera antarbhukta hatAma|’
athavA zAsti pratyakSa karale yena kAukeo valite nA haYa, ‘AhA, yadi ekavAra pRthivIte AmAra pratyAvartana ghaTata tave Ami satkarmaparAYaNa hatAma!’
prakRta vyApAra to ei ye, AmAra nidarzana tomAra nikaTa esechila, kintu tumi eigulike mithyA valechile o ahaMkAra karechile; Ara tumi to chile kAphiradera ekajana|
yArA AllAh ra prati mithyA Aropa kare, tumi kiYAmatera dina tAdera mukha kAlo dekhave| uddhatadera AvAsasthala ki jAhAnnAma naYa?
AllAh muttAkIderake uddhAra karavena tAdera sAphalyasaha; tAderake amaGgala sparza karave nA evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
AllAh samasta kichura sraSTA evaM tini samasta kichura karmavidhAYaka|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra kuJji tA~rai nikaTa| Ara yArA AllAh ra AYAtake asvIkAra kare tArAi to kSatigrasta|
vala, ‘he ajJa vyaktirA! tomarA ki AmAke AllAh vyatIta anyera ‘ivAdata karate valatecha?’
tomAra prati o tomAra pUrvavartIdera prati avazyai ohI haYeche, ‘tumi AllAh ra zarIka sthira karale tomAra karma to niSphala have evaM avazyai tumi have kSatigrasta|
‘ataeva tumi AllAh ra i ‘ivAdata kara evaM kRtajJa hao|’

erA AllAh ra yathocita sammAna kare nA| kiYAmatera dina samasta pRthivI thAkave tA~ra hAtera muSTite evaM AkAzamaNDalI thAkave bhA~ja karA avasthAYa tA~ra dakSiNa haste| pavitra o mahAna tini, erA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|

evaM ziMgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, phale yAderake AllAh icchA karena tArA vyatIta AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sakale mUrchita haYe par3ave| erapara AvAra ziMgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, tatkSaNAt erA daNDAYamAna haYe tAkAte thAkave|

vizva era pratipAlakera jyotite udbhAsita have, AmalanAmA peza karA have evaM navIgaNake o sAkSigaNake upasthita karA have evaM sakalera madhye nyAYavicAra karA have o tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
pratyekera kRtakarmera pUrNa pratiphala deoYA have| erA yA kare se samparke AllAh savizeSa avahita|

kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera dike dale dale hA~kiYe niYe yAoYA have| yakhana erA jAhAnnAmera nikaTa upasthita have takhana eTAra pravezadvAraguli khule deoYA have evaM jAhAnnAmera rakSIrA ederake valave, ‘tomAdera nikaTa ki tomAdera madhya hate rAsUla Ase nAi yArA tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera pratipAlakera AYAta AvRtti karata, evaM ei dinera sAkSAt samvandhe tomAderake satarka karata?’ erA valave, ‘avazyai esechila|’ vastuta kAphiradera prati zAstira kathA vAstavAYita haYeche|
ederake valA have, ‘jAhAnnAmera dvArasamUhe praveza kara ete sthAYibhAve avasthitira janye| kata nikRSTa uddhatadera AvAsasthala!’

yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa karata tAderake dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA jAnnAtera nikaTa upasthita have o eTAra dvArasamUha khule deYA have evaM jAnnAtera rakSIrA tAderake valave, ‘tomAdera prati ‘sAlAma’, tomarA sukhI hao evaM jAnnAte praveza kara sthAYibhAve avasthitira janye|’

tArA praveza kare valave, ‘prazaMsA AllAh ra, yini AmAdera prati tA~ra pratizruti pUrNa karechena evaM AmAderake adhikArI karechena ei bha‚mira; AmarA jAnnAte yekhAne icchA vasavAsa karava|’ sadAcArIdera puraskAra kata uttama!

evaM tumi pherezatAderake dekhate pAve ye, erA ‘Arazera catuSpArzve ghire edera pratipAlakera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karache| Ara tAdera vicAra karA have nyAYera saGge| valA have, sakala prazaMsA jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAh ra prApya|
hA-mIma|
ei kitAva avatIrNa haYeche parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAh ra nikaTa hate-
yini pApa kSamA karena, taovA kavula karena, yini zAsti dAne kaThora, zaktizAlI| tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei| pratyAvartana tA~rai nikaTa|
kevala kAphirarAi AllAh ra nidarzana samvandhe vitarka kare; sutarAM deze deze tAdera avAdha vicaraNa yena tomAke vibhrAnta nA kare|

edera pUrve nUhera sampradAYa evaM tAdera pare anyAnya dalao asvIkAra karechila| pratyeka sampradAYa nija nija rAsUlake Avaddha karAra abhisandhi karechila evaM erA asAra tarke lipta haYechila, tA diYe satyake vyartha kare divAra janye| phale Ami ederake pAkar3Ao karalAma evaM kata kaThora chila AmAra zAsti!
eibhAve kAphiradera kSetre satya hala tomAra pratipAlakera vANI-erA jAhAnnAmI|

yArA ‘rAza dhAraNa kare Ache evaM yArA eTAra catuSpArzva ghiriYA Ache, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare prazaMsAra saGge evaM tA~ra prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM mu’minadera janye kSamA prArthanA kare vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tomAra daYA o jJAna sarvavyApI| ataeva yArA taovA kare o tomAra patha avalamvana kare tumi tAderake kSamA kara evaM jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate rakSA kara|’

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi tAderake dAkhila kara sthAYI jAnnAte, yAra pratizruti tumi tAderake diYecha evaM tAdera pitAmAtA, pati-patnI o santAna-santatidera madhye yArA satkarma kareche tAderakeo| tumi to parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
‘evaM tumi tAderake zAsti hate rakSA kara| sei dina tumi yAke zAsti hate rakSA karave, tAke to anugrahai karave; eTAi to mahAsAphalya|’

nizcaYa kAphiraderake uccakaNThe valA have, ‘tomAdera nijedera prati tomAdera kSobha apekSA AllAh ra aprasannatA chila adhika-yakhana tomAderake ImAnera prati AhvAna karA haYechila Ara tomarA tA asvIkAra karechile|’

erA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAderake prANahIna avasthAYa duivAra rekhecha evaM duivAra AmAderake prANa diYecha| AmarA AmAdera aparAdha svIkAra karachi; ekhana niSkramaNera kona patha milave ki?’

‘tomAdera ei zAsti tAra janya ye, yakhana eka AllAhke DAkA hata takhana tomarA tA~ke asvIkAra karate evaM AllAh ra zarIka sthira karA hale tomarA tA vizvAsa karate|’ vastuta samucca, mahAna AllAh ra i samasta kartRtva|
tinii tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhAna evaM AkAza hate preraNa karena tomAdera janye riyika, AllAh-abhimukhI vyaktii upadeza grahaNa kare|
sutarAM AllAhke DAka tA~ra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe, yadio kAphirarA eTA apachanda kare|
tini samucca maryAdAra adhikArI, ‘Arazera adhipati, tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA ohI preraNa karena svIYa Adezasaha, yAte se satarka karate pAre kiYAmata divasa samparke|
yedina mAnuSa vera haYe par3ave sedina AllAh ra nikaTa edera kichui gopana thAkave nA| Aja kartRtva kAra? AllAharai, yini eka, parAkramazAlI|
Aja pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera phala deoYA have; Aja kona juluma karA have nA| AllAh hiseva grahaNe tatpara|
ederake satarka kare dAo Asanna dina samparke yakhana duHkha-kaSTe edera prANa kaNThAgata have| jAlimadera janye kona antaraMga vandhu nei, yAra supAriza grAhya have emana kona supArizakArIo nAi|
cokhera apavyavahAra o antare yA gopana Ache se samvandhe tini avahita|
AllAhi vicAra karena saThikabhAve| AllAh ra parivarte erA yAderake DAke tArA vicAra karate akSama| AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

erA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA? karale dekhata-edera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kI haYechila| pRthivIte erA chila edera apekSA zaktite evaM kIrtite pravalatara| erapara AllAh ederake zAsti diYechilena edera aparAdhera janye evaM AllAhara zAsti hate ederake rakSA karAra keu chila nA|
eTA eijanye ye, edera nikaTa edera rAsUlagaNa nidarzanasaha Asale erA tAderake pratyAkhyAna karechila| phale AllAh ederake zAsti dilena| tini to zaktizAlI, zAstidAne kaThora|
Ami AmAra nidarzana o spaSTa pramANasaha mUsAke preraNa karechilAma,
phira‘Aona, hAmAna o kArUnera nikaTa kintu erA valechila, ‘ei lokaTA to eka jAdukara, carama mithyAvAdI|’

erapara mUsA AmAra nikaTa hate satya niYe edera nikaTa upasthita hale erA valala, ‘mUsAra saGge yArA ImAna eneche, tAdera putra-santAnaderake hatyA kara evaM tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkha|’ kintu kAphiradera Sar3ayantra vyartha havei|

phira‘Aona valala, ‘AmAke cher3e dAo Ami mUsAke hatyA kari evaM se tAra pratipAlakera zaraNApanna hoka| Ami AzaMkA kari ye, se tomAdera dInera parivartana ghaTAve vA se pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karave|’
mUsA valala, ‘yArA vicAra divase vizvAsa kare nA, sei sakala uddhata vyakti hate Ami AmAra o tomAdera pratipAlakera zaraNApanna haYechi|’

phira‘Aona vaMzera eka vyakti, ye mu’mina chila evaM nija ImAna gopana rAkhata, valala, ‘tomarA ki eka vyaktike eijanye hatyA karave ye, se vale, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka AllAh,’ athaca se tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate suspaSTa pramANasaha tomAdera nikaTa eseche? se mithyAvAdI hale tAra mithyAvAditAra janye se dAYI have, Ara yadi se satyavAdI haYa, se tomAderake ye zAstira kathA vale, tAra kichu to tomAdera opara Apatita havei|’ nizcaYa AllAh sImAlaMghanakArI o mithyAvAdIke satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

‘he AmAra sampradAYa! Aja kartRtva tomAdera, deze tomarAi pravala; kintu AmAdera opara AllAh ra zAsti ese par3ile ke AmAderake sAhAyya karave?’ phira‘Aona valala, ‘Ami yA vujhi, Ami tomAderake tAi valachi| Ami tomAderake kevala satpathai dekhiYe thAki|’
mu’mina vyaktiTi valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami tomAdera janye pUrvavartI sampradAYasamUhera zAstira dinera anurUpa durdinera AzaMkA kari-
‘yemana ghaTiYAchila nUh, ‘Ada, sAmUda evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera vyApAre| AllAh to vAndAdera prati kona juluma karate cAna nA|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami tomAdera janye AzaMkA kari ArtanAda divasera,
‘yedina tomarA pazcAt phire palAYana karate cAive| AllAh ra zAsti hate tomAderake rakSA karAra keu thAkave nA| AllAh yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janye kona pathapradarzaka nei|’

pUrveo tomAdera nikaTa iusupha esechila spaSTa nidarzanasaha; kintu se tomAdera nikaTa yA niYe esechila tomarA tAte vAravAra sandeha poSaNa karate| parizeSe yakhana iusuphera mRtyu hala takhana tomarA valechile, ‘tAra pare AllAh Ara kona rAsUla preraNa karavena nA|’ eibhAve AllAh vibhrAnta karena sImAlaMghanakArI o saMzaYavAdIderake-

yArA nijedera nikaTa kona dalIla-pramANa nA thAkaleo AllAh ra nidarzana samparke vitaNDAYa lipta haYa, tAdera ei karma AllAh evaM mu’minadera dRSTite atizaYa ghRNArha| eibhAve AllAh pratyeka uddhata o svairAcArI vyaktira hRdaYake mohara kare dena|
phira‘Aona valala, ‘he hAmAna! AmAra janye tumi nirmANa kara eka suucca prAsAda yAte Ami pAi avalamvana-

‘avalamvana AsamAne ArohaNera, yena dekhate pAi mUsAra ilAhke; tave Ami to eke mithyAvAdIi mane kari|’ eibhAve phira‘Aonera nikaTa zobhanIYa karA haYechila tAra manda karmake evaM tAke nivRtta karA haYechila sarala patha hate evaM phira‘Aonera Sar3ayantra vyartha haYechila sampUrNarUpe|
mu’mina vyaktiTi valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara, Ami tomAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karava|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! ei pArthiva jIvana to asthAYI upabhogera vastu evaM AkhirAtai hacche cirasthAYI AvAsa|

‘keu manda karma karale se kevala tAra karmera anurUpa zAsti pAve evaM puruSa kiMvA nArIra madhye yArA mu’mina haYe satkarma kare tArA dAkhila have jAnnAte, sekhAne tAderake deoYA have aparimita jIvanopakaraNa|
‘he AmAra sampradAYa! kI Azcarya! Ami tomAderake AhvAna karachi muktira dike, Ara tomarA AmAke DAkachi agnira dike!
‘tomarA AmAke valacho AllAhke asvIkAra karate evaM tA~ra samakakSa dA~r3a karAte, yAra samparke AmAra kona jJAna nei; pakSAntare Ami tomAderake AhvAna karachi parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla AllAh ra dike|

niHsandehe tomarA AmAke AhvAna karacho emana ekajanera dike ye duniYA o AkhirAte kothAo AhvAnayogya naYa| vastuta AmAdera pratyAvartana to AllAh ra nikaTa evaM sImAlaMghanakArIrAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|
‘Ami tomAderake yA valitechi, tomarA tA acirei smaraNa karave evaM Ami AmAra vyApAra AllAhte arpaNa karachi; AllAh tA~ra vAndAdera prati savizeSa dRSTi rAkhena|’
erapara AllAh tAke edera Sar3ayantrera aniSTa hate rakSA karalena evaM kaThina zAsti pariveSTana karala phira‘Aona sampradAYake|
ederake upasthita karA haYa Agunera sAmane sakAla o sandhyAYa evaM yedina kiYAmata ghaTave sedina valA have, ‘phiraAona-sampradAYake nikSepa kara kaThina zAstite|’

yakhana erA jAhAnnAme paraspara vitarke lipta have takhana durvalerA dAmbhikaderake valave, ‘AmarA to tomAderai anusArI chilAma, ekhana ki tomarA AmAdera hate jAhAnnAmera Agunera kiYadaMza nivAraNa karave?’
dAmbhikerA valave, ‘AmarA sakalei to jAhAnnAme Achi, nizcaYa AllAh vAndAdera vicAra to kare phelechena|’
agnivAsIrA jAhAnnAmera praharIderake valave, ‘tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa prArthanA kara tini yena AmAdera hate lAghava karena eka dinera zAsti|’

tArA valave, ‘tomAdera nikaTa ki spaSTa nidarzanasaha tomAdera rAsUlagaNa Ase nAi?’ jAhAnnAmIrA valave, ‘avazyai esechila|’ praharIrA valave, ‘tave tomarAi prArthanA kara; Ara kAphiradera prArthanA vyarthai haYa|
nizcaYai Ami AmAra rAsUladerake o mu’minaderake sAhAyya karava pArthiva jIvane evaM yei dina sAkSigaNa daNDAYamAna have|
yedina jAlimadera ‘oyara-Apatti kona kAje Asave nA, Ara edera janye raYeche lA‘nata evaM edera janye raYeche nikRSTa AvAsa|
Ami avazyai mUsAke dAna karechilAma pathanirdeza evaM vanI isarAIlake uttarAdhikArI karechilAma sei kitAvera,
pathanirdeza o upadezasvarUpa vodhazaktisampanna lokadera janye|

ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara; nizcaYai AllAh ra pratizruti satya, tumi tomAra truTira janye kSamA prArthanA kara evaM tomAra pratipAlakera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara sakAla o sandhyAYa|

yArA nijedera nikaTa kona dalIla nA thAkaleo AllAh ra nidarzana samparke vitarke lipta haYa, edera antare Ache kevala ahaMkAra, yArA ei vyApAre saphalakAma have nA| ataeva AllAh ra zaraNApanna hao; tini to sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
mAnava sRjana apekSA AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTi to kaThinatara, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA jAne nA|’
samAna naYa andha o cakSuSmAna evaM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare evaM yArA duSkRtiparAYaNa| tomarA alpai upadeza grahaNa kare thAka|
kiYAmata avazyambhAvI, ete kona sandeha nei; kintu adhikAMza loka vizvAsa kare nA|
tomAdera pratipAlaka valena, ‘tomarA AmAke DAka, Ami tomAdera DAke sAr3A diva| yArA ahaMkAravaze AmAra ‘ivAdate vimukha, erA avazyai jAhAnnAme praveza karave lAJchita haYe|’
AllAhi tomAdera vizrAmera janye sRSTi karechena rAtrike evaM Alokojjvala karechena divasake| AllAh to mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tinii AllAh, tomAdera pratipAlaka, sava kichura sraSTA; tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei; sutarAM tomAderake kothAYa phiriYe neoYA hacche?
eibhAvei vipathagAmI karA haYa tAderake yArA AllAh ra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra kare|

AllAhi tomAdera janye pRthivIke karechena vAsopayogI evaM AkAzake karechena chAda evaM tini tomAdera AkRti gaThana karechena evaM tomAdera AkRti karechena sundara evaM tomAderake dAna karechena utkRSTa riyika; tinii AllAh, tomAdera pratipAlaka| jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAh kata mahAna!
tini ciraJjIva, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei| sutarAM tomarA tA~kei DAka, tA~ra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe| sakala prazaMsA jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAh ra i|

vala, ‘tomarA AllAh vyatIta yAderake AhvAna kara, tAdera ‘ivAdata karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche yakhana AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate AmAra nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzana eseche| evaM Ami AdiSTa haYechi jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karate|

‘tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena mRttikA hate, pare zukravindu hate, tArapara AlAkA hate, tArapara tomAderake vera karena zizurUpe, erapara yena tomarA upanIta hao tomAdera yauvane, tArapara haYe yAo vRddha| Ara tomAdera madhye kArao mRtyu ghaTe eTAra pUrvei! yAte tomarA nirdhArita kAla prApta hao evaM yena tomarA anudhAvana karate pAra|
‘tinii jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna evaM yakhana tini kichu karA sthira karena takhana tini era janye valena, ‘hao’, Ara tA haYe yAYa|’
tumi ki lakSya kara nA ederake yArA AllAh ra nidarzana samparke vitarka kare? kibhAve ederake vipathagAmI karA hacche?’
yArA asvIkAra kare kitAva o yA saha AmAra rAsUlagaNake preraNa karechilAma tA; zIghrai erA jAnate pArave-
yakhana edera galadeze ver3i o zRMkhala thAkave, ederake Tene niYe yAoYA have
phuTanta pAnite, erapara ederake dagdha karA have agnite|
pare ederake valA have, ‘kothAYa tArA yAderake tomarA zarIka karate,
‘AllAh vyatIta?’ erA valave, ‘erA to AmAdera nikaTa hate udhAo haYeche; vastuta pUrve AmarA emana kichuke AhvAna kari nAi|’ eibhAve AllAh kAphiraderake vibhrAnta karena|
eTA ei kAraNe ye, tomarA pRthivIte ayathA ullAsa karate evaM eijanye ye, tomarA dambha karate|
tomarA jAhAnnAmera vibhinna darajA diYe praveza kara ete sthAYibhAve avasthitira janye, Ara katai nA nikRSTa uddhatadera AvAsasthala!

sutarAM tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara| nizcaYa AllAh ra pratizruti satya| Ami ederake ye pratizruti pradAna kari tAra kichu yadi tomAke dekhiYei dei vA tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi-edera pratyAvartana to AmArai nikaTa|

Ami to tomAra pUrve aneka rAsUla preraNa karechilAma| Ami tAdera kArao kArao kathA tomAra nikaTa vivRta karechi evaM kArao kArao kathA tomAra nikaTa vivRta kari nAi| AllAh ra anumati vyatIta kona nidarzana upasthita karA kona rAsUlera kAja naYa| AllAh ra Adeza Asale nyAYasaMgatabhAve phaYasAlA haYe yAve| takhana mithyAzraYIrA kSatigrasta have|
AllAhi tomAdera janye Ana‘Ama sRSTi karechena, yAte edera katakera opara tomarA ArohaNa kara evaM kataka tomarA AhAra kara|
ete tomAdera janye raYeche pracura upakAra| tomarA antare yA praYojana vodha kara, eTA diYe yena tA pUrNa karate pAra, Ara edera opara o nauyAnera opara tomAderake vahana karA haYa|
tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhiYe thAkena| sutarAM tomarA AllAh ra kon kon nidarzanake asvIkAra karave?

erA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nAi o dekhe nAi edera pUrvavartIdera kI pariNAma haYechila? pRthivIte tArA chila edera apekSA saMkhyAYa adhika evaM zaktite o kIrtite adhika pravala| tArA yA karata tA tAdera kona kAje Ase nAi|
edera nikaTa yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha edera rAsUla Asata takhana erA nijedera jJAnera dambha karata| erA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karata tAi ederake veSTana karala|
erapara erA yakhana AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala takhana valala, ‘AmarA eka AllAhtei ImAna AnalAma evaM AmarA tA~ra saGge yAderake zarIka karatAma tAderake pratyAkhyAna karalAma|’
erA yakhana AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala takhana edera ImAna edera kona upakAre elo nA| AllAh ra ei vidhAna pUrva hatei tA~ra vAndAdera madhye cale Asache evaM sei kSetre kAphirarA kSatigrasta haYa|
hA-mIma|
eTA daYAmaYa, parama daYAlura nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
eka kitAva, vizadabhAve vivRta haYeche eTAra AYAtasamUha, AravI bhASAYa kuraAna, jJAnI sampradAYera janye,
susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI| kintu adhikAMza loka mukha phiriYe niYeche, sutarAM erA zunave nA|

erA vale, ‘tumi yAra prati AmAderake AhvAna karacho se viSaYe AmAdera antara AvaraNa-AcchAdita, AmAdera karNe Ache vadhiratA evaM tomAra o AmAdera madhye Ache antarAla; sutarAM tumi tomAra kAja kara evaM AmarA AmAdera kAja kari|’

vala, ‘Ami to tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSai, AmAra prati ohI haYa ye, tomAdera ilAh ekamAtra ilAh| ataeva tomarA tA~rai patha dRr3habhAve avalamvana kara evaM tA~rai nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara| durbheAga aMzIvAdIdera janye-
yArA yAkAta pradAna kare nA evaM erA AkhirAteo avizvAsI|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera janye raYeche niravacchinna puraskAra|
vala, ‘tomarA ki tA~ke asvIkAra karavei yini pRthivI sRSTi karechena dui dine evaM tomarA ki tA~ra samakakSa dA~r3a karAtecha? tini to jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka!
tini sthApana karechena aTala parvatamAlA bhUpRSThe evaM ete rekhechena kalyANa evaM cAra dinera madhye ete vyavasthA karechena khAdyera samabhAve, yAcJAkArIdera janye|
erapara tini AkAzera dike manoniveza karena yA chila dhUmrapuJjavizeSa| anantara tini eke o pRthivIke valalena, ‘tomarA ubhaYe Asa icchAYa vA anicchAYa|’ erA valala, ‘AmarA elAma anugata haYe|’

erapara tini AkAzamaNDalake dui dine saptAkAze pariNata karalena evaM pratyeka AkAze era vidhAna vyakta karalena, evaM Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake suzobhita karalAma pradIpamAlA diYe evaM karalAma surakSita| eTA parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa AllAh ra vyavasthApanA|
tavuo erA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tave vala, ‘Ami to tomAderake satarka karachi eka dhvaMsakara zAstira, Ada o sAmUdera zAstira anurUpa|’

yakhana edera nikaTa rAsUlagaNa esechila edera sammukha o pazcAt hate evaM valechila, ‘tomarA AllAh vyatIta kArao ‘ivAdata kara nA|’ takhana erA valechila, ‘AmAdera pratipAlakera eirUpa icchA hale tini avazyai pherezatA preraNa karatena| ataeva tomarA yAsaha prerita haYecha, AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna karalAma|’

Ara ‘Ada sampradAYera vyApAra ei ye, erA pRthivIte ayathA dambha karata evaM valata, ‘AmAdera apekSA zaktizAlI ke Ache?’ erA ki tave lakSya kare nAi ye, AllAh, yini ederake sRSTi karechena, tini edera apekSA zaktizAlI? athaca erA AmAra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra karata|

erapara Ami ederake pArthiva jIvane lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti AsvAdana karAivAra janye edera viruddhe preraNa karechilAma jhaJjhAvAYu azubha dine| AkhirAtera zAsti to adhikatara lAJchanAdAYaka evaM ederake sAhAyya karA have nA|

Ara sAmUda sampradAYera vyApAra to ei ye, Ami ederake pathanirdeza karechilAma, kintu erA satpathera parivarte bhrAnta patha avalamvana karechila| erapara ederake lAJchanAdAYaka zAstira vajra AghAta hAnila edera kRtakarmera pariNAmasvarUpa|
Ami rakSA karalAma tAderake, yArA ImAna enechila evaM yArA tAkoYA avalamvana karata|
yedina AllAh ra zatruderake jAhAnnAmera dike samaveta karA have sedina ederake vinyasta karA have vibhinna dale,
parizeSe yakhana erA jAhAnnAmera sannikaTe peৗ~chive takhana edera karNa, cokha o tvaka edera kRtakarma samvandhe sAkSya dive, edera viruddhe|

jAhAnnAmIrA edera tvakake jijJAsA karave, ‘tomarA AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya ditecha kena?’ uttare erA valave, ‘AllAh, yini AmAderake vAkazakti diYechena tini samasta kichuke vAkazakti diYechena| tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena prathamavAra evaM tA~rai nikaTe tomarA pratyAvartita have|’
‘tomarA kichu gopana karate nA ei vizvAse ye, tomAdera karNa, cokha o tvaka tomAdera viruddhe sAkSya dive nA-oparantu tomarA mane karate ye, tomarA yA karate tAra aneka kichui AllAh jAnena nA|
‘tomAdera pratipAlaka samvandhe tomAdera ei dhAraNAi tomAdera dhvaMsa eneche| phale tomarA haYecha kSatigrasta|’
ekhana erA dhairya dhAraNa karaleo jAhAnnAmai have edera AvAsa evaM erA anugraha cAileo erA anugraha prApta have nA|

Ami edera janye nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma sahacara, yArA edera sAmane o pazcAte yA Ache tA edera dRSTite zobhana kare dekhiYechila evaM edera vyApAreo edera pUrvavartI jina o mAnuSadera nyAYa zAstira vANI vAstava haYeche| erA to chila kSatigrasta|
kAphirarA vale, ‘tomarA ei kuraAna zona nA evaM tA AvRttikAle zoragola sRSTi kara yAte tomarA jaYI hate pAra|’
Ami avazyai kAphiraderake kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAva evaM nizcaYai Ami ederake edera nikRSTa kAryakalApera pratiphala diva|
jAhAnnAma, eTAi AllAh ra zatrudera pratiphala; sekhAne edera janye raYeche sthAYI AvAsa, AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkRtira pratiphalasvarUpa|
kAphirarA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! yesava jina o mAnava AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila edera ubhaYake dekhiYe dAo, AmarA ubhaYake padadalita karava, yAte erA lAJchita haYa|’

yArA vale, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAh’, erapara avicalita thAke, tAdera nikaTa avatIrNa haYa pherezatA evaM vale, ‘tomarA bhIta haYo nA, cintita haYo nA evaM tomAderake ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deoYA haYechila tAra janye Anandita hao|
‘AmarAi tomAdera vandhu duniYAra jIvane o AkhirAte| sekhAne tomAdera janye raYeche yA kichu tomAdera mana cAYa evaM sekhAne tomAdera janye raYeche yA tomarA rphamAYeza kara|’
eTA kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu AllAh ra pakSa hate ApyAYana|
kathAYa ke uttama ai vyakti apekSA ye AllAh ra prati mAnuSake AhvAna kare, satkarma kare evaM vale, ‘Ami to anugatadera antarbhukta|’
bhAla o manda samAna hate pAre nA| manda pratihata kara utkRSTa diYe; phale tomAra saGge yAra zatrutA Ache, se haYe yAve antaraGga vandhura mata|
ei guNera adhikArI karA haYa kevala tAderakei, yArA dhairyazIla, ei guNera adhikArI karA haYa kevala tAderakei, yArA mahAbhAgyavAna|
yadi zaYatAnera kumantraNA tomAke prarocita kare tave AllAh ra zaraNa nive, tini to sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche rajanI o divasa, sUrya o candra| tomarA sUryake sijdA kara nA, candrakeo naYa; sijdA kara AllAhke, yini eiguli sRSTi karechena, yadi tomarA prakRtai tA~ra ‘ivAdata kara|
erA ahaMkAra karaleo yArA tomAra pratipAlakera sAnnidhye raYeche tArA to divasa o rajanIte tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM tArA klAntivodha kare nA|

evaM tA~ra ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, tumi bhUmike dekhate pAo zuSka USara, erapara yakhana Ami ete vAri varSaNa kari takhana tA Andolita o sphIta haYa| yini bhUmike jIvita karena tinii to mRtera jIvanadAnakArI| nizcaYa tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vikRta kare tArA AmAra agocara naYa| zreSTha ke-ye vyakti jAhAnnAme nikSipta have se, nA ye kiYAmatera dina nirApade thAkave se? tomAdera yA icchA kara; tomarA yA kara tini tAra samyaka draSTA|
yArA edera nikaTa kuraAna AsAra para tA pratyAkhyAna kare tAderake kaThina zAsti deoYA have; eTA avazyai eka mahimamaYa grantha-
kona mithyA ete anupraveza karate pAre nA-agra hateo naYa, pazcAt hateo naYa| eTA prajJAmaYa, prazaMsArha AllAh ra nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
tomAra samvandhe to tAi valA haYa, yA valA hata tomAra pUrvavartI rAsUlagaNa samparke| tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai kSamAzIla evaM kaThina zAstidAtA|

Ami yadi ‘AjamI bhASAYa kuraAna avatIrNa karatAma tave erA avazyai valata, ‘eTAra AYAtaguli vizadabhAve vivRta haYa nAi kena?’ kI Azcarya ye, eTAra bhASA ‘AjamI, athaca rAsUla AravIYa! vala, ‘mu’minadera janye eTA pathanirdeza o vyAdhira pratikAra|’ kintu yArA avizvAsI tAdera karNe raYeche vadhiratA evaM kuraAna have edera janye andhatva| erA emana ye, ederake yena AhvAna karA haYa vahudUra hate|

Ami to mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, erapara ete matabheda ghaTechila| tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale edera mImAMsA haYe yeta| erA avazyai eTAra samvandhe vibhrAntikara sandehe raYeche|
ye satkarma kare se nijera kalyANera janyei tA kare evaM keu manda karma karale era pratiphala se-i bhoga karave| tomAra pratipAlaka tA~ra vAndAdera prati juluma karena nA|

kiYAmatera jJAna kevala AllAhtei nyasta, tA~ra ajJAtasAre kona phala AvaraNa hate vera haYa nA, kona nArI garbha dhAraNa kare nA evaM santAnao prasava kare nA| yedina AllAh ederake Deke valavena, ‘AmAra zarIkerA kothAYa?’ takhana erA valave, ‘AmarA ApanAra nikaTa nivedana kari ye, ei vyApAre AmarA kichui jAni nA|’
pUrve erA yAderake AhvAna karata tArA udhAo haYe yAve evaM aMzIvAdIrA upalavdhi karave ye, edera niSkRtira kona upAYa nei|
mAnuSa dhana-sampada prArthanAYa kona klAnti vodha kare nA, kintu yakhana tAke duHkha-dainya sparza kare takhana se nirAza o hatAza haYe par3e;

duHkha-dainya sparza karAra para yadi Ami tAke anugraha AsvAdana karAi takhana se avazyai vale thAke, ‘eTA AmAra prApya evaM Ami mane kari nA ye, kiYAmata saMghaTata have, Ara Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa pratyAvartita haYo tA~ra nikaTa to AmAra janye kalyANai thAkave|’ Ami kAphiraderake edera kRtakarma samvandhe avazyai avahita karava evaM ederake AsvAdana karAivai kaThora zAsti|
yakhana Ami mAnuSera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa o dUre sariYA yAYa evaM tAke aniSTa sparza karale se takhana dIrgha prArthanAYa rata haYa|

vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi ei kuraAna AllAh ra nikaTa hate avatIrNa haYe thAke Ara tomarA eTA pratyAkhyAna kara, tave ye vyakti ghora viruddhAcaraNe lipta Ache, tAra apekSA adhika vibhrAnta Ara ke?’

Ami edera janye AmAra nidarzanAvalI vyakta karava, vizvajagate evaM edera nijedera madhye; phale edera nikaTa suspaSTa haYe uThive ye, eTAi satya| eTA ki tomAra pratipAlaka samparke yatheSTa naYa ye, tini sarvaviSaYe avahita?
jene rAkha, erA edera pratipAlakera saGge sAkSAtkAre sandihAna| jene rAkha, savakichuke AllAh pariveSTana kare raYechena|
hA-mIma|
‘Aina-sIna-kApha|
ebhAvei tomAra prati evaM tomAra pUrvavartIdera prati pratyAdeza karena parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAh|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai| tini samunnata, mahAna|

AkAzamaNDalI Urdhvadeza hate bheGge par3Ara upakrama haYa evaM pherezatAgaNa tAdera pratipAlakera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM martyavAsIdera janye kSamA prArthanA kare| jene rAkha, AllAh, tini to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA AllAh ra parivarte aparake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare, AllAh tAdera prati samyaka dRSTi rAkhena| tumi tAdera karmavidhAYaka nao|

ebhAve Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi AravI bhASAYa, yAte tumi satarka karate pAra makkA o era caturdikera janagaNake evaM satarka karate pAra kiYAmata divasa samparke, yAte kona sandeha nei| sedina ekadala jAnnAte praveza karave evaM ekadala jAhAnnAme praveza karave|
AllAh icchA karale mAnuSake ekai ummata karate pAratena; vastuta tini yAke icchA tAke svIYa anugrahera adhikArI karena; Ara jAlimarA, edera kona abhibhAvaka nei, kona sAhAyyakArIo nei|
erA ki AllAh ra parivarte aparake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kareche, kintu AllAh, abhibhAvaka to tinii, evaM tini mRtake jIvita karena| tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tomarA ye viSaYei matabheda kara nA kena-era mImAMsA to AllAh ra i nikaTa| tinii AllAh-AmAra pratipAlaka; tA~rai opara Ami nirbhara kari Ara tA~rai abhimukhI Ami|

tini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA, tini tomAdera madhya hate tomAdera jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM Ana‘Amera madhya hate sRSTi karechena edera jor3A| eibhAve tini tomAdera vaMzavistAra karena; kona kichui tA~ra sadRza naYa, tini sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra kuJji tA~rai nikaTa| tini yAra janye icchA tAra riyika vardhita karena evaM saMkucita karena| tini sarvaviSaYe savizeSa avahita|

tini tomAdera janye vidhivaddha karechena dIna yAra nirdeza diYechilena tini nUhke, Ara yA Ami ohI karechi tomAke evaM yAra nirdeza diYechilAma ivrAhIma, mUsA o IsAke, ei vale ye, tomarA dInake pratiSThita kara evaM ete matabheda kara nA| tumi muzarikaderake yAra prati AhvAna karacho tA edera nikaTa durvaha mane haYa| AllAh yAke icchA dInera prati AkRSTa karena evaM ye tA~ra abhimukhI, tAke dInera dike paricAlita karena|

edera nikaTa jJAna AsAra para kevala pArasparika vidveSavazata erA nijedera madhye matabheda ghaTAYa| eka nirdhArita kAla paryanta avakAza samparke tomAra pratipAlakera pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale edera viSaYe phaYasAlA haYe yeta| edera para yArA kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYeche tArA to sei samparke vibhrAntikara sandehe raYeche|

sutarAM tumi era dike AhvAna kara o etei dRr3ha pratiSThita thAka yebhAve tumi AdiSTa haYecha evaM edera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara nA| vala, ‘AllAh ye kitAva avatIrNa karechena Ami tAte vizvAsa kari evaM Ami AdiSTa haYechi tomAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karate| AllAhi AmAdera pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka| AmAdera karma AmAdera evaM tomAdera karma tomAdera; AmAdera o tomAdera madhye vivAda-visamvAda nei| AllAhi AmAderake ekatra karavena evaM pratyAvartana tA~rai nikaTa|’
AllAhke svIkAra karAra para yArA AllAh samparke vitarka kare tAdera yukti-tarka tAdera pratipAlakera dRSTite asAra evaM erA tA~ra krodhera pAtra evaM edera janye raYeche kaThina zAsti|
AllAhi avatIrNa karechena satyasaha kitAva evaM tulAdaNDa| tumi ki jAna, sambhavata kiYAmata Asanna?

yArA eTA vizvAsa kare nA tArAi eTA tvarAnvita karate cAYa| Ara yArA vizvAsI tArA eke bhaYa kare evaM jAne eTAi satya| jene rAkha, kiYAmata samparke yArA vAka-vitaNDA kare tArA ghora vibhrAntite raYeche|
AllAh tA~ra vAndAdera prati ati daYAlu; tini yAke icchA riyika dAna karena| tini pravala parAkramazAlI|
ye keu AkhirAtera phasala kAmanA kare tAra janye Ami tAra phasala vardhita kare dei evaM ye keu duniYAra phasala kAmanA kare Ami tAke erai kichu dei, AkhirAte tAra janye kichui thAkave nA|

edera ki emana katakaguli devatA Ache yArA edera janye vidhAna diYeche emana dInera, yAra anumati AllAh dena nAi? phaYasAlAra ghoSaNA nA thAkale edera viSaYe to siddhAnta haYei yeta| nizcaYai jAlimadera janye raYeche marmantuda zAsti|

tumi jAlimaderake bhIta-santrasta dekhave edera kRtakarmera janye; Ara eTA Apatita havei edera opara| yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tArA thAkave jAnnAtera manorama sthAne| tArA yA kichu cAive tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tAi pAve| eTAi to mahAanugraha|

ei susaMvAdai AllAh dena tA~ra vAndAderake yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare| vala, ‘Ami eTAra vinimaYe tomAdera nikaTa hate AtmIYera sauhArdya vyatIta anya kona pratidAna cAi nA|’ ye uttama kAja kare Ami tAra janye ete kalyANa vardhita kari| AllAh kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|

erA ki vale ye, se AllAh samparke mithyA udbhAvana kareche? yadi tAi hata tave AllAh icchA karale tomAra hRdaYa mohara kare ditena| AllAha mithyAke muche dena evaM nija vANI diYe satyake pratiSThita karena| antare yA Ache se viSaYe tini to savizeSa avahita|
tinii tA~ra vAndAdera taovA kavUla karena o pApa mocana karena evaM tomarA yA kara tini tA jAnena|
tini mu’mina o satkarmaparAYaNadera AhvAne sAr3A dena evaM tAdera prati tA~ra anugraha vardhita karena; kAphiradera janye raYeche kaThina zAsti|

AllAh tA~ra sakala vAndAke jIvanopakaraNe prAcurya dile tArA pRthivIte avazyai viparyaYa sRSTi karata; kintu tini tA~ra icchAmata parimANei nAyila kare thAkena| tini tA~ra vAndAderake samyaka jAnena o dekhena|
erA yakhana hatAzAgrasta haYe par3e takhanai tini vRSTi preraNa karena evaM tA~ra karuNA vistAra karena| tinii to abhibhAvaka, prazaMsArha|
tA~ra anyatama nidarzana AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sRSTi evaM ei duiYera madhye tini ye sakala jIvajantu char3iYe diYechena seiguli| tini yakhana icchA takhanai ederake samaveta karate sakSama|
tomAdera ye vipada-Apada ghaTe tA to tomAdera kRtakarmerai phala evaM tomAdera aneka aparAdha to tini kSamA kare dena|
tomarA pRthivIte AllAh ra abhiprAYake vyartha karate pArave nA evaM AllAh vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tA~ra anyatama nidarzana parvatasadRza samudre calamAna nauyAnasamUha|
tini icchA karale vAYuke stavdha kare dite pArena; phale nauyAnasamUha nizcala haYe par3ave samudrapRSThe| nizcaYai ete nidarzana rahiYAcha dhairyazIla o kRtajJa vyaktira janye|
athavA tini tAdera kRtakarmera janye seigulike vidhvasta kare dite pArena evaM anekake tini kSamAo karena;
Ara AmAra nidarzana samparke yArA vitarka kare tArA yena jAnate pAre ye, tAdera kona niSkRti nei|
vastuuta tomAderake yA kichu deoYA haYeche tA pArthiva jIvanera bhoga, kintu AllAh ra nikaTa yA Ache tA uttama o sthAYI tAdera janye, yArA ImAna Ane o tAdera pratipAlakera opara nirbhara kare,
yArA gurutara pApa o azlIla kArya hate veA~ce thAke evaM krodhAviSTa hale kSamA kare deYa,
yArA tAdera pratipAlakera AhvAne sAr3A deYa, sAlAta kAYema kare, nijedera madhye parAmarzera mAdhyame nijedera karma sampAdana kare evaM tAderake Ami ye riyika diYechi tA hate vyaYa kare|
evaM yArA atyAcArita hale pratizodha grahaNa kare|
mandera pratiphala anurUpa manda evaM ye kSamA kare deYa o Aposa-niSpatti kare tAra puraskAra AllAh ra nikaTa Ache| AllAh jAlimaderake pachanda karena nA|
tave atyAcArita haoYAra para yArA pratividhAna kare tAdera viruddhe kona vyavasthA grahaNa karA have nA;
kevala tAdera viruddhe vyavasthA avalamvana karA have yArA mAnuSera opara atyAcAra kare evaM pRthivIte anyAYabhAve vidrohAcaraNa kare ver3AYa, edera janye marmantuda zAsti|
avazya ye dhairya dhAraNa kare evaM kSamA kare deYa, tA to have dRr3ha saMkalperai kAja|
AllAh yAke pathabhraSTa karena tatpara tAra janye kona abhibhAvaka nei| jAlimarA yakhana zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana tumi ederake valite zunave, ‘pratyAvartanera kona upAYa Ache ki?’

tumi ederake dekhate pAve ye, ederake jAhAnnAmera sAmane upasthita karA hacche; tArA apamAne avanata avasthAYa ardhanimIlita netre tAkAcche| mu’minarA kiYAmatera dina valave, ‘kSatigrasta tArAi yArA nijedera o nijedera parijanavargera kSatisAdhana kareche|’ jene rAkha, jAlimarA avazyai bhoga karave sthAYI zAsti|
AllAh vyatIta ederake sAhAyya karAra janye edera kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA evaM AllAh yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra kona gati nei|
tomAdera pratipAlakera AhvAne sAr3A dAo AllAh ra pakSa hate sei divasa AsAra pUrve, yA apratirodhya; yedina tomAdera kona AzraYasthala thAkave nA evaM tomAdera janye tA nirodha karAra keu thAkave nA|

erA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tomAke to Ami edera rakSaka kare pAThAi nAi| tomAra kAja to kevala vANI peৗ~che deoYA| Ami mAnuSake yakhana anugraha AsvAdana karAi takhana se ete utphula¬ haYa evaM yakhana edera kRtakarmera janye edera vipada-Apada ghaTe takhana mAnuSa haYe par3e akRtajJa|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra Adhipatya AllAh ra i| tini yA icchA tAi sRSTi karena| tini yAke icchA kanyA santAna dAna karena evaM yAke icchA putra santAna dAna karena,
athavA dAna karena putra o kanyA ubhaYai evaM yAke icchA tAke kare dena vandhyA; tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

mAnuSera emana maryAdA nei ye, AllAh tAra saGge kathA valavena ohIra mAdhyama vyatireke, vA pardAra antarAla vyatireke, vA emana dUta preraNa vyatireke, yei dUta tA~ra anumatikrame tini yA cAna tA vyakta karena, tini samunnata, prajJAmaYa|

eibhAve Ami tomAra prati pratyAdeza karechi rUh tathA AmAra nirdeza; tumi to jAnate nA kitAva ki evaM ImAna ki| pakSAntare Ami eTAke karechi Alo yA diYe Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA pathanirdeza kari; tumi to pradarzana kara kevala sarala patha-
sei AllAh ra patha yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tAra mAlika| jene rAkha, sakala viSaYera pariNAma AllAh ra i dike pratyAvartana kare|
hA-mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera;
Ami eTA avatIrNa karechi AravI bhASAYa kuraAna, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
eTA to raYeche AmAra nikaTa ummula kitAve; eTA mahAna, jJAnagarbha|
Ami ki tomAdera hate ei upadezavANI sampUrNarUpe pratyAhAra kare niva ei kAraNe ye, tomarA sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa?
pUrvavartIdera nikaTa Ami vahu navI preraNa karechilAma|
evaM yakhanai edera nikaTa kona navI eseche erA tAke ThATTA-vidrupa kareche|
yArA edera apekSA zaktite pravala chila, tAderake Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma; Ara eibhAve cale eseche pUrvavartIdera anurUpa dRSTAnta|
tumi yadi ederake jijJAsA kara, ‘ke AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi kareche?’ erA avazyai valave, ‘eiguli to sRSTi karechena parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa AllAh’,
yini tomAdera janye pRthivIke karechena zayyA evaM ete karechena tomAdera calAra patha, yAte tomarA saThika patha pete pAra;
evaM yini AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena parimitabhAve| erapara Ami tA diYe saJjIvita kari nirjIva janapadake| eibhAvei tomAderake vera karA have|
Ara yini sakala prakArera jor3A yugala sRSTi karena evaM yini tomAdera janye sRSTi karena emana nauyAna o Ana‘Ama, yAte tomarA ArohaNa kara,

yAte tomarA edera pRSThe sthira haYe vasite pAra. tArapara tomAdera pratipAlakera anugraha smaraNa kara yakhana tomarA era opara sthira haYe vasa; evaM vala, ‘pavitra o mahAna tini, yini ederake AmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena, yadio AmarA samartha chilAma nA ederake vazIbhUta karate|
‘AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa avazyai pratyAvartana karava|’
erA tA~ra vAndAdera madhya hate tA~ra aMza sAvyasta kareche| mAnuSa to spaSTai akRtajJa|
tini ki tA~ra sRSTi hate nijera janye kanyA santAna grahaNa karechena evaM tomAderake viziSTa karechena putra santAna diYe?
daYAmaYa AllAh ra prati erA yA Aropa kare edera kAukeo sei santAnera saMvAda deoYA hale tAra mukhamaNDala kAlo haYe yAYa evaM se duHsaha marma yAtanAYa kliSTa haYa|
erA ki AllAh ra prati Aropa kare emana santAna, ye alaGkAre maNDita haYe lAlita-pAlita haYa evaM tarka-vitarkakAle spaSTa vaktavye asamartha?
erA daYAmaYa AllAh ra vAndA pherezatAderake nArI gaNya kareche; edera sRSTi ki erA pratyakSa karechila? edera ukti avazya lipivaddha karA have evaM ederake jijJAsA karA have|
erA vale, ‘daYAmaYa AllAh icchA karale AmarA edera pUjA karatAma nA|’ e viSaYe edera kona jJAna nei; erA to kevala managar3A valiteche|
Ami ki ederake kuraAnera pUrve kona kitAva dAna karechi yA erA dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare Ache?
varaM erA vale, ‘AmarA to AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake peYechi eka matAdarzera anusArI evaM AmarA tAderai padAMka anusaraNa karachi|’

eibhAve tomAra pUrve kona janapade yakhanai Ami kona satarkakArI preraNa karechi takhana era samRddhizAlI vyaktirA valata, ‘AmarA to AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake peYechi eka matAdarzera anusArI evaM AmarA tAderai padAMka anusaraNa karachi|’

sei satarkakArI valata, ‘tomarA tomAdera pUrvapuruSaderake ye pathe peYecha, Ami yadi tomAdera janye tadapekSA utkRSTa pathanirdeza AnaYana kari tavuo ki tomarA tAdera padAMka anusaraNa karave? tArA valata, ‘tomarA yAsaha prerita haYecha AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna kari|’
erapara Ami edera hate pratizodha nilAma| dekha, mithyAcArIdera pariNAma kI haYeche|
smaraNa kara, ivrAhIma tAra pitA evaM sampradAYake valechila, ‘tomarA yAdera pUjA kara tAdera saGge AmAra kona samparka nei;
‘samparka Ache zudhu tA~rai saGge, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena evaM tinii AmAke satpathe paricAlita karavena|’
ei ghoSaNAke se sthAYI vANIrUpe rekhe geche tAra paravartIdera janye, yAte erA pratyAvartana kare|
varaJca Amii ederake evaM edera pUrvapuruSaderake diYechilAma bhogera sAmagrI, avazeSe edera nikaTa elo satya evaM spaSTa varNanAkArI rAsUla|
yakhana edera nikaTa satya elo, erA valala, ‘eTA to jAdu evaM AmarA eTA pratyAkhyAna kari|’
evaM erA vale, ‘ei kuraAna kena nAyila karA hala nA dui janapadera kona pratipattizAlI vyaktira opara?’

erA ki tomAra pratipAlakera karuNA vaNTana kare? Amii edera madhye edera jIvikA vaNTana kari, pArthiva jIvane evaM ekajanake aparera opara maryAdAYa unnata kari, yAte eke aparera diYe kAja kariYe nite pAre; evaM erA yA jamA kare tA hate tomAra pratipAlakera anugraha utkRSTatara|

satya pratyAkhyAne mAnuSa eka-matAvalamvI haYe par3ave, ei AzaMkA nA thAkale daYAmaYa AllAhke yArA asvIkAra kare, ederake Ami ditAma edera gRhera janye raupya-nirmita chAda o si~r3i yAte erA ArohaNa kare,
evaM edera gRhera janye darajA o pAlaGka-yAte erA helAna diYe vizrAma karate pAre,
evaM svarNa-nirmitao| Ara ei sakalai to zudhu pArthiva jIvanera bhoga-sambhAra| muttAkIdera janye tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa raYeche AkhirAtera kalyANa|
ye vyakti daYAmaYa AllAh ra smaraNe vimukha haYa Ami tAra janye niYojita kari eka zaYatAna, erapara se-i haYa tAra sahacara|
zaYatAnerAi mAnuSake satpatha hate virata rAkhe, athaca mAnuSa mane kare tArA satpathe paricAlita hacche|
avazeSe yakhana se AmAra nikaTa upasthita have, takhana se zaYatAnake valave, ‘hAYa! AmAra o tomAra madhye yadi pUrva o pazcimera vyavadhAna thAkata!’ kata nikRSTa sahacara se!
Ara Aja tomAdera ei anutApa tomAdera kona kAjei Asave nA, yehetu tomarA sImAlaMghana karechile; tomarA to sakalei zAstite zarIka|
tumi ki zonAte pArave vadhirake vA ye andha o ye vyakti spaSTa vibhrAntite Ache, tAke ki pArave satpathe paricAlita karate?
Ami yadi tomAke niYe yAi, tavu Ami ederake zAsti diva;
athavA Ami ederake ye zAstira bhIti pradarzana karechi, Ami tomAke tA pratyakSa karAi, vastuta edera opara AmAra to pUrNa kSamatA raYeche|
sutarAM tomAra prati yA ohI karA haYeche tA dRr3habhAve avalamvana kara| tumi sarala pathei rahiYAcha|
kuraAna to tomAra o tomAra sampradAYera janye sammAnera vastu; tomAderake avazyai e viSaYe prazna karA have|
tomAra pUrve Ami ye sakala rAsUla preraNa karechilAma tAderake tumi jijJAsA kara, Ami ki daYAmaYa AllAh vyatIta kona devatA sthira karechilAma yAra ‘ivAdata karA yAYa?
mUsAke to Ami AmAra nidarzanasaha phira‘Aona o tAra pAriSadavargera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘Ami to jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera prerita|’
se edera nikaTa AmAra nidarzanasaha AsA mAtra erA tA niYe hAsi-ThATTA karate lAgala|
Ami ederake emana kona nidarzana dekhAi nAi yA era anurUpa nidarzana apekSA zreSTha naYa| Ami ederake zAsti dilAma yAte erA pratyAvartana kare|
erA valechila, he jAdukara! tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa tumi AmAdera janye tA prArthanA kara yA tini tomAra saGge aGgIkAra karechena, tA hale AmarA avazyai satpatha avalamvana karava|’
erapara yakhana Ami edera hate zAsti vidUrita karalAma takhanai erA aGgIkAra bhaGga kare vasala|
phira‘Aona tAra sampradAYera madhye ei vale ghoSaNA karala, he AmAra sampradAYa! misara rAjya ki AmAra naYa? Ara ei nadIguli AmAra pAdadeze pravAhita; tomarA eTA dekha nA?
‘Ami to zreSTha ei vyakti hate, ye hIna evaM spaSTa kathA valateo akSama!
‘mUsAke kena deoYA hala nA svarNa-valaYa vA tAra saGge kena elo nA pherezatAgaNa dalavaddhabhAve?’
eibhAve se tAra sampradAYake hatavuddhi kare dila, phale erA tAra kathA mene nila| erA to chila eka satyatyAgI sampradAYa|
yakhana erA AmAke krodhAnvita karala Ami ederake zAsti dilAma evaM nimajjita karalAma edera sakalake|
tatpara paravartIdera janye Ami ederake kare rAkhalAma atIta itihAsa o dRSTAnta|
yakhana mAraiYAma-tanaYera dRSTAnta upasthita karA haYa, takhana tomAra sampradAYa tAte zoragola Arambha kare deYa,
evaM vale, ‘AmAdera upAsyaguli zreSTha nA ‘IsA?’ erA kevala vAka-vitaNDAra uddezyei tomAke ei kathA vale| vastuta erA to eka vitaNDAkArI sampradAYa|
se to chila AmArai eka vAndA, yAke Ami anugraha karechilAma evaM karechilAma vanI isarAIlera janye dRSTAnta|
Ami icchA karale tomAdera madhya hate pherezatA sRSTi karate pAratAma, yArA pRthivIte uttarAdhikArI hata|
‘IsA to kiYAmatera nizcita nidarzana; sutarAM tomarA kiYAmate sandeha kara nA evaM AmAke anusaraNa kara| eTAi sarala patha|
zaYatAna yena tomAderake kichutei nivRtta nA kare, se to tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

‘IsA yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha elo takhana se valechila, ‘Ami to tomAdera nikaTa esechi prajJAsaha evaM tomarA ye kataka viSaYe matabheda karacho, tA spaSTa kare divAra janye| sutarAM tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM AmAra anusaraNa kara|
‘AllAhi to AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka, ataeva tomarA tA~ra ‘ivAdata kara; eTAi sarala patha|’
erapara edera vibhinna dala matAnaikya sRSTi karala, sutarAM jAlimadera janye durbheAga marmantuda divasera zAstira|
erA to edera ajJAtasAre AkasmikabhAve kiYAmata AsArai apekSA karache|
vandhurA sei dina haYe par3ave eke aparera zatru, muttAkIrA vyatIta|
he AmAra vAndAgaNa! Aja tomAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tomarA duHkhitao have nA|
yArA AmAra AYAte vizvAsa karechila evaM AtmasamarpaNa karechila-
tomarA evaM tomAdera sahadharmiNIgaNa sAnande jAnnAte praveza kara|
svarNera thAlA o pAnapAtra niYe tAderake pradakSiNa karA have; sekhAne raYeche samasta kichu, yA antara cAYa evaM yAte naYana tRpta haYa| sekhAne tomarA sthAYI have|
eTAi jAnnAta, tomAderake yAra adhikArI karA haYeche, tomAdera karmera phalasvarUpa|
sekhAne tomAdera janye raYeche pracura phalamUla, tA hate tomarA AhAra karave|
nizcaYai aparAdhIrA jAhAnnAmera zAstite thAkave sthAYibhAve;
edera zAsti lAghava karA have nA evaM erA ete hatAza haYe par3ave|
Ami edera prati juluma kari nAi, varaM erA nijerAi chila jAlima|
erA citkAra kare valave, ‘he mAlika, tomAra pratipAlaka yena AmAderake niHzeSa kare dena|’ se valave, ‘tomarA to ebhAvei thAkave|’
AllAh valavena, ‘Ami to tomAdera nikaTa satya pau~~chiYechilAma, kintu tomAdera adhikAMzai chila satyavimukha|’
erA ki kona vyApAre cUr3Anta siddhAnta grahaNa kareche? varaM Amii to cUr3Anta siddhAntakArI|
erA ki mane kare ye, Ami edera gopana viSaYa o mantraNAra khavara rAkhi nA? avazyai rAkhi| AmAra pherezatAgaNa to edera nikaTa theke savakichu lipivaddha kare|
vala, ‘daYAmaYa AllAh ra kona santAna thAkale Ami hatAma tAra upAsakagaNera agraNI;
‘erA yA Aropa kare tA hate AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra adhipati evaM Arazera adhikArI pavitra mahAna|’
ataeva ederake ye divasera kathA valA haYeche tAra sammukhIna haoYAra pUrva paryanta tumi ederake vAka-vitaNDA o krIr3A-kautuka karate dAo|
tinii ilAh nabhomaNDale, tinii ilAh bhUtale evaM tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
kata mahAna tini, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM edera madhyavartI samasta kichura sArvabhauma adhipati! kiYAmatera jJAna kevala tA~hArai Ache evaM tA~hArai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|
AllAh ra parivarte erA yAderake DAke, supArizera kSamatA tAdera nei, tave yArA satya upalavdhi kare era sAkSya deYa, tArA vyatIta|
yadi tumi ederake jijJAsA kara, ke ederake sRSTi kareche, erA avazyai valave, ‘AllAh’| tavuo erA kothAYa phire yeteche?
Ami avagata Achi rAsUlera ei ukti: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ei sampradAYa to ImAna Anave nA|’
sutarAM tumi ederake upekSA kara evaM vala, ‘sAlAma’; erA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
hA-mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera|
Ami to eTA avatIrNa karechi eka muvAraka rajanIte; Ami to satarkakArI|
ei rajanIte pratyeka prajJApUrNa viSaYa sthirIkRta haYa,
AmAra Adezakrame, Ami to rAsUla preraNa kare thAki
tomAra pratipAlakera anugrahasvarUpa; tini to sarvazrotA, sarvajJa-
yini AkAzamaNDalI, pRthivI o edera madhyavartI samasta kichura pratipAlaka, yadi tomarA nizcita vizvAsI hao|
