tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei, tini jIvana dAna karena evaM tinii mRtyu ghaTAna; tini tomAdera pratipAlaka evaM tomAdera pUrvapuruSaderao pratipAlaka|
vastuta erA sandehera vazavartI haYe hAsiThATTA karache|
ataeva tumi apekSA kara sei dinera yedina spaSTa dhUmrAcchanna have AkAza,
evaM tA AvRta kare phelave mAnava jAtike| eTA have marmantuda zAsti|
takhana erA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera hate zAsti dUra kara, avazyai AmarA ImAna Anava|’
erA kI kare upadeza grahaNa karave? edera nikaTa to eseche spaSTa vyAkhyAtA eka rAsUla;
erapara erA tAke amAnya kare vale, ‘se zikSAprApta eka pAgala!’
Ami kichu kAlera janye zAsti rahita karava-tomarA to tomAdera pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAve|
yedina Ami tomAderake pravalabhAve pAkar3Ao karava, sedina nizcaYai Ami tomAderake zAsti divai|
edera pUrve Ami to phira‘Aona sampradAYake parIkSA karechilAma evaM edera nikaTao esechila eka sammAnita rAsUla,
se valala, ‘AllAh ra vAndAderake AmAra nikaTa pratyarpaNa kara| Ami tomAdera janye eka vizvasta rAsUla|
‘evaM tomarA AllAh ra viruddhe auddhatya prakAza kara nA, Ami tomAdera nikaTa upasthita karachi spaSTa pramANa|
‘tomarA yAte AmAke prastarAghAte hatyA karate nA pAra, tAra janye Ami AmAra pratipAlaka o tomAdera pratipAlakera zaraNa nicchi|
‘yadi tomarA AmAra kathAYa vizvAsa sthApana nA kara, tave tomarA AmAra nikaTa hate dUre thAka|’
erapara mUsA tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa nivedana karala, ‘erA to eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|’
Ami valechilAma, ‘tumi AmAra vAndAderake niYe rajanIyoge vera haYe par3a, tomAdera pazcAddhAvana karA havei|’
samudrake sthira thAkate dAo, erA emana eka vAhinI yA nimajjita havei|
erA pazcAte rekhe giYechila kata udyAna o prasravaNa;
kata zasyakSetra o suramya prAsAda,
kata vilAsa-upakaraNa, ete tArA Ananda peta!
eirUpai ghaTiYAchila evaM Ami ei samudaYera uttarAdhikArI karechilAma bhinna sampradAYake|
AkAza evaM pRthivI keui edera janye azrupAta kare nAi evaM ederake avakAzao deoYA haYa nAi|
Ami to uddhAra karechilAma vanI isarAIlake lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti hate
phira‘Aonera; se to chila parAkrAnta sImAlaMghanakArIdera madhye|
Ami to jene-zunei ederake vizve zreSThatva diYechilAma,
evaM ederake diYechilAma nidarzanAvalI, yAte chila suspaSTa parIkSA;
erA valei thAke,
‘AmAdera prathama mRtyu vyatIta Ara kichui nei evaM AmarA Ara utthita hava nA|
‘ataeva tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake upasthita kara|’
zreSTha ki erA, nA tuvvA sampradAYa o edera pUrvavartIrA? Ami ederake dhvaMsa karechilAma, avazyai erA chila aparAdhI|
Ami AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM edera madhye kona kichui krIr3Acchale sRSTi kari nAi;
Ami ei duiTi ayathA sRSTi kari nAi, kintu edera adhikAMzai eTA jAne nA|
nizcaYai sakalera janye nirdhArita raYeche edera vicAra divasa|
sedina eka vandhu apara vandhura kona kAje Asave nA evaM erA sAhAyyao pAve nA|
tave AllAh yAra prati daYA karena tAra kathA svatantra| tini to parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai yAkkuma vRkSa have-
pApIra khAdya;
galita tAmrera mata, edera udare phuTate thAkave
phuTanta pAnira mata|
eke dhara evaM Tene niYe yAo jAhAnnAmera madhyasthale,
erapara era mastakera opara phuTanta pAni Dhele zAsti dAo-
evaM valA have ‘AsvAda grahaNa kara, tumi to chile sammAnita, abhijAta!
‘eTA to eTAi, ye viSaYe tomarA sandeha karate|’
muttAkIrA to thAkave nirApada sthAne-
udyAna o jharNAra mAjhe,
tArA paridhAna karave mihi o puru rezamI vastra evaM mukhomukhi haYe vasave|
eirUpai ghaTave; Ami ederake saGginI dAna karava AYatalocanA hura,
sethAYa tArA prazAnta citte vividha phalamUla Anate valave|
prathama mRtyura para tArA sekhAne Ara mRtyu AsvAdana karave nA| Ara tAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate rakSA karavena-
tomAra pratipAlaka nija anugrahe| eTAi to mahAsAphalya|
Ami to tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi, yAte erA upadeza grahaNa kare|
sutarAM tumi pratIkSA kara, erAo pratIkSamANa|
hA-mIma|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAh ra nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
nizcaYai AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte nidarzana raYeche mu’minadera janye|
tomAdera sRjane evaM jIvajantura vistAre nidarzana raYeche nizcita vizvAsIdera janye;
nidarzana raYeche cintAzIla sampradAYera janye, rAtri o divasera parivartane evaM AllAh AkAza hate ye vAri varSaNa diYe dharitrIke era mRtyura para punarjIvita karena tAte o vAYura parivartane|
eiguli AllAh ra AYAta, yA Ami tomAra nikaTa tilAoYAta karachi yathAyathabhAve| sutarAM AllAh ra evaM tA~ra AYAtera parivarte erA Ara kon vANIte vizvAsa karave?
durbheAga pratyeka ghora mithyAvAdI pApIra,
ye AllAh ra AYAtasamUhera tilAoYAta zune athaca auddhatyera saGge aTala thAke yena se tA zune nAi| eke saMvAda dAo marmantuda zAstira;
yakhana AmAra kona AYAta se avagata haYa takhana tA niYe parihAsa kare| edera janye raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
edera pazcAte raYeche jAhAnnAma; edera kRtakarma edera kona kAje Asave nA, erA AllAh ra parivarte yAderake abhibhAvaka sthira kareche erAo naYa| edera janye raYeche mahAzAsti|
ei kuraAna satpathera dizArI; yArA tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalI pratyAkhyAna kare, edera janye raYeche atizaYa marmantuda zAsti|

AllAhi to samudrake tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena, yAte tA~ra Adeze ete nauyAnasamUha calAcala karate pAre o yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha anusandhAna karate pAra evaM yena tomarA tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao|
Ara tini tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra samasta kichu nija anugrahe, cintAzIla sampradAYera janye ete to raYeche nidarzana|
mu’minaderake vala, ‘tArA yena kSamA kare ederake, yArA AllAh ra divasagulira pratyAzA kare nA| eTA eijanye ye, AllAh pratyeka sampradAYake tAra kRtakarmera janye pratidAna divena|’
ye satkarma kare se tAra kalyANera janyei tA kare evaM keu manda karma karale era pratiphala se-i bhoga karave, erapara tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
Ami to vanI isarAIlake kitAva, kartRtva o navuoYAta dAna karechilAma evaM ederake uttama jIvanopakaraNa diYechilAma evaM diYechilAma zreSThatva vizvajagatera opara|

Ami ederake suspaSTa pramANa dAna karechilAma dIna samparke| edera nikaTa jJAna AsAra para erA zudhu paraspara vidveSavazata virodhitA karechila| erA ye viSaYe matavirodha karata, tomAra pratipAlaka kiYAmatera dina edera madhye se viSaYe phaYasAlA kare divena|
eTAra para Ami tomAke pratiSThita karechi dInera vizeSa vidhAnera opara; sutarAM tumi era anusaraNa kara, ajJadera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara nA|
AllAh ra mukAvilAYa erA tomAra konai upakAra karate pArave nA; jAlimarA to eke aparera vandhu; Ara AllAh muttAkIdera vandhu|
ei kuraAna mAnavajAtira janye suspaSTa dalIla evaM nizcita vizvAsI sampradAYera janye pathanirdeza o rahamata|
duSkRtikArIrA ki mane kare ye, Ami jIvana o mRtyura dika diYe ederake tAdera samAna gaNya karava, yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare? edera siddhAnta kata manda!
AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve evaM yAte pratyeka vyaktike tAra karmAnuyAYI phala deoYA yete pAre Ara tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|

tumi ki lakSya karecha tAke, ye tAra kheYAla-khuzike nija ilAh vAnAiYA niYeche? AllAh jene-zunei eke vibhrAnta karechena evaM era karNa o hRdaYa mohara kare diYechena evaM era cokhera opara rekhechena AvaraNa| ataeva AllAh ra pare ke tAke pathanirdeza karave? tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
erA vale, ‘ekamAtra pArthiva jIvanai AmAdera jIvana, AmarA mari o vA~ci Ara kAlai AmAderake dhvaMsa kare|’ vastuta ei vyApAre edera kona jJAna nei, erA to kevala managar3A kathA vale|
edera nikaTa yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAta AvRtti karA haYa takhana edera kona yukti thAke nA kevala ei ukti chAr3A ye, tomarA satyavAdI hale AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake upasthita kara|
vala, ‘AllAhi tomAderake jIvana dAna karena o tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna| erapara tini tomAderake kiYAmata divase ekatra karavena, yAte kona sandeha nei| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|’
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra Adhipatya AllAh ra i, yedina kiYAmata saMghaTata have sedina mithyAzraYIrA have kSatigrasta,
evaM tumi pratyeka sampradAYake dekhave bhaYe natajAnu, pratyeka sampradAYake tAra AmalanAmAra prati AhvAna karA have o valA have, ‘Aja tomAderake tArai pratiphala deoYA have yA tomarA karate|
‘ei AmAra lipi, eTA tomAdera viruddhe sAkSya dive satyabhAve| tomarA yA karate tA Ami lipivaddha karechilAma|’
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake dAkhila karavena svIYa rahamate| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
pakSAntare, yArA kupharI kare tAderake valA have, ‘tomAdera nikaTa ki AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa nAi? kintu tomarA auddhatya prakAza karechile evaM tomarA chile eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|’

yakhana valA haYa, ‘AllAh ra pratizruti to satya, evaM kiYAmata-ete kona sandeha nei, takhana tomarA vale thAka, ‘AmarA jAni nA kiYAmata kI; AmarA mane kari eTA ekaTi dhAraNA mAtra evaM AmarA ei viSaYe nizcita nai|’
edera manda karmaguli edera nikaTa prakAza haYe par3ave evaM yA niYe erA ThATTA-vidrupa karata tA ederake pariveSTana karave|
Ara valA have, ‘Aja Ami tomAderake vismRta hava yemana tomarA ei divasera sAkSAtkArake vismRta haYechile| tomAdera AvAsasthala have jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|

‘eTA eijanye ye, tomarA AllAh ra nidarzanAvalIke vidrupa karechile evaM pArthiva jIvana tomAderake pratArita karechila|’ sutarAM sei dina ederake jAhAnnAma hate vera karA have nA evaM AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhera suyoga deoYA have nA|
samasta prazaMsA AllAh ra i, yini AkAzamaNDalIra pratipAlaka, pRthivIra pratipAlaka evaM jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte gaurava-garimA tA~rai evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
hA-mIma|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAh ra nikaTa hate avatIrNa;

AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM edera madhyavartI samasta kichui Ami yathAyathabhAve nirdiSTa kAlera janye sRSTi karechi| kintu kAphirarA, ederake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYeche tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa|

vala, ‘tomarA AllAh ra parivarte yAderake DAka tAdera kathA bheve dekhecha ki? erA pRthivIte kI sRSTi kareche AmAke dekhAo vA AkAzamaNDalIte edera kona aMzIdAritva Ache ki? pUrvavartI kona kitAva vA paramparAgata kona jJAna thAkale tA tomarA AmAra nikaTa upasthita kara yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
sei vyakti apekSA adhika vibhrAnta ke, ye AllAh ra parivarte emana kichuke DAke yA kiYAmata divasa paryantao ete sAr3A dive nA? evaM eiguli edera prArthanA samvandhe avahitao naYa|
yakhana kiYAmatera dina mAnuSake ekatra karA have takhana aiguli have edera zatru evaM aiguli edera ‘ivAdata asvIkAra karave|
yakhana edera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha AvRtti karA haYa evaM edera nikaTa satya upasthita haYa, takhana kAphirarA vale, ‘eTA to suspaSTa jAdu|’

tave ki erA vale ye, ‘se eTA udbhAvana kareche|’ vala, ‘yadi Ami eTA udbhAvana kare thAki, tave tomarA to AllAh ra zAsti hate AmAke kichutei rakSA karate pArave nA| tomarA ye viSaYe AlocanAYa lipta Acha, se samvandhe AllAh savizeSa avahita| AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve tinii yatheSTa evaM tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
vala, ‘Ami kona nUtana rAsUla nai| Ami jAni nA, AmAra o tomAdera vyApAre kI karA have; Ami AmAra prati yA ohI karA haYa kevala tArai anusaraNa kari| Ara Ami to eka spaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|’

vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki yadi ei kuraAna AllAh ra nikaTa hate avatIrNa haYe thAke Ara tomarA ete avizvAsa kara, athaca vanI isarAIlera ekajana eTAra anurUpa kitAva samparke sAkSya diYeche evaM ete vizvAsa sthApana kareche; Ara tomarA auddhatya prakAza kara, tA hale tomAdera pariNAma ki have? nizcaYai AllAh jAlimaderake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

mu’minadera samparke kAphirarA vale, ‘yadi eTA bhAla hata tave tArA eTAra dike AmAderake atikrama kare yete pArata nA|’ Ara yakhana erA eTA diYe satpathaprApta haYa nAi takhana tArA avazya valave, ‘eTA to eka purAtana mithyA|’
eTAra pUrve chila mUsAra kitAva Adarza o anugrahasvarUpa| Ara ei kitAva eTAra pratyAYanakArI, AravI bhASAYa, yena eTA jAlimaderake satarka kare evaM yArA satkarma kare tAderake susaMvAda deYa|
yArA vale, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka to AllAh’ erapara avicalita thAke, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, tArA yA karata tAra puraskArasvarUpa|

Ami mAnuSake tAra mAtA-pitAra prati sadaYa vyavahArera nirdeza diYechi| tAra jananI tAke garbhe dhAraNa kare kaSTera saGge evaM prasava kare kaSTera saGge, tAke garbhe dhAraNa karate o tAra stanya chAr3Ate lAge triza mAsa, krame se yakhana pUrNa zaktiprApta haYa evaM calliza vatsare upanIta haYa takhana vale, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke sAmarthya dAo, yAte Ami tomAra prati kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAri, AmAra prati o AmAra pitA-mAtAra prati tumi ye anugraha karecha, tAra janye evaM yAte Ami satkarma karate pAri yA tumi pachanda kara; AmAra janye AmAra santAna-santatiderake satkarmaparAYaNa kara, Ami tomArai abhimukhI halAma evaM Ami avazyai AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta|
‘Ami ederai sukRtiguli grahaNa kare thAki evaM manda karmaguli kSamA kari, tArA jAnnAtavAsIdera antarbhukta| ederake ye pratizruti deoYA haYeche tA satya|

Ara emana loka Ache, ye tAra mAtA-pitAke vale, ‘Aphasosa tomAdera janye! tomarA ki AmAke ei bhaYa dekhete cAo ye, Ami punarutthita hava yadio AmAra pUrve vahu puruSa gata haYeche?’ takhana tAra mAtA-pitA AllAh ra nikaTa phariYAda kare vale, ‘durbheAga tomAra janye! tumi vizvAsa sthApana kara, AllAh ra pratizruti avazyai satya|’ kintu se vale, ‘eTA to atIta kAlera upakathA vyatIta kichui naYa|’
edera pUrve ye jina o mAnava sampradAYa gata haYeche tAdera mata edera pratio AllAh ra ukti satya haYeche| erAi to kSatigrasta|
pratyekera maryAdA tAra karmAnuyAYI, eTA eijanye ye, AllAh pratyekera karmera pUrNa pratiphala divena evaM tAdera prati avicAra karA have nA|

yedina kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera sannikaTe upasthita karA have sedina ederake valA have, ‘tomarA tomAdera pArthiva jIvanei sukha-sambhAra peYecha evaM seiguli upabhogao karecha| sutarAM Aja tomAderake deoYA have avamAnanAkara zAsti| kAraNa tomarA pRthivIte anyAYabhAve auddhatya prakAza karechile evaM tomarA chile satyadrohI|’

smaraNa kara, ‘Ad sampradAYera bhAiYera kathA, yAra pUrve evaM pareo satarkakArIrA esechila| se tAra AhkAphvAsI sampradAYake satarka karechila ei vale, ‘tomarA AllAh vyatIta kArao ‘ivAdata kara nA| Ami to tomAdera janye mahAdivasera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|’
erA valechila, ‘tumi ki AmAderake AmAdera deva-devIgulira pUjA hate nivRtta karate esecho? tumi satyavAdI hale AmAderake yAra bhaYa dekhAccho tA AnaYana kara|’
se valala, ‘eTAra jJAna to kevala AllAh ra i nikaTa Ache| Ami yA niYe prerita haYechi kevala tAi tomAdera nikaTa pracAra kari, kintu Ami dekhachi, tomarA eka mUr3ha sampradAYa|’

‘erapara yakhana erA edera upatyakAra dike megha Asate dekhala takhana valate lAgala, ‘tA to megha, AmAderake vRSTi dAna karave|’ hUda valala, ‘eTAi to tA, yA tomarA tvarAnvita karate ceYecha, eka jhar3a, ete raYeche marmantuda zAsti|
‘AllAh ra nirdeze eTA samasta kichuke dhvaMsa kare dive|’ erapara edera pariNAma ei hala ye, edera vasatiguli chAr3A Ara kichui raila nA| eibhAve Ami aparAdhI sampradAYake pratiphala diYe thAki|

Ami ederake ye pratiSThA diYechilAma tomAderake tA dei nAi; Ami ederake diYechilAma karNa, cokha o hRdaYa; kintu edera karNa, cokha o hRdaYa edera kona kAje Ase nAi; kenanA erA AllAh ra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karechila| yA niYe erA ThATTA-vidrupa karata, eTAi ederake pariveSTana karala|
Ami to dhvaMsa karechilAma tomAdera catuSpArzvavartI janapadasamUha; Ami ederake vibhinnabhAve AmAra nidarzanAvalI vivRta karechilAma, yAte erA phire Ase|

erA AllAh ra sAnnidhya lAbhera janye AllAh ra parivarte yAderake ilAha rUpe grahaNa karechila tArA ederake sAhAyya karala nA kena? vastuta edera ilAhguli edera nikaTa hate antarhita haYe gela| edera mithyA o alIka udbhAvanera pariNAma eirUpai|

smaraNa kara, Ami tomAra prati AkRSTa karechilAma ekadala jinake, yArA kuraAna pATha zunatechila| yakhana erA tAra nikaTa upasthita hala, erA valala, ‘cupa kare zone kara|’ yakhana kuraAna pATha samApta hala erA edera sampradAYera nikaTa phire gela satarkakArIrUpe|

tArA valechila, ‘he AmAdera sampradAYa! AmarA emana eka kitAvera pATha zunechi yA avatIrNa haYeche mUsAra pare, eTA era pUrvavartI kitAvake pratyaYana kare evaM satya o sarala pathera dike paricAlita kare|
‘he AmAdera sampradAYa! AllAh ra dike AhvAnakArIra prati sAr3A dAo evaM tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana kara, AllAh tomAdera pApa kSamA karavena evaM marmantuda zAsti hate tomAderake rakSA karavena|’

keu yadi AllAh ra dike AhvAnakArIra prati sAr3A nA deYa tave se pRthivIte AllAh ra abhiprAYa vyartha karate pArave nA evaM AllAh vyatIta tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA| erAi suspaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche|

erA ki anudhAvana kare nA ye, AllAh, yini AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM ei sakalera sRSTite kona klAnti vodha karena nAi, tini mRtera jIvana dAna karateo sakSama? vastuta tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yedina kAphiraderake upasthita karA have jAhAnnAmera nikaTa, sedina ederake valA have, ‘eTA ki satya naYa?’ erA valave, ‘AmAdera pratipAlakera zapatha! eTA satya|’ takhana tAderake valA have, ‘zAsti AsvAdana kara, kAraNa tomarA chile satya pratyAkhyAnakArI|’

ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara yemana dhairya dhAraNa karechila dRr3hapratijJa rAsUlagaNa| tumi edera janye tvarA kara nA| ederake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYeche tA yedina erA pratyakSa karave, sedina edera mane have, erA yena divasera eka daNDera vezi pRthivIte avasthAna kare nAi| eTA eka ghoSaNA, pApAcArI sampradAYakei dhvaMsa karA have|
yArA kupharI kare evaM aparake AllAh ra patha hate nivRtta kare tini tAdera karma vyartha kare dena|

yArA ImAna Ane, satkarma kare evaM muhAmmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte vizvAsa kare, Ara eTAi tAdera pratipAlaka hate prerita satya, tini tAdera manda karmaguli vidUrita karavena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla karavena|
eTA eijanye ye, yArA kupharI kare tArA mithyAra anusaraNa kare evaM yArA ImAna Ane tArA tAdera pratipAlaka-prerita satyera anusaraNa kare| eibhAve AllAh mAnuSera janye tAdera dRSTAnta pradAna karena|

ataeva yakhana tomarA kAphiradera saGge yuddhe mukAvilA kara takhana tAdera gardAne AghAta kara, parizeSe yakhana tomarA ederake sampUrNarUpe parAbha‚ta karave takhana ederake kaSe vA~dhive; erapara haYa anukampA, naYa muktipaNa| tomarA jihAda cAlAve yatakSaNa nA yuddha eTAra astra nAmiYe phele| eTAi vidhAna| eTA ejanye ye, AllAh icchA karale ederake zAsti dite pAratena, kintu tini cAna tomAdera ekajanake aparake diYe parIkSA karate| yArA AllAh ra pathe nihata haYa tini kakhanao tAdera karma vinaSTa hate dena nA|
tini tAderake satpathe paricAlita karena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla kare dena|
tini tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra kathA tini tAderake jAniYechilena|
he mu’minagaNa! yadi tomarA AllAhke sAhAyya kara, AllAh tomAderake sAhAyya karavena evaM tomAdera avasthAna dRr3ha karavena|
yArA kupharI kareche tAdera janye raYeche durbheAga evaM tini tAdera karma vyartha kare divena|
eTA ejanye ye, AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena erA tA apachanda kare| sutarAM AllAh edera karma niSphala kare divena|
erA ki pRthivIte paribhramaNa kare nAi evaM dekhe nAi edera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma ki haYeche? AllAh ederake dhvaMsa karechena evaM kAphiradera janye raYeche anurUpa pariNAma|
eTA ejanye ye, AllAh to mu’minadera abhibhAvaka evaM kAphiradera to kona abhibhAvakai nei|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare AllAh tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita; kintu yArA kupharI kare erA bhoga-vilAse matta thAke evaM jantu-jAnoYArera mata udara pUrti kare; Ara jAhAnnAmai edera nivAsa|
erA tomAra ye janapada hate tomAke vitAr3ita kareche tA apekSA ati zaktizAlI kata janapada chila; Ami ederake dhvaMsa karechi evaM edera sAhAyyakArI keu chila nA|
ye vyakti tAra pratipAlaka-prerita suspaSTa pramANera opara pratiSThita, se ki tAra nyAYa, yAra nikaTa nijera manda karmaguli zobhana pratIYamAna haYa evaM yArA nija kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kare?

muttAkIderake ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deoYA haYeche tAra dRSTAnta: ete Ache nirmala pAnira nahara, Ache dudhera nahara yAra svAda aparivartanIYa, Ache pAnakArIdera janye susvAdu surAra nahara, Ache parizodhita madhura nahara evaM sekhAne edera janye thAkave vividha phalamUla Ara tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate kSamA| muttAkIrA ki tAdera nyAYa, yArA jAhAnnAme sthAYI have evaM yAderake pAna karate deoYA have phuTanta pAni yA edera nAr3ibhu~r3i chinna-vicchinna kare dive?

edera madhye kataka tomAra kathA zone, erapara tomAra nikaTa hate vera haYe yArA jJAnaprApta tAderake vale, ‘eimAtra se kI valala?’ edera antara AllAh mohara kare diYechena evaM erA nijedera kheYAla-khuzirai anusaraNa kare|
yArA satpatha avalamvana kare AllAh tAdera satpathe calAra zakti vRddhi karena evaM tAderake muttAkI haoYAra zakti dAna karena|
erA ki kevala ejanye apekSA karache ye, kiYAmata edera nikaTa ese par3uka AkasmikabhAve? kiYAmatera lakSaNasamUha to esei par3eche| kiYAmata ese par3ale erA upadeza grahaNa karave kemana kare!
sutarAM jene rAkha, AllAh vyatIta anya kona ilAh nei, kSamA prArthanA kara tomAra evaM mu’mina nara-nArIdera truTira janye| AllAh tomAdera gatividhi evaM avasthAna samvandhe samyaka avagata Achena|

mu’minarA vale, ‘ekaTi sUrA avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ erapara yadi dvyarthahIna kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa evaM ete yuddhera kona nirdeza thAke tumi dekhave yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA mRtyubhaYe vihaŸla mAnuSera mata tomAra dike tAkAcche| zocanIYa pariNAma edera|
Anugatya o nyAYasaMgata vAkya edera janye uttama chila; sutarAM cUr3Anta siddhAnta hala, yadi erA AllAh ra prati pradatta aGgIkAra pUraNa karata tave tAdera janye eTA avazyai maGgalajanaka hata|
tave kSamatAYa adhiSThita hale sambhavata tomarA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM AtmIYatAra vandhana chinna karave|
AllAh ederakei lA‘nata karena Ara karena vadhira o dRSTizaktihIna|
tave ki erA kuraAna samvandhe abhiniveza sahakAre cintA kare nA? nA edera antara tAlAvaddha?
yArA nijedera nikaTa satpatha vyakta haoYAra para tA parityAga kare, zaYatAna edera kAjake zobhana kare dekhAYa evaM ederake mithyA AzA deYa|
eTA eijanye ye, AllAh yA avatIrNa karechena, tA yArA apachanda kare tAderake erA vale, ‘AmarA kon kon viSaYe tomAdera Anugatya karava|’ AllAh edera gopana abhisandhi avagata Achena|
pherezatArA yakhana edera mukhamaNDale o pRSThadeze AghAta karate karate prANa haraNa karave, takhana edera dazA kemana have|
eTA ejanye ye, erA tAra anusaraNa kare, yA AllAh ra asantoSa janmAYa evaM tA~ra santuSTike apriYa gaNya kare; tini edera karma niSphala kare dena|
yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA ki mane kare ye, AllAh kakhano edera vidveSabhAva prakAza kare divena nA?
Ami icchA karale tomAke edera paricaYa ditAma| phale tumi edera lakSaNa dekhe ederake cinate pArate, tave tumi avazyai kathAra bhaMgite ederake cinite pArave| AllAh tomAdera karma samparke avagata|
Ami avazyai tomAderake parIkSA karava, yatakSaNa nA Ami jene nii tomAdera madhye jihAdakArI o dhairyazIladerake evaM Ami tomAdera vyApAre parIkSA kari|

yArA kupharI kare evaM mAnuSake AllAh ra patha hate nivRtta kare evaM nijedera nikaTa pathera dizA vyakta haoYAra para rAsUlera virodhitA kare, erA AllAh ra konai kSati karate pArave nA| tini to tAdera karma vyartha karavena|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAh ra Anugatya kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara, Ara tomAdera karma vinaSTa kara nA|
yArA kupharI kare o AllAh ra patha hate mAnuSake nivRtta kare, erapara kAphira avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kare, AllAh tAderake kichutei kSamA karavena nA|
sutarAM tomarA hInavala haYo nA evaM sandhira prastAva kara nA, tomarAi pravala; AllAh tomAdera saGge Achena, tini tomAdera karmaphala kakhanao kSuNNa karavena nA|
pArthiva jIvana to kevala krIr3A-kautuka, yadi tomarA ImAna Ana, tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, AllAh tomAderake tomAdera puraskAra divena evaM tini tomAdera dhana-sampada cAna nA|
tomAdera nikaTa hate tini tA cAile o tAra janye tomAdera opara cApa dile tomarA to kArpaNya karave evaM takhana tini tomAdera vidveSabhAva prakAza kare divena|

dekha, tomarAi to tArA yAderake AllAh ra pathe vyaYa karate valA hacche athaca tomAdera aneke kRpaNatA karache| yArA kArpaNya kare tArA to kArpaNya kare nijederai prati| AllAh abhAvamukta evaM tomarA abhAvagrasta| yadi tomarA vimukha hao, tini anya jAtike tomAdera sthalavartI karavena; tArA tomAdera mata have nA|
nizcaYai Ami tomAke diYechi suspaSTa vijaYa,
yena AllAh tomAra atIta o bhaviSyata truTisamUha mArjanA karena evaM tomAra prati tA~ra anugraha pUrNa karena o tomAke sarala pathe paricAlita karena,
evaM AllAh tomAke valiSTha sAhAyya dAna karena|
tinii mu’minadera antare prazAnti dAna karena yena tArA tAdera ImAnera saGge ImAna dRr3ha kare neYa, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra vAhinIsamUha AllAh ra i evaM AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

eTA ejanye ye, tini mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita, yekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM tini tAdera pApa mocana karavena; eTAi AllAh ra dRSTite mahAsAphalya|

Ara tini munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArI, muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArI yArA AllAh samvandhe manda dhAraNA poSaNa kare tAderake zAsti divena| amaGgala cakra edera janye, AllAh edera prati ruSTa haYechena evaM ederake lA‘nata karechena evaM edera janye jAhAnnAma prastuta rekhechena, tA kata nikRSTa AvAsa!
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra vAhinIsamUha AllAh ra i evaM AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ami tomAke preraNa karechi sAkSIrUpe, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe,
yAte tomarA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana evaM rAsUlake zakti yogAo o tAke sammAna kara; sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAh ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|

yArA tomAra hAte vAYa‘Ata kare tArA to AllAh ra i hAte vAYa‘Ata kare| AllAh ra hAta tAdera hAtera opara| erapara ye tA bhaGga kare, tA bhaGga karAra pariNAma tArai evaM ye AllAh ra saGge aGgIkAra pUrNa kare tini avazyai tAke mahApuraskAra divena|

ye sakala maruvAsI pazcAte raYe geche tArA tomAke valave, ‘AmAdera dhana-sampada o parivAra-parijana AmAderake vyasta rekheche, ataeva AmAdera janye kSamA prArthanA karuna|’ erA mukhe tA vale yA edera antare nei| ederake vala, ‘AllAh tomAdera kArao kona kSati kiMvA maGgala sAdhanera icchA karale ke tA~ke nivRtta karate pAre? vastuta tomarA yA kara se viSaYe AllAh samyaka avahita|

nA, tomarA dhAraNA karechile ye, rAsUla o mu’minagaNa tAdera parivAra-parijanera nikaTa kakhanai phire Asate pArave nA evaM ei dhAraNA tomAdera antare prItikara mane haYechila; tomarA manda dhAraNA karechile, tomarA to dhvaMsamukhI eka sampradAYa!
yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ane nA, Ami sei sava kAphirera janye jvalanta agni prastuta rekhechi|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra sarvamaYa kartRtva AllAh ra i, tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti dena| tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana yuddhalavdha sampada saMgrahera janye yAve takhana yArA pazcAte raYe giYechila tArA valave, ‘AmAderake tomAdera saGge yete dAo|’ erA AllAh ra pratizruti parivartana karate cAYa| vala, ‘tomarA kichutei AmAdera saGgI hate pArave nA| AllAh pUrvei eirUpa ghoSaNA karechena|’ erA avazyai valave, ‘tomarA to AmAdera prati vidveSa poSaNa karacho|’ vastuta edera vodhazakti sAmAnya|

yesava maruvAsI pazcAte raYe giYechila tAderake vala, ‘tomarA Aha‚ta have eka pravala-parAkrAnta jAtira viruddhe yuddha karate; tomarA edera saGge yuddha karave yatakSaNa nA erA AtmasamarpaNa kare| tomarA ei nirdeza pAlana karale AllAh tomAderake uttama puraskAra dAna karavena| Ara tomarA yadi pUrvAnurUpa pRSTha pradarzana kara, tini tomAderake marmantuda zAsti divena|

andhera janye kona aparAdha nei, khaJjera janye kona aparAdha nei evaM pIr3itera janye kona aparAdha nei; evaM ye keu AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave AllAh tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita; kintu ye vyakti pRSTha pradarzana karave tini tAke marmantuda zAsti divena|

AllAh to mu’minagaNera opara santuSTa halena yakhana tArA vRkSatale tomAra nikaTa vAYa‘Ata grahaNa karala, tAdera antare yA chila tA tini avagata chilena; tAderake tini dAna karalena prazAnti evaM tAderake puraskAra dilena Asanna vijaYa
o vipula parimANa yuddhe labhya sampada, yA erA hastagata karave; AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAh tomAderake pratizruti diYechena yuddhe labhya vipula sampadera yAra adhikArI have tomarA| tini eTA tomAdera janye tvarAnvita karechena evaM tini tomAdera hate mAnuSera hasta nivArita karechena yena eTA haYa mu’minadera janye eka nidarzana evaM AllAh tomAderake paricAlita karena sarala pathe;
evaM Arao raYeche yA ekhanao tomAdera adhikAre Ase nAi, tA to AllAh AYatte rekhechena| AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
kAphirarA tomAdera mukAvilA karale erA avazyai pRSTha pradarzana karata, takhana erA kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyya-kArI peta nA|
eTAi AllAh ra vidhAna-prAcIna kAla hate cale Asache, tumi AllAh ra vidhAne kona parivartana pAve nA|
tini makkA upatyakAYa edera hAta tomAdera hate evaM tomAdera hAta edera hate nivArita karechena, edera opara tomAderake vijaYI karAra para, tomarA yA kichu kara AllAh tA dekhena|

erAi to kupharI karechila evaM nivRtta karechila tomAderake masajidula-hArAma hate o vAdhA diYechila kuravAnIra janye Avaddha pazugulike yathAsthAne peৗ~chate| tomAderake yuddhera Adeza deoYA hata yadi nA thAkata emana kataka mu’mina nara o nArI yAderake tomarA jAna nA, tomarA tAderake padadalita karate ajJAtasAre, phale tAdera kAraNe tomarA kSatigrasta hate| yuddhera nirdeza deoYA haYa nAi ejanye ye, tini yAke icchA nija anugraha dAna karavena| yadi erA pRthaka hata, Ami edera madhye kAphiraderake marmantuda zAsti ditAma|

yakhana kAphirarA tAdera antare poSaNa karata gotrIYa ahamikA-ajJatAra yugera ahamikA, takhana AllAh tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minaderake svIYa prazAnti dAna karalena; Ara tAderake tAkoYAra vAkye sudRr3ha karalena, evaM tArAi chila eTAra adhikatara yogya o upayukta| AllAha samasta viSaYe samyaka jJAna rAkhena|

nizcaYai AllAh tA~ra rAsUlake svapnaTi yathAyathabhAve vAstavAYana kare dekhiYechena, AllAh ra icchAYa tomarA avazyai masjidula-hArAme praveza karave nirApade-tomAdera keu keu mastaka muNDita karave Ara keu keu keza kartana karave| tomAdera kona bhaYa thAkave nA| AllAh jAnena tomarA yA jAna nA| eTA chAr3Ao tini tomAderake diYechena eka sadya vijaYa|
tinii tA~ra rAsUlake pathanirdeza o satya dInasaha preraNa karechena, apara samasta dInera opara eTAke jaYayukta karAra janye| Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|

muhAmmada AllAh ra rAsUla; tA~ra sahacaragaNa kAphiradera prati kaThora evaM nijedera madhye parasparera prati sahAnubha‚tizIla; AllAh ra anugraha o santuSTi kAmanAYa tumi tAderake ruka‚‘ o sijdAYa avanata dekhave| tAdera lakSaNa tAdera mukhamaNDale sijdAra prabhAve parisphuTita thAkave; taorAte tAdera varNanA eirUpa evaM iJjIleo tAdera varNanA erUpai| tAdera dRSTAnta ekaTi cArAgAcha, yA hate nirgata haYa kizalaYa, erapara eTA zakta o puSTa haYa evaM pare kANDera opara dA~r3AYa dRr3habhAve yA cASIra janye AnandadAYaka| ebhAve AllAh mu’minadera samRddhi diYe kAphiradera antarjvAlA sRSTi karena| yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare AllAh tAderake pratizruti diYechena kSamA o mahApuraskArera|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera samakSe tomarA kona viSaYe agraNI haYo nA evaM AllAhke bhaYa kara; AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA navIra kaNThasvarera opara nijedera kaNThasvara u~cu kara nA evaM nijedera madhye yebhAve uccasvare kathA vala tAra saGge serUpa uccasvare kathA vala nA, kAraNa ete tomAdera karma niSphala haYe yAve tomAdera ajJAtasAre|
yArA AllAh ra rAsUlera sAmane nijedera kaNThasvara nicu kare, AllAh tAdera antarake tAkoYAra janye parIkSA kare niYechena| tAdera janye raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
yArA gharera vera hate tomAke uccasvare DAke, tAdera adhikAMzai nirveAdha,
tumi vera haYe edera nikaTa AsA paryanta yadi erA dhairya dhAraNa karata, tAi edera janye uttama hata| AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa! yadi kona pApAcArI tomAdera nikaTa kona vArtA AnaYana kare, tomarA tA parIkSA kare dekhave, pAche ajJatAvazata tomarA kona sampradAYake kSatigrasta kare vasa, evaM pare tomAdera kRtakarmera janye tomAderake anutapta hate haYa|

tomarA jene rAkha ye, tomAdera madhye AllAh ra rAsUla raYechena; tini vahu viSaYe tomAdera kathA zunile tomarAi kaSTa pete| kintu AllAh tomAdera nikaTa ImAnake priYa karechena evaM eke tomAdera hRdaYagrAhI karechena; kupharI, pApAcAra o avAdhyatAke karechena tomAdera nikaTa apriYa| erAi satpatha avalamvanakArI,
AllAh ra dAna o anugrahasvarUpa; AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

mu’minadera dui dala dvande¡ lipta hale tomarA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dive; Ara tAdera ekadala apara dalera viruddhe vAr3AvAr3i karale, yArA vAr3AvAr3i kare tAdera viruddhe tomarA yuddha karave, yatakSaNa nA tArA AllAh ra nirdezera dike phire Ase-yadi tArA phire Ase tAdera madhye nyAYera saGge phaYasAlA karave evaM suvicAra karave| nizcaYai AllAh suvicArakArIderake bhAlavAsena|
mu’minagaNa paraspara bhAi bhAi; sutarAM tomarA bhrAtRgaNera madhye zAnti sthApana kara Ara AllAhke bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA anugraha prApta hao|

he mu’minagaNa! kona puruSa yena apara kona puruSake upahAsa nA kare; kenanA yAke upahAsa karA haYa se upahAsakArI apekSA uttama hate pAre evaM kona nArI apara kona nArIkeo yena upahAsa nA kare; kenanA yAke upahAsa karA haYa se upahAsakAriNI apekSA uttama hate pAre| tomarA eke aparera prati doSAropa kara nA evaM tomarA eke aparake manda nAme Deko nA; ImAnera para manda nAma ati manda| yArA taovA nA kare tArAi jAlima|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA adhikAMza anumAna hate dUre thAka; kAraNa anumAna kona kona kSetre pApa| evaM tomarA eke aparera gopanIYa viSaYa sandhAna kara nA evaM eke aparera pazcAte nindA kara nA| tomAdera madhye ki keu tAra mRta bhAira gozta khete cAive? vastuta tomarA to eTAke ghRNyai mane kara| tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara; AllAh taovA grahaNakArI, parama daYAlu|

he mAnuSa! Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi eka puruSa o eka nArI hate, pare tomAderake vibhakta karechi vibhinna jAti o gotre, yAte tomarA eke aparera saGge paricita hate pAra| tomAdera madhye AllAh ra nikaTa sei vyaktii adhika maryAdAsampanna, ye tomAdera madhye adhika muttAkI| nizcaYai AllAh sakala kichu jAnena, samasta khavara rAkhena|

veduInarA vale, ‘AmarA ImAna AnalAma|’ vala, ‘tomarA ImAna Ana nAi’, varaM tomarA vala, ‘AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karechi’; kAraNa ImAna ekhanao tomAdera antare praveza kare nAi| yadi tomarA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara tave tomAdera karmaphala sAmAnya parimANao lAghava karA have nA| AllAh to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|”
tArAi mu’mina yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ane, pare sandeha poSaNa kare nA evaM jIvana o sampada diYe AllAh ra pathe jihAda kare, tArAi satyaniSTha|
vala, ‘tomarA ki tomAdera dIna samparke AllAhke avahita karacho? athaca AllAh jAnena yA kichu Ache AkAzamaNDalIte evaM yA kichu Ache pRthivIte| AllAh sarvaviSaYe samyaka avahita|’

erA AtmasamarpaNa kare tomAke dhanya kareche mane kare| vala, ‘tomAdera AtmasamarpaNa AmAke dhanya kareche mane kara nA, varaM AllAhi ImAnera dike paricAlita kare tomAderake dhanya karechena, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
AllAh AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYa samparke avagata Achena| tomarA yA kara AllAh tA dekhena|
kA-ph, zapatha sammAnita kuraAnera
varaM tArA vismaYa vodha kare ye, edera madhye ekajana satarkakArI AvirbhUta haYeche, Ara kAphirarA vale, ‘eTA to eka Azcarya vyApAra!
‘AmAdera mRtyu hale evaM AmarA mRttikAYa pariNata hale AmarA ki punarutthita hava? sudUraparAhata sei pratyAvartana|’
Ami to jAni mRttikA kSaYa kare edera kataTuku evaM AmAra nikaTa Ache rakSita kitAva|
vastuta edera nikaTa satya AsAra para erA tA pratyAkhyAna kareche| phale, erA saMzaYe dodulyamAna|
erA ki edera Urdhvasthita AkAzera dike tAkiYe dekhe nA, Ami kibhAve tA nirmANa karechi o eke suzobhita karechi evaM ete kona phATalao nei?
Ami vistRta karechi bha‚mike o tAte sthApana karechi parvatamAlA evaM ete udgata karechi naYanaprItikara sarvaprakAra udbhida,
AllAh ra anurAgI pratyeka vyaktira janye jJAna o upadezasvarUpa|
AkAza hate Ami varSaNa kari kalyANakara vRSTi evaM tA diYe Ami sRSTi kari udyAna o paripakva zasyarAji,
o samunnata kharjura vRkSa yAte Ache guccha guccha khejura-
AmAra vAndAdera jIvikAsvarUpa| vRSTi diYe Ami saJjIvita kari mRta bha‚mike; ebhAve utthAna ghaTave|
edera pUrveo satya pratyAkhyAna karechila nUhera sampradAYa, rAs o sAmUda sampradAYa,
‘Ada, phira‘Aona o lUta sampradAYa
evaM AYakAra adhivAsI o tuvvA sampradAYa; erA sakalei rAsUlagaNake mithyAvAdI valechila, phale edera opara AmAra zAsti Apatita haYeche|
Ami ki prathamavAra sRSTi karei klAnta haYe par3echi! vastuta punaH sRSTira viSaYe erA sandehe patita|
Amii mAnuSake sRSTi karechi evaM tAra pravRtti tAke ye kumantraNA deYa tA Ami jAni| Ami tAra grIvAsthita dhamanI apekSAo nikaTatara|
smaraNa rekha, ‘dui grahaNakArI’ phirizatA tAra dakSiNe o vAme vase tAra karma lipivaddha kare;
mAnuSa ye kathAi uccAraNa kare tAra janye tatpara praharI tAra nikaTei raYeche|
mRtyuyantraNA satyai Asave; eTA hatei tomarA avyAhati ceYe esecho|
Ara ziGgAYa phutkAra deoYA have, eTAi zAstira dina|
sedina pratyeka vyakti upasthita have, tAra saGge thAkave cAlaka o sAkSI|
tumi ei divasa samvandhe udAsIna chile, ekhana Ami tomAra sammukha hate pardA unmocana karechi| adya tomAra dRSTi prakhara|
tAra saGgI pherezatA valave, ‘ei to AmAra nikaTa ‘AmalanAmA prastuta|’
Adeza karA have, tomarA ubhaYe nikSepa kara jAhAnnAme pratyeka uddhata kAphirake-
kalyANakara kAje pravala vAdhAdAnakArI, sImAlaMghanakArI o sandeha poSaNakArI|
ye vyakti AllAh ra saGge anya ilAh grahaNa karata tAke kaThina zAstite nikSepa kara|
tAra sahacara zaYatAna valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Ami tAke avAdhya kari nAi| vastuta se-i chila ghora vibhrAnta|
AllAh valavena, ‘AmAra sAmane vAka-vitaNDA kara nA; tomAderake Ami to pUrvei satarka karechi|
‘AmAra kathAra radavadala haYa nA evaM Ami AmAra vAndAdera prati kona avicAra kari nA|’
sedina Ami jAhAnnAmake jijJAsA karava, ‘tumi ki pUrNa haYe gecho?’ jAhAnnAma valave, ‘Arao Ache ki?’
Ara jAnnAtake nikaTastha karA have muttAkIdera-kona dUratva thAkave nA|
eTArai pratizruti tomAderake deoYA haYechila-pratyeka AllAh-abhimukhI, hiphAyatakArIra janye-
yArA nA dekhe daYAmaYa AllAhke bhaYa kare evaM vinIta citte upasthita haYa-
tAderake valA have, ‘zAntira saGge tomarA ete praveza kara; tA ananta jIvanera dina|’
ekhAne tArA yA kAmanA karave tAi pAve evaM AmAra nikaTa raYeche tArao adhika|
Ami tAdera pUrve Arao kata mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa karechi yArA chila edera apekSA zaktite pravala, erA deze deze ghure ver3Aita; edera kona palAYanasthala raila ki?
nizcaYai ete upadeza raYeche tAra janye yAra Ache antaHkaraNa vA ye zravaNa kare niviSTa citte|
Ami AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI evaM edera antarvartI samasta kichu sRSTi karechi chaYa dine; AmAke kona klAnti sparza kare nAi|
ataeva erA yA vale tAte tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM tomAra pratipAlakera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara sUryeAdaYera pUrve o sUryAstera pUrve,
tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara rAtrira ekAMze evaM sAlAtera pareo|
zona, yedina eka ghoSaNAkArI nikaTavartI sthAna hate AhvAna karave,
yedina mAnuSa avazyai zunate pAve mahAnAda, sei dinai vera haoYAra dina|
Amii jIvana dAna kari, mRtyu ghaTAi evaM sakalera pratyAvartana AmArai dike|
yedina tAdera oparastha yamIna vidIrNa have evaM mAnuSa trasta-vyasta haYe chuTAchuTi karave, ei samaveta samAvezakaraNa AmAra janye sahaja|

kata mahAna tomAra pratipAlakera nAma yini mahimamaYa o mahAnubhava!
yakhana kiYAmata ghaTave,

eTA kAukeo karave nIca, kAukeo karave samunnata;

evaM parvatamAlA cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe par3ave,
phale tA paryavasita have utkSipta dhUlikaNAYa;
evaM tomarA vibhakta haYe par3ave tina zreNIte-
DAna dikera dala; kata bhAgyavAna DAna dikera dala!
evaM vAma dikera dala; kata hatabhAgya vAma dikera dala!
Ara agravartIgaNai to agravartI,
erAi naikaTyaprApta-
niYAmatapUrNa udyAne;
vahusaMkhyaka have pUrvavartIdera madhya hate;
evaM alpasaMkhyaka have paravartIdera madhya hate|
svarNakhacita Asane
erA helAna diYe vasive, paraspara mukhomukhi haYe|
tAdera sevAYa ghorApherA karave cira-kizorerA
pAnapAtra, ku~jA o prasravaNa-niHsRta surApUrNa peYAlA niYe|
sei surA pAne tAdera ziraHpIr3A have nA, tArA jJAnahArAo have nA-

Ara tAdera Ipsita pAkhira gozta niYe,
Ara tAdera janye thAkave AYatalocanA ha‚ra,

Ara erA valata, ‘mariYA asthi o mRttikAYa pariNata haleo ki utthita hava AmarA?
‘evaM AmAdera pUrvapuruSagaNao?’

Ara pAna karave tRSNArta uSTrera nyAYa|

tA ki tomarA sRSTi kara, nA Ami sRSTi kari?
Ami tomAdera madhye mRtyu nirdhArita karechi evaM Ami akSama nai-
tomAdera sthale tomAdera sadRza AnaYana karate evaM tomAderake emana eka AkRtite sRSTi karate yA tomarA jAna nA|

Ami icchA karale eTAke khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata karate pAri, takhana hatavuddhi haYe par3ave tomarA;
‘AmarA to dAYagrasta haYe par3echi’,

‘Aja tomAdera nikaTa hate kona muktipaNa grahaNa karA have nA evaM yArA kupharI karechila tAdera nikaTa hateo naYa| jAhAnnAmai tomAdera AvAsasthala, eTAi tomAdera yogya; kata nikRSTa ei pariNAma!’

yArA ImAna Ane tAdera hRdaYa bhakti-vigalita haoYAra samaYa ki Ase nAi, AllAh ra smaraNe evaM ye satya avatIrNa haYeche tAte? evaM pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYechila tAdera mata yena erA nA haYa-vahu kAla atikrAnta haYe gele yAdera antakaraNa kaThina haYe par3echila| edera adhikAMzai satyatyAgI|
jene rAkha, AllAhi dharitrIke era mRtyura para punarjIvita karena| Ami nidarzanaguli tomAdera janye vizadabhAve vyakta karechi yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUle ImAna Ane, tArAi tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa siddIka o zahIda| tAdera janye raYeche tAdera prApya puraskAra o jyoti evaM yArA kupharI kareche o AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra kareche, erAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

tomarA jene rAkha, pArthiva jIvana to krIr3A-kautuka, jA~kajamaka, pArasparika zAghA, dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite prAcurya lAbhera pratiyogitA vyatIta Ara kichu naYa| era upamA vRSTi, yA diYe utpanna zasya-sambhAra kRSakaderake camatkRta kare, erapara tA zukAiYA yAYa, phale tumi tA pItavarNa dekhate pAo, avazeSe tA khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata haYa| parakAle raYeche kaThina zAsti evaM AllAh ra kSamA o santuSTi| pArthiva jIvana pratAraNAra sAmagrI vyatIta kichui naYa|

tomarA agraNI hao tomAdera pratipAlakera kSamA o sei jAnnAta lAbhera praYAse yA prazastatAYa AkAza o pRthivIra mata, yA prastuta karA haYeche tAdera janye yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlagaNe ImAna Ane| eTA AllAh ra anugraha, yAke icchA tini eTA dAna karena; AllAh mahAanugrahazIla|
pRthivIte vA vyaktigatabhAve tomAdera opara ye viparyaYa Ase Ami tA saMghaTata karAra pUrvei tA lipivaddha thAke; AllAh ra pakSe eTA khuvai sahaja|
eTA eijanye ye, tomarA yA hAriYecha tAte yena tomarA vimarSa nA hao, evaM yA tini tomAderake diYechena tAra janye harSeAtphula nA hao| AllAh pachanda karena nA uddhata o ahaMkArIderake-
yArA kArpaNya kare o mAnuSake kArpaNyera nirdeza deYa evaM ye mukha phiriYe neYa se jene rAkhuka AllAh to abhAvamukta, prazaMsArha|

nizcaYai Ami AmAra rAsUlagaNake preraNa karechi spaSTa pramANasaha evaM tAdera saGge diYechi kitAva o nyAYanIti, yAte mAnuSa suvicAra pratiSThA kare| Ami lauhao diYechi yAte raYeche pracaNDa zakti o raYeche mAnuSera janye vahuvidha kalyANa| eTA eijanye ye, AllAh prakAza kare dena ke pratyakSa nA kareo tA~ke o tA~ra rAsUlagaNake sAhAyya kare| avazyai AllAh zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

Ami nUh evaM ivrAhImake rAsUlarUpe preraNa karechilAma evaM Ami tAdera vaMzadharagaNera janye sthira karechilAma navuoYAta o kitAva, kintu edera alpai satpatha avalamvana karechila evaM adhikAMzai chila satyatyAgI|

erapara Ami tAdera pazcAte anugAmI karechilAma AmAra rAsUlagaNake evaM anugAmI karechilAma mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa IsAke, Ara tAke diYechilAma iJjIla evaM tAra anusArIdera antare diYechilAma karuNA o daYA| Ara sannyAsavAda-eTA to erA nijerAi AllAh ra santuSTi lAbhera janye pravartana karechila| Ami ederake eTAra vidhAna dei nAi; athaca eTAo erA yathAyathabhAve pAlana kare nAi| edera madhye yArA ImAna enechila, ederake Ami diYechilAma puraskAra evaM edera adhikAMzai satyatyAgI|

he mu’minagaNa! AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara| tini tA~ra anugrahe tomAderake divena dviguNa puraskAra evaM tini tomAderake divena Alo, yAra sAhAyye tomarA calave evaM tini tomAderake kSamA karavena; AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

eTA eijanye ye, kitAvIgaNa yena jAnate pAre, AllAh ra sAmAnyatama anugrahera oparao edera kona adhikAra nei| anugraha AllAh ra i ikhtiYAre, yAke icchA tAke tini tA dAna karena| AllAh mahAanugrahazIla|

AllAh avazyai zunechena sei nArIra kathA, ye tAra svAmIra viSaYe tomAra saGge vAdAnuvAda karache evaM AllAh ra nikaTao phariYAda karache| AllAh tomAdera kathopakathana zonena, AllAh sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tomAdera madhye yArA nijedera strIgaNera saGge yihAra kare, tArA jene rAkhuka-tAdera strIgaNa tAdera mAtA nana, yArA tAderake janmadAna kare kevala tArAi tAdera mAtA; erA to asaGgata o asatya kathAi vale| nizcaYai AllAh pApa mocanakArI o kSamAzIla|

yArA nijedera strIgaNera saGge yihAra kare evaM pare edera ukti pratyAhAra kare, tave eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve ekaTi dAsa mukta karate have, eTA diYe tomAderake upadeza deoYA yAcche| tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra khavara rAkhena|

kintu yAra e sAmarthya thAkave nA, eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve tAke ekAdikrame dui mAsa siYAma pAlana karate have; ye tAteo asamartha, se SATajana abhAvagrastake khAoYAve; eTA ejanye ye, tomarA yena AllAh o tA~ra rAsUle vizvAsa sthApana kara| eguli AllAh ra nirdhArita vidhAna; kAphiradera janye raYeche marmantuda zAsti|

yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tAderake apadastha karA have yemana apadastha karA haYeche tAdera pUrvavartIderake; Ami suspaSTa AYAta avatIrNa karechi; kAphiradera janye raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti-
sedina, yedina edera sakalake ekatre utthita karA have evaM ederake jAniYe deoYA have yA erA karata; AllAh era hiseva rekhechena, Ara erA tA vismRta haYeche| AllAh sarvaviSaYe samyaka draSTA|

tumi ki lakSya kara nA, AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache AllAh tA jAnena? tina vyaktira madhye emana kona gopana parAmarza haYa nA yAte caturtha jana hiseve tini upasthita thAkena nA evaM pA~ca vyaktira madhyeo haYa nA yAte SaSTha jana hiseve tini upasthita thAkena nA| erA etadapekSA kama hoka vA vezi hoka tini to tAdera saGgei Achena, erA yekhAnei thAkuka nA kena| erapara erA yA kare, tini ederake kiYAmatera dina tA jAniYe divena| nizcaYai AllAh sarvaviSaYe samyaka avagata|

tumi ki tAderake lakSya kara nA, yAderake gopana parAmarza karate niSedha karA haYechila? erapara erA yA niSiddha tArai punarAvRtti kare evaM pApAcaraNa, sImAlaMghana o rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNera janye kAnAkAni kare| erA yakhana tomAra nikaTa Ase takhana erA tomAke emana kathA diYe abhivAdana kare yA diYe AllAh tomAke abhivAdana karena nAi| erA mane mane vale, ‘AmarA yA vali tAra janye AllAh AmAderake zAsti dena nA kena?’ jAhAnnAmai edera janye yatheSTa, yekhAne erA praveza karave, kata nikRSTa sei AvAsa!

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana gopana parAmarza kara, se parAmarza yena pApAcaraNa, sImAlaMghana o rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa samparke nA haYa| tomarA kalyANakara kAja o tAkoYA avalamvanera parAmarza kara, evaM bhaYa kara AllAhke yA~hAra nikaTa tomAderake samaveta karA have|

zaYatAnera prarocanAYa haYa ei gopana parAmarza mu’minaderake duHkha deoYAra janye| tave AllAh ra icchA vyatIta zaYatAna tAdera sAmAnyatama kSati sAdhaneo sakSama naYa| mu’minadera kartavya AllAh ra opara nirbhara karA|

he mu’minagaNa! yakhana tomAderake valA haYa, majalise sthAna prazasta kare dAo, takhana tomarA sthAna kare dio, AllAh tomAdera janye sthAna prazasta kare divena evaM yakhana valA haYa, ‘uThe yAo’, tomarA uThe yeo| tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche evaM yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYeche AllAh tAderake maryAdAYa unnata karavena; tomarA yA kara AllAh se samparke savizeSa avahita|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA rAsUlera saGge cupi cupi kathA valate cAile tAra pUrve sAdAkA pradAna karave, eTAi tomAdera janye zreYa o parizodhaka; yadi tAte akSama hao, AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA ki cupe cupe kathA valAra pUrve sAdAkA pradAnake kaSTakara mane kara! yakhana tomarA sAdAkA dite pArale nA, Ara AllAh tomAderake kSamA kare dilena, takhana tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara| tomarA yA kara AllAh tA samyaka avagata|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya kara nAi yArA, AllAh ye sampradAYera prati ruSTa, tAdera saGge vandhutva kare? erA tomAdera dalabhukta naYa, tAdera dalabhuktao naYa evaM erA jene-zune mithyA zapatha kare|
AllAh edera janye prastuta rekhechena kaThina zAsti| erA yA kare tA kata manda!
erA edera zapathagulike DhAlasvarUpa vyavahAra kare, Ara erA AllAh ra patha hate nivRtta kare; ataeva edera janye raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
AllAh ra zAstira mukAvilAYa edera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati edera kona kAje Asave nA; erAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAne erA sthAYI have|

ye dina AllAh punarutthita karavena edera sakalake, takhana erA AllAh ra nikaTa serUpa zapatha karave yerUpa zapatha tomAdera nikaTa kare evaM erA mane kare ye, ete erA bhAla kichura opara raYeche| sAvadhAna! erAi to prakRta mithyAvAdI|
zaYatAna edera opara prabhAva vistAra kareche; phale ederake bhuliYe diYeche AllAh ra smaraNa| erA zaYatAnera dala| sAvadhAna! zaYatAnera dala avazyai kSatigrasta|
yArA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tArA have carama lAJchitadera antarbhukta|
AllAh siddhAnta karechena, Ami avazyai vijaYI hava evaM AmAra rAsUlagaNao| nizcaYai AllAh zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

tumi pAve nA AllAh o AkhirAte vizvAsI emana kona sampradAYa, yArA bhAlavAse AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcArIderake-hoka nA ei viruddhAcArIrA tAdera pitA, putra, bhAi vA edera jJAti-gotra| edera antare AllAh sudRr3ha karechena ImAna evaM tAderake zaktizAlI karechena tA~ra pakSa hate rUh diYe| tini ederake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; sekhAne erA sthAYI have; AllAh edera prati santuSTa haYechena evaM erAo tA~ra prati santuSTa, erAi AllAh ra dala| jene rAkha, AllAh ra dalai saphalakAma have|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare; tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii kitAvIdera madhye yArA kAphira tAderake prathamavAra samavetabhAve tAdera AvAsabhUmi hate vitAr3ita karechilena| tomarA kalpanAo kara nAi ye, erA nirvAsita have evaM erA mane karechila edera durgaguli ederake rakSA karave AllAh hate; kintu AllAh ra zAsti emana eka dika hate elo yA chila edera dhAraNAtIta evaM edera antare tA trAsera saJcAra karala| erA dhvaMsa kare phelala nijedera vAr3ighara nijedera hAte evaM mu’minadera hAteo; ataeva he cakSuSmAna vyaktigaNa! tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|
AllAh edera nirvAsanera siddhAnta nA karale ederake avazyai pRthivIte zAsti ditena; parakAle edera janye raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti|
eTA eijanye ye, erA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa karechila, evaM keu AllAh ra viruddhAcaraNa karale AllAh to zAstidAne kaThora|
tomarA ye kharjura vRkSaguli kartana karecha evaM yeguli kANDera opara sthira rekhe diYecha, tA to AllAh ra i anumatikrame; evaM eijanye ye, AllAh pApAcArIderake lAJchita karavena|

AllAh iYAhUdIdera nikaTa hate tA~ra rAsUlake ye phAYa diYechena, tAra janye tomarA azve kiMvA uSTre ArohaNa kare yuddha kara nAi; AllAh to yAra opara icchA tA~ra rAsUladerake kartRtva dAna karena; AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

AllAh janapadavAsIdera nikaTa hate tA~ra rAsUlake ye phAYa diYechena tA AllAh ra, tA~ra rAsUlera, rAsUlera svajanagaNera, iYAtImadera, abhAvagrasta o pathacArIdera, yAte tomAdera madhye yArA vittavAna kevala tAdera madhyei aizvarya Avartana nA kare| rAsUla tomAderake yA deYa tA tomarA grahaNa kara evaM yA hate tomAderake niSedha kare tA hate virata thAka evaM tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara; AllAh to zAstidAne kaThora|

ei sampada abhAvagrasta muhAjiragaNera janye yArA nijedera gharavAr3i o sampatti hate utkhAta haYeche| tArA AllAh ra anugraha o santuSTi kAmanA kare evaM AllAh o tA~ra rAsUlera sAhAyya kare| erAi to satyAzraYI|

Ara tAdera janyeo, muhAjiradera Agamanera pUrve yArA ei nagarIte vasavAsa kareche o ImAna eneche, tArA muhAjiraderake bhAlavAse evaM muhAjiraderake yA deoYA haYeche tAra janye tArA antare AkAksakSA poSaNa kare nA, Ara tArA tAderake nijedera opara agrAdhikAra deYa nijerA abhAvagrasta haleo| yAderake antarera kArpaNya hate mukta rAkhA haYeche, tArAi saphalakAma|

yArA edera pare eseche, tArA vale, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake evaM ImAne agraNI AmAdera bhAigaNake kSamA kara evaM mu’minadera viruddhe AmAdera antare vidveSa rekha nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi to daYArdra, parama daYAlu|’

tumi ki munAphikaderake dekha nAi? erA kitAvIdera madhye yArA kupharI kareche edera sei sava saGgIke vale, ‘tomarA yadi vahiSkRta hao, AmarA avazyai tomAdera saGge dezatyAgI hava evaM AmarA tomAdera vyApAre kakhanao kArao kathA mAnava nA evaM yadi tomarA AkrAnta hao AmarA avazyai tomAderake sAhAyya karava|’ kintu AllAh sAkSya dicchena ye, erA avazyai mithyAvAdI|

vastuta erA vahiSkRta hale munAphikagaNa tAdera saGge dezatyAga karave nA evaM erA AkrAnta hale erA ederake sAhAyya karave nA evaM erA sAhAyya karate Asaleo avazyai pRSThapradarzana karave; erapara tArA kona sAhAyyai pAve nA|
prakRtapakSe edera antare AllAh apekSA tomAdera bhaYai adhikatara| eTA eijanye ye, erA eka avujha sampradAYa|

erA sakale saMghavaddhabhAveo tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karate samartha have nA, kintu kevala surakSita janapadera abhyantare vA durga-prAcIrera antarAle theke; parasparera madhye edera yuddha pracaNDa| tumi mane kara erA aikyavaddha, kintu edera manera mila nei; eTA eijanye ye, erA eka nirveAdha sampradAYa|
erA sei lokadera mata, yArA edera avyavahita pUrve nijedera kRtakarmera zAsti AsvAdana kareche, edera janye raYeche marmantuda zAsti|
erA zaYatAnera mata, se mAnuSake vale, ‘kupharI kara’; erapara yakhana se kupharI kare takhana se vale, ‘tomAra saGge AmAra kona samparka nei, Ami to jagatasamUhera pratipAlaka AllAhke bhaYa kari|’
phale ubhaYera pariNAma have jAhAnnAma| sekhAne erA sthAYI have evaM eTAi jAlimadera karmaphala|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara; pratyekei bheve dekhuka AgAmIkAlera janye se kI agrima pAThiYeche| Ara tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara; tomarA yA kara AllAh se samparke avahita|
Ara tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA AllAhke bhule geche; phale AllAh ederake AtmavismRta karechena| erAi to pApAcArI|
jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI evaM jAnnAtera adhivAsI samAna naYa| jAnnAtavAsIrAi saphalakAma|
yadi Ami ei kuraAna parvatera opara avatIrNa karatAma tave tumi eke AllAh ra bhaYe vinIta evaM vidIrNa dekhate| Ami ei samasta dRSTAnta varNanA kari mAnuSera janye, yAte tArA cintA kare|
tinii AllAh, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei, tini adRzya o dRzyera parijJAtA; tini daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

tinii AllAh, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei| tinii adhipati, tinii pavitra, tinii zAnti, tinii nirApattA vidhAYaka, tinii rakSaka, tinii parAkramazAlI, tinii pravala, tinii atIva mahimAnvita| erA yAke zarIka sthira kare AllAh tA hate pavitra, mahAna|
tinii AllAh, sRjanakartA, udbhAvanakartA, rUpadAtA, tA~rai sakala uttama nAma| AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache, samastai tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AmAra zatru o tomAdera zatruke vandhurUpe grahaNa kara nA, tomarA edera prati vandhutvera vArtA preraNa karacho, athaca erA, tomAdera nikaTa ye satya eseche, tA pratyAkhyAna kareche, rAsUlake evaM tomAderake vahiSkAra kareche ei kAraNe ye, tomarA tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAhte vizvAsa kara| yadi tomarA AmAra pathe jihAdera uddezye evaM AmAra santuSTi lAbhera janye vahirgata haYe thAka, tave kena tomarA edera saGge gopane vandhutva karacho? tomarA yA gopana kara evaM tomarA yA prakAza kara tA Ami samyaka avagata| tomAdera madhye ye keu eTA kare se to vicyuta haYa sarala patha hate|
tomAderake kAvu karate pArale erA have tomAdera zatru evaM hasta o rasanA diYe tomAdera aniSTa sAdhana karave evaM kAmanA karave ye, tomarAo kupharI kara|
tomAdera AtmIYa-svajana o santAna-santati kiYAmatera dina tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA| AllAh tomAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare divena; tomarA yA kara tini tA dekhena|

tomAdera janye ivrAhIma o tAra anusArIdera madhye raYeche uttama Adarza| yakhana tArA tAdera sampradAYake valechila, ‘tomAdera saGge evaM tomarA AllAh ra parivarte yAra ‘ivAdata kara tAra saGge AmAdera kona samparka nei| AmarA tomAderake mAni nA| tomAdera o AmAdera madhye sRSTi hala zatrutA o vidveSa cirakAlera janye; yadi nA tomarA eka AllAhte ImAna Ana|’ tave vyatikrama tAra pitAra prati ivrAhImera ukti: ‘Ami nizcaYai tomAra janye kSamA prArthanA karava; evaM tomAra vyApAre AllAh ra nikaTa Ami kona adhikAra rAkhi nA|’ ivrAhIma o tAra anusArigaNa valechila, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA tomArai opara nirbhara karechi, tomArai abhimukhI haYechi evaM pratyAvartana to tomArai nikaTa|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAderake kAphiradera pIr3anera pAtra kara nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAderake kSamA kara; tumi to parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’
tomarA yArA AllAh o AkhirAtera pratyAzA kara nizcaYai tAdera janye raYeche uttama Adarza tAdera madhye| keu mukha phiriYe nile se jene rAkhuka, nizcaYai AllAh, tini to abhAvamukta, prazaMsArha|
yAdera saGge tomAdera zatrutA raYeche sambhavata AllAh tAdera o tomAdera madhye vandhutva sRSTi kare divena; AllAh sarvazaktimAna evaM AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

dInera vyApAre yArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kare nAi evaM tomAderake svadeza hate vahiSkAra kare nAi tAdera prati mahAnubhavatA pradarzana o nyAYavicAra karate AllAh tomAderake niSedha karena nA| AllAh to nyAYaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|

AllAh kevala tAdera saGge vandhutva karate niSedha karena yArA dInera vyApAre tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kareche, tomAderake svadeza hate vahiSkAra kareche evaM tomAdera vahiSkaraNe sAhAyya kareche| edera saGge yArA vandhutva kare tArA to jAlima|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera nikaTa mu’mina nArIrA hijarata kare Asale tAderake parIkSA kara, AllAh tAdera ImAna samvandhe samyaka avagata Achena| yadi tomarA jAnate pAra ye, tArA mu’mina tave tAderake kAphiradera nikaTa pherata pAThio nA| mu’mina nArIgaNa kAphiradera janye vaidha naYa evaM kAphiragaNa mu’mina nArIdera janye vaidha naYa| kAphirarA yA vyaYa kareche tA ederake phiriYe dio| erapara tomarA tAderake vivAha karale tomAdera kona aparAdha have nA yadi tomarA tAderake tAdera mAhara dAo| tomarA kAphira nArIdera saGge dAmpatya samparka vajAYa rekha nA| tomarA yA vyaYa karecha tA pherata cAive evaM kAphirarA pherata cAive yA tArA vyaYa kareche| eTAi AllAh ra vidhAna; tini tomAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare thAkena| AllAh sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera strIdera madhye yadi keu hAtachAr3A haYe kAphiradera nikaTa raYe yAYa evaM tomAdera yadi suyoga Ase takhana yAdera strIgaNa hAtachAr3A haYe geche tAderake, tArA yA vyaYa kareche tAra samaparimANa artha pradAna karave, bhaYa kara AllAhke, yAte tomarA vizvAsI|

he navI! mu’mina nArIgaNa yakhana tomAra nikaTa ese vAYa‘Ata kare ei marme ye, tArA AllAh ra saGge kona zarIka sthira karave nA, curi karave nA, vyabhicAra karave nA, nijedera santAna hatyA karave nA, tArA sajJAne kona apavAda racanA kare raTAive nA evaM satkArye tomAke amAnya karave nA takhana tAdera vAYa‘Ata grahaNa kara evaM tAdera janye AllAh ra nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara| AllAh to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAh ye sampradAYera prati ruSTa tomarA tAdera saGge vandhutva kara nA, erA to parakAla samparke hatAza haYe par3eche, yemana hatAza haYeche kAphirarA kavarasthadera viSaYe|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai AllAh ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yA kara nA tA tomarA kena vala?
tomarA yA kara nA tomAdera tA valA AllAh ra dRSTite atizaYa asantoSajanaka|
yArA AllAh ra pathe saMgrAma kare sArivaddhabhAve sudRr3ha prAcIrera mata, AllAh to tAderake bhAlavAsena|

smaraNa kara, mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAke kena kaSTa ditecha yakhana tomarA jAna ye, Ami tomAdera nikaTa AllAh ra rAsUla? erapara erA yakhana vakra patha avalamvana karala takhana AllAh edera hRdaYake vakra kare dilena| AllAh pApAcArI sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|

smaraNa kara, mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa ‘IsA valechila, ‘he vanI isrAIla! avazyai Ami tomAdera nikaTa AllAh ra rAsUla evaM AmAra pUrva hate tomAdera nikaTa ye tAorAta raYeche Ami tAra pratyAYanakArI evaM AmAra pare AhmAda nAme ye rAsUla Asavena Ami tAra susaMvAdadAtA| pare se yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha edera nikaTa elo takhana erA valite lAgala, ‘eTA to eka spaSTa jAdu|’
ye vyakti isalAmera dike AhUta haYeo AllAh samvandhe mithyA racanA kare tAra apekSA adhika jAlima Ara ke? AllAh jAlima sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|
erA AllAh ra nUra phutkAre nibhAite cAYa, kintu AllAh tA~ra nUra pUrNarUpe udbhAsita karavena, yadio kAphirarA tA apachanda kare|
tinii tA~ra rAsUlake preraNa karechena hidAYAta o satya dInasaha sakala dInera opara eke vijaYI karAra janye, yadio muzarikarA tA apachanda kare|
he mu’minagaNa! Ami ki tomAderake emana eka vANijyera sandhAna diva yA tomAderake rakSA karave marmantuda zAsti hate?
tA ei ye, tomarA AllAh o tA~ra rAsUle vizvAsa sthApana karave evaM tomAdera dhana-sampada o jIvana diYe AllAh ra pathe jihAda karave| eTAi tomAdera janye zreYa yadi tomarA jAnate!
AllAh tomAdera pApa kSamA kare divena evaM tomAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, evaM sthAYI jAnnAtera uttama vAsagRhe| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
evaM tini dAna karavena tomAdera vAJchita Arao ekaTi anugraha: AllAh ra sAhAyya o Asanna vijaYa; mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAh ra dInera sAhAyyakArI hao, yemana mAraiya়Ama-tanaYa IsA hAoYArIgaNake valechila, ‘AllAh ra pathe ke AmAra sAhAyyakArI have?’ hAoYArIgaNa valechila, ‘AmarAi AllAh ra pathe sAhAyyakArI|’ erapara vanI isrAIlera ekadala ImAna Anila evaM ekadala kupharI karala| takhana Ami yArA ImAna enechila, tAdera zatrudera mukAvilAYa tAderake zaktizAlI karalAma, phale tArA vijaYI hala|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare AllAh ra, yini adhipati, mahApavitra, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii ummIdera madhye ekajana rAsUla pAThiYechena tAdera madhya hate, ye tAdera nikaTa AvRtti kare tA~ra AYAtasamUha; tAderake pavitra kare evaM zikSA deYa kitAva o hikmata; itipUrve to erA chila ghora vibhrAntite;
evaM tAdera anyAnyera janyeo yArA ekhanao tAdera saGge milita haYa nAi| AllAh parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
eTA AllAh ra i anugraha, yAke icchA tini eTA dAna karena| AllAh to mahA anugrahazIla|

yAderake tAorAtera dAYitvabhAra arpaNa karA haYechila, kintu tArA tA vahana kare nAi, tAdera dRSTAnta pustaka vahanakArI gardabha! kata nikRSTa se sampradAYera dRSTAnta yArA AllAh ra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare! AllAh jAlima sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|
vala, ‘he iYAhUdIrA! yadi tomarA mane kara tomarAi AllAh ra vandhu, anya kona mAnavagoSThI naYa; tave tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
kintu erA edera hasta diYe yA agre preraNa kareche era kAraNe kakhanao mRtyu kAmanA karave nA| AllAh jAlimadera samparke samyaka avagata|

vala, ‘tomarA ye mRtyu hate palAYana kara sei mRtyu tomAdera saGge avazyai sAkSAt karave| erapara tomarA pratyAnIta have adRzya o dRzyera parijJAtA AllAh ra nikaTa evaM tini tomAderake jAniYe divena yA tomarA karate|’
he mu’minagaNa! jumu‘Ara dine yakhana sAlAtera janye AhvAna karA haYa takhana tomarA AllAh ra smaraNe dhAvita hao evaM kraYa-vikraYa tyAga kara, eTAi tomAdera janye zreYa yadi tomarA upalavdhi kara|
sAlAta samApta hale tomarA pRthivIte char3iYe par3ave evaM AllAh ra anugraha sandhAna karave o AllAhke adhika smaraNa karave, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|

yakhana tArA dekhala vyavasAYa o kautuka takhana tArA tomAke dA~r3Ana avasthAYa rekhe era dike chuTe gela| vala, ‘AllAh ra nikaTa yA Ache tA krIr3A-kautuka o vyavasAYa apekSA utkRSTa|’ AllAh sarvazreSTha riyikadAtA|

yakhana munAphikarA tomAra nikaTa Ase tArA vale, ‘AmarA sAkSya dicchi ye, Apani nizcaYai AllAh ra rAsUla|’ AllAh jAnena ye, tumi nizcaYai tA~ra rAsUla evaM AllAh sAkSya dicchena ye, munAphikarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
erA edera zapathagulike DhAlarUpe vyavahAra kare Ara erA AllAh ra patha hate mAnuSake nivRtta kare| erA yA karateche tA kata manda!
eTA eijanye ye, erA ImAna AnavAra para kupharI kareche| phale edera hRdaYa mohara kare deoYA haYeche; pariNAme erA vujhe nA|

tumi yakhana edera dike tAkAo edera dehAkRti tomAra nikaTa prItikara mane haYa evaM erA yakhana kathA vale, tumi sAgrahe edera kathA zono, yadio erA deoYAle ThekAna kAThera stambhasadRza; erA ye kona zoragolake mane kare ederai viruddhe| erAi zatru, ataeva edera samparke satarka hao; AllAh ederake dhvaMsa karuna! vibhrAnta haYe erA kothAYa caleche!
yakhana ederake valA haYa, ‘tomarA Asa, AllAh ra rAsUla tomAdera janye kSamA prArthanA karavena,’ takhana erA mAthA phiriYe neYa evaM tumi ederake dekhate pAo, erA dambhabhare phire yAYa|
tumi edera janye kSamA prArthanA kara vA nA kara, ubhaYai edera janye samAna| AllAh ederake kakhanao kSamA karavena nA| AllAh pApAcArI sampradAYake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|
erAi vale, ‘tomarA AllAh ra rAsUlera sahacaradera janye vyaYa kara nA, yAte erA sare par3e|’ AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIra dhanabhANDAra to AllAh ra i; kintu munAphikarA tA vujhe nA|
erA vale, ‘AmarA madInAYa pratyAvartana karale sekhAna hate avazyai pravala durvalake vahiSkAra karave|’ kintu zakti to AllAh ra i, Ara tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minadera| tave munAphikarA eTA jAne nA|
‘he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera aizvarya o santAna-santati yena tomAderake AllAh ra smaraNe udAsIna nA kare, yArA udAsIna have tArAi to kSatigrasta|

Ami tomAderake ye riyika diYechi tomarA tA hate vyaYa karave tomAdera kArao mRtyu AsAra pUrve| anyathAYa mRtyu Asale se valave, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke Arao kichukAlera janye avakAza dile Ami sAdAkA ditAma evaM satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta hatAma!’
kintu yakhana kArao nirdhArita kAla upasthita have, takhana AllAh tAke kichutei avakAza divena nA| tomarA yA kara AllAh se samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai AllAh ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, Adhipatya tA~rai evaM prazaMsA tA~rai; tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena, erapara tomAdera madhye keu haYa kAphira evaM tomAdera madhye keu haYa mu’mina| tomarA yA kara AllAh tAra samyaka draSTA|
tini sRSTi karechena AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivI yathAyathabhAve evaM tomAderake AkRti dAna karechena-tomAdera AkRti karechena suzobhana, evaM pratyAvartana to tA~rai nikaTa|
AkAzamaNDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai tini jAnena evaM tini jAnena tomarA yA gopana kara o tomarA yA prakAza kara evaM tini antaryAmI|
tomAdera nikaTa ki peৗ~che nAi pUrvavartI kAphiradera vRttAnta? erA edera karmera manda phala AsvAdana karechila evaM edera janye raYeche marmantuda zAsti|

tA eijanye ye, edera nikaTa edera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzanasaha Asata takhana erA valata, ‘mAnuSai ki AmAderake pathera sandhAna dive?’ erapara erA kupharI karala o mukha phiriYe nila| kintu ete AllAh ra kichu Ase yAYa nA; AllAh abhAvamukta, prazaMsArha|

kAphirarA dhAraNA kare ye, erA kakhanao punarutthita have nA| vala, ‘nizcaYai have, AmAra pratipAlakera zapatha! tomarA avazyai punarutthita have| erapara tomarA yA karate tomAderake se samvandhe avazyai avahita karA have| eTA AllAh ra pakSe sahaja|’
ataeva tomarA AllAh, tA~ra rAsUla o ye jyoti Ami avatIrNa karechi tAte vizvAsa sthApana kara| tomAdera kRtakarma samparke AllAh savizeSa avahita|

smaraNa kara, yedina tini tomAderake samaveta karavena samAveza divase sedina have lAbha-lokasAnera dina| ye vyakti AllAhe vizvAsa kare o satkarma kare tini tAra pApa mocana karavena evaM tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte; yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA have cirasthAYI| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
kintu yArA kupharI kare evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUhake asvIkAra kare tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| kata manda sei pratyAvartanasthala!
AllAh ra anumati vyatireke kona vipadai Apatita haYa nA evaM ye AllAhke vizvAsa kare tini tAra antarake supathe paricAlita karena| AllAh sarvaviSaYe samyaka avahita|
tomarA AllAh ra Anugatya kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara; yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe lao, tave AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva kevala spaSTabhAve pracAra karA|
AllAh, tini vyatIta kona ilAh nei; sutarAM mu’minagaNa AllAh ra opara nirbhara karuka|

‘he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera strI o santAna-santatidera madhye keu keu tomAdera zatru; ataeva tAdera samparke tomarA satarka theka| tomarA yadi ederake mArjanA kara, edera doSatruTi upekSA kara evaM ederake kSamA kara, tave jene rAkha, AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomAdera sampada o santAna-santati to parIkSAvizeSa; Ara AllAh, tA~rai nikaTa raYeche mahApuraskAra|
tomarA AllAhke yathAsAdhya bhaYa kara, evaM zona, Anugatya kara o vyaYa kara tomAdera nijederai kalyANera janye; yArA antarera kArpaNya hate mukta; tArAi saphalakAma|
yadi tomarA AllAhke uttama RNa dAna kara tini tomAdera janye tA vahuguNa vRddhi karavena evaM tini tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAh guNagrAhI, dhairyazIla|
tini dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtA, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he navI! tomarA yakhana tomAdera strIgaNake tAlAka dite icchA kara, ederake tAlAka dio ‘iddatera prati lakSya rekhe evaM tomarA ‘iddatera hiseva rekha evaM tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAhke bhaYa kara| tomarA ederake edera vAsagRha hate vahiSkAra kara nA evaM erAo yena vera nA haYa, yadi nA erA lipta haYa spaSTa azlIlatAYa| eiguli AllAh ra nirdhArita sImA; ye AllAh ra sImA laMghana kare se nijerai opara atyAcAra kare| tumi jAna nA, haYato AllAh eTAra para kona upAYa kare divena|

edera ‘iddata pUraNera kAla Asanna hale tomarA haYa yathAvidhi ederake rekhe dive, nA haYa ederake yathAvidhi parityAga karave evaM tomAdera madhya hate du’jana nyAYaparAYaNa lokake sAkSI rAkhave; Ara tomarA AllAh ra janye saThika sAkSya dive| eTA diYe tomAdera madhye ye keu AllAh o AkhirAte vizvAsa kare tAke upadeza deoYA hacche| ye keu AllAhke bhaYa kare AllAh tAra patha kare divena,

evaM tAke tAra dhAraNAtIta utsa hate dAna karavena riyika| ye vyakti AllAh ra opara nirbhara kare tAra janye AllAhi yatheSTa| AllAh tA~ra icchA pUraNa karavenai; AllAh samasta kichura janye sthira karechena nirdiSTa mAtrA|

tomAdera ye sakala strIra Ara RtumatI haoYAra AzA nei tAdera ‘iddata samparke tomarA sandeha karale tAdera ‘iddatakAla have tina mAsa evaM yArA ekhanao rajaHsvalA haYa nAi tAderao; Ara garbhavatI nArIdera ‘iddatakAla santAna prasava paryanta| AllAhke ye bhaYa kare AllAh tAra samasyA samAdhAna sahaja kare divena|
eTA AllAh ra vidhAna yA tini tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena| AllAhke ye bhaYa kare tini tAra pApa mocana karavena evaM tAke divena mahApuraskAra|

tomarA tomAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI yerUpa gRhe vAsa kara tAderakeo serUpa gRhe vAsa karate dive; tAderake uttyakta karave nA saGkaTe phelAra janye; tArA garbhavatI haYe thAkale santAna prasava paryanta tAdera janye vyaYa karave| yadi tArA tomAdera santAnaderake stanya dAna kare tave tAderake pArizramika dive evaM santAnera kalyANa samparke tomarA saGgatabhAve nijedera madhye parAmarza karave| tomarA yadi nija nija dAvite anamanIYa hao tA hale anya nArI tAra pakSe stanya dAna karave|

vittavAna nija sAmarthya anuyAYI vyaYa karave evaM yAra jIvanopakaraNa sImita se AllAha yA dAna karechena tA hate vyaYa karave| AllAh yAke ye sAmarthya diYechena tadapekSA gurutara vojhA tini tAra opara cApAna nA| AllAh kaSTera para divena svasti|
kata janapada edera pratipAlaka o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera nirdezera viruddhAcaraNa karechila! phale Ami edera nikaTa hate kaThora hiseva niYechilAma evaM ederake diYechilAma kaThina zAsti|
erapara erA edera kRtakarmera zAsti AsvAdana karala; kSatii hala edera karmera pariNAma|
AllAh edera janye kaThora zAsti prastuta rekhechena| ataeva tomarA AllAhke bhaYa kara, he vodhasampanna vyaktigaNa! yArA ImAna enecha| nizcaYa AllAh tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena upadeza-

eka rAsUla, ye tomAdera nikaTa AllAh ra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha AvRtti kare, yArA mu’mina o satkarmaparAYaNa tAderake andhakAra hate Alote AnAra janye| ye keu AllAhe vizvAsa kare o satkarma kare tini tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have; AllAh tAke uttama riyika divena|

AllAhi sRSTi karechena sapta AkAza evaM edera anurUpa pRthivIo, edera madhye neme Ase tA~ra nirdeza; yAte tomarA vujhate pAra ye, AllAh sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna evaM jJAne AllAh savakichuke pariveSTana kare Achena|
he navI! AllAh tomAra janye yA vaidha karechena tumi tA niSiddha karacho kena? tumi tomAra strIdera santuSTi cAicho; AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAh tomAdera kasama hate mukti lAbhera vyavasthA karechena, AllAh tomAdera karmavidhAYaka, tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

smaraNa kara-navI tAra strIdera ekajanake gopane ekaTi kathA valechila| erapara yakhana se tA anyake vale diYechila evaM AllAh navIke tA jAniYe diYechilena, takhana navI ei viSaYe kichu vyakta karala evaM kichu avyakta rAkhalo| yakhana navI tA tAra sei strIke jAnAila takhana se valala, ‘ke ApanAke eTA avahita karala?’ navI valala, ‘AmAke avahita karechena tini, yini sarvajJa, samyaka avagata|’

yadi tomarA ubhaYe anutapta haYe AllAh ra dike pratyAvartana kara tave bhAla, kAraNa tomAdera hRdaYa to jhu~ke par3eche| kintu tomarA yadi navIra viruddhe eke aparera poSakatA kara tave jene rAkha, AllAhi tAra vandhu evaM jivrAIla o satkarmaparAYaNa mu’minagaNao, tA chAr3A anyAnya pherezatAo tAra sAhAyyakArI|

yadi navI tomAdera sakalake parityAga kare tave tAra pratipAlaka sambhavata tomAdera sthale tAke divena tomAdera apekSA utkRSTatara strI- yArA have AtmasamarpaNakArI, vizvAsI, anugata, taovAkArI, ‘ivAdatakArI, siYAma pAlanakArI, akumArI evaM kumArI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA nijederake evaM tomAdera parivAra-parijanake rakSA kara doyakha hate, yAra indhana have mAnuSa o prastara, yAte niYojita Ache nirmamahRdaYa, kaThorasvabhAva pherezatAgaNa, yArA amAnya kare nA tA, yA AllAh tAderake Adeza karena| Ara tArA yA karate AdiSTa haYa tAi kare|
he kAphiragaNa! Aja tomarA doSa skhAlanera ceSTA kara nA| tomarA yA karate tomAderake tArai pratiphala deoYA have|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAh ra nikaTa taovA kara-vizuddha taovA; tA hale tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera manda karmaguli mocana kare divena evaM tomAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| sei dina AllAh lajjA divena nA navIke evaM tAra mu’mina saGgIderake, tAdera jyoti tAdera sAmane o dakSiNa pArzve dhAvita have| tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera jyotike pUrNatA dAna kara evaM AmAderake kSamA kara, nizcaYai tumi sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|’
he navI! kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe jihAda kara evaM edera prati kaThora hao| edera AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma, tA kata nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|

AllAh kAphiradera janye nUhera strI o lUtera strIra dRSTAnta dicchena, erA chila AmAra vAndAdera madhye dui satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAra adhIna| kintu erA tAdera prati vizvAsaghAtakatA karechila| phale nUh o lUta ederake AllAh ra zAsti hate rakSA karate pArala nA evaM ederake valA hala, ‘tomarA ubhaYe pravezakArIdera saGge jAhAnnAme praveza kara|’

AllAh mu’minadera janye dicchena phira‘Aona patnIra dRSTAnta, ye prArthanA karechila: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tomAra sannidhAne jAnnAte AmAra janye ekaTi gRha nirmANa kara evaM AmAke uddhAra kara phirA‘Aona o tAra duSkRti hate evaM AmAke uddhAra kara jAlima sampradAYa hate|’

Arao dRSTAnta dicchena imarAna-tanaYA mAraiya়Amera-ye tAra satItva rakSA karechila, phale Ami tAra madhye rUh phu~ke diYechilAma evaM se tAra pratipAlakera vANI o tA~ra kitAvasamUha satya vale grahaNa karechila, se chila anugatadera anyatama|
mahAmahimAnvita tini, sarvamaYa kartRtva yA~hAra karAYatta; tini sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
yini sRSTi karechena mRtyu o jIvana, tomAderake parIkSA karAra janye-ke tomAdera madhye karme uttama? tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla,
yini sRSTi karechena stare stare saptAkAza| daYAmaYa AllAh ra sRSTite tumi kona khu~ta dekhate pAve nA; tumi AvAra tAkAiYA dekha, kona truTi dekhate pAo ki?
erapara tumi vAravAra dRSTi phirAo, sei dRSTi vyartha o klAnta haYe tomAra dike phire Asave|
Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake suzobhita karechi pradIpamAlA diYe evaM ederake karechi zaYatAnera prati nikSepera upakaraNa evaM edera janye prastuta rekhechi jvalanta agnira zAsti|
yArA tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra kare tAdera janye raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti; tA kata manda pratyAvartanasthala!
yakhana erA tanmadhye nikSipta have takhana erA jAhAnnAmera vikaTa zavda zunave, Ara tA have udvelita|
roSe jAhAnnAma yena pheTe par3ave, yakhanai ete kona dalake nikSepa karA have, ederake rakSIrA jijJAsA karave, ‘tomAdera nikaTa ki kona satarkakArI Ase nAi?’
erA valave, ‘avazyai AmAdera nikaTa satarkakArI esechila, AmarA ederake mithyAvAdI gaNya karechilAma evaM valechilAma, ‘AllAh kichui avatIrNa karena nAi, tomarA to mahAvibhrAntite raYecha|’
evaM erA Arao valave, ‘yadi AmarA zunatAma vA viveka-vuddhi praYoga karatAma, tA hale AmarA jAhAnnAmavAsI hatAma nA|’
erA edera aparAdha svIkAra karave| dhvaMsa jAhAnnAmIdera janye|
yArA dRSTira agocare tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare tAdera janye raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
tomarA tomAdera kathA gopanei vala vA prakAzye vala, tini to antaryAmI|
yini sRSTi karechena, tini ki jAnena nA? tini sUkSmadarzI, samyaka avagata|
tinii to tomAdera janye bhUmike sugama kare diYechena; ataeva tomarA era diga-digante vicaraNa kara evaM tA~ra pradatta jIvanopakaraNa hate AhArya grahaNa kara; punarutthAna to tA~rai nikaTa|
tomarA ki eTA hate nirbhaYa haYecha ye, yini AkAze raYechena tini tomAderakesaha bha‚mike dhasiYe divena, anantara tA AkasmikabhAve thara thara kare kA~pite thAkave?
athavA tomarA ki eTA hate nirbhaYa haYecha ye, AkAze yini raYechena tini tomAdera opara kaGkaravarSI jhaJjhA preraNa karavena? takhana tomarA jAnate pArave kirUpa chila AmAra satarkavANI!
edera pUrvavartIrAo asvIkAra karechila; phale kirUpa haYechila AmAra zAsti!
erA ki lakSya kare nA edera Urdhvadeze vihaGgakulera prati, yArA pakSa vistAra kare o saGkucita kare? daYAmaYa AllAhi ederake sthira rAkhena| tini sarvaviSaYe samyaka draSTA|
